trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 3 () damage to the target.

action.name: Talon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Summon Air Elemental
entries: Five aarakocra within 30 feet of each other can magically summon an air elemental. Each of the five must use its action and movement on three consecutive turns to perform an aerial dance and must maintain concentration while doing so (as if concentrating on a spell). When all five have finished their third turn of the dance, the elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of them. It is friendly toward them and obeys their spoken commands. It remains for 1 hour, until it or all its summoners die, or until any of its summoners dismisses it as a bonus action. A summoner can't perform the dance again until it finishes a short rest. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within 5 feet of it can return with it.

action.name: Dagger

action.name: Radiant Pellet

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The abhorrent overlord's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Insatiable Greed
entries: The abhorrent overlord can sense the presence of gold within 1000 feet of itself. It can determine which location has the greatest amount of gold and can sense the direction to that site. If the gold is being moved, it knows the direction of the movement. It can't locate gold if any thickness of clay or lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between it and the gold.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abhorrent overlord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abhorrent overlord makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The abhorrent overlord regains hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt if the target is a creature.

action.name: Storm of Crows (Recharge 6)
entries: The abhorrent overlord conjures a swarm of spectral crows and harpies in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the overlord can see within 120 feet of it. The sphere remains for 1 minute or until the overlord loses concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), and its area is lightly obscured and difficult terrain.

Any creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 16 (3d10) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Multilayer Ward
entries: Whenever the abjurer is hit with an attack, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 13.

trait.name: Abjurative Purge (1/Day)
entries: At the start of each of the abjurer's turns, it can end one spell or condition affecting it or a creature within 30 feet, or can restore its AC to 18.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abjurer makes two attacks with its Nullsteel Staff or Threadbind.

action.name: Nullsteel Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) force damage.
This attack ignores any bonuses to the target's AC provided by spells, magic items, or other magical effects.

action.name: Threadbind (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) force damage.
Whether this attack hits or misses, the next attack made against the target is made at advantage. On a critical hit, the target is restrained until the end of the abjurer's next turn (escape DC 14).

action.name: Sunder Arms (Recharge 5-6, 4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the abjurer can see within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) thunder damage and one weapon or spell focus carried by it flies 30 (1d6 x 10) feet in a direction of the abjurer's choice, or half as much damage on a success.
Nonmagical weapons affected by this spell shatter and are destroyed.

reaction.name: Dilute (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the abjurer can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the abjurer can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, any damage dealt by the spell is reduced by half.

reaction.name: Syncopate (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the abjurer can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the abjurer can roll a d6. If the result is greater than the level of the triggering spell, the spell fails, and any action or spell slot used in its casting is wasted.

action.name: Thunderous Rejection (3rd Level Spell)

action.name: Adamant Stand (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The abjurer bolsters up to two creatures of its choice within 30 feet of it against harm. Until the start of the abjurer's next turn, each creature has resistance to all damage and regains its reaction at the start of each turn.

action.name: Asylum Field (5th Level Spell, Concentration)

reaction.name: Mirrorveil (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When the abjurer is missed with a spell attack roll, it can force the attacker to make a new attack roll with the same spell, targeting itself.

reaction.name: Mage's Misstep (3rd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the abjurer teleports, the abjurer can force it to make a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw. legendary.name: Vigor on the Brink (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 feet gains 10 temporary hit points. If the target is at 0 hit points, it instead gains 20 temporary hit points and is stabilized.

legendary.name: Beacon of Shelter (2nd Level Spell)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mucous Cloud
entries: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for  hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Probing Telepathy
entries: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Enslave (3/Day)
entries: The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
entries: The aboleth makes one tail attack.

legendary.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

trait.name: Abolethic Vessel
entries: The spawn must obey its aboleth master.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The spawn can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Water Dependency
entries: The spawn takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes it goes without being immersed in water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn makes one Spear attack, two Tentacle attacks, and one Psychic Lash attack.

action.name: Spear

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The yeti has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Snow-Dweller
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain, and can see in areas heavily obscured due to falling snow as though they were lightly obscured.
If the yeti allows itself to be covered in snow while remaining motionless for 24 hours, it becomes undetectable except by magic until it moves or is uncovered.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the yeti may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Burial Slam
entries: The yeti slams a creature grappled by it into the ground, releasing it. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 52 (8d12) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

If the ground is comprised of packed snow or ice, a creature that fails this save is additionally buried 5 feet beneath the surface (escape DC 18). While buried, a creature is blinded, restrained, and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Chilling Gaze (Recharges when the yeti takes the Hide action)

entries: One creature the yeti can see within 40 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) cold damage, then gain an equal number of temporary hit points it is encased in a shell of ice.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is paralyzed. A creature freed from this effect by bludgeoning damage immediately takes 14 (4d6) additional slashing damage.

action.name: Blizzard Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: he yeti exhales a 30-foot cone of frigid air. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) cold plus 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or take half as much damage on a success.
Additionally, the area becomes difficult terrain as spines of jagged ice grow forth. A creature that moves into or within the area takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

reaction.name: Eerie Whistle (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the yeti takes damage, it lets out an echoing whistle, and each other yeti within 1 mile may also take this reaction.

Each non-yeti creature within 1 mile of three or more yetis that took this reaction must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened by each of them for the next minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Freezing Howl
entries: As a reaction when a creature climbing on the yeti hits it with an attack, the yeti howls furiously.
The attacker must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) cold plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage and be stunned until the end of the yeti's next turn.
The yeti does not roll to recharge its Blizzard Breath on its following turn.

reaction.name: Invoke Avalanche (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 50 hit points, the yeti falls prone and begins to pound the earth, screaming with wild fury.
At the beginning of its next turn, if the yeti is not incapacitated, an avalanche begins to slide down the nearest slope.

name: Abyssal Chicken
languages: telepathy 60 ft. (Works Only With Creatures That Understand Abyssal)

trait.name: Bad Flier
entries: The abyssal chicken falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

action.name: Fanged Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Razor Talon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Then, if the target is unconscious, the abyssal chicken may lay a barbed egg in the wound this turn as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Henpeck
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet receives magical healing, the abyssal chicken makes a Fanged Bite attack against it.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The achaierai have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spring Attack
entries: The achaierai can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The achaierai makes two attacks with its talons and one attack with its beak.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Talon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Defensive Cloud
entries: When injured the achaierai can use its reaction to release a cloud of poisonous gas in a 10-foot radius. All creatures in the cloud take 7 (2d6) poison damage and must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned the target is confused as if from a confusion spell. At the end of its turns, the affected target can repeat the Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds the confusion ends. Achaierai are immune to the effects of this cloud.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The acolyte is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The acolyte has following cleric spells prepared:

action.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Forcebreaker
entries: The dragon can destroy an adjacent creation of magical force, such as that produced by Wall of Force or Forcecage, by spending 10 feet of movement.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 30 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 17.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20).

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Shattergem Breath
entries: The dragon breathes forth a hail of luminous crystals in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Singularity Breath
entries: The dragon creates a shining bead of gravitational force in its mouth, then releases the energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 45 (10d8) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Psychokinetic Hurl
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be flung up to 20 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes invisible to one creature it can see until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature that it can telepathically communicate with.

reaction.name: Psychoport Inversion
entries: As a reaction when a creature teleports to or away from a space the dragon can see, the dragon forces it to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force damage and immediately teleport back.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon uses its Psionic Empowerment.

legendary.name: Gravity Collapse
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of a line of gems created by the dragon's breath must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward it by the most direct route.

legendary.name: Detonate Gems (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One line of gems created by the dragon's breath detonates in a chained explosion of force. Each creature within 15 feet of the line must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 33 (6d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Forge Touch (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 fire damage.
If three or more azer contributed to this attack and the target is wielding a metal weapon, the target must either drop the weapon or take an additional 5 fire damage.

action.name: Swelter (Group Action)
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the azer takes 2 fire damage for each azer within 5 feet of it that took this action, including itself.

trait.name: Cherry-Hot
entries: At the start of each of the azer's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. If the azer takes any amount of cold damage, this trait is disabled until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Firestone Sledge
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Stoke Flames (1st Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 30 feet of the azer must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target begins burning (1d10), or has its burning value increase by 1d10 if it is already burning.

action.name: Bodge-Weld
entries: The azer hastily repairs an allied azer or construct within 5 feet of it. The target takes 5 fire damage, then gains 15 temporary hit points.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it ignores the effects of being dazed, paralyzed, or stunned.

reaction.name: Work-Harden
entries: When the azer is hit by an attack, after taking damage, it gains a +2 bonus to its AC until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Cherry-Hot
entries: At the start of each of the azer's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. If the azer takes any amount of cold damage, this trait is disabled until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Burstflame Barrage

action.name: Slag Splash (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the azer can see within 15 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and globs of liquid metal stick to it, reducing its speed by a cumulative 10 feet.
If the target is hit with a melee attack or uses its action to free itself, any reduction to its speed ends.

action.name: Forgefire Chains (Recharge 5-6, 5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the azer can see within 60 feet must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 (8d6) fire damage and begins burning (1d10). While the target is burning in this way, it is considered restrained. On a success, the target takes half as much damage and does not begin burning.

reaction.name: Preserve Spark

trait.name: Cherry-Hot

trait.name: Lord of the Ninth
entries: Creatures within 500 feet of Asmodeus act on an initiative that he chooses for them, instead of rolling. At initiative count 0 of each round, he can choose a new initiative for each creature in the area.

trait.name: Eyes of Hell
entries: Asmodeus telepathically learns the details of every act of callousness, deception, or cruelty ever committed by a creature that meets his gaze.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery
entries: When Asmodeus would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.

items.name: Resistance
entries: The target takes an additional 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

items.name: Sacrifice
entries: One non-artifact, non-consumable magic item of the target's choice that it is wearing or carrying disintegrates.

items.name: Service
entries: The target is dominated by Asmodeus until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Submission
entries: The target kneels, falling prone.

action.name: Clothe in Terrors (9th Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of Asmodeus of his choice that can see him is frightened of him until the end of its next turn, then each frightened creature takes 67 (6d8 + 40) nonlethal psychic damage and falls prone.

action.name: Make Low (9th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Asmodeus can see within 60 feet of him must make a DC 27 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is cursed, shapeshifting into a small and wormlike form.

items: Asmodeus can spend any amount of time speaking or observing, and can take the Search action as a free action.
Asmodeus has infinite speed.

entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Molten Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon breaths a spray of lava in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 45 (10d8) fire damage, and it becomes restrained by rapidly hardening igneous rock until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and it isn't restrained.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

bonus.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The dragon makes one claw attack.

legendary.name: Psionics (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon uses Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Explosive Crystal (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The dragon causes the ground to shake and erupt like a volcano at a point it can see within 60 feet of it.  Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) fire damage and be knocked prone.  The ground within 20 feet of that point is also difficult terrain until the lava cools in 1d4 hours.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 10 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each frightened creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Bloodbathed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw while a bleeding or unconscious creature is within 30 feet of it, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite or Tailbarb Stab, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one weapon or piece of armor of Uncommon or lesser rarity that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target prone or grapple it (escape DC 19).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage and the target begins bleeding (1d10).
Any hit against a prone creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 60 feet, where it splashes in a 10 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove DC 18).

A sludge-drenched creature is blinded, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 54 (12d8) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers an acid injury.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 136 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Flesh-Melting Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Mire Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement submerged in murky water, it can attempt to Hide.

legendary.name: Drooling Torment
entries: Acid drips from the dragon's jaws toward a creature grappled by it, dealing 9 (2d8) acid damage to the creature.
The target can use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapple, avoiding the damage on a success.

legendary.name: Peel Nerve (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon makes a Subduing Claw attack.
If this attack hits a creature grappled by the dragon, the target has one spell affect on it end, or gains vulnerability to acid damage until it regains any hit points if it cannot.

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 10 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to the number rolled.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and attacks of opportunity made against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Reserved Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Its save DCs are reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Sparking Bite or Ridgetail Sweep, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Sparking Bite

action.name: Sandhoned Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20).

action.name: Ridgetail Sweep
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed up to 10 feet on a success.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to three creatures the dragon can see within 90 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 33 (6d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 90 foot long, 10 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 66 (12d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Battle of Wits
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can push a creature grappled by it up to 10 feet into the attack's path.
The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence (Insight) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the pushed creature.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 144 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Sand Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its burrow speed. Then, if it started this movement submerged in earth, it can make a Sandhoned Claw attack.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: The dragon inhales, draining the moisture from a creature grappled by it. The creature takes 5 (1d10) necrotic damage, and each potion and other liquid the target is carrying turns to dust until rehydrated.

legendary.name: Skyfury Drop (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon flies up to half its fly speed, then can drop up to 60 feet into an unoccupied space.
If it does, each other creature within 10 feet is pushed up to 10 feet away and must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet the dragon descended.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Burning Aura

entries: The dragon begins telling a story that lasts until the end of its next turn. While the dragon is telling a story, it cannot use its breath weapons, and a creature that can hear the dragon and attempts to target the dragon with an attack or harmful spell must first make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.
The dragon can continue the story as a bonus action on each of its turns, extending the duration until the end of its following turn.

action.name: Breath of Lingering Flames

action.name: Breath of Deepening Sleep
entries: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes and gain 21 (6d6) temporary hit points, or 45 (13d6) temporary hit points if it failed the save by 5 or more. This effect ends for a creature if it loses any non-temporary hit points.

reaction.name: I Wasn't Finished!

If the creature ends this movement off the ground, it does not fall until the end of the dragon's next turn.

legendary.name: Educate the Ignorant (Costs 2 Actions)

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the dragon's choice).

In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

action.name: Slowing Breath
entries: The dragon exhales gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

reaction.name: Heckler's Veto
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see within 60 ft. casting a spell, the dragon forces the creature to make a DC 16 saving throw using the creature's spell casting ability. On a failed save, the spell fails.

legendary.name: Banter
entries: The dragon offers a humorous comment or pun on an action a creature within 60 ft. took on its previous turn. The creature may use its reaction to reply with a humorous comment or salient pun of its own. If it does, both the creature and the dragon have advantage on the next attack or saving throw they make in the next minute. If it fails to do so, the creature has disadvantage on the next attack or saving throw it makes in the next minute.

legendary.name: False Wall
entries: The dragon raises an illusory wall of opaque stone, 20 ft. high and 20 ft. long, within 60 ft. A creature that attempts to pass through must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw to do so. A creature that knows the wall is an illusion makes this save at advantage.

Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may knock the target prone.

action.name: Icecarve Tail
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail, flinging a spray of ice and snow in a 30 foot cone.
Each creature in the area is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) cold damage and be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Raise Hackles
entries: The dragon extends its spined frill and a deep, booming rumble ripples through the air around it in a 20 foot radius.
Each creature in the area that is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence or the Frightened condition must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or lose that immunity for the next minute.

action.name: Winterglass Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 60-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 90 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to Hide from it, the dragon can leap up to 90 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Roar of Triumph
entries: When the dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, it can let out a terrifying roar.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 122 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Winterglass Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the dragon, or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage if it can't.

legendary.name: Ice Tomb
entries: The dragon breathes a layer of dense, translucent ice that encrusts a prone creature within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or gain 15 temporary hit points, or half as many on a success.
A creature that has any of these temporary hit points is restrained and loses two unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or gains a point of exhaustion if it can't.

legendary.name: Uttercold (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dragon deals ignores damage resistance, and it can reroll any of the damage dice of its Winterglass Breath once, taking the second result.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The absorber has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the absorber moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits its claws attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the absorber can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The absorber makes three attacks: one with its bite or Mind Bolt and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) force damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

action.name: Mind Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Tail Ray
entries: When the absorber takes damage from a spell, the absorber takes only half the triggering damage. If the spellcaster is within 60 feet of the absorber, the absorber can force the caster to make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the caster takes the other half of the damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The nullifier's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Horrid Gnashing
entries: The nullifier's mouths gnash incoherently while it can see any enemies. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the nullifier and can hear it must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the creature rolls a  to determine what it does during the current turn:
1-4: The creature is stunned until the end of the turn.
5-6: The creature is frightened until the end of the turn and uses its movement to get as far as possible from the nullifier.
7-8: The creature doesn't move, and it uses its action to make one melee attack against a random creature (other than itself) if one is within reach. It otherwise does nothing.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The nullifier has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nullifier makes three attacks: one with its bites and two with its claws.

action.name: Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it's a creature. The nullifier has two claws, each of which can grapple one target.

reaction.name: Counterspell
entries: The nullifier attempts to interrupt a creature that it can see within 60 feet in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, the nullifier makes a Charisma check with a DC equal to 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The reverser has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reverser makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) force damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

reaction.name: Reversal
entries: When a creature the reverser can see within 30 feet of it regains hit points, the reverser reduces the number of hit points regained to 0, and the reverser deals 13 (3d8) force damage to the creature.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the aerosaur is flying and dives at least 30 feet toward a target and then hits with a bite attack, the attack deals an extra 10 () damage to the target.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The aerosaur doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The aerosaur doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Razor Whirl or Updraft.

action.name: Cloudsteel War Fan
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.
This attack is made at advantage against a flying or levitating creature.

action.name: Razor Whirl
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the myrmidon must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Updraft (Concentration)
entries: One creature the myrmidon can see within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target rises 10 feet into the air and begins levitating for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Bolt Slice
entries: When the myrmidon would be hit with a ranged attack, it can gain a +3 bonus to its Armor Class against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Zephyr Rush
entries: When a creature moves or is pushed out of the myrmidon's reach, it can move up to half its speed.

name: Alkilith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The alkilith can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the alkilith is mionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary slime or fungus.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The alkilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alkilith makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Polluting Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 1 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) acid damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Living Portal (Concentration)
entries: The alkilith begins to channel the essence of the Abyss through its body, becoming a portal to a distant corner of the Abyss.

If the alkilith is still concentrating at the beginning of its next turn, a demon with maximum hit points equal to or less than the alkilith's current hit points is summoned to the nearest unoccupied space, and the alkilith loses half its current hit points.

action.name: Fume (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The area in a 15 ft. radius around the alkilith becomes heavily obscured until the beginning of its next turn as it exudes toxic fumes. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Foment Madness
entries: As a reaction to losing concentration as a result of a melee attack, the alkilith forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by one for the next minute.

name: Allip
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The allip can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Depths of Madness
entries: A creature that attempts to read the allip's mind has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The allip's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Maddening Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) psychic damage and the target's Wisdom score is reduced by 2 (1d4) for the next minute, to a minimum of 1.
A creature whose Wisdom score is reduced to 1 in this way becomes hostile to all living creatures, including itself, until it recovers.

action.name: Whispers of Madness (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each non-fiend, non-undead creature within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature uses its reaction to move up half its speed toward and make a melee attack against a living creature in range.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide
entries: When the allip takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet to a location it can see and turns invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the allosaurus moves at least 30 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the allosaurus can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Vulnerability
entries: The almiraj has disadvantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects. Charm effects that target the almiraj have a duration of Until Dispelled.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. A creature killed by this damage turns to stone.

action.name: Disrupt Hex (1/Day)
entries: The almiraj ends a spell or magical effect of 2nd level or below affecting a creature within 5 ft.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The alseid's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Hide in Plain Sight
entries: The alseid has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide while it is in grassland.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The alseid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alseid makes two radiant touch attacks.

action.name: Radiant Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) radiant damage.

name: Amber Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Ambush Drake
languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The drake has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the drake's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the drake surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 () damage from the attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 15 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 13.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) force damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Shattergem Breath
entries: The dragon breathes forth a hail of luminous crystals in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

At the end of the dragon's next turn, the gems detonate. Each creature within 5 feet of the line must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Singularity Breath
entries: The dragon creates a shining bead of gravitational force in its mouth, then releases the energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (5d8) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Telekinetic Trip
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the dragon can see must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes invisible to one creature it can see until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Molten Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon breaths a spray of lava in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (5d8) fire damage, and it becomes restrained by rapidly hardening igneous rock until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and it isn't restrained.

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The amphisbaena has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The amphisbaena makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the anarch can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The anarch deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Spiked Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Forcebreaker
entries: The dragon can destroy an adjacent creation of magical force, such as that produced by Wall of Force or Forcecage, by spending 10 feet of movement.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 30 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 19.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) force damage.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 23) and restrained.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 15 ft. away from the dragon.

entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

On a failed save, the creature takes 63 (14d8) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Psychokinetic Hurl
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be flung up to 30 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes invisible to one creature it can see until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Metabolic Overdrive
entries: The dragon gains advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature that it can telepathically communicate with.

reaction.name: Psychoport Inversion
entries: As a reaction when a creature teleports to or away from a space the dragon can see, the dragon forces it to succeed on a DC 23 Charisma saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force damage and immediately teleport back.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 223 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon uses its Psionic Empowerment.

legendary.name: Gravity Collapse
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of a line of gems created by the dragon's breath must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward it by the most direct route.

legendary.name: Detonate Gems (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One line of gems created by the dragon's breath detonates in a chained explosion of force. Each creature within 15 feet of the line must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Molten Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon breaths a spray of lava in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 63 (14d8) fire damage, and it becomes restrained by rapidly hardening igneous rock until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and it isn't restrained.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

bonus.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The dragon makes one claw attack.

legendary.name: Psionics (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon uses Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Eruption (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The dragon causes the ground to shake and erupt like a volcano at a point it can see within 60 feet of it.  Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) fire damage and be knocked prone.  The ground within 20 feet of that point is also difficult terrain until the lava cools in 1d4 hours.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 10 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each frightened creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Bloodbathed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw while a bleeding or unconscious creature is within 30 feet of it, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite or Tailbarb Stab, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one weapon or piece of armor of Rare or lesser rarity that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target prone or grapple it (escape DC 23).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage and the target begins bleeding (1d10).
Any hit against a prone creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 90 feet, where it splashes in a 15 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove DC 22).

A sludge-drenched creature is blinded, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 90-foot long, 10-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 67 (15d8) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers an acid injury.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 217 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Flesh-Melting Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Mire Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement submerged in murky water, it can attempt to Hide.

legendary.name: Drooling Torment
entries: Acid drips from the dragon's jaws toward a creature grappled by it, dealing 13 (3d8) acid damage to the creature.
The target can use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapple, avoiding the damage on a success.

legendary.name: Peel Nerve (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon makes a Subduing Claw attack.
If this attack hits a creature grappled by the dragon, the target has one spell affect on it end, or gains vulnerability to acid damage until it regains any hit points if it cannot.

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 10 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to the number rolled.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and attacks of opportunity made against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Reserved Resistance (3/Day)

action.name: Ridgetail Sweep
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 20 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed up to 10 feet on a success.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to three creatures the dragon can see within 120 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 44 (8d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 120 foot long, 10 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 88 (16d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Battle of Wits
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can push a creature grappled by it up to 10 feet into the attack's path.
The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence (Insight) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the pushed creature.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 241 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Sand Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its burrow speed. Then, if it started this movement submerged in earth, it can make a Sandhoned Claw attack.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: The dragon inhales, draining the moisture from a creature grappled by it. The creature takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and each potion and other liquid the target is carrying turns to dust until rehydrated.

legendary.name: Skyfury Drop (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon flies up to half its fly speed, then can drop up to 60 feet into an unoccupied space.
If it does, each other creature within 15 feet is pushed up to 15 feet away and must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet the dragon descended.

action.name: Breath of Deepening Sleep (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 90-foot cone. This effect ends for a creature if it loses any non-temporary hit points.

reaction.name: I Wasn't Finished!

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)

reaction.name: Billowing Wings

legendary.name: This Reminds Me... (Costs 3 Actions)

While the dragon is telling a story, it cannot use its breath weapons, and a creature that can hear the dragon and attempts to target the dragon with an attack or harmful spell must first make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.
The dragon can continue the story as a bonus action on each of its turns, extending the duration until the end of its following turn.

legendary.name: Calm The Unruly

legendary.name: Tail Sweep

entries: The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the dragon's choice).

The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

legendary.name: Banter

The creature may use its reaction to reply with a humorous comment or salient pun of its own. If it does, both the creature and the dragon have advantage on the next attack or saving throw they make in the next minute. If it fails to do so, the creature has disadvantage on the next attack or saving throw it makes in the next minute.

legendary.name: False Wall

action.name: Breath of Inner Dawn
entries: The dragon blows a mighty breath in a 90 foot long, 10 foot wide line that stokes a blinding glow within all it touches.

The dragon and each creature and object in the area begins to emit sunlight in a 30 foot radius for the next minute, and a creature without resistance to radiant damage that targets an affected creature with an attack or spell must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.
