action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Photonic Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales a flashing mote of radiant energy that travels to a point the dragon can see within 240 feet of itself, then blossoms into a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Blinding Brilliance (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon emits magical light in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in this area must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe both air and water.

trait.name: Fabricate (1/Day)
entries: The dragon can cast fabricate, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Desiccating Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales yellowish necrotic energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 49 (14d6) necrotic damage and is weakened until the end of its next turn. A weakened creature has disadvantage on Strength-based ability checks and Strength saving throws, and the creature's weapon attacks that rely on Strength deal half damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't weakened.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The dragon magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

bonus.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The dragon makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Psionics (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon uses Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Essential Reduction (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The dragon targets a creature or an object not being worn or carried that it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 40 (9d8) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it crumbles to dust.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being blinded.

trait.name: Glacial Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 25 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.
A creature can lose one unexpended hit die to ignore this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Frostblood Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal fire damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Bitter Bite or Icecarve Tail, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing plus 9 (2d8) cold damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 21).
A creature grappled in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Winterglass Breath.

action.name: Barbed Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may knock the target prone.

action.name: Icecarve Tail
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail, flinging a spray of ice and snow in a 30 foot cone.
Each creature in the area is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) cold damage and be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Raise Hackles
entries: The dragon extends its spined frill and a deep, booming rumble ripples through the air around it in a 30 foot radius.
Each creature in the area that is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence or the Frightened condition must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or lose that immunity for the next minute.

action.name: Winterglass Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 72 (16d8) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 90 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to Hide from it, the dragon can leap up to 90 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Roar of Triumph
entries: When the dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, it can let out a terrifying roar.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 196 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Winterglass Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the dragon, or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage if it can't.

legendary.name: Ice Tomb
entries: The dragon breathes a layer of dense, translucent ice that encrusts a prone creature within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or gain 20 temporary hit points, or half as many on a success.
A creature that has any of these temporary hit points is restrained and loses two unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or gains a point of exhaustion if it can't.

legendary.name: Uttercold (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dragon deals ignores damage resistance, and it can reroll any of the damage dice of its Winterglass Breath once, taking the second result.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The anhkolox doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anhkolox makes two Claw attacks and one Entrapping Rend attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet in a horizontal direction of the anhkolox's choice.

action.name: Entrapping Rend
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (5d6 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be trapped in the anhkolox's rib cage and grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the anhkolox can't use Entrapping Rend on another target.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the ballista is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

action.name: Magic Bolt
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) fire damage

resist.special: damage of the type matching the animated breath's form (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison)

trait.name: Chromatic Form
entries: When created, the animated breath takes one of five forms, matching its creator's breath weapon: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This form determines the creature's AC, damage resistance, traits, and attacks.

trait.name: Fire Aura (Fire Form Only)
entries: At the start of each of the animated breath's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the animated breath or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Putrid Aura (Acid and Poison Forms Only)
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the animated breath must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. A creature that touches the animated breath or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The animated breath makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) damage of a type determined by the animated breath's form: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

bonus.name: Lightning Burst (Lightning Form Only)
entries: The animated breath magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of the animated breath after it teleports takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the stove is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stove remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal stove.

trait.name: Iron Arsenal
entries: At the beginning of each of the stove's turns, its flung cookware returns to it. A creature grasping a piece of cookware can make a DC 15 Strength saving throw to prevent its return, reducing the number of attacks the stove can make with its Multiattack this turn by one on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stove makes three attacks with its Hurl Cookware, one of which it can replace with a use of its Burner Flare.

action.name: Hurl Cookware
entries: Range Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
If the stove used its Burner Flare this turn, this attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Burner Flare
entries: The stove's burners roar with flame, forcing each creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Blackiron Scoot
entries: The stove moves up to 5 feet, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature with this movement, pushing it 5 feet directly away.
A creature that would be pushed into a solid surface in this way instead takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and is restrained (escape DC 15) until the stove moves.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the table is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the table remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal table.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the table moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Tabletop Ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tabletop Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Animated Tree
languages: understands Common, Druidic, Elvish, and Sylvan but cannot speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tree makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
entries: The tree magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as a treant, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of the tree. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until the tree dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the tree takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

trait.name: Scute Armor
entries: Creatures cannot benefit from flanking the ankylosaurus unless it is prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ankylosaurus makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its tail club. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 4 (1d8) piercing damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, the target is pushed 10 feet away, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone. A Large or larger creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Flatten
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more damage from a single source, the ankylosaurus presses its body to the ground, protecting its soft underbelly. Until the beginning of its next turn, the Anklyosaurus adds 3 to its AC.

name: Annis Hag
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Skinktaker Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any humanoid it has skinned. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Corruptor Coven
entries: Children within 10 miles of a coven of annis hags are slowly incited to misbehave in ever-escalating ways, up to and including things like destruction of food stores, killing pets and livestock, arson, and even murder.
Additionally, a fog settles in the area that never lifts. Creatures other than the annis hag in the area are blind beyond a 30 ft. radius.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The annis makes three attacks: one with her teeth of iron and two with her corkscrew claws.

action.name: Teeth of Iron
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage against a prone creature.

action.name: Corkscrew Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and the hag may grapple the target (escape DC 16). While the hag has a creature grappled in this way, it cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Crushing Hug
entries: One creature grappled by the hag must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 39 (6d12) bludgeoning damage, falls prone, and cannot stand on its following turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot stand until it completes a short or long rest. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Grisly Display
entries: As a reaction when the hag kills a creature with a melee attack, the hag rips the creature's skin off in a single piece. Each creature that can see the display must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. While frightened in this way, a creature uses its movement and action to dash in a random direction.

name: Anvilwrought Raptor
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The raptor has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Recorded Mimicry
entries: The raptor can mimic any sound, including voices, it has heard in the last 24 hours. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The raptor makes two attacks with its beak.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the ape can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The ape's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the ape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any medium or smaller creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the ape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ape makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 10 (3d6) damage to a grappled creature.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 25/50 ft., one target. Hit: (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gorilla makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 25/50 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Chest Pound (1/Day)
entries: The gorilla frantically beats its chest are roars.  Every creature, expect those the gorilla is friendly to, within 30 feet that can see or hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the gorilla until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Aphemia fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Aphemia has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aphemia makes two attacks: one with her bite and one with her claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Discordant Song
entries: Aphemia shrieks a cacophony of magical sounds. Each humanoid within 120 feet of her must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of her until the song ends. A frightened creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage at the start of its turn while Aphemia is singing. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Aphemia's Discordant Song for the next 24 hours. Aphemia must take a bonus action on her subsequent turns to continue singing. She can stop singing at any time. The song ends if Aphemia is incapacitated or dies.

action.name: Grave Calling Song
entries: Aphemia intones a low, growling magical melody. Every undead within 300 feet of her must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or fall under her control until the song ends. Aphemia must take a bonus action on her subsequent turns to continue singing, and she can mentally command the undead under her control as part of the same bonus action. She can stop singing at any time. The song ends if Aphemia is incapacitated or dies.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The apprentice is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Arcanaloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The arcanaloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A yugoloth will usually accept a rate of the yugoloth's challenge rating times 25 gp, though it may accept less.

trait.name: Spell Trader
entries: The arcanaloth knows all wizard spells of 8th level or lower. If it fears it will lose a fight, it may offer to teach a creature with a spellbook one spell in exchange for mercy.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arcanaloth uses its arcane insight once and its magic barrage twice. It may replace one use of its magic barrage with a use of its Steal Spell, if available.

action.name: Arcane Insight
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must make a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failure, the Arcanaloth discovers what spells the target has prepared and what unexpended spell slots they have.

action.name: Magic Barrage
entries: The arcanaloth unleashes a swarm of magical missiles that strike a creature within 120 feet, dealing 27 (5d8 + 5) force damage. A creature may halve this damage with the Shield spell.

action.name: Steal Spell (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 feet must make a DC 17 Charisma save. On a failed save, the Arcanaloth casts a spell the creature has prepared, expending one of the creature's spell slots to do so. For the next minute, the creature cannot cast that spell.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Invisibility (2nd level spell)
entries: The Arcanaloth becomes invisible until it takes another action.

reaction.name: Trickster's Escape
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack or spell, the Arcanaloth may force a small or medium creature within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or switch places with the arcanaloth, becoming the new target.

reaction.name: Shield (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the Arcanaloth increases its AC by 5, including against the triggering attack, until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature within 60 feet cast a spell, the yugoloth may attempt to disrupt it, making an Intelligence ability check with DC equal to 10+ the spells level. This check succeeds automatically if the spell is 3rd level or below.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archaic casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

trait.name: Enigmatic Mind
entries: The archaic's mind can't be read, creatures can communicate telepathically with the archaic only if it allows, and magic can't determine whether the archaic is lying.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the archaic fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The archaic doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archaic makes two Force Strike attacks. It can also use Gravity Shift, if available.

action.name: Force Strike
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) force damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the archaic or pushed 10 feet away from it, as the archaic chooses.

action.name: Gravity Shift (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The archaic reverses gravity for one creature it can see within 100 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or fall 100 feet upward. If the falling creature encounters a solid object (such as a ceiling) in this fall, it strikes the object just as it would during a downward fall. If the creature reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it hovers there until the start of the archaic's next turn, at which time gravity returns to normal and the creature falls.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The archaic teleports to an unoccupied space that it can see within 120 feet of itself.

reaction.name: Spell Mimicry (1/Day)
entries: Immediately after a creature the archaic can see casts a spell of 5th level or lower, that creature must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw, or the archaic immediately casts the same spell at the same level (+14 to hit with spell attacks, spell save DC 22), requiring no material components and choosing the spell's targets.

legendary.name: Strike
entries: The archaic makes one Force Strike attack.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The archaic uses Teleport.

legendary.name: Unravel Magic (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archaic targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) force damage, and each spell of 5th level or lower on the target ends.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archdruid is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Wild Shape (2/Day)
entries: The archdruid magically polymorphs into a beast or elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 9 hours. The archdruid can choose whether its equipment falls to the ground, melds with its new form, or is worn by the new form. The archdruid reverts to its true form if it dies or falls unconscious. The archdruid can revert to its true form using a bonus action on its turn.

While in a new form, the archdruid retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. It can cast its spells with verbal or somatic components in its new form.
The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

name: Archmage
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archmage is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archmage can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
footerEntries: *The archmage casts these spells on itself before combat.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archmage has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archon's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mount
entries: If the archon isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto the creature serving as its mount, provided the archon and its mount are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the archon appears astride the mount, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the archon can't be surprised, and both it and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

trait.name: Radiant Rebirth (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points, it regains 30 hit points and springs back to its feet with a burst of radiance. Each creature of the archon's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, or the creature takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage and is blinded until the start of the archon's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes two attacks with its radiant spear.

action.name: Radiant Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The archon makes a radiant spear attack or casts guiding bolt.

legendary.name: Coordinated Assault (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archon makes a radiant spear attack, and then its mount can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Return to Nyx (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The archon causes a corpse it can see within 30 feet of it to burst into a shower of radiant stars leaving no trace of it behind. Everything it is wearing or carrying remains. Each creature within 10 feet of the corpse when it bursts must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) radiant damage.

name: Archon of Redemption
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The archon's weapon attacks are magical. When the archon hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra  radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Axiomatic Mind
entries: The archon can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its understanding of justice.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: One Being
entries: Though it appears as a humanoid creature riding a mount, an archon is a single being. The "rider" can't be dismounted, and no other means can separate the two portions of the archon's being short of its death.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes two attacks: one with its sword and one with its claws.

action.name: Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

name: Archon of the Triumvirate
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Eye of the Law
entries: As a bonus action, the archon can target a creature it can see within 120 feet of it and determine which laws that creature has broken in the last 24 hours.

trait.name: Mount
entries: If the archon isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto the creature serving as its mount, provided the archon and its mount are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the archon appears astride the mount along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the archon can't be surprised, and both it and its mount gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes two Hammer of Justice attacks.

action.name: Hammer of Justice
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Pacifying Presence
entries: Each creature of the archon's choice that the archon can see within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw, or else the target drops any weapons it is holding, ends its concentration on any spells or other effects, and becomes charmed by the archon for 1 minute. The charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the archon's Pacifying Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Rejoin Mount
entries: If the archon isn't mounted, it magically teleports to its steed and mounts it as long as the archon and its steed are on the same plane of existence.

legendary.name: Smite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archon makes a Hammer of Justice attack, and then its mount can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Detention (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The archon targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be magically teleported to a harmless demiplane until the end of the archon's next turn, whereupon the target reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

name: Arclight Phoenix
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The arclight phoenix doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Grounded Lightning
entries: The first time on a turn that the arclight phoenix touches the ground, it takes 11 (2d10) force damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The arclight phoenix sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

trait.name: Lightning Form
entries: The arclight phoenix can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage. In addition, the arclight phoenix can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

trait.name: Crackling Death
entries: When the arclight phoenix dies, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion destroys the phoenix but leaves behind a Tiny, warm egg with a mizzium shell. The egg contains the embryo of a new arclight phoenix. It hatches when it is in the area of a spell that deals lightning damage, or if a creature touches the egg and expends spell slots whose combined levels equal 13 or more. When it hatches, the egg releases a new arclight phoenix that appears in the egg's space.

action.name: Arclight Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) lightning damage, and lightning jumps from the target to one creature of the phoenix's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target. That second creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) piercing damage.

name: Ash Zombie
languages: understands all languages it spoke in life but can't speak

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Ash Puff
entries: The first time the zombie takes damage, any living creature within 5 feet of the zombie must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on it early with a successful save.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: When the assassin reduces a creature to 0 hit points or kills a creature, its speed increases by 10 feet for the next minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Slip Away.

action.name: Hidden Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 3).
A creature that is reduced to less than half its hit points by this damage starts bleeding (1d6).

action.name: Knotted Garrote
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
Until the grapple ends, the target is choking and takes 4 (1d8) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Slip Away
entries: The assassin creates a distraction, becoming invisible to each creature with a Passive Perception of 16 or lower until the end of its turn, or until it makes an attack.

reaction.name: Twist Knife
entries: When the assassin reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it can impose disadvantage on the first death saving throw the target makes.

reaction.name: Hole Up
entries: When the assassin ends its turn not immediately visible to any hostile creature, it can take the Hide action.

trait.name: Slow Death
entries: Whenever the assassin scores a critical hit against a creature, the target is afflicted by a slow and worming poison. The next time the affected creature finishes a long rest, they must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and gains no benefits from the triggering long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Slip Away or Study Mark.

action.name: Blackblade Sica
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is incapacitated and poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Repeating Dart-Thrower
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Slip Away
entries: The assassin creates a distraction, becoming invisible to each creature with a Passive Perception of 19 or lower until the end of its turn, or until it makes an attack.

action.name: Study Mark
entries: The assassin examines the vulnerabilities of a creature it is hidden from or that isn't hostile towards it.  The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw.  On a failed save, the assassin's attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 16-20 for 1 minute.
If the target succeeds on its saving throw by 5 or more, the target learns the assasssin's location and that it is hostile.

reaction.name: Agile Swerve
entries: When the assassin is forced to make a saving throw with any ability that isn't Dexterity, it can make a Dexterity saving throw instead. On a success, the assassin suffers no ill effects.

reaction.name: Hole Up
entries: When the assassin ends its turn not immediately visible to any hostile creature, it can take the Hide action.

trait.name: Slow Death
entries: Whenever the assassin scores a critical hit against a creature, the target is afflicted by a slow and worming poison. The next time the affected creature finishes a long rest, they must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and gains no benefits from the triggering long rest.

trait.name: Silencer's Shroud
entries: Sounds produced within 15 feet of the assassin are muffled, and can't be heard from outside of that area.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Slip Away, Study Mark, or Death Touch, if available.

action.name: Magebane Needle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) force damage per spell level of the target's highest level unexpended spell slot.
This attack ignores any bonuses to the target's Armor Class granted by spells.

action.name: Sawtooth Garrote
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).
Until the grapple ends, the target is choking and takes 9 (2d8) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns.

If the target succeeds on its saving throw by 5 or more, the target learns the assasssin's location and that it is hostile.

action.name: Death Touch (Recharge 5-6, 4th Level Spell)
entries: The assassin touches a creature and forces it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
While poisoned in this way, the target takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the assassin that it hit with a melee attack in the last minute teleports, the assassin can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

On a failed save, the target takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and gains no benefits from the triggering long rest.

This attack ignores any bonuses to the target's Armor Class granted by spells.

entries: The assassin touches a creature and forces it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
While poisoned in this way, the target takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Hole Up
entries: When the assassin ends its turn not immediately visible to any hostile creature, it can take the Hide action.

reaction.name: Bloodbond Step (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the assassin that it hit with a melee attack in the last minute teleports, the assassin can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The assassin bug has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin bug makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Ovipositor
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is infested with assassin bug eggs, which immediately hatch into assassin bug maggots. At the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes piercing damage per maggot infesting it. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills these assassin bug maggots. After this time, the maggots are too far under the skin to be burned.

If a target infested by assassin bug maggots ends its turn with 0 hit points, it dies as the maggots burrow into its heart and kill it. Any effect that cures disease kills all assassin bug maggots infesting the target.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the assassin vine remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal plant.

trait.name: Entangling Vines
entries: Nonmagical plants within 15 ft. of the assassin vine animate under its will, causing the area to be difficult terrain. A creature that moves 10 or more feet through this area on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Vine Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Constrict
entries: One creature grappled by the assassin vine must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature grappled by the assassin vine speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the assassin vine crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature immediately begins to suffocate.

reaction.name: Toxic Sap
entries: As a reaction to taking piercing or slashing damage, the alraune deals 9 (2d8) poison damage to each creature grappled by it.

name: Asteroid Spider
senses: blindsight 120 ft. while the spider's eyes are closed

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the spider is motionless, has its eyes and mouth closed, and has its legs wrapped around its body at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the spider move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the spider is anything other than an asteroid.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The spider doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two Web Strand attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

action.name: Web Strand
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 18). The web strand can be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; 20 hit points; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). The spider can grapple up to six creatures at a time using its web strands.

action.name: Reel
entries: The spider pulls each creature grappled by it up to 60 feet straight toward itself.

bonus.name: Snare Ship (1/Day)
entries: The spider weaves a magical web around a spelljamming ship it can see within 120 feet of itself. The web lasts for 1 minute and suppresses the magic of any spelljamming helm aboard the ship. Decks and other surfaces of the ship that aren't enclosed become difficult terrain until the effect ends. The web is impervious to damage but is destroyed by a successful casting of dispel magic (DC 18).

trait.name: Stampede
entries: When the aurochs moves, each adjacent aurochs may use its reaction to move with it. If one or more aurochs do so, the aurochs has advantage on attack rolls this turn.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the aurochs moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the aurochs can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the aurochs can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The aurumvorax can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 ft. of it.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The aurumvorax does not die or fall unconscious due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Incredible Density
entries: The aurumvorax has advantage on attempts to shove creatures, and on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would shove it or knock it prone. The aurumvorax may grapple or shove creatures up to three sizes larger than it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aurumvorax makes five attacks: one with its locking jaws and four with its scrabbling claws. It may replace any of its claw attacks with a Shove attempt.

action.name: Locking Jaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled. Until this grapple ends, the aurumvorax can bite only the grappled creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage. If this attack is made at advantage, it does an additional 2 (1d4) damage.

trait.name: Malfunction
entries: Whenever the autognome takes 15 damage or more from a single source and isn't reduced to 0 hit points by that damage, roll a d20 to determine if it suffers a malfunction:

items.name: 1-10: "All Fine Here!"
entries: No malfunction occurs.

items.name: 11-12: "My Mind Is Going. I Can Feel It."
entries: The autognome is incapacitated for 1 minute.

items.name: 13-14: "You've Disarmed Me!"
entries: One of the autognome's arms falls off, reducing the number of Shock attacks it can make by 1 until a creature uses an action to reattach the arm.

items.name: 15-16: "Who Turned Out the Lights?"
entries: The autognome's head falls off and deactivates, causing the autognome to be blinded and deafened until a creature uses an action to reattach the head, which reactivates it.

items.name: 17-20: "Have a Magical Day!"
entries: The autognome explodes and is destroyed. Each creature within 20 feet of the exploding autognome must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The autognome doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The autognome makes two Shock attacks.

action.name: Shock
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

name: Awakened Shrub
languages: One language known by its creator

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

trait.name: Rooted
entries: The shrub makes saving throws and ability checks to resist being forced to move or be knocked prone at advantage. If the shrub is forced to move or knocked prone, it loses 3 (1d6) hit points.

action.name: Rake
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Throw Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) bludgeoning damage. If the shrub was hidden, this attack does not reveal its position.

action.name: Rustle
entries: The shrub rustles as though something were moving around inside it. Creatures within 30 ft. that can hear it have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive any creature other than the shrub until the end of its next turn.

name: Awakened Tree
languages: One language known by its creator

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the tree takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the tree takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of the tree's turns, and all attacks against the tree are made at advantage. While on fire, the tree's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Rooted
entries: The tree makes saving throws and ability checks to resist being forced to move or be knocked prone at advantage. If the tree is forced to move or knocked prone, it loses 19 (3d12) hit points.

action.name: Branch Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Writhing Roots (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 15 ft. of the tree must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The axe beak has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the axe beak's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Burst of Speed (Recharge 6)
entries: The axe beak may dash as a bonus action.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 4 (1d8) damage to a prone target.

action.name: Kick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The b'rohg makes four Fist attacks or two Rock attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hideous Rend
entries: The b'rohg uses all four of its hands to target one Large or smaller creature it can see within 10 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the b'rohg can't make Fist attacks or Rock attacks, and the target takes 49 (8d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is ripped into four pieces.

name: Baalzebul, Lord of the Flies
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lord of the Seventh
entries: Devils under Baalzebul's control rupture upon death, releasing a cloud of biting flies that deals 7 (2d6) piercing damage to each creature in a 5-foot radius.

trait.name: Perfection Profaned
entries: Whenever Baalzebul takes any radiant damage, he takes an additional 11 (2d10) psychic damage and gains disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
entries: When Baalzebul would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
If he does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Baalzebul immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Baalzebul makes three attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Defiler's Slime or Pollute Spirit.

action.name: Putrid Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.
If Baalzebul doesn't have any temporary hit points, a creature hit with this attack is restrained (escape DC 25) until Baalzebul moves or makes another attack.

action.name: Defiler's Slime (4th Level Spell)
entries: A wave of rotten discharge boils forth from Baalzebul in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more is additionally drenched in slime. Until the creature or another creature within 5 feet of them takes an action to clear the slime, their speed is halved and they are considered poisoned.

action.name: Pollute Spirit (5th Level Spell)
entries: Baalzebul forces a creature he can see within 60 feet of him to make a DC 24 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is cursed. While cursed in this way, the target can't benefit from resistance or immunity to poison damage, the poisoned condition, or disease, and it has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

action.name: Maggot Feast (7th Level Spell)
entries: Baalzebul forces each creature within 60 feet of him to make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) necrotic damage as maggots infest their wounds, or half as much damage on a success.
If a creature that is poisoned, diseased, or below half of its maximum hit points fails a saving throw against this effect, it is additionally dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Heart of Pestilence (Recharge 5-6, 8th Level Spell)
entries: Baalzebul forces one creature he can see within 60 feet of him to make three DC 24 Constitution saving throws. For each saving throw it failed, the target suffers one of the following effects of Baalzebul's choice:

items: The target takes 38 (7d10) poison damage and is poisoned until cured by the Lesser Restoration spell or similar magic.
The target takes 38 (7d10) necrotic damage and is infected with Filth Fever.
The target loses 38 (7d10) hit points and begins bleeding (2d10).

reaction.name: Boil Rupture
entries: When Baalzebul takes 50 or more damage from a single source, he can cause one of his many cysts to rupture, releasing a Swarm of Ayperobos that acts on his initiative into his space.

reaction.name: Hero's Downfall
entries: When Baalzebul takes any amount of radiant damage while he has any number of temporary hit points, he can deal an equal amount of radiant damage to the source of the damage he took.

legendary.name: Chains of Filth
entries: Baalzebul chooses up to three creatures within 500 feet of him that are willing, diseased, or poisoned, teleporting each to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of him.

legendary.name: Divine Mockery
entries: Baalzebul gains 30 temporary hit points. While he has these temporary hit points, he is shapeshifted into a Huge angel, has a flying speed of 100 feet, and can choose for any damage he deals to become radiant damage.

legendary.name: Grotesque Lurch
entries: Baalzebul moves up to his speed and makes a Putrid Slam attack. He can move through spaces as small as 5 feet wide without squeezing when he moves using this legendary action.

name: Cultist of the Lord of Flies

trait.name: Rot-Ridden
entries: When the cultist dies, each creature within 5 feet of it becomes poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Filthslick Blade (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 piercing damage.
A cursed or poisoned target hit with this attack is infected with Filth Fever.

action.name: Coax Infection (Group Action)
entries: One cursed, diseased, or poisoned creature within 30 feet of the cultist takes 3 necrotic damage.
If three or more cultists contributed to this action, the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn)

name: Cult Fanatic of the Lord of Flies

trait.name: Rot-Ridden
entries: When the cultist dies, each creature within 5 feet of it becomes poisoned until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Corpseleech.

action.name: Infested Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus one of the following effects of the target's choice:

items: The target must use its reaction to move 10 feet directly away from the cultist.
The target takes an additional 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Corpseleech (1st Level Spell)
entries: The cultist touches a corpse that died in the last minute and consumes its lingering vitality, desiccating its flesh to dust and gaining 9 (2d8) temporary hit points.

action.name: Invocation of the Most-Low (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The cultist touches a wiilling creature, causing its veins to turn black and swell with crawling corruption. For the next minute, the target is poisoned and bleeding (1d6).
The first time on a turn that the target loses any amount of hit points, each creature of its choice within 15 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Necromiasma (1st Level Spell)
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the cultist fails a Constitution saving throw by 5 or more, the cultist can cause foul vapors to rise and corrupt the wounds of the target, causing it to be unaffected by the first source of healing it receives before the end of its next turn.

name: Devoted of the Lord of Flies

trait.name: Rot-Ridden
entries: When the cultist dies, each creature within 5 feet of it becomes poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Curse of Pestilence
entries: Whenever the cultist deals damage to a creature, it can cause that creature to become cursed for 1 minute, causing flies to swarm forth from its wounds. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes three attacks with its Canker Bolt, one of which it can replace with a use of its Corpseleech or Quagmire Coil.

action.name: Canker Bolt (Cantrip)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice)
This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) to a poisoned creature or one that has less than half of its maximum hit points.

action.name: Corpseleech (1st Level Spell)
entries: The cultist touches a corpse that died in the last minute and consumes its lingering vitality, desiccating its flesh to dust and gaining 9 (2d8) temporary hit points.

action.name: Quagmire Coil (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Filth boils forth to engulf a creature within 60 feet, forcing it to make a DC 14 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice). On a failed save, the target takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and is restrained (escape DC 14)
If the target fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is additionally considered blinded and choking while it is restrained.

action.name: Plague of Leeches (Recharge 5-6, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: Gnawing spectral worms swarm in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the cultist. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) and is poisoned until the end of the cultist's next turn.
A creature that is submerged in water or restrained by the cultist's Quagmire Coil has disadvantage on this saving throw.

name: Chosen of the Lord of Flies

trait.name: Rot-Ridden
entries: When the cultist dies, each creature within 5 feet of it becomes poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Greater Curse of Pestilence
entries: Whenever the cultist deals damage to a creature, it can cause that creature to become cursed for 1 minute, causing flies to swarm forth from its wounds. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.
At the start of each of its turns, the cultist gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature cursed in this way within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Purging Physick (2/Day)
entries: At the start of its turn, the cultist can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does so, it loses one saving throw proficiency of its choice until it completes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes three attacks with its Canker Bolt, one of which it can replace with a use of its Sickening Exhaust.

action.name: Canker Bolt (Cantrip)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice)
This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) to a poisoned creature or one that has less than half of its maximum hit points.

action.name: Sickening Exhaust (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A plume of foul smoke billows within a creature the cultist can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn)

The first time on a turn that the poisoned creature speaks or casts a spell with a verbal component, it takes 14 (4d6) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) damage nad is blinded until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Defiler's Slime (Recharge 5-6, 4th Level Spell)
entries: A wave of rotten discharge boils forth from the cultist in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage plus 22 (4d10) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more is additionally drenched in slime. Until the creature or another creature within 5 feet of them takes an action to clear the slime, their speed is halved and they are considered poisoned.

reaction.name: Cursed Contagion
entries: When a creature affected by a Curse of Pestilence is reduced to 0 hit points or dies, the cultist can afflict each creature of its choice within 20 feet of the target with its Curse of Pestilence.

legendary.name: Canker Bolt
entries: The cultist makes an attack with its Canker Bolt.

legendary.name: Vector-Spread (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Corruption spirals out around a creature within 60 feet that is bleeding, diseased, paralyzed, or poisoned. Each creature within 15 feet of the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become afflicted with the same condition(s) for the same duration.

legendary.name: Tainted Visit (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The cultist teleports to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of it, then each creature within 10 feet of it that is cursed or poisoned, or has less than half of its maximum hit points, takes 5 (1d10) posion or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) for each of those criteria that it meets.

name: Exarch of the Lord of Flies

trait.name: Rot-Ridden
entries: When the cultist dies, each creature within 5 feet of it becomes poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Greater Curse of Pestilence
entries: Whenever the cultist deals damage to a creature, it can cause that creature to become cursed for 1 minute, causing flies to swarm forth from its wounds. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.
At the start of each of its turns, the cultist gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature cursed in this way within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Purging Physick (3/Day)
entries: At the start of its turn, the cultist can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does so, it loses one saving throw proficiency of its choice until it completes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Sickening Exhaust.

action.name: Harrow Rod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Canker Bolt (Cantrip)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice)
This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) to a poisoned creature or one that has less than half of its maximum hit points.

action.name: Sickening Exhaust (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A plume of foul smoke billows within a creature the cultist can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn)

The first time on a turn that the poisoned creature speaks or casts a spell with a verbal component, it takes 14 (4d6) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) damage nad is blinded until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Insect Plague (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Biting locusts fill a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 300 feet. When the area appears, each creature in it must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 22 (4d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

action.name: Venomous End (6th Level Spell)
entries: One poisoned creature within 60 feet of the cultist takes 50 poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice). Then, if the target has fewer than 50 hit points remaining, it must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is paralyzed for as long as it remains poisoned.

action.name: Maggot Feast (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The cultist forces each creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) poison or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) as maggots infest their wounds, or half as much damage on a success.
If a creature that is poisoned, diseased, or below half of its maximum hit points fails a saving throw against this effect, it is additionally dazed until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Cursed Contagion
entries: When a creature affected by a Curse of Pestilence is reduced to 0 hit points or dies, the cultist can afflict each creature of its choice within 20 feet of the target with its Curse of Pestilence.

reaction.name: Plague Reservoir
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of at least 3 other creatures afflicted with a Curse of Pestilence makes a Constitution saving throw against an effect that the cultist controls, the cultist can impose disadvantage on the saving throw.

legendary.name: Canker Bolt
entries: The cultist makes an attack with its Canker Bolt.

legendary.name: Thrumming Symphony
entries: The cultist moves the effect of its Insect Plague up to 15 feet. Each creature whose space the effect enters during this movement must make a saving throw against it.

legendary.name: Vector-Spread (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Corruption spirals out around a creature within 60 feet that is bleeding, diseased, paralyzed, or poisoned. Each creature within 15 feet of the target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or become afflicted with the same condition(s) for the same duration.

legendary.name: Tainted Visit (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The cultist teleports to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of it, then each creature within 10 feet of it that is cursed or poisoned, or has less than half of its maximum hit points, takes 5 (1d10) posion or necrotic damage (cultist's choice) for each of those criteria that it meets.

name: Babau
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shadow Clones
entries: Whenever the babau teleports, it leaves behind a copy of itself with the following traits:
The clone has 1 hit point and dies at the end of the babau's next turn.
When the clone dies, each creature within 5 ft. of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage.
As a Bonus Action, the babau can command the clone to move up to 40 ft. and make a Flickering Claw attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The babau makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Rend Magic or Murderous Abduction, if available.

action.name: Flickering Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and the babau teleports up to 10 ft.

action.name: Rend Magic (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The babau ends one spell affecting a creature it can see within 60 ft. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Murderous Abduction (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The babau and up to one creature within 5 ft. of it each teleport up to 30 ft. in the same direction. An unwilling and conscious creature makes a DC 13 Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Weakening Glare
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the babau forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the attack's damage reduced by half.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the baboon can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The baboon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The baboon's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the baboon jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any medium or smaller creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the baboon's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Screeching Bark
entries: Each creature within 100 ft. that can hear, but not see the baboon must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute. A creature may repeat this save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

name: Bael, the Bronze General
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Bael casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21):

trait.name: Dread
entries: Any creature, other than a devil, that starts its turn within 10 feet of Bael must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of him until the start of its next turn. A creature succeeds on this saving throw automatically if Bael wishes it or if he is incapacitated.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Bael fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Bael have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Bael regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes cold or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Bael dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Bael makes two Hellish Morningstar attacks.

action.name: Hellish Morningstar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) force damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Infernal Command
entries: Each of Bael's allies within 60 feet of him can't be charmed or frightened until the end of his next turn.

action.name: Teleport
entries: Bael teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Fiendish Magic
entries: Bael uses Spellcasting or Teleport.

legendary.name: Infernal Command
entries: Bael uses Infernal Command.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Bael makes one Hellish Morningstar attack.

trait.name: Dead Magic Grip
entries: A creature grappled by the balhannoth that attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of one Action must first roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the spell doesn't take effect until the creature's next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the spell.

trait.name: Superior Camouflage
entries: The balhannoth is invisible to creatures more than 10 feet away from it. It may attempt to hide without cover.

trait.name: False Hope
entries: The landscape in a 500 ft. radius around the balhannoth warps to fit ideas of safety and security it gleans from passing creatures through telepathic eavesdropping.
The balhannoth cannot create functional or moving objects in this way, and close inspection of objects created in this way reveals them to be facsimiles.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
