entries: If the balhannoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The balhannoth makes a bite attack and up to two tentacle attacks, or it makes up to four tentacle attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the balhannoth. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the balhannoth can't use this tentacle against other targets. The balhannoth has four tentacles.

legendary.name: Drain Magic
entries: Each creature grappled by the balhannoth must succeed on a DC 15 Constitiution saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot. The balhannoth gains 4 (1d8) temporary hit points for each spell level expended this way.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The balhannoth magically teleports, along with each creature it has grappled, up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The balhannoth makes a bite attack against a creature it has grappled.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the baloth moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the baloth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage

name: Banshee
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: Any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Ill Omen
entries: When initiative is rolled, the banshee forces one creature it can see to succeed on DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature subtracts 1d8 from the result of any Wisdom saving throws it makes.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the banshee takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The banshee's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the banshee is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions, though it can still communicate. After 24 hours, the banshee recovers all of its hit points. While at 0 hit points, the banshee can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unifinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Performing funeral rites for it with the Ceremony spell.

action.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (4d6 + 1) necrotic damage and plants within 10 feet of the target wither and die.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the banshee that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of Turn), or become immune to this effect for 24 hours on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has its face twist into a permanent rictus of terror until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Wail (1/Day)
entries: When the banshee is reduced below 41 hit points while not in sunlight, it releases a mournful wail.
Each living creature within 30 feet that can hear her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or drop to 0 hit points, or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a success.

name: Baphomet, the Horned King

resist.preNote: damage from attacks made without advantage

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of their turn, Baphomet can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If they miss with an attack this turn, they are stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Baphomet may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Baphomet. While climbing on Baphomet, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against Baphomet.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Baphomet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Bestial Juggernaut
entries: Baphomet is immune to any effect that would incapacitate them, immobilize them, alter their form, or reduce their speed. If Baphomet is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, attacks against them are made at advantage until the beginning of their next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Baphomet makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with their gore. If Baphomet has fewer than 262 hit points, they may make any of their attacks with their gore.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 11 (2d10) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Heartcleaver
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d8 + 10) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target suffers one additional effect selected at random:

items.name: 1. Curse of Brutality
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, a creature's appearance becomes partially bestial, and the creature cannot cast spells of 5th level or above.

items.name: 2. Crush Bones
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a long rest.

items.name: 3. Cleave Limb
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or lose a limb (target's choice).

items.name: 4. Bisect
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or die.

action.name: Desecration Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Baphomet disgorges a torrent of unholy, bilious water in a 90 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison plus 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The area becomes desecrated for the next hour. A non-fiend creature that starts its turn in the area takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Gouging Toss
entries: As a reaction to a creature moving within 10 ft. of him, Baphomet forces the creature to succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) piercing damage and be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Bloodied Bellow (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 262 hit points, Baphomet lets out an anguished bellow. Each other creature within 60 ft. takes 36 (8d8) thunder damage, or half as much if behind full cover, and must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Plummet
entries: One flying creature that Baphomet can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or fall prone. If the creature would take damage from falling as a result of this, it takes twice as much damage.

legendary.name: Raise Labyrinth
entries: Baphomet raises a 2 ft. thick wall of stone comprised of two contiguous 20 ft. by 20 ft. panels from the ground within 300 ft. As long as a pathway from one side of the wall to the other exists that Baphomet could traverse, the wall does not impede Baphomet's vision or movement.
The wall is an object made of stone that can be damaged and thus breached (AC 20; 30 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), and crumbles if Baphomet moves through it.

legendary.name: Thrashing Horns (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Up to two creatures on opposite sides of Baphomet must each succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (8d8) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The bard is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following bard spells prepared:

trait.name: Song of Rest
entries: The bard can perform a song while taking a short rest. Any ally who hears the song regains an extra  hit points if it spends any Hit Dice to regain hit points at the end of that rest. The bard can confer this benefit on itself as well.

trait.name: Taunt (2/Day)
entries: The bard can use a bonus action on its turn to target one creature within 30 feet of it. If the target can hear the bard, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bard's next turn.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Barghest
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The barghest can use a bonus action to polymorph into a Small goblin or back into its true form. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. The barghest reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Fire Banishment
entries: The barghest treats any areas of open flames at least 10 feet wide as one-way portals to Gehenna. A barghest that starts its turn in a burning area must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be drawn through.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the barghest moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the barghest can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The barghest makes two claw attacks and uses its teleport.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the barghest can grapple the target (escape DC 14).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both the barghest and at least one of the barghest's allies must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Teleport (spell, 4th level)
entries: The barghest and up to one creature that is riding it or grappled by it magically teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the  greater restoration spell or other magic.

A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the basilisk sees its reflection within 30 feet of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Echolocation
entries: If the bat is not deafened, it gains one of the following benefits until the end of its next turn:

items.name: Low Frequency
entries: The bat gains Blindsight to a range of 60 feet.

items.name: High Frequency
entries: The bat has advantage on melee attack rolls. Whenever the bat uses its Chaotic Swerve and the triggering attack misses it, the bat regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Chaotic Swerve
entries: As a reaction when the bat is targeted with an attack, it may move 5 feet directly toward the nearest creature and impose disadvantage on the attack roll.
Then, if one or more creatures are within 5 feet of it, the bat must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

name: Bebilith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Abyssal but only speaks telepathically to its own kind

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The bebilith can innately cast the following spell, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Relentless Hunter
entries: The bebilith may use a bonus action to mark prey that it has damaged. Only one creature can be marked at a time. The bebilith always knows the exact location of the marked prey on the current plane of existence, cannot be surprised by it, and has advantage on all attack rolls against it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down, without needing to make an ability check and ignores any movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bebilith uses poisoned web if it can and then makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage. Any creature that drops to zero hit points because it has been bit by the bebilith lights on fire and suffers 7 (2d6) fire damage each round until healing is applied to them.

action.name: Foreleg
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Poisoned Web (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (8d8) poison damage, and the target is restrained by webbing. While restrained, the target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns and the target may then make a DC 17 Strength check to free itself from the webbing. Unlike normal webs, fire cannot burn a bebilith's webbing but if used will ignite the web inflicting an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage to trapped targets.

name: Behir
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Lighting Reflexes
entries: The behir does not roll initiative. Instead, it takes its turn on both initiative count 20 and initiative count 10.

trait.name: Sparking Wounds
entries: If the behir has fewer than 84 hit points, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the behir takes 4 (1d8) lightning damage.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the behir may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behir. While climbing on the behir, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the behir.

trait.name: Restless
entries: If the behir ends its turn without moving at least 25 feet, attacks against it are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends.

action.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns, and its attacks bypass the behir's resistances. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

name: Beholder

trait.name: Antimagic Cone
entries: The beholder's central eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the antimagic field spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the beholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. The area works against the beholder's own eye rays.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the beholder is dealt a critical hit, the beholder must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the beholder use.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The beholder has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Many Eyes (3/Day)
entries: If the behikder fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind it, it may choose to succeed instead. The beholder takes one fewer legendary actions each turn for each time it has used this ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The beholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it:

items.name: 1. Charm Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the beholder for 1 hour, or until the beholder harms the creature.

items.name: 2. Paralyzing Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 3. Fear Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Slowing Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 5. Enervation Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 6. Telekinetic Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or the beholder moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder is incapacitated.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The beholder can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

items.name: 7. Sleep Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.

items.name: 8. Petrification Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the  greater restoration spell or other magic.

items.name: 9. Disintegration Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 45 (10d8) force damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.

If the target is a Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a saving throw. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a 10-foot cube of it.

items.name: 10. Death Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

legendaryHeader: The beholder can take 3 legendary actions, using the Eye Ray option below. It can take only one legendary action at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The beholder regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The beholder uses one random eye ray.

name: Beholder Zombie
languages: understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but can't speak

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the beholder starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, unless it was dealt radiant damage or a critical hit since the end of its last turn.
On a success, the beholder regains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

trait.name: Rotting Eyestalks
entries: Attacks that deal slashing damage score a critical hit on an 18-20 against the beholder.
When the beholder is dealt a critical hit, the beholder must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice.

action.name: Befouling Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Moan of the Undreaming (Recharge 6)
entries: A fetid gasp escapes the beholder's mouth, carried from beyond this world.

Each creature within 20 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or take 9 (2d8) necrotic plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of the beholder's next turn.

reaction.name: What Dreams May Come
entries: When the beholder is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, it may create a Gazer in an unoccupied space it can see within 15 feet.

reaction.name: Clouded Rays
entries: When a creature the beholder can see ends its movement within 30 feet of the beholder, the beholder forces it to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

items.name: 1. Wasting Ray
entries: The target's Dexterity score is reduced by a cumulative 7 (2d6), to a minimum of 1 (Save Ends at end of turn). A creature reduced to 1 Dexterity in this way is paralyzed.

items.name: 2. Flickering Panic Ray
entries: The target is blinded until the end of its next turn. While blinded in this way, a creature cannot distinguish friend from foe.

items.name: 3. Stumbling Ray
entries: The target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and falls prone.

items.name: 4. Flaying Ray
entries: A portion of the target's skin begins to disintegrate, taking 16 (3d10) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way gains vulnerability to all damage until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

trait.name: Read Bones
entries: By carefully examining the bones of a creature, the berbalang can extract any secrets it knew in life.

trait.name: Dream Travel
entries: While the berbalang sleeps, its spirit leaves its body. In spirit form, the berbalang has the same statistics, except that its attacks deal psychic damage instead of any other type and it can teleport to another plane as an action. If the berbalang dies in spirit form, its body dies.

trait.name: Weak Flier
entries: While grappling a creature larger than size Small, the berbalang cannot fly unless the creature is also grappled by one of its duplicates.

action.name: Bonegnaw Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or reveal one of its secrets to the berbalang.

action.name: Grasping Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Absorb Duplicate
entries: The berbalang absorbs one of its duplicates, destroying it and gaining 20 Temporary hit points.

action.name: Detonate Duplicate
entries: The berbalang detonates one of its duplicates. Each creature within 15 ft. of the duplicate must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Duplicate Self (Original Only)
entries: If the berbalang has at least 20 hit points, the berbalang creates a duplicate of itself, reducing its current hit points by 1/4. The duplicate has hit points equal to those lost in its creation, and acts on the berbalang's initiative.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Graystaff Magic
entries: The hag carries a graystaff, a length of gray wood that is a focus for her inner power. She can ride the staff as if it were a broom of flying. If the staff is lost or destroyed, the hag cannot use its rime burst and must craft another, which takes a year and a day. Only a bheur hag can use a graystaff.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The hag can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra moment.

trait.name: Sapping Cold
entries: Each time a creature hits the bheur hag with a melee attack, it must expend one unexpended hit die. If it cannot, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end its next turn.

trait.name: Wintergiver Coven
entries: The area within 50 miles of a coven of bheur hags drops 1 degree every hour until it reaches 10 degrees below the lowest natural winter temperature of the area. Creatures in the area without cold resistance or immunity subtract 1d4 from the result of saving throws they make.

action.name: Rime Burst (Greystaff only)
entries: The hag sends forth an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creatue that starts its turn in it or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Maddening Feast
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one incacitated or dead target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage and 36 (8d8) cold damage. Each creature of the hag's choice that can see it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for a minute. A frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Curse of Paranoia
entries: One frightened creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A cursed creature cannot target friendly creatures with spells. If the cursed creature is targeted with a spell by a friendly creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unaffected by the spell.

reaction.name: Feed on Greed
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. targeting itself with a spell, the bhuer hag changes the spell's target to itself.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The biomancer is a 16th-level Simic spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The biomancer has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Bolstering Presence
entries: The biomancer magically emanates life-giving energy within 30 feet of itself. Any ally of the biomancer that starts its turn there regains 5 () hit points.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The biomancer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Black Abishai
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the abishai can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Creeping Darkness
entries: The abishai continously drains the light from the area around it. At the beginning of its turn, each source of bright light within 30 ft. becomes a source of dim light, each source of dim light is extinguished, and each area of darkness becomes magical darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai makes three attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its bite.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target drops one item of the abishai's choice that it is holding.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.

reaction.name: Dragonspawn Exhultation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly dragon within 30 ft. using its breath weapon, the abishai may move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the bear must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same medium or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 7 (2d6) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Blustery Charge (Recharge 6)
entries: The bear moves up to its speed towards a creature. Each creature within 5 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the bear's next turn.
If no creature fails this save, the bear is frightened of each creature that passed it until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The dog has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Teleport (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then makes a bite attack at advantage.

name: Blistercoil Weird
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Feed on Fire
entries: If the weird takes fire damage from a spell or other magical effect, its size increases by one category. If there isn't enough room for the weird to increase in size, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available. While the weird is Large or bigger, it makes Strength checks and saving throws with advantage. If the weird starts its turn at Gargantuan size, the weird releases energy in an explosion. Each creature within 30 feet of the weird must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. The weird's size then becomes Medium.

trait.name: Form of Fire and Water
entries: The weird can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, the weird can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time the weird enters another creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the burning creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the weird or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The weird sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, or 11 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage if the weird is Large or bigger.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Air Superiority
entries: If the hawk descended at least 60 ft. this turn, it may Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hawk makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is Small or smaller, it is grappled and (escape DC 14).

name: Blood Witch
languages: Abyssal plus any one language (usually Common)

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The witch can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Blood Witch Dance
entries: The witch can use a bonus action to control the movement of one creature cursed by its hex spell that it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or use its reaction to move up to 30 feet in a direction of the witch's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witch makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its shortsword.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The harpy has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Dark Devotion
entries: The harpy has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Chain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the giant can't use this attack on anyone else.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Furious Defense
entries: After a creature the giant can see is dealt damage by a foe within 20 feet of the giant, the giant makes a chain attack against that foe.

name: Blue Abishai
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mirage
entries: If the abishai starts its turn with fewer than 98 hit points, the air around it wavers and shimmers causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai attacks three times with its crackling doom. It may replace one of these attacks with its Bite or its Ionize, if available.

action.name: Crackling Doom (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Ionize (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Constituiton saving throw or become a conduit for lightning energy until the end of the abishai's next turn. Attacks that deal lightning damage are made at advantage against an affected creature, and the creature makes Dexterity saving throws against effects that deal lightning damage at disadvantage. Whenever an affected creature takes lightning damage, each creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity save or take half as much lightning damage.

reaction.name: Dragonspawn Exhultation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly dragon within 30 ft. using its breath weapon, the abishai may move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

reaction.name: Shimmering Escape (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting it with a melee attack, the abishai magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

trait.name: Wall Lurker
entries: The slaad may pass through wood, plaster, or stone walls without resistance.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The slaad regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its phage-laden bite. It may replace any number of these attacks with uses of its Mighty Leap.

action.name: Phage-Laden Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Chaos Phage.

action.name: Rending Bonescythes
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

action.name: Mighty Leap
entries: The slaad leaups up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Earth Scenting
entries: The boar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 ft. of it.

trait.name: Ploughing Charge
entries: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line, it may move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature.
When the boar enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage. A prone creature takes an additional 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance
entries: As a reaction to taking damage that would reduce it to 0 hit points, the boar makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the boar is instead reduced to 1 hit point.
If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Earth Scenting
entries: The firepig has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 ft. of it.

trait.name: Water-Warded
entries: If the firepig is doused in water, it becomes frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Fire-Iron Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.
If the firepig moved up to 10 feet towards the target before making this attack, the target is additionally pushed 10 feet away from it.

action.name: Wildfire Wallow (1/Day)
entries: The firepig unleashes a firey explosion around it. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and begins burning (1d10), taking half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Blistering Squeal
entries: When the firepig succeeds on a saving throw or takes the Dash action, it can cause each burning creature within 30 feet of it to take 5 (1d10) fire damage, and then it regains the use of its Wildfire Wallow.

name: Bodak
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Death Gaze
entries: The bodak's eyes reflect the horror that frightened it to death. A creature not immune to the frightened condition that starts its turn within 30 feet of the bodak and can see its eyes must succeed a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead drops to 0 hit points.
The bodak is forced to close its eyes while in sunlight, disabling this trait.

trait.name: Aura of Annihilation
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the bodak fail death saving throws automatically, and cannot be stabilized without regaining at least one Hit Point. A creature that dies in this aura rises as a bodak after 24 hours.

trait.name: Fear is Where It Lives
entries: The bodak is always frightened. If another effect would subject the bodak to the frightened condition, it instead gains 18 (4d8) temporary hit points.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the bodak must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Share Horror (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bodak opens its mind to those around it. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed and frightened by the bodak until the end of its next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature cannot avert its eyes.

trait.name: Podling Link
entries: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: When the plant dies, it returns to life in the place where it died  months later, unless the ground where it took root is sown with salt or soaked with poison.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The plant doesn't require sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plant makes three Vine Lash attacks.

action.name: Vine Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The plant has four vines, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Entrapping Pod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature grappled by the plant. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage, and the target is pulled into the plant's space and enveloped by the pod, and the grapple ends. While enveloped, the target is restrained, and it has total cover against attacks and effects originating outside the pod. The enveloped target must also immediately succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned by the plant's sapping enzymes until it is removed from the pod or the plant dies. The enveloped target doesn't require air and gains 1 level of exhaustion for each hour it spends in the pod. If the target dies while enveloped, it immediately emerges from the pod as a living podling, wearing or carrying all of the original creature's equipment.

As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the bodytaker plant that is outside the pod can open the pod and pull the target free with a successful DC 15 Strength check. If the plant dies, the target is no longer restrained and can escape from the pod by spending 10 feet of movement, exiting prone. The plant has one pod, which can envelop one creature at a time.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The knight is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Commander of Bones
entries: As a bonus action, the knight can target one skeleton or zombie it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must obey the knight's commands until the knight dies or until the knight releases it as a bonus action. The knight can command up to twelve undead at a time this way.

trait.name: Master of the Pallid Banner
entries: While within 60 feet of the knight, any undead ally of the knight has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight attacks twice with one of its weapons.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The naga scores a critical hit on a roll of 15-20 on attacks made against a creature that is frightened.

action.name: Cursed Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws to resist fear effects. A cursed creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Death Rattle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee weapon attack, the naga lets loose an echoing rattle that causes living creatures to reflect on their own mortality. Each non-undead creature within 5 feet of the naga must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the naga's next turn.

trait.name: Adhesive
entries: The bone whelk can cause Medium or smaller objects to adhere to it. A Medium or smaller creature that touches the bone whelk is grappled by it (escape DC 10).

trait.name: Death Scream
entries: When the bone whelk dies, it emits a blood-curdling shriek than can be heard out to a range of 120 feet. This shriek causes nonmagical, organic material within 10 feet of the bone whelk to rot. Each creature within 10 feet of the bone whelk when it dies takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bone whelk can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

name: Boneclaw
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources while in dim light or darkness
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: While its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw gains a new body in 1d10 hours, with all its hit points. The new body appears within 1 mile of the boneclaw's master.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the boneclaw can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneclaw makes two attacks with its Ghastly Claws, each of which it may replace with a use of its Douse or Shadowsink, if available.

action.name: Ghastly Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the boneclaw and grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Douse
entries: The boneclaw reduces a source of Bright Light you can see within 60 feet to Dim Light, or extinguishes a source of Dim Light it can see in the area. If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

action.name: Shadowsink (Recharge 5-6)
entries: If the boneclaw is in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadows around it deepen to a pure black and it sinks through to the world of shadow, emerging at another location in Dim Light or Darkness within 60 feet.

Each creature within 5 feet of the boneclaw must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be drawn through this passage behind it, taking 32 (5d12) necrotic damage and emerging in the nearest unoccupied space to the boneclaw. A grappled creature makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is wrapped around a creature, the boneless takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature grappled by the boneless takes the other half.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the boneless wraps itself around the target (escape DC 11). While the boneless is wrapped around it, a creature cannot speak or breathe, and the boneless moves with the target.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One creature the boneless is wrapped around must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or have the air driven from its lungs and begin to suffocate.

name: Bore Worm
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The worm regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm makes two attacks: one with its grinding jaws and one with its stinger.

action.name: Grinding Jaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The brain in a jar's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Detect Sentience
entries: The brain in a jar can sense the presence and location of any creature within 300 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers, unless the creature is protected by a mind blank spell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The brain in a jar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The brain in a jar magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 13 (2d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The braxat casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

trait.name: Intellect Fortress
entries: The braxat's AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The braxat makes two Greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The braxat exhales a 15-foot cone of acid. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Psionic Shield (3/Day)
entries: When the braxat would be hit by an attack roll or a magic missile spell that originates from a source the braxat can see, the braxat can create an invisible barrier of magical force around itself that lasts until the start of its next turn. This barrier gives the braxat a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and prevents magic missile spells from damaging it.

trait.name: Bladed Hide
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the moorbounder deals 5 (2d4) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The moorbounder's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The moorbounder makes two attacks: one with its blades and one with its claws.

action.name: Blades
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Thunderous Stride
entries: If the brontosaurus moves on its turn, the ground within 10 feet of it becomes difficult terrain for all other creatures until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the brontosaurus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brontosaurus attacks twice with its stomp, one of which it may replace with a use of its Tail Sweep, if available.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Tail Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success.

name: Bronze Sable
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the sable remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The sable has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sable's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the sable surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sable makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Bronze Scout
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Earth Armor
entries: The bronze scout doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it burrows.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The bronze scout has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Flare (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Each creature in contact with the ground within 15 feet of the bronze scout must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the bear must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Rear Up
entries: The bear may use 30 ft. of its movement to stand upright until the end of its turn. While standing, the bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and attacks made with its claws, and cannot attack with its bite.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same medium or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 7 (2d6) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Bluff Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bear moves up to its speed towards a creature. Each creature within 10 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the bear's next turn.
If no creature fails this save, the bear may make a claw attack against a creature in range as part of this action.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Deadly Leap
entries: If the bulette jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the bulette's space.

trait.name: Rotting Presence
entries: When any creature that isn't a demon starts its turn within 30 feet of the bulezau, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The bulezau's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The bulezau has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Barbed Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease ends. While poisoned in this way, the target sports festering boils, coughs up flies, and sheds rotting skin, and the target must repeat the saving throw after every 24 hours that elapse. On a successful save, the disease ends. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by 4 (). The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

name: Burnished Hart
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the hart moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antlers attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the hart or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The hart has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hart makes two attacks: one with its antlers and one with its hooves.

action.name: Antlers
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

name: Cackler
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cackler's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). The cackler can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Last Laugh
entries: When the cackler dies, it releases a dying laugh that scars the minds of other nearby creatures. Each creature within 10 feet of the cackler must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or take 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The cackler can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 11 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Spiked Chain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Cambion Advocate
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dark Heart
entries: Unless bound with blessed salt and silver, the cambion can magically conceal its fiendish traits at will, and its nature cannot be detected by magic.

trait.name: Unfated (1/Day)
entries: At the end of the cambion's turn, it can end one condition affecting it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cambion makes two attacks with its Balefire Blade or Hurl Flame.

action.name: Balefire Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) fire or necrotic damage (cambion's choice).

action.name: Hurl Flame (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a critical hit, the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Infernal Animus (Recharge 5-6, 4th Level Spell)
entries: The cambion cloaks one creature it can see within 30 feet of it in a vile, hateful aura. Each creature of the cambion's choice within 30 feet of the target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become hostile towards the target and indifferent to all other creatures until the end of the cambion's next turn.

bonus.name: Suborn Will
entries: The cambion touches a dazed creature within 5 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw, becoming dominated by the cambion on a failed save.
A dominated creature can repeat its saving throw whenver it takes damage or when a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to attempt to free it, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Trickster's Guile (Concentration)
entries: The cambion touches a creature within 5 feet of it and causes it to become dazed until the end of the cambion's next turn.

name: Cambion Evangel
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dark Heart
entries: Unless bound with blessed salt and silver, the cambion can magically conceal its fiendish traits at will, and its nature cannot be detected by magic.

trait.name: Unfated (3/Day)
entries: At the end of the cambion's turn, it can end one condition affecting it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cambion makes two attacks with its Rootfang Longspear, one of which it can replace with a use of its Brimstone Barrage or Infernal Animus.

action.name: Rootfang Longspear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.
If the target would regain any hit points before the start of its next turn, it instead regains half as many.

action.name: Brimstone Barrage (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The cambion spews clinging fire in a 30 feet cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) fire damage and beginning burning (1d10) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Infernal Animus (4th Level Spell)
entries: The cambion cloaks one creature it can see within 30 feet of it in a vile, hateful aura. Each creature of the cambion's choice within 30 feet of the target must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become hostile towards the target and indifferent to all other creatures until the end of the cambion's next turn.

action.name: Calamitous Rite (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: A storm of astral chaos tears through reality in an instant, lashing unpredictably in a 40-foot radius from the cambion.
Roll a d20 for each other creature in the area. On a roll of 1-10, the creature takes 33 (6d10) force damage and is pushed up to 30 feet away.

bonus.name: Devilish Transposition (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The cambion teleports to switch places with an ally within 60 feet, or teleports two allies it can see within 60 feet to switch place with each other.

bonus.name: Suborn Will
entries: The cambion touches a dazed creature within 5 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, becoming dominated by the cambion on a failed save.
A dominated creature can repeat its saving throw whenver it takes damage or when a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to attempt to free it, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Trickster's Guile (Concentration)
entries: The cambion touches a creature within 5 feet of it and causes it to become dazed until the end of the cambion's next turn.

legendary.name: Insidious Influence
entries: One creature dazed or dominated by the cambion must use its reaction, if available, to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the cambion's choice.

legendary.name: Scales of Malice
entries: Tormenting energy slithers forth from the cambion, dealing 18 (4d8) psychic damage to a creature within 30 feet of it.
The target can choose to transfer half of this damage to one of its allies.

legendary.name: Twirling Slash
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the cambion must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) slashing damage and being pushed 5 feet away on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.
Before or after using this legendary action, the cambion can move up to half its speed.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Campestri
languages: understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The campestri can mimic any voice or song it has heard, albeit in a nasal falsetto.

action.name: Head Butt
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spores (1/Day)
entries: A 5-foot radius of spores extends from the campestri. These spores can go around corners, and they have no effect on Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Each other creature in the area must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated and its speed is halved, both for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Canoloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dimensional Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the canoloth. Any attempt to do so is wasted. Creatures in the area have resistance to Force damage.

trait.name: Outsize Strength
entries: While grappling, dragging, or being ridden by another creature, the canoloth is considered to be Large.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The canoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Barbed Tongue
entries: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the canoloth takes 13 (2d12) piercing damage. The tongue can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points). Destroying the tongue deals no damage to the canoloth, which can extrude more tongue on its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The canoloth makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Tongue
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15), and is restrained until the grapple ends. The canoloth can grapple one target at a time with its tongue.

reaction.name: Reel
entries: As a reaction to a creature damaging its tongue or failing an attempt to escape its grapple, the canoloth may force a creature grappled by it to succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and pulled 30 feet towards the canoloth.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The plant can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plant makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 () on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The plant has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: The plant slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the plant's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The carrion crawler has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The carrion crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Consume
entries: If the carrion crawler has a creature grappled, the carrion crawler can make a predigest attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The carrion crawler makes two attacks with its tentacles.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage, the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the carrion crawler can't use its tentacles against another target.

action.name: Predigest
entries: One grappled creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, attackers score a critical hit against the poisoned creature on a roll of 11-20. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Bite Down
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a creature it does not have grappled, the carrion crawler makes a bite attack against a creature it has grappled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The creature makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Tied Down
entries: While lashed to the floor, the creature is prone and restrained. It also suffers from two levels of exhaustion.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The carrion stalker makes three Tentacle attacks. If it is attached to a creature, it can replace one Tentacle attack with Larval Burst, if available.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target and pulls itself into the target's space. While attached, the carrion stalker moves with the target and has advantage on attack rolls against it.

A creature can use its action to try to detach the carrion stalker and force it to move into the nearest unoccupied space, doing so with a successful DC 11 Strength check. On its turn, the carrion stalker can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement. When it dies, the carrion stalker detaches from any creature it is attached to.

action.name: Larval Burst (1/Day)
entries: The carrion stalker releases a burst of larvae in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. A creature poisoned in this way takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns as larvae infest its body. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Any effect that cures disease or removes the poisoned condition instantly kills the larvae in the creature, ending the effect on it.

If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by the infestation, it dies. The larvae remain in the corpse, and one survives to become a fully grown carrion stalker in  weeks. Any effect that cures diseases or removes the poisoned condition that targets the corpse instantly kills the larvae.

name: Carrionette
languages: understands the languages of its creator

trait.name: False Object
entries: If the carrionette is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the carrionette move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the carrionette is animate.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The carrionette doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Silver Needle
