entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or become cursed for 1 minute. While cursed in this way, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it must roll a d6 and subtract the number rolled from each ability check or attack roll it makes.

action.name: Soul Swap
entries: The carrionette targets a creature it can see within 15 feet of it that is cursed by its Silver Needle. Unless the target is protected by a protection from evil and good spell, it must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or have its consciousness swapped with the carrionette. The carrionette gains control of the target's body, and the target is unconscious for 1 hour, after which it gains control of the carrionette's body. While controlling the target's body, the carrionette retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. It otherwise uses the controlled body's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

If the carrionette's body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the controlled body drives the carrionette out and returns the consciousness of both creatures to their original bodies. The swap is also undone if the controlled body takes damage from the carrionette's Silver Needle.

trait.name: Righting Reflex
entries: The cat takes no fall damage if it falls from a height of 30 ft. or greater.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the cat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 6 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: As a reaction when a Tiny creature attempts to leave the cat's reach, the cat may force it to make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the Stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of the catoblepas's next turn.

action.name: Death Ray (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The catoblepas targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target instead takes 64 necrotic damage. The target dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this ray.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the crawler can bite only the grappled creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

action.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 6)
entries: The crawler spits acid in a line that is 30 feet long and 5 feet wide, provided that it has no creature grappled. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The badger does not die or fall unconscious due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Flammable Blood
entries: If the cave fisher takes fire damage while below 30 hit points, it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns, and deals an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage with its melee attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave fisher makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Adhesive Filament
entries: The cave fisher extrudes a sticky filament up to 60 ft. A creature that touches this filament is grappled (escape DC 13). The filament can be attacked (AC 15; 5 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), but a weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful DC 13 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament causes no damage to the cave fisher, which can extrude a replacement filament on its next turn.

action.name: Reel
entries: One Medium or smaller creature grappled by the cave fisher's filament becomes restrained  must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 60 ft. toward the cave fisher.

reaction.name: Angler's Set
entries: As a reaction to a creature becoming grappled by or failing an attempt to escape its filament, the cave fisher uses its Reel.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the ceratops moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the ceratops can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the cerodon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the cerodon can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The cerodon deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
entries: The champion rerolls a failed saving throw.

trait.name: Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the champion can regain 20 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The champion makes three attacks with its greatsword or its shortbow.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) slashing damage if the champion has more than half of its total hit points remaining.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the champion has more than half of its total hit points remaining.

trait.name: Change Appearance
entries: The changeling can use its action to polymorph into a Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The changeling makes two attacks with its dagger.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Unsettling Visage (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the changeling must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Chimera
languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: The chimera has three reactions each round. Whenever it takes 20 or more damage from a single source it must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose one of its reactions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d8) fire damage

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon head exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Headbutt
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the chimera may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or  take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the chimera's next turn.

reaction.name: Rake
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the chimera may make a claws attack against it.

reaction.name: Roar
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the chimera may let out a terrifying roar. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the chimera until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Aberrant Quickness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The choker can take an extra action on its turn.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The choker can move through and occupy a space as narrow as 4 inches wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The choker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The choker makes two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the choker can't use this tentacle on another target. The choker has two tentacles. If this attack is a critical hit, the target also can't breathe or speak until the grapple ends.

name: Chupacabra
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the chupacabra has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Drain Blood
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is prone, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the chupacabra regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

reaction.name: Pin
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of the chupacabra stands up, the chupacabra can use its reaction to make a bite attack.

name: Chuul
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of it. It can't be surprised by creatures carrying magic items.

trait.name: Brittle Shell
entries: If the chuul takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 13 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chuul makes two attacks: one with its seizer claw and one with its crusher claw, then uses it tentacles, if available.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) and dragged up to 5 feet towards the chuul. The chuul can grapple only a single target at a time.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: One creature grappled by the chuul must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is poisoned and attacks against it score a critical on a 15-20 until the end of the chuul's next turn.

reaction.name: Psychic Static (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 46 hit points, the chuul forces each creature within 10 ft. to succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage. A creature with telepathy makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chwinga's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components:

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The chwinga doesn't require air, food, or drink. When it dies, it turns into a handful of flower petals, a cloud of pollen, a stone statuette resembling its former self, a tiny sphere of smooth stone, or a puddle of fresh water (your choice).

trait.name: Evasion
entries: When the chwinga is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

action.name: Magical Gift (1/Day)
entries: The chwinga targets a humanoid it can see within 5 feet of it. The target gains a supernatural charm of the DM's choice.

action.name: Natural Shelter
entries: The chwinga magically takes shelter inside a rock, a living plant, or a natural source of fresh water in its space. The chwinga can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect while inside this shelter, and the shelter doesn't impair the chwinga's blindsight. The chwinga can use its action to emerge from a shelter. If its shelter is destroyed, the chwinga is forced out and appears in the shelter's space, but is otherwise unharmed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chwinga casts one of the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Evasion
entries: When the chwinga is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails, provided it isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The chwinga doesn't require air, food, or drink. When it dies, it turns into a tiny pile of moondust, a cloud of glittering spores, a statuette resembling its former self, a chunk of ice, or a sponge shaped like a dodecahedron (DM's choice).

action.name: Magical Gift (1/Day)
entries: The chwinga targets a Humanoid it can see within 5 feet of itself. The target gains a supernatural charm of the DM's choice.

action.name: Natural Shelter
entries: The chwinga takes shelter inside a rock, a bush, a tree, or a natural source of fresh water in its space. The chwinga can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect while it is magically protected in this way, and the shelter doesn't impair the chwinga's blindsight. The chwinga can use its action to emerge from a shelter. If its shelter is destroyed, the chwinga is forced out and appears in the shelter's space, but is otherwise unharmed.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The clawfoot has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the clawfoot's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the clawfoot moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the clawfoot can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The clawfoot makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Clay Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands The Languages Of Its Creator but can't speak

trait.name: Acid Neutralization
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to acid damage, its form becomes brittle and it loses its immunity to nonmagical weaponry until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Clay Body
entries: Whenever the golem takes at least 25 points of fire damage in a turn, its speed is reduced by 10 and its AC is increased by 2 until it completes a short or long rest. If its speed is reduced to 0 in this way, it loses all damage immunities and gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Shed Layer
entries: When the golem is reduced below 67 hit points, it sheds its outer layer, freeing itself of all debilitating conditions. For the next minute, the golem can use its slam attack as a bonus action and gains a +2 bonus to its AC.

trait.name: Words of the Creator
entries: Immediately before the golem takes an action, a description of that action appears on the surface of its body in a language known to its creator. A creature that can read this language and can see the golem may use its reaction to halve one source of damage dealt by the golem this turn.

A creature may use its action to write a word in the same language on the golem's surface. If the word describes an action, the golem must take that action on its following turn. If the word describes a condition, the golem must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted with that condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same Large or smaller creature, the creature is knocked prone and cannot stand on its following turn.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. This attack deals an additional 11 (2d10) damage against a prone creature.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

reaction.name: Grip of Clay
entries: When the golem is hit with a melee weapon attack, it can cause the weapon to stick to it.
A creature can wrench the weapon free as an action or bonus action with a successful DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check.

name: Archivist Grim
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Chained Vigil
entries: If the grim is reduced to 0 hit points, it becomes incapacitated but is not destroyed unless its bones are exhumed and reburied.

trait.name: Stifling Aura
entries: The grim projects magical silence in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on it. Creatures in the area have advantage on saving throws made to maintain concentration.

action.name: Multiattack
action.entries: The grim makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Scribe's Mastery.

action.name: Inkwrought Bonds (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +9 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) force damage and the target is restrained until the end of its next turn (escape DC 17).

action.name: Scribe's Mastery
entries: The grim unbinds the magic of a spell scroll within 60 feet of it, casting the spell contained within (+9 to hit, save DC 17). If the scroll is carried by a creature, the grim casts a randomly selected scroll carried by the creature.

action.name: Consign to Myth (Recharge 5-6, 7th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the grim touches must make a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target disappears into a book within 15 feet of it and is considered incapacitated. When the spell ends, the target gains the benefits of a short rest.

The target can repeat its saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After three failed saving throws, the target stops repeating the saving throw. If the book is opened or destroyed, the spell ends.

reaction.name: Fictive Twist (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the grim casts a spell, it can cause the spell's effect to become an illusion, resulting in the following effects:

items: Any damage dealt by the spell becomes psychic damage
Any saving throw that the spell forces creatures to make becomes an Intelligence saving throw

name: Topiary Golem Ornamental
languages: One language known by its creator

trait.name: Hedgeblend
entries: The golem can move through hedges or other dense foliage without impediment, and can occupy their space.

trait.name: Golemcraft Ward (1/Day)
entries: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead. The golem adds +3 to saving throws against spells and magical effects for each use of this ability it has remaining.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks with its Manicured Slash.

action.name: Manicured Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.
If the golem has half of its maximum hit points or fewer, this attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage.

bonus.name: Extend Roots
entries: The golem drives its roots into the ground, reducing its speed to 0 and gaining tremorsense to a range of 90 feet until it ends this effect as a bonus action.
While in this state, the golem is indistinguishable from an ordinary topiary and has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being forcefully moved.

name: Topiary Golem Mazewatch
languages: One language known by its creator

trait.name: Hedgeblend
entries: The golem can move through hedges or other dense foliage without impediment, and can occupy their space.

trait.name: Golemcraft Ward (2/Day)
entries: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead. The golem adds +3 to saving throws against spells and magical effects for each use of this ability it has remaining.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Custodian's Command or Bough Shelter, if available.

action.name: Manicured Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.
If the golem has half of its maximum hit points or fewer, this attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage.

action.name: Thorn Dart
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Custodian's Command
entries: One plant creature within 30 feet of the golem can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack.

action.name: Bough Shelter (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem or one plant creature the golem can see within 30 feet gains 30 temporary hit points as a shield of boughs grows to envelop it, restraining it until the start of its next turn.
If the target starts its turn with any of these temporary hit points remaining, it loses all of them and regains 30 hit points.

bonus.name: Extend Roots
entries: The golem drives its roots into the ground, reducing its speed to 0 and gaining tremorsense to a range of 90 feet until it ends this effect as a bonus action.
While in this state, the golem is indistinguishable from an ordinary topiary and has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being forcefully moved.

legendary.name: Growth Burst
entries: The golem forces each creature within 5 feet of it to make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from it.

legendary.name: Rustling Rancor
entries: The golem moves up to 10 feet, then makes an attack.

legendary.name: Sculpt Cutting (1/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The golem drags forth a Topiary Golem Ornamental from a Large or larger inanimate hedge or shrub within 5 feet that acts on its initiative and under its control.
After 1 minute, the created golem turns back into inanimate foliage.

name: Tome Golem
languages: understands the languages in its component books but can't speak

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the golem takes any amount of fire damage, it begins burning (1d10)

trait.name: Golemcraft Ward (3/Day)
entries: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead. The golem adds +3 to saving throws against spells and magical effects for each use of this ability it has remaining.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three attacks and can use its Awaken Spellbook or Dweomer Flare.

action.name: Codex Crush
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
If the golem is burning, this attack deals an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Awaken Spellbook
entries: The golem calls upon the stored magic of one spellbook within 30 feet ofit, transforming it into an Animated Book that uses the golem's attack bonus for 1 hour.

action.name: Dweomer Flare
entries: Raw magic bursts from the golem's pages. One randomly selected creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Archive Spell (Concentration)
entries: When the golem is targeted by a spell of 3rd level or lower, it can trap the spell within itself, delaying its effects. At the start of the golem's next turn, it releases the spell, and can choose new targets for it within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down). and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the cloaker remains motionless without its underside exposed, it is indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cloaker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it. If the cloaker has advantage against the target, the cloaker attaches to the target's head, and the target is blinded and unable to breathe while the cloaker is attached. While attached, the cloaker can make this attack only against the target and has advantage on the attack roll. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the cloaker by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Moan
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the cloaker that can hear its moan and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the cloaker's moan for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Phantasms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The cloaker magically creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in bright light. The duplicates move with it and mimic its actions, shifting position so as to make it impossible to track which cloaker is the real one. If the cloaker is ever in an area of bright light, the duplicates disappear.

Whenever any creature targets the cloaker with an attack or a harmful spell while a duplicate remains, that creature rolls randomly to determine whether it targets the cloaker or one of the duplicates. A creature is unaffected by this magical effect if it can't see or if it relies on senses other than sight.
A duplicate has the cloaker's AC and uses its saving throws. If an attack hits a duplicate, or if a duplicate fails a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the duplicate disappears.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the clockwork dragon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a metal statue.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The clockwork dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Shutdown
entries: If targeted by dispel magic, the horror must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The horror doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes one Bite attack and two Rotating Saw attacks, or it makes two Lightning Jolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Rotating Saw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Lightning Jolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) lightning damage.

action.name: Spelljamming Helm Interface
entries: The horror attaches to a spelljamming helm it can see within 5 feet of itself and attunes to the helm instantly. If another creature is already attuned to the helm, that creature's attunement to the helm ends when the horror's attunement begins. The horror can operate the helm even though it isn't a spellcaster. The horror can detach from the helm as a bonus action, which ends its attunement to the helm.

name: Clockwork Observer
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The observer doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the observer is within 1 mile of its creator, it can magically convey what it sees to its creator, and the two can communicate telepathically.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The observer doesn't need air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Shriek
entries: The observer emits a mechanical shriek until the start of its next turn or until it drops to 0 hit points. This shriek can be heard within a range of 300 feet.

name: Cloud Giant
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Current Sense
entries: The giant's vision is not obscured by fog or clouds.

trait.name: Cloudwalk
entries: The giant can walk or jump on air, leaving a visible path of solidified clouds in its wake as it moves that remains for 1 minute before dispersing. If the giant is knocked prone or pushed off of this path, it falls as normal.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Topple
entries: As an action, a creature climbing on the giant may attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to topple it. On a success the giant is knocked prone and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its harden air ability.

action.name: Snatch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20).

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

action.name: Shake
entries: The giant turns a creature it has grappled upside down and shakes it vigorously. The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the giant's next turn and drops any money or items it is carrying but not wielding.

action.name: Harden Air
entries: The cloud giant condenses the air in an unoccupied 5 ft. cube it can see within 60 ft., turning it the consistency of stone. If suspended, the cube drops. A creature underneath it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Bleed Fog
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the cloud giant may shroud itself fog, becoming heavily obscured until the end of its next turn or until it moves.

name: Cloud Giant Smiling One
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Current Sense
entries: The giant's vision is not obscured by fog or clouds.

trait.name: Cloudwalk
entries: The giant can walk or jump on air, leaving a visible path of solidified clouds in its wake as it moves that remains for 1 minute before dispersing. If the giant is knocked prone or pushed off of this path, it falls as normal.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Topple
entries: As an action, a creature climbing on the giant may attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to topple it. On a success the giant is knocked prone in an unoccupied adjacent space and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes three melee attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its misty ephemery ability.

action.name: Filigree Greatscepter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the creature is pushed 10 feet away. A creature that is levitating takes an additional 5 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and is instead pushed up to 30 feet.

action.name: Misty Ephemera
entries: The giant creates a construct of light and air in the image of some creature, object, or other visible phenomena that occupies a space no larger than a 20-ft. cube centered on a point within 60 ft. that the giant can see, and lasts for a minute.

The construct moves and produces sound naturally, and seems to resist any spells or magical effects. Any physical interaction with the construct disperses it, then up to one Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be levitated 10 ft. off the ground until the end of the giant's following turn.

action.name: Runefog Vortex (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature the giant can see within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature loses all temporary hit points and each spell effect affecting it. The giant gains all temporary hit points and spell effects lost in this way.

reaction.name: Bleed Fog
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the cloud giant may shroud itself fog, becoming heavily obscured until the end of its next turn or until it moves.

reaction.name: Shift Fortunes
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see within 60 ft. making an attack roll or skill check, the giant causes a minor unpredictable event to intercede, imposing its choice of advantage or disadvantage on the roll.

action.name: Colorful Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Thawing Permafrost
entries: If the walker takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose its damage resistances and gain the ability to Dash as a Bonus Action for the next minute.

trait.name: Blinding Light
entries: The walker sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
As a bonus action, the walker can force one creature in its bright light to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the walker's next turn.

trait.name: Icy Doom
entries: A creature killed by the walker freezes for 9 days, during which time it can't be thawed, animated or raised from the dead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The walker makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Cold Ray (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the walker can see must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 49 (9d10) cold damage, or half as much on a success. A grappled creature makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Chill Weapon
entries: When the walker is hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) cold damage and drop its weapon.
If the creature attempts to pick the weapon up this turn, it must repeat this saving throw.

name: Colossus
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Common and Celestial but can't speak

trait.name: Crumbling Destruction
entries: When the colossus drops to 0 hit points, it crumbles and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of the crumbling statue must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the colossus is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The colossus's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The colossus of Akros makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., or range 200/600 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) piercing damage, or 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the colossus makes a ranged attack with this spear, the spear magically returns to its hand after the attack.

action.name: Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d8 + 9) slashing damage.

action.name: Flames of Akros (Recharge 6)
entries: Magical flames issue from the colossus toward up to three creatures the colossus can see within 90 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target also magically catches fire for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns thereafter, the burning target repeats the saving throw. It takes 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save, and the effect ends on a successful one.

trait.name: Power of the Mob
entries: When making Strength (Athletics) checks and Wisdom saving throws to avoid being frightened, the commoner rolls an additional d20 for each other commoner adjacent to it and takes the highest result rolled.

action.name: Improvised Weapon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Trample
entries: Target prone creature within 5 feet of the commoner takes 1 bludgeoning damage for each commoner adjacent to the target.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The conjurer is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The conjurer has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Benign Transportation (Recharges after the Conjurer Casts a Conjuration Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
entries: As a bonus action, the conjurer teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see. If it instead chooses a space within range that is occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature, they both teleport, swapping places.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The snake has advantage on stealth checks if it is more than 30 feet from any hostile creature.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the snake takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The snake's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being blinded.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the snake can't attack another target.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the snake has grappled with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the snake crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

name: Star Spawn Crawler
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The crawler has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the crawler's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crawler makes four attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the start of the crawler's next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Star Spawn Emissary
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The emissary has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The emissary makes three talons attacks.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Alluring Thrum (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The emissary emits a dreadful yet alluring hum. Each creature within 20 feet of the emissary that can hear it and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Crystal Spores (Recharge 6)
entries: A 15-foot-radius cloud of toxic crystalline spores extends out from the emissary. The spores spread around corners. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a creature takes 11 (2d10) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The prophet can traverse through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the prophet doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The prophet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The prohpet uses Fission Staff twice, Psychedelic Orb twice, or each one once.

action.name: Fission Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage, and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Psychedelic Orb
entries: The prophet hurls a glimmering orb at one creature it can see within 120 of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage and suffer a random condition until the start of the prophet's next turn. Roll a d6 for the condition: (1-2) blinded, (3-4) frightened, or (5-6) stunned.

reaction.name: Fuse Damage
entries: When the prophet is hit by an attack, it takes only half of the triggering damage. The first time the prophet hits with a melee attack on its next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 radiant damage.

name: Star Spawn Worm
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The worm sheds dim light in a 20-foot radius.

trait.name: Radiant Mirror
entries: If the worm takes radiant damage, each creature within 20 feet of it takes that damage as well.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm makes two attacks: one with its barbed tentacles and one with its bite.

action.name: Barbed Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The tentacles can grapple only one creature at a time.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (5d8 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 21 (6d6) fire damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Corpses
entries: When first encountered, a corpse flower contains the corpses of 1d6 + 3 humanoids. A corpse flower can hold the remains of up to nine dead humanoids. At the beginning of each of its turns, the corpse flower gains temporary hit points equal to the number of corpses it contains.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The corpse flower can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Stench of Death
entries: Each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the corpse flower or of a zombie under its control must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the beginning of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the creature's movement speed is halved and attacks against the creature are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corpse flower makes three tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Harvest
entries: The corpse flower stuffs a grappled creature into itself. A living creature in the corpse flower is restrained (escape DC 16), and takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage at the beginning of each of the corpse flower's turns. Corpses in the corpse flower can be used with its corpses trait.

reaction.name: Disgorge Zombie
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type that isn't fire or radiant, the corpse flower disgorges one of its corpses, which rises immediately as a zombie under the corpse flower's control in an unoccupied space within 10 ft., and acts on initiative count 0.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the horror fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The horror doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the horror can't use this tentacle against other targets. The horror has 1d8 + 1 tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Psychic Whispers (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The horror emits dreadful whispers in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in the sphere that isn't an Aberration must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Crushing Tentacle
entries: The horror crushes one creature it is grappling. The grappled creature must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (3d6 + 8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Poison Jet (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Foul gas squirts from the horror in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) poison damage.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The horror teleports, along with any creatures it is grappling, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself.

name: Couatl
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The couatl has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Dream Traveler
entries: The couatl can appear in the dreams of any creature it is familiar with. While in a creature's dream, the couatl may appear however it wishes, can communicate with the creature, and can free it from any poison, disease, or curse it is afflicted with.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the couatl may transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).

trait.name: Leaf on the Wind
entries: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement adjacent to the couatl, the couatl may move up to 15 feet. Opportunity attacks that it provokes with this movement are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The couatl attacks once with its bite and once with its constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target perceives its reality as though in a dream, and the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks. The target may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. When the effect ends, the target retains no memory of events that transpired while it was poisoned.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the couatl can't constrict another target.

trait.name: Stampede
entries: When the cow moves, each adjacent cow may use its reaction to move with it. If one or more cows do so, the cow has advantage on attack rolls this turn.

trait.name: Trample
entries: If the cow moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The crab can breathe air and water.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Nondetection
entries: The cat cannot be targeted or detected by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

trait.name: Righting Reflex
entries: The cat takes no fall damage if it falls from a height of 30 ft. or greater.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the cat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the cat can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The cat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Spell Turning
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell of 7th level or lower that targets only it, the cat avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the cat forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 15 ft. away.

trait.name: Psychic Conflict
entries: As a Bonus Action, a telepathic creature may issue a command to the cranium rat, making a contested Intelligence check against it. The creature that fails this check acts under the other's control on its following turn.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the rat gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again.

items.name: Avoid Notice
entries: The rat becomes invisible to creatures without proficiency in Perception.

items.name: Cerebral Glow
entries: The rat's exposed brain begins to glow softly, casting dim Light in a 10 foot radius. A creature illuminated by only this glow subtracts 1d4 from any Wisdom saving throws it makes.

action.name: Chittering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Devouring Cogniphage.

action.name: Invade Space
entries: The rat targets one humanoid within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity Saving Throw or have the rat enter its clothing or armor, sharing a space with it.

While the rat is in the creature's attire, it has full cover, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws, and the rat moves with it. The creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, dislodging the rat on a success.

trait.name: Murderous Intent
entries: The claw may pick up and wield unattended weapons and improvised weapons without the Heavy or Two-Handed trait. It is proficient with all such weapons.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning or slashing damage (claw's choice).

action.name: Grab
entries: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or have the claw become Attached to it (remove DC 11).
When a creature the claw is Attached to in this way makes an attack roll, it rolls a d4 and subtracts it from the total.

action.name: Squick
entries: One creature the claw is Attached to must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is frightened of the claw until the end of the claw's next turn, and must use its action to try to kill or remove the claw.

reaction.name: Skittering Shift
entries: When the claw targeted with an attack while grabbing a creature, it may move up to 5 feet.
If this movement makes it an invalid target for the attack, the attack instead targets the creature the claw was grabbing.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the crocodile remains motionless in water, it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when trying to pass itself off as a log.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the crocodile has a creature grappled and takes 5 or more Poison damage from a single source, it immediately releases its grapple.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

action.name: Death Roll (Recharge 6)
entries: A creature grappled by the crocodile must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) slashing damage and be stunned until the end of the crocodile's next turn, or half as much damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this ability loses a limb (crocodile's choice). The crocodile may not use this ability if it is grappled.

name: Cryonax, Bringer of Endless Winter
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Cryonax's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks). Cryonax can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Cold Aura
entries: At the start of each of Cryonax's turns, each creature within 10 feet of him takes 21 (6d6) cold damage. A creature also takes 21 (6d6) cold damage if they touch or hit Cryonax. Nonmagical weapons that hit Cryonax are frozen immediately after dealing damage to Cryonax. If used again and they hit any creature, the weapon shatters. The freezing effect disappears after an hour.

trait.name: Empowered Attacks
entries: Cryonax's slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical weapons.

trait.name: Ice Walker
entries: No ability checks are required when Cryonax walks or climbs across icy surfaces and difficult snow or ice terrain does not cost him extra movement.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Cryonax fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Cryonax has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cryonax makes two slam attacks with his tentacles or two ice spear attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Cryonax can grapple up to two targets but any tentacle that is grappling cannot be used to slam attack or use the ice spear attack.

action.name: Ice Spear
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage.

action.name: Summon Frost Horde (1/Day)
entries: Cryonax summons two young white dragons or a frost giant with 2 yetis. The summoning costs Cryonax 50 hit points. The summoned creatures have maximum hit points and appear within 100 feet of Cryonax.

legendary.name: Smash
entries: Cryonax slams a grappled target against the ground, dealing 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage to it.

legendary.name: Tentacle Freeze
entries: Cryonax's tentacle freezes a grappled target. If the target fails a DC 22 Constitution saving throw they are paralyzed and Cryonax releases them from its tentacle. They remain frozen indefinitely but can attempt the constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns. Success means they shrug off the freezing.

legendary.name: Ice Shroud (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: With a gesture Cryonax targets a frozen creature (see Tentacle Freeze) that is within 30 feet of him. The target is encased instantly in a hard shell of crushing ice. The target receives no saving throw and suffers 22 (5d8) cold damage immediately and at the start of each of their turns. The target is considered stunned but is partly protected by the shroud so is resistant to all damage. The shroud disappears if Cryonax removes it, Cryonax dies, the shroud takes 100 hit points of damage or another character uses their action and succeeds against a DC 22 Strength check to remove the trapped ally.

name: Crystal Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The golem magically sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. This light goes out when the golem is destroyed.

trait.name: Light Intensity
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the illuminated golem and can see the golem must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the start of the creature's next turn.

A creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the golem until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the golem in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Rocky Camouflage
entries: The dragon may attempt to hide in rocky terrain without being obscured.

trait.name: Lifechannel Aura
entries: At the beginning of each of the dragon's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it gains 5 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) radiant damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Breath of Life Overflowing
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of pure life energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) radiant damage and regaining 2 (1d4) expended hit dice on a failure, or taking half as much damage on a success.

Then, if the creature has no unexpended hit dice, it incandesces, losing each of its unexpended hit dice, rolling a number of d8s equal to the number of hit dice lost in this way, and taking additional radiant damage equal to the result.

action.name: Breath of Inner Dawn
entries: The dragon blows a mighty breath in a 15 foot long, 5 foot wide line that stokes a blinding glow within all it touches.

The dragon and each creature and object in the area begins to emit sunlight in a 30 foot radius for the next minute, and a creature without resistance to radiant damage that targets an affected creature with an attack or spell must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Whirling Gust
entries: One creature that the dragon can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be spun about with dizzying force. The next attack that creature makes before the beginning of the dragon's next turn is at disadvantage.

items.name: Prevailing Winds
entries: One creature that the dragon can see within 60 feet has its speed increased or decreased by 10 until the beginning of the dragon's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fanatic is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). The fanatic has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Dark Devotion
entries: The fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Dark Devotion
entries: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

trait.name: Pact of Pain
entries: Using a 10-minute ritual, the daemogoth can forge a magical bond with a willing creature it touches throughout the ritual. The creature becomes bound by the pact until it dies, the daemogoth dies, or the pact is broken by any effect that can remove a curse.

The daemogoth chooses one spell from the necromancy or enchantment school that is 3rd level or lower. The bound creature can cast that spell using this pact, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. When it casts the spell, the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage, which can't break the creature's concentration on a spell. Once the bound creature casts the spell in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The daemogoth makes three Agonizing Burst attacks. It can use Terrify, if available, in place of one of the attacks.

action.name: Agonizing Burst
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage. If the target is a creature, the daemogoth regains 5 hit points.

action.name: Terrify (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The daemogoth targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the daemogoth until the end of the daemogoth's next turn, and the daemogoth regains 5 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't frightened, and the daemogoth doesn't heal.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the titan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Pact of Suffering
entries: Using a 10-minute long ritual, the titan can forge a magical bond with a willing creature it touches throughout the ritual. The creature becomes bound by the pact until it dies, the titan dies, or the pact is broken by a wish spell.

The titan chooses one spell from the necromancy or enchantment school that is 8th level or lower. The bound creature can cast that spell using this pact, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. When it casts the spell, the creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage, which can't break the creature's concentration on a spell. Once the bound creature casts the spell in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The titan makes two Agonizing Burst attacks.

action.name: Agonizing Burst
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage. If the target is a creature, the titan regains 5 hit points.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The titan teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The titan makes one Agonizing Burst attack.

legendary.name: Stalking Nightmare (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The titan uses Teleport, after which it can target one creature within 20 feet of itself that it can see. The target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage, and the titan regains 10 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and the titan doesn't heal.

legendary.name: Terrorize (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The titan targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 38 (7d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the titan until the end of the target's next turn, and the titan regains 15 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't frightened, and the titan doesn't heal.

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the dao dies, its body disintegrates into crystalline powder, leaving behind only equipment the dao was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Earth Mastery
entries: Earth and unworked stone in a 15 ft. radius around the Dao moves at its whim. A creature that starts its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. in a direction of the dao's choice.

trait.name: Rooted Stance
entries: If the dao does not use its multiattack on its turn, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dao makes three maul attacks.

action.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Boulder Charge
entries: The Dao charges 30 ft. in a straight line. Each creature in the path of its charge must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed ahead of the dao, or take half as much damage and stop the dao's charge on a success.

action.name: Shockwave Stomp (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 55 (9d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the Dao's next turn. Each other creature within 15 feet of the dao is pushed 10 ft. away.

reaction.name: Earthen Grasp
entries: As a reaction to a creature falling prone within 15 ft. of it, the dao forces the creature to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of the Dao's next turn.

reaction.name: Fissures
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 99 hit points, the dao opens up to four fissures in the earth, each 5 ft. wide, 20 ft. long, and 15 ft. deep. A creature in one or more of the areas when they open must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or fall in, moving to an adjacent space on a success.

trait.name: Death Flash
entries: When the darkling dies, nonmagical light flashes out from it as its body burns to ash. Each creature in a 10-foot radius that can see must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Prematurely Aged
entries: The darkling has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

action.name: Shoddy Stiletto
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, it deals an additional extra 7 (1d6) piercing damage. On a natural 1, the blade breaks and becomes unusable.

action.name: Absorb Light
entries: The light level within 30 ft. of the darkling has its degree of brightness decreased by one, from Bright Light to Dim Light, from Dim Light to Darkness, or from Darkness to Magical Darkness. The Darkling takes 5 (2d4) radiant damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Hex
entries: Baleful shadows cling to one creature within 60 ft. that the darkling can see. Whenever the target takes damage, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. This effect ends if the cursed creature is illuminated with Bright Light.

trait.name: Death Flash
entries: When the darkling dies, nonmagical light flashes out from it as its body burns to ash. Each creature in a 10-foot radius that can see must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) radiant damage and be blinded until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Prematurely Aged
entries: The darkling has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The darkling makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Shoddy Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, it deals an additional extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage. On a natural 1, the blade breaks and becomes unusable.

bonus.name: Absorb Light
entries: The light level within 30 ft. of the darkling has its degree of brightness decreased by one, from Bright Light to Dim Light, from Dim Light to Darkness, or from Darkness to Magical Darkness. The Darkling takes 5 (2d4) radiant damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Hex
entries: Baleful shadows cling to one creature within 60 ft. that the darkling can see. Whenever the target takes damage, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. This effect ends if the cursed creature is illuminated with Bright Light.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while deafened.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

action.name: Crush
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). While grappled, the target is blinded and can't breathe breathe, and the darkmantle has advantage on attacks against it and cannot bite another target. If this attack was made with advantage, the creature loses its breath if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the darkmantle exudes a 15-foot radius of magical darkness that moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts until the next time the darkmantle takes damage.

trait.name: Two-Headed
entries: The dreadwolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreadwolf makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both of the dreadwolf's heads must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 17 (5d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Two-Headed
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dog makes two bite attacks.
