action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the creature must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 on a failure. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both of the death dog's heads must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 17 (5d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Petrifying Tendrils
entries: Any creature that starts its turn in the death embrace's space must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature is restrained. A creature restrained in this way must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failed saving throw or ending the effect on a successful one. The petrified condition lasts until the effect is ended by a greater restoration spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Reel
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the death embrace can pull each creature it is grappling up to 20 feet toward it (no action required).

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The death embrace can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The death embrace makes two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is also grappled (escape DC 16). The death embrace has six tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

reaction.name: Body Shield
entries: When the death embrace is hit by an attack, one creature the death embrace is grappling (chosen by the death embrace) takes the damage instead.

trait.name: Hemmoraging Cone
entries: The death kiss's eye creates a field that draws out a creature's blood through its wounds, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the death kiss decides which way the cone faces. Each creature that does not have all of its hit points that starts its turn in the area loses 5 (2d4) hit points and makes death saving throws at disadvantage.

trait.name: Lightning Blood
entries: Whenever the death kiss takes piercing or slashing damage, each other creature within 5 ft. takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage. A creature that that takes this damage while wearing metal armor can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Tendrils
entries: When the death kiss is dealt a critical hit, the death kiss must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or make one fewer attack with its multiattack until it completes a long rest.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The death kiss has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Th Death Kiss makes six attacks with its feeding tendrils. If more than one of them target a single creature, attacks beyond the first are made at advantage.

action.name: Feeding Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). The death kiss has ten tendrils, each of which may grapple a single creature. A creature grappled by two or more tendrils is restrained.

action.name: Thin Blood
entries: Each creature grappled by the deathkiss must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or one lose one unexpended hit die for each tendril grappling it, or half as many on a success, and the death kiss gains 10 temporary hit points for each hit die expended in this way. A creature that cannot instead drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Corrupted Blood Infusion
entries: One creature with zero unexpended hit die grappled by the death kiss must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 55 (10d10) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, a creature has immunity to lightning damage, remains conscious even if at 0 hit points, and acts under the death kiss' control. A creature that succeeds on this save instead takes 27 (5d10) lightning damage.

reaction.name: Blood Rejection
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the death kiss changes the effect's target to a creature it is grappling. If it does, the death kiss releases the creature from each tendril grappling it, and the creature gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Profane Resistance
entries: The death knight has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects, except those with a divine source.

trait.name: Deathless March
entries: While the knight is not incapacitated, undead allies of CR 4 or lower within 60 feet of it have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

trait.name: Grave Purge (1/Day)
entries: At the start of each of the knight's turns, it can end one condition or spell affecting it. If it does so, it is dazed until thie end of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes three attacks.

action.name: Dreadblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage has its soul absorbed into the blade, and cannot be revived while the blade is intact.

action.name: Necroflame Torrent (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The death knight spews forth black flames in a 30-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Destructive Wave (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The death knight creates a shockwave of unholy energy in a 30-foot radius around it. Each creature of the knight's choice in the area must mak a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 (5d6) thunder damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Grim Steed
entries: The death knight conjures and mounts a spectral steed. The steed has a speed of 100 feet, the same Armor Class as the knight, and dies if it takes 15 or more damage from a single source.

bonus.name: No Escape
entries: The knight drags one creature within 150 feet of it up to 30 feet towards it, then the target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, falling prone on a failed save.

bonus.name: Shatter Magic (5th Level Spell)
entries: The knight attempts to end a spell within 60 feet, forcing its controller to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends, and the controller takes 5 (1d10) force damage per level of the spell.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: When the death knight is hit with a melee attack, it can add +4 to its Armor Class against the triggering attack.

trait.name: Profane Resistance
entries: The death knight has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects, except those with a divine source.

trait.name: Deathless March
entries: While the knight is not incapacitated, undead allies of CR 4 or lower within 60 feet of it have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

trait.name: Grave Purge (3/Day)
entries: At the start of each of the knight's turns, it can end one condition or spell affecting it. If it does so, it is dazed until thie end of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Seal of Death's Gate.

action.name: Dreadblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage has its soul absorbed into the blade, and cannot be revived while the blade is intact.

action.name: Seal of Death's Gate (5th Level Spell)
entries: The knight forces a creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this spell has its hit point maximum reduced to 1 until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Necrofire Orb (7th Level Spell)
entries: The death knight causes black flames to erupt in a 20-foot radius sphere within 120 feet, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) fire damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and is knocked prone, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Grim Steed
entries: The death knight conjures and mounts a spectral steed. The steed has a speed of 100 feet, the same Armor Class as the knight, and dies if it takes 15 or more damage from a single source.

bonus.name: No Escape
entries: The knight drags one creature within 150 feet of it up to 30 feet towards it, then the target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, falling prone on a failed save.

bonus.name: Shatter Magic (5th Level Spell)
entries: The knight attempts to end a spell within 60 feet, forcing its controller to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends, and the controller takes 5 (1d10) force damage per level of the spell.

bonus.name: Tyrant's Glare
entries: The knight's gaze bores into a creature within 60 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened of the knight until the end of the knight's next turn.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: When the death knight is hit with a melee attack, it can add +6 to its Armor Class against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Overpower
entries: When the death knight misses with a melee attack, it can make a melee attack against the same target at advantage.

legendary.name: Black Command
entries: Up to two undead allies of the knight within 60 feet of it can each use their reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Gauntlet Strike
entries: The death knight brutally backhands a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is knocked prone and dazed until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Battle Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The death knight moves up to its speed, then makes two attacks. If the knight takes any damage during this movement, it regains the use of its reaction.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The slaad can use its action to polymorph itself or another slaad into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The slaad regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its havoc bite.  It may replace any number of these attacks with uses of its Mighty Leap or Death Croak, if available.

action.name: Havoc Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Additionally on a hit, the first 10 ft. of movement the target takes on its following turn is made in a random direction.

action.name: Entropic Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) force plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage disintigrates.

action.name: Mighty Leap
entries: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Pandemoniac Ideal (Concentration)
entries: The slaad creates the image of an object, creature, or pheneomenon no larger than a 30-foot cube. It seems real to all senses, though a successful DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals its illusory nature. The slaad may interact with the illusion physically as though it were real.

As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the slaad can move the illusion up to 30 ft. and force one creature within 5 ft. of it to succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 26 (4d12) damage of a type appropriate to the illusion. A creature that has investigated the illusion makes this save with advantage.

action.name: Death Croak (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The slaadi lets out a horrible, atonal croak that destabilizes matter around it. Until the end of the slaad's next turn, a non-slaad creature that ends its turn within 20 ft. of the slaad takes 22 (4d10) force damage.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The slaad and any number of slaadi adjacent to it teleport to a different plane of existence.

trait.name: Negative Energy Cone
entries: The death tyrant's central eye emits an invisible, magical 150-foot cone of negative energy. At the start of each of its turns, the tyrant decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active.

Any creature in that area can't regain hit points. Any humanoid that dies there becomes a zombie under the tyrant's command. The dead humanoid retains its place in the initiative order and animates at the start of its next turn, provided that its body hasn't been completely destroyed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The death tyrant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Many Eyes (3/Day)
entries: If the death tyrant fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind or incapacitate it, it may choose to succeed instead. The death tyrant takes one fewer legendary action each turn for each time it has used this ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The death tyrant shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 ft. of it:

action.name: 1. Decay Ray (Luminescent Green)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or have its maximum hit points reduced to its current hit points until it completes a long rest.

action.name: 2. Compulsion Ray (Wispy Red)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 33 (6d10) psychic damage and be unable to voluntarily leave the death tyrant's eye cone until the end of its next turn.

action.name: 3. Terror Ray (Wavy Purple.)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for the next minute. The creature repeats this save at end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failure.

action.name: 4. Dispel Ray (Pale Silver)
entries: The death tyrant ends one spell affecting the target.

action.name: 5. Seizure Ray (Mottled Green)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute. While poisoned in this way, whenever the creature casts a spell it is stunned until the beginning of its next turn. A poisoned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: 6. Blood Ray (Sludgy Crimson)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become susceptible to bleeding for the next minute. Whenever the afflicted character takes damage, it begins bleeding, losing 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. The creature stops bleeding when magically healed, or with a successful DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check, but retains its susceptibility. This can be applied to the same creature multiple times, with its effects applied cumulatively.

action.name: 7. Etherealness Ray (Diaphanous White)
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is shunted partially into the ethereal plane, gaining a 30 ft. fly speed and dealing half as much damage with attacks that use Strength for the next minute, or until the death tyrant uses this ability again.

action.name: 8. Enchaining Ray (Gleaming Blue-Grey)
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 16) as chains of seething shadow envelop its body. A creature in bright light may attempt to escape as a bonus action.

action.name: 9. Doom Ray (Shivering Marroon)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, the creature acquires a Doom counter each time it takes necrotic damage. If the creature drops to 0 hit points while cursed, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom counter it has.

action.name: 10. Death Ray (Streaky Black)
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 44 (8d10) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The death tyrant uses one random eye ray.

legendary.name: Death Ray (Costs 3 actions)
entries: The death tyrant uses its Death Ray.

name: Deathlock
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deathlock's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deathlock is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The deathlock has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Deathly Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage.

name: Deathlock Mastermind
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deathlock's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deathlock is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The deathlock has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Deathly Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage).

action.name: Grave Bolts
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one or two targets. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or become restrained as shadowy tendrils wrap around it for 1 minute. A restrained target can use its action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The decapus can take two reactions each round in combat, but only once per turn.

trait.name: Unstructured Form
entries: While on the ground, the decapus has disadvantage on any d20 roll that involves Strength or Dexterity.

trait.name: Suckered Clutch
entries: If the decapus or a creature grappled by it is forcefully moved, it is moved 10 feet less, to a minimum of 0 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The decapus makes four attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Swinging Lunge.

action.name: Tentacle Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swinging Lunge
entries: If the decapus is hanging from a branch or similar surface, it leaps up to 20 feet.

reaction.name: Anchor Hook
entries: When the decapus hits a creature with a Tentacle Flail attack for the second time on a turn, it can choose to grapple the target (escape DC 12). While grappled in this way, the target is considered restrained.

reaction.name: Dragging Thrash
entries: When the decapus uses its Swinging Lunge while it has at least one creature grappled, it can cause one creature grappled by it to take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and become dazed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deep crow has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the deep crow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the deep crow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep crow makes three attacks: one with its mandibles and two with its claws.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the deep crow can't use its mandibles on another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The gnome's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The gnome has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: The gnome has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

action.name: War Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Poisoned Dart
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The rothe is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the rothe moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Dancing Lights
entries: The rothe casts dancing lights, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep spider makes two foreleg attacks and one bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

action.name: Foreleg
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The deinonychus has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the deinonychus's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Leaping Pounce
entries: The deinonychus's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start. If the deinonychus jumps at least 20 ft. then hits a creature with a claw attack, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Foe-Climber
entries: If the deinonychus hits a Large or larger creature with a claw attack, instead of grappling it climbs on to the creature. While climbing on a creature, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that target the deinonychus.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deinonychus makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Sawing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a prone creature.

action.name: Terrible Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

name: Demilich
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from magical attacks
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the demilich is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The demilich is immune to effects that turn undead.

action.name: Howl (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The demilich emits a bloodcurdling howl. Each creature within 30 feet of the demilich that can hear the howl must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. On a successful save, the creature is frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: The demilich targets up to three creatures that it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) necrotic damage, and the demilich regains hit points equal to the total damage dealt to all targets.

legendary.name: Flight
entries: The demilich flies up to half its flying speed.

legendary.name: Cloud of Dust
entries: The demilich magically swirls its dusty remains. Each creature within 10 feet of the demilich, including around a corner, must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the demilich's next turn. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect until the end of the demilich's next turn.

legendary.name: Energy Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature with in 30 feet of the demilich must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's hit point maximum is magically reduced by 10 (). If a creature's hit point maximum is reduced to 0 by this effect, the creature dies. A creature's hit point maximum can be restored with the  greater restoration spell or similar magic.

legendary.name: Vile Curse (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The demilich targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically cursed. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the curse on a success.

name: Demogorgon, Prince of Demons

resist.preNote: damage from attacks made without advantage

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: Demogorgon rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them. If his mythic trait is active, he acts only on his lowest initiative.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Demogorgon may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Demogorgon. While climbing on Demogorgon, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against Demogorgon.

trait.name: Engineered Resistance
entries: Demogorgon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and has resistance to damage from spells of third level or below.

trait.name: Indecision Weakness
entries: While three or more enemies are within his reach, Demogorgon has disadvantage on attack rolls and attack rolls are made against him at advantage.

trait.name: Shed Weakness (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Demogorgon is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 336 hit points and tears off one of his heads, losing his Indecision Weakness and Gaze of Aarneul, and gaining a second action on each of his turns.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Demogorgon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Demogorgon makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with either his Gaze of Hethradiah or Gaze of Aameul, if available.

action.name: Tentacle Thrash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 25). A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Doll-Joint Malacia.

action.name: Forked Tail Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) slashing damage and the target loses two of its unexpended hit dice. If the creature can't, it takes an additional 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Gaze of Hethradiah
entries: One creature that Demogorgon can see must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, attacks against the creature score a critical on an 18-20 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Gaze of Aameul (Recharges when Demogorgon uses his Gaze of Hethradiah)
entries: One creature that Demogorgon can see must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to take an action of Demogorgon's choice.

action.name: Into the Spiraling Depths (8th Level Spell, Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: An enormous spectral maw breaches forth through a planar rift. Each creature in a 15 foot radius centered on a point Demogorgon can see must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) piercing damage and be abducted to the depths of Abysm.

An abducted creature makes a DC 21 Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed on a success, or taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failure. A creature killed by this damage does not return.

reaction.name: Body Shield
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack while grappling one or more creatures, Demorgorgon adds +4 to its AC. If the attack misses, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting a grappled creature instead.

legendary.name: Fling
entries: One creature grappled by Demogorgon is thrown up to 40 feet.. If a thrown target strikes a creature or solid surface, the target takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Demogorgon teleports up to 30 feet to a location he can see, along with each creature he is grappling and each creature that is climbing on him.

legendary.name: Deep Father's Mastery
entries: one friendly creature within 60 feet that has a swim speed may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack.

mythic.name: Unshackled Brutality (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Demogorgon makes a melee attack at advantage and rolls to recharge his Into the Spiraling Depths.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Hooked Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the derro can choose to deal no damage and knock it prone.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Deva
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The angel's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the angel is attacking with them.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Numinous Presence
entries: If the angel has at least 69 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the angel until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the angel since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: If the angel has 68 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the angel until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the deva may  transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deva makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Luminous Mace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness. If the target is a corpse that died in the last 10 days, it is restored to life.

reaction.name: Shielding Wings
entries: As a reaction to an ally being hit with an attack, the deva may move up to half its speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the targeted creature, the creature's AC is increased by 2 (including against the triggering attack) and the deva's AC is decreased by 2 until the end of the deva's next turn.

reaction.name: Radiant Retribution
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the deva may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend each unexpended hit die it has, rolling each of them and taking radiant damage equal to the total rolled.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: A devourer doesn't require air, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devourer makes two Claw attacks and can use either Imprison Soul or Soul Rend, if available.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Imprison Soul
entries: The devourer chooses a living Humanoid with 0 hit points that it can see within 30 feet of it. That creature is teleported inside the devourer's ribcage and imprisoned there. While imprisoned in this way, the creature is restrained and has disadvantage on death saving throws. If the creature dies while imprisoned, the devourer regains 25 hit points and immediately recharges Soul Rend. Additionally, at the start of its next turn, the devourer regurgitates the slain creature as a bonus action, and the creature becomes an undead. If the victim had 2 or fewer Hit Dice, it becomes a zombie. If it had 3 to 5 Hit Dice, it becomes a ghoul. Otherwise, it becomes a wight. A devourer can imprison only one creature at a time.

action.name: Soul Rend (Recharge 6)
entries: The devourer creates a vortex of life-draining energy in a 20-foot radius centered on itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Dhergoloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dhergoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Confusing Anatomy
entries: A creature gains no benefit from flanking the dhergoloth. If the dhergoloth falls prone, it must spend its action to stand up.

trait.name: Gyroscopic
entries: If the dhergoloth makes four or more claw attacks in a turn, it has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A dhergoloth will usually accept a rate of its challenge rating times 25 gp, or half as much from a creature proficient in Intimidation.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dhergoloth makes three flailing claw attacks, plus an additional flailing claw attack for each successive turn it uses this ability, to a maximum of six. If it makes five or more flailing claw attacks in a turn, it also uses its Shriek.

action.name: Flailing Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Shriek
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the Dhergoloth must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of it until the end of the Dhergoloth's next turn.

action.name: Teleport (3rd level spell)
entries: The dhergoloth magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Dark Escape
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the Dhergoloth may shroud itself in a 20 foot radius cloud of magical darkness until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Canopy Stalker
entries: The displacer beast has advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

trait.name: Teleportation Weakness
entries: The displacer beast takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Displacement
entries:
While the displacer beast is not grappled or incapacitated and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects:
  • Attacks against it are made at disadvantage.
  • When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the displacer beast treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The displacer beast makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

action.name: Spinal Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Any hit with this attack against a target that is both prone and grappled is a critical hit.

action.name: Hexapod Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
A prone target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Tendril Pads
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: If the displacer beast is in dim light or darkness, it attempts to Hide.

bonus.name: Lithe Pounce
entries: The displacer beast leaps up to 15 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Canopy Stalker
entries: The displacer beast has advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

trait.name: Teleportation Weakness
entries: The displacer beast is stunned until the end of it is next turn whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Minor Displacement
entries: The kitten magically disrupts the light around it, making it appear slightly blurry.
Checks to determine what the kitten is carrying in its mouth or tentacles are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Hexapod Biscuits
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Tendril Pads
entries: One creature the kitten can see within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or have one object weighing 1 pound or less that it is carrying stolen by the kitten.

action.name: Distracting Blink
entries: The kitten affixes its gaze on a creature it can see within 15 feet and slowly blinks.
The creature must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take reactions until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Strained Displacement
entries: As a reaction when the kitten is hit with an attack of opportunity, it causes the attack to miss then falls unconscious until the beginning of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The dohwar casts the following spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

trait.name: Merging
entries: Two dohwars can have a telepathic conversation with each other and a third willing creature of their choice, provided all three are within 30 feet of one another.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the dolgaunt is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the dolgaunt instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's incapacitated.

trait.name: Coordinated Advance
entries: The dolgaunt acts on initiative count 10, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

trait.name: Drillmaster
entries: Friendly hobgoblins within 30 feet of the dolgaunt use its attack bonus, rather than their own.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dolgaunt makes four melee attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The dolgaunt has two tentacles that can each grapple a single target.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned.

action.name: Vitality Leech
entries: One creature grappled by a tentacle of the dolgaunt must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 1d6 for the next minute. The dolgaunt gains 5 temporary hit points for each point the creature's Constitution was reduced by.

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The dolgrim has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The dolgrim rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The dolgrim can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Mace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Flail (Recharge 6)
entries: The dolgrim makes three weapon attacks at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Slippery
entries: If an attack misses the dolgrim, it can move up to 5 feet as a reaction without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The dolphin can hold its breath for 20 minutes.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the dolphin moved at least 30 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The dolphin can hold its breath for 20 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dolphin makes two Dazzling Slam attacks.

action.name: Dazzling Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the target is blinded until the start of the dolphin's next turn.

bonus.name: Delightful Light (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dolphin magically emanates light in a 10-foot radius for a moment. The dolphin and each creature of its choice in that light gain 11 () temporary hit points.

bonus.name: Fey Leap
entries: The dolphin teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Immediately before teleporting, the dolphin can choose one creature within 5 feet of it. That creature can teleport with the dolphin, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the dolphin's destination space.

trait.name: Aura of Erebos
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the giant must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, or it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the giant's Aura of Erebos for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Noxious Gust (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant exhales a mighty gust that creates a blast of deadly mist in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Mind Reader
entries: The doppelganger can magically read the surface thoughts of  creatures within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Mimicry
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature taking an action, the doppelganger may memorize that action. On its next turn, it may take that action. If the action included a weapon, the doppelganger grows an appendage to mimic it. If the action was to cast a spell, the doppelganger cast it innately without a spell slot, using the mimicked creature's attack bonus and save DC.

name: Dracohydra
languages: understands draconic but can't speak it

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The dracohydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the dracohydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Whenever the dracohydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the dracohydra dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, the dracohydra has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, the dracohydra makes a DC 13 Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning of its last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn. The dracohydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the dracohydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the dracohydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dracohydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The dracohydra makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained in the dracohydra's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the dracohydra, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the dracohydra's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the hydra loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by at least two of the dracohydra's heads must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution throw or take 66 (12d10) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more heads.

action.name: Prismatic Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dracohydra exhales elemental energy in a number of 60-foot long, 5-foot wide lines equal to the number of heads that it has. Each creature in one or more lines must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 28 (8d6) damage of a type chosen by the dracohydra; acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison; plus an additional 7 (2d6) damage of another type for each line it is in beyond the first. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Shed Head
entries: As a reaction when the dracohydra fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the dracohydra may choose to succeed. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it bursts into flames and is reduced to ashes. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the draconian must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draconian makes two Serrated Sword attacks and one Tail attack.

action.name: Serrated Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Shape Theft
entries: After the draconian kills a Medium or smaller Humanoid, the draconian can magically transform itself to look and feel like that creature while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation lasts until the draconian dies or uses an action to end it.

trait.name: Controlled Fall
entries: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its body turns to stone and releases a petrifying gas. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends; otherwise the creature is petrified for 1 minute. After 1 minute, the body of the draconian crumbles to dust.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draconian makes two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into a puddle of acid and splashes acid on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draconian makes two Dagger attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of the target's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The draconian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its scales and flesh immediately shrivel away and its bones explode. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage.

trait.name: Glide
entries: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draconian makes two Trident or Necrotic Ray attacks.

action.name: Trident
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Necrotic Ray
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The draconian casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its magical essence lashes out as a ball of lightning at the closest creature within 30 feet of it before arcing out to up to two other creatures within 15 feet of the first. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draconian makes three Rend or Energy Ray attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Energy Ray
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

action.name: Noxious Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The draconian exhales a 15-foot cone of noxious gas. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and gains 1 level of exhaustion. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, doesn't gain exhaustion, and is immune to all draconians' Noxious Breath for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Magic Shield (3/Day)
entries: When the draconian is hit by an attack roll, it can create an invisible barrier of magical force around itself, granting it a +5 bonus to its AC against that attack and potentially causing the attack to miss.

name: Draconic Shard
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The shard casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

trait.name: Deflection
entries: The shard's AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The shard can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the shard fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points, the shard disappears and leaves a Tiny cracked gemstone in its space. The gemstone matches the kind of gem dragon it was in life and has AC 20, 15 hit points, and immunity to all damage except force. Unless the gemstone is destroyed, after  days, the gemstone dissipates and the shard re-forms, regaining all its hit points and appearing in the place the gemstone once occupied or in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The shard doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shard makes two Telekinetic Rend attacks.

action.name: Telekinetic Rend
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage.

action.name: Inhabit Object
entries: The shard disappears as it pours its psychic essence into a Medium or smaller nonsentient object it can see within 30 feet of it, magically possessing it. The object uses the shard's AC, and any damage dealt to the object applies to the shard's hit points. The shard inhabits the object until it uses an action to leave; until it is turned; until it is reduced to 0 hit points; or until an effect that ends possession, such as a dispel evil and good spell, is used on it. When it leaves the object, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space.

While inhabited, the object becomes a magic item if it wasn't already, and a Tiny cracked gemstone matching the kind of gem dragon the shard was in life appears somewhere on the object. The shard can cause the object to fly using the shard's own flying speed, use its senses, speak verbally or telepathically, cast spells, and use its legendary actions.
If a creature wears or carries the inhabited object, the shard can grant the creature the following benefits:
Each of the creature's attacks deals an extra 1d8 force damage on a hit.
The creature gains resistance to psychic damage.

action.name: Psychic Crush (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The shard unleashes a pulse of psychic power. Each creature of the shard's choice in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on it must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

legendary.name: Rend
entries: The shard makes one Telekinetic Rend attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The shard uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Commanding Thought (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The shard targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn. While charmed in this way, the target becomes the shard's puppet, acting and moving in accordance with its telepathic commands. While under the shard's control, the target can take only the Attack (shard chooses the target) or Dash action on its turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The draegloth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The draegloth has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draegloth makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon turtle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked prone.

action.name: Sand Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon tortoise exhales abrasive sand in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

resist.preNote: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The dragon turtle can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals, stones, and crafted objects within 300 ft.

trait.name: Troubled Waters
entries: The seas within 1 mile of a dragon turtle are choppy and full of unpredictable currents, increasing the difficulty of ability checks made to navigate them by 5.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the dragon turtle may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the dragon turtle. While climbing on the dragon turtle, a creature has advantage on melee attacks made against the dragon turtle, and the dragon turtle has disadvantage on attacks made against the creature.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dragon turtle fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon turtle makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 21) and restrained. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage. The affected area becomes heavily obscured until the end of the dragon turtle's next turn.

reaction.name: Retract Head
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the dragon turtle gains resistance to the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 172 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses its Steam Breath.

legendary.name: Dive
entries: The dragon turtle moves up to half its speed. If it is submerged, each creature climbing on it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or fall off.

legendary.name: Hull Breach
entries: The dragon turtle scrapes its shell against the hull of a boat or ship. A vehicle 20 ft. in length or less capsizes immediately. A vehicle greater than 20 ft. in length suffers a hull breach and begins to fill with water, capsizing after 30 minutes if the breach is not repaired. Each successive breach halves the remaining time. A breach can be repaired as an action with a successful DC 18 Woodworking Tools ability check.

legendary.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon turtle rocks a boat or ship within 15 ft. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 ft. in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered prone.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon turtle exhales steam in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.

name: Dragonblood Ooze
languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. The ooze can replace one Pseudopod attack with its Slime Breath, if available.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Slime Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The ooze expels a spray of its gelatinous mass in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) acid damage and is pulled up to 30 feet straight toward the ooze. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pulled.

name: Dragonbone Golem
languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Brittle Body
entries: Attacks that deal bludgeoning damage score a critical against the golem on an 18-20. When a critical hit is scored against the golem, the golem suffers one additional effect of the attacker's choice:
The golem's movement speed is reduced by 20.
The golem has disadvantage on attacks made with its Splinterfang Bite.
The save DC of the dragon's Tailbarb Swipe is reduced to 12.
The golem makes one fewer attack with its multiattack.
The golem loses a use of its Pinion Cage.

trait.name: Fear Aura
entries: Each creature of the golem's choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the golem must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw unless the golem is
incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this golem's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three  attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Splinterfang Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. On a hit or miss, the target and each creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) piercing damage.

action.name: Rending Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 against a creature that is frightened.

action.name: Tailbarb Swipe (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft cone must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone and take 18 (6d8) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) slashing damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Pinion Cage (2/Day)
entries: When a creature falls prone within 10 feet of it, the golem can detach one of its wings, stabbing the bones of it into the ground around the creature and restraining it in place (escape DC 17).
The bones can be attacked (AC 17; 20 HP; immunity to poison and psychic damage).

name: Dragonflesh Abomination
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

trait.name: Cloying Miasma
entries: The abomination is surrounded by a noxious stench. At the start of the abomination's turn, any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the abomination's next turn.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The abomination regains 10 hit points at the start of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abomination makes three attacks using Claw, Acidic Spit, or a combination of them. It can replace one of the attacks with a Tail attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Acidic Spit
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

action.name: Acid Belch (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The abomination belches forth a cloud of acidic gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grafter makes one Claw attack and one Greatclub attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Retch (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The grafter retches forth a spray of acidic bile in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Dragonnel
languages: understands Draconic and Common but can't speak

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The dragonnel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragonnel makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the dread warrior to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the dread warrior drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dread warrior makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Dream Eater
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ghastly Visions
entries: Each creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dream eater must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened of the dream eater until the start of the creature's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to this dream eater's Ghastly Visions trait for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dream eater can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dream eater has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dream eater makes two Ensnaring Shriek attacks.

action.name: Ensnaring Shriek
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) psychic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the dream eater.

bonus.name: Engulfing Nightmare
entries: The dream eater targets one creature within 5 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be engulfed by the dream eater, as the dream eater envelops the creature in a miasma of its worst fears.

When the dream eater engulfs a target, the dream eater enters its space, and the target immediately takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. An engulfed target is restrained and blinded, and it takes an additional 10 (3d6) psychic damage at the start of each of the dream eater's turns. When the dream eater moves, the engulfed target moves with it.

The dream eater can have only one target engulfed at a time. An engulfed target escapes at the start of its turn by making a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the target escapes; the target is no longer engulfed, and it enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the dream eater. A creature within 15 feet of the dream eater also can use its action to attempt to free an engulfed target. Doing so requires the creature to use its action to make a DC 16 Charisma (Persuasion) check to convince the engulfed target the nightmare isn't real, with the target escaping on a success. The creature making the check takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, regardless of the check's success or failure, as its mind brushes against the nightmare.

name: Dretch
languages: telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dretch makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

action.name: Fetid Cloud (1/Day)
entries: A 10-foot radius of disgusting green gas extends out from the dretch. The gas spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it. Any creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both, and can't take reactions.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the drider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Light-Blind
entries: If the drider ends his turn in bright light or takes any amount of radiant damage, he is blinded until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Deathwish
entries: While the drider is below half of his maximum hit points, he has advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and can take one additional reaction each round.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drider makes three attacks, one of which he can replace with his Split-Jaw Embrace.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Rotten Silkblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Split-Jaw Embrace
entries: One creature grappled by the drider must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, a creature teaks 17 (5d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), taking half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more is additional considered paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

reaction.name: Lunging Strike
entries: When the drider is missed with a melee attack, he can make an attack against the attacker at disadvantage.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the drider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Light-Blind
entries: If the drider ends her turn in bright light or takes any amount of radiant damage, she is blinded until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Lolth's Embrace
