entries: While the drider is below half of her maximum hit points, she has advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and can take one additional reaction each round.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drider makes four attacks, one of which she can replace with her Split-Jaw Embrace or Bleak Snare.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Darkfire Bolt (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage and the target is wreathed in writhing shadows for one minute, or until it is illuminated by bright light.
Whenever the wreathed creature is hit with an attack, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Bleak Snare (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the drider can see within 60 feet of her must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is dragged up to 20 feet in a direction of the drider's choice.
If the target ends this movement in darkness or dim light, it restrained (escape DC 15) until it is illuminated by bright light.

action.name: Split-Jaw Embrace
entries: One creature grappled by the drider must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, a creature teaks 17 (5d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), taking half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more is additional considered paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

bonus.name: Douse (1st Level Spell)
entries: The drider dims one light source she can see within 60 feet, reducing bright light to dim light or reducing dim light to darkness.
This spell does not reveal the drider's location to any creature she is invisible to. Lights produced by spells of 2nd level or higher are unaffected.

bonus.name: Shadowslip (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The drider teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness she can see. The drider can't cast this spell if she's illuminated by bright light.

bonus.name: Death Leap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The drider jumps up to 60 feet, and can land in the space of up to one Huge or smaller creature.

A creature whose space the drider lands in must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, a creature is prone and stunned until the start of the drider's next turn.  On a successful save, the drider instead lands in the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Lunging Strike
entries: When the drider is missed with a melee attack, she can make an attack against the attacker at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Silken Bonds
entries: When a creature within 10 feet of the drider becomes incapacitated, she can wrap the creature in webs, restraining it (escape DC 16).

reaction.name: Shadowy Skitter
entries: When the drider is forced to make a Dexterity saving throw while in dim light or darkness, she can make the saving throw with advantage.  On a success, she takes no damage and can immediately move up to half her speed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the dryad may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

trait.name: Fervent Protectors
entries: While a creature that is charmed by the dryad is within 5 feet of it, attacks against the dryad have disadvantage.

action.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target has no adjacent allies, this attack is made at advantage and deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

action.name: Soporific Fragrance (Concentration)
entries: One humanoid creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. While charmed, the creature moves towards the dryad by the most direct path. Each time the target takes damage, it may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Entreat
entries: One creature charmed by the dryad moves up to its speed and makes an attack against a target of its choice.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

action.name: War Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

action.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

action.name: Acid Vial
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 20 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Alchemist's Fire
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 20 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a successful DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

action.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Haywire
entries: Attacks that deal lightning damage are made at advantage against the duergar. When the duergar takes lightning damage, it must use its reaction to make a melee attack against a randomly selected creature in its reach.

trait.name: Entombed in Steel
entries: Critical hits scored against the duergar roll their damage dice three times and add them together, rather than twice.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a bonus action, the duergar gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Telekinetic Leap
entries: The duergar's standing long jump and standing high jump both become equal to its movement speed.

items.name: Impulsion
entries: The duergar's speed is doubled.

items.name: Gravity Draw
entries: Whenever the duergar uses its crushing stomp, each creature within 30 ft. is pulled 5 ft. towards it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duergar makes four melee attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Flame Jet.

action.name: Iron Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must suceed on a successful DC 17 Strength saving throw or be thrown up to 30 feet away in a straight line. The target lands prone and then takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 ft. it was pushed.

action.name: Crushing Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 9 (2d8) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Flame jet
entries: The duergar spews flames in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Self-Destruct (1/Day)
entries: The duergar begins to spark and smoke as it overloads its psychic engine. At the beginning of its next turn it explodes. Each creature within 40 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 54 (12d8) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Psychic Feedback
entries: As a reaction to being targeted by a spell or magical effect by a creature it can see within 20 ft., the duergar forces the creature to succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage. If the creature fails by 5 or more, the spell fails.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Lensing
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a ranged attack, the duergar causes it to target another creature within 10 feet.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Haywire
entries: Attacks that deal lightning damage are made at advantage against the duergar. When the duergar takes lightning damage, it must use its reaction to make a melee attack against a randomly selected creature in its reach.

trait.name: Entombed in Steel
entries: Critical hits scored against the duergar roll their damage dice three times and add them together, rather than twice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duergar makes two attacks; one with its shatterstorn maul and one with its mining claw.

action.name: Shatterstone Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage to a grappled target.

action.name: Mining Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the duergar may grapple the target.

reaction.name: Fueled by Pain
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the duergar moves up to half its speed and makes a melee attack.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Cavalry Training
entries: While riding a steeder or similar creature, the duergar acts on its mounts initiative, rather than its own.
When the duergar hits a target with a melee attack while mounted on a female steeder, the steeder can make a melee attack agains the same target as a reaction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duergar makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Spur Steeder.

action.name: Nadziak Cavalry Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. This attack is made at advantage against a creature wearing heavy armor.

action.name: Steed-Mounted Ballistae
entries: Heavy Crossbow. Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) piercing damage.

action.name: Spur Steeder
entries: The duergar's mount uses its reaction to move up to its speed in a straight line, and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature as part of this movement.
The first time it enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Denizens of the Dark (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage while in Dim Light or Darkness, the duergar and its mount become invisible for the next minute, or until one of them makes an attack.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The Keeper of the Flame's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12.) It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Keeper of the Flame is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The Keeper of the Flame has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

action.name: War Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

action.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Mind-Poison Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and 10 (3d6) psychic damage, or 1 piercing damage and 14 (4d6) psychic damage while reduced.

action.name: Mind Mastery
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or be forced to use its reaction to move up to 10 ft. toward and make an attack against a creature of the duergar's choice. If the duergar was hidden, this action does not reveal it.

action.name: Scale Creature (Tiny Size Only)
entries: The duergar climbs onto a Medium or larger creature. A creature that the duergar is not hidden from may make a DC 13 Strength saving throw, pushing the duergar 5 ft. away and knocking it prone on a success.
While the duergar is climbing on a creature, the duergar takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

reaction.name: Shrink Down
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or psionic effect, the duergar magically shrinks.

For the next minute, the duergar's size decreases to Tiny, it can attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action even if in plain sight, it has advantage on Stealth (Dexterity) checks, and it has disadvantage on  checks and saving throws that use Strength.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Haywire
entries: Attacks that deal lightning damage are made at advantage against the duergar. When the duergar takes lightning damage, it must use its reaction to make a melee attack against a randomly selected creature in its reach.

trait.name: Entombed in Steel
entries: Critical hits scored against the duergar roll their damage dice three times and add them together, rather than twice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duergar makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Rock-Breaking Scream.

action.name: Hydraulic Drill
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. If the target cannot be pushed away and is wearing nonmagical metal armor, the AC bonus provided by its armor is reduced by 1.

action.name: Scoop Wheel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be thrown bodily over the duergar, landing prone up to 15 ft. away on the duergar's oppposite side.

action.name: Rock-Breaking Scream
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) thunder damage and be deafened for 1 minute, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Fueled by Pain
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the duergar moves up to half its speed and makes a melee attack.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a bonus action, the duergar gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Telekinetic Leap
entries: The duergar's standing long jump and standing high jump both become equal to its movement speed.

items.name: Mental Masking
entries: The duergar becomes invisible to one creature it can see.

items.name: Endure Pain
entries: The duergar gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

action.name: Soulblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) force damage. If the soulblade has advantage on the attack roll, the attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) force damage.

action.name: Twist of the Blade (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The duergar makes a melee attack against a creature it is hidden from or invisible to.
If this attack hits, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or fall prone and be stunned until the end of the duergar's next turn.

reaction.name: Ancestral Rage
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or psionic effect, the duergar flies into a magically empowered rage.
For the next minute, the duergar's size increases to Large, it scores a critical on a 15-20, and it makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The spy has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, the spy can deal an extra 7 () damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the spy that isn't incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the spy has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spy makes two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the spy magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the spy is Large, doubles her damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the spy lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage while enlarged.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The spy magically turns invisible until it attacks, deals damage, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the spy wears or carries is invisible with it.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Phalanx Formation
entries: The duergar has advantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws while standing Within 5 feet of a duergar ally wielding a shield.

trait.name: The Stone Endures
entries: The duergar has resistance to all damage on the first turn of combat if it has not yet taken a turn.

action.name: Heartless Blasthammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Set Charges (1/Day)
entries: The next time the duergar hits a creature or object with its heartless blasthammer, the duergar and each other creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage.

reaction.name: Set-Up Strike
entries: As a reaction when a creature is forced to move into its reach, the duergar makes a melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Ancestral Rage
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or psionic effect, the duergar flies into a magically empowered rage.
For the next minute, the duergar's size increases to Large, it scores a critical on a 15-20, and it makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Spurred by Pain
entries: If the duergar is affected by an ongoing effect that ends on a successful saving throw, it may repeat the saving throw whenever it takes 10 or more damage from a single source.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duergar makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Wave of Despair, if available.

action.name: Psy-Loaded Crop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
On a critical hit, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or follow the warlord's verbal commands until the end of the warlord's next turn.

action.name: Drive Forward
entries: Up to three allied duergar of CR 5 or lower within 30 ft. each take 3 (1d6) psychic damage and may use their reaction to move up to 10 ft. and make a melee weapon attack.

action.name: Wave of Despair (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the duergar's choice within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn.

reaction.name: Scouring Reprimand
entries: As a reaction when an allied creature the duergar can see fails a saving throw, the duergar deals 3 (1d6) psychic damage to the creature, and the creature adds an amount to the result of its saving throw equal to the damage dealt.

reaction.name: Ancestral Rage
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or psionic effect, the duergar flies into a magically empowered rage.
For the next minute, the duergar's size increases to Large, it scores a critical on a 15-20, and it makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage.

name: Dullahan
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dark Rider
entries: While riding a creature, the dullahan acts on its mount's initiative, rather than rolling its own, and it scores a critical hit on a roll of 17-20 on attacks made against a creature that is frightened.

trait.name: Repelled by Gold
entries: The dullahan has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature brandishing a gold object.
If a creature flings gold toward it, the dullahan must succeed on DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed away from the creature.

trait.name: Portended Resilience (3/Day)
entries: If the dullahan fails a saving throw on the night of a solstice, equinox, or feast-day, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dullahan makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Headtaker Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the target is nonlethally decapitated and has its head roll 20 feet in a random direction.

A decapitated creature is blinded and has its movement speed reduced by half while more than 5 feet from its head, and can reattach its head as an Action. A creature that remains headless for a minute dies.

action.name: Spine Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or lose an eye if it can see the dullahan.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: Each creature that can see the dullahan must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dullahan's next turn. A creature with one or more Doom Counters makes this save at disadvantage.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell, 1/Day)
entries: The dullahan and its mount teleport to another plane of existence.

reaction.name: Wrathful Parry
entries: As a reaction when it is targeted with an attack, the dullahan adds 4 to its AC against that attack. If the attack misses and the dullahan has fewer than half its hit points, the dullahan may make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Headless Wail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the dullahan is reduced below 106 hit points, the dullahan releases an echoing shriek from its headless stump. Each creature that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or drop anything it's holding and be frightened until the end of the dullahan's next turn.

legendary.name: Spine Whip
entries: The dullahan makes an attack with its spine whip.

legendary.name: Go Where the Devil Drives
entries: The dullahan or its mount moves up to its speed in a straight line, telekinetically flinging aside all obstacles before it to clear its path.

A creature in its path makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 5 (1d10) fire damage and being pushed to the nearest unoccupied space out of the dullahan's path on a success, or halting the dullahan's passage on a success.

legendary.name: Speak Name (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dullahan speaks the name of a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or gain a Doom Counter that lasts a minute. If the creature drops to 0 hit points, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom Counter it has.
A creature with three or more Doom Counters that is killed by the dullahan can't be restored to life by any means short of a Wish spell.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The duodrone may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the duodrone is within 30 feet of a tridrone, it uses the tridrone's attack bonus instead of its own. If the tridrone is using a quadrone's attack bonus, the duodrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duodrone makes two attacks with its Pressure Point Jab.

action.name: Pressure Point Jab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or drop each object it is holding and be unable to use its hands until the end of the duodrone's next turn.

action.name: Deft Binding
entries: The modron quickly binds an incapacitated creature it can see within 5 feet in a lattice of intricate knots. The creature is restrained (escape DC 12).
A creature that is not restrained succeeds automatically on checks made to free the restrained creature.

action.name: Break Time (1/Day)
entries: The duodrone regains all of its hit points, and falls unconscious until the beginning of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a tridrone within 60 feet die or transform, the duodrone may transform into a tridrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one duodrone may take this reaction.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Nightmare Touch attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Nightmare Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is unconscious, it takes an extra 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is cursed until the hag dies or the curse is removed. The cursed creature's hit point maximum decreases by 5 () whenever it finishes a long rest.

reaction.name: Dream Eater
entries: When an unconscious creature the hag can see within 30 feet of her regains consciousness, the hag can force the creature to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage, and the hag regains hit points equal to the amount of damage taken.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of dust. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait ceases to function for the next minute.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage. If this attack is made at advantage, it deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage.

action.name: Clinging Dust (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in pale, clinging dust. Until a creature takes an action to clear it, attacks against the affected creature are made at advantage, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being invisible.

reaction.name: Explosive
entries: As a reaction to taking fire damage, the dust mephit may force each creature within 10 feet to succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) fire damage and be knocked prone, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Singularity
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from magical sources
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Death Collapse
entries: If the singularity dies, it starts to collapse. Its Living Void trait remains active, but its radius increases by 30 feet on each subsequent turn until the singularity collapses. All creatures or objects that enter the singularity's space take 90 (20d8) force damage and are transported to the Astral Plane.

At the start of each of the singularity's turns, all creatures within 500 feet of it must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. This necrotic damage increases by 9 (2d8) on each subsequent turn until the singularity collapses.

After 2d4 turns have passed, the singularity collapses on its following turn, resulting in a massive shockwave rippling through the area around it. Creatures within 1 mile of the singularity are thrown 6d6 x 10 feet away and must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) force damage plus 45 (10d8) bludgeoning damage and is deafened for 24 hours, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Event Horizon
entries: The singularity can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and end its turn there there.

When a creature enters the singularity's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, roll a d10. On a roll of 1, the creature is sent to a random plane and takes 90 (20d8) force damage. On a roll of 2 or higher, the creature is instantly disintegrated and can't be revived by any means short of the wish spell.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The singularity is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The singularity has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Living Void
entries: The area within 60 feet of the singularity is filled with blackness and bitter cold. The void is filled with a cacophony of soft whispers and slurping noises that can be heard up to 30 feet away. No light, magical or otherwise, can illuminate the area, and creatures within the area are blinded, even if they have darksight. Any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 7 (2d6) cold damage.
The area within 120 feet of the singularity is difficult terrain and creatures within the area begin levitating.
A creature that starts its turn within 1 mile of the singularity must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be pulled 30 feet closer to the singularity.
Whenever the singularity reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated, and cannot be restored to life by any means short of the wish spell.

trait.name: Space-Time Anomaly
entries: The singularity ignores difficult terrain, its speed canot be reduced, it cannot be moved forcefully, and it cannot be teleported against its will. It can move through solid objects, consuming and disintegrating them in the process.

In addition, the singularity is immune to divination spells unless it chooses to be affected, and divination spells cast within or targeting a point within 1 mile of the singularity fail unless it chooses to allow them.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the singularity fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The singularity makes four attacks with its Spaghettify, one of which it may replace with Relativistic Jet if available.

action.name: Spaghettify
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +19 to hit, reach 150 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or begin levitating, be pulled 10 feet towards the singularity, and suffer a slashing injury. A creature cannot suffer more than one injury per round.

action.name: Relativistic Jet (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The singularity shoots an outflow of ionized matter in a 150-foot line that is 25 feet wide. Creatures in the area must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) force damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success. While dazed in this way, a creature has disadvantage on Strength ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.

action.name: Gravity Surge (Recharge 6)
entries: All creatures within 500 feet of the singularity must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) force damage, gains a level of exhaustion, and is dazed (save ends at end of turn), or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Radiation Pulse
entries: When the singularity disintegrates a creature, it can emit a pulse of radiation. Creatures within 120 feet of the singularity must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success. The singularity then regains 22 (5d8) hit points.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The singularity moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Spaghettify
entries: The singularity makes an attack with its Spaghettify.

legendary.name: Accretion Disk (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: A rapidly spinning disk of ionized matter forms around the singularity in a 90-foot wide, 10-foot tall disk appears around it until the start of its next turn. For every 5 feet a creature moves through the accretion disk, it must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Intensify Gravity (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: All creatures within 1 mile of the singularity must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pulled 30 feet towards the singularity.

name: Dybbuk
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dybbuk casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dybbuk can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dybbuk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its hit point maximum is also reduced by 3 (). This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

action.name: Possess Corpse (Recharge 6)
entries: The dybbuk disappears into an intact corpse within 5 feet of it that belonged to a Large or smaller Beast or Humanoid. The dybbuk gains 20 temporary hit points. While possessing the corpse, the dybbuk adopts the corpse's size and can't use Incorporeal Movement. Its game statistics otherwise remain the same. The possession lasts until the temporary hit points are lost or the dybbuk ends it as a bonus action. When the possession ends, the dybbuk appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the corpse.

bonus.name: Control Corpse
entries: While Possess Corpse is active, the dybbuk makes the corpse do something unnatural, such as vomit blood, twist its head all the way around, or cause a quadruped to move as a biped. Any Beast or Humanoid that sees this behavior must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the dybbuk for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on a saving throw against this ability is immune to Control Corpse for 24 hours.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the eagle is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19, or 20.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is blinded until the end of the eagle's next turn.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with its Earthbreak Rush or Quake Slam.

action.name: Megaton Hammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 15-20 on a prone target.

action.name: Earthbreak Rush
entries: The myrmidon moves up to half its speed, then makes an attack with advantage. On a hit, the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Quake Slam
entries: The myrmidon strikes the ground, forcing each grounded creature within 15 feet of it to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and falls prone, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Earthen Endurance
entries: When the myrmidon takes any amount of piercing or slashing damage, it can reduce the damage by half.

trait.name: Insatiable Greed
entries: The eater of hope can sense the presence of gold within 1000 feet of itself. It can determine which location has the greatest amount of gold and can sense the direction to that site. If the gold is being moved, it knows the direction of the movement. It can't locate gold if any thickness of clay or lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between it and the gold.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The eater of hope has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eater of hope makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Breath of Hopelessness (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The eater of hope exhales a miasma of Underworld winds in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and is cursed for 1 minute. While cursed in this way, the target takes an extra 6 (1d12) necrotic damage whenever the eater of hope hits it with an attack. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't cursed.

Dragons have disadvantage on this check.

action.name: Torpor Spores (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The egg hunter releases a billow of sparkling blue spores. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the egg hunter must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn but not both, and it can't take reactions. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this egg hunter's Torpor Spores for the next 24 hours.

entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the eidolon that can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of it for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to any eidolon's Divine Dread for the next 24 hours.

entries: The drow can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Demon's Dance
entries: Whenever a summoned creature or ally misses the drow with an attack, the drow can force it to reroll the attack, choosing a different target in range.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drow makes three melee attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Bleak Snare.

action.name: Death's-Head Warpick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage and the target is pushed 5 feet in a direction of the drow's choice.
If the drow is in darkness, this attack has advantage.

action.name: Bleak Snare (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the drow can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is dragged up to 20 feet in a direction of the drow's choice.
If the target ends this movement in darkness or dim light, it restrained (escape DC 15) until it is illuminated by bright light.

action.name: Ruinous Summons (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The drow summons a Chasme Tormentor that is hostile to all creatures in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

reaction.name: Talon Flick
entries: When the drow is missed with a melee attack, it can deal 5 slashing damage to the attacker.

reaction.name: Slip Bonds (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When the drow becomes grappled or restrained, the drow can immediately attempt to escape.

reaction.name: Song of Defiance (1/Day)
entries: When the drow takes any amount of damage, the drow can reduce that damage by 25.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The drow can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Cloak of Spiders
entries: A roil of spiders seethes around the drow in a 5-foot radius.  A creature of the drow's choice that starts its turn there must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) poison damage and becoming poisoned until the start of its next turn on a failed save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drow makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Widowcraft or Lolth's Favor.

action.name: Bitterkiss Fangblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 26 (4d12) poison damage.

action.name: Widowcraft (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The drow conjures two Terror Widows in unoccupied spaces within 15 feet of it. The Terror Widows act on the drow's initiative under its control, and remain until the drow loses concentration.

action.name: Lolth's Favor (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One willing creature the drow can see within 60 feet immediately dies and erupts in a 15-foot radius torrent of venomous spiders.
Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Painbond
entries: As a reaction to seeing an creature within 60 feet take damage, the drow may cause a willing creature within 60 feet to take the damage instead.

reaction.name: Lolth's Scorn
entries: When an ally within 60 feet of the drow dies, the drow can use its Lolth's Favor, targeting the ally and treating it as a willing target.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Quicksilver Mind
entries: The drow knows when a frightened creature tells a lie.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drow makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with its Mindkiller Probe or Curse of Frailty.

action.name: Painstave
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage. This damage can't reduce the target below 1 hit point.

action.name: Mindkiller Probe (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the drow can see within 30 feet of it must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, the target takes 7 (2d6) poison damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the drow for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).  While frightened in this way, the target must answer any question asked of it by the drow or its allies.

action.name: Curse of Frailty (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the drow can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw.  On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and is cursed, taking half as much damage on a success.
While cursed in this way, the target has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal poison damage and against being poisoned.

action.name: Night's Black Veil (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: Each light source within 60 feet of the drow is extinguished.  Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or fall asleep until the end of the drow's next turn.

A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more remains asleep for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).  The unconscious creature wakes if it takes any damage or if a creature uses an action to wake it.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drow makes three attacks with its Soulchar Silkblade, one of which it can replace with its Charnel Haze or Death Touch.

action.name: Soulchar Silkblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) force damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage.
If a target hit with this attack in the last minute teleports, it takes 22 (4d10) force damage.

action.name: Charnel Haze (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A cloud of viscous black billows forth, filling a 15-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet of the drow.
Creatures other than the drow treat the area as difficult terrain and magical darkness, and the drow can choose for spells that it casts to originate from a point within the area.

action.name: Death Touch (4th Level Spell)
entries: The drow touches a creature and forces it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
While poisoned in this way, the target takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Darklight Surge (Recharge 5-6, 6th Level Spell)
entries: Invisible light flashes in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 150 feet of the drow, searing unwary eyes.  Each creature in the area takes 27 (6d8) radiant damage and must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw.  On a failed save, a creature can't benefit from darkvision or truesight for the next hour, or until cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Stonefire Cascade (1/Day, 7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Oily acid pours down in a 10-foot radius, 40-foot tall cylinder within 150 feet of the drow for 1 minute, igniting plumes of lightless flame where it touches. When the drow casts this spell and at the start of each of its turns, nonmagical stone in the area is disintegrated to a depth of 10 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) acid damage plus an additional 14 (4d6) fire damage if the target is touching a stone surface, or half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Shadowslip (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The drow teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness it can see. The drow can't cast this spell if it's illuminated by bright light.

bonus.name: Bleak Snare (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the drow can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is dragged up to 20 feet in a direction of the drow's choice.
If the target ends this movement in darkness or dim light, it restrained (escape DC 18) until it is illuminated by bright light.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Ruthless Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the drow fails a saving throw, she can force an ally within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or suffer the effects of the failed saving throw in her stead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drow makes three attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Poison Thoughts or Insidious Pulse, if available.

action.name: Matron's Lash-Scepter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 4) force damage and the target gains a Venom Counter that lasts for 1 hour.

Whenever the creature fails a saving throw against being poisoned, it takes 3 (1d6) poison damage for each Venom Counter it has. A creature with 3 or more Venom Counters can't benefit from immunity to poison damage or the poisoned condition. A creature with 6 or more Venom Counters can't benefit from resistance to poison damage, and can't have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

action.name: Poison Thoughts (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One poisoned creature the drow can see within 60 feet of her has the poisoned condition end for it, and then must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is dominated by the drow for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).  On a successful save, the target is instead charmed by the drow for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Indious Pulse (Recharge 5-6, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The drow forces creatures of her choice within 30 feet of her to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, a target takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Mass Unraveling (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: The drow furrows the weave, disrupting magic in a 300-foot long, 15-foot wide line within 500 feet of her.
Each spell or other magical effect in the area of 7th level or below ends. Each other magical item or effect in the area is suppressed until the end of the drow's next turn.

action.name: Fatal Flaw (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: The drow touches a creature and each of its deepest fears, wounds, and weaknesses unfolds before her. For 1 hour, the target has disadvantage on saving throws against effects caused by the drow, and any attack she hits the target with becomes a critical hit.

bonus.name: Demonic Corruption
entries: One allied demon or charmed creature that the drow can see within 30 feet can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Her Eye is Upon You
entries: The drow draws Lolth's attention to an ally she can see within 60 feet, granting it advantage on the first ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Lolth's Scorn
entries: When an ally within 60 feet of the drow dies, the drow can cause it to erupt in a 15-foot radius torrent of venomous spiders.
Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Handmaiden Anointment (1/Day)
entries: When the drow is reduced below half of her maximum hit points, she can turn each corpse within 30 feet of her to sludge and then summon a Yochol in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of her.  The yochol is friendly to the drow.

legendary.name: Preservation of Lolth
entries: The drow or a friendly creature she can see within 30 feet is warded by dark power. The next time a creature targets the warded creature with an attack or spell before the beginning of the drow's next turn, it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to choose a different target, or has its attack or spell fail if it cannot.

legendary.name: Shadowslip (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The drow teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness she can see. The drow can't cast this spell if she's illuminated by bright light.

legendary.name: Power Word: Suffer (Costs 2 Actions, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The drow speaks a word of power, targeting a creature she can see within 60 feet. The target takes 25 psychic damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn. This damage can't reduce a creature below 1 hit point.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The dragon deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The dragon doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tentacle attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) psychic damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 18). The dragon can have up to four targets grappled at a time.

action.name: Tadpole Brine Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales brine in a 120-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, if the creature isn't a Construct or an Undead, it becomes infested with illithid tadpoles.

While infested, the creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself after it succeeds on three of these saves. If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a curse or restores 40 hit points or more, the tadpoles infesting the creature are killed instantly, ending the effect on the creature.

If a Humanoid is reduced to 0 hit points while infested, the creature is stable but remains unconscious for  hours. When the period of unconsciousness ends, the creature transforms into an illithid (see the Monster Manual) with all its hit points. Casting a wish spell on the unconscious creature rids it of the infestation and prevents it from turning into an illithid.

legendary.name: Tentacle
entries: The dragon makes one Tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Shatter Concentration (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon targets a creature it is grappling. The target's concentration on a spell it has cast or an ability it is maintaining ends, and the target takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizard can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lizard can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the lizard. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Elder Tempest
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tempest deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The tempest may enter a creature's space and stop there. A huge or smaller creature whose space the tempest passes through is sucked into its maelstrom.

trait.name: Grab the Wind
entries: The tempest is divided into 5 sections: Head, forewings, midwings, rearwings, and Maelstrom.

items.name: Maelstrom
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the maelstrom takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) thunder damage.

items.name: Damage Resistant
entries: The maelstrom is immune to all damage, and the wings are resistant to all damage.

items.name: Movement
entries: A creature can make a DC 19 Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Acrobatics), Intelligence (Nature), or Wisdom (Survival) check and spend all of its movement to move one section closer to the head. A creature that succeeds by 5 or more instead advances two sections. A creature that fails by 5 or more loses its grip and falls.

items.name: Gaining Advantage
entries: If the wings take 20 or more damage from a single source (after reductions), the tempest contracts and thrashes, giving all creatures advantage on checks made to move along its length until the tempest's next turn. A creature with a fly speed has advantage on checks to navigate the tempest.

items.name: Falling
entries: A creature that loses its grip falls toward the maelstrom. It may make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw for each section it falls past, catching itself there on a success.

trait.name: Living Storm
entries: Strong winds swirl in the area covered by the storm. The winds impose disadvantage on ranged attack rolls made from further than 30 feet, or one section, away. Ranged attack rolls made from more than 60 feet, or two sections away, miss automaticially.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The tempest doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the tempest fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tempest uses its thunderous wingbeat twice.

action.name: Thunderous Wingbeat
entries: Creatures in one section of the tempest's body other than the maelstrom or head must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 23 (5d8) thunder damage. A creature that fails this save by five or more loses its grip and falls toward the maelstrom.

action.name: Sheet Lightning (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in or adjacent to the tempest must succed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) lightning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more drops what its holding. Nonmetal objects fall to the maelstrom, metal objects have a 50% chance to fall to the maelstrom and a 50% chance to drop out of it.

action.name: The Living Wind (1/Day)
entries: The tempest summons two Air Elementals that appear at its head and act on initiative count 20. The elementals disperse when the tempest dies.

action.name: Screaming Ascent. (1/Day)
entries: Each creature in the tempest must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 22 (4d10) thunder damage and lose its grip and begin to fall toward the maelstrom

action.name: Galvanic Ruin (1/Day)
entries: The tempest releases a blast of lightning and wind in a line that is 1 mile long and 20 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 88 (16d10) damage, or half as much on a failure. A creature behind full cover makes this Saving Throw at advantage, takes half damage on a failure, or 1/4 damage on a success. Objects and structures take double damage from this ability.

action.name: Shed Refuse
entries: If the tempest is below 100 HP, it may attempt to eject one creature from its body. One creature in a section other than the head must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be lauched 30 feet away from the tempest into open air.

reaction.name: Crackling Rebuke
entries: When a creature deals 20 or more damage to the tempest's head with a melee attack, the tempest may use its reaction to force the attacker to succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) lightning damage as electricity erupts from the wound.

name: Elephant
resist: piercing damage from nonmagical ranged attacks

trait.name: Trample
entries: If the elephant first moves at least 20 feet on its turn, it may make a stomp attack against a prone creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Spear Maddened
entries: Weapon attacks against the elephant with the Reach property are made at advantage. Whenever the elephant takes damage from a spear, glaive, pike, or similar long, bladed weapon, it must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the elephant attacks the nearest creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the elk moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antler rush attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Springing Grace
entries: The elk's high jump is up to 10 ft., or up to 15 ft. with a running start. It may treat any surface at least 1 inch across as solid ground to jump off of.

action.name: Antler Rush
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Rearing Kick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Unearthly Scream (Recharge 6)
entries: The elk releases a haunting sound. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action on its following turn.

reaction.name: Elusive Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the elk, the elk moves up to half its speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Burning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The minotaur exhales a cloud of burning embers in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Empyrean
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The empyrean has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Empyrean uses its Shift Mood ability and makes three attacks with its maul or bolt in any combination.

action.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (10d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet the empyrean fell this turn. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +15 to hit, range 600 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (12d6) damage of one of the following types (empyrean's choice): acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, radiant, or thunder. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the empyrean's next turn. A blinded creature has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Shift Mood
entries: The Empyrean adopts one of the following moods. It may not choose the same one twice until it has selected all of them.

items.name: Impatient
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the Empyrean have their movement speed doubled and advantage on Dexterity saving throws. The Empyrean makes an additional attack when it uses its multiattack.

items.name: Fearful
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the Empyrean's next turn. As part of this action, the Empyrean may attempt to teleport to another plane of existence **(7th level spell)**

items.name: Joyous
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean are unaffected by difficult terrain, and have a fly speed equal to their movement speed. The empyrean adds its Charisma modifier its damage rolls.

items.name: Lonely
entries: Creatures within 100 feet of the empyrean are dragged 100 feet closer to it. The Empyrean has vulnerability to psychic damage.

items.name: Melancholic
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean have their movement speed halved and have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. The empyrean's attacks deal an addition 2d6 psychic damage this turn.

items.name: Peaceful
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean who targets another creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attack or spell fails.

items.name: Regretful
entries: Creatures within 30 feet are healed for 20d8 hit points and freed of all debilitating effects.

items.name: Wrathful
entries: : Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean lose concentration on spells and make all attack rolls at advantage. The Empyrean gains resistance to all damage until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Legendary Reactions
entries: The Empyrean may make a legendary reaction whenever its conditions are met, without using its reaction.

reaction.name: Psychic Instability
entries: Whenever the Empyrean takes psychic damage, it uses its Shift Mood ability.

reaction.name: Magnetic Presence
entries: Whenever the Empyrean takes 20 or more damage from a single ranged attack, it may force the attacker to make a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be dragged 30 feet towards it.

reaction.name: Brilliant Flash
entries: Whenever the Empyrean takes 20 or more damage from a single melee attack, it may force the attacker to make a DC 23 Consitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The enchanter is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The enchanter has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

reaction.name: Instinctive Charm (Recharges after the Enchanter Casts an Enchantment Spell of 1st level or Higher)
entries: The enchanter tries to magically divert an attack made against it, provided that the attacker is within 30 feet of it and visible to it. The enchanter must decide to do so before the attack hits or misses.

The attacker must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker targets the creature closest to it, other than the enchanter or itself. If multiple creatures are closest, the attacker chooses which one to target.

trait.name: Bioluminescence
entries: While it has at least 1 hit point, the esthetic sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet, and its interior compartments are dimly lit.

trait.name: Spelljamming
entries: The esthetic has the properties of a spelljamming helm (see the Astral Adventurer's Guide), but only its reigar creator can attune to it.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The esthetic doesn't require air, food, or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The esthetic makes two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the creature takes 18 (4d8) acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and the esthetic can't use this tentacle against other targets. The esthetic has 1d4 x 2 tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

bonus.name: Jammerscream (Recharge 6)
entries: The esthetic targets one spelljamming ship within 300 feet of itself, magically suppressing the properties of the ship's spelljamming helm for  days. If the ship has more than one helm aboard it, randomly determine which helm is affected. A creature attuned to that helm can choose to make a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 42 (12d6) psychic damage, and the helm is suppressed for  hours instead of  days. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and the helm is suppressed for  minutes instead of  days.

name: Eternal
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the eternal has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eternal makes two longsword attacks or two longbow attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the eternal's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The eternal can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Spiderkind
entries: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Spider Trainer
entries: Whenever a friendly spider within 30 feet makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with either its Bite or Silken Noose, if available.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Silken Noose (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing (escape DC 11). While restrained in this way, the ettercap may drag the restrained creature 15 feet toward it at the beginning of each of the ettercap's turns.

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The ettin rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

reaction.name: Kick Away
