entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the ettin, the ettin forces it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and lose concentration, if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Lash Out
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a magical effect, the ettin may move up to half its movement toward the spell caster. If it ends this movement with the spell's caster within its reach, it may then make an attack against the spell's caster.

name: Eye Monger
senses: blindsight 120 ft. while the eye monger's eye is closed

trait.name: Antimagic Gullet
entries: Magical effects, including those produced by spells and magic items but excluding those created by artifacts or deities, are suppressed inside the eye monger's gullet. Any spell slot or charge expended by a creature in the gullet to cast a spell or activate a property of a magic item is wasted. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration. No spell or magical effect that originates outside the eye monger's gullet, except one created by an artifact or a deity, can affect a creature or an object inside the gullet.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the eye monger is motionless and has its eye and mouth closed at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the eye monger move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the eye monger is animate.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The eye monger doesn't require air.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the eye monger and deposited in the eye monger's gullet (see Antimagic Gullet). The eye monger can swallow one creature at a time. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the eye monger, and takes 35 (10d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

If the eye monger takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside its gullet, the eye monger regurgitates the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the eye monger. If the eye monger dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The eyedrake doesn't require food or drink.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Antimagic Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The eyedrake emits a magic wave in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 39 (6d12) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Every spell of 3rd level or lower ends on creatures and objects of the eyedrake's choice in that area.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The eyedrake shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), each ray targeting one creature it can see within 60 feet of it:

items.name: 1: Freezing Ray
entries: The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 17 (5d6) cold damage, and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

items.name: 2: Debilitating Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) thunder damage and become incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 3: Repulsion Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) force damage and be pushed up to 60 feet away from the eyedrake.

items.name: 4: Fire Ray
entries: The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 5: Paralyzing Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 6: Death Ray
entries: The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The falcon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

trait.name: Quickness (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The fastieth can take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Felidar
languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

trait.name: Bonding
entries: The felidar can magically bond with one creature it can see, right after spending at least 1 hour observing that creature while within 30 feet of it. The bond lasts until the felidar bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. This bond has the following effects: The felidar and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet. The felidar can sense the direction and distance to the bonded creature if they're on the same plane of existence. As an action, the felidar or the bonded creature can sense what the other sees and hears, during which time it loses its own sight and hearing. This effect lasts until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The felidar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the felidar moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the felidar can make one claw attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The felidar makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Extraordinary Leap
entries: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to move 3 feet.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

action.name: Sticky Leg
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the ferocidon moves at least 30 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the ferocidon can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The feyr doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The feyr makes one Frightful Bite attack and one Tentacle attack.

action.name: Frightful Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage, and each creature within 10 feet of the feyr that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the feyr until the end of the feyr's next turn.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the feyr can't use this tentacle against other targets. The feyr has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The feyr becomes invisible until it attacks, uses Nightmare Fuel, or uses a bonus action to become visible.

action.name: Nightmare Fuel (1/Day)
entries: The feyr targets one unconscious creature it can see within 10 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage, and the feyr gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.

name: Fiendish Flesh Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources that aren't silvered
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 100 hit points or fewer, roll a . On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points. If the golem's creator is within 60 feet of the berserk golem, the creator can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 100 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the myrmidon takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the myrmidon can't take reactions or use its Flamewheel Dash.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks and can use its Flamewheel Dash.

action.name: Inferno Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Flamewheel Dash
entries: The myrmidon moves up to half its speed in a straight line. Each creature it moves within 5 feet of during this move must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or begin burning (1d10).
Opportunity attacks provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Sudden Flare
entries: When a burning creature targets the myrmidon with a melee attack, the myrmidon can deal 5 (1d10) fire damage to it and impose disadvantage on its attack roll.

name: Fire Giant
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Inner Fire
entries: A creature without fire resistance or immunity that touches the giant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Dampen Flames
entries: If the giant takes any cold damage, its Inner Fire trait is disabled until the beginning of its next turn, and the next attack made against it is made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fire giant makes two attacks with its searing greatsword. It may replace one of these attacks with an Overhead Cleave

action.name: Searing Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. If the target is on fire, this attack does an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Creatures within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Iron Javelins
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (10d6 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Overhead Cleave (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot long, 10 foot wide line that isn't climbing on the giant must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing damage and be knocked prone, or half damage on a success. A creature that passes this save may use its reaction to move 5 feet, taking no damage if it ends this movement outside the affected area.

reaction.name: Battering Blows
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 82 hit points, the fire giant may make a searing greatsword attack against each creature in its reach.

name: Fire Giant Dreadnought
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 21 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Inner Fire
entries: A creature without fire resistance or immunity that touches the giant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Dampen Flames
entries: If the giant takes any cold damage, its Inner Fire trait is disabled until the beginning of its next turn, and the next attack made against it is made at advantage.

trait.name: Dual Shields
entries: The giant carries two shields, each of which is accounted for in the giant's AC. The giant must stow or drop one of its shields to throw javelins.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fire giant makes two attacks with its fire shields, one of which it may replace with a shield charge.

action.name: Fire Shields
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. If the target is on fire, this attack does an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Shield Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed ahead of the giant for the rest of this move.
A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is additionally knocked prone, or takes an additional 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damag if it was already prone.

action.name: Iron Javelins
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 41 (10d6 + 8) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Raise Shields
entries: As a reaction to the fire giant or a friendly creature within 5 ft. being targeted with a ranged attack, the giant may raise its shields, increasing its or its allies' AC by 5 against the attack. Until the beginning of its next turn, melee attacks against the giant are made at advantage.

name: Fire Guardian
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: The fire guardian can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the fire guardian or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the fire guardian can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The fire guardian sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the fire guardian moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fire guardian makes two touch attacks.

action.name: Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

name: Fire Snake
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the snake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The snake makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The firenewt can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the firenewt takes cold damage, it cannot make more than one attack on its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The firenewt makes two attacks with its scimitar.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Regrow Limb
entries: The firenewt regrows one missing limb, which bursts out in a gout of scalding steam. The firenewt regains the use of its limb, and each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) fire damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Drop Limb
entries: As a reaction to taking 6 or more damage, the firenewt drops one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5. A firenewt that drops an arm loses the use of either its scimitar or shield. A firenewt that drops a leg reduces its maximum speed by half.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The fish can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Flail Tentacles
entries: The flail snail has five flail tentacles. Whenever the snail takes 10 or more damage from a single source, one of its tentacles dies. If the snail has no tentacles remaining, it retracts into its shell and begins to wail loudly.

trait.name: Salt-Shriveled
entries: If a creature casts salt on the flail snail with an improvised weapon attack, the flail snail takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and gains a level of exhaustion on a hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flail snail makes as many flail tentacle attacks as it has flail tentacles, then uses its Shift Harmonics.

action.name: Flail Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If this attack misses by 5 or more, the target may use its reaction to make a single melee attack against the snail.

action.name: Shift Harmonics
entries: The snail shifts the swirling patterns of its shell, adopting one of the following effects until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Resistance
entries: The snail has advantage on saving throws against spells.

items.name: Diffraction
entries: Spell attacks made against the snail have disadvantage.

items.name: Reflection
entries: If the snail is missed with a spell attack, the spell is reflected back at its caster.

reaction.name: Shell Defense
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged weapon attack, the snail withdraws into its shell, gaining a +4 bonus to AC until the beginning of its next turn. It cannot attack while withdrawn.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The flameskull sheds either dim light in a 15-foot radius, or bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. It can switch between the options as an action.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its hit points in 1 hour unless holy water is sprinkled on its remains or a Dispel Magic or Remove Curse spell is cast on them.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The flameskull has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Spontaneous Combustion (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 40 feet that the flameskull can see must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire damage and ignite.
Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Fireburst (1st level Spell)
entries: One burning creature within 20 feet erupts in an explosion of flame. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.

reaction.name: Screaming Flame (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the flameskull is targeted with a melee attack, it screams a gout of flame at the attacker, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage and make its attack with disadvantage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

trait.name: Spell Turning
entries: The lion has advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only the lion (not an area). If the lion's saving throw succeeds and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the lion and instead targets the caster.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lion makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claw.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The lion makes one claw attack.

legendary.name: Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lion emits a magical roar. Each creature within 60 feet of the lion that can hear the roar must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the lion until the end of the lion's next turn.

name: Flesh Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
entries: If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Wounded Fury
entries: While it has 20 hit points or fewer, the golem has advantage on attack rolls and its melee attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Resilient Animus
entries: If the golem would take 9 or fewer Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks, one of which it may replace with a hurl.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Throttle
entries: One grappled creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the golem's next turn.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The golem hurls a grappled creature up to 20 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't knocked prone.

trait.name: Advanced Telepathy
entries: The flumph can perceive the content of any telepathic communication used within 60 feet of it, and it can't be surprised by creatures with any form of telepathy.

trait.name: Prone Deficiency
entries: If the flumph is knocked prone, roll a die. On an odd result, the flumph lands upside-down and is incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns, the flumph can make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, righting itself and ending the incapacitated condition if it succeeds.

trait.name: Telepathic Shroud
entries: The flumph is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as all divination spells.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 2 (1d4) acid damage on a failure or ending the recurring acid damage on a success. A lesser restoration spell cast on the target also ends the recurring acid damage.

action.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot cone originating from the flumph must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a foul-smelling liquid. A coated creature exudes a horrible stench for  hours. The coated creature is poisoned as long as the stench lasts, and other creatures are poisoned while with in 5 feet of the coated creature. A creature can remove the stench on itself by using a short rest to bathe in water, alcohol, or vinegar.

trait.name: Fear Frenzy
entries: The horror has advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the horror has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Frightening Screech (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The horror screeches. Each creature within 30 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of it for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the horror's Frightening Screech for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The monkey man mimic the sounds of humanoid speech, albeit poorly.

trait.name: Lackey
entries: The monkey can follow simple instructions, such as going to a speciic location and fetching, delivering, or surveiling something.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The monkey has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the monkey's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the snake takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The snake's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being blinded.

trait.name: Gliding Flyby
entries: The snake may disengage as a bonus action. If it does, it cannot use its fly speed to gain altitude until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the snake's reach while it is not flying, the snake may force the creature to succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the snake, if it can.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the sword is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the sword remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

action.name: Drill-Thrust
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a 19-20.

action.name: Twirling Flourish
entries: One creature within 5 feet must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have one object it is wielding flung up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Whirligig Rush
entries: The sword begins to spin wildly and moves up to half its speed. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement have disadvantage.
Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that misses the sword with a melee attack takes 4 (1d8) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The sword adds +2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Denizen of the Mist
entries: During its turn, the fog giant ignores the effects of fog cloud spells cast by it or other allied fog giants.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatsword attacks and casts fog cloud.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (6d6 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Petty Tyrant (Recharge 6)
entries: The fog giant shouts bloodcurdling threats at the creatures that serve it. Each medium or smaller ally of the giant within 120 feet of it that can see or hear it can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The forlarren's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The forlarren has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The forlarren makes two claw attacks and one gore attack, or it makes three chromatic ray attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Chromatic Ray
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) lightning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The fox has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fractine has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Scrying Focus
entries: A spellcaster can use the fractine as a substitute focus when casting the scrying spell or similar magic, provided the spellcaster and the fractine are within 5 feet of each other.

trait.name: Two-Dimensionality
entries: The fractine can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. It can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, but it takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The fractine doesn't require air, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Extradimensional Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (8d6) force damage.

bonus.name: Imprison
entries: The fractine targets one creature of its size or smaller in its space. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be imprisoned in a demiplane. While the creature is imprisoned, a distorted image of it can be seen on the fractine's two-dimensional surface.

The demiplane moves with the fractine, has indestructible and opaque walls, and is only as big as it needs to be to contain the target, which doesn't suffer from hunger or thirst while imprisoned. No other creature can enter the demiplane, and the fractine can't be harmed from within the demiplane.

The fractine can imprison only one creature at a time and can release that creature as a bonus action. If the fractine is reduced to 0 hit points, any creature in the fractine's demiplane is released instantly. A released creature reappears in an unoccupied space as close to the fractine (or where it died) as possible. A creature can leave the demiplane on its own by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the plane shift spell.

reaction.name: Mirrored Damage
entries: In response to being damaged by a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself, the fractine forces that creature to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (8d6) force damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a Large fractine that has at least 10 hit points remaining takes bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, or thunder damage from any source, it splits into two Medium fractines. The new fractines occupy the space formerly occupied by the original fractine, and each new fractine has hit points equal to half the original's, rounded down. If the original fractine had a creature trapped in its demiplane, that creature is released when the fractine splits, reappearing in an unoccupied space as close to the new fractines as possible.

name: Fraz-Urb'luu, Lord of Illusions
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shroud of the Hidden Hand (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Fraz-Urb'luu is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 200 hit points.
For the next hour, he becomes invisible to creatures affected by his Lying Eyes trait and his Illusory Fiend ability does not require concentration.

trait.name: Lying Eyes
entries: A creature without truesight within 60 feet of Fraz-Urb'luu can see only what he chooses for it to see. He cannot use this ability to obscure or otherwise conceal himself.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Ephemeral Resistance (5/Day)
entries: When Fraz-Urb'luu is targeted with a spell or magical effect, he can choose to teleport to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet, revealing his previous position to be an illusory trick.
If he does, he suffers no effects from the spell or magical effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu makes two attacks with his Phantasmal Fist, one of which he may replace with his Tail Thrash or a use of his Deceptive Charm.

action.name: Phantasmal Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 9) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage and Fraz-Urb'luu teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target.

action.name: Tail Thrash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Deceptive Charm
entries: One creature Fraz-Urb'luu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him for the next minute, or until it takes any damage.

action.name: Twisting Havoc (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of Fraz-Urb'luu's choice affected by his Lying Eyes trait must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by Fraz-Urb'luu and hostile to each other creature that failed this save until the end of his next turn.

reaction.name: Cruel Conciliation
entries: As a reaction when Fraz-Urb-Luu is missed with an attack, he uses his Deceptive Charm against the attacker.

legendary.name: Phantasmal Fist
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu makes an attack with his Phantasmal Fist.

legendary.name: Corrupt Memories
entries: One charmed creature Fraz-Urb'luu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 4 (1d8), to a minimum of 1, for as long as it remains charmed.
A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 1 in this way believes itself to be a demon in Fraz-Urb'luu's service and remains charmed until freed by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

legendary.name: Illusory Fiend (Concentration)
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu shapes the raw energies of the Abyss into a semi-real demon of CR 6 or lower in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet.
The demon acts on initiative count 0 under Fraz-Urb'luu's control, and is destroyed if it begins its turn more than 60 feet away from him, or if he loses concentration.

mythic.name: Disjunctive Touch
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu ends one spell or destroys one non-artifact magic item of Very Rare or lesser rarity within 5 feet.

mythic.name: Hollow the Heart (Costs 2 Actions, 1/Day)
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu moves up to half his speed, then forces a creature within 10 feet to make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, Fraz-Urb'luu rips the creature's still-beating heart from its chest. The creature becomes charmed by Fraz-Urb'luu, acts under his control, and dies if it ceases to be charmed by him. On a successful save, the creature takes 55 (10d10) piercing damage.
A creature with no heart succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

name: Mordenkainen, Lord Mage of Oerth
resist: bludgeoning and piercing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Arbiter of the Balance (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Mordenkainen is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 157 hit points and each condition affecting him ends.
For the next hour, Mordenkainen's Unerring Sword grows in size and deals an additional 10 (2d10) force damage on a hit.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Mordenkainen has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Mordenkainen fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mordenkainen makes two attacks with his Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 6) force damage.

A creation of magical force hit with this weapon explodes, forcing each creature within 15 feet of it to succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Arcing Fingertips (5th Level Spell)
entries: A bolt of lightning leaps from each of Mordenkainen's splayed fingertips, forcing up to ten creatures of his choice in a 90 foot cone to make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw.
A target takes 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Involuntary Wizardry (5th Level Spell)
entries: Mordenkainen calls forth a magical spasm from a creature he can see within range, forcing it to succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or use its highest level unexpended spell slot to cast Magic Missile at that level.
The missiles produced by it are divided evenly between other creatures within 30 feet of the target, with any extras hitting the creature that produced them.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Ultimate Cogitation (8th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Mordenkainen casts any Arcane spell of 6th level or lower that has a casting time of 1 action.

reaction.name: Mordenkainen's Instant Opposition (7th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature Mordenkainen can see within 60 feet casts a spell, Mordenkainen can attempt to neutralize it with a tailored blend of opposing cosmic energies.
The spell caster must succeed on a DC 21 Intelligence saving throw or have its spell fail. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead has its spell rebound upon it.
If the spell targets one or more creatures, it instead targets only the spell caster. If the spell targets an area, it instead targets an area centered on the spell caster.

reaction.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Phantoms (6th Level Spell, Concentration, 2/Day)
entries: When Mordenkainen's Mythic trait becomes active, he can sculpt raw magical force into two Faithful Phantoms.
Each Faithful Phantom appears in an unoccupied space Mordenkainen can see within 15 feet and acts under his control on initiative 0.

legendary.name: Magician's Step
entries: Mordenkainen moves up to half his speed. Then, if no hostile creature within 30 feet can clearly see him, he can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space.

legendary.name: Dancing Slash
entries: Mordenkainen's sword flies up to 30 feet and makes a Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.
At the beginning of Mordenkainen's turn, it returns to his hand.

legendary.name: Hasty Ward (Concentration)
entries: Mordenkainen quickly improvises a protective spell, chosen at random from the Hasty Ward table.

d6SpellLevelEffect
1Mordenkainen's Altered Orbs2Whenever a creature casts a spell that affects a spherical area centered on a point Mordenkainen can see within 60 feet, he can increase or decrease that sphere's radius by 1d4 x 5 feet.
2Mordenkainen's Defense Against Silence2Mordenkainen creates a zone of magical non-silence in a space he can see within range, rendering the space unaffected by any form of magical silence.
3Mordenkainen's Ingenius Aegis2Mordenkainen adds his Intelligence score to his AC against any attack made by a creature with a lower Intelligence score than him.
4Mordenkainen's Invisibility to Exotic Ancestries3Mordenkainen becomes invisible to humanoid races other than humans, non-drow elves, and dwarves.
5Mordenkainen's Protection From Armored Assailants1Creatures wearing metal armor have disadvantage on attack rolls against Mordenkainen, and he can't be grappled or forced to move by them.
6Mordenkainen's Reversed Advance3Whenever a creature moves within 5 feet of Mordenkainen for the first time on a turn, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet directly away from you.

mythic.name: Mordenkainen's Focused Disjunction (Costs 3 Actions, 9th Level Spell)
entries: Mordenkainen attempts to sunder a spell or nonartifact magic item he can see within 60 feet.
A creature concentrating on the spell or attuned to the magic item can make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, preventing its destruction on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deathspitter makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Spit Poison
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, a creature that fails its saving throw is blinded until the end of the deathspitter's next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The frog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The frog's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.

reaction.name: Jumpy
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the frog may impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the frog may jump up to 10 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Shock Susceptibility
entries: If the froghemoth takes lightning damage, it suffers several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity saving throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both.

trait.name: Toxic Secretions
entries: A creature that makes an attack that benefits from flanking the froghemoth must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or suffer 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The froghemoth makes two attacks with its tentacles and one with its bite. It can replace its bite with a use of its Tongue or Lob Mucous

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns. The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth. If the froghemoth dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tongue
entries: The froghemoth targets one Medium or smaller creature that it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth, and the froghemoth can make a bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Lob Mucous
entries: The froghemoth expels a large glob of mucous, covering a 20-foot radius area within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity saving throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. A creature in the froghemoth's gullet when it uses this ability may attempt a DC 16 Athletics or Acrobatics check. On a success, the creature is launched out with mucous and must immediately save against it.

reaction.name: Fling
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a grappled creature, the froghemoth may throw the creature up to 40 feet away. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Reel
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a grappled creature, the froghemoth may pull the creature up to 20 feet straight towards it.

reaction.name: Slam
entries: As a reaction to a creature casting a spell that targets the froghemoth, the froghemoth may lift the creature and slam it into the ground. The creature must make a DC 16 constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. If the creature was concentrating on a spell, it makes its save to maintain concentration at disadvantage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Humanoid Form Only)
headerEntries: The druid is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14; +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The druid makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Ice Sickle (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) cold damage.

action.name: Maul (Beast Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Wild Shape
entries: The druid magically polymorphs into a beast form - fox, mountain goat, owl, or wolf - or back into its humanoid form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the beast form (the druid's choice). It reverts to its humanoid form when it dies. The druid's statistics are the same in each form, except where noted in this stat block.

name: Frost Giant
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The giant can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The frost giant makes two attacks with its icy greataxe or its handaxes.

action.name: Icy Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) cold damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Cleaving Sweep
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot radius that isn't climbing on the giant must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 26 (4d12) slashing damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall prone as a reaction to gain advantage on this save.

reaction.name: Icy Retort
entries: As a reaction to being attacked by a creature within 15 feet of it, the frost giant may force the attacker to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker gains 10 (3d6) temporary hit points that last for one minute. While a creature has these temporary hit points, it is restrained and has vulnerability to fire damage.

name: Frost Giant Everlasting One
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The giant rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The giant can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The giant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the giant takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the giant's next turn. The giant dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Glacierbreaker Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Mutant Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) cold damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way takes 5 (1d10) cold damage. On a critical hit, the giant's arm shears off at the shoulder, retaining its grip against the target.

The arm is an object and can be destroyed (AC 15, HP 15). If the giant is missing an arm, attacks against it are made at advantage, it cannot make attacks with its Mutant Fist, and makes a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns, growing a new arm on a success.

action.name: Hurl Greataxe
entries: The frost giant flings its axe in a rotating arc. Each creature in a 60 foot line that is 10 feet wide must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving thow or take 19 (3d12) slashing damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much on a success.

action.name: Vaprak's Rage (Recharge 6)
entries: The giant makes a mutant fist attack at advantage. If the attack hits, it is a critical.

reaction.name: Icy Retort
entries: As a reaction to being attacked by a creature within 15 feet of it, the frost giant may force the attacker to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker gains 10 (3d6) temporary hit points that last for one minute. While a creature has these temporary hit points, it is restrained and has vulnerability to fire damage.

trait.name: Burning Fury
entries: When the salamander takes fire damage, its
Freezing Breath automatically recharges.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salamander makes one Bite attack and four Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) cold damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The salamander exhales chill wind in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Freezing Body
entries: A creature that touches the worm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the worm dies, it explodes in a burst of frigid energy. Each creature within 60 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures inside the worm when it dies automatically fail this saving throw.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm makes two bite attacks, or uses its Trill and makes a bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and 10 (3d6) cold damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm.

action.name: Trill
entries: The frost worm emits a haunting cry. Each creature within 60 feet of the worm that can hear it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw each time it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once a creature successfully saves against this effect, or if this effect ends for it, that creature is immune to the Trill of all frost worms for the next 24 hours. Frost worms are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the fume drake dies, it explodes in a cloud of noxious fumes. Each creature within 5 feet of the fume drake must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 4 (1d8) poison damage.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The fume drake doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) fire damage.

action.name: Scalding Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The fume drake exhales a 15-foot cone of scalding steam. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Fungal Servant
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fungal servant is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The fungal servant has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fungal servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed fungal servant gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the fungal servant's heart.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fungal servant can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to spores. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: The fungal servant targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the fungal servant, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the fungal servant's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all fungal servants for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The fungal servant makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary.name: Blinding Spores
entries: Blinding spores swirls magically around the fungal servant. Each creature within 5 feet of the fungal servant must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fungal servant utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the fungal servant that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fungal servant magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the fungal servant, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Spores (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fungal servant magically transforms into a whirlwind of spores, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the fungal servant is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the fungal servant remain in its possession.

trait.name: Air Envelope
entries: If it has at least 1 hit point, the gadabout can generate an air envelope around itself when in a vacuum. This air envelope can sustain the gadabout and one other creature in its space indefinitely.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The gadabout doesn't require food or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gadabout makes two Branch attacks.

action.name: Branch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Wrap
entries: The gadabout enters the space of a willing Medium or Small creature within 5 feet of itself and gently wraps its branches around the target. The target is grappled (escape DC 0). Any attempt by the target to escape the grapple causes the gadabout to use its reaction to move into the nearest unoccupied space. While grappled by the gadabout, the target determines where the gadabout moves on the gadabout's turns and accompanies the gadabout wherever it goes.

name: Gaj
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gaj makes one Mandibles attack and uses Mind-Probing Antennae or Paralyze (if available).

action.name: Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage at the start of each of the gaj's turns. While it is grappling a creature, the gaj can't use its mandibles to attack other creatures.

action.name: Mind-Probing Antennae
entries: The gaj targets one creature grappled by it. The target must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage, and the gaj magically pulls one piece of information from the target's mind that the gaj wants to know. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and the gaj learns nothing.

action.name: Paralyze (Recharge 6)
entries: The gaj magically targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Galeb Duhr

walk.condition: (30 ft. when rolling 60 ft. rolling downhill)

resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the galeb duhr remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal boulder.

trait.name: Rolling Charge
entries: If the galeb duhr rolls at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Clang!
entries: A creature that misses the galeb duhr with an attack of opportunity must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be disarmed and have its weapon flung 15 feet in a random direction.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shockwave (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much damage on a success. Additionally, the affected area become difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Animated Boulders
entries: As a reaction to a creature that is within 30 feet of a mundane boulder hitting the galeb duhr with an attack, the galeb duhr may cause the boulder to move up to 30 feet and make a slam attack against the attacker, using the galeb duhr's statistics.

name: Galvanice Weird
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the galvanice weird dies, it explodes in a burst of ice and lightning. Each creature within 10 feet of the exploding weird must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or lose the ability to use reactions until the start of the weird's next turn.

name: Gargoyle
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources that aren't adamantine

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

trait.name: Brittle Body
entries: If the gargoyle takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it can no longer use its multiattack until it completes a short or long rest. If it takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source a second time, it loses its fly speed until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Clumsy Flier
entries: The gargoyle falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed. Attacks it makes while airborne are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Silverblood Gargoyle
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

trait.name: Silverblood Adrenaline
entries: Once the gargoyle drops below half of its maximum hit points, it becomes enraged. While enraged, it can make an extra attack with its claws when it uses its Multiattack, and it no longer provokes attacks of opportunity.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes four attacks with its claws, one of which it can replace with a bite attack or with a use of its Silence feature.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the gargoyle regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
If the gargoyle flew at least 20 feet towards its target, it deals an additional 7 (1d12) slashing damage.

action.name: Silence (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The gargoyle creates a 20-foot radius sphere of magical silence at a point within 120 feet for 10 minutes. No sound can be created within or pass through the area, any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.

bonus.name: Stone Shift
entries: The gargoyle alters its stony exterior to adapt to incoming attacks. The gargoyle gains resistance to one type of damage of its choice until the start of its next turn.

bonus.name: Winged Ambush
entries: The gargoyle moves up to its flying speed.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The gas spore explodes when it drops to 0 hit points. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and become infected with a disease on a failed save. Creatures immune to the poisoned condition are immune to this disease.

Spores invade an infected creature's system, killing the creature in a number of hours equal to  + the creature's Constitution score, unless the disease is removed. In half that time, the creature becomes poisoned for the rest of the duration. After the creature dies, it sprouts  Tiny gas spores that grow to full size in 7 days.

trait.name: Eerie Resemblance
entries: The gas spore resembles a beholder. A creature that can see the gas spore can discern its true nature with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) check.

action.name: Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 poison damage, and the creature must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or become infected with the disease described in the Death Burst trait.

trait.name: Stunning Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the gauth's central eye starts its turn within 30 feet of the gauth, the gauth can force it to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw if the gauth isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. A creature that fails the save is stunned until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the gauth in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the gauth dies, the magical energy within it explodes, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The gauth shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it:

items.name: 1. Devour Magic Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or have one of its magic items lose all magical properties until the start of the gauth's next turn. If the object is a charged item, it also loses  charges. Determine the affected item randomly, ignoring single-use items such as potions and scrolls.

items.name: 2. Enervation Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 3. Pushing Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from the gauth and have its speed halved until the start of the gauth's next turn.

items.name: 4. Fire Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) fire damage.

items.name: 5. Paralyzing Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 6. Sleep Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.

name: Gazer
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Born Fink
entries: Each beholder within a 5 mile radius hears and sees everything the gazer sees.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The gazer shoots two of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one or two targets it can see within 60 feet of it:

items.name: Dazing Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of the gazer's next turn. While charmed, a creature's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls.

items.name: Fear Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the gazer's next turn.

items.name: Cold Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) cold damage.

items.name: Telekinetic Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 ft. away from the gazer.

name: Beholderling
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The beholderling shoots bright, but otherwise harmless, eye rays at a creature it can see within 60 feet of it.  The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the beholderling's next turn.

name: Gem Stalker
languages: telepathy 60 ft. understands Draconic but can't speak

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The gem stalker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The gem stalker doesn't require food or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gem stalker makes four Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Crystal Dart
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage, and one of the following effects occurs, determined by the kind of dragon that created the gem stalker:

bonus.name: Amethyst
entries: The gem stalker can teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it.

bonus.name: Diamond
entries: The gem stalker gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.

bonus.name: Emerald
entries: The target must roll a d6 and subtract the number rolled from the next attack roll it makes before the start of the gem stalker's next turn.

bonus.name: Sapphire
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed horizontally up to 10 feet away from the gem stalker and be knocked prone.

bonus.name: Topaz
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the gem stalker's next turn.

reaction.name: Protective Link
entries: When another creature the gem stalker can see within 30 feet of it is about to take damage, the gem stalker reduces that damage by 10 (). The gem stalker then takes damage equal to that amount.

name: Geryon, the Forgotten Lord
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Geryon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 21). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
will: alter self (can become Medium when changing his appearance)

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Geryon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Geryon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Geryon's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Geryon regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Geryon dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Geryon makes two attacks: one with his claws and one with his stinger.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (DC 24) and is restrained until the grapple ends. Geryon can grapple one creature at a time. If the target is already grappled by Geryon, the target takes an extra 27 (6d8) slashing damage.

action.name: Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d4 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (2d12) poison damage and become poisoned until it finishes a short or long rest. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the poison damage it takes. If its hit point maximum drops to 0, it dies. This reduction lasts until the poisoned condition is removed.

action.name: Teleport
entries: Geryon magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Infernal Glare
entries: Geryon targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. If the target can see Geryon, the target must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of Geryon until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Swift Sting (Costs 2 Actions)
