entries: Geryon attacks with his stinger.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Geryon uses his Teleport action.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the ghast must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

trait.name: Dead Blood Burst
entries: When the ghast dies, each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Fleshripper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Death Grip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). A creature that ends its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Tear Apart (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature grappled by the ghast and at least one of its allies must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (5d8) slashing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a death save.

name: Ghost
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 x 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a  greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

action.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
entries: One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

name: Ghost Dragon
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The ghost's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Agonizing Attachment
entries: Whenever 100 gp or more of its horde is destroyed in a turn, the ghost takes 25 psychic damage.

trait.name: Creeping Whisper
entries: The ghost is invisible. Whenever it takes an action other than its Telekinetic Thrash, it becomes visible for 1 minute.

trait.name: Hordebound
entries: If the ghost is destroyed while its horde contains less treasure than it did at the moment of its original death, the ghost returns to undeath and regains all of its hit points after 9 (2d8) hours, appearing within 60 feet of its horde.
If the ghost's horde is restored to its original value, the ghost curls up atop the horde and vanishes, along with its horde.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghost makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Spectral Bite.

action.name: Spectral Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (6d8 + 3) cold damage damage and the target's speed is halved until the start of the dragon's next turn.

action.name: Covetous Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage and the target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw.

On a failure, the ghost snatches one magic item or coinpouch the creature is carrying and flings it up to 30 feet towards the ghost's horde. If the ghost's Hoard Possession is active, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrash (Recharges when the ghost uses its Terrormist Breath)
entries: Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, be pushed up to 20 feet in a direction of the ghost's choice, and be knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Terrormist Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales a cloud of shifting mists that heavily obscures the area in a 90-foot cone for the next minute, until cleared away by a strong wind, or until it uses this ability again.

A living creature that starts its turn in the area, or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 40 (9d8) cold damage and is frightened until the beginning of its next turn as terrifying hallucinations overcome it, or takes half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more has its speed reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.
A living creature that ends its turn in the area ages by 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Hoard Possession (1/Day)
entries: When the ghost is reduced below 163 hit points, the ghost draws its hoard into itself, forming a body of treasure. For the next minute, the ghost gains the following effects:
The ghost loses its Spectral Weapons and Agonizing Attachment traits.
All damage dealt to the ghost becomes psychic damage, instead of any other type.
The ghost's melee attacks are made at advantage, and deal an additional 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the ape can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The ape's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the ape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any large or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the ape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ape makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 21 (6d6) damage to a grappled creature.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The ape hurls a huge or smaller grappled creature up to 40 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't knocked prone. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 50/100 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The badger does not die or fall unconscious due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The badger can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The badger attacks once with its bite and once with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d4 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Spirit Vapors
entries: The bat's breath is a heavy mist that settles across the ground beneath it. Creatures within 15 feet of the bat cannot benefit from invisibility.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bat makes two melee attacks and uses its Echolocation.

action.name: Vicious Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Claw Rake
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). This attack is made at advantage against a flying creature.

action.name: Echolocation
entries: If the bat is not deafened, it gains one of the following benefits until the end of its next turn:

items.name: High Frequency
entries: The bat has advantage on melee attack rolls. Whenever the bat uses its Chaotic Swerve and the triggering attack misses it, the bat regains its reaction.

items.name: Sonic Assault
entries: At the end of the bat's turn, each nonbat creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of the bat's next turn and lose concentration, if it was concentrating.

reaction.name: Chaotic Swerve
entries: As a reaction when the bat is targeted with an attack, it may move 10 feet directly toward the nearest creature that is not riding it and impose disadvantage on the attack roll.
Then, if one or more creatures that are not riding it are within 5 feet of the bat, the bat and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Earth Scenting
entries: The boar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 ft. of it.

trait.name: Ploughing Charge
entries: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line, it may move through the space of any huge or smaller creature.
When the boar enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boar makes two attacks, one of which may be with its trample.

action.name: Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Trample
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rooting Rush (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The boar moves up to half its speed, dragging its tusks through the ground, then flings them forward. Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success.
The ground the boar passed over with this movement becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance
entries: As a reaction to taking damage that would reduce it to 0 hit points, the boar makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the boar is instead reduced to 1 hit point.
If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at disadvantage.

action.name: Peck
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

trait.name: Water Camouflage
entries: The snake has advantage on stealth checks while submerged.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the snake takes 5 or more Cold damage in a turn, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The snake's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being blinded.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damag and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the snake can't attack another target.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the snake has grappled with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the snake crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a failed save, the target begins to hallucinate and is afflicted with a short-term madness effect (determined randomly or by the DM). The effect lasts 10 minutes.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the crab can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 ft.

trait.name: Brittle Shell
entries: If the crab takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crab makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature grappled by the crab must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 45 (10d8) bludgeoning damage and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the crab moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the crab out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the crab is unaffected.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant crayfish can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant crayfish makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The crayfish has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the crocodile has a creature grappled and takes 5 or more Poison damage from a single source, it immediately releases its grapple.

trait.name: Grapple Vulnerability
entries: The crocodile can be grappled by a creature up to two sizes smaller than it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crocodile makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the crocodile. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Death Roll (Recharge 6)
entries: A creature grappled by the crocodile must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) slashing damage and be stunned until the end of the crocodile's next turn, or half as much damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this ability loses a limb (crocodile's choice). The crocodile may not use this ability if it is grappled. nbsp;

trait.name: Drone
entries: When it beats its wings, the dragonfly emits a loud droning sound that can be heard out to a range of 120 feet.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: The dragonfly halves the damage it takes from an attack made against it, provided it can see the attacker.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the eagle is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19, or 20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eagle makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the elk moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antler rush attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Springing Grace
entries: The elk's high jump is up to 15 ft., or up to 30 ft. with a running start. It may treat any surface at least 1 inch across as solid ground to jump off of.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elk makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Unearthly Scream, if available.

action.name: Antler Rush
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Rearing Kick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage. A prone target takes an additional 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Unearthly Scream (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The elk releases a haunting sound. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action on its following turn.

reaction.name: Elusive Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the elk, the elk moves up to half its speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

action.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The frog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The frog's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Poisonous
entries: A creature that hits the frog with a melee attack using Natural Weapons takes 11 (2d10) poison damage. If this damage reduces the frog to 0 hit points, the attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 22 (4d10) poison damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the frog can't bite another target.

action.name: Tongue
entries: One Huge or smaller creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 ft towards the frog, which can use a bonus action to make a bite attack against it.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The frog makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

reaction.name: Jumpy
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the frog may impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the frog may jump up to 40 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The goat does not die or fall unconscious due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the goat starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Pushy
entries: If the goat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target is pushed 15 ft. away. If it is pushed into a wall or other solid surface, the creature takes an additional 10 (3d6) damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goat attacks once with its bite and once with its ram.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the hyena can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: The hyena has advantage on attack rolls against a creature unless that creature hit it with a melee attack since the end of the hyena's last turn.

action.name: Latching Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the hyena can't bite another target.

action.name: Crush Bones
entries: One creature grappled by the hyena takes 52 (8d12) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Giggling Retreat
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the hyena moves up to 10 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the hyena this turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Cold Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the toad takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the toad can't bite another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the toad is grappling. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and 11 (2d10) cold damage at the start of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The eel can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eel makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Jolt (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the eel touches within 5 feet of it outside water, or each creature within 15 feet of it in a body of water, must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On failed save, a target takes 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the target takes any of this damage, the target is stunned until the end of the eel's next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the monitor takes 10 or more Cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the monitor has a creature grappled and takes 10 or more Poison damage, it immediately releases its grapple.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizard makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tail Thrash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target the lizarad isn't grappling. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the lizard. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

reaction.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the lizard reduces the attack's damage to 0.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Deception (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 feet wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The octopus makes two tentacle attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its fling

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

action.name: Fling
entries: One creature grappled by the octopus is thrown up to 30 feet. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

action.name: Blanket (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. radius sphere must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled and pulled up to 5 ft. toward the octopus. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. A creature without a swim speed makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 55 hit points while underwater, the octopus exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash or Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Raking Flyby
entries: The owl does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures that it started its turn hidden from.

trait.name: Silent Flight
entries: While flying in dim light or darkness, the owl can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owl makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 16).

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The serpent makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the serpent isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The serpent makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the serpent, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the serpent's turns. A serpent can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the serpent takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the serpent must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the serpent. If the serpent dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the octopus can't use its tentacles on another target.

action.name: Ink Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: A 20-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.

name: Giant Scorpion
resist: poison damage from its own attacks

trait.name: Slowed Metabolism
entries: The scorpion can survive up to a year without food or water, and up to two weeks without oxygen before suffering any ill effects.

trait.name: Heat Spasms
entries: Whenever the scorpion takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it makes a tail stinger attack against a random creature within reach.

trait.name: Brittle Barb
entries: If the scorpion is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scorpion makes three melee attacks, up to one of which may be with its its Tail Stinger.

action.name: Grasping Pincers
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing plus 11 (2d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be infected with wandering eye neurotoxemia.

action.name: Acid Spew (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature grappled by the scorpion must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Twisting Tail
entries: As a reaction when a creature grapples the scorpion, the scorpion makes an attack with its tail stinger against the creature.

reaction.name: Chittering Feint
entries: As a reaction when the scorpion misses a creature with a Tail Stinger attack, it may reroll the attack with disadvantage.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The eel can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the sea horse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The sea horse can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Test Bite
entries: If the shark starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may Dash or Disengage as a bonus action this turn.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the shark takes lightning damage, it has disadvantage on attacks on its following turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose 5 (2d4) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Ram (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The shark moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards a creature that does not have all its hit points and makes a bite attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the shark's next turn.

reaction.name: Circle
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 64 hit points, the shark moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. Each creature of its choice within 50 ft. that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The slug's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The slug has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The slug can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slug makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Salt Osmosis
entries: Whenever the snail starts its turn in contact with a pound or more of salt, it takes 1d4 necrotic damage. Using an action to sprinkle a pound of salt on the snail deals 1d4 necrotic damage to it immediately and another 1d4 necrotic damage to it at the start of its next turn (after which the salt rubs off), provided the snail has not withdrawn into its shell.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shell Defense
entries: The snail withdraws into its shell, gaining a +4 bonus to its AC until it emerges. It can emerge from its shell as a bonus action on its turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The turtle can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Stable
entries: Whenever an effect knocks the turtle prone, it can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw to avoid being knocked prone. A prone turtle is upside down. To stand up, it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity check on its turn and then use all its movement for that turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Paralyzing Bite.

action.name: Paralyzing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way stabilizes automatically, and becomes poisoned for the next hour. While poisoned in this way, a creature is paralyzed.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Death Leap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The deathleaper jumps up to 120 feet, and can land in the space of up to one Huge or smaller creature.
A creature whose space the deathleaper lands in must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned until the beginning of its next turn.
On a successful saving throw, the deathleaper instead lands in the nearest unoccupied space.

bonus.name: Tangleweb Launch (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The spider launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 16). The webbing can be destroyed (AC 15; 15 HP; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

bonus.name: Web Bind
entries: The spider attempts to wrap a grappled or prone creature within 5 feet in webbing, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 16).
If the target is Large or smaller, the spider can attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the giant strider is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to half the fire damage dealt.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Fire Burst (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant strider hurls a gout of flame at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners, and it ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. One attack can be replaced by Swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lizard can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Swallow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the lizard is grappling. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. The target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the lizard, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the lizard's turns. The lizard can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the lizard dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The swan has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swan makes two attacks with its beak.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the toad can't bite another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The toad makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vulture makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The walrus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The walrus makes two attacks: one with its body flop and one with its tusks.

action.name: Body Flop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The eel can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature is reduced to 0 HP while poisoned, the target stabilizes automatically. The spider may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone enemy.

action.name: Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 7 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

action.name: Deadly Leap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: If the spider jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 7 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the spider's space into the nearest unoccupied space.

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The spider may use its webbing to restrain a grappled or prone target (escape DC 12). If the target is Medium or smaller, the spider may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

trait.name: Aberrant Ground
entries: The ground within 10 feet of the mouther is doughlike difficult terrain. A creature in this area must spend half its movement to exit the area.

trait.name: Gibbering
entries: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't incapacitated. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more gibberers and can hear the gibbering makes a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature must take the Attack action this turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more chooses targets at random among the creatures it can reach with its movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gibbering mouther makes one lunging bite attack and uses its blinding spittle, if available. It may replace its bite attack with its gibbering feast ability.

action.name: Lunging Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the mouther.

action.name: Gibbering Feast
entries: One creature the mouther can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Charisma saving throw or take 17 (5d6) piercing damage as unnatural mouths grow from their body and bite them, after which they fall off and rot away immediately.

action.name: Blinding Spittle (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The mouther spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.

reaction.name: Desperate Shrieking
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the mouther lets out a human-sounding cry of pain. The next attack made against it before the beginning of its next turn is made with disadvantage.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the gibberling can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, gibberlings have disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Burrow
entries: A gibberling gains advantage on stealth checks if it uses an action to burrow into dirt.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Swarm
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The target is grappled (escape DC 10). All gibberlings within 5 ft. of the target can use a reaction to make a dagger attack with advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Firearms Knowledge
entries: The giff's mastery of its weapons enables it to ignore the loading property of any firearm.

trait.name: Steady as She Goes
entries: On the deck of a ship, the giff has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone or shove it overboard.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giff makes two Longsword or Musket attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Musket
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Force Grenade
entries: The giff throws a grenade up to 60 feet, and the grenade explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After the giff throws the grenade, roll a ; on a roll of 4 or lower, the giff has no more grenades to throw.

trait.name: Firearms Knowledge
entries: The giff's mastery of its weapons enables it to ignore the loading property of any firearm.

trait.name: Headfirst Charge
entries: If the giff moves at least 20 feet in a straight line and ends within 5 feet of a Large or smaller creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The giff deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giff makes two Greatsword or Musket attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Musket
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d12 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Thunder Bomb
entries: The giff lights a grapefruit-sized bomb and throws it at a point up to 60 feet away, where it explodes. Each creature within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After the giff throws the bomb, roll a ; on a roll of 4 or lower, the giff has no more bombs to throw.

trait.name: Firearms Knowledge
entries: The giff's mastery of its weapons enables it to ignore the loading property of any firearm.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the giff fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giff makes two Morningstar attacks.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Double-Barreled Musket
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d12 + 2) piercing damage.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The giff moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Rallying Cry
entries: The giff ends the frightened condition on itself and each creature of its choice that it can see within 30 feet of it.

legendary.name: Weapon of Choice (2 Actions)
entries: The giff makes two Morningstar attacks or one Double-Barreled Musket attack.

trait.name: Keen Scent
entries: The girallon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on scent, and can detect the presence of creatures up to 120 ft. away.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the girallon can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Bowl Over
entries: If the girallon moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The girallon makes five attacks: one with its bite and four with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit. reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the girallon can grapple the target (escape DC 14).

action.name: Slam
entries: The girallon slams two grappled creatures into each other. The creatures must each succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the girallon's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The girallon hurls a grappled creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The githyanki makes two Greatsword or Telekinetic Bolt attacks.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a bonus action, the githyanki gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Astral Stride
entries: At the end of the githyanki's turn roll a d20. On an 11 or higher it vanishes into the Ethereal plane, returning to the Material plane at the start of its next turn to an unoccupied space within 10 ft. of its departure.

items.name: Teleport
entries: The githyanki teleports up to 30 ft. to a location it can see.

items.name: Psychic Shroud
entries: The githyanki becomes invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Iron Mind

reaction.name: Disrupt Dweomer (2nd level spell)

trait.name: Dragonrider

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment

items.name: Telekinetic Trip

entries: The goon balloon bursts when it drops to 0 hit points, releasing noxious gas in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries: The goon balloon doesn't require air, food, or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goon balloon makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

action.name: Scintillating Eye
entries: Magical, kaleidoscopic light emanates from one of the goon balloon's eyes as the goon balloon targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. bonus.name: Float
entries: The goon balloon moves up to 20 feet vertically in one direction without provoking opportunity attacks. If it ends this movement suspended in the air, it hovers in place. It can't be knocked prone while airborne.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the bull can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

entries: The bull exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

entries: One piece of nonmagical metal armor the target is wearing softens and sags, offering no AC bonus until the end of the ooze's next turn.

items.name: Soften Weapon
entries: One nonmagical metal weapon the target is wielding becomes springy and pliable, counting as an improvised weapon until the end of the ooze's next turn.

action.name: Chaos Meld
entries: One creature within 5 feet that is wearing or wielding an item affected by the ooze's Shifting Pseudopod must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw.

action.name: Cryptic Mimicry
entries: The ooze mimics the texture of nearby surfaces, becoming indistinguishable from them until it moves or is illuminated by a source of bright light within 10 feet of it.

trait.name: Imprint

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Rending Claws

On a critical hit, nonmagical leather armor the target is wearing is destroyed.

reaction.name: Bloody Rampage
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the gray render lets out an enraged bellow, adding one claw attack to its multiattack, cumulatively, for the next minute.

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Seductive Guile
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw against a spell or ability Graz'zt controls can choose to succeed instead. If it does, the creature gains 30 temporary hit points.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is charmed by Graz'zt and acts under his control, and loses any immunity to the charmed condition.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Graz'zt has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Graz'zt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Graz'zt makes two attacks with Bitter Bastard and uses either his Gift of Writhing Pain or Gift of Transcendent Pleasure.

action.name: Bitter Bastard
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing and an arc of acid splashes forth in a 15 foot cone centered on the target, dealing 9 (2d8) acid damage to each creature in the area.

action.name: Gift of Writhing Pain (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet falls prone and is wracked with agony for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage and be unable to stand until the beginning of its next turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Gift of Transcendent Pleasure (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet cannot take reactions and is suffused in an aura of pure rapturous delight for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or voluntarily fail all other saving throws until the beginning of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends.

action.name: Annihilating Despair (Concentration, Recharges when Graz'zt uses his Ambrosial Ecstasy)
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet becomes invisible to him for the next minute.
At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or take 77 (14d10) psychic damage.
When a creature is killed by this damage, each of its allies must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or lose all memory of them until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Ambrosial Ecstasy (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Graz'zt gently touches a creature within 5 feet and shares with it a fragment of his power. The creature must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be cursed.

While cursed in this way, a creature charmed by Graz'zt adds a d4 to all of its attack rolls and saving throws, and a creature not charmed by him subtracts a d4 from all of its attack rolls and saving throws.
A creature that has this curse removed by any means other than a Wish spell takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage whenever it completes a Long Rest.

reaction.name: Exploit Opening
entries: As a reaction when he is missed with a melee attack, Graz'zt moves up to 10 feet and makes an attack with Bitter Bastard.

reaction.name: Covetous Intercession (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature under his control is targeted with an attack, Graz'zt and that creature teleport to switch places with one another, and Graz'zt becomes the new target of the attack.

legendary.name: Beguiling Invitation
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet may use its reaction to move up to its speed, then takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage for each 5 feet away from him it ends this movement.

legendary.name: Devour Magic
entries: Graz'zt ends one spell or magical effect within 60 feet, and gains disadvantage on the next saving throw he makes in the next minute against magic controlled by that spell's caster.

legendary.name: Mercurial Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Graz'zt teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature he can see and makes two melee attacks against it.

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.
While a creature's size is reduced in this way, it deals half as much damage with attacks that use its Strength score.

entries: The cyclops makes two attacks with its Ice Claw or Ray of Frost, one of which it can replace with a use of its Sleet Storm.

entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) cold damage.

action.name: Sleet Storm (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The cyclops calls freezing rain and sleet to fall in a 20-foot tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius within 120 feet of it for 1 minute. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused.

The ground in the area is covered with slick ice, making it difficult terrain. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.
If a creature starts its turn in the spell's area and is concentrating, it must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

action.name: Frost Nova (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The cyclops forces all creatures within 20 feet of it to make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the start of the cyclops' next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Intercepting Burst (1st Level Spell)
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the cyclops makes an attack, it can force it to make DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and has disadvantage on its attack roll.

name: Fomorian Glour
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack

reaction.name: Predictive Sway (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the fomorian would be hit with an attack, it can make an Intelligence saving throw with a DC equal to the attack roll. On a success, the fomorian moves up to 5 feet and the attack misses.

legendary.name: Cursebound Charge
entries: The fomorian moves up to its speed and makes an attack with its Woundcrook Spear. On a hit, the target takes an additional 5 (1d10) lightning damage for each expended use of the fomorian's Cursed Purge.

legendary.name: Venom-Hex Glare

entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and a chattering spectral head accosts the target. Until the end of the fomorian's next turn or until the target fails a saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from any attack roll or saving throw it makes.

action.name: Plague of Thorns (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Biting thorns rise to entwine the fomorian and each other creature of its choice within 20 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 19 (3d12) piercing damage and is restrained until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Ur-Light Glare (2/Day)
entries: One creature the fomorian can see within 60 feet must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage plus 22 (4d10) radiant damage and is cursed for 1 hour. On a success, both the target and the fomorian take 10 psychic damage.
While cursed in this way, whenever the creature casts or is affected by a spell of 1st level or higher, it is blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Greater Zombie
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The zombie has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Empowered Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

name: Green Abishai
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mind Reader
entries: At the beginning of the abishai's turn, one creature it can see within 120 ft. must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the Abishai is aware of its thoughts, and treats its AC as 4 higher against that creature's attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai makes two melee attacks and uses its Incite Panic.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature cannot see the abishai. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Incite Panic
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the Abishai's next turn. While frightened in this way, a creature selects targets at random.

reaction.name: Dragonspawn Exhultation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly dragon within 30 ft. using its breath weapon, the abishai may move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

reaction.name: Convincing Cry
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting it with a melee attack, the abishai may compel one creature affected by its Incite Panic to move up to half its speed. If it ends this speed within 5 ft. of the attacker, the frightened creature makes a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Swampwalk
entries: The hag is unaffected by difficult terrain caused by swampy terrain or vegetation.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it has killed. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Glimmer of Hope
entries: Whenever one or more creatures the hag can see within 30 ft. succeed on a saving throw against a spell the hag controls, the hag gains 5 (1d10) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Earthdrinker Coven
entries: The earth within 10 miles of a coven of green hags gradually softens and becomes waterlogged over the course of a week. The roots of food crops begin to rot away, livestock sicken, and the area becomes difficult terrain.

action.name: Swampgift Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be cursed.
While cursed, a creature glows with a pale blue light, attracts biting insects, and swamp-dwelling creatures have advantage on attack rolls against the cursed creature.

action.name: Hurl to Earth
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be teleported 60 ft. in the air and knocked prone.

action.name: Grasping Muck
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 13) as it begins to sink into the earth. A prone creature has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Stagnant Miasma (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ground in a 10 ft. radius within 60 ft. begins to bubble, exuding a cloud of toxic gas that remains for a minute, or until cleared with a strong breeze. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) poison damage.

reaction.name: Hope to Despair
entries: When a creature that the hag can see within 30 ft. makes a saving throw against a spell the hag (or a member of her coven) cast, she may expend all temporary hit points from her Glimmer of Hope ability and subtract the number expended from the creature's saving throw.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The slaad can use its action to polymorph itself or another slaad into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

trait.name: Disordered Transposition
entries: At the beginning of the slaad's turn, a randomly selected creature within 60 ft. is teleported up to 30 ft. to a location of the slaad's choice that the slaad can see.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The slaad regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three melee attacks, up to two of which it may replace with uses of its chaos flame.

action.name: Brainstaff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.
On a critical hit, the slaad must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Chaos Flame (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage. The fire ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.
If this attack misses, the slaad makes a second attack roll against a random creature within 10 ft. of the original target.

action.name: Pandemoniac Ephemera (Concentration)
entries: The slaad creates the image of an object or creature no larger than a 20-foot cube. It seems real to all senses, though a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals its illusory nature. The slaad may interact with the illusion physically as though it were real.

While charmed by the matriarch, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the matriarch, the target must move on its turn toward the matriarch by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the matriarch, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this matriarch's song for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Soot-Tongued Chorus (1/Day)
entries: When Cerberus is reduced to half of his maximum hit points or lower, he can use his reaction to fill nearby flames with vigor.  Each burning creature within 60 feet has its burning value increase by 2d10, to a maximum of 5d10, then each other creature within 5 feet of it begins burning (2d10).

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the mosquito attaches to the target. While attached, the mosquito doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the mosquito's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.

The mosquito can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the mosquito.

name: Hellfire Engine
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources that aren't silvered

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The hellfire engine is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hellfire engine has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The hellfire engine doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Flesh-Crushing Stride
entries: The hellfire engine moves up to its speed in a straight line. During this move, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. A creature whose space the hellfire engine enters must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest space out of the hellfire engine's path. On a failed save, the creature falls prone and takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage.

If the hellfire engine remains in the prone creature's space, the creature is also restrained until it's no longer in the same space as the hellfire engine. While restrained in this way, the creature, or another creature within 5 feet of it, can make a DC 18 Strength check. On a success, the creature is shunted to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the hellfire engine and is no longer restrained.

action.name: Hellfire Weapons
entries: The hellfire engine uses one of the following options (choose one or roll a ):

items.name: 1â€“2: Bonemelt Sprayer
entries: The hellfire engine spews acidic flame in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are drenched in burning acid and take 5 (1d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage at the end of their turns. An affected creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to scrape off the burning fuel.

items.name: 3â€“4: Lightning Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) lightning damage. Up to three other creatures of the hellfire engine's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target must each make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 5â€“6: Thunder Cannon
