entries: The hellfire engine targets a point within 120 feet of it that it can see. Each creature within 30 feet of that point must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

If the chosen option kills a creature, the creature's soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in  hours. If the creature isn't revived before then, only a wish spell or killing the lemure and casting true resurrection on the creature's original body can restore it to life. Constructs and devils are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the hellion or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the hellion can't bite another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The hellion makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hellion, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the hellion's turns.

If the hellion takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the hellion must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the hellion. If the hellion dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

name: Crawlspark Hellion
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amplify Charge
entries: If the hellion would take any lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hellion makes two attacks with its Furtive Zap.

action.name: Furtive Zap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) lightning damage.
Before or after making this attack, the hellion can teleport up to 10 feet.

action.name: Haywire Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the hellion must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) lightning damage and use its reaction, if available, to make a melee attack against a random target in its reach.  Constructs have disadvantage on this saving throw.

name: Lightning Elemental
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amplify Charge
entries: If the elemental would take any lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Spark Gap
entries: When the elemental is hit with an attack, it teleports up to 10 feet directly toward the largest metal object within 60 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Thrumming Sparkbolt.

action.name: Thrumming Sparkbolt
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) lightning damage.
This attack has advantage if it targets the closest creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon.

action.name: Static Field (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The elemental charges the air in a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, raising the hair of creatures in the area on end.

The first time a creature in the area takes lightning damage before the end of the elemental's next turn, each other creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

reaction.name: Arc Flash
entries: When a creature wearing metal armor leaves an area affected by the elemental's Static Field, the elemental can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet toward the field's center and knocked prone.

name: Cracklestep Conduit
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amplify Charge
entries: If the conduit would take any lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Field-Bound Flight
entries: While it is within 40 feet of a solid surface, the conduit has a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

trait.name: Return Path
entries: When the conduit misses with an attack, it is dragged up to 10 feet directly toward the nearest solid surface.
If it ends this movement within 10 feet of the surface, the conduit falls prone and is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The conduit makes four attacks with its Fulgur Arc.

action.name: Fulgur Arc
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d8) lightning damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the conduit.
This attack has advantage if it targets the closest creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon.

action.name: Electroskewer Impalement (Concentration)
entries: A searing bolt spears toward a creature the conduit can see within 30 feet, drawing it into the air.

The target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) lightning damage and begin levitating 10 feet into the air until the end of the conduit's next turn, or until the conduit moves more than 30 feet away from it.
Whenever the levitating creature takes any lightning damage, it takes an additional 11 (2d10) force damage.

action.name: The Sky Alight (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The conduit makes 3 (1d4 + 1) attacks with its Fulgur Arc against each creature within 15 feet of it.

reaction.name: Plasma Flash
entries: When the conduit fails a saving throw to maintain concentration on its Electroskewer Impalement, it can ionize the air around it.
Each other creature within 30 feet that can see the conduit must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

name: Helmed Horror
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The helmed horror can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks, one of which it may replace with a cleaving sweep if available.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Cleaving Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 5 foot radius must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Disarming Swipe
entries: As a reaction to a creature missing it with an attack, the helmed horror may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or drop its weapon and have it flung 15 feet in a random direction.

name: Hezrou
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's stench for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Hill Giant
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Easily Confused
entries: While at least three hostile creatures are within 5 feet of the giant, all attacks against it are made at advantage. While at least two creatures are speaking to the giant, it has disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to detect deception.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hill giant makes two tree trunk attacks. It may replace one tree trunk attack with a use of its brutal shove ability.

action.name: Tree Trunk
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Body Slam
entries: The Hill Giant expends all of its remaining movement and throws itself prone in a 15 foot square centered on a point within 25 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

A creature that is climbing on the giant has disadvantage on the saving throw. A creature that succeeds may use its reaction to move up to ten feet, taking no damage if it ends this movement outside the affected area.

action.name: Brutal Shove (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Up to two creatures within 10 feet of the giant and within 15 feet of each other must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 20 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall prone as a reaction to gain advantage on this save.

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the giant, the giant forces it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone, pushed 10 feet away, and lose concentration if it was holding it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hippocamp can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the hippocamp moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The hippogriff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The hippogriff has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hippogriff's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Vicious Dive
entries: If the hippogriff is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 4 (1d6) damage to the target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hippogriff makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Hoard Form Only)
entries: If the mimic is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the mimic move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the mimic is animate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes one Bite attack and two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the mimic adheres to the target. A creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

action.name: Caustic Mist (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The mimic sprays a fine mist of acid in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 27 (6d8) acid damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

action.name: Shapechanger
entries: The mimic transforms into a hoard or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the scarab is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the scarab move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the scarab is animate.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

bonus.name: Scale Dust (1/Day)
entries: The scarab releases magical glittering dust from its wings. Each creature within 5 feet of the scarab must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in blue light for 10 minutes. While outlined in this way, a creature sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from being invisible. In addition, every Dragon within 1 mile of the creature becomes aware of it and can unerringly track the creature. Casting dispel magic on the creature ends the effect on it.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Coordinated Advance
entries: The hobgoblin acts on initiative count 10, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

action.name: Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 10 () damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hobgoblin makes two greatsword attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the hobgoblin can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a  to its roll provided it can hear and understand the hobgoblin. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the hobgoblin is incapacitated.

trait.name: Battle Magic
entries: The hobgoblin's spells count as three levels higher for the purposes of Counterspell.

trait.name: Coordinated Advance
entries: The hobgoblin acts on initiative count 10, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

action.name: Rain of Fire (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Three bolts of fire flare from the sky, each exploding in a 5 foot radius centered on a point within 90 feet that the hobgoblin can see.

Each flammable object in the area ignites, and each creature not beneath cover in the area of one or more of the explosions must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Irontide (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hobgoblin sends a wave of jagged iron spikes that last for a minute rising from the earth in a 30 foot cone.
The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature moving into or within the area takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage for each 5 feet it travels.
Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) piercing damage and fall prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Battle-Sanctuary (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The hobgoblin surrounds itself in a 30 foot radius sphere of dancing air currents that lasts for an hour. Ranged attacks made from outside the area that target creatures or objects within it are made at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Blunt Spell (2nd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the hobgoblin or an ally within 15 feet of it is forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect of 5th level or below, the hobgoblin halves the damage dealt by the spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hobgoblin is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the hobgoblin is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hobgoblin makes four attacks, each of which can be an unarmed strike or a dart attack. It can also use Shadow Jaunt once, either before or after one of the attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Shadow Jaunt
entries: The hobgoblin magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it is leaving and its destination must be in dim light or darkness.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: While the hobgoblin is within 5 feet of at least two allied creatures, the first attack it hits a creature with each turn deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

trait.name: Coordinated Advance
entries: The hobgoblin acts on initiative count 10, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

trait.name: Target Priority
entries: Whenever the warlord hits a creature with an attack, up to one hobgoblin within 30 feet may use its reaction to make a weapon attack against the same creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warlord makes two attacks with its Flail of Terror and uses its Inexorable Advance.

action.name: Flail of Terror
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage and the target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the target must use all of its movement on its following turn to move directly away from the warlord.

action.name: Inexorable Advance
entries: Each hostile creature within 5 feet of two or more hobgoblins that the warlord can see must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet in a direction of the warlord's choice.

reaction.name: Indomitable Leader
entries: When one or more friendly hobgoblins within 30 feet that the warlord can see fail a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the warlord can cause each of them to reroll their saving throw, taking the higher result.

reaction.name: Bloodied Resolve (1/Day)
entries: When the warlord is reduced below 53 hit points, it can restore 1 hit point to up to three hobgoblins it can see that were reduced to 0 hit points in the last minute.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the hollow dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Reconstruction
entries: When the hollow dragon is reduced to 0 hit points, its body breaks into nine pieces: two arms, two legs, two wings, a tail, a torso, and a head. Each piece is a Large object with AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to psychic and poison damage. After  days, if all pieces are still within 6 miles of each other, they all teleport to the location of the head piece and merge with it, whereupon the hollow dragon regains all its hit points and becomes active again.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hollow dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, and it can use Sapping Presence.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Sapping Presence
entries: Each creature of the hollow dragon's choice within 60 feet of it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this hollow dragon's Sapping Presence for 24 hours.

action.name: Radiant Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hollow dragon exhales radiant flames in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The hollow dragon makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Ghostly Binding (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hollow dragon creates ethereal bindings around a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of the dragon's next turn.

legendary.name: Booming Scales (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from the hollow dragon's frame. Each creature within 10 feet of the hollow dragon must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Hollyphant
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hollyphant's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

1e: shapechange (into a golden-furred mammoth with feathered wings and a flying speed of 120 ft.)

trait.name: Aura of Invulnerability
entries: An invisible aura forms a 10-foot-radius sphere around the hollyphant for as long as it lives. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it, even if the spell is cast using a higher level spell slot. Such a spell can target creatures and objects within the barrier, but the spell has no effect on them. Similarly, the area within the barrier is excluded from the areas affected by such spells. The hollyphant can use an action to suppress this trait until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The hollyphant's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Trumpet (3/Day)
entries: The hollyphant blows air through its trunk, creating a trumpet sound that can be heard out to a range of 600 feet. The trumpet also creates a 30-foot cone of energy that has one of the following effects, chosen by the hollyphant:

action.name: Trumpet of Blasting
entries: Each creature in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 (5d6) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't deafened. Nonmagical objects in the cone that aren't being held or worn take 35 (10d6) thunder damage.

action.name: Trumpet of Sparkles
entries: Creatures in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d8 + 4) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Evil creatures have disadvantage on the saving throw. Good creatures in the cone take no damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The tortoise can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Massive Frame
entries: The tortoise can carry up to 20000 pounds of weight atop its shell, but moves at half speed if the weight exceeds 10000 pounds. Medium or smaller creatures can move underneath the tortoise while it's not prone.
Any creature under the tortoise when it falls prone is grappled (escape DC 18). Until the grapple ends, the creature is prone and restrained.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shell Defense (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The tortoise withdraws into its shell, falls prone, and gains a +5 bonus to AC. While the tortoise is in its shell, its speed is 0 and can't increase. The tortoise can emerge from its shell as an action, whereupon it is no longer prone.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The frog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The frog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the frog can't bite another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The frog makes one bite attack against a Small or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

name: Howler
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The Howler has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Howler has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Howler's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Quill Defense
entries: Any creature that strikes a howler with a non-reach melee weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon takes 1d4 points of piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The howler makes two attacks with its rending bite.

action.name: Rending Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage if the target is frightened. This attack ignores damage resistance.

action.name: Cursed Quills
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC16 Dexterity save or a cursed quill breaks off in its flesh, causing the target to subtract 1d4 from the result whenever it makes an attack or save. The quills may be removed as an action with a successful DC 16 medicine check, or by taking an additional 1d6 damage per quill removed.

action.name: Mind-Breaking Howl (Recharge 6)
entries: The howler emits a keening howl in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area that isn't deafened must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the howler's next turn. While a creature is frightened in this way, its speed is halved, and it is incapacitated. A target that successfully saves is immune to the Mind-Breaking Howl of all howlers for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Present Quills
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the howler may make an attack with its cursed quills.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: As an action, it can make two attacks with its pseudopods.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) acid damage, or 42 (12d6) acid damage while the ooze is enlarged. If the target is wearing nonmagical metal armor, its armor is partly corroded and takes a permanent and cumulative âˆ’1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

action.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the ooze magically increases in size. While enlarged, the ooze is Gargantuan, doubles its damage dice with its pseudopod attack, and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage.

action.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The ooze magically turns invisible for up to 1 hour until it attacks, it uses its Enlarge, or its concentration is broken (as if concentrating on a spell).

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Corrode Metal
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the ooze corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative âˆ’1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to âˆ’5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the ooze is destroyed after dealing damage.
The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

name: Stone Titan
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The hecatoncheires can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

trait.name: Vigilant
entries: The hecatoncheires can't be surprised.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hecatoncheires makes four longsword attacks or two rock attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Deflect Attack
entries: The hecatoncheires adds 5 to its AC against one weapon attack that would hit it. To do so, the giant must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The shark can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Hutijin, Right Hand of the Eighth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Hutijin's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 22). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
will: alter self (can become Medium when changing his appearance)

trait.name: Infernal Despair
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of Hutijin that isn't a devil makes saving throws with disadvantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Hutijin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Hutijin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Hutijin's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Hutijin regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Hutijin dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hutijin makes four attacks: one with his bite, one with his claw, one with his mace, and one with his tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points, and it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Mace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: Hutijin magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

reaction.name: Fearful Voice (Recharge 5-6)
entries: In response to taking damage, Hutijin utters a dreadful word of power. Each creature within 30 feet of him that isn't a devil must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of him for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that saves against this effect is immune to Hutijin's Fearful Voice for 24 hours.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Hutijin attacks once with his mace.

legendary.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Hutijin releases lightning in a 20-foot radius. All other creatures in that area must each make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Hutijin uses his Teleport action.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

name: Hydroloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hydroloth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hydroloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Adaptive Combat
entries: The hydroloth treats its AC as 20 against attacks made by creatures affected by its Steal Memories.

trait.name: Secure Memory
entries: The hydroloth is immune to the waters of the River Styx as well as any effect that would steal or modify its memories or detect or read its thoughts.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A yugoloth will usually accept a rate of its challenge rating times 25 gp.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydroloth attacks twice with its claws and uses its Steal Memories, if available. It may replace either or both of its claw attacks with its Deepest Fears or Teleport abilities.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and 14 (4d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Deepest Fears
entries: One creature affected by the hydroloth's Steal Memories has a manifestation of its deepest fears appear to it for the next minute. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and be frightened for the duration. A creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 14 (4d6) psychic damage on a failure.

action.name: Steal Memories (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the hydroloth can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by 1 until it completes a long rest. A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way can't speak or cast spells.

action.name: Teleport (3rd level spell)
entries: The hydroloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Shared Mind
entries: As a reaction to failing an Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw, the hydroloth may force a creature within 60 feet that is affected by its Steal Memory to succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or suffer the triggering saving throw's effects as well.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The hyena has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hyena's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

name: Medusa, Queen of Gorgons

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Medusa's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18). She can innately cast animate objects once per day requiring no material components.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Medusa fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see Medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of her, Medusa can force it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw if she isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, on a failed save the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If Medusa sees herself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of her and in an area of bright light, she is affected by her own gaze.

trait.name: Shed Skin (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Medusa is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she sheds her skin, regains 199 hit points, and moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Medusa makes three attacks: one with her claws, one to constrict, and one with her snaky hair.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and Medusa can't constrict another target.

action.name: Snaky Hair
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and Medusa can pull the target up to 5 feet closer to her if it is a Large or smaller creature.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Medusa moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Snaky Hair
entries: Medusa makes one attack with her snaky hair.

legendary.name: Petrified Earth (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Medusa causes stone spikes to erupt from the ground in a 30-foot radius centered on her. The area becomes difficult terrain until the start of her next turn. Any creature, other than Medusa, takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage for every 5 feet it moves on those spikes.

mythicHeader: If Medusa's mythic trait is active, she can use the options below as legendary actions for 1 hour after using Shed Skin.

mythic.name: Numbing Claws
entries: Medusa makes two attacks with her claws. If both attacks hit the same creature, it takes an extra 7 (2d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed until the start of her next turn.

mythic.name: Look at Me (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Medusa can force a sighted creature she has grappled to see her eyes and be affected by her gaze.

trait.name: Chip Away
entries: The mephit is encased in a brittle icy shell. When the mephit is reduced below its maximum hit points, its AC is reduced by 4.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of ice. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 9 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (3d4) cold damage and have its movement speed reduced by 20 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Chilling Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) cold damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn. A creature whose movement speed is reduced to 0 in this way must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Encase in Frost (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 9 Strength saving throw or gain 5 (2d4) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, the creature has vulnerability to fire damage and is restrained.

reaction.name: Icy Gust
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting the mephit with a melee attack, the mephit may make a melee attack against the attacker. If the attack hits, the creature is pushed back 5 feet.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ice piercer remains motionless on the ceiling, it is indistinguishable from a normal stalactite.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ice piercer can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Drop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, one creature directly underneath the piercer. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage. Miss: The piercer takes half the normal falling damage for the distance fallen.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Sapping Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
For the next minute, whenever the target takes any cold damage it takes 4 (1d8 additional cold damage.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Frostsilk Globule
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) cold damage and the globule sticks to the target (remove DC 13).
For each such globule stuck to it, a creature's movement speed is reduced by 10 and it takes 1 cold damage at the beginning of each of its turns.
If the creature takes any fire damage, each globule stuck to it melts away.

bonus.name: Cold Shock (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature grappled by the spider must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 4 (1d8) cold damage per frostweb globule stuck to it.
A creature that takes 10 or more cold damage in this way is additionally paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Cold Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the spider takes 5 (2d4) cold damage.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

action.name: Icy Web (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing, and takes 2 (1d4) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air or water.

trait.name: Cold Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the toad takes 3 (1d6) cold damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) cold damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature it is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the toad can't bite another target.

trait.name: Freezing Flesh
entries: A creature not resistant or immune to cold damage that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ice troll has its movement speed reduced by 10 until the beginning of its next turn.
If the ice troll starts its turn in water, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 15) as a mass of clinging ice forms around it.

trait.name: Brittle Joints
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage, one of its limbs breaks off, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two frostbite claw attacks, one of which it may replace with its bite or Cryoheal, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

action.name: Frostbite Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage and the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the troll's next turn.

action.name: Cryoheal (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The troll packs its wounds with nearby snow, ice, or water, which freezes into a semblance of its flesh. The troll regains 30 hit points, may reattach one of its lost limbs, and gains vulnerability to fire damage until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Rimestrike Retaliation
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack the troll makes an attack with its Frostbite Claw against the attacker. If the attack hits, the target is knocked prone.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +0 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d6 - 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The illusionist is a 7th-level spellcaster. its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The illusionist has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Displacement (Recharges after the Illusionist Casts an Illusion Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
entries: As a bonus action, the illusionist projects an illusion that makes the illusionist appear to be standing in a place a few inches from its actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against the illusionist. The effect ends if the illusionist takes damage, it is incapacitated, or its speed becomes 0.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

name: Incubus
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The fiend ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The fiend can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, the fiend loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Claw (Fiend Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Charm
entries: One humanoid the fiend can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for the next 24 hours.
The fiend can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

action.name: Draining Kiss
entries: The fiend kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The fiend magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 1 poison damage.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The hook horror can't use its blindsight while deafened.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The hook horror has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

name: Intellect Devourer
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Mindsense
entries: The intellect devourer is aware of the presence of creatures within 300 feet of it that have an Intelligence of 3 or higher. It knows the relative distance and direction of each creature, regardless of physical barriers. Creatures under the effects of magic that protects the mind cannot be detected by the intellect devourer.

trait.name: Exposed Brain
entries: The intellect devourer has a telepathic field that grants it resistace to all damage but psychic, which it must concentrate on as though concentrating on a spell. If it loses concentration, until the beginning of its next turn it loses its damage resistances and gains vulnerability to all damage but psychic.

action.name: Trepanation Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 21 (6d6) damage to an incapacitated target and bores a small hole in its skull.

action.name: Rend Mind
entries: The intellect devourer chooses one creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher The target must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its Intelligence score reduced to 0 and is stunned. The target may repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Displace Brain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target with a hole in its skull. Hit: The creature is grappled (escape DC 13) and blinded as the intellect devourer latches onto it. If the intellect devourer begins its turn grappling a creature in this way, it forces its way into the creature's skull, consumes and displaces the creature's brain, and takes full control of its body.

While inside the creature's skull, the intellect devourer has total cover against attacks and other effects outside of the host. The intellect devourer retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as its comprehension of language, its telepathy, and its traits. Otherwise, it inherits the target's statistics, memories and knowledge, including spells and languages. If the host body drops to 0 hit points, the intellect devourer must leave the host. It can also be magically forced from the host's body by means of a protection from evil and good spell being cast on the host.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, the intellect devourer may move up to half its speed. If it ends this movement outside the effect's area, range, or line-of-sight, the intellect devourer takes no damage.

name: Iron Cobra
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The iron cobra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer one random poison effect:
1. Poison Damage: The target takes 13 (3d8) poison damage.

2. Confusion: On its next turn, the target must use its action to make one weapon attack against a random creature it can see within 30 feet of it, using whatever weapon it has in hand and moving beforehand if necessary to get in range. If it's holding no weapon, it makes an unarmed strike. If no creature is visible within 30 feet, it takes the Dash action, moving toward the nearest creature.
3. Paralysis: The target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

name: Iron Defender
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The defender has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the defender is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take an extra 3 (1d6) piercing damage and be grappled (escape DC 13). The defender can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

name: Royal Incinerator
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands The Languages Of Its Creator but rarely speaks

trait.name: Battle Scars
entries: If the royal incinerator is killed by a creature before finishing its mission, when the royal incinerator comes back to life it gains a +2 bonus to AC, saving throws, attack rolls, and damage rolls.  This effect stacks with each death until the mission is completed.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The royal incinerator has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track its prey, and damage it deals ignores resistances.

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the royal incinerator is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The royal incinerator can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The royal incinerator's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Unfaltering
entries: The royal incinerator is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form or force it to act against its mission, and isn't affected by enchantment or illusion spells.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: As long as its brazier is lit, a destroyed royal incinerator gains a new body in 1d4 days, regaining all hit points and becoming active again.  The new body appears within 5 feet of the brazier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The royal incinerator makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Impale
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be restrained by the blade and take 10 (3d6) fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

The royal incinerator can only use Slam attacks while a creature is impaled until it summons its sword back to itself as a bonus action, freeing the impaled target.  The target, or another creature within 5 feet of them, can use an action to remove the sword and free themselves.

action.name: Cleansing Fire (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The royal incinerator exhales fire in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide.  Each creature in that line must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (14d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

trait.name: Acidic Blood
entries: When the hydra takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of the hydra takes 9 (2d8) acid damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious. Whenever the hydra takes 35 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Barbed Tail
entries: When a creature provokes an opportunity attack from the ixitxachitl, the ixitxachitl can make the following attack instead of using its bite.
Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Confusing Burble
entries: The jabberwocky burbles to itself unless it is incapacitated. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the jabberwocky and is able to hear its burbling must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn, and it rolls a  to determine what it does during its current turn:

items.entry: The creature does nothing.
The creature does nothing except use all its movement to move in a random direction.
The creature either makes one melee attack against a random creature it can see or does nothing if no visible creature is within its reach.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the jabberwocky fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The jabberwocky regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the jabberwocky takes slashing damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The jabberwocky dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Uncanny Tracker
entries: The jabberwocky can unerringly track any creature it has wounded in the last 24 hours, and it knows the distance and direction to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jabberwocky makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fiery Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Unless it is blinded, the jabberwocky emits a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of fire from its eyes. Each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The jabberwocky makes one Tail attack.

legendary.name: Rend Attack (2 Actions)
entries: The jabberwocky makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (3 Actions)
entries: The jabberwocky beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the jabberwock must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The jackal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The jackal has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackal's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The jaculi has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The jaculi has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Spring
entries: The jaculi springs up to 30 feet in a straight line and makes a bite attack against a target within its reach. This attack has advantage if the jaculi springs at least 10 feet. If the attack hits, the bite deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

name: Jiangshi
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak them

trait.name: Jiangshi Weaknesses
entries: The jiangshi has the following flaws:

items.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that is holding its breath may attempt to hide from the jiangshi without being obsucred.

items.name: Fear of Mirrors
entries: The jiangshi must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn if its sees its reflection.

items.name: Pinned Talisman
entries: If a holy talisman is affixed to the jiangshi's forehead with a successful DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, the jiangshi must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed until the seal is removed or it takes damage.

items.name: Flammable
entries: If the jiangshi takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the jiangshi takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of the jiangshi's turns, and its attacks deal an additional 4 (1d8) fire damage.

trait.name: Hopping Movement
entries: The jiangshi is always facing a single direction, and must spend 5 feet of movement to change its facing. Additionally, it may spend 5 ft. of movement to stand from prone. The jiangshi's reach extends only in the direction it is facing.

trait.name: Graceless
entries: If the jiangshi is struck with a melee attack from a direction it is not facing, it is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jiangshi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jiangshi makes three attacks, one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claw Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. in the direction it is facing, one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the jiangshi adds one of the following effects:
The target is grappled.
The target is pushed 10 ft. away.
The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Ki Draining Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone, grappled, or incapacitated creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure the target is forced to expend two hit dice, or drop to 0 HP if it cannot, and the jiangshi gains 17 (5d6) temporary hit points.
While it has these temporary hit points, the jiangshi has 20 AC, advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and a speed of 60 ft.

reaction.name: Whip Around
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack by a creature it is not facing, the jiangshi turns to face it and makes a claw attack.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Juiblex can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Corrosive Horror
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 20 ft. of Juiblex has the attack bonus of any metal or organic nonartifact weapons it is wielding and the AC bonus of any metal or organic nonartifact armor it is wearing reduced by a permanent and cumulative 1.

trait.name: Heart of Chaos
entries: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by a creature grappled by Juiblex bypasses its resistances, and scores a critical on a 16-20.

trait.name: Alter Form
entries: At the end of each of its turns, Juiblex chooses a shape for its body. Its new form may be centered on any space its previous form occupied:

items.name: Fetid Pool
entries: Juiblex becomes a 30 ft. by 30 ft. shallow pool of slime that can enter and occupy the space of any other creature. A creature that starts its turn in Juiblex's space takes 9 (2d8) acid damage. Any creatures engulfed or grappled by Juiblex are freed.

items.name: Flowing Prison
entries: Juiblex becomes a 15 ft. by 15 ft. vortex centered on a creature in its space or grappled by it. Each creature in Juiblex's new space must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be engulfed and grappled (escape DC 22) in Juiblex's space, or pushed into the nearest adjacent space on a success. While in this form, a creature grappled by Juiblex can't speak or breathe, and takes 18 (4d8) acid damage at the start of each of Juiblex's turns.

items.name: Towering Slime
entries: Juiblex becomes a 10 ft. by 10 ft. tower that is up to 40 ft. tall. Melee attacks it makes deal an additional 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Juiblex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Juiblex fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Juiblex makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Corrosive Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning plus 27 (6d8) acid damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be pulled 5 ft. toward Juiblex's center, or be grappled (escape DC 22) if it cannot.

action.name: Heaving Mass
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Caustic Jet (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Juiblex expels a jet of slime in a 90 ft. long, 10 ft. wide line. Each creature in the area is pushed 15 ft. away and must succeed  on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 95 (10d8 + 50) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Blinding Excretion
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, Juiblex forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of Juiblex's next turn.

reaction.name: Birth Scion
entries: As a reaction to taking 50 or more damage in a turn, Juiblex creates an ooze scion that acts on its turn in the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Foul Spawning (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 304 hit points, Juiblex creates six ooze scions that act on its turn in the nearest unoccupied spaces.

legendary.name: Assimilate
entries: Each creature grappled by Juiblex must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw or have its Proficiency Bonus reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest. Juiblex learns one secret the creature wishes to keep hidden. If the creature was an ooze, it dies and Juiblex gains temporary hit points equal to the creature's maximum hit points.

legendary.name: Seething Vitriol
entries: Juiblex takes 11 (1d20) fire damage and rolls to recharge its Caustic Jet.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Juiblex casts a spell of 6th level or below with a casting time of 1 action known by a creature affected by its Assimilate.

legendary.name: Wheels Within Wheels (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: If Juiblex has not taken a turn this round, it takes its turn. If it does, it cannot take actions or reactions for the rest of the round, and its Caustic Jet cannot recharge this round.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The hook horror can't use its blindsight while deafened.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The hook horror has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hook horror makes two hook attacks.

action.name: Hook
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Juvenile Kraken
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kraken can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Freedom of Movement
entries: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes two tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of Fling.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. One Medium or two smaller creatures can be swallowed at the same time.

If the kraken takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Lightning Strike
entries: The kraken magically create a bolt of lightning, which can strike a target the kraken can see within 90 feet of it. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Tentacle Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The kraken makes one tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Fling
entries: The kraken uses Fling.

legendary.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 40-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The mimic can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.

action.name: Shape-Shift
