entries: The mimic polymorphs into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Dual Mind
entries: The kalashtar has advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Mind Thrust
entries: The kalashtar targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kelpie can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Seaweed Shape
entries: The kelpie can use its action to reshape its body into the form of a humanoid or beast that is Small, Medium, or Large. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged. The disguise is convincing, unless the kelpie is in bright light or the viewer is within 30 feet of it, in which case the seams between the seaweed strands are visible. The kelpie returns to its true form if takes a bonus action to do so or if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the kelpie remains motionless in its true form, it is indistinguishable from normal seaweed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kelpie makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

action.name: Drowning Hypnosis
entries: The kelpie chooses one humanoid it can see within 150 feet of it. If the target can see the kelpie, the target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed while the kelpie maintains concentration, up to 10 minutes (as if concentrating on a spell). The charmed target is incapacitated, and instead of holding its breath underwater, it tries to breathe normally and immediately runs out of breath, unless it can breathe water. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the kelpie, the target must move on its turn toward the kelpie by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks.

Before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the kelpie or drowning, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this kelpie's hypnosis for the next 24 hours.

name: Kenku
languages: understands Auran and Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the kenku has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Flock Tactics
entries: While adjacent to two or more kenku, a creature has disadvantage on attacks that target one of them.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Hoopak
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage if the kender used the hoopak's sling to make a ranged attack.

action.name: Taunt
entries: The kender launches a barrage of insults at a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. If the target can hear the kender, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Elusive
entries: The kender takes the Disengage or Hide action.

trait.name: Iron Scent
entries: The khargra can scent the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and if the target is wearing metal armor or carrying a metal shield, the khargra attaches to that armor or shield. While attached, the khargra doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the khargra's turns, roll a . On a 10 or higher, the armor or shield takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed.
The khargra can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the khargra.

action.name: Earth Phasing
entries: Until the end of its next turn, the khargra can fly through nonmagical earth and stone. While doing so, it doesn't disturb the material it moves through. It can end its movement within earth or stone, but if it remains within earth or stone when this ability ends, it takes 14 (4d6) force damage and immediately moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Opportunistic Hunger
entries: When a creature the khargra can see within 5 feet of it hits it with a metal weapon, the khargra can make a bite attack against that creature.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The orca can't use its blindsight while deafened.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The orca can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The orca has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The kindori doesn't require food, drink, or air.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Flashing Eyes (Recharge 6)
entries: The kindori emits bright light in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The trout can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Flimsy Bravado
entries: If the kobold misses a creature with an attack, its speed increases by 15 feet until the end of its turn, and attacks of opportunity are made against it at disadvantage.

action.name: Cutpurse Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or have an item that is worn or carried, but not wielded, stolen.

action.name: Sling
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The kobold is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following sorcerer spells prepared:

trait.name: Sorcery Points
entries: The kobold has 3 sorcery points. It regains all its spent sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend its sorcery points on the following options:

Heightened Spell: When it casts a spell that forces a creature to a saving throw to resist the spell's effects, the kobold can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw against the spell.
Subtle Spell: When the kobold casts a spell, it can spend 1 sorcery point to cast the spell without any somatic or verbal components.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature it at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the prawn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The prawn can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

name: Korred
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The korred's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

1e: conjure elemental (as 6th-level spell; galeb duhr, gargoyle, earth elemental, or xorn only)

trait.name: Command Hair
entries: The korred has at least one 50-foot-long rope woven out of its hair. As a bonus action, the korred commands one such rope within 30 feet of it to move up to 20 feet and entangle a Large or smaller creature that the korred can see. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or become grappled by the rope (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends. the target is restrained. The korred can use a bonus action to release the target, which is also freed if the korred dies or becomes incapacitated.

A rope of korred hair has AC 20 and 20 hit points. It regains 1 hit point at the start of each of the korred's turns while it has at least 1 hit point and the korred is alive. If the rope drops to 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The korred has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Stone's Strength
entries: While on the ground, the korred deals 2 extra dice of damage with any weapon attack (included in its attacks).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The korred makes two attacks with its greatclub or hurls two rocks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage if the korred is on the ground.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage if the korred is on the ground.

name: Kraken Priest
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The priest can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Brinewarded
entries: Aquatic creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or less are indifferent to the priest.

trait.name: Kraken Host (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the priest is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 90 hit points and explosively sprouts eight bloody tentacles from its back, becoming size Large and gaining a climb speed equal to its movement speed.

action.name: Thunderous Touch (3rd level spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d10) thunder damage and the target is pushed 15 ft. away. A creature pushed into a wood or plaster wall less than a foot thick is pushed through the wall.

action.name: Whelm (2nd level spell)
entries: A wave of water crashes out from the priest. Each creature in a 30 ft. long, 10 ft. wide line must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Call The Storm (3rd Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The priest chooses three points within 60 ft. Each creature within 5 ft. of one or more of those points must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Briny Dissolution
entries: The priest dissolves into a puddle of water, reforming at a location it can see within 20 ft.

legendary.name: Voice of Eons
entries: The priest telepathic utters a thunderous imprecation. One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is knocked prone, additionally.

mythic.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

mythic.name: Fling
entries: One grappled creature is flung up to 30 ft. and knocked prone. If the creature hits a solid surface, it takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 2 1/2-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Gnashing Horde
entries: Any non-kruthik creature that starts its turn adjacent to one or more kruthiks takes 1 piercing damage per adjacent kruthik.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kruthik makes two stab attacks or two spike attacks.

action.name: Stab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Spike
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) poison damage and the target's movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Agitate The Swarm
entries: For the next turn, the gnashing horde ability of kruthiks within 60 feet deals an additional 1d4 piercing damage per adjacent kruthik.

action.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The kruthik sprays acid in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Otherworldly Perception
entries: The kuo-toa can sense the presence of any creature within 30 feet of it that is invisible or on the Ethereal Plane. It can pinpoint such a creature that is moving.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The kuo-toa has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Net
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The target is restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature in a net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

reaction.name: Sticky Shield
entries: When a creature misses the kuo-toa with a melee weapon attack, the kuo-toa uses its sticky shield to catch the weapon. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw, or the weapon becomes stuck to the kuo-toa's shield. If the weapon's wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is grappled while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. A creature can pull the weapon free by taking an action to make a DC 11 Strength check and succeeding.

action.name: Unarmed Strike

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lamia's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lamia makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its dagger or Intoxicating Touch.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Dagger

action.name: Intoxicating Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is magically cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all ability checks.

name: Larva
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The leonin's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the leonin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's incapacitated.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the leonin is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leonin makes three weapon attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The leucrotta can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the leucrotta reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the leucrotta can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Hit-and-Run
entries: If the leucrotta ends its turn more than 30 ft. from any hostile creature, it may take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leucrotta makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its hooves.

action.name: Jagged Steel Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer a bleeding wound. At the beginning of each of its turns, a bleeding creature loses 2 (1d4) hit points, then repeats this saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the creature can't make attacks of opportunity this turn.

reaction.name: Disquieting Cackle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the leucrotta moves up to 20 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the leucrotta this turn.

name: Leviathan
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Partial Freeze
entries: If the leviathan takes cold damage, the leviathan partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, its speeds are reduced by 20 feet and its normally invisible vital organs are revealed. Attacks made from inside the leviathan against it have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures (included in Tidal Wave).

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The leviathan can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Slow to Wrath
entries: When the Leviathan is reduced below 100 HP, it gains a fourth legendary action and immediately regains all spent actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leviathan makes two attacks: one with its whelming slam and one with either its evoke essence, brine, or tidal wave abilities, if available.

action.name: Whelming Slam
entries: Creatures in a 20 foot radius within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (1d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be grappled in the leviathan's space (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is unable to breathe unless it can breathe water and moves with the leviathan. If the leviathan moved at least 100 feet before using this ability, it deals an additional 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Evoke Essence
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the leveiathan must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have their lungs fill with water. If the creature cannot breathe water, it cannot speak or breathe and begins to drown. A creature may take its action to cough and retch up water, ending the effect.

action.name: Brine (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature that is drowning must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have the water ripped from its lungs, taking  36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is forced to expend 1d4 unexpended hit dice. If it cannot, the creature drops to 0 HP.

action.name: Tidal Wave (Recharge 6)
entries: While submerged, the leviathan magically creates a wall of water centered on itself. The wall is up 250 feet long, up to 250 feet high, and up to 50 feet thick. When the wall appears, all other creatures within its area must each make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. A creature takes 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage and is pushed 50 feet away on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The leviathan may affect creatures inside of it with this ability.

legendary.name: Undertow
entries: One creatue within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 60 feet toward and into the leviathan, grappled and restrained per its Whelming Slam ability. The leviathan then rolls to recharge its Tidal Wave, if applicable.

legendary.name: Waterspout
entries: One creature within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be launched 60 feet into the air by a watery tornado. It remains there until the end of its next turn, when it drops.

legendary.name: Jet Breath (Costs 2 Actions.)
entries: The Leviathan spews a line of seawater 10 feet wide and 120 feet long. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet away. The leviathan may choose to eject a creature that is inside of it with this ability, launching it up to 60 feet away.

legendary.name: Wash Away (Costs 4 Actions)
entries: The leviathan creates an enormous 100 foot radius whirlpool that lasts for a minute. Each creature that starts its turn in the whirlpool has one spell or magical effect of its choice dispelled, and must make a strength saving throw or be drawn 30 feet towards the whirlpool's center. Creatures in the leviathan are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Light Absorption
entries: If the light devourer spends any part of its turn in an area of bright light or is subjected to radiant damage, it radiates dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 hour.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The light devourer can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The light devourer makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage, or radiant damage if the light devourer is radiating light (see Light Absorption).

bonus.name: Radiant Discharge
entries: If the light devourer is radiating light (see Light Absorption), it releases the light stored in its body in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself, then ceases to radiate light. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) radiant damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Lightning Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a . On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

trait.name: Stalking Pounce
entries: If the lion is hidden from each hostile creature, it may Dash as a Bonus Action. If the lion hits a creature with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The lion may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a prone target.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Daunting Roar (1/Day)
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lion lets out a menacing roar. Each hostile creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the lion until the end of the lion's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Blood-Chilling Roar (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The liondrake lets out a terrifying roar audible out to 300 feet. Any creature within 30 feet of the liondrake that can hear its roar must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the liondrake for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is also paralyzed for the same duration. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this liondrake's Blood-Chilling Roar for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Cold Blooded

trait.name: Feral Bite

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Rend the Field (Recharge 5-6)

action.name: Multiattack

reaction.name: Shield Block

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Lizardfolk Form Only)
headerEntries: The lizardfolk is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The lizardfolk has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack (Lizardfolk Form Only)
entries: The lizardfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage in crocodile form. If the lizardfolk is in crocodile form and the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lizardfolk can't bite another target. If the lizardfolk reverts to its true form, the grapple ends.

action.name: Claws (Lizardfolk Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Change Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The lizardfolk magically polymorphs into a crocodile, remaining in that form for up to 1 hour. It can revert to its true form as a bonus action. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Leviathan Will
entries: The locathah has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or put to sleep.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The locathah can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The locathah makes two melee attacks with its spear.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands.

walk.condition: (40 ft. in hybrid form, 50 ft. in dire wolf form)

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The loup garou has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: When the loup garou fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The loup garou regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the loup garou takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of the loup garou's next turn. The loup garou dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The loup garou makes two attacks: two with its Longsword (humanoid form) or one with its Bite and one with its Claws (dire wolf or hybrid form).

action.name: Bite (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with loup garou lycanthropy.

action.name: Claws (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Longsword (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The loup garou polymorphs into a Large wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a Large dire wolf, or back into its true form, which appears humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

legendary.name: Swipe
entries: The loup garou makes one Claws attack (dire wolf or hybrid form only) or one Longsword attack (humanoid form only).

legendary.name: Mauling Pounce (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The loup garou moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, and it can make one Claws attack (dire wolf or hybrid form only) or one Longsword attack (humanoid form only) against each creature it moves past.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The loup garou changes into hybrid or dire wolf form and then makes one Bite attack.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The dragon doesn't require air.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

action.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales a blast of frost in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 13 (3d8) cold damage, and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Phase (2/Day)
entries: The dragon becomes partially incorporeal for as long as it maintains concentration on the effect (as if concentrating on a spell). While partially incorporeal, the dragon has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The macaw can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The mage has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Sense
entries: The hunter knows the location of every spellcaster, active spell, and magic item within 120 feet of itself.

trait.name: Spider Climb (Hunter Form Only)
entries: The hunter can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack (Hunter Form Only)
entries: The hunter makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw (Hunter Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the hunter can't make a Tail attack against another target.

action.name: Mage Tracker (Sentry Form Only)
entries: The hunter emits a pulse of energy that helps it better locate its magical quarry. Each creature within 120 feet of the hunter that has the ability to cast spells must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be mystically marked by the hunter for 1 hour.

While marked, a creature can't become hidden from the hunter and gains no benefit from the invisible condition against the hunter. Additionally, while a marked creature is on the same plane of existence as the hunter, the hunter always knows the distance and direction to the creature.

bonus.name: Shift Form
entries: The hunter folds into its drone-like sentry form or unfolds into its hunter form. Its game statistics are the same in each form.

reaction.name: Consume and Destroy
entries: When the hunter takes damage from a spell, it takes only half the triggering damage (rounded down). If the creature that cast the spell is within 60 feet of the hunter, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take the other half of the damage.

trait.name: Molten Body
entries: If the mephit takes 10 or more cold damage from a single source, it is petrified.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of magma. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) fire damage and have molten rock splashed on it. Until it or another creature takes an action to clear the rock, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Magma Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and 3 (1d6) fire damage. The target must then succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Molten Fissure (Recharge 6)
entries: A 15 ft. long, 5 ft. wide, 5 ft. deep fissure originating from the mephit opens in the earth. Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall in, taking 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and falling prone. For the next minute, a creature that starts its turn in the fissure takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

reaction.name: Melt Weapon
entries: As a reaction to being hit with nonmagical melee weapon attack, the mephit melts and warps the weapon. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

trait.name: Extraordinary Leap
entries: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to jump 3 feet.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

action.name: Sticky Leg
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. Hit: The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

name: Mammoth
resist: piercing damage from nonmagical ranged attacks

trait.name: Trample
entries: If the mammoth first moves at least 20 feet on its turn, it may make a stomp attack against a prone creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Spear Maddened
entries: Weapon attacks against the mammoth with the Reach property are made at advantage. Whenever the mammoth takes damage from a spear, glaive, pike, or similar long, bladed weapon, it must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the mammoth attacks the nearest creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
entries: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or three with its tail spikes.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Spike
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Attractive Pollen (1/Day)
entries: When the mantrap detects any creatures nearby, it can use its reaction to release pollen out to a radius of 30 feet. Any beast or humanoid within the area must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the the mantrap as possible. An affected target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mantrap remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary tropical plant.

action.name: Engulf
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is trapped inside the mantrap's leafy jaws. While trapped in this way, the target is blinded and restrained, has total cover from an attacks and other effects outside the mantrap, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the target's turns. If the mantrap dies, the creature inside it is no longer restrained by it. A mantrap can engulf only one creature at a time.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the adept is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The adept makes three unarmed strikes or three dart attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the adept can choose one of the following additional effects:

items: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding (adept's choice).
The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the adept's next turn.

action.name: Dart
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Deflect Missile
entries: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the adept deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by . If the damage is reduced to 0, the adept catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the adept has a hand free.

trait.name: Like Water
entries: The marid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attack rolls made against it are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Violent Tide
entries: Whenever a creature is pushed into a solid object or surface by a spell or ability the marid controls, it takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marid makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Tidal Stride.

action.name: Leiptre-Bronze Trident
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Tidal Stride (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The marid teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet, arriving in a splash of brine. Each creature within 5 feet of it after it teleports must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

On a critical hit, each other creature of the marid's choice within 15 feet of the target takes half as much damage.

action.name: Borewater Bolt (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the marid's choice.

action.name: Omenspray (4th Level Spell)
entries: The marid scatters a spray of mirror-bright frost in a 15-foot cone, each flake reflecting misfortune. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) cold damage and has disadvatange on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Dilute (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the marid can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the marid can force it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, any damage dealt by the spell is halved.

trait.name: Cleansing Surge (2/Day)
entries: At the start of each of the marid's turns, it can end one spell or condition affecting it, or regain 20 hit points. If it does so, each other creature within 15 feet of it regains 20 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marid makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Shorebreaker Slam, Jet Cutter, or Winding Wave.

action.name: Borewater Bolt (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the marid's choice.

action.name: Shorebreaker Slam (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The marid touches a creature within 5 feet of it and forces it to make a DC 18 Strength saivng throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) cold damage and is pushed 5 feet for each point it failed by, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Jet Cutter (4th Level Spell)
entries: The marid slices through the air with a thin line of water, forcing a creature it can see within 60 feet to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (4d8) cold damage plus 18 (4d8) slashing damage.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is bisected, killing it instantly.

action.name: Glimmershoal (7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A tempest of swirling light and illusory images swells into being, swarming in a 60-foot radius sphere within 300 feet. Whenever a creature targets somehting in the area with an attack or harmful spell, the marid can force it to make a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage and the creature's target is unaffected by its attack or harmful spell. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Treasure-Pearl Seal (1/Day, 8th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: An opaque pearlescent sphere clamps shut arund a creature the marid can see within 60 feet, restraining it (escape DC 18) within and granting it full cover against outside effects.

At the end of each of its turns, the target's size descreases by one category. If this would reduce the creature's size below Tiny, it remains trapped in stasis within the pearl until the effect is dispelled. Reduction to size caused by this effect can be reversed with the Greater Restoration spell or similar magic.

reaction.name: Dilute (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the marid can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the marid can force it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, any damage dealt by the spell is halved.

reaction.name: Brightwater Lens
entries: When the marid is missed by a spell attack roll, it can choose a new target for the attack, making a new spell attack roll with its own modifier (+10).

entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +13 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the marid's choice.

action.name: Shorebreaker Slam (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The marid touches a creature within 5 feet of it and forces it to make a DC 21 Strength saivng throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) cold damage and is pushed 5 feet for each point it failed by, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Pressure Spike (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The marid forces a creature it can see within 60 feet to make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (5d8) thunder damage and is dazed until the end of the marid's next turn.
While a creature is dazed in this way, it has vulnerability to thunder damage.

action.name: Reefbloom (6th Level Spell)
entries: A matrix of jagged, razor-sharp coral sprouts forth in a 30-foot sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. The area is considered difficult terrain and has the following effects:

items: Creatures in the area have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 4 (1d8) slashing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Open the Seagates (8th Level Spell)
entries: Water crashes into being, filling a 120-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 500 feet for 1 hour. Each creature in the area when the water appears without a swimming speed is pushed up to 30 feet in a direction of the marid's choice and is dazed until the end of the marid's next turn.

action.name: Leviathan Tide (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: Dark water and thrashing horrors from the deep crest forth in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) cold damage plus 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is pushed up to 60 feet. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed half as far.

reaction.name: Dilute (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the marid can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the marid can force it to make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, any damage dealt by the spell is halved.

reaction.name: Brightwater Lens
entries: When the marid is missed by a spell attack roll, it can choose a new target for the attack, making a new spell attack roll with its own modifier (+13).

legendary.name: Aegis Cascade (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A sheltering cascade swirls around the marid. Until the start of its next turn, the marid gains a +5 bonus to its Armor Class and any saving throws it makes.

legendary.name: Depth Charge
entries: The marid moves up to half its speed, then uses its Pressure Spike, targeting a creature within 10 feet of it.

legendary.name: Tidal Stride (4th Level Spell)
entries: The marid teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet, arriving in a splash of brine. Each creature within 5 feet of it after it teleports must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Strange Geometrics
entries: Non-aberrations treat the area within 10 feet of the brain as difficult terrain.

trait.name: Extruded Tendrils
entries: The brain can have up to six Synaptic Tendrils at a time, each of which can be targeted and destroyed (AC 10; 10 HP). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the brain, which can extrude a replacement tendril whenever it makes an attack.

trait.name: Exclusion Field (Concentration)
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the brain can begin concentrating on this effect, producing the following results:

items: The brain has advantage on all saving throws other than those made to maintain concentration.
The brain has resistance to all damage other than force and psychic damage.
If the brain would fail a saving throw, it can end its concentration to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes three attacks with its Synaptic Tendrils.

action.name: Synaptic Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the target is tethered (remove DC 15).

action.name: Nerve Shock
entries: Each creature tethered by the brain must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) lightning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Distortion Helix (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A spiraling river of twisted spacetime extends from the brain in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) force damage and is teleported to an unoccupied space of the brain's choice within the cone.

bonus.name: Collapse Space
entries: The brain folds reality in a 15-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 500 feet of it, dragging each creature in that area up to 15 feet towards its center.

bonus.name: Gray Matter Reclamation
entries: The brain telekinetically shatters an illithid corpse within 30 feet of it, the corpse's brain levitates to the elder brain is absorbed, and the brain can roll to recharge its Distortion Helix.

bonus.name: Psychoport Fargate (Concentration)
entries: The brain begins to thin the boundaries of space around it, causing it to writhe. If the brain is still concentrating at the start of its next turn, it and each illithid of its choice within 30 feet of it teleport to another plane, then each other creature in that area takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Psychic Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below half of its maximum hit points, the elder brain lets out a telepathic wail. Each creature within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is dazed until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Tendril
entries: The brain makes an attack with its Synaptic Tendrils.

legendary.name: Impulse Wave
entries: One creature tethered by the brain moves up to it speed and uses its reaction to take an action of the brain's choice, then is stunned until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Mindslaver Drill (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brain bores into the mind of a creature tethered by it, forcing the target to make a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is dominated by the brain.
If each tendril tethering the dominated creature is destroyed, the effect ends and the creature takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage.

trait.name: Fickle Winds
entries: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the djinni would counter, dispel, or otherwise negate a spell, the creature instead gains control of the spell and can choose new targets for it as if it had cast it.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) thunder damage.
A flying or levitating creature hit by this spell takes an additional 4 (1d8) thunder damage.

action.name: Airburst (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Each creature of the djinni's choice within 10 feet of it must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage and is pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the djinni's choice.

bonus.name: Disturb Currents
entries: Until the start of the djinni's next turn, ranged attacks against it are made at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Wind Slash
entries: Until the start of the djinni's next turn, its melee attacks have a reach of 30 feet.

trait.name: Fickle Winds
entries: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the djinni would counter, dispel, or otherwise negate a spell, the creature instead gains control of the spell and can choose new targets for it as if it had cast it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The djinni makes two attacks.

action.name: Gust Slam
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) thunder damage and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away.

action.name: Squall Shot (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) thunder damage.

action.name: Aetherbolt (4th Level Spell)
entries: A bolt strikes from above, forcing a creature the djinni can see within 300 feet to make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) force damage plus 14 (4d6) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Raise Cyclone (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A 20-foot radius, 60-foot high cylinder of air within 120 feet of the djinni begins to churn. Each creature that enters the wind for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage. In addition, a Large or smaller creature that fails the save becomes restrained in the cyclone until the spell ends (escape DC 17). While restrained in this way, a creature is considered levitating.

bonus.name: Disturb Currents
entries: Until the start of the djinni's next turn, ranged attacks against it are made at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Change Course
entries: The djinni moves the area created by its Raise Cyclone spell up to 30 feet in a straight line. Each creature whose space the cyclone enters in this way must make a saving throw against the spell's effect.

bonus.name: Churn Cyclone
entries: Each creature restrained by the djinni's Raise Cyclone spell takes 10 (3d6) thunder damage.

entries: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the djinni would counter, dispel, or otherwise negate a spell, the creature instead gains control of the spell and can choose new targets for it as if it had cast it.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The djinni can take two reactions each round in combat, but only once per turn.

trait.name: Unfettered Muse (3/Day)
entries: At the end of each of the djinni's turns, it can end one spell or magical effect affecting it or an elemental ally within 30 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The djinni makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Boreal Sweep, Dizzying Nimbus, or Deceiver's Veil.

action.name: Steal Breath (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is choking and dazed until the end of the djinni's next turn.

action.name: Squall Shot (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) thunder damage.
A flying or levitating creature hit by this spell takes an additional 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

action.name: Boreal Sweep (3rd Level Spell)
entries: An icy wind rushes down in a 30-foot long line that is 10-feet wide at a point within 150 feet of the djinni, forcing each creature in its area to make a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) cold damage and is knocked prone, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Dizzying Nimbus (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the djinni can see within 60 feet of it is haloed in a confounding swirl of vapors, forcing it to make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and has disadvantage on any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw that uses its Strength or Dexterity for the next minute.

action.name: Deceiver's Veil (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Perception twists and shimmers for a creature the djinni can see within 60 feet of it for 1 minute. Once per turn, when the target makes an attack, the djinni can force it to make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the djinni chooses the attack's target.

action.name: Galebraid (7th Level Spell)
entries: A knot of living wind tightens around a creature the djinni can see within 60 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target rises 15 feet into the air and is restrained (escape DC 19) for 1 minute.
While restrained in this way, a creature is considered levitating, and takes 27 (6d8) thunder damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Disturb Currents
entries: Until the start of the djinni's next turn, ranged attacks against it are made at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Hidden Slip
entries: The djinni disappears, becoming invisible until the start of its next turn. This effect ends early if the djinni takes or deals any damage.

reaction.name: Stratus Dance
entries: When the djinni would take half damage from succeeding on a saving throw, it can instead take no damage.

reaction.name: Wind Surge (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature misses the djinni with a melee attack, it can force it to make a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is launched 30 feet directly upwards.

trait.name: Fickle Winds
entries: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the djinni would counter, dispel, or otherwise negate a spell, the creature instead gains control of the spell and can choose new targets for it as if it had cast it.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The djinni can take three reactions each round in combat, but only once per turn.

trait.name: Unfettered Muse (5/Day)
entries: At the end of each of the djinni's turns, it can end one spell or magical effect affecting it or an elemental ally within 30 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The djinni makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Dizzying Nimbus.

action.name: Stormweaver Distaff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) force damage plus one additional effect of the djinni's choice:

items: The target takes an additional 11 (2d10) lightning damage and loses its reaction.
The target takes an additional 9 (2d8) thunder damage and one spell of 3rd level or lower affecting it of the djinni's choice ends
The target levitates up to 15 feet upwards and is restrained (escape DC 21) until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Squall Shot (4th Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +13 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) thunder damage.
A flying or levitating creature hit by this spell takes an additional 13 (3d8) thunder damage.

action.name: Dizzying Nimbus (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the djinni can see within 60 feet of it is haloed in a confounding swirl of vapors, forcing it to make a DC 21 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (5d10) psychic damage and has disadvantage on any ability check, attack roll, or saving throw that uses its Strength or Dexterity for the next minute.

action.name: Cloudsea Expanse (7th Level Spell)
entries: A seething fog rushes from the djinni to fill a 500-foot radius sphere centered on it. The fog lasts for 10 minutes, and moves with the djinni. Creatures of the djinni's choice in the fog treat any space more than 5 feet away from them as heavily obscured.

action.name: Last Gasp (Recharge 5-6, 8th Level Spell)
entries: The djinni touches a creature, forcing it to make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 45 (10d8) thunder damage and begins suffocating, or half as much damage on a success. It can repeat this saving throw as an action, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Firmament's End (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: The sky roars, rejecting the djinni's enemies. Each creature of the djinni's choice within 150 feet of it must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 77 (6d8 + 50) thunder damage and can't fly or levitate by any means for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or half as much damage on a success. A creature who is flying has disadvantage on this saving throw.

bonus.name: Disturb Currents
entries: Until the start of the djinni's next turn, ranged attacks against it are made at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Hidden Slip
entries: The djinni disappears, becoming invisible until the start of its next turn. This effect ends early if the djinni takes or deals any damage.

bonus.name: Misty Step (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The djinni teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Stratus Dance
entries: When the djinni would take half damage from succeeding on a saving throw, it can instead take no damage.

reaction.name: Wandering Squall
entries: When the djinni is missed with an attack, it can fly up to half its speed and make an attack with its Squall Shot. Opportunity attacks provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Counterveil (5th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the djinni can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the djinni can roll a d8. If the result is greater than or equal to the spell's level, the djinni gains control of the spell and can choose new targets for it.

trait.name: Strange Geometrics
entries: Non-aberrations treat the area within 15 feet of the brain as difficult terrain.

trait.name: Extruded Tendrils
entries: The brain can have up to six Synaptic Tendrils at a time, each of which can be targeted and destroyed (AC 16; 20 HP). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the brain, which can extrude a replacement tendril whenever it makes an attack.

trait.name: Exclusion Field (Concentration)
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the brain can begin concentrating on this effect, producing the following results:

items: The brain has advantage on all saving throws other than those made to maintain concentration.
The brain has resistance to all damage other than force and psychic damage.
If the brain would fail a saving throw, it can end its concentration to succeed instead.

trait.name: Power of Realms Beyond (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the brain is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 264 hit points, and for the next hour it and each creature tethered by its tendrils have a 60 foot hover speed and advantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes three attacks with its Synaptic Tendrils, one of which it can replace with its Nerve Shock.

action.name: Synaptic Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 45 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the target is tethered (remove DC 19).

action.name: Nerve Shock
entries: Each creature tethered by the brain must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) lightning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Unravel Psyche
entries: One creature tethered by the brain takes 100 psychic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must make a DC 23 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is dazed until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Distortion Helix (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A spiraling river of twisted spacetime extends from the brain in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 55 (10d10) force damage and is teleported to an unoccupied space of the brain's choice within the cone.

bonus.name: Collapse Space
entries: The brain folds reality in a 15-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 500 feet of it, dragging each creature in that area up to 15 feet towards its center.

bonus.name: Gray Matter Reclamation
entries: The brain telekinetically shatters an illithid corpse within 30 feet of it, the corpse's brain levitates to the elder brain is absorbed, and the brain can roll to recharge its Distortion Helix.

bonus.name: Psychoport Fargate (Concentration)
entries: The brain begins to thin the boundaries of space around it, causing it to writhe. If the brain is still concentrating at the start of its next turn, it and each illithid of its choice within 30 feet of it teleport to another plane, then each other creature in that area takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Psychic Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below half of its maximum hit points, the elder brain lets out a telepathic wail. Each creature within 60 feet of it must make a DC 23 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is dazed until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Awestrike
entries: The brain makes an attack with its Synaptic Tendrils. On a hit, the target has disadvantage on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes.

legendary.name: Impulse Wave
entries: One creature tethered by the brain moves up to it speed and uses its reaction to take an action of the brain's choice, then is stunned until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Mindslaver Drill (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brain bores into the mind of a creature tethered by it, forcing the target to make a DC 23 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is dominated by the brain.
If each tendril tethering the dominated creature is destroyed, the effect ends and the creature takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage.

mythic.name: Exalted Communion
entries: Each creature tethered by the brain loses 5 (1d10) levels worth of spell slots in any combination of the target's choice, or an equivalent amount of sorcery points, then the brain regains 10 hit points for each spell slot lost in this way.

mythic.name: Cleanse Mind (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the brain is pushed up to 10 feet away from it, then the brain begins concentrating on its Exclusion Field.

name: Marut
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dimensional Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the marut. Any attempt to do so is wasted.

trait.name: Unyielding Form
entries: The marut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The marut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable Tracker
entries: The marut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has exceeded its natural lifespan, even if the creature and the marut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the marut dies, the marut knows.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marut makes three slam attacks, one of which it may replace with its Curse of Inevitable Death, if available.

action.name: Unerring Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. automatic hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 60 force damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. A creature that has legendary resistances loses one.

action.name: Curse of Inevitable Death
entries: One creature the marut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be cursed to die, suffering the following effects:
If a cursed creature is restored to life, it dies.
If a cursed creature gains a new body, the new body is destroyed.
If this curse is removed, another marut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell)
entries: The Marut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

name: Mastiff
languages: understands one language but can't speak

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Maurezhi
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Assume Form
entries: The maurezhi can assume the appearance of any Medium Humanoid it eats. It remains in this form for  days, during which time the form gradually decays until, when the effect ends, the form sloughs from the demon's body.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The maurezhi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maurezhi makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, its Charisma score is reduced by . This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The target dies if this reduces its Charisma to 0. It rises 24 hours later as a ghoul unless it has been revived or its corpse has been destroyed.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an Undead, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Raise Ghoul (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The maurezhi targets one dead ghoul or ghast it can see within 30 feet of it. The target is revived with all its hit points.

action.name: Garrote
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target of the meazel's size or smaller. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13 with disadvantage). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the meazel's turns. The meazel can't make weapon attacks while grappling a creature in this way.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage

action.name: Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The meazel, any equipment it is wearing or carrying, and any creature it is grappling teleport to an unoccupied space within 500 feet of it, provided that the starting space and the destination are in dim light or darkness. The destination must be a place the meazel has seen before, but it need not be within line of sight. If the destination space is occupied, the teleportation leads to the nearest unoccupied space.

Any other creature the meazel teleports becomes cursed for 1 hour or until the curse is ended by remove curse or greater restoration. Until this curse ends, every Undead and every creature native to the Shadowfell within 300 feet of the cursed creature can sense it, which prevents that creature from hiding from them.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the meazel takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the gorgon's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the gorgon, the gorgon can force it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw if the gorgon isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the  greater restoration spell or other magic.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the gorgon until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the gorgon in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the gorgon sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of bright light, the gorgon is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gorgon makes either three melee attacksâ€”one with its snake hair and two with its shortswordâ€”or two ranged attacks with its longbow.

action.name: Snake Hair
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The megapede makes one Bite attack and uses either Life Drain or Psychic Bomb.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) poison damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: The megapede magically drains life energy from other creatures nearby. Each creature within 15 feet of the megapede must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Psychic Bomb
entries: The megapede targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated.

name: Mephistopheles, Lord of Contradictions
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lord of the Eighth
entries: Devils under Mephistopheles' control have a +8 bonus to saving throws they make to resist their magical effects being countered or dispelled, and to resist spells cast by him and his allies.

trait.name: Magics Unbound
entries: The first time each turn that a creature succeeds on a saving throw against a spell Mephistopheles cast, it rebounds upon him, forcing him to make a saving throw against the same effect.
Additionally, fire damage dealt by Mephistopheles ignores resistance to fire damage and treats immunity as resistance.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
entries: When Mephistopheles would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
If he does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Mephistopheles immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mephistopheles makes two attacks with his Cold-Iron Ranseur, each of which he can replace with his Hurl Meteor.

action.name: Cold-Iron Ranseur
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.
A creation of magical force struck by this attack shatters and is dispelled.

action.name: Hurl Meteor (6th Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +14 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (10d6) bludgeoning plus 35 (10d6) fire damage.
Against a target at lower elevation than the fiend, this attack has advantage and pushes the target up to 15 feet away on a hit.

action.name: Hellfire Cascade (7th Level Spell)
entries: Mephistopheles causes hellfire to rain from the sky in a 30-foot radius cylinder that is 500 feet tall, centered on a point within 500 feet of him.  Creatures in the area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more additionally begins burning (2d10).

action.name: Glacier Surge (8th Level Spell)
entries: Mephistopheles a mountain of ice to burst from the earth in a 100-foot line that is 20 feet wide.  Creatures in the area are pushed 30 feet directly away from Mephistopheles and must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw, taking 62 (4d10 + 40) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
Objects automatically fail their saving throws against this spell and take twice the amount of damage.

action.name: Hellfire Baptism (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Mephistopheles immerses a 30-foot radius sphere within 150 feet of him in hellfire.  Creatures in the area take 80 fire damage.
