Each creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage can make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw.  On a successful save, the creature regains 36 (8d8) hit points and has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Coldblood Quickening (1/Day)
entries: Mephistopheles draws two frost-rimed larva from his throat and tosses them to unoccupied spaces within 60 feet, where each immediately grows into a Gelugon Coldblood that acts on his initiative.

reaction.name: Alter Odds
entries: When a creature makes a saving throw against a spell that Mephistopheles or one of his allies cast, Mephistopheles can use his reaction to add 1d10 to the result.  If the target fails their saving throw, Mephistopheles gains 25 temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Fuel for the Fire
entries: As a reaction when a devil within 30 feet is destroyed, Mephistopheles can absorb some of their essence, causing his save DCs to be increased by 1 for the next minute.

legendary.name: Dark One's Ways (5th Level Spell)
entries: Mephistopheles chooses an unoccupied space within 60 feet, teleporting either himself or one of his allies within 500 feet to that space.

legendary.name: Litany of Smoldering Cinders (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that is burning has its burning value increase by 1d10. Each creature in the area that was burning in the last minute begins burning (1d10).

legendary.name: Mage's Blind (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Mephistopheles chooses a school of magic.  The first time in the next minute that a creature casts a spell of that school within 60 feet of him, Mephistopheles can force them to make a DC 26 Intelligence saving throw.  On a failed save, Mephistopheles gains control of the spell.

legendary.name: Savage Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Mephistopheles moves up to half his speed, then can make three attacks with his Cold-Iron Ranseur against a single target.

trait.name: Anointed Flesh
entries: If the cultist is killed by an effect that deals fire damage in an area, each creature in the affected area takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Fireswarm (Group Attack)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 fire damage.
If the target is burning, this attack is made at advantage.

action.name: Cinder Chant (Group Action)
entries: One creature within 30 feet of the culist must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed sace, until the end of the cultist's next turn, whenever the target makes a saving throw against an effect that deals fire damage or imposes the burning condition, it subtracts 1d6 from the roll.
If three or more cultists took this action, the target additionally begins burning (1d10) on a failed save.

name: Cult Fanatic of the Hellfire Master

trait.name: Anointed Flesh
entries: If the cultist is killed by an effect that deals fire damage in an area, each creature in the affected area takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Blazing Branch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target begins burning (1d10)

action.name: Hurl Flame (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a critical hit, the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Rain of Fire (1/Day, 2nd Level Spell)
entries: Three bolts of fire flare from the sky, each exploding in a 5 foot radius centered on a point within 90 feet that the hobgoblin can see.

Each flammable object in the area ignites, and each creature not beneath cover in the area of one or more of the explosions must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage.

bonus.name: Invocation of Soot (1st Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One burning creature within 60 feet of the cultist must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes blinded for 1 minute or until it is no longer burning, whichever comes first.

trait.name: Anointed Flesh
entries: If the cultist is killed by an effect that deals fire damage in an area, each creature in the affected area takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Sacrificial Spellcasting
entries: Once per turn when the cultist deals fire damage with a spell, it can choose to lose 5 hit points to add one of the following additional effects of its choice:

items: The spell deals an additional 10 fire damage
The spell ignores resistance to fire damage and treats immunity as resistance

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes two attacks with its Hurl Flame, one of which it can replace with a use of its Dazzle or its Litany of Smoldering Cinder.

action.name: Hurl Flame (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a critical hit, the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Dazzle (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the cultist must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature loses its reaction and is blinded until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Litany of Smoldering Cinders (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that is burning has its burning value increase by 1d10. Each creature in the area that was burning in the last minute begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Testaron's Fumarole (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The ground cracks in a 15-foot long, 1-foot wide line within 120 feet, venting forth scalding, acrid fumes. Each creature within 5 feet of the line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, taking half as much damage on a success.
A burning creature has disadvantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Hellish Rebuke (1st Level Spell)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet deals damage to the cultist, it can force the creature to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Rejuvenating Pyre (1/Day)
entries: When the cultist reduces one or more creatures to 0 hit points with a spell that deals fire damage, it can regain 20 hit points for each creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way.

trait.name: Anointed Flesh
entries: If the cultist is killed by an effect that deals fire damage in an area, each creature in the affected area takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Sacrificial Spellcasting
entries: Once per turn when the cultist deals fire damage with a spell, it can choose to lose 5 hit points to add one of the following additional effects of its choice:

items: The spell deals an additional 10 fire damage
The spell ignores resistance to fire damage and treats immunity as resistance

trait.name: Burning Purge
entries: At the start of each of the cultist's turns, it can choose to end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does so, it begins burning (1d10). This burning value increases by 1d10 for each time the cultist has used this ability in the past hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks with its Hurl Flame, one of which it can replace with a use of its Dazzle.

action.name: Hurl Flame (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a critical hit, the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Dazzle (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the cultist must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature loses its reaction and is blinded until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Brimstone Barrage (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Clinging fire sprays forth in a 30-foot cone, forcing each creature in that area to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 (3d10) fire damage and begins burning (1d10), taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Earthscorch Plume (Recharge 5-6, 5th Level Spell)
entries: Fire erupts from the earth in a 10 foot radius, 40 foot high column centered on a point the cultist can see within 300 feet.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage and fall prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
A prone creature makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

action.name: Hellfire Decimation (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: Up to 10 friendly non-minion creatures of CR 5 or lower within 60 feet of the cultist each lose hit points equal to 1/10 their maximum.

Then, one creature the cultist can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take fire damage (ignores resistance) equal to the total hit points lost in this way, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Deflect Spell (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When the cultist would make a saving throw against a spell that targets it, it can allow the spellcaster to choose a different target, or gain advantage on its saving throw if the spellcaster chooses not to.

reaction.name: Rejuvenating Pyre (1/Day)
entries: When the cultist reduces one or more creatures to 0 hit points with a spell that deals fire damage, it can regain 20 hit points for each creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way.

legendary.name: Devour Embers (Cantrip)
entries: The cultist ends the burning condition for any number of burning creatures within 60 feet of it. For each creature, the cultist can choose to roll to recharge its Earthscorch Plume, or gain 10 cumulative temporary hit points.

legendary.name: Litany of Smoldering Cinders (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that is burning has its burning value increase by 1d10. Each creature in the area that was burning in the last minute begins burning (1d10).

legendary.name: Razing Blaze
entries: The cultist teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then uses its Hurl Flame twice.

trait.name: Anointed Flesh
entries: If the cultist is killed by an effect that deals fire damage in an area, each creature in the affected area takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Sacrificial Spellcasting
entries: Once per turn when the cultist deals fire damage with a spell, it can choose to lose 5 hit points to add one of the following additional effects of its choice:

items: The spell deals an additional 10 fire damage
The spell ignores resistance to fire damage and treats immunity as resistance

trait.name: Burning Purge
entries: At the start of each of the cultist's turns, it can choose to end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does so, it begins burning (1d10). This burning value increases by 1d10 for each time the cultist has used this ability in the past hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes three attacks with its Hurl Flame, one of which it can replace with a use of its Brimstone Barrage or Earthscorch Plume.

action.name: Hurl Flame (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +13 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a critical hit, the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Brimstone Barrage (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Clinging fire sprays forth in a 30-foot cone, forcing each creature in that area to make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 (3d10) fire damage and begins burning (1d10), taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Earthscorch Plume (5th Level Spell)
entries: Fire erupts from the earth in a 10 foot radius, 40 foot high column centered on a point the cultist can see within 300 feet.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage and fall prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
A prone creature makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

action.name: Hellfire Decimation (5th Level Spell)
entries: Up to 10 friendly non-minion creatures of CR 5 or lower within 60 feet of the cultist each lose hit points equal to 1/10 their maximum.

Then, one creature the cultist can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take fire damage (ignores resistance) equal to the total hit points lost in this way, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Hellfire Cascade (Recharge 5-6, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The cultist causes hellfire to rain from the sky in a 30-foot radius cylinder that is 500 feet tall, centered on a point within 500 feet of it.  Creatures in the area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails its saving throw by 5 or more additionally begins burning (2d10).

reaction.name: Deflect Spell (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When the cultist would make a saving throw against a spell that targets it, it can allow the spellcaster to choose a different target, or gain advantage on its saving throw if the spellcaster chooses not to.

reaction.name: Rejuvenating Pyre (2/Day)
entries: When the cultist reduces one or more creatures to 0 hit points with a spell that deals fire damage, it can regain 20 hit points for each creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way.

legendary.name: Devour Embers (Cantrip)
entries: The cultist ends the burning condition for any number of burning creatures within 60 feet of it. For each creature, the cultist can choose to roll to recharge its Earthscorch Plume, or gain 10 cumulative temporary hit points.

legendary.name: Litany of Smoldering Cinders (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that is burning has its burning value increase by 1d10. Each creature in the area that was burning in the last minute begins burning (1d10).

legendary.name: Razing Blaze
entries: The cultist teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then uses its Hurl Flame twice.

legendary.name: Earthscorch Plume (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The cultist uses its Earthscorch Plume.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

name: Merrenoloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The merrenoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The merrenoloth charges a rate of 100 gp per passenger for passage on its boat, or 1000 gp for a passenger that has wronged it or another merrenoloth.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The merrenoloth makes two attacks with its oar and uses its Fear Gaze.

action.name: Oar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Drowning Gaze
entries: The merrenoloth targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the merrenoloth for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature cannot swim or hold its breath. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Teleport
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the merrenoloth magically teleports, along with its boat and whichever occupants of the boat it chooses, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The peacekeeper is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the peacekeeper is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically with each other.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The peacekeeper makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Calming Mist (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The peacekeeper releases a calming gas in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or become charmed by the peacekeeper for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

name: Metallic Warbler
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The warbler is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the warbler is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically with each other.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Calming Mist (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The warbler releases a calming gas in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or become charmed by the warbler for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

name: Mezzoloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mezzoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The mezzoloth's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A yugoloth will usually accept a rate of the yugoloth's challenge rating times 25 gp, though it may accept less.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mezzoloth makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its trident. It may replace its claw attack with a use of its Toxic Spittle ability.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Trident
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage when held with two claws and used to make a melee attack.

action.name: Toxic Spittle (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 23 (5d8) poison damage and be blinded until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Teleport (3rd level spell)
entries: The mezzoloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Dark Escape
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the Mezzoloth may shroud itself in a 20 foot radius cloud of magical darkness until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Telepathic Hub
entries: When the mindwitness receives a telepathic message, each other creature within 600 ft. receives the same message.

trait.name: Psychic Tether Cone
entries: The mindwitness' central eye creates an area of psychic intermingling in a 150-foot cone. Whenever the mindwitness makes an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw against a magical effect, each creature in the cone must make the same saving throw against the effect. At the start of each of its turns, the mindwitness decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the mindwitness is dealt a critical hit, the mindwitness must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the mindwitness use.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mindwitness makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite, or uses three of its its eye rays, chosen at random (reroll duplicates).

action.name: Oral Disk Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). A creature grappled in this way takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns and has its Intelligence score reduced by the same amount until the grapple ends. A creature with an Intelligence of 0 is stunned.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The mindwitness shoots one of its eye rays, choosing a target it can see within 120 ft.:

items.name: 1. Telekinetic Ray (Opalescent White)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 ft. in any direction. An object weighing 300 lbs or less is moved 30 ft. in any direction.

items.name: 2. Apathy Ray (Fuzzy Grey)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved until the end of its next turn. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both.

items.name: 3. Stunning Ray (Pulsing Maroon)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 4. Psychic Disruption Ray (Pale Silver)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage and lose concentration, if it was holding it.

items.name: 5. Paranoia Ray (Wavy Purple.)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of one of its allies until the end of its next turn. While frightened in this way, it cannot willingly accept assistance from that ally.

items.name: 6. Aversion Ray (Sickly Yellow)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be unable to use an object it carries of the mindwitness' choice without mental anguish for the next minute. If the mindwitness chooses a weapon or spell focus, whenever the creature uses the object to cast a spell or make an attack, the creature takes 1d6 psychic damage. If the mindwitness chose a shield, whenever an attack misses the creature, the creature takes 1d6 psychic damage.

name: Moloch, Right Hand of the Sixth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Moloch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 21). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
will: alter self (can become Medium when changing his appearance)

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Moloch fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Moloch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Moloch's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Moloch regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Moloch dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Moloch makes three attacks: one with his bite, one with his claw, and one with his whip.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Many-Tailed Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d4 + 8) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet in a straight line toward Moloch.

action.name: Breath of Despair (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Moloch exhales in a 30-foot cube. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage, drop whatever it is holding, and become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from Moloch by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move, in which case it needn't take the Dash action. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to Moloch, the creature can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends.

action.name: Teleport
entries: Moloch magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Stinking Cloud
entries: Moloch casts stinking cloud.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Moloch uses his Teleport action.

legendary.name: Whip
entries: Moloch makes one attack with his whip.

name: Molydeus
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Bonded at Creation
entries: A Serpentine Overseer is Attached to the molydeus, shares its space, and cannot be removed while the overseer lives.

The molydeus cannot see or take hostile action against the overseer attached to it. If its overseer is killed, the molydeus must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or gain a level of exhaustion.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the molydeus may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the molydeus. While climbing on the molydeus, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the molydeus, and the molydeus has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The molydeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the molydeus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The molydeus makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Slavering Bite.

action.name: Slavering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 24).
A creature grappled in this way takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Mountain-Splitter Doomaxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d8 + 9) slashing damage.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take half the attack's damage.
Each structure and unattended object within 5 feet of the target is destroyed.

bonus.name: Manifest Archdemon (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: If the molydeus has fewer than half its hit points, it partially transforms until the end of its next turn, taking on a rough likeness of its archdemon patron.
While transformed, the molydeus may take any action, reaction, or legendary action listed on its patron's stat block.

legendary.name: Voice of the Master
entries: If the molydeus' serpentine overseer is not dead or incapacitated, it may use its Voice of the Master.

legendary.name: Crushing Pulse (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or fall prone. Any fall damage taken as a result deals maximum damage, instead of rolling.

legendary.name: Cleaving Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The  molydeus moves up to its speed and makes an attack with its Mountain-Splitter Doomaxe.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The monodrone may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the monodrone is within 30 feet of a duodrone, it uses the duodrone's attack bonus instead of its own. If the duodrone is using a tridrone's attack bonus, the monodrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Bladed Ruler (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage.

action.name: Measure Cuts
entries: The modron assesses the wounds of a creature it can see within 5 feet, learning how many hit points it is missing.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a duodrone within 60 feet die or transform, the monodrone may transform into a duodrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one monodrone may take this reaction.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. If the shark misses, it can use a bonus action to swim up to 25 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The shark can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Silver Spear
entries: A character within 5 feet of the shark can use an action to try to dislodge the spear, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. While the spear is lodged in the shark, the shark glows with silvery illumination, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:

items.name: Dream Breath
entries: The dragon exhales mist in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

items.name: Moonlight Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a beam of moonlight in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The moorbounder's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Mordakhesh, the Shadowed Sword
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mordakhesh's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). Mordakhesh can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Mordakhesh can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless he wishes to be. Mordakhesh has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mordakhesh makes three greatsword attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) force damage.

action.name: Chromatic Orb
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 () damage of a type chosen by Mordakhesh: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Mordakhesh makes one weapon attack or casts chromatic orb.

legendary.name: Chromatic Resistance
entries: Modakhesh gains resistance to one damage type of his choice - acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder - until the start of his next turn.

legendary.name: Warlord's Command (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Mordakhesh targets up to two allies that he can see within 30 feet of him. If a target can see and hear him, the target can make one weapon attack as a reaction and gains advantage on the attack roll.

name: Morkoth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The morkoth is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The morkoth has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The morkoth can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The morkoth makes three attacks: two with its bite and one with its tentacles or three with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends. the target is restrained and takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the morkoth's turns. and the morkoth can't use its tentacles on another target.

action.name: Hypnosis
entries: The morkoth projects a 30-foot cone of magical energy. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by the morkoth for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the target tries to get as close to the morkoth as possible, using its actions to Dash until it is within 5 feet of the morkoth. A charmed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature has advantage on saving throws against the morkoth's Hypnosis for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Spell Reflection
entries: If the morkoth makes a successful saving throw against a spell, or a spell attack misses it, the morkoth can choose another creature (including the spellcaster) it can see within 120 feet of it. The spell targets the chosen creature instead of the morkoth. If the spell forced a saving throw, the chosen creature makes its own save. If the spell was an attack, the attack roll is rerolled against the chosen creature.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The goat does not die or fall unconscious due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the goat starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Pushy
entries: If the goat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target is pushed 10 ft. away. If it is pushed into a wall or other solid surface, the creature takes an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goat attacks once with its bite and once with its ram.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Mouth of Chaos
entries: The giant is immune to the confusion spell.

On each of its turns, the giant uses all its movement to move toward the nearest creature or whatever else it might perceive as food. Roll a d8 at the start of each of the giant's turns to determine its action for that turn:

items.name: 1â€“3:
items.entry: The giant makes three Fist attacks against one random creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 4â€“5:
items.entry: The giant makes one Fist attack against each creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, the giant makes one Fist attack against itself.

items.name: 6â€“7:
items.entry: The giant makes one Bite attack against one random creature within reach. If no other creatures are within reach, its eyes glaze over and it is stunned until the start of its next turn.

items.name: 8â€“10:
items.entry: The giant makes one Bite attack and two Fist attacks against one random creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the giant magically regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Earthglide
entries: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the mephit doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of sticky mud. Each Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of the creature's next turn.

action.name: Muddy Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature knocked prone in this way must spend its full movement to stand.

action.name: Soften Earth (Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: The ground in a 10 ft. radius around the mephit becomes difficult terrain for the next minute. This radius moves with the mephit.

reaction.name: Non-Newtonian
entries: As a reaction to taking bludgeoning or slashing damage, the mephit increases its AC by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The donkey is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The donkey has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The mule is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The mule has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Mummy
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: The mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies (but not mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.

name: Mummy Lord
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Warding Hex
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the mummy that hits it with an attack must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and be stunned until the end of the mummy's next turn.

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 hit points must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mummy lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed mummy lord gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the mummy lord's heart.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two attacks with its Rotting Fist and uses its Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Mummy Rot.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally paralyzed for the same duration.
A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Plague Chant (6th Level Spell, Recharges when the mummy uses its Grave Terror)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +9 to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. Hit 28 (8d6) necrotic damage. If this attack hits, the plague chant leaps to another creature within 15 feet of the previous target.
The mummy lord makes a new attack roll against the new target, which could cause this ability to leap again. A creature can be targeted no more than once with each casting of this spell.

action.name: Grave Terror (8th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the mummy lord can see within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 99 (18d10) psychic damage and be dragged up to 15 feet toward the mummy, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that isn't frightened may use its reaction to move 15 feet directly away from the mummy. If it does, it gains advantage on this saving throw.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand
entries: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity, and reverts to its normal form.

legendary.name: Blinding Dust
entries: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded and stunned until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

trait.name: Explode
entries: When the comet drops to 0 hit points, it explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The comet doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The comet sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The comet deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The comet doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The comet makes one Slam attack and one Spit Fire attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Spit Fire
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) fire damage.

trait.name: Campfire Scenting
entries: The marshbellow can detect, by scent, the direction and size of each fire and each creature with a spell or ability that can deal fire damage within 20 miles.

trait.name: Springy Hide
entries: A creature that hits the marshbellow with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the creature is pushed 15 feet away or has its weapon flung 15 feet from its grasp (attacker's choice).

action.name: Soft-Toothed Snap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 12).
A creature grappled in this way automatically fails saving throws against the marshbellow's Stickyspore Snarl.

action.name: Squidgy Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.
If the marshbellow is size Medium, the target is pushed an additional 5 feet.

action.name: Stickyspore Snarl
entries: The marshbellow coughs out a glob of gluey spores in a 5 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be restrained (escape DC 12).
If the marshbellow's Puff Up is active, this ability instead affects a 15 foot cone, and deals an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage on a failed saving throw.

reaction.name: Puff Up
entries: When the marshbellow takes any fire damage, it can grow to size Medium for the next minute, or until it uses its Stickyspore Snarl.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the naiad may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

trait.name: Polymorph Weakness
entries: Spells and magical effects that would polymorph the naiad persist until dispelled.

action.name: Aquatic Aid
entries: One creature that the naiad can see within 10 ft. of a body of fresh water must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. in a direction of the nymph's choice.

action.name: Parting Touch (concentration)
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the next minute. While charmed in this way, a creature takes 3 (1d6) nonlethal psychic damage at the start of each of its turn for each 5 ft. away from the nymph that it is.
A charmed creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Blood to Water
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the naiad forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature submerged in fresh water must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or acquire a point of exhaustion.

name: Nalfeshnee
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nalfeshnee uses Horror Nimbus if it can. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Horror Nimbus (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nalfeshnee magically emits scintillating, multicolored light. Each creature within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee that can see the light must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The nalfeshnee magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The necrichor can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: Unless its lifeless remains are splashed with holy water or interred in a location under the effects of the hallow spell, the destroyed necrichor re-forms in 1d1O days, regaining all its hits points and appearing in an unoccupied space adjacent to any living creature that has been affected by its blood puppeteering ability.

trait.name: Coagulate
entries: If the necrichor takes any cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any temporary hit points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the necrichor may not use its spider climb trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

trait.name: Blood Siphon
entries: Whenever a creature the necrichor is attached to takes any necrotic damage, the necrichor gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The necrichor makes two attacks with its ichor tendril, one or both of which it may replace with a use of its wrench blood.

action.name: Ichor Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend two of its hit dice. A creature that cannot is instead paralyzed until the start of the necrichor's next turn.

action.name: Wrench Blood
entries: One creature the necrichor can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and be pulled up to 15 feet toward the necrichor, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Blood Puppeteering (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet that does not have all of its hit points must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the necrichor enters the target's space and attaches itself to the target. While attached, the nechrichor takes only half the damage dealt to it and the target takes the remaining damage.

While the necrichor is attached to a creature, the necrichor can't use its multiattack and the creature acts under the necrichor's control. An affected creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, expelling the necrichor into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

reaction.name: Lose Cohesion
entries: When the necrichor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, any creatures it is Attached to are freed and the necrichor moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Bloody Retribution
entries: When it succeeds on a saving throw, the necrichor can cause a creature it is Attached to to make a melee attack against itself.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The necromancer is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The necromancer has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Grim Harvest (1/Turn)
entries: When necromancer kills a creature that is neither a construct nor undead with a spell of 1st level or higher, the necromancer regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level, or three times if it is a necromancy spell.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) necrotic damage.

name: Neh-thalggu
languages: Deep Speech; see also Brain Dump

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The neh-thalggu casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11). It must have consumed the requisite number of brains to cast the spell, as indicated:

trait.name: Brain Dump
entries: Whenever the neh-thalggu consumes a brain, it gains the magical ability to speak and understand languages known by the brain's previous owner.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The neh-thalggu doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The neh-thalggu makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid. Hit: 35 (10d6) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the neh-thalggu kills the target by extracting and consuming its brain.

action.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The neh-thalggu magically emits psychic energy at one Humanoid it can see within 10 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Spying Eye
entries: The otyugh has advantage on checks made to hide while submerged in filth.

trait.name: Horrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the Otyugh must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Intrusive Presence
entries: The neo-otyugh can detect the surface thoughts of each creature within 120 feet. Affected creatures are aware of the otyugh's mental presence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes three attacks, one of which may be with its diseased bite or its disgusting lure.

action.name: Diseased Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract filth fever.

action.name: Spined Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Tentacle Slam (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The otyugh slams up to two creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the otyugh's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Disgusting Lure
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a ranged attack or harmful spell, the otyugh forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or use all of its remaining movement to approach the otyugh by the most direct path.

trait.name: Mental Fortitude
entries: The neogi has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened, and magic can't put the neogi to sleep.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The neogi makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Enslave (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The neogi targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the neogi for 1 day, or until the neogi dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. The charmed target obeys the neogi's commands and can't take reactions, and the neogi and the target can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 1 mile. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Pharyngeal Jaws
entries: When the neogi hits a creature with a bite attack, it may make another bite attack against the same creature as a Bonus Action. If it does, it latches on to the creature. While latched, the swarm moves with the target and cannot use its bite on another creature until it uses an action to free itself.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

action.name: Swarm of Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (6d6 + 1) poison damage, or 11 (3d6 + 1) poison damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Pharyngeal Jaws
entries: When the neogi hits a creature with a bite attack, it may make another bite attack against the same creature as a Bonus Action. If it does, it latches on to the creature. While latched, the swarm moves with the target and cannot use its bite on another creature until it uses an action to free itself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Neogi makes two attacks; one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bloating Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) plus 7 (2d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

A poisoned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or having its movement reduced by a cumulative 5 ft. for as long as it is poisoned on a failure. A creature that has its movement speed reduced to 0 in this way has its size category increase by one and is immobilized for the next hour.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3).

action.name: Strange Geometries (2nd level spell, Concentration)
entries: Space warps in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 60 ft. that the neogi can see for the next minute. A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or have its movement speed halved and its Wisdom score reduced by 1d4 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Dominate (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or act under the neogi's control on its following turn. A creature with a Wisdom score of 13 or lower that fails this save instead acts under the neogi's control for the next 24 hours, or until the neogi dies.

reaction.name: Revelation of the Gate
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. casting a spell, the neogi forces the spell caster to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute. While frightened in this way, a creature cannot cast spells of 1st level or higher. A frightened creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Mental Fortitude
entries: The neogi has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened, and magic can't put the neogi to sleep.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The neogi makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The neogi casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Mental Fortitude
entries: The neogi has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened, and magic can't put the neogi to sleep.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The neogi makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes two Eldritch Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Eldritch Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.

bonus.name: Enslave (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The neogi targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the neogi for 1 day, or until the neogi dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. The charmed target obeys the neogi's commands and can't take reactions, and the neogi and the target can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 1 mile. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Neothelid
resist: weapon attacks not made from inside it

trait.name: Mind Sense
entries: The neothelid knows the number and direction of each creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or higher within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 5 foot radius around the neothelid is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the neothelid's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The neothelid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the neothelid fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The neothelid makes four attacks with its tentacles, one of which it may replace with a swallow.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 21).

action.name: Swallow
entries: One creature grappled by two or more tentacles must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the neothelid. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the neothelid, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the neothelid's turns.

If the neothelid takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the neothelid must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces. If the neothelid dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Brain-Stripper Enzyme Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The neothelid disgorges a torrent of acid in a 60 ft. cone that dissolves bone and flesh but leaves fat and nerves behind. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in the enzyme until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash it off. A creature covered in the enzyme takes 35 (10d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Draw
entries: As a reaction to passing a saving throw against a spell, the neothelid forces the spell's caster to succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled 15 ft. toward the neothelid.

reaction.name: Wild Thrash
entries: As a reaction to taking 30 or more damage in a turn, the neothelid thrashes about. Each creature within 15 ft. of it is pushed up to 15 ft. away. A creature that cannot move the full 15 ft. additionally takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Psychic Crush
entries: As a reaction a creature reducing it below 80 hit points, the neothelid attempts to crush its mind with brute psionic force. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or drop to 0 hit points, or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage on a success.

name: Slimy Quiverer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mutable Mass
entries: The quiverer can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
If the quiverer takes any amount of lightning or slashing damage, it loses its damage resistances and its Slimy Coating trait is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Slimy Coating
entries: A creature that touches the quiverer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.

action.name: Quivering Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage and the quiverer gains an equal number of temporary hit points if the target is diseased.

action.name: Release Spores (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The quiverer releases fungal spores in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in the area takes 7 (2d6) poison damage.

The cloud of spores remains for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature contracts Fungal Choke. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to Fungal Choke for 1 minute.

name: Oozing Invader
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mutable Mass
entries: The invader can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
If the invader takes any amount of lightning or slashing damage, it loses its damage resistances and its Oozing Corruption trait is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Oozing Corruption
entries: A creature that touches the invader or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage.

action.name: Slimy Probe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage and the invader becomes attached to the target (remove DC 13).

When the invader becomes attached to a creature, and at the start of each of a creature's turns if the invader is attached to it, it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature contracts Bile Rot.

action.name: Absorb Nutrients
entries: The invader absorbs nutrients from the body of a creature it is attached to, slowly liquifying its internals. The target takes 13 (3d8) acid damage and the invader gains an equal number of temporary hit points if the target is diseased. The target must also make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

name: Corrosive Devourer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mutable Mass
entries: The devourer can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
If the devourer takes any amount of lightning or slashing damage, it loses its damage resistances and its Corrosive Body trait is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Corrosive Body
entries: A creature that touches the devourer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract Acid Reflux.
Additionally, whenever the devourer touches a nonmagical weapon, it suffers a -1 penalty to attack and damage rolls. If this penalty exceeds -5, the weapon is destroyed.

Finally, whenever the devourer deals acid damage to a creature wearing nonmagical armor or wielding a nonmagical shield, the armor or shield suffers a -1 penalty to the AC it provides. If this penalty exceeds the amount the armor or shield grants, it is destroyed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devourer makes three attacks with its Acid Lash. It can replace one attack with Bathe in acid and one with Vitriolic Sphere if available.

action.name: Acid Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage and the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target contracts Acid Reflux.

action.name: Bathe in Acid
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) acid damage and the devourer gains an equal number of temporary hit points if the target is diseased. Additionally, the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Vitriolic Sphere (Recharge 5-6, 4th Level Spell)
entries: The devourer lobs a blob of acid to a point within 150 feet of it, where it explodes in a 20-foot radius sphere. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 25 (10d4) acid damage, and an additional 13 (5d4) acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Acidic Fumes (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The devourer lets out a buildup of acidic fumes from its body, forcing each creature within 20 feet of it to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) acid damage and is blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Consume Object
entries: When the devourer destroys an object due to its Corrosive Body trait, it can consume the object and regain 30 hit points.

name: Virulent Blightcradle
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mutable Mass
entries: The blightcradle can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
If the blightcradle takes any amount of lightning or slashing damage, it loses its damage resistances and its Disgusting Body trait is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Disgusting Body
entries: A creature that touches the blightcradle or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage.

Additionally, whenever a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the blightcradle, it must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 (2d8) acid damage and contracts Necrotic Blight. On a success, a creature is immune to the blightcradle's Disgusting Body for 1 minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blightcradle uses its Corrupting Presence and makes one attack.

action.name: Festering Blow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage and the blightcradle gains an equal number of temporary hit points if the target is diseased.

action.name: Pestilence Needle
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) acid damage and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on Strength ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of the blightcradle's next turn.

action.name: Corrupting Presence
entries: The blightcradle corrupts the ground within 10 feet of it, turning it into Blighted Terrain for 1 hour. A creature that starts its turn in Blighted Terrain or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 (2d8) acid damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. If a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it additionally contracts Necrotic Blight.

action.name: Blight Nova (Recharge 6)
entries: The blightcradle releases a violent explosion of sludge in a 20-foot radius centered on it. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 35 (10d6) acid damage, contracts Necrotic Blight, and has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

bonus.name: Roiling Sickness
entries: The blightcradle moves up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. It can make an attack with its Festering Blow against each creature whose space it moves through during this move. On a hit, a creature additionally must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or contract Necrotic Blight.

bonus.name: Pestilence Barrage (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The blightcradle makes three attacks with its Pestilence Needle.

name: Borgean
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mutable Mass
entries: The borgean can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
If the borgean takes any amount of lightning or slashing damage, it loses its damage resistances and its Viral Conversion trait is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Viral Conversion
entries: A creature that touches the borgean or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 13 (2d12) damage of the damage type it is immune to from its Adapt Immunity and must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or contract Assimilation Plague.

trait.name: Adapt Immunity
entries: Whenever the borgean takes any amount of damage from any source, it gains immunity to that damage type after the damage is resolved. It can only have one immunity from this trait at a time. While it has no immunity, features that deal damage of the type it is immune to instead deal acid damage.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the borgean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points and it loses the immunity from its Adapt Immunity trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The borgean makes four attacks with its Adaptive Strike, one of which can be replaced by Assimilate Matter and one of which can be replaced by System Shock Pulse.

action.name: Adaptive Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19) and must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or contract Assimilation Plague.

action.name: Assimilate Matter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) damage of the damage type it is immune to from its Adapt Immunity. If the target is diseased, the borgean gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

action.name: System Shock (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The borgean emits a destabilizing pulse of corrupted energy in a 30-foot radius centered on it. Each creature in the area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) damage of the damage type it is immune to from its Adapt Immunity, contracts Assimilation Plague, and is restrained until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Myxovore
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mutable Mass
entries: The myxovore can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
If the myxovore takes any amount of lightning or slashing damage, it loses its damage resistances and its Extermination Flow trait is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Extermination Flow
entries: A creature that touches the borgean, hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, or starts its turn within 30 feet of it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage.
Additionally, the myxovore's Purification Plague ignores immunity to disease, but still can't infect constructs or undead.

trait.name: Adaptive Resistance
entries: Whenever the myxovore takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it gains resistance to that damage type until the start of its next turn. If it takes 50 or more damage from a single source, it gains immunity to that damage type until the start of its next turn.
Additionally, the myxovore has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the myxovore fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
