entries: The borgean makes four attacks with its Bio-Suppressing Slam, one of which can be replaced by Auto Response System and one of which can be replaced by Neutralising Expulsion.

action.name: Bio-Suppressing Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (4d10) acid damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19) and must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or contract Purification Plague.

If the target is already grappled, instead of dealing damage the myxovore can choose to swallow it. While swallowed in this way, a creature takes 35 (10d6) acid damage the start of each of the myxovore's turns and is considered choking.

action.name: Autoimmune Response
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (8d8) acid damage. If the target is diseased, the myxovore gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

action.name: Neutralizing Expulsion (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The myxovore purges its body, launching antibodies at up to 3 creatures within 60 feet, and launching all creatures swallowed by it to unoccupied spaces within 30 feet, where they land prone. Each target must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) acid damage and contracts Purification Plague, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: The Grand Cleansing (Recharge 6)
entries: The myxovore fully purges its body, concentrating its acids. Each creature swallowed by the myxovore must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 70 (20d6) acid damage, stops holding its breath, and contracts Purification Plague, or half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Pathogen Burst
entries: The myxovore exudes a burst of corruptive enzymes in a 10-foot radius around itself. Creatures in the area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and contracts Purification Plague, or half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Absorption Response (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The myxovore swallows a creautre it is grappling, or makes an attack with its Autoimmune Response.

legendary.name: Adaptive Countermeasures (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The myxovore moves up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity and then chooses a damage type. It gains resistance to that damage type for 1 minute, or instead gains immunity if it was already resistant.

name: Sludge Hulk
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mutable Mass
entries: The hulk can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
If the hulk takes any amount of lightning or slashing damage, it loses its damage resistances and its Sludge Taint trait is suppressed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Sludge Taint
entries: A creature that touches the hulk or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) acid damage.

trait.name: Sludge Flow
entries: The hulk cannot be moved forcefully and melee weapon attacks made against it are made at disadvantage unless they are made with a magical weapon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stalker makes two attacks with its Toxic Blow, one of which it can replace with a use of its Sludge Breath if available.

action.name: Toxic Blow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage and the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target additionally suffers an acid injury.

action.name: Sludge Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hulk exhales sticky sludge in a 60-foot cone. Creatures within the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) acid damage and is restrained (escape DC 16), or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Swamp Bubble
entries: When the hulk takes any amount of lightning or thunder damage, it can choose for one of the bubbles in its body to pop, releasing noxious fumes. Creatures within 15 feet of the hulk must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) acid damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Night Hag
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it knows the name of. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Debt Keeper
entries: A creature that is indebted to the hag is psychically connected to it. The hag can telepathically communicate with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through its senses. Once per day, the hag can force an indebted creature to reroll an attack, ability check, or saving throw, taking the second result.

trait.name: Soultaker Coven
entries: Humanoid creatures within 100 miles of a coven of night hags feel drawn to the coven's location in times of desperation. While part of a coven, the hag's hellish portal does not close when a creature falls into it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Fiendish Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Hellish Portal (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hag opens a rift to a hellish demplane, 10 ft. long and 5 ft. wide, on a surface within 60 ft. A creature standing in the rift's space when it appears or that enters it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone in an unoccupied space adjacent to the rift. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls in. If one or more creatures fall into the rift, the rift closes.

A creature that falls into the rift takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage, 21 (6d6) fire damage, and ages 21 (6d6) years, and is incapacitated until the beginning of its next turn, when it reappears in the space it left. The aging Effect can be reversed with a Greater Restoration spell.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. To do so, the hag must have a heartstone in her possession.

action.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day)
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane, afflicting it with dreadful nightmares. If this contact persists for an hour, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from its rest, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10).

If this effect reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and if the target was indebted to the hag, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

A creature that is wearing a silver protective talsiman, or one that has had a Protection From Good And Evil spell cast on it in the last 8 hours makes this save at advantage. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more awakes, dragging the hag into the waking world with it. The hag appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and cannot use its Etherealness ability for the next minute.

reaction.name: Offer Bargain
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see  failing a saving throw, the hag grants it the ability to choose to succeed instead. A creature that does is Indebted to the hag.

reaction.name: True Magic (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see wihthin 60 ft. casting a spell, the hag disrupts the magic. The spell fails, and the spell caster takes 5 (1d10) force damage per level of the spell and must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned.

name: Nightmare Beast
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The beast deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The beast makes two Claw attacks and one Tusk attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (1d12 + 8) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tusk
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Disintegration Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The beast targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 70 (10d6 + 40) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this magical effect reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is disintegrated and leaves nothing behind, except a pile of ashes plus whatever equipment it was wearing or carrying.

bonus.name: Teleport (2/Day)
entries: The beast magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Tusk Attack
entries: The beast makes one Tusk attack.

legendary.name: Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The beast moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes two Tusk attacks.

legendary.name: Frightful Howl (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The beast howls as it exhales a cloud of magical fear gas in a 120-foot cone. Any creature in that area must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the beast for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The shepherd's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Nightmares
entries: Undead creatures within 30 feet of the shepherd gain a +5 bonus to attack and damage rolls. When any other creature that isn't undead or a construct starts its turn within 30 feet of the shepherd, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shepherd has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shepherd makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its staff.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 26 (4d12) psychic damage.

action.name: Herd the Underworld (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The shepherd pulls twisted souls from the Underworld;  shadows (without Sunlight Weakness) arise in unoccupied spaces within 20 feet of the shepherd. The shadows act right after the shepherd on the same initiative count and fight until they're destroyed. They disappear when the shepherd dies.

name: Nightveil Wight
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mount
entries: If the wight isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto its gloamwing mount, provided the wight and the gloamwing are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the wight appears astride the gloamwing along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the wight can't be surprised, and both it and its mount gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes two scythe attacks.

action.name: Scythe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) psychic damage.

action.name: Mind Twist (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The wight magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (5d8) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Reap Memory (3/Day)
entries: The wight touches one incapacitated creature and chooses 1 hour from among the past 24. Unless the creature succeeds on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, the creature loses all memory of that hour. The creature regains the memory only if the wight dies within the next 24 hours.

name: Nightwalker
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwalker must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and grant the nightwalker advantage on attack rolls against it until the start of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Light Eater
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightwalker is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 4th level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed.  If the nightwalker starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

trait.name: Anti-Life Nature
entries: If the nightwalker would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success. On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightwalker have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the nightwalker may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nightwalker. While climbing on the nightwalker, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the nightwalker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightwalker makes two attacks with its enervating focus, one of which it may replace with a use of its Finger of Doom, if available.

action.name: Enervating Focus
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (5d8 + 6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount until it finishes a Long Rest.

action.name: Drown in Death (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or fall into its shadow (escape DC 21). A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot hold its breath.

While in its shadow, a creature is blinded, cannot breathe, and takes 45 (10d8) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns. A creature that ends its turn in its shadow while afflicted with a Curse of Doom ceases to exist and can't be revived by any means short of a Wish spell.

action.name: Finger of Doom (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nightwalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be afflicted with a Curse of Doom.

While cursed in this way, the creature acquires a Doom counter each time it takes necrotic damage. If the creature drops to 0 hit points while cursed, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom counter it has.

name: Daywalker
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Regeneration Aura
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the daywalker regains 14 (4d6) hit points.

trait.name: Light Bringer
entries: The area within 60 feet of the daywalker is illumiated with bright light. Areas of darkness created by a spell of 4th level or lower are instantly dispelled. Celestial bodies appear to shine brighter. If the daywalker starts its turn in darkness, it takes 25 necrotic damage.

trait.name: Life-Filled Nature
entries: Whenever the daywalker is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the daywalker may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the daywalker. While climbing on the daywalker, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the daywalker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The daywalker makes two attacks with its Regenerative Touch, one of which it may replace with a use of its Hand of Healing, if available.

action.name: Regenerative Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 6) hit points are regained. If the target was already at their hit point maximum, or if the attack heals them beyond their hit point maximum, they must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion as cancerous tumors grow all over their body. This exhaustion is not reduced upon taking a long rest.
If a creature is killed by this exhaustion, instead of dying, the creature becomes an Overgrown Tumor under the daywalker's control.  Only a Wish spell can return the creature to their original form.
If a creature with any levels of exhaustion from the daywalker takes any amount of necrotic damage, one level of exhaustion gained from the daywalker is removed.

action.name: Drown in Life (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that is in bright light must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or be enveloped in the light (escape DC 21). A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot hold its breath.

While in the light, a creature is blinded and regains 45 (10d8) hit points at the end of each of its turns. A creature that ends its turn in the light while afflicted with a Curse of Healing must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion as cancerous tumors grow all over their body.  This exhaustion is not reduced upon taking a long rest.
If a creature is killed by this exhaustion, instead of dying, the creature becomes an Overgrown Tumor under the daywalker's control.  Only a Wish spell can return the creature to their original form.
If a creature with any levels of exhaustion from the daywalker takes any amount of necrotic damage, one level of exhaustion gained from the daywalker is removed.

action.name: Hand of Healing (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The daywalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or regain 26 (4d12) hit points and be afflicted with a Curse of Healing (Save Ends at end of turn).
While cursed in this way, a creature views the daywalker as a trusted friend, and must use their turn to move as close to the daywalker as they can.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Healing Spores
entries: Creatures within 10 feet of the tumor roll an additional die whenever they receive magical healing.

action.name: Regenerative Fluid (Group Attack)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: the target regains the maximum possible number of hit points the next time it receives magical healing before the beginning of the tumor's next turn.

trait.name: Trickster's Tumble
entries: The nilbog can take the Dodge action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Healing Reversal
entries: If the nilbog would receive a source of magical healing, it instead loses that many hit points.

action.name: Fool's Scepter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. For the next minute, the target falls prone and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage whenever it misses with an attack.

action.name: Distorted Perception (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 ft must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, for the next minute whenever the creature moves the nilbog chooses the direction of that movement. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Trade Weapon
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee weapon attack, the nilbog trades weapons with the attacker. It is considered attuned to any magic weapons that require attunement.

reaction.name: Damage Reversal
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack or hostile spell, the nilbog activates its damage reversal, taking no damage and instead being healed for the same amount. The nilbog receives healing beyond its maximum hit points as temporary hit points.

trait.name: Silver Tongue
entries: The noble has advantage on Charisma based ability checks to interact with guards or other figures of authority.

trait.name: Heraldic Arms
entries: While the noble is armed, creatures proficient in History can determine, by sight, the noble's station and lineage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must suceed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

reaction.name: Deft Parry
entries: When the noble would be hit with a melee attack, it can add +2 to its AC against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Bon Mot
entries: When the noble is missed with a melee attack, it can make a cutting remark.
The target gains disadvantage on the next attack it makes against the noble this turn.

name: Nosferatu
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The nosferatu regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If the nosferatu takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function until the start of the nosferatu's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The nosferatu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The nosferatu takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The nosferatu doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nosferatu makes two Claw attacks followed by one Bite attack. If both Claw attacks hit the same creature, the Bite attack is made with advantage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its hit points, it instead takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the nosferatu regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises as a nosferatu after  days.

action.name: Blood Disgorge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nosferatu vomits blood in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.

name: Nycaloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A yugoloth will usually accept a rate of the yugoloth's challenge rating times 25 gp, though it may accept less.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The nycaloth can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The nycaloth's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nycaloth makes a claw attack and uses its teleport, or it makes a greataxe attack and uses its invisibility.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or lose half its current HP. A creature that fails this save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or losing half its current HP on a failure.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target is grappled.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The Nycaloth magically turns invisible until it attacks or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

action.name: Teleport
entries: The nycaloth magically teleports, along with any creatures it is grappling, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the ram moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ram has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The ram has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

trait.name: Oozing Mass
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Impelled Division
entries: When the jelly would be dealt any lightning or slashing damage, it divides into two Ochre Jelly Pluribles with hit points equal to half the jelly's that act on its initiative.

action.name: Sloshing Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.
This attack has advantage against a target in the ooze's space.

action.name: Fleshfueled Regeneration
entries: The jelly dissolves the flesh from an intact corpse in its space, regaining 15 hit points.

reaction.name: Engulfing Wave
entries: When a creature moves within 10 feet of the jelly, it can lurch up to 10 feet, then force each creature whose space it entered in this way to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 12).

reaction.name: Splitting Impulse
entries: When the jelly is targeted with a spell of 1st level or above, it can deal 2 (1d4) lightning damage to itself and to each other creature in its space.
If it does, the spell instead targets one of the Ochre Jelly Pluribles created by its Impelled Division.

trait.name: Oozing Master
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.
Oozes within 500 feet with an intelligence score of 4 or lower act under the jelly's telepathic control, and have their movement speed increased by 10 feet.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Impelled Spawning
entries: When the jelly would be dealt any lightning or slashing damage, it can spawn an Ochre Jelly Plurible that acts on its initiative in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. If it does, the jelly loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jelly makes two attacks with its Sloshing Pseudopod, each of which it can replace with a use of its Fleshfueled Regeneration.

action.name: Sloshing Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.
This attack has advantage against a target in the ooze's space.

action.name: Fleshfueled Regeneration
entries: The jelly dissolves the flesh from an intact corpse in its space, regaining 15 hit points.

action.name: Crawling Sparks (3rd Level Spell)
entries: A pulse of electricity spreads across a surface the jelly is touching, shocking each creature of the jelly's choice within 30 feet of the jelly and within 5 feet of that surface.
Each affected creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) lightning damage and be Dazed until the end of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Vent Fumes (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The jelly spews dense, toxic fumes in a 20 foot radius, heavily obscuring the area until they dissipate at the end of its next turn.

A creasture that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) acid plus 9 (2d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Engulfing Wave
entries: When a creature moves within 10 feet of the jelly, it can lurch up to 10 feet, then force each creature whose space it entered in this way to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 14).

trait.name: Oozing Mass
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Sloshing Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.
This attack has advantage against a target in the ooze's space.

action.name: Fleshfueled Regeneration
entries: The jelly dissolves the flesh from an intact corpse in its space, regaining 15 hit points.
If the corpse was size Medium or larger, the jelly transforms into an Ochre Jelly Gurgler with hit points equal to the jelly's.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends, the octopus can't use its tentacles on another target.

action.name: Ink Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: A 5-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The ogre deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ogre makes two Bash attacks.

action.name: Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the ogre can push the target 5 feet away if the target is Huge or smaller.

reaction.name: Block the Path
entries: When a creature enters a space within 5 feet of the ogre, the ogre makes a Bash attack against that creature. If the attack hits, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the start of the ogre's next turn.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bolt Launcher
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d10 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chain Smash (Recharge 6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw if it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Chain Sweep
entries: The ogre swings its chain, and every creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ogre's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The ogre can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The ogre's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The ogre regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ogre makes two attacks, either with its claws or its glaive.

action.name: Claw (Oni Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Glaive
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage in Small or Medium form.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The ogre magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a Large giant, or back into its true form. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. The only equipment that is transformed is its glaive, which shrinks so that it can be wielded in humanoid form. If the ogre dies, it reverts to its true form, and its glaive reverts to its normal size.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Goblin Projectile
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft. (can't hit targets within 30 feet of the hucker), one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (4d4) piercing damage if the projectile is wearing a spiked helmet. Hit or Miss: The goblin projectile takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet it travels through the air (maximum 20d6).

trait.name: Howdah
entries: The ogre carries a compact fort on its back. Up to four Small creatures can ride in the fort without squeezing. To make a melee attack against a target within 5 feet of the ogre, they must use spears or weapons with reach. Creatures in the fort have three-quarters cover against attacks and effects from outside it. If the ogre dies, creatures in the fort are placed in unoccupied spaces within 5 feet of the ogre.

action.name: Mace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Oinoloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. An oinoloth will usually accept a rate of its challenge rating times 25 gp, or half as much for a creature willing to pledge a future service.

trait.name: Bringer of Plagues
entries: The Oinoloth is immune to the effects of disease. A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the oinoloth must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be infected with wastegash.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oinoloth makes two claw attacks and uses its Teleport or its Transfixing Gaze, if available.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Teleport (spell, 3rd level)
entries: The yagnoloth magically teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Transfixing Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is infected with wasterot must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the oinoloth for the next minute, or until its disease is cured. While charmed in this way, the target does its best to follow the commands of the oinoloth, and repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Wall of Vermin (1/Day)
entries: The oinoloth summons a wall of writhing vermin on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall counts as difficult terrrain, is 5 ft. thick and comprised of six contiguous segments each up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high. A creature that begins its turn in the wall or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 23 (5d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with filth fever.

reaction.name: Dark Escape
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the oinoloth may shroud itself in a 20 foot radius cloud of magical darkness until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Corrupted Healing
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 30 ft. reciving magical healing, the oinoloth forces the creature to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. A creature infected with a disease makes this save at disadvantage. On a failure, the creature has vulnerability to all damage for the next minute, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The oni's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The oni regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack (Oni Form Only)
entries: The oni uses makes one glaive attack and uses its creeping sleep ability.

action.name: Hidden Glaive
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Creeping Sleep
entries: One creature within 15 feet must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature falls asleep until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead falls asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The oni magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a cloud of black mist, or back into its true form. In its mist form, it cannot make attacks, has resistance to weapon damage, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The only equipment that is transformed is its glaive, which shrinks so that it can be wielded in humanoid form. If the oni dies, it reverts to its true form, and its glaive reverts to its normal size.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The oni becomes invisible until it takes another action.

reaction.name: Mutable Form
entries: As a reaction to taking 15 or more damage from a single source, the Oni may use is change shape ability.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The oracle's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Blessings of the Gods
entries: While the oracle is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier. In addition, a creature that hits the oracle with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) force damage.

action.name: Eldritch Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) force damage.

reaction.name: Divine Insight (3/Day)
entries: When the oracle or a creature it can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, the oracle can cause the roll to be made with advantage or disadvantage.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Foe Smiter of Ilneval
entries: The orc deals an extra die of damage when it hits with a longsword attack (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The orc makes two melee attacks with its longsword or two ranged attacks with its javelins. If Ilneval's Command is available to use, the orc can use it after these attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Ilneval's Command (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Up to three allied orcs within 120 feet of this orc that can hear it can use their reactions to each make one weapon attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The orc is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The orc has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The orc makes two claw attacks, or four claw attacks if it has fewer than half of its hit points remaining.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a Bonus Action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Powerful Strikes
entries: If the orc moved at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Swift Arm of Vengeance
entries: When the eye of Gruumsh is reduced below 61 hit points, each friendly orc within 15 feet may use its reaction to make a single melee weapon attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eye of Gruumsh makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Warbreaker Hammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chaos Hammer (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each other creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) thunder damage and be knocked prone, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Savage Demise
entries: When the orc drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to make a single attack before falling unconscious.

reaction.name: Eye of Wrath
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the orc forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the attacker's next turn. A creature frightened in this way must use all of its movement to move away from the orc.

name: Orc Hand of Yurtrus
languages: understands Common and Orcish but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The orc is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no verbal components to cast its spells. The orc has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

action.name: Touch of the White Hand
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Corrupted Carrier
entries: When the orc is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes, and any creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and becomes poisoned. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. A creature poisoned by this effect can repeat the save at the end of each of its turn, ending the effect on itself on a success. While poisoned by this effect, a creature can't regain hit points.

trait.name: Nurtured One of Yurtrus
entries: The orc has advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

action.name: Corrupted Vengeance
entries: The orc reduces itself to 0 hit points, triggering its Corrupted Carrier trait.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, the orc can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Hand of Shargaas
entries: The orc deals 2 extra dice of damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack (included in its attacks).

trait.name: Shargaas's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the orc's darkvision.

trait.name: Slayer
entries: In the first round of a combat, the orc has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet. If the orc hits a creature that round who was surprised, the hit is automatically a critical hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The orc makes two scimitar or dart attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Veil of Shargaas (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The orc casts darkness without any components. Wisdom is its spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Gruumsh's Fury
entries: The orc deals an extra 4 () damage when it hits with a weapon attack (included in the attacks).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The orc makes two attacks with its greataxe or its spear.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (1d12 + 4 plus 1d8) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d6 + 4 plus 1d8) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Battle Cry (1/Day)
entries: Each creature of the war chief's choice that is within 30 feet of it, can hear it, and not already affected by Battle Cry gain advantage on attack rolls until the start of the war chief's next turn. The war chief can then make one attack as a bonus action.

name: Orcus, Master of Lichdom

resist.preNote: damage from attacks made without advantage

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: The Shadow That Was (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Orcus is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 324 hit points and rises as a shade from his body, gaining vulnerability to radiant damage and losing his Magic Resistance.

trait.name: Master of the Dead and Deathless
entries: The area in a 30 foot radius around Orcus seethes with the raw magic of death and undeath. When a creature starts its turn in the area, he may cause it to take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. At the beginning of each of Orcus' turns, up to four undead creatures in the area that were reduced to 0 hit points since the end of his last turn each regain 1 hit point.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Orcus may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Orcus. While climbing on Orcus, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against Orcus.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Orcus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Orcus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Orcus makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with The Wand of Orcus. He may replace one of these attacks with a use of his Bloodlord's Contempt, if available.

action.name: The Wand of Orcus
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning plus 55 (10d10) necrotic damage and the target suffers one additional effect of Orcus' choice:

items.name: Vile Rupture
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have one of its eyes rupture in a gout of vitreous fluid. A creature that fails by 5 or more falls prone and has both of its eyes rupture.

items.name: Black Iron Bloodwell
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or lose half of its current hit points as blood evacuates from each of its orifices. A creature that loses fewer than 50 hit points in this way additionally gains a point of exhaustion.

items.name: Curse of Living Bones
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A creature cursed in this way has its skeleton animated within it, and must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw at the start of each of its turns or have its body move under its skeleton's control until the beginning of its next turn. If the creature dies, a skeletal liberator tears free of its flesh at the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Soulshredder Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 8) slashing plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 24). A creature killed by this damage cannot be returned to life by any means short of a wish spell.

action.name: Bloodlord's Contempt (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of Orcus' choice that he can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or gain a doom counter that can't be removed by any means short of a wish spell. Whenever a creature drops to 0 hit points, it immediately fails a death save for each doom counter it has.

reaction.name: Waste Not
entries: As a reaction when a skeleton tears free from a corpse Orcus can see, Orcus animates the remnants into a Bloodrot Ooze and a Skin Kite, which each appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces.

legendary.name: Spectral Call
entries: A voidsoul specter that lasts a minute and acts on initiative count 0 spills forth from Orcus' wand, appearing in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of him.

legendary.name: Spiteful Command
entries: One undead creature Orcus can see of CR 10 or lower can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Graveway Travel (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Orcus turns to dust and crumbles away, then burst from the earth in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the space he departed must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of his next turn.

mythic.name: The Final Word (10th Level Spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Orcus and one other creature he can see must each succeed on a DC 23 Charisma saving throw or die.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the oread may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

trait.name: Sure-footed
entries: The oread has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oread makes two attacks with its elusive bow.

action.name: Elusive Bow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the oread becomes invisible to the target until the end of the oread's next turn. This bow can fire arrows, bolts, or javelins.

action.name: Rough Shove
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 ft. away. A creature that cannot see the oread makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Catch Token
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a ranged weapon attack, the oread catches the projectile. As long as it holds this projectile, it gains +2 AC against the attacker's attacks. If the oread fires the projectile back at its owner, the attack hits automatically.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the orog can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The orog makes two greataxe attacks.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 () on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: The otyugh slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the otyugh's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Raking Flyby
entries: The owl does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures that it started its turn hidden from.

trait.name: Silent Flight
entries: While flying in dim light or darkness, the owl can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is blinded until the end of the owl's next turn.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the ox moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The oxen is considered to be a Huge animal for the purposes of determining its carrying capacity.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The panther has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the panther moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the panther can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

action.name: Beaks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage, or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The parrot can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

name: Pazuzu, Gatekeeper of the Abyss
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Evangel of the Four Winds
entries: Creatures with a fly speed within 300 feet of Pazuzu may Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action, and have disadvantage on attacks made against him.

trait.name: Perfidious Aid
entries: When another creature that Pazuzu can see fails a saving throw, he may allow it to reroll the save. If it does, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage as a Mark of Corruption sears itself into the creature's flesh.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Pazuzu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Madness of the Lower Aerie (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Pazuzu is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 291 hit points and each creature with a Mark of Corruption explosively sprouts a number of ragged, bloody wings, losing half its current hit points and gaining a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Pazuzu makes three attacks with his Spear of the Stolen Winds.

action.name: Spear of the Stolen Winds
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage and the target suffers one of the following effects:

items.name: Wind of Dreams
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be launched up to 30 feet in any direction, and be magically unaffected by gravity until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Wind of Awakening
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw or gain vulnerability to damage from falling until the end of the turn and have each spell and magical effect on it end.

action.name: Heartrot Tail Sting
entries: One creature within 10 feet of Pazuzu must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or take 54 (12d8) necrotic plus 42 (12d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Pestilent Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Pazuzu exhales a plague of abyssal locusts in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area loses concentration, if it was holding it, and must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) piercing plus 28 (8d6) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Devouring Rain (Recharges when Pazuzu uses his Pestilent Breath, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: An acrid rain begins to fall in a 15 foot radius, 300 foot tall cylinder centered on a point Pazuzu can see within 300 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the area, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage melts and is disintegrated.

reaction.name: Feign Weakness (Recharges when Pazuzu voluntarily fails a saving throw)
entries: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, Pazuzu falls prone.
When a creature enters his reach before the beginning of his next turn, Pazuzu may immediately stand and make a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Corruption (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when Pazuzu's mythic trait becomes active, Pazuzu forces one creature he can see with a Mark of Corruption to succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him.
While charmed, the creature acts under Pazuzu's control and repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Favorable Currents
entries: One creature with a fly speed that Pazuzu can see  may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Traveling Storm
entries: Pazuzu moves the area of his Devouring Rain up to 30 feet.

legendary.name: Wind of Folly
entries: One creature Pazuzu can see must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in any direction.
A creature with a Mark of Corruption has disadvantage on this saving throw.

mythic.name: Wind of the Amorites (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Pazuzu moves up to his speed and uses his multiattack.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The peafowl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The peafowl has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the peafowl's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The pentadrone may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the pentadrone is within 30 feet of a decaton, it uses the decaton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the decaton is using a nonaton's attack bonus, the pentadrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pentadrone makes five attacks with its Spinning Slap.

action.name: Spinning Slap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chaos Alert!
entries: The modron loudly lists the violations of the laws of cosmic order it can see. Until the beginning of its next turn, friendly quadrones that can hear it have advantage on attacks against any creature that is concentrating on a spell.

action.name: Pyschosoma Ether (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The pentadrone exhales a desensitizing gas in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Restrain Chaos (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature the pentadrone can see within 30 feet makes an attack or casts a damaging spell, the pentadrone causes the attack or spell to deal minimum damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a decaton within 60 feet die or transform, the pentadrone may transform into a decaton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one pentadrone may take this reaction.

name: Pestilence Demon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The demon makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Spores (Recharge 6)
entries: A 15-foot-radius cloud of toxic spores extends out from the demon. The spores spread around corners. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a target takes 5 (1d10) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Emptying a vial of holy water on the target also ends the effect on it.

action.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
entries: The demon emits a horrific screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it and that isn't a demon must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the demon's next turn.

name: Phaerimm
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The phaerimm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Desiccating Dweomer
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect of the phaerimm's has any potions or other liquids it is carrying dry up, becoming unusable until rehydrated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phaerimm makes five attacks, one of which may be with its bite or its stinger.

action.name: Grinding Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 46 (8d10 + 2) piercing damage. A creature killed by this damage has its corpse utterly destroyed.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the phaerimm can grapple the target (escape DC 14).

action.name: Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute. A poisoned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Implant Egg
entries: The phaerimm makes a stinger attack against a poisoned creature. If the attack hits, the phaerimm deposits an egg in the wound. The creature is paralyzed and levitates 3 ft. off the ground until a creature makes a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check to remove the egg, or until the egg hatches in 2d20 hours, killing the host. Each attempt (successful or not) deals 1d4 points of damage to the host.

reaction.name: Absorption
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the phaerimm gains temporary hit points equal to 10 times the level of the spell.

reaction.name: Reflection
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the phaerimm changes the spell's target to a creature of its choice that it can see within 30 ft.

legendary.name: Tortuous Compulsion (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage. A creature that takes 10 or more psychic damage in this way acts under the phaerimm's control on its following turn.

legendary.name: Wrack (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. is overwhelmed with indescribable pain. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more subtracts 1d4 from attacks and saving throws it makes for the next minute.

legendary.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Blood wells up in the mouth and lungs of a creature, suffocating it. One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Phoenix
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the phoenix may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the phoenix. While climbing on the phoenix, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the phoenix, and the phoenix can't make melee attacks against it. A creature that isn't prone may attempt this check as a reaction in place of an attack of opportunity.

trait.name: Dampened Flames
entries: If the phoenix takes 10 or more cold damage from a single source, attacks against it are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn. If the phoenix takes 20 or more cold damage from a single source, its Inner Fire trait ceases to function until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Fiery Rebirth
entries: When the phoenix is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die. Instead, its body crumbles to ash, revealing a new phoenix fledgeling. This trait is suspended in an area infused with unholy power by the Hallow spell. If the phoenix's body is completely destroyed while this trait is suspended, the phoenix dies.

trait.name: Inner Fire
entries: A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 11 (2d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the phoenix fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phoenix makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) piercing damage and 11 (2d10) fire damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) slashing damage and 11 (2d10) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the phoenix can't use its talons on another target.

action.name: Shake Off
entries: Each creature climbing on the phoenix must succeed on a DC 18 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or lose its grip and fall. The phoenix may then make a talon attack targeting a creature that failed this save as it falls.

action.name: Wing Attack
entries: The phoenix beats its wings. Each creature within 20 feet of the phoenix that isn't climbing on it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 ft. away, and and be knocked prone. The phoenix can then fly up to half its flying speed.

action.name: Eruption Wake (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The phoenix moves up to its fly speed, and a 20-foot wide section of the ground it passes over begins to shake violently. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

At the beginning of the phoenix's next turn, lava erupts in the area. For the next minute, each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 55 (10d10) fire damage.

reaction.name: Quickening Scream (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 158 hit points, the phoenix lets out a mighty screech. Each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the phoenix's next turn. 1d4 Lava Children emerge from unoccupied areas of lava within range.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the piercer remains motionless on the ceiling, it is indistinguishable from a normal stalactite.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The piercer can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Drop
entries: One creature directly underneath the piercer must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) piercing damage per 10 feet fallen, up to 21 (6d6), and have the piercer embed itself in the  wound. A surprised creature makes this save at disadvantage. The piercer may be removed as an action with a successful DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check.

action.name: Digest
entries: One creature the piercer is embedded in must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) acid damage and be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to a creature attempting to remove it from a wound, the piercer thrashes. The creature it is embedded in must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) piercing damage and be stunned until the end of the piercer's next turn.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The piranha has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The piranha can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Cargo Hauler
entries: The bosun has advantage on Strength checks.

trait.name: Sea Legs
entries: The bosun has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

action.name: Light Hammer
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hook
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

trait.name: Pirate's Panache
entries: If the pirate makes a successful DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics check as part of its movement, its gains Panache until the end of its turn. While the pirate has panache, it makes attacks at advantage and a creature it hits with an attack is pushed 5 ft. away.

trait.name: Bravado
entries: While the pirate is not incapacitated, it always appears to succeed on saving throws, even when it fails.

trait.name: Fearsome Reputation
entries: The pirate's reputation for mercy to those who surrender and ruthlessness to those who resist is known to any creature with proficiency in History.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pirate makes three attacks with its cutlass. Then, if the pirate has Panache, it may use its Inspiring Advance ability.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or drop one item is is holding.

action.name: Brace of Flintlocks
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. The pirate has four pistols that each contain one shot and can be reloaded on a short or long rest.

action.name: Inspiring Advance
entries: Each friendly pirate within 30 ft. increases its movement speed by 10 ft. and has advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks until the beginning of the captain's next turn.

reaction.name: Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the pirate makes a melee attack against the attacker.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deck wizard is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Sea Legs
entries: The deck wizard has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Sea Legs
entries: The first mate has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The first mate makes two attacks with its longsword.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands. If the target is a creature, the first mate can choose to deal no damage with the attack to disarm the target. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding on the ground.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pixie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: The pixie is  invisible to creatures with less than 20 Passive Perception. Whenever it is hit with an attack, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Pixie Dust
entries: One creature within 15 feet gains a 60 foot fly speed for the next hour.

action.name: Grasping Vines
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained by entangling vines (escape DC 13).

action.name: Drowsy Drift
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep until the sleeper takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake.

name: Planetar
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The planetar's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the planetar is attacking with them.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The planetar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Cowing Presence
