entries: If the planetar has at least 101 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the planetar must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the planetar until the beginning of its next turn. A creature has advantage on this save if it took damage from the planetar since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: If the planetar has 100 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the planetar must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the planetar until the beginning of its next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature has vulnerability to radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The planetar makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Sword of Wrath
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage and the creature must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to salt and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

action.name: Plague of Locusts
entries: Each creature of the planetar's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (5d10) piercing damage. Until the end of the planetar's next turn, the affected area is difficult terrain and heavily obscured for all other creatures.

action.name: Judgement of Heaven
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The planetar touches another creature that is alive, or has been dead for no more than a century. If the target was dead, it is restored to life with 1 HP. Then, the target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, deafness, or petrification.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The plasmoid can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide, provided it is wearing and carrying nothing. It has advantage on ability checks it makes to initiate or escape a grapple.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The plasmoid can hold its breath for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plasmoid makes three Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit (with advantage if the plasmoid has one or more allies within 10 feet of itself), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: The plasmoid halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. The plasmoid must be able to see the attacker.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The plasmoid can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide, provided it is wearing and carrying nothing. It has advantage on ability checks it makes to initiate or escape a grapple.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The plasmoid can hold its breath for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plasmoid makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one of those attacks with a Javelin attack.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plasmoid makes three Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one of those attacks with a Spear or Pistol attack.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Pistol
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Serpentine Neck
entries: The plesiosaurus can move up to 10 feet into any space large enough for a Small creature without squeezing.

trait.name: Countershading
entries: The plesiosaurus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures above it in open water.

action.name: Shellsplitter Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

action.name: Dark Water Ambush (Recharge 6)
entries: The plesiosaurus moves up to its speed in a straight line towards a creature it is hidden from and makes a bite attack against it.
If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the plesiosaurus' next turn.

reaction.name: Darting Snap
entries: As a reaction when a creature enters its reach, the plesiosaurus makes a bite attack against it, then moves up to 10 feet.

name: Podling
languages: the languages the creature knew in life

trait.name: Semblance of Life
entries: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a bodytaker plant. The podling has the digested creature's memories and behaves like that creature, but with occasional lapses. An observer familiar with the digested creature can recognize the discrepancies with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check, or automatically if the podling does something in direct contradiction to the digested creature's established beliefs or behavior. The podling melts into a slurry when it dies, when the bodytaker plant that created it dies, or when the bodytaker plant dismisses it (no action required).

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The podling doesn't require sleep.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Poison Weird

trait.name: Invisible in Water
entries: The weird is invisible while fully immersed in toxic brew.

trait.name: Brew Bound
entries: The weird dies if forced to leave the basin of toxic brew it inhabits, or if a purify food and drink spell is cast on the brew.

trait.name: Poisonous Body
entries: A creature takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns while grappled by a poison weird.

resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and pulled 5 feet toward the poison weird. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the poison weird tries to drown it, and the poison weird can't constrict another target.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The bear can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the bear must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Rear Up
entries: The bear may use 30 ft. of its movement to stand upright until the end of its turn. While standing, the bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and attacks made with its claws, and cannot attack with its bite.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same medium or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 9 (2d8) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Run Down
entries: As a reaction to a hostile creature the bear can see ending its movement at least 20 ft. further from the bear than it started, the bear moves up to its speed towards the creature.
If the bear ends this movement within 5 ft. of the creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Poltergeist
resist: damage other than the type that killed it
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The poltergeist can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The poltergeist is invisible. While invisible, the poltergeist can attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action. If fine particles  of silver are scattered in its space, it loses this invisibility for the next minute.

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the poltergeist is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it ceases to be invisible and loses the ability to take actions, though it can still communicate. After 1d4 hours, the poltergeist recovers all of its hit points. While at 0 hit points, the poltergeist can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unfinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Interring its remains with the Ceremony spell.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrust
entries: The poltergeist hurls a creature or object weighing up to 150 lbs. up to 30 feet. An unwilling creature makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw, resisting the effect on a success. If a thrown creature strikes a solid object surface, the creature takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrash (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a  DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. The poltergeist ceases to be invisible until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the poltergeist is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Acidic Blood
entries: When the hydra takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the hydra may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the hydra. While climbing on the hydra, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the hydra, and the hydra can't make melee attacks against it. A creature that isn't prone may attempt this check as a reaction in place of an attack of opportunity.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious. Whenever the hydra takes 40 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, the hydra has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, the hydra makes a DC 16 Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning of its last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn. The hydra regains 15 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only to make opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Shed Head
entries: When the hydra fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The hydra deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away from the hydra.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The hydra makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
entries: The hydra makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Trampling Charge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The hydra moves up to 50 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature Huge or smaller. The first time it enters each creature's space during this move, it can make a stomp attack against that creature.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Divine Eminence

This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the priest expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by  for each level above 1st.

trait.name: Aberrant Mind

entries: The psurlon has advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the frightened, stunned, or unconscious condition on itself. While one of the psurlon's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Psychic Crush

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The pteranodon doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

name: Purple Worm
resist: weapon attacks not made from inside it

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Earth Quaker
entries: When the worm burrows 30 feet or fewer below the surface, 10 foot wide, 10 foot deep fissures open at the surface above where it passes. Creatures in the space where a fissure opens must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone in the trench, or move to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area on a success.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the worm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Shock Sensitivity
entries: If the worm, or the ground within 30 feet of it is subjected to lightning damage, it cannot use its Terror From the Deep action on its next turn, and must use all of its movement to surface.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Terror From the Deep (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Worm moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half damage on a success. As a bonus action, the worm may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this save.

reaction.name: Dweomersense
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of 4th level or above, the purple worm may move up to its burrow speed. If it is no longer a valid target for the spell, the spell slot is not expended and the spell caster may choose a different use for their action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wormling makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Small or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the wormling, and it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wormling's turns.

If the wormling takes 10 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wormling must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wormling. If the wormling dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tail Stinger

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The quadrone may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the quadrone is within 30 feet of a pentadrone, it uses the pentadrone's attack bonus instead of its own. If the pentadrone is using a decaton's attack bonus, the quadrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quadrone makes four attacks with its Springlock Shortbow, two of which it may replace with its Clanking Kick.

action.name: Clanking Kink
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Springlock Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Troubleshoot
entries: As a reaction when a friendly modron within 5 feet fails a Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom saving throw, the quadrone adds 4 to its result.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a pentadrone within 60 feet die or transform, the quadrone may transform into a pentadrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one quadrone may take this reaction.

trait.name: Wounded Fury
entries: While it has 10 hit points or fewer, the quaggoth has advantage on attack rolls. In addition, it deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to any target it hits with a melee attack.

trait.name: Psychic Sensitivity
entries: If the quaggoth takes psychic damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Corpse Eater
entries: If the quaggoth hits a dead or unconscious creature with its bite, it gains resistance to all damage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quaggoth makes two attacks; one its Claw and one with its Bite.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the quetzalcoatlus is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 18-20.

trait.name: Throat Pouch
entries: A creature grappled by the quetzalcoatlus is blinded and restrained in the quetzalcoatlus' throat pouch.

action.name: Savage Peck
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned until the end of the quetzalcoatlus' next turn.

action.name: Scoop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it's a Large or smaller creature.

action.name: Battering Wings
entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 ft away. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls prone, additionally. The quetzalcoatlus' speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Flip Back
entries: As a reaction to a creature falling prone within 10 ft. of it, the quetzalcoatlus makes a Scoop attack against the creature.

trait.name: Blurred Movement
entries: Attack rolls against the quickling have disadvantage unless the quickling is incapacitated or has its movement speed reduced.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the quickling is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Small and Distant
entries: While at least 60 ft. from any hostile creature, the quickling can attempt to Hide as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quickling makes three dagger attacks.

action.name: Cutpurse Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the quickling steals a worn or carried item from the target.

reaction.name: Cackling Caprice
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the quickling may force the creature to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The quipper has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The quipper can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

name: Red Abishai
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
entries: The commands of the abishai carry with them the authority of Tiamat. A chromatic dragon that starts its turn within 120 ft. of the abishai takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage the first time each turn it disobeys a command of the abishai, then must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the abishai for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai makes three attacks: one with its morningstar, one with its claw, and one with its bite.

action.name: Terrorstrike Morningstar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the abishai's next turn. On a critical hit, the target loses any immunity it has to the frightened condition for the next minute.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.

action.name: Incite Fanaticism
entries: The abishai chooses up to four of its allies within 60 feet of it that can see it. For 1 minute, each of those allies makes attack rolls with advantage and can't be frightened.

reaction.name: Dragonspawn Exhultation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly dragon within 30 ft. using its breath weapon, the abishai may move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The slaad regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace up to one of its attacks with a use of its Mighty Leap.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Vicious Kick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 5 (2d4) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Ovoduct Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with a slaad egg.

action.name: Mighty Leap
entries: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Iron Boots
entries: The redcap has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

trait.name: Outsize Strength
entries: While grappling, the redcap is considered to be Medium. Also, wielding a heavy weapon doesn't impose disadvantage on its attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The redcap makes three Wicked Sickle attacks.

action.name: Wicked Sickle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Ironbound Pursuit
entries: The redcap moves up to its speed to a creature it can see and kicks with its iron boots. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

trait.name: Test Bite
entries: If the shark starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may Dash or Disengage as a bonus action this turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The shark has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Reflection
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The reflection can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the reflection can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the reflection has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Strength Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by . The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new reflection rises from the corpse  hours later.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the caribou moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Relentless Juggernaut
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the juggernaut fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The juggernaut regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If the juggernaut takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The juggernaut dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The juggernaut doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The juggernaut makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with Deadly Shaping if it is ready.

action.name: Executioner's Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the juggernaut's next turn.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Deadly Shaping (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The juggernaut magically shapes a feature of its surroundings into a deadly implement. A creature the juggernaut can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the targeted creature is struck by one of the following (juggernaut's choice):

action.name: Flying Stone
entries: The target takes 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and is incapacitated until the start of the juggernaut's next turn, and the implement vanishes.

action.name: Scything Shrapnel
entries: The target takes 14 (4d6) slashing damage, and the implement vanishes. At the start of each of its turns, the target takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage from the wound left by the shrapnel. The wound ends if the target regains any hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

legendary.name: Implacable Advance
entries: The juggernaut moves up to its speed, ignoring difficult terrain. Any object in its path takes 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage if it isn't being worn or carried.

legendary.name: Rapid Shaping (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The juggernaut recharges Deadly Shaping and uses it.

name: Relentless Slasher
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the slasher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Shrouded Presence
entries: The slasher is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, and it can't be detected by abilities that sense Fiends.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slasher makes two Slasher's Knife attacks.

action.name: Slasher's Knife
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it suffers a lingering wound that causes it to take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the slasher hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 3 (). The wound ends if the target regains hit points or if a creature uses an action to stanch the wound, which requires a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

legendary.name: Slice
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Vanishing Strike (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The slasher makes one Slasher's Knife attack. After the attack hits or misses, the slasher can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). The relic sloth can grapple no more than two targets at a time.

reaction.name: Slow but Sturdy
entries: When the relic sloth is subjected to an effect that would move it out of its current space or knock it prone, it is neither moved nor knocked prone.

name: Retriever
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The retriever can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The retriever is given a quarry by its master. The quarry can be a specific creature or object the master is personally acquainted with, or it can be a general type of creature or object the master has seen before. The retriever knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The retriever can have only one such quarry at a time. The retriever also always knows the location of its master.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The retriever has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The retriever makes two foreleg attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its telekinetic beam.

action.name: Rending Forelegs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Telekinetic Beam
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be dragged 30 ft. toward the retriever.

action.name: Force Beam (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The retriever emits a beam of transdimensional force in an 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 77 (14d10) force damage, or half as much on a successful save. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell, 2/Day)
entries: The retriever and up to four unconscious or incapacitated creatures on its back teleport to a location on this or another plane of existence. An unwilling creature makes a DC 18 Charisma saving throw, and is not teleported away on a success.

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The retriever restrains an incapacitated or prone target with steel netting (escape DC 18). If the target is Large or smaller, the retreiver may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action. The netting can be attacked and destroyed (AC 18; HP 10; immunity to poison and psychic damage)

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the retriever moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the retriver out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the retriever is unaffected.

reaction.name: Bloodied Beam (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 144 hit points, the retriever immediately recharges and uses its force beam.

name: Revenant
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The revenant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the revenant takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the revenant's next turn. The revenant's body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: When the revenant's body is destroyed, its soul lingers. After 24 hours, the soul inhabits and animates another humanoid corpse on the same plane of existence and regains all its hit points. While the soul is bodiless, a wish spell can be used to force the soul to go to the afterlife and not return.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The revenant is immune to effects that turn undead.

trait.name: Vengeful Tracker
entries: The revenant knows the distance to and direction of any creature against which it seeks revenge, even if the creature and the revenant are on different planes of existence. If the creature being tracked by the revenant dies, the revenant knows.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The revenant makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature against which the revenant has sworn vengeance, the target takes an extra 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the revenant can grapple the target (escape DC 14) provided the target is Large or smaller.

action.name: Vengeful Glare
entries: The revenant targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it and against which it has sworn vengeance. The target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target is paralyzed until the revenant deals damage to it, or until the end of the revenant's next turn. When the paralysis ends, the target is frightened of the revenant for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if it can see the revenant, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the rhinoceros moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the serpent can't constrict another target.

name: Roper
resist: piercing damage from nonmagical sources made with ranged weapons

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roper makes six attacks, one of which may be with its ravening maw, and uses its Reel.

action.name: Ravening Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage. This attack is made with advantage against a grappled creature. On a critical hit, the target is frightened until the end of the roper's next turn.

action.name: Tendril Snare
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Wrench
entries: One creature grappled by at least two tendrils must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapples.

action.name: Reel
entries: The roper pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

trait.name: Rancid Degeneration
entries: At the end of each of the troll's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, unless the troll has taken acid or fire damage since the end of its last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the rothe moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Club
entries: In the rotter's hand, its club is magical and deals 7 (3d4) extra damage (included in its attacks).

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The rotter has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The rotter regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it is in contact with the ground. If the rotter takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the rotter's next turn. The rotter dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Shared Senses
entries: The rotter can see and hear what any plant within 120 ft can see and hear. In addition, the rotter can communicate telepathically with any plant within this range.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on each of its turns, the rotter can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one copse of mushrooms within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second copse of mushrooms within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second copse. Both copses of mushrooms must be Large or bigger. The rotter doesn't need to be able to see the second copse to use this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rotter makes two attacks with its club.

action.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Ruin Grinder
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the ruin grinder is subjected to fire damage, it regains a number of hit points equal to half the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The ruin grinder deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The ruin grinder can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ruin grinder makes two Excavator attacks.

action.name: Excavator
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) force damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Iron Scent
entries: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Rust Metal
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

trait.name: Oxide Armor
entries: Whenever the Rust Monster takes any acid or lightning damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the end of its next turn. Whenever the Rust Monster takes any fire damage, its AC is improved by 2 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Antennae
entries: The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.

If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

trait.name: Immobilizing Fear
entries: When a creature that isn't a demon starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more rutterkins, that creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. The creature has disadvantage on the save if it's within 30 feet of six or more rutterkins. On a failed save, the creature becomes frightened of the rutterkins for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, the creature is restrained. At the end of each of the frightened creature's turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the Crippling Fear of all rutterkins for 24 hours.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned. At the end of each long rest, the poisoned target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points while poisoned in this way, it dies and instantly transforms into a living manes. The transformation can be undone only by a wish spell.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Shocking Grasp (Cantrip)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit (with advantage if the target is wearing armor made of metal), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shield (1st-Level Spell; 3/Day)
entries: When the sage is hit by an attack or targeted by a magic missile spell, it calls forth an invisible barrier of magical force that protects it. Until the start of its next turn, the sage has a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and it takes no damage from magic missile.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The swarm has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Seething
entries: Once it enters combat, the swarm deals 10 slashing damage to itself at the end of its turn if it did not make an attack on that turn. This damage ignores resistance, and it cannot reduce the swarm to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The swarm can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The spinosaurus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spinosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the spinosaurus can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the spinosaurus. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wurm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the wurm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the wurm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns.

If the wurm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wurm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wurm. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and can leave a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

action.name: Debilitating Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales a pulse of high-pitched, nearly inaudible sound in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated.

name: Scaladar
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the scaladar is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage, and its sting deals an extra 11 (2d10) lightning damage until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Scaladar Link
entries: The scaladar knows the location of other scaladar within 100 feet of it, and it can sense when any of them take damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scaladar makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). The scaladar has two claws, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Sting
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage.

action.name: Sting
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d3 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The serpentmaw can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The serpentmaw has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the serpentmaw's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The serpentmaw makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage if the serpentmaw had advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The sea elf has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the sea elf to sleep.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The sea elf can breathe air and water.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The hag may Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action while submerged in water.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can perfectly mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid affected by its Steal Voice.

trait.name: Shipbreaker Coven
entries: The sea within 10 miles of a coven of sea hags is filled with dangerous riptides, jagged reefs, and vicious storms that raise with little warning. Creatures on a ship or shore have disadvantage on ability checks made to spot or assess these dangers.

action.name: Rotflesh Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage and an illusory corruption begins to spread rapidly from the wound, giving the appearance of rotting, waterlogged flesh.
The creature must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the hag's next turn.

action.name: Stolen Spell (Coven Only)
entries: The sea hag casts a spell of third level or below known by a creature affected by its steal voice, using the creature's spell slots.

action.name: Steal Voice (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. of the hag must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or be unable to speak. If a creature fails this saving throw voluntarily, the hag does not require concentration to maintain the effect.

reaction.name: Courage to Dread
entries: As a reaction to a creature succeeding on a saving throw against its rotflesh claw, the hag makes the illusion real, dealing 9 (2d8) necrotic damage to the creature.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The sea horse can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The sea lion can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The sea lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The sea lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sea lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Swimming Leap
entries: With a 10-foot swimming start, the sea lion can long jump out of or across the water up to 25 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sea lion makes three attacks: one bite attack and two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Bio-Tinker
languages: understands Aquan and Common but can't speak

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The bio-tinker can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged in the sea at least once a day for 1 minute to avoid suffocating.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bio-tinker makes two Unarmed Strike attacks and one Piscine Anatomy attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Piscine Anatomy
entries: The bio-tinker uses one of the following options (choose one or roll a ):

items.name: 1-2: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: 3-4: Poison Quills
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 5-6: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the bio-tinker can't use this tentacle on another target.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The seal can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The seal has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The serpopard has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the serpopard moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the serpopard can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The shadar-kai casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

trait.name: Burden of Time
entries: Beasts and Humanoids (except elves) have disadvantage on saving throws while within 10 feet of the shadar-kai.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadar-kai has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadar-kai makes three Shadow Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Shadow Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120, one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 26 (4d12) necrotic damage. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the shadar-kai's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

reaction.name: Misty Escape (Recharge 6)
entries: When the shadar-kai takes damage, it turns invisible and teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It remains invisible until the start of its next turn or until it attacks or casts a spell.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadar-kai has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadar-kai makes three Spiked Chain attacks.
It can use Shadow Jump after one of these attacks.

action.name: Spiked Chain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or suffer one of the following effects (choose one or roll a ):

items.name: 1â€“2: Decay
entries: The target takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

items.name: 3â€“4: Grapple
entries: The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the shadar-kai can't grapple another target.

items.name: 5â€“6: Topple
entries: The target is knocked prone.

bonus.name: Shadow Jump
entries: The shadar-kai teleports, along with any equipment is it wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it teleports from and the space it teleports to must be in dim light or darkness.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The shadar-kai casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadar-kai has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shadar-kai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soul Thirst
entries: When it reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the shadar-kai can gain temporary hit points equal to half the creature's hit point maximum. While the shadar-kai has temporary hit points from this trait, it has advantage on attack rolls.

trait.name: Weight of Ages
entries: Any Beast or Humanoid (except an elf) that starts its turn within 5 feet of the shadar-kai has its speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of that creature's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadar-kai makes two Shadow Dagger attacks.

action.name: Shadow Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws until the end of the shadar-kai's next turn. Hit or Miss: The dagger magically returns to the shadar-kai's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

action.name: Wave of Weariness (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The shadar-kai emits weariness in a 60-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) psychic damage and suffers 1 level of exhaustion. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't gain a level of exhaustion.

name: Shade
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shade can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shade can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the shade has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Strength Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by . The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shade rises from the corpse  hours later.

name: Tenebrous Shadow
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Dark Embrace
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 2) necrotic damage and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Shade Assassin
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The assassin can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the assassin can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the assassin has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes two Shadow Blade attacks.

action.name: Shadow Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Unless the target is immune to necrotic damage, the target's Strength score is reduced by each time it is hit by this attack. The target dies if its Strength is reduced to 0. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shade rises from the corpse hours later.

name: Shadow Demon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The demon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the demon has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the demon can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage or, if the demon had advantage on the attack roll, 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage.

name: Shadow Mastiff Umbra
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ghostlight Hunter
entries: The mastiff can see into the Border Ethereal and can detect by scent the number and direction of each source of bright light within 1 mile.
Additionally, the mastiff loses its resistance to nonmagical damage while in bright light.

action.name: Fearsome Jaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.
A frightened target hit with this attack gains becomes grappled (escape DC 13) or is knocked prone (mastiff's choice).

action.name: Blackening Bay
entries: The mastiff emits a dreadful howl in a 30 foot radius.  Each source of bright light in the area from a nonmagical source or produced by a cantrip or magic of similar strength is snuffed out.

Then, each creature of the mastiff's choice within the area that isn't illuminated by bright light must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is frightened of the mastiff for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
If a target succeeds on its saving throw by 5 or more, it is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

bonus.name: Shadow Blend
entries: If the mastiff isn't in bright light, it can teleport to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness within 30 feet.

bonus.name: Swirling Shadow
entries: If the mastiff isn't in bright light, it can turn invisible until it makes an attack or is in bright light.

name: Shadow Mastiff Alpha
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ghostlight Hunter
entries: The mastiff can see into the Border Ethereal and can detect by scent the number and direction of each source of bright light within 1 mile.
Additionally, the mastiff loses its resistance to nonmagical damage while in bright light.

trait.name: Shadowpack Alpha
entries: Whenever the mastiff takes a bonus action, each other shadow mastiff within 30 feet of it can use its reaction to take a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mastiff makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Blackening Bay.

action.name: Fearsome Jaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.
A frightened target hit with this attack gains becomes grappled (escape DC 13) or is knocked prone (mastiff's choice).

action.name: Blackening Bay
entries: The mastiff emits a dreadful howl in a 30 foot radius.  Each source of bright light in the area from a nonmagical source or produced by a cantrip or magic of similar strength is snuffed out.

Then, each creature of the mastiff's choice within the area that isn't illuminated by bright light must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is frightened of the mastiff for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
If a target succeeds on its saving throw by 5 or more, it is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

bonus.name: Shadow Blend
entries: If the mastiff isn't in bright light, it can teleport to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness within 30 feet.

bonus.name: Swirling Shadow
entries: If the mastiff isn't in bright light, it can turn invisible until it makes an attack or is in bright light.

name: Shadow Mastiff Whisperpack
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ghostlight Hunter
entries: The whisperpack can see into the Border Ethereal and can detect by scent the number and direction of each source of bright light within 1 mile.
Additionally, the whisperpack loses its resistance to nonmagical damage while in bright light.

trait.name: Stumbling Terror
entries: A frightened creature that starts its turn in the whisperpack's space must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13) and knocked prone.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The whisperpack can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature.

action.name: Jaws from the Dark
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (8d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage, or 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage if the whisperpack is at half its maximum hit points or fewer.

action.name: Blackening Chorus (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The whisperpack emits a dreadful howl in a 60 foot radius.  Each source of bright light in the area from a nonmagical source or produced by a 2nd level or magic of similar or lesser strength is snuffed out.

Then, each creature of the whisperpack's choice within the area that isn't illuminated by bright light must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw.  On a failed save, the target is frightened of the whisperpack for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
If a target succeeds on its saving throw by 5 or more, it is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

bonus.name: Shadow Blend
entries: If the whisperpack isn't in bright light, it can teleport to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness within 30 feet, along with each creature grappled by it.

reaction.name: Cringing Slink
entries: When the whisperpack becomes illuminated by bright light, it must use its reaction, if available, to move up to 15 feet directly away from the light's source.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the shadowghast must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this Stench for 24 hours.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadowghast can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadowghast makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boring Roots
entries: One creature grappled by the mound must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw as the shambling mound attempts to bore roots through its flesh. On a failed save, the creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage, and its HP maximum is reduced by the same amount.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

reaction.name: Entangling Hide
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shambling mound can force the attacker to make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The sheep has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shark has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The shark can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shark makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

trait.name: Bound
entries: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target must then make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 11 (2d10) force damage and be pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Protective Wall
entries: The shield guardian can fold into a whirling wall of grinding metal, comprised of three contiguous 10 ft x 10 ft x 1 ft segments. Creatures in the wall's space when it appears must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) slashing damage and be pushed to a side of the guardian's choice. The shield guardian cannot move or take actions while in this form except to resume its normal form as a bonus action.

action.name: Death Ward
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the shield guardian is granted a measure of protection from death. The first time in the next minute that the creature would drop to 0 hit points, it instead drops to 1 hit point.

reaction.name: Interpose
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet targeting the wearer of the guardian's amulet with an attack, the guardian may impose disadvantage on the roll.

trait.name: Shifting (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the shifter takes on a more bestial form for 1 minute or until it dies. The shifter gains 5 temporary hit points. It can make a bite attack when it activates this trait and also as a bonus action on each of its turns while in its bestial form.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
