entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The serpent can hold its breath for 1 hour.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Shoosuva
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the shoosuva reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the shoosuva can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: The shoosuva has advantage on attack rolls against a creature unless that creature hit it with a melee attack since the end of the shoosuva's last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoosuva makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail stinger.

action.name: Latching Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute. While poisoned in this way, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Crush Bones
entries: One creature grappled by the shoosuva takes 52 (8d12) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Abyssal Cackle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shoosuva moves up to 20 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity, emitting an maddening laugh. The attacker and each other creature within 10 ft. of the it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Each creature (other than shoosuvas, gnolls, or hyenas) that failed the save must move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against the nearest creature (or against itself if there are no other creatures in range), starting with the attacker and progressing in initiative order.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the shrieker remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.

action.name: Shriek
entries: When bright light or a creature is within 30 feet of the shrieker, it emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of it. The shrieker continues to shriek until the disturbance moves out of range and for  of the shrieker's turns afterward.

name: Sibriex
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Form of Corruption
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 ft. of one or more sibriexes and is able to see at least one of them must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature has its Wisdom score reduced by 1d4 to a minimum of 1, until it succeeds on this save or leaves the effect's area, as it begins to find its own body to be intollerably misshapen and corrupted.
A creature that succeeds on this save becomes immune to it for 1 hour.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sibriex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the sibreix fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sibriex makes three attacks with its flailing chains.

action.name: Flailing Chains
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 21). A creature grappled by two or more chains is additionally restrained.
Each chain can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to psychic damage and damage not from attacks). Destroying a chain deals no damage to the sibriex.

action.name: Abyssal Graft
entries: One willing or restrained creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 55 (10d10) piercing damage and be afflicted with Flesh Warp as the sibriex surgically implants abyssal matter within it, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Black Bile Slick (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) poison damage and fall prone, or take half as much damage on a success. A grappled creature makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Breeder of Horrors (Concentration)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 163 hit points, the sibriex animates its own spilled blood and bile, causing it to rise as an alkalith that acts on the sibriex's initiative in the nearest unoccupied space. If the sibriex loses concentration within the next minute, the alkalith dies.

legendary.name: Chain Lash
entries: The sibriex makes a flailing chains attack or animates a new chain, to a maximum of three.

legendary.name: Gaze of Perfection (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature the sibriex can see within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by it until the end of the creature's next turn. While charmed in this way, the creature believes that the sibriex is the most perfect and beautiful form of life.

legendary.name: Contaminate Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. of the sibriex that does not have all of its hit points must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of the ecreature's next turn. A creature that has fewer than half of its hit points makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Wave of Bones (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The horror crashes into foes like a wave before quickly reforming. Each creature within 10 feet of the horror must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw is also knocked prone.

trait.name: Disassemble
entries: If the juggernaut is reduced to 0 hit points, twelve skeletons rise from its remains.

trait.name: Falling Apart
entries: If the juggernaut does not have all of its hit points at the start of its turn, it loses 10 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The juggernaut makes two claws attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Avalanche of Bones (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The juggernaut collapses into a large heap before quickly reforming. Each creature within 10 feet of the juggernaut must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw is also knocked prone.

trait.name: Deafening Clatter
entries: Creatures are deafened while in the swarm's space.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small creature.

action.name: Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The horror can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the horror has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror can use its Maddening Presence and make three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Maddening Presence
entries: The horror targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the horror, the target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the target becomes paralyzed until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the horror's Maddening Presence for the next 24 hours.

name: Skull Lord
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Triple Skulls
entries: The skull lord has three skulls, each of which anchor one of its abilities. A creature that reduces the skull lord to 0 hit points chooses one of its remaining skulls to destroy. Then, if the skull lord has any skulls remaining, it regains all of its hit points.

items.name: Skull of Death's Tranquility
entries: While it has this skull, the skull lord and its undead allies within 30 ft. make attacks and saving throws against magical effects at advantage, and take no damage on a successful Constitution save.

items.name: Skull of Bonechilling Fear
entries: While it has this skull, a living creature that starts its turn within 15 ft. of the Skull lord must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Skull of the Grave Master
entries: While it has this skull, at the start of each of the skull lord's turns one destroyed undead creature of CR 3 or below within 30 feet is returned to undeath with full hit points.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the skull lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skull lord casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action and makes two bone staff attacks.

action.name: Bone Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Clutch of Terror (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and the target is dragged up to 15 feet toward the skull lord, then must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Corrupt Marrow (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the end of the skull lord's next turn.

action.name: Finger of Death (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the skull lord can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 62 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage, or half damage on a success.

items.name: A humanoid creature killed by this damage rises as a
entries: Zombie Rotter** under the skull lord's control at the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shield of Bones (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the skull lord or a friendly undead creature is targeted with a ranged attack, the skull lord can raise a shield of bones and earth, granting the target 3/4 cover against ranged attacks until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Heartstop (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature destroys its second-to-last skull, the skull lord can attempt to crush the creature's heart within its chest.
The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. A creature with no unexpended hit dice makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Grave Step
entries: The skull lord moves up to half its speed. A creature that hits the skull lord with an attack of opportunity provoked by this movement takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Death's Command
entries: If the skull lord still has its Skull of Death's Tranquility, one friendly undead creature of CR 3 or below within 30 feet may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Bonechilling Fear
entries: One creature frightened by the skull lord's Skull of Bonechilling Fear must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 9 (2d8) cold damage and 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Gravelord's Excavation
entries: The skull lord excavates a grave 10 ft long, 10 ft. deep, and 5 ft wide centered on a point within 30 ft. Each creature standing in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall in, moving to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area on a success.

legendary.name: Bone Staff (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The skull lord makes an attack with its bone staff.

trait.name: Abolethic Vassal
entries: The skum is permanently charmed by its aboleth master.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The skum can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Psychic Conditioning
entries: The skum is immune to the frightened and charmed conditions unless they are from effects created by an aboleth.

trait.name: Water Dependency
entries: The skum takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes it goes without exposure to water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skum makes three attacks: two with its trident and one with its Mind-Breaking Touch.

action.name: Trident
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Mind-Breaking Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage, and the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws until the end of the skum's next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the leviathan. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the leviathan, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the leviathan's turns.

If the leviathan takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the leviathan must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the leviathan. If the leviathan dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The skyswimmer can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skyswimmer makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its slam.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the skyswimmer. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the skyswimmer, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the skyswimmer's turns. If the skyswimmer takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the skyswimmer must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the skyswimmer. If the skyswimmer dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Rapid Evolution
entries: Each hour it survives, the tadpole adds 10 hit points to its current and maximum hit points. Every 4 hours, the tadpole's size category increases by one step.
After 13 hours, the tadpole transforms into a full grown slaad.

trait.name: Bloody Trail
entries: For the first hour after it emerges, the tadpole leaves a clear trail of blood that creatures have advantage on Survival (Wisdom) checks made to track.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Goreslick Scuttle
entries: The tadpole takes the dodge action. Until the beginning of its next turn, whenever the tadpole is missed with an attack, it may move up to 10 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity.

action.name: Emerge
entries: The tadpole bursts forth from its host's chest in a spray of gore. Each creature that can see it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the tadpole's next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead stunned until the end of the tadpole's next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the bloodfin dies, it explodes in a cloud of toxic blood. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the exploding bloodfin, including any creature swallowed by the bloodfin, must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage. A creature inside the bloodfin when it explodes falls prone in the space formerly occupied by the bloodfin and is no longer blinded or restrained by it.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The bloodfin can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bloodfin makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit (with advantage if the target is a creature missing any hit points), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the bloodfin can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit (with advantage if the target is a creature missing any hit points), reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the bloodfin is grappling. Hit: The bloodfin swallows the target. The swallowed creature is no longer grappled but is blinded and restrained. It has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the bloodfin, it takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the bloodfin regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt. A bloodfin can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the bloodfin takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the bloodfin must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the bloodfin and is no longer blinded or restrained by it.

name: Slithering Tracker
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands languages it knew in its previous form but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the slithering tracker is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the slithering tracker move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the slithering tracker isn't a puddle.

trait.name: Liquid Form
entries: The slithering tracker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can also move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The slithering tracker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Life Leech
entries: One Large or smaller creature that the slithering tracker can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. In addition, the grappled target takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The slithering tracker can grapple only one target at a time.
While grappling the target, the slithering tracker takes only half any damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the target takes the other half.

bonus.name: Watery Stealth
entries: If underwater, the slithering tracker takes the Hide action, and it makes the Dexterity (Stealth) check with advantage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
footerEntries: The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The sludge hag can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The sludge hag can breathe air and water.

action.name: False Appearance
entries: The sludge hag collapses into a oily pool of sludge. While motionless, the sludge hag is indistinguishable from any other oily pool of oozy drippiness.

action.name: Sludge Slap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage, plus 4 (1d8) acid damage. Sludge Slap does both bludgeoning and acid damage

trait.name: Pull Together (1/Day)
entries: When the mephit is reduced to 0 HP, it may turn to smoke and disipate instead of dying. At the beginning of its next turn, it appears within 15 feet of the space it left with 1 Hit Point.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of choking smoke. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute. A creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made at advantage, it deals an additional 2 (1d4) fire damage.

action.name: Billow (Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit wreaths itself in a 10 ft. radius cloud of dense smoke that travels with it. The smoke spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured.

reaction.name: In the Wind
entries: As a reaction to taking slashing or bludgeoning damage, the mephit may teleport up to 30 feet to a location it can see.

name: Snow Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Refreeze
entries: If the golem takes any fire damage, it loses its immunities to cold damage and cantrips until the beginning of its next turn.
If the golem takes any cold damage, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or freeze solid and be petrified.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks, or takes the Dash action and uses its Snowslide.

action.name: Ice-Packed Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
On a critical hit, the target has disadvantge on Dexterity saving throws until the end of the golem's next turn.

action.name: Snowball
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. 0 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage.

action.name: Snowslide (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The snow golem falls prone in the space of a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet and ends its turn. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be engulfed and restrained (escape DC 12), or move to an adjacent space on a success.

A creature restrained in this way can't speak or breathe, and  must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The leopard has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the leopard moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the leopard can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

name: Solar
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The solar's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the Solar is attacking with them.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The solar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Cowing Presence
entries: If the solar has at least 122 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the solar must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the solar until the beginning of its next turn. A creature has advantage on this save if it took damage from the solar since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: If the solar has 121 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the solar must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the solar until the beginning of its next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature has vulnerability to radiant damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The solar attacks with its sword twice, one of which it may replace with a longbow attack.

action.name: Sword of Ruin
entries: The solar slashes with its sword and a line of incandescent light 5 feet wide and 30 feet long appears within 120 feet and lasts for a minute. A creature that starts its turn in one or more such lines, or enters one for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Lifeburst Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target is pushed back 10 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take an additional 9 (2d8) radiant damage per unexpended hit die it has, then regains one hit die.

action.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
entries: The solar touches another creature that is alive, or has been dead for no more than a century. If the target was dead, it is restored to life with 1 HP. Then, the target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness. If the target is a corpse that died in the last century, it is restored to life.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius centered on the solar must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The dragon doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The dragon doesn't require air.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Photonic Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales a flashing mote of radiant energy that travels to a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of itself, then blossoms into a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Enthralled Lure (1/Day)
entries: The soul shaker can cast the geas spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

trait.name: Reconstruction
entries: When the soul shaker is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes into 7 (1d4 + 5) crawling claws. After 6 () days, if at least two of those crawling claws are alive, they teleport to the location of the soul shaker's death and merge together, whereupon the soul shaker reforms and regains all its hit points.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The soul shaker doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The soul shaker can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

bonus.name: Consume Vitality
entries: The soul shaker targets a creature it is grappling. If the target is not a Construct or an Undead, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the soul shaker regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The clown casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Dying Burst
entries: When the clown drops to 0 hit points, it pops like a balloon, releasing a splash of putrid, corrosive ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of the clown when it bursts must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Squeakers
entries: The clown wears shoes that squeak when it walks. The squeaking can be heard out to a range of 30 feet. The squeaking is silenced while the clown's Phantasmal Form is in effect.

action.name: Shock
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) lightning damage.

action.name: Ray Gun
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and if the target is a Humanoid with an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, it must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target perceives everything it sees or hears as hilariously funny and is incapacitated for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Phantasmal Form (3/Day)
entries: The clown veils itself and everything it is wearing and carrying in an illusion that makes it look like some other creature of its size or smaller (such as a child) or an object small enough to fit in the clown's space (such as a floating balloon). Maintaining this effect requires the clown's concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), and the illusion fails to hold up to physical inspection. As an action, a creature that can see the clown's illusory form can make a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check, piercing the illusion and discerning the clown's true form on a success.

name: Specter
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Radiance Sensitivity
entries: If the specter takes radiant damage, it loses its damage resistances and it is temporarily made corporeal until the beginning of its next turn .

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The specter's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Inflict Weakness
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the beginning of the specter's next turn.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: the specter becomes invisible until it makes an attack.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide
entries: When the specter takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet to a location it can see and turn invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The whale can't use its blindsight while deafened.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The whale can hold its breath for 90 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The whale makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the whale. A swallowed creature has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the whale, and it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the whale's turns. If the whale takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the whale must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the whale. If the whale dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, or 37 (6d6 + 16) bludgeoning damage if the target is an object.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 poison damage and the target subtracts 1d4 from the next Constitution saving throw it makes in the next minute.

reaction.name: Crushed Vengeance
entries: When the spider is reduced to 0 hit points by a melee attack, it can make a Bite attack with advantage against the attacker.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The spiderfrog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spiderfrog can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Spiderfrog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Target is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and spiderfrog can't bite another target.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

action.name: Beguiling Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 31 (7d8) poison damage and be poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a successful one. While poisoned in this way, a creature is charmed and follows the mental commands of the naga.

action.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: A bolt of lightning 100 ft. long and 5 ft. wide extends from the naga. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Mana Drain (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or have its highest level unexpended spell slot expended. If the naga expends a spell slot of 3rd level or above in this way, the next time it uses its lightning bolt it deals maximum damage, instead of rolling.

reaction.name: Shunt Pain
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits it with an attack and a charmed creature is within 10 feet, the naga gains resistance to the attacks damage types until the beginning of its next turn, and the charmed creature takes the same amount of damage as psychic damage.

name: Spirit Troll
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals piercing or slashing damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a Troll Budling that acts on initiative count 0. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The troll can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The troll's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Confounding Bite.

action.name: Confounding Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented until the end of the troll's next turn.
A disoriented creature that misses with a melee attack must make a new attack roll against a friendly creature in its reach, if available.

action.name: Ephemeral Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) psychic damage.

action.name: Strangling Grasp
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, a creature cannot speak or breathe.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot hold its breath. A creature that cannot see the troll makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Wraithform (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 67 hit points, the troll becomes invisible until it makes an attack or regains all of its hit points.
When the troll becomes invisible, each hostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement on its following turn to move away from the troll.

trait.name: Heart Sight
entries: The sprite can magically sense the emotional state of creatures it can see.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: The sprite is  invisible to creatures with less than 20 Passive Perception. Whenever it is hit with an attack, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

trait.name: Forest Guardian
entries: The sprite is bound to a particular forest. A forest bound to one or more sprites has the following features:
The forest has a secret name, known only to those who reside there and those they trust implicitly.
The entire forest counts as difficult terrain to those who do not know its name.
Creatures who do not know the forest's name have disadvantage on checks made to navigate or to track creatures.
Creatures native to the forest have advantage on checks made to hide from creatures who do not know its name.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

action.name: Spirit Away (concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or be banished to the edge of the forest. A creature has advantage on this save if it knows the forest's name. If this effect ends before 1 minute has passed, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. Otherwise, the target doesn't return.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

bonus.name: Shove
entries: While wielding a shield, you try to shove one creature within 5 feet of you.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The ssurran casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The ssurran can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: Intellect Fortress
entries: The ssurran's AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ssurran makes two Claw attacks and uses Defile (if available).

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Defile (Recharge 6)
entries: Ordinary vegetation within 10 feet of the ssurran withers and dies. In addition, each creature within 10 feet of the ssurran must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The ssurran regains 5 () hit points for each creature that fails the saving throw.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The ssurran can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ssurran makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

action.name: Poison Bomb
entries: The ssurran throws a tangerine-sized bomb at a point up to 60 feet away, where it explodes, releasing a 10-foot-radius sphere of poisonous gas that disperses quickly. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After the ssurran throws a bomb, roll a ; on a roll of 4 or lower, the ssurran has no more bombs to throw.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The star lancer doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the star lancer moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Invisibility Cloak (3/Day)
entries: The star lancer and one creature riding it (chosen by the star lancer) magically turn invisible. This effect lasts until the star lancer or a creature riding it attacks or casts a spell, or until the star lancer's concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment worn or carried by the invisible creatures is also invisible for the duration of the Invisibility Cloak.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Waning Light
entries: At initiative count 0, each light source within 30 ft. of at least three grues is diminished by one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.
Each light source within 30 ft. of at least ten grues is instead extinguished.

action.name: Gleaming Bite (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 4 piercing damage if no non-aberration creature can see the grue.

action.name: Pitch Dark
entries: The grue fills a 10 foot radius centered on a point in darkness it can see within 60 feet with a magical darkness that lasts until the end of the grue's next turn.
When the magical darkness appears, each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to make a melee attack against a randomly selected creature in its reach.

name: Star Spawn Hulk
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Psychic Mirror
entries: A creature that attempts to read the hulk's mind instead reads deeply into its own, its deepest fears, insecurities and repressed memories laid bare before it.

trait.name: Freed From Will
entries: Whenever the hulk voluntarily fails a saving throw, it gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, the hulk's attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulk makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Hurl ability.

action.name: Pallid Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit. reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Hurl
entries: The hulk hurls a grappled creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Ragdoll Slam (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hulk slams a grappled creature into the ground repeatedly, forcing it to make three DC 17 Constitution saving throws.
For each save it failed, the creature takes 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and half as much damage for each save on which it succeeded.
A creature that fails two or more of these saving throws in a turn is stunned until the end of the hulk's next turn.

reaction.name: Psychic Dispersal
entries: When the hulk takes any psychic damage, it may force each creature within 10 feet of it to succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take the same damage, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Aura of Hysteria
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of one or more manglers have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Each frightened creature in the area takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage at the beginning of each of the mangler's turns.

trait.name: Crawler
entries: The mangler is not slowed by being prone or by difficult terrain, and while prone may Dash as a bonus action and stand from prone by spending 5 feet of movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mangler makes three attacks with its Mangling Claw.

action.name: Skullbreaker Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Any hit with this attack against a restrained or incapacitated target becomes a critical.

action.name: Mangling Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
A creature affected by the mangler's Weaken Flesh ability takes an additional 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Flurry of Claws (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The mangler makes six attacks with its Mangling Claw.

reaction.name: Weaken Flesh
entries: When the mangler is reduced below 50 hit points, it may force one creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or have its flesh soften and sag.
For the next minute, whenever the affected creature takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

name: Star Spawn Seer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Out-of-Phase Movement
entries: The seer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. Each creature it moves through takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage; no creature can take this damage more than once per turn. The seer takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Mind Colonizer
entries: When the seer casts a spell that requires concentration, it may have a willing aberration within 30 feet of it maintain concentration in its stead.

trait.name: Fractal Demise
entries: When the star spawn is reduced to 0 hit points, if one or more friendly aberrations are within 30 ft. it casts Astral Maelstrom before it dies centered on itself, its body tearing apart into a ragged spiral.

action.name: Untether Mind (5th level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit. reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) force plus 39 (6d12) psychic damage and the target must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw.

On a failure, the creature is frightened and blinded until the end of the seer's next turn as its field of perception expands and expands and expands until it encompasses the entirety of the multiverse.
A creature that fails by 10 or more is additionally paralyzed until the end of the seer's next turn.

action.name: Astral Maelstrom (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The seer creates a 5-ft. radius disk of unimaginable density in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet that lasts for a minute; raw voidstuff compressed until it glows with a searing light that does not reflect or illuminate.
A creature that begins its turn within 10 ft. of the sphere must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 33 (6d10) radiant damage.

action.name: Crumple Space (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The seer chooses a point along a 5 ft. wide line that is 30 ft. long and wholly within 120 feet.

Each creature in the line's area must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be teleported to the nearest unoccupied space to the point chosen by the seer, then take 22 (4d10) force plus 13 (2d12) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Warp (1st Level Spell)
entries: A 10 ft. radius of space centered on a point the seer can see within 60 ft. becomes difficult terrain for non-aberrations until the beginning of the seer's turn.

legendary.name: Music of the Spheres (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The seer chooses two creatures or objects it can see within 120 ft. The first creature or object is levitated off the ground and revolves up to 30 ft. clockwise around the second, maintaining the same distance. A creature levitated in this way makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Beckoning of the Expanse (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 ft. of the seer's Astral Maelstrom must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move 10 ft. towards it.

name: Starlight Apparition
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Astral Existence
entries: The apparition can exist only on the Astral Plane. If it is sent to a location not on the Astral Plane, the apparition is destroyed.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: While it has at least 1 hit point, the apparition sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The apparition can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The apparition doesn't require air, drink, food, or sleep.

action.name: Radiant Eruption
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) radiant damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
entries: One Humanoid that the apparition can see within 5 feet of itself must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the apparition; the apparition then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The apparition now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The apparition can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the apparition ends it as a bonus action, the body leaves the Astral Plane, or the apparition is forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the apparition reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If it reappears in a location not on the Astral Plane, the apparition is destroyed. The target is immune to this apparition's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Condense
entries: If the steam mephit takes cold damage, it is reduced to size Tiny and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of steam, leaving behind a cloud that fills a 15-foot-diameter sphere centered on its space. The sphere is heavily obscured. Wind disperses the cloud, which otherwise lasts for 1 minute.

action.name: Hazy Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away. This attack is made at advantage against a creature with lower than 12 Passive Perception.

action.name: Heavy Air (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be slowed by its labored breaths for the next minute. An affected creature cannot make more than a single attack in a turn, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Misty Advance
entries: As a reaction to a creature targeting the mephit with a ranged attack, the mephit may teleport up to thirty feet toward the attacker. If it ends this teleportation within 5 feet of the attacker, it may impose disadvantage on the triggering attack.

name: Steel Predator
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Binary and the language of its owner but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The steel predator's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. The steel predator can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The steel predator has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The steel predator's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The steel predator makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claw.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Stunning Roar (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The steel predator emits a roar in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (5d10) thunder damage, drops everything it's holding, and is stunned for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) piercing damage.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the kow moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kow can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the kow must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Reckless Thrash
entries: At the start of its turn, the kow can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it falls prone and is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the stirge's turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points due to blood loss.

The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge.

name: Stone Defender
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stone defender remains motionless against an uneven earthen or stone surface, it is indistinguishable from that surface.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The stone defender has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is knocked prone.

reaction.name: Intercept Attack
entries: In response to another creature within 5 feet of it being hit by an attack roll, the stone defender gives that creature a +5 bonus to its AC against that attack, potentially causing a miss. To use this ability, the stone defender must be able to see the creature and the attacker.

name: Stone Giant
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone giant makes two attacks with its sculpted greatclub, one of which it may replace with a use of its sweeping club ability.

action.name: Sculpted Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Rolling Rock
entries: Each creature in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Sweeping Club (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall prone as a reaction to gain advantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Fling Pest
entries: As a reaction to being attacked by a creature that is climbing on it, the giant may force the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be hurled 20 feet away, take 14 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

name: Stone Giant Dreamwalker
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Dreamwalker's Fugue
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the dreamwalker perceives its reality as though in a dream, and must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects at random. A creature that failed at least one of these saving throws retains no memory of events that transpired while in the affected area.

items.name: Frightening Apparition
entries: The earth boils, twisted faces and grasping hands surfacing and crying out before turning to stone. The creature is frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Incomprehensible Babbling
entries: The creature babbles incoherently and cannot speak or perform the verbal components of spells until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Endless Loops
entries: The creature must perform the same action this turn that it did on its previous turn. If it cannot, the creature teleports 40 ft. into the air and immediately falls.

items.name: Change Unending
entries: Colors and textures blur and run together, flowing like oil before rapidly sharpening into new focus. The area in a 10 ft. radius around the creature becomes difficult terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone giant makes two attacks with its surreality grasp, one of which it may replace with a use of its absorb dreamer ability, if available.

action.name: Surreality Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage and the creature is grappled (escape DC 18). While grappled, a creature's flesh takes on the appearance of stone.

action.name: Sculpt Creature
entries: The dreamwalker sculpts a grappled creature like clay, imposing a new artistic form onto it. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 66 (12d10) psychic damage and be restrained until it leaves the area of the dreamwalker's fugue.

action.name: Absorb Dreamer
entries: One grappled creature affected by the giant's sculpt creature ability must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed and paratially absorbed into the giant's body until the giant dies or releases it. The creature can still perceive and speak.

reaction.name: Across the Veil
entries: As a reaction to being targeted by a ranged attack or harmful spell from outside the area of its dreamwalker's fugue, the giant turns the attack or spell into a shower of petals or a splash of water as it enters the area.

name: Stone Juggernaut
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Deathroller
entries: The juggernaut is equipped with a series of stone rollers, granting it the following traits:

items.name: Facing
entries: The juggernaut has a facing, and can only move in a straight line in the direction it is facing.

items.name: Turning
entries: The juggernaut may spend 10 feet of movement to make a turn of up to 90 degrees, and cannot turn otherwise.

items.name: prone Vulnerability
entries: While prone, the juggernaut is incapacitated.

trait.name: Rear Hatch
entries: The juggernaut is hollow, and can be entered through a locked hatch in its rear, which can be opened with a successful DC 18 Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) or DC 24 Strength (Athletics) check. A creature in the juggernaut moves with it, and  its attacks bypass the juggernaut's Damage Resistances and Damage Threshold.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The juggernaut makes two Piston Fist attacks, each of which must be against a different target, and uses its Flattening Charge.

action.name: Piston Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.
The juggernaut has six fists, and can use each of them once before it must use its Vent Hydraulics to retract them.

action.name: Flattening Charge
entries: The juggernaut moves up to its speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge.
The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.
A creature that is already prone takes an additional 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Vent Hydraulics (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The juggernaut retracts each of its fists, and vents boiling steam into its interior. Each creature inside of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Storm Giant
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crackling Power
entries: Whenever the storm giant is subjected to lightning damage, its speed doubles until the end of its next turn, and the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn deals an extra 21 (6d6) lightning damage.

trait.name: Shifting Omens
entries: The giant relies on reading omens to predict its opponents next move, making it vulnerable to rapid, unconscious decisions.
A player that declares what they are doing on their turn within five seconds of being told that their turn has started makes attacks at advantage against the giant.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 22 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two booming greatsword attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its howling winds.

action.name: Booming Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing damage and the creature is pushed 15 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage as thunder damage and be be pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Howling Winds
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the giant must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead blown 30 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Forked Fury (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 116 hit points, the giant immediately recharges its lightning strike and uses it, targeting itself.

name: Storm Giant Quintessent
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Storm-Followed
entries: Stormy weather always accompanies the giant's presence. At the beginning of the giant's turn, a randomly determined creature within 60 feet of it is struck by lightning, and must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (3d10) lightning damage. If the giant is struck by lightning, each creature climbing on it must also make this save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant uses its bolt barrage twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Traveling Thundercloud.

action.name: Bolt Barrage
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +14 to hit, range 120 ft., up to three targets. Hit: 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Traveling Thundercloud (Concentration)
entries: The giant becomes insubstantial until the end of its next turn, gaining a 50 ft. fly speed and resistance to all damage. While in this form, the giant cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Fury of the Storm
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 HP, the giant may call down a bolt of lightning on each creature in range, per its Storm-Followed ability.

trait.name: Stirge Telepathy
entries: The strigoi can magically command any stirge within 120 feet of it, using a limited form of telepathy.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The strigoi makes one Claw attack and makes one Proboscis attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 6 (1d12) acid damage.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the strigoi regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from this attack dies and leaves nothing behind except its skin and its equipment.

action.name: Ravenous Children (1/Day)
entries: The strigoi magically summons 1d4 + 2 stirges (see their entry in the Monster Manual) in unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 feet of it. The stirges are under the strigoi's control and act immediately after the strigoi in the initiative order. The stirges disappear after 1 hour, when the strigoi dies, or when the strigoi dismisses them (no action required).

name: Succubus
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The fiend ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The fiend can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, the fiend loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Claw (Fiend Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Charm
entries: One humanoid the fiend can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for the next 24 hours.
The fiend can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

action.name: Draining Kiss
entries: The fiend kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The fiend magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

trait.name: False Objects
entries: If the swarm is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the swarm move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the swarm is animate.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Diminutive creature.

action.name: Book Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Blinding Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Diminutive creature.
A creature that starts its turn in the bat's space is blinded until it moves, and if it moves this turn must move as far as it can in a single, randomly chosen direction.

action.name: Carrier Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract lyssavirus.

action.name: Echolocation
entries: If the bat is not deafened, it gains one of the following benefits until the end of its next turn:

items.name: Low Frequency
entries: The swarm gains Blindsight to a range of 60 feet.

items.name: High Frequency
entries: The swarm has advantage on melee attack rolls.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

name: Swarm of Campestris
languages: understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: Each campestri in the swarm can mimic any voice or song it has heard, albeit in a nasal falsetto.

action.name: Spores (1/Day)
entries: A 20-foot radius of spores extends from the swarm. These spores can go around corners, and they have no effect on Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Each other creature in the area must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated and its speed is halved, both for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Horrid Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

A creature whose space the swarm enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. On a successful saving throw, the creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed.

action.name: Thrash of Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (4d4 + 1) piercing damage, or 6 (2d4 + 1 ) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Mass Envenomation
entries: One creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage, or half as much if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Skittering Clutch

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment

items.name: Rat-Mind Melding
