items.name: Invade Mind
entries: A creature that hits the swarm with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or feel an illusory rat crawling through its clothing or armor, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Plaguefog Shiver

bonus.name: Swarm Within

Whenever the possessed creature takes any damage, the swarm takes an equal amount of psychic damage.

entries: The swarm releases magical glittering dust from its wings. In addition, every Dragon within 1 mile of the creature becomes aware of it and can unerringly track the creature. Casting dispel magic on the creature ends the effect on it.

entries: The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Ravenous Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. If the target is a creature, scarabs burrow into its body, and the creature takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. Any creature can use an action to kill or remove the scarabs with fire or a weapon that deals piercing damage, causing 1 damage of the appropriate type to the target. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the swarm's piercing damage dies.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Diminutive creature.

trait.name: Virulent Sorrow
entries: Each time the swarm takes damage, any creature within 5 feet of it must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature suffers the following effects until the end of its next turn: it has disadvantage on its attack rolls, it can't take reactions, and its speed is halved.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The swarm can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Swarm of Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) piercing damage, or 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Desolate Drain (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in the swarm's space must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 24 (7d6) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. The effect ends on a creature if the swarm moves out of the creature's space or if another creature within 5 feet of the swarm uses an action to make a DC 14 Strength check, pulling the affected creature out of the swarm on a successful check. On a successful saving throw, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes one Undead Mass attack and one Grasping Limbs attack.

action.name: Undead Mass
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Grasping Limbs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 7 (2d6) necrotic damage on a failed save. The creature is freed if it succeeds on this saving throw, the swarm moves out of the creature's space, or the swarm dies.

trait.name: Lightfooted
entries: The swashbuckler can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Suave Defense
entries: While the swashbuckler is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Charisma modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swashbuckler makes three attacks: one with a dagger and two with its rapier.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Feline Agility
entries: When the tabaxi moves on its turn in combat, it can double its speed until the end of the turn. Once it uses this ability, the tabaxi can't use it again until it moves 0 feet on one of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tabaxi makes two attacks with its claws, its shortsword, or its shortbow.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Tarrasque, Beast of the Apocalypse
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources made without advantage

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tarrasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Invulnerable Hide
entries: Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, the tarrasque is unaffected. Instead, the next weapon attack that targets the tarrasque has advantage.

trait.name: Eternal Threat
entries: When the Tarrasque is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it cannot take actions other than to dash. While at 0 HP, it can be killed with a Wish spell.

trait.name: Slow to Wrath
entries: When the Tarrasque is reduced to 400 HP, it gains a fourth legendary action and immediately regains all spent actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tarrasque can't bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 15ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage.

action.name: Horns
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 20ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, ramge 360/1440 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the tarrasque's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the tarrasque's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The tarrasque makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Erupt
entries: The Tarrasque bursts out of the ground. Each creature in a 60 foot radius must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 (12d6) bludgeoning damage and is stunned until the end of the Tarrasque's next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

reaction.name: Reflective
entries: As a reaction, the tarrasque may reflect a spell that targets it back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The tarrasque makes one claw attack or tail attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The tarrasque moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The tarrasque makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

legendary.name: Bone-Shattering Roar (Costs 4 Actions)
entries: The tarrasque emits a titanic roar in a 600-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 135 (30d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is permanently deafened.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the terastodon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the terastodon can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Timbermaw
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The timbermaw has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The timbermaw makes one attack with its tentacles. If that attack hits, the timbermaw can make one beak attack against the same target.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe both air and water.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

action.name: Desiccating Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon exhales yellowish necrotic energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and is weakened until the end of its next turn. A weakened creature has disadvantage on Strength-based ability checks and Strength saving throws, and the creature's weapon attacks that rely on Strength deal half damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't weakened.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands in melee.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

action.name: Shell Defense
entries: The tortle withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and can't increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The transmuter is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The transmuter has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Transmuter's Stone
entries: The transmuter carries a magic stone it crafted that grants its bearer one of the following effects:
Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet
An extra 10 feet of speed while the bearer is unencumbered
Proficiency with Constitution saving throws
Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (transmuter's choice whenever the transmuter chooses this benefit)
If the transmuter has the stone and casts a transmutation spell of 1st level or higher, it can change the effect of the stone.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the trapper is motionless on a floor, wall, or ceiling at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the trapper move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the trapper isn't part of the floor, wall, or ceiling.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The trapper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Smother
entries: One Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of the trapper must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, blinded, and deprived of air. The trapper can smother only one creature at a time.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the treant is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the treant move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the treant is animate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
entries: The treant magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as an awakened tree (see the Monster Manual), except they can't speak. An animated tree acts as an ally of the treant. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree, or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

trait.name: Detect Invisibility
entries: Within 60 feet of the tressym, magical invisibility fails to conceal anything from the tressym's sight.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The tressym has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Poison Sense
entries: The tressym can detect whether a substance is poisonous by taste, touch, or smell.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant attacks twice with its greatclub or makes one greatclub attack and uses Evil Eye once.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Evil Eye
entries: The giant magically forces a creature it can see within 60 feet of it to make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. The creature takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Curse of the Evil Eye (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: With a stare, the giant uses Evil Eye, but on a failed save, the creature is also cursed with magical deformities. While deformed, the creature has its speed halved and has disadvantage on ability checks, saving throws, and attacks based on Strength or Dexterity.
The transformed creature can repeat the saving throw whenever it finishes a long rest, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Bony Frill
entries: While the triceratops is not flanked, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by melee attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The triceratops makes up to two attacks; one with its gore and one with its stomp, if available.

action.name: Goring Horns
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away and must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wrecking Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The triceratops moves up to its speed, and can move through the space of any creature larger than huge, making a gore attack against each creature whose space it passes through.

reaction.name: Dominance Display
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a creature within 30 ft., the triceratops shakes its horns. The attacker may use its reaction to drop prone; if the creature does not, or if it stands before the end of its turn, the triceratops may move up to 30 ft. towards it and make a gore attack.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The tridrone may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the tridrone is within 30 feet of a quadrone, it uses the quadrone's attack bonus instead of its own. If the quadrone is using a pentadrone's attack bonus, the tridrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tridrone makes three attacks with its Equitempered Javelins and uses its Recall Javelins, if available.

action.name: Equitempered Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.
The tridrone has three javelins.

action.name: Recall Javelins (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Each of the tridrone's thrown javelins grow dozens of slender legs and crawls up to 30 feet toward the tridrone before retracting them.

reaction.name: Supervise Work
entries: As a reaction when a duodrone within 30 feet that the tridrone can see misses with an attack against a creature, the tridrone makes a note.
Duodrones under the tridrone's control add +1 to their attack rolls for each note the tridrone has made in the last minute.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a quadrone within 60 feet die or transform, the tridrone may transform into a quadrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one tridrone may take this reaction.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The trilobite can breathe air and water.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The trilobite can breathe air and water.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). The trilobite has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The triton's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The triton can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Summon Water Weird (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the triton magically summons  water weirds. The summoned weirds appear in unoccupied spaces in water within 60 feet of the triton. The water weirds act immediately after the triton on the same initiative count and fight until they're destroyed. They disappear if the triton dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The triton makes two attacks using Wave Touch and casts ray of frost.

action.name: Wave Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) cold damage.

action.name: Ray of Frost (Cantrip)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) cold damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the triton's next turn.

reaction.name: Frigid Shield
entries: When a creature the triton can see targets the triton with an attack, the triton gains 10 temporary hit points. If the attack hits and reduces the temporary hit points to 0, each creature within 5 feet of the triton takes 9 (2d8) cold damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Expert Seeker
entries: The troll has advantage on ability checks made to find things.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4 - 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Camouflage
entries: The troll magically disguises itself as a Small object. A successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check can identify the troll. The troll can use this action again to remove its disguise.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The blob can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Astral Implosion
entries: If the blob is reduced to 0 hit points, it implodes and ejects any creatures and objects engulfed by it into the Astral Sea. The blob itself vanishes, leaving behind a layer of slime on everything that was within 600 feet of it. In 1d20 years, the blob reconstitutes on a random world in the Material Plane.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The blob has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the blob fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blob makes two Pseudopod attacks and uses Engulf. It can replace one attack with a use of Restraining Glob.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) force damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The blob moves up to its speed, and can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures and objects. Each creature or object whose space the blob enters for the first time during this move must make a DC 23 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is engulfed. While engulfed, a target has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the blob, and when the blob moves, the engulfed target moves with it. A nonmagical object is destroyed after spending 1 minute engulfed. On a success, a creature is ejected to the nearest unoccupied space.

While engulfed, a creature takes 21 (6d6) force damage at the start of each of its turns, is suffocating, restrained, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. An engulfed creature that is reduced to 0 hit points dissolves into ash, which is ejected into the Astral Sea.

action.name: Restraining Glob
entries: The blob lobs a slimy glob at one Large or smaller creature it can see within 600 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 18 (3d6 + 8) acid damage and is pulled 60 feet towards the blob, then it is restrained until the end of its next turn, taking half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Decay
entries: The blob deals 14 (4d6) necrotic damage to each creature engulfed by it. The blob can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Grasping Glob
entries: The blob uses its Restraining Glob. The blob can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Lashing Goop
entries: The blob makes one Pseudopod attack.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The cataclysm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the cataclysm doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The cataclysm deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the cataclysm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cataclysm makes two Elemental Burst attacks.

action.name: Elemental Burst
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. or range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder (cataclysm's choice)

action.name: Cataclysmic Event {@recharge 4}
entries: The cataclysm creates one of the following effects at random:

items.name: 1: Clinging Flames
entries: Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 150 feet must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (13d6) fire damage and begins burning (2d10), taking half as much damage and burning (1d10) on a success.

items.name: 2: Freezing Waves
entries: Each creature in a 90-foot cone must make a DC 23 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) cold damage, is knocked prone, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 3: Raging Storm
entries: A storm cloud fills a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 150 feet. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until the cataclysm uses Cataclysmic Event again. Creatures entirely in the cloud are considered blinded, deafened, and muted. Each creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) lightning damage plus 18 (4d8) thunder damage, or half as much on a success..

items.name: 4: Swallowing Earth
entries: Each creature in a 90-foot cube originating from a point on the ground within 150 feet must make a DC 23 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage, and is knocked prone and buried under rubble. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

A buried target is considered restrained, has total cover, and is suffocating. As an action, a buried creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can make a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the creature is no longer buried.

legendary.name: Eruption
entries: The cataclysm makes one Elemental Burst attack.

legendary.name: Rumbling Movement
entries: The cataclysm moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature within 5 feet of the cataclysm as it moves must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is knocked prone. The cataclysm can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The limb regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If the limb takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Troll Spawn
entries: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn't destroyed within 24 hours, roll a d12. On a 12, the limb turns into a Troll. Otherwise, the limb persists, but can't turn into a troll.

action.name: Rend
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The limb regains 1 hit point at the start of its turn. If the limb takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Troll Spawn
entries: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll.

action.name: Rend
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Tromokratis, Scourge of the Seas
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Tromokratis can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Hearts of the Kraken (Mythic Trait; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When Tromokratis is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, the damage creates cracks in his carapace, revealing his hearts. Tromokratis has four hearts: two on his chest, one on his back, and one at the base of his tail. A heart has an AC of 22 and 100 hit points. It is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources, and it is immune to all conditions. If it is forced to make a saving throw, treat its ability scores as 10 (+0). If Tromokratis finishes a short or long rest, the carapace heals, any destroyed hearts regenerate, and the hearts are covered again. Tromokratis dies when all the hearts are destroyed.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Tromokratis fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Tromokratis's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Tromokratis deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Spell-Resistant Carapace
entries: Tromokratis has advantage on saving throws against spells, and any creature that makes a spell attack against Tromokratis has disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tromokratis makes three attacks: one with his pincer, one with his tail, and one with his tentacle grasp.

action.name: Pincer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 26). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Tromokratis can't use this attack on anyone else.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is knocked prone.

action.name: Tentacle Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 26). If the target doesn't escape by the end of its next turn, Tromokratis throws the target up to 60 feet in a straight line. The target lands prone and takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by Tromokratis, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Tromokratis, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Tromokratis's turns. If Tromokratis takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside him, Tromokratis must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of Tromokratis. If Tromokratis dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by him and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Tromokratis moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Tail
entries: Tromokratis makes one tail attack.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Tromokratis makes one bite attack.

mythic.name: Rampage
entries: Tromokratis makes two attacks: one with his tail and one with his tentacle grasp.

mythic.name: Coral Growth (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of Tromokratis must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the start of his next turn, Tromokratis and his hearts gain a +2 bonus to AC.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The typhon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The typhon regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The typhon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The typhon makes three attacks: one with its Flurry of Bites, one to constrict, and one with its maw.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (8d6 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The typhon can have up to two creatures constricted.

action.name: Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) acid damage.

trait.name: Opportunistic Feeder
entries: The tyrannosaurus's attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 when targeting a stunned creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaurus makes two attacks against different targets, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace its bite with a use of its Thunderous Roar, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tyrannosaurus can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thunderous Roar (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the tyrannosaurus' next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is also stunned for the same duration.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to a creature failing an attempt to escape its grapple, the tyrannosaur forces the grappled creature to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the tyrannosaurus' next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead paralyzed for the same duration.

name: Udaak
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the udaak moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away from the udaak and knocked prone.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The udaak deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The udaak makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its slam.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 21). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the udaak can't bite another target.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The udaak makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the udaak, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the udaak's turns.

If the udaak takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the udaak must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the udaak. If the udaak dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ulitharid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Psychic Overload
entries: Whenever the ulitharid takes psychic damage from a source other than this ability, each friendly illithid and charmed creature within 60 ft. takes half as much psychic damage.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 5 foot radius around the ulitharid is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the ulitharid's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Thrall-Master Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the ulitharid fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to transfer the saving throw's effect to a friendly or charmed creature within 60 ft.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ulitharid makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) psychic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).
A creature that starts its turn grappled by the ulitharid must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Skulltap Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or die as the staff splits its skull open and extracts its brain.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid grappled by the ulitharid. Hit: The target takes 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the ulitharid begins to extract and devour the target's brain. At the beginning of the ulitharid's next turn if the target is still unconscious and grappled, the target dies and the illithid gains 40 temporary hit points.

action.name: Enthralling Mind Blast (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The illithid magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 44 (6d12 + 5) psychic damage. A creature that fails by 5 or more is magically charmed and under the ulitharid's telepathic control. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Break Will
entries: One creature charmed by the ulitharid must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and have its Wisdom score reduced by the same amount, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest. If this reduces the charmed creature to 0 Wisdom, the ulitharid no longer requires Concentration to Charm it.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell, 1/day)
entries: The ulitharid and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Shove
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the ulitharid forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Deflection
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the ulitharid halves the attack's damage against it.

name: Ultroloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ultroloth's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The ultroloth can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ultroloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The ultroloth's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ultroloth can use its Hypnotic Gaze and makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Hypnotic Gaze
entries: The ultroloth's eyes sparkle with opalescent light as it targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the ultroloth, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed until the end of the ultroloth's next turn. The charmed target is stunned. If the target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the ultroloth's gaze for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The ultroloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Undying Soldier
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The soldier magically sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The soldier can extinguish or restore this light as a bonus action.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The soldier has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The soldier makes two spear attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage if the target is a fiend or undead.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The unicorn has advantage on stealth checks to hide from non-good-aligned creatures.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (1/Day)
entries: The unicorn magically restores 10 (2d8 + 1) hit points to a creature within 5 feet. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

trait.name: Numinous Presence
entries: If the unicorn has at least 34 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the unicorn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the unicorn until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the unicorn since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The unicorn has advantage on stealth checks to hide from non-good-aligned creatures.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn. If it has 33 or fewer HP, it instead makes three attacks with its hooves and one with its horn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The unicorn magically restores 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points to a creature within 5 feet. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

action.name: Teleport (1/Day)
entries: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

reaction.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature make an attack, the unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

trait.name: Formed by the Mists
entries: When created, the horror's body composition takes one of four forms: Aberrant Armor, Loathsome Limbs, Malleable Mass, or Oozing Organs. This form determines certain traits in this stat block.

trait.name: Amorphous (Malleable Mass Only)
entries: The horror can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Bile Body (Oozing Organs Only)
entries: Any creature that touches the horror or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 (1d10) acid damage.

trait.name: Relentless Stride (Loathsome Limbs Only)
entries: The horror can move through the space of another creature. The first time on a turn that the horror enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes two Limbs attacks.

action.name: Limbs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hex Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The horror expels necrotic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (7d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Vampirate
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Explode
entries: When the vampirate is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a cloud of ash. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampirate can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The vampirate doesn't require air or drink.

action.name: Energy Drain
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this attack dies and instantly transforms into a free-willed shadow under the DM's control.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Vampirate Captain
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Explode
entries: When the captain is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a cloud of ash. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The captain can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The captain doesn't require air or drink.

action.name: Energy Drain
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this attack dies and instantly transforms into a free-willed shadow or vampirate (captain's choice) under the DM's control.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Ship Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: A ship upon which the captain stands, along with all creatures and objects aboard it, becomes invisible to creatures not aboard the ship. The captain must concentrate on this magical effect to maintain it (as if concentrating on a spell), and it lasts for up to 1 hour. The effect ends if the captain leaves the ship.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: The captain halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. The captain must be able to see the attacker.

name: Vampirate Mage
languages: the languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

trait.name: Explode
entries: When the mage is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a cloud of ash. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The mage can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The mage doesn't require air or drink.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mage makes two Ray of Cold attacks.

action.name: Energy Drain
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this attack dies and instantly transforms into a free-willed shadow under the DM's control.

action.name: Ray of Cold
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) cold damage.

name: Vampire
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Blood Eternal
entries: If the vampire is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than Bonus Actions, and cannot regain any hit points until it completes a Long Rest in its resting place. If it does not return to its resting place by the following dawn, the vampire is destroyed.

trait.name: Vampiric Traits
entries: The vampire has two traits from the Common Weaknesses table, two traits from the Uncommon Weaknesses table, and four traits from the vampiric powers table. Its weaknesses must include a method of destruction.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its Blood Drain.

action.name: Grasping Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled, incapacitated, restrained, or willing creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose three unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.
A creature killed by this attack rises as a Vampire Spawn at the next sunset.

action.name: Charm
entries: One creature within 30 feet that can see the vampire must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the vampire and its allies for 24 hours. A charmed creature repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Leaping Strike
entries: The vampire move up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity and makes a Grasping Strike attack.

legendary.name: Children of the Night
entries: The vampire conjures a swarm of spectral vermin that envelop a creature it can see within 30 feet, heavily obscuring the area in a 5 foot radius around it until the vampire uses this ability again.

legendary.name: Blood Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire makes a Blood Drain attack.

name: Vampire Neonate
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 13).

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Vampiric Glamer
entries: The vampire obscures its form with mind-affecting magic that makes others perceive it as a beautiful human of the same size and shape. The illusion ends if the vampire takes a bonus action to end it or if the vampire dies. A creature that can see the vampire can take an action to visually inspect it, ending the mental effect on itself and seeing the vampire's true form with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check.

action.name: Aura of Silence
entries: The vampire shrouds itself in a cloak of silence to a radius of 2 feet. Within that radius, the effect is the same as the silence spell.

name: Vampire Null
languages: understands all languages it spoke in life but can't speak

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the null to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the null drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

name: Vampiric Illithid
languages: telepathy 120 ft. but can only project emotions

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The illithid can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the illithid has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The illithid doesn't require air, food, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The illithid makes two Claw attacks or one Claw attack and one Tentacles attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Drink Sapience
entries: The illithid targets one creature it is grappling. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage and gain 1 level of exhaustion. The illithid regains a number of hit points equal to the psychic damage dealt. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the psychic damage dies.

bonus.name: Disrupt Psyche (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The illithid magically emits psionic energy in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute. The incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Vampiric Mist
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Life Sense
entries: The mist can sense the location of any creature within 60 feet of it, unless that creature's type is Construct or Undead.

trait.name: Forbiddance
entries: The mist can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

trait.name: Misty Form
entries: The mist can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can pass through it without squeezing. Each foot of movement in water costs it 2 extra feet, rather than 1 extra foot. The mist can't manipulate objects in any way that requires fingers or manual dexterity.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The mist takes 10 radiant damage whenever it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, the mist has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The mist doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: The mist touches one creature in its space. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw (Undead and Constructs automatically succeed), or it takes 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage, the mist regains 10 hit points, and the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

trait.name: Screeching Flock
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. of three or more vargouilles must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

trait.name: Poor Vision
entries: The swarm has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. As an action, a creature may attempt a DC 8 Charisma (Deception) check to convince the vargouille that something inedible is edible.

action.name: Locking Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) plus 10 (3d6) poison damage and the vargouille attaches itself to the target (escape DC 12).
While attached, the vargouille can't attack another target, and may free itself as an Action or Bonus Action.

action.name: Cursed Kiss
entries: One incapacitated creature within 5 feet of the vargouille must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed.

While cursed in this way, a creature loses 1 point of Charisma for each hour it spends in dim light or darkness. A creature that has its Charisma reduced to 0 in this way has its head tear free of its body and sprout wings, becoming a vargouille.

action.name: Manic Shrieking (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The vargouille unleashes a piercing shriek. Each creature in a 15 foot cone that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the Vargouille's next turn. A frightened creature makes this save at disadvantage.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vegepygmy regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Sling
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vegepygmy regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vegepygmy makes two Claw attacks or two melee Spear attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Spores (1/Day)
entries: A 15-foot-radius cloud of toxic spores extends out from the vegepygmy. The spores spread around corners. Each creature in that area that isn't a Plant must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The velociraptor has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the velociraptor's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Grasslands Hunter
entries: The velociraptor can attempt to Hide as a bonus action in dense foliage.

action.name: Ripping Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone if it is Medium or smaller.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19 or 20 against a prone creature.

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals piercing or slashing damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a Troll Budling that acts on initiative count 0. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

trait.name: Poison Splash
entries: When the troll takes damage of any type but psychic, each creature within 5 feet of the troll takes 9 (2d8) poison damage.

trait.name: Poison Reliance
entries: If it would be subjected to an effect that would neutralize poison, the venom troll instead must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or die, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Slavering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

action.name: Claw Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Reckless Thrash (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the troll must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks that target the troll are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Venom Spray (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 74 hit points, the troll slices itself with a claw, releasing a spray of poison in a 20-foot cone. The troll takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) poison damage and be poisoned until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

trait.name: Battle-Honed Reflexes
entries: The veteran adds its Wisdom modifier to initiative rolls. At initiative count 20 on the first round of combat it may move up to half its speed and take the dodge action or drop prone.

trait.name: Advantageous Position
entries: The veteran's attacks are made at advantage if it is in cover or an elevated position, as long as it is not flanked.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The veteran makes two longsword attacks, or makes one crossbow attack and takes the Dash or Disengage action.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Pommel Bash
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the veteran may attempt a contested Strength (Athletics) check to shove the attacker prone or push it 5 ft. away.

trait.name: Distress Spores
entries: When the fungus takes damage, all other plant creatures within 240 feet of it can sense its pain.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the violet fungus remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fungus makes 1d4 Rotting Touch attacks.

action.name: Rotting Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 8 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with Ophidomycosis.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Curse (Recharges After a Long Rest)
entries: The Vistana targets one creature that it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. The Vistana chooses the curse's effect from the options that follow; other Vistani curses are possible. All such effects deal psychic damage to the Vistani who uttered them when they end:

items: The target is unable to perform a certain kind of act involving fine motor control, such as tying knots, writing, playing an instrument, sewing, or casting spells that have somatic components. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage.

The target's appearance changes in a sinister yet purely cosmetic way. For example, the curse can place a scar on the target's face, turn the target's teeth into yellow fangs, or give the target bad breath. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage.

A nonmagical item in the target's possession (chosen by the DM) disappears and can't be found until the curse ends. The lost item can weigh no more than 1 pound. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage.
The target gains vulnerability to a damage type of the Vistana's choice. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 3d6 psychic damage.
The target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws tied to one ability score of the Vistana's choice. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 3d6 psychic damage.
The target's attunement to one magic item (chosen by the DM) ends, and the target can't attune to the chosen item until the curse ends. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 5d6 psychic damage.
The target is blinded, deafened, or both. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 5d6 psychic damage.

entries: The curse lasts until ended with a greater restoration spell, a remove curse spell, or similar magic. It doesn't end when the target dies. If a cursed target is returned to life, the curse remains in effect.

action.name: Evil Eye (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As an action, a Vistana can target a creature within 10 feet that the Vistana can see. This magical ability, which the Vistani call the Evil Eye, duplicates the duration and effect of the animal friendship, charm person, or hold person spell (Vistana's choice; spell DC 10), but requires neither somatic nor material components. If the target succeeds on the save, the Vistana is blinded until the end of the Vistana's next turn.

A Vistana who uses Evil Eye can't use it again before finishing a short or long rest. Once a target succeeds on a saving throw against a Vistana's Evil Eye, it is immune to the Evil Eye of all Vistani for 24 hours.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The walrus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

action.name: Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The priest is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The priest makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Guided Strike (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The priest grants a +10 bonus to an attack roll made by itself or another creature within 30 feet of it. The priest can make this choice after the roll is made but before it hits or misses.

name: Warforged Colossus
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the colossus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Towering Terror
entries: Any enemy outside the colossus that starts its turn within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of the enemy's next turn. If the enemy's saving throw is successful, it is immune to this colossus's Towering Terror for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The colossus makes three attacksâ€”one with its slam and two with its eldritch turretsâ€”and then uses Stomp.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the colossus can push the target up to 20 feet away from it.

action.name: Eldritch Turret
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +18 to hit, range 300 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it is knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: The colossus stomps one of its feet at a point on the ground within 20 feet of it. Any creature in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on this point must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Until the colossus uses its Stomp again or moves, the creature is restrained. While restrained in this way, the creature (or another creature within 5 feet of it) can use its action to make a DC 26 Strength check. On a success, the creature relocates to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the colossus and is no longer restrained.
Structures, as well as nonmagical objects that are neither being worn nor carried, take the same amount of damage if they are in the cylinder (no save).

action.name: Incinerating Beam (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The colossus fires a beam of light in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 60 (11d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this beam is disintegrated, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Single Minded Focus
entries: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Grapplebolt Launcher.

action.name: Retractable Armblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Grapplebolt Launcher
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 40/80 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the bolt embeds itself in the target.

Until a creature removes the bolt as an action with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check, the target cannot move away from the warforged, the warforged can't attack with this weapon, and the warforged may spend 5 feet of its movement to drag the creature 5 feet towards it.

reaction.name: Rapid Assessment
entries: As a reaction when a creature marked as the warforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

name: Warforged Titan
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Platforms
entries: The warforged titan has two platforms built into its chassis. One Medium or smaller creature can ride on each platform without squeezing. To make a melee attack against a target within 5 feet of the warforged, they must use spears or weapons with reach and the target must be Large or larger.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The warforged titan deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged titan makes one axehand attack and one hammerfist attack.

action.name: Axehand
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage, plus 11 (2d10) slashing damage if the target is prone.

action.name: Hammerfist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Sweeping Axe (Recharge 6)
entries: The warforged titan makes a sweep with its axehand, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Hard Freeze
entries: If the myrmidon takes 20 or more cold damage from a single source, it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Crushing Tide
entries: If the myrmidon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) cold damage.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks and can use its Geyser Jet or Churning Swell.

action.name: Waveblade Glaive
