entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature that is at least partially submerged.

action.name: Geyser-Jet
entries: The myrmidon sprays a stream of frigid water at a creature within 60 feet, forcing it to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 13 (3d8) cold damage and is pushed up to 15 feet, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Churning Swell
entries: The myrmidon moves up to half its speed, then each creature within 5 feet of it must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

name: Werebat

walk.condition: (climb 30 ft. fly 60 ft. in bat or hybrid form)

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The werebat can use its action to polymorph into a Medium bat-humanoid hybrid, or into a Large giant bat, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Echolocation (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The werebat has blindsight out to a range of 60 feet as long as it's not deafened.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The werebat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Nimble Escape (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: The werebat can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the werebat has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: In humanoid form, the werebat makes two scimitar attacks or two shortbow attacks. In hybrid form, it can make one bite attack and one scimitar attack.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the werebat gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werebat lycanthropy.

action.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Werebear
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the werebear can transform into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid, into a Large bear, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The werebear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the werebear must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the werebear is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The werebear makes two attacks with its claws and one with its bite.

action.name: Ripping Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Heavy Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target suffers one additional effect of the werebear's choice.
The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be  grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained.
The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.
The target must succeeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have one item it is holding knocked out of its grip and flung 10 feet away.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the wereboar can transform into a boar-humanoid hybrid, into a Large boar, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Frantic Charge
entries: When the wereboar takes the Dash action, it may make one melee attack as a Bonus Action. If this attack hits,  the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wereboar is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wereboar makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its Tusk Gore.

action.name: Ploughsledge Maul (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Bristling Fist (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tusk Gore (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
A prone target takes an additional 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage that would reduce it to 0 hit points, the wereboar makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the wereboar is instead reduced to 1 hit point. If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at disadvantage.

name: Werejaguar
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The werejaguar can use its action to polymorph into a jaguar-humanoid hybrid or into a jaguar, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The werejaguar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pounce (Jaguar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: If the werejaguar moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the werejaguar can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: In humanoid form, the werejaguar makes two scimitar attacks or two longbow attacks. In hybrid form, it can attack like a humanoid or make two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite (Jaguar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werejaguar lycanthropy.

action.name: Claw (Jaguar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Wererat
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the wererat can transform into a rat-humanoid hybrid, into a Large rat, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The wererat may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wererat is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wererat makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Gnawing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on on a DC 11 Constituton saving throw or be infected with filth fever.

action.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)

reaction.name: Blink Out

action.name: Frozen Pane

action.name: Rime Shackle (5th Level Spell, Concentration)

An affected creature can use its action to shatter the bridge with a successful DC 15 Strength saving throw. The bridge can also be damaged; it has AC 15, 30 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage.

entries: The gang packs tightly, facing its spears outward. Until the start of its next turn, whenever a creature enters a space within 5 feet of the gang for the first time on a turn, the gang can deal 5 (2d4) piercing damage to it.

action.name: Cleaver Volley

action.name: Cover Eyes
entries: The goblin attempts to cover the eyes of a creature it is attached to, forcing the target to make a DC 13 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice). On a failed save, the target becomes blinded until the goblin makes an attack or is no longer attached to it.

action.name: Trick-Crack

entries: When the goose detects an invisible creature or one hiding from it, it can allow each creature within 60 feet of it to use its reaction to take the Search action.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire warwing gaggle takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Reserved Capacity
entries: While the gaggle has at least half of its hit points, it can use its action to move up to half its speed and make one melee attack on its turn, even while incapacitated or unconscious.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The gaggle can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Large creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gaggle makes one attack against each creature of its choice in its space, or makes one attack and uses its Honked Cacophony.

action.name: Raspy Ruckus
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (5d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 24 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage if the gaggle has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Honked Cacophony
entries: The gaggle honks a discordant melody, forcing each creature within 20 feet of it to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature loses concentration if it is concentrating, and can't concentrate for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Thrashing Flurry
entries: Until the end of the gaggle's next turn, it can't use its flying speed, and each creature that enters its space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone, taking half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Raise Racket
entries: When the gaggle detects an invisible creature or one hiding from it, it can allow each creature within 60 feet of it to use its reaction to take the Search action.

name: Goose Mother
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing admage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Bickering Gaggle
entries: The goose has five heads, and loses one whenever she takes 50 or more damage from a single source. While she has at least two heads, she has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

trait.name: Glittering Shroud
entries: When the goose fails a saving throw, she can envelop herself in a cocoon of feathers, becoming incapacitated and gaining resistance to all damage except for fire damage until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Gainsay the Gods (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the goose is reduced to 0 hit points or loses all of her heads, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she resets to 403 hit points, grows two heads if she has less than seven, and trumpets a mighty clairon, ending one spell or magical effect within 60 feet for each head she has remaining.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goose makes a number of attacks with her Viperous Strikes equal to the number of heads she has.

action.name: Viperous Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 23). A creature grappled by two or more of her heads is considered restrained.

action.name: Spit Nettles (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The goose spits a spray of stinging nettles from each of her heads, forcing a number of creatures within 60 feet of her equal to the number of heads she has to make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 28 (8d6) poison damage. If a target fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is additionally dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: The Empress Makes Her Bed (1/Day)
entries: The goose moves up to her fly speed, shedding a cascade of down from herself as she does. Each creature who she moves over must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 48 (4d8 + 30) bludgeoning damage and is buried in a pile of down, becoming restrained until a creature uses an action to free it. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Raise Racket
entries: When the goose detects an invisible creature or one hiding from her, she can allow each creature within 60 feet of her to use its reaction to take the Search action.

legendary.name: Viperous Storm
entries: The goose makes two attacks with her Viperous Strikes against a single target.

legendary.name: Terror Honk
entries: The goose suddenly honks at a creature within 60 feet of her, forcing the target to make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature loses concentration if it is concentrating, and is frightened of the goose until the start of her next turn.
While frightened in this way, a creature can't concentrate and is considered turned.

legendary.name: Wing Flurry (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The goose flings herself up to 30 feet, and then forces each creature within 15 feet of her to make a DC 23 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a success, a target takes half as much damage and is pushed 10 feet away from the goose.

mythic.name: Cackle at Death
entries: If the goose has fewer than seven heads, she grows two heads.

mythic.name: Rip and Tear (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature grappled by at least two of the goose's heads must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution throw or take 66 (3d10 + 50) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more of the goose's heads. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is ripped in half and dies.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire wolf pack takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Predatory Bearing
entries: The pack has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has no allies within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The pack can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Large creature.

action.name: Pack Harry
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d8 + 3) piercing damage, or 16 (3d8 + 3) piercing damage if the pack has half of its hit points or fewer, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
If this attack was made as an opportunity attack, the target additionally falls prone on a hit.

bonus.name: Rip and Tear
entries: The pack tugs and tears at a creature grappled by it, forcing the target to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 18 (4d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Packbond
entries: At initiative count 0, Fenrir can change its initiative to that of a friendly wolf he can see within 60 feet.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Fenrir has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of his allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Evil out of Hunger (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Fenrir is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 154 hit points and waves of black hunger begin to roll forth from him in a 30 foot radius.
A creature that ends its turn in the area without consuming anything must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Devouring Altar (3/Day)
entries: If Fenrir fails a saving throw against an effect that would incapacitate him, he can choose to succeed instead, then gain a level of exhaustion.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Fenrir makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Worry or Dire Howl, if available.

action.name: Cruel Jaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 21).
If this attack was made as an opportunity attack, the target additionally falls prone on a hit.

action.name: Shoulder Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
If Fenrir missed with his Cruel Jaws this turn, he can make this attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Worry
entries: Fenrir tugs and tears at a creature grappled both by him and by one of his allies, forcing the target to make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target takes 39 (6d12) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Dire Howl
entries: Fenrir howls forth a shuddering cry; each creature of his choice within 60 feet that can hear him must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more must use its reaction to move its speed directly away from Fenrir, if available.

action.name: Howlpath Aurora (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: Fenrir opens the sky above him and shimmering lights spill forth, bathing the area in a 500 foot radius in an eldritch glow.
At the end of each of Fenrir's turns, he can call 2 (1d4) Dire Wolves, or one Dire Wolf Pack if his Mythic Trait is active, to rain down from the sky into unoccupied spaces within range.

reaction.name: Hem In
entries: When a friendly creature Fenrir can see misses with a melee attack, he can move up to half his speed toward the attack's target.

reaction.name: Consume Offering
entries: Whenever a creature within 30 feet consumes a potion or similar item, Fenrir can negate its effects, then regains 15 hit points or a use of his Devouring Altar.

legendary.name: Contagion Mists
entries: Fenrir shakes and snorts, shedding a sickening mist that heavily obscures a 30 foot radius around him until he is hit with a melee attack.
A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Gnawnerves.

legendary.name: Shift Pack
entries: Each other wolf that Fenrir can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.

legendary.name: Bounding Snap (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Fenrir leaps up to 30 feet, then can make an attack with his Cruel Jaws against a creature he can see.

mythic.name: Devour the Sun (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Dark, celestial jaws begin close around the sun and moon, plunging the world into darkness for the next minute.
Creatures on this plane have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened for the duration, and Fenrir regains a use of his Howlpack Aurora.

name: Dendar, the Night Serpent
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Living Shadow
entries: While in dim light or darkness, Dendar is immune to damage that isn't force, psychic, or radiant and she can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Dendar fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Harbinger of Shadows (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If Dendar would be reduced to 0 hit points, her current hit point total instead resets to 300 hit points. Additionally, Dendar can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dendar uses her Aura of Madness, then makes two attacks with her bite and one attack with her constrict. She can replace the constrict attack with a use of her Mana Drain, Night Mother's Kiss, or Oblivion.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage, the target is grappled (escape DC 23), and the target must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes an additional 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and its hit point maximum is reduced by an equal amount until it finishes a long rest, or half as much on a success.

If the target is a Huge or smaller creature grappled by Dendar, instead of dealing damage, she can choose to swallow it. While swallowed in this way, the creature takes 42 (12d6) psychic damage at the start of each of Dendar's turns, and is considered to be in the Shadowfell for the purposes of spells and abilities.

If Dendar takes 40 damage or more from a single creature inside her, she must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of her.

action.name: Midnight Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Gargantuan or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 23). Until this grapple ends, the target is blinded, restrained, and choking.

action.name: Aura of Madness
entries: Each creature of Dendar's choice that is within 120 feet of her and aware of her must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or suffer short-term madness for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Dendar's Aura of Madness for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Mana Drain
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 23 Charisma saving throw or have its highest level unexpended spell slot expended. If Dendar expends a spell slot of 7th level or above in this way, the next time she uses her Blightning it deals maximum damage, instead of rolling.

action.name: Night Mother's Kiss (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Dendar forces a creature within 60 feet of her to make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, dark whispers fill its mind, wracking it with terrible pain and manipulating its actions. For 1 minute, the creature is charmed by Dendar, and takes 11 (3d6) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns (save ends at end of turn). This damage does not wake a sleeping creature.

action.name: Oblivion (5th Level Spell)
entries: Dendar exudes energy that overwhelms creatures around her with drowsiness. Creatures within 20 feet of her must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep for 1 minute, until it takes any amount of damage, or until another creature within 5 feet of them uses an action to wake them.

action.name: Blightning (Recharge 5-6, 7th Level Spell)
entries: Dendar fans her hood and hisses, firing black lightning in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) lightning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a success.

A living creature that fails its saving throw is suffused with necrotic energy. Whenever the creature would regain hit points, it regains half as many hit points. A greater restoration spell or similar magic will end this effect.

reaction.name: Shunt Pain
entries: When Dendar takes any amount of damage while a creature charmed by her is within 10 feet of her, she can reduce the damage by half, and deal psychic damage to the charmed creature equal to the damage she takes after reduction.

legendary.name: Dark Command
entries: Dendar gazes at a creature charmed by her and temporarily fully overrides its free will. The target must make a DC 23 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of the target's next turn, it is dominated by Dendar.

legendary.name: Night Mother's Kiss
entries: Dendar uses her Night Mother's Kiss.

legendary.name: Dream Eater (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Dendar devours the dreams of a sleeping creature within 120 feet of her. The target gains no benefits from resting, is considered dazed, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 32 (6d10) until it is cured by a greater restoration spell or similar magic.
If this effect reduces a creature's maximum hit points to 0, the target dies and its soul is consumed by Dendar. The target cannot be restored to life by any means short of the wish spell.

mythic.name: Phantasmal Horror (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: While in darkness, Dendar turns invisible until the start of her next turn. Creatures grappled by Dendar turn invisible along with her, as does anything she is wearing or carrying. This effect ends early if she attacks or casts a spell.

mythic.name: Devour the Sun (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Dendar plunges the area within 1 mile of her into magical darkness for 1 hour. Creatures who enter the darkness for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 11 (3d6) psychic damage. This damage does not wake a sleeping creature. Creatures within the darkness have disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed.

trait.name: Ancestral Memory
entries: The wood woad remembers each wrong and trespass its home forest has ever suffered. It can recognize those who have wronged the forest and their descendants, but has difficulty distinguishing between the two.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on its turn, the wood wad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

trait.name: Nourishing Roots
entries: If the wood woad ends its turn without spending more than half of its movement, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the wood woad takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the wood woad takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wood woad makes two attacks with its cudgel, one of which it may replace with a use of its Nature's Judgement, if available.

action.name: Cudgel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Nature's Judgement (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One humanoid creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained for the next minute. A creature proficient in Nature checks makes this save at advantage.

While restrained, the creature takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the nearest Fey or Plant creature friendly to the wood woad recovers the same amount of hit points. A creature can repeat this save as an action, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the worg moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the worg can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Baying Pack
entries: A group of three or more worgs has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the worg can grapple the target (escape DC 13).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both the worg and at least one of the worg's allies must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 17 (5d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Wraith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

name: Drelb
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Twilight Haunt
entries: At dawn, if the drelb is outside the Plane of Negative Energy it is banished there until the next dusk.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drelb makes two attacks with its Bloodless Fists.

action.name: Bloodless Fists
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Nether Chill (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The drelb fixes its gaze upon a Medium or smaller creature it can see within 30 feet, turning its blood cold.
The target takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and falls prone, then must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand for the next minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Trick of Perspective
entries: When a creature makes an opportunity attack against the drelb, the drelb can reveal that it was simply shrinking, rather than moving away.
The opportunity attack misses, and the drelb teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the attacker, then uses its Nether Chill against the attacker, if available.

reaction.name: Psionic Repeater
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the drelb uses a psionic ability that targets one or more creatures, the drelb can cause that ability to target one additional creature.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The wurm deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Earth Tremors
entries: The wurm creates earth tremors as it moves overland or underground. Any creature that comes within 30 feet of the moving wurm for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Any structure or object anchored to the ground that comes within 30 feet of the moving wurm for the first time on a turn takes 10 (3d6) force damage.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (5d6 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the wurm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the wurm, and takes 17 (5d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. If the wurm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wurm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wurm. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Raxivort's Tongue
entries: The xvart can communicate with ordinary bats and rats.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If at least one of the xvart's allies is within 5 feet of the target, the xvart can push the target 5 feet if the target is a Medium or smaller creature.

action.name: Sling
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Low Cunning
entries: The xvart takes the Disengage action.

name: Yagnoloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A yagnoloth will usually accept a rate of its challenge rating times 25 gp, or half as much for a creature willing to pledge a future service.

trait.name: Electrified Flesh
entries: A creature that hits the yugoloth with a melee attack can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yagnoloth uses two of its actions. It may not use the same action twice in a turn.

action.name: Battlefield Cunning
entries: One allied yugoloth within 60 feet of the yagnoloth that can hear it can use its reaction to make one melee attack.

action.name: Lightning Bolt (3rd level spell)
entries: Creatures in a 100 ft. long, 5 ft. wide line must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Massive Arm
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone and unable to stand until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.

action.name: Teleport (3rd level spell)
entries: The yagnoloth magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Dark Escape
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the yagnoloth may shroud itself in a 20 foot radius cloud of magical darkness until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Steal Life
entries: As a reaction to passing a saving throw against a spell, the yagnoloth may force the spell caster to make a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the spell caster is teleported to within 5 feet of the yagnoloth, takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and expends two hit die. If the spell caster cannot do so, it drops to 0 HP instead.

trait.name: Trample
entries: If the yak moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Overheat
entries: If the yak takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Grunting Bellow
entries: Each creature within 20 feet that can hear the yak must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the yak's next turn.
Until the beginning of its next turn, the yak may make a gore attack as a reaction against any creature that enters its reach.

reaction.name: Give Chase
entries: As a reaction to a hostile creature the yak can see ending its movement at least 20 ft. further from the yak than it started, the yak moves up to half its speed towards the creature.
If the yak ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, it may make a gore attack as part of this reaction.

name: Yeenoghu, Beast of Butchery

resist.preNote: damage from attacks made without advantage

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When Yeenoghu reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, Yeenoghu can take a bonus action to move up to half his speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Seething Fury
entries: If Yeenoghu begins his turn incapacitated, on his following turn he may take an additional action.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Yeenoghu may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Yeenoghu. While climbing on Yeenoghu, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against Yeenoghu.

trait.name: Hunger Unto Madness
entries: When Yeenoghu makes a bite attack against a dead or unconscious creature, he gains 20 temporary hit points and begins to swallow the creature whole.
At the beginning of Yeenoghu's next turn, the creature is swallowed and cannot be retrieved while Yeenoghu lives. While Yeenoghu is swallowing a creature, attacks against him are made at advantage.
A creature may free a creature that is being swallowed with a successful  DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check, or by dealing a critical hit to Yeenoghu.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Yeenoghu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Yeenoghu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Yeenoghu makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with his Unhinged Jaws.

action.name: Unhinged Jaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) piercing damage and the creature is grappled (escape DC 24). While Yeenoghu has a creature grappled in this way, he can't bite another creature.

action.name: The Butcherflail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one additional effect of Yeenoghu's choice:

items.name: Hunger
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or lose three unexpended hit dice. If the target cannot, it instead takes a level of exhaustion.

items.name: Pain
entries: The target takes an additional 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

items.name: Terror
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Decay
entries: If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it suffers a permanent and cumulative -1 to the AC it offers.

action.name: Path of The Lord of Ruin (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Yeenoghu moves up to his speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any construct of force and of any creature smaller than Huge.

Each creature whose space he moves through in this way must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or and take 52 (8d12) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that succeeds by 5 or more stops this movement from continuing past it.

reaction.name: Gorecall
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, Yeenoghu forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 ft. toward him and knocked prone.

reaction.name: Deiphage Spawning (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 283 hit points, Yeenoghu creates six Gnoll Deathpleged within his body, which immediately chew their way out of his wounds and land prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces. Yeenoghu takes 17 (6d4 + 2) damage.

legendary.name: Blood Feast
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that has fewer than half of its hit points must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or be marked as prey. For the next minute, gnolls may make a bite attack against the creature as a bonus action. This effect ends early if the creature regains any hit points

legendary.name: Flesh Craze
entries: Up to three gnolls within 60 ft. may each use their reaction to move up to their speed toward a creature of Yeenoghu's choice without provoking attacks of opportunity.

legendary.name: Wake Bones
entries: One friendly gnoll within 60 ft. becomes suffused with negative energy, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target dies in the next minute, its flesh sloughs off and it immediately rises as a witherling.

name: Yeth Hound
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: Elvish and Sylvan but can't speak

trait.name: Beasts of Nightmare
entries: A frightened creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of one or more yeth hounds has its speed reduced by half until the beginning of its next turn.
If a creature affected by this ability Dashes, it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Banished by Sunlight
entries: If the hound ends its turn in sunlight, it dissolves into smoke and dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hound makes two attacks with its Heel Snap, one of which it may replace with a use of its Ghastly Baying, if available.

action.name: Heel Snap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one frightened target. Hit: 14 (4d6) psychic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer a failed Death Save.

action.name: Ghastly Baying (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hound lets out a shrieking, exhultant howl. Each enemy within 300 feet that can hear the hound must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the hound's next turn.
A creature that fails by 5 or more must use its action to Dash.

reaction.name: Sooted Slip
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell that targets only it, the yeth hound turns briefly to smoke, making a contested Dexterity check against the spell's caster. On a success, the spell passes through it without effect.

trait.name: Heat Intolerant
entries: If the yeti takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain a level of Exhaustion.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The yeti has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Snow-Dweller
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain, and can see in areas heavily obscured due to falling snow as though they were lightly obscured.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yeti makes two attacks with its Frostbreaker Fist and uses its Chilling Gaze, if available.

action.name: Frostbreaker Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the yeti may grapple the target (escape DC 14).

action.name: Chilling Gaze (Recharges when the yeti takes the Hide action)
entries: One creature the yeti can see within 40 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) cold damage, then gain an equal number of temporary hit points as a crust of ice crawls over it.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is restrained. A creature freed from this effect by bludgeoning damage immediately takes 10 (3d6) additional slashing damage.

reaction.name: Eerie Whistle (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the yeti takes damage, it lets out an echoing whistle, and each other yeti within 1 mile may also take this reaction.

Each non-yeti creature within 1 mile of three or more yetis that took this reaction must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened by each of them for the next minute (save ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Heat Intolerant
entries: If the yeti takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain a level of Exhaustion.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The yeti has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Snow-Dweller
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain, and can see in areas heavily obscured due to falling snow as though they were lightly obscured.

trait.name: Shrine Watcher
entries: The yeti may cast any Divine spell of 3rd level or below that it saw another creature cast since the end of its last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yeti makes three attacks with its Crushing Grasp, one of which it may replace with the Hide action or its Chilling Gaze, if available.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).
A creature already grappled in this way takes an additional 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chilling Gaze (Recharges when the yeti takes the Hide action)
entries: One creature the yeti can see within 40 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) cold damage, then gain an equal number of temporary hit points as a crust of ice crawls over it.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is restrained. A creature freed from this effect by bludgeoning damage immediately takes 10 (3d6) additional slashing damage.

action.name: Spiritrend Screech (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The yeti calls out a deafening screech that reverberates across the ethereal plane. Each creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) thunder plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.
Ethereal undead creatures have disadvantage on this saving throw, and take maximum damage on a failed save.

reaction.name: Eerie Whistle (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the yeti takes damage, it lets out an echoing whistle, and each other yeti within 1 mile may also take this reaction.

Each non-yeti creature within 1 mile of three or more yetis that took this reaction must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened by each of them for the next minute (save ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The yeti has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Snow-Dweller
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain, and can see in areas heavily obscured due to falling snow as though they were lightly obscured.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

trait.name: Cavities
entries: The yggdrasti has 1d4 + 2 cavities in its trunk. Each cavity is big enough to hold one Medium creature, two Small creatures, or eight Tiny creatures. A creature inside a cavity has three-quarters cover against attacks and other effects that originate outside the cavity. The yggdrasti's cavities aren't connected to one another.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the yggdrasti is motionless and rooted in the ground at the start of combat, it looks just like a dead tree and has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the rooted yggdrasti move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the yggdrasti is animate.

trait.name: Lightning Conduit
entries: If the yggdrasti is subjected to lightning damage, it is unhurt, and the lightning damage is instead divided evenly among all creatures it is grappling. In addition, the yggdrasti regains one use of Lightning Discharge.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The yggdrasti doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yggdrasti makes two Root attacks and uses Lightning Discharge (if available).

action.name: Root
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). The yggdrasti has four roots, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Lightning Discharge (3/Day)
entries: The yggdrasti shoots lightning at one creature within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 15 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 15.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Shattergem Breath
entries: The dragon breathes forth a hail of luminous crystals in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

At the end of the dragon's next turn, the gems detonate. Each creature within 10 feet of the line must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 33 (6d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Singularity Breath
entries: The dragon creates a shining bead of gravitational force in its mouth, then releases the energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Psychokinetic Hurl
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be flung up to 20 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes invisible to one creature it can see until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature that it can telepathically communicate with.

reaction.name: Psychoport Inversion
entries: As a reaction when a creature teleports to or away from a space the dragon can see, the dragon forces it to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force damage and immediately teleport back.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Molten Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon breaths a spray of lava in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage, and it becomes restrained by rapidly hardening igneous rock until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and it isn't restrained.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 10 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 19-20.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each frightened creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite or Tailbarb Stab.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one nonmagical weapon or piece of armor that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target prone or grapple it (escape DC 15).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target begins bleeding (1d10).

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 30 feet, where it splashes in a 5 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove DC 14).

A sludge-drenched creature is blinded, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 30-foot long, 5-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 49 (11d8) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers an acid injury.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 10 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to the number rolled.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and attacks of opportunity made against it have disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Sparking Bite.

action.name: Sparking Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

action.name: Sandhoned Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may grapple the target (escape DC 17).

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to three creatures the dragon can see within 60 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 60 foot long, 5 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 44 (8d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Battle of Wits
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can push a creature grappled by it up to 10 feet into the attack's path.
The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence (Insight) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the pushed creature.

trait.name: Burning Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the dragon takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: This Reminds Me..
entries: The dragon begins telling a story that lasts until the end of its next turn. While the dragon is telling a story, it cannot use its breath weapons, and a creature that can hear the dragon and attempts to target the dragon with an attack or harmful spell must first make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Breath of Lingering Flames
entries: The dragon exhales fire in an 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide and persists until the end of its next turn. Each creature that starts its turn in that line, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 42 (12d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful save.

action.name: Breath of Deepening Sleep
entries: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute and gain 10 (3d6) temporary hit points, or 21 (6d6) temporary hit points if it failed the save by 5 or more. This effect ends for a creature if it loses any non-temporary hit points.

reaction.name: I Wasn't Finished!
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting the dragon with a melee attack while the dragon is telling a story, the dragon ends the story and uses one of its breath weapons, if available.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Battle Analyst
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against any spells or abilities it has been affected by in the last 24 hours.

Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 40 feet away from the dragon.  A creature wearing metal armor makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Correct Form (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 30 feet, the dragon forces the spell caster to cast the spell at a level one higher than it intended. If the spell caster cannot, the spell fails.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the bulette moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Outshine the Eager
entries: At initiative count 20, the dragon may force one creature within 60 ft. that it can see to make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the dragon trades initiatives with it.

trait.name: Jester's Fury
entries: Whenever one or more creatures fail to laugh at a humorous comment or pun made by the dragon, it rolls to recharge its breath weapon.

action.name: Alkahest Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in an 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) acid damage and losing 20% of the gold and platinum it is carrying on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Unattended gold and platinum in the area dissolves entirely.

action.name: Slowing Breath
entries: The dragon exhales gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

reaction.name: Banter
entries: As a reaction when a creature the dragon can see ends its turn within 60 ft. of it, the dragon offers a humorous comment or pun on an action the creature took this turn. The creature may use its reaction to reply with a humorous comment or salient pun of its own. If it does, both the creature and the dragon have advantage on the next attack or saving throw they make in the next minute. If it fails to do so, the creature has disadvantage on the next attack or saving throw it makes in the next minute.

trait.name: Snowy Camouflage
entries: The dragon may attempt to hide in snowy terrain without being obscured.

trait.name: Lifechannel Aura
entries: At the beginning of each of the dragon's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it gains 5 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

action.name: Claw

action.name: Breath of Life Overflowing
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of pure life energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) radiant damage and regaining 2 (1d4) expended hit dice on a failure, or taking half as much damage on a success.

Then, if the creature has no unexpended hit dice, it incandesces, losing each of its unexpended hit dice, rolling a number of d8s equal to the number of hit dice lost in this way, and taking additional radiant damage equal to the result.

action.name: Breath of Inner Dawn
entries: The dragon blows a mighty breath in a 30 foot long, 5 foot wide line that stokes a blinding glow within all it touches.

The dragon and each creature and object in the area begins to emit sunlight in a 30 foot radius for the next minute, and a creature without resistance to radiant damage that targets an affected creature with an attack or spell must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Pacify (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that the dragon can see must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, for the next minute the creature takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage whenever it deals damage.

items.name: Psychic Intrusion (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that the dragon can see must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or gain disadvantage on attacks made against the dragon.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The dragon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Extinguishing Aura
entries: The dragon is surrounded by an aura of light-eating microbes. At the beginning of the dragon's turn, each light source within 15 ft. diminishes one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.

On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is covered in spores until a creature takes an action to remove them. While covered in these spores, a creature is frightened.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 30-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 14) as it begins to sink into the stone.
A creature already affected by this ability that fails the saving throw sinks entirely beneath the surface, and is blinded and cannot speak or breathe until it escapes.

reaction.name: Phantasmagoria
entries: As a reaction when a frightened creature fails a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, the dragon forces the creature to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the dragon's choice.

trait.name: Huge Stature

While climbing on the dragon turtle, a creature has advantage on melee attacks made against the dragon turtle, and the dragon turtle has disadvantage on attacks made against the creature.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dragon turtle fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.
