entries: While in sunlight, the yuan-ti adds 1d4 to the result of any attack roll or Charisma check it makes.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The yuan-ti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Fed by Terror
entries: At the beginning of its turn, if one creature within 60 feet is frightened of it, the yuan-ti increases its size to Large. If two or more creatures within 60 feet are frightened of it, the yuan-ti instead increases its size to Huge. If no creatures within 60 feet are frightened of it, it reverts to its normal size.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yuan-ti makes two melee attacks if it is size Medium, three attacks if it is size Large, and four attacks if it is size Huge, one of which may be with its Bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Invoke Nightmare
entries: The yuan-ti evokes the nightmares of a creature it can see within 60 feet, appearing to that creature as a manifestation of its deepest fears.

The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (4d10) psychic damage and be frightened for the next minute, or take half as much damage on a success. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Blessed by the Sun
entries: While in sunlight, the yuan-ti adds 1d4 to the result of any attack roll or Charisma check it makes.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The yuan-ti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Serpent's Glory
entries: Friendly yuan-ti within 30 feet of the Pit Master may use its attack bonus, rather than their own.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yuan-ti attacks once with its Flurry of Bites and uses its Sinuous Command. If it has fewer than 69 hit points, it may instead attack twice with its Flurry of Bites.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Sinuous Command
entries: One friendly yuan-ti may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and take an action. If it does, it can't take actions on its following turn, other than to disengage.

reaction.name: Embrace the Swarm
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 69 hit points, the yuan-ti transforms into a swarm of venomous snakes. Its statistics remain the same, except it can occupy another creature's space, it has advantage on melee attacks, and it has resistance to blugeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

trait.name: Blessed by the Sun
entries: While in sunlight, the yuan-ti adds 1d4 to the result of any attack roll or Charisma check it makes.

trait.name: Cold Reading
entries: The yuan-ti has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to present themselves as a forgotten friendly acquaintance.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yuan-ti makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

name: Zaratan
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the zaratan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Earth Shaking Movement
entries: Whenever the zaratan moves at least 10 feet, the ground in a 120 foot radius becomes difficult terrain for other creatures until the beginning of its next turn. Structures in the area collapse. Each creature in the area, and each creature climbing on the zaratan must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Titanic Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the zaratan may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zaratan's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the zaratan's legs to its back, or from its back to its head.

items.name: Legs
entries: While climbing on the zaratan's legs, a creature has advantage on attacks against it.

items.name: Back
entries: While climbing on the zaratan's back, the zaratan has immunity to damage the creature deals and cannot target the creature with melee attacks. A creature on the zaratan's back that falls prone does not fall off.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the zaratan's head, the creature has advantage on melee attacks against the zaratan and the zaratan cannot target the creature with melee attacks. A creature on the zaratan's head that falls prone does not fall off.

trait.name: Ponderous
entries: The zaratan moves only when it uses its stride action.

trait.name: Slow to Wrath
entries: When the Zaratan is reduced below 100 HP, it gains a second legendary action and immediately regains all spent actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zaratan makes two attacks: one with its stride and one with its bite, its spit rock or its swalow.

action.name: Stride
entries: The zaratan takes a single step, moving up to its movement speed. Each creature in a 20 foot radius area within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 26 (3d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success. A prone creature has disadvantage on this save.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the zaratan can't bite another target.

action.name: Spit Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, range 120/240 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The zaratan makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zaratan, its attacks bypass the zaratan's resistances, and it takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the zaratan's turns.

If the zaratan takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the zaratan.

action.name: Spew Debris (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The zaratan exhales rocky debris in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is knocked prone.

legendary.name: Stride
entries: The zaratan uses its stride.

legendary.name: Chomp
entries: The zaratan makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

legendary.name: Retract
entries: The zaratan retracts its head into its shell. Each creature climbing on its head must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or fall 100 feet. On a successful save, the creature may leap to the zaratan's back as a reaction. If it cannot, it falls.

legendary.name: Bone-Shattering Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The zaratan emits a titanic roar in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Zombie Clot
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Deathly Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) poison damage and be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Flesh Entomb (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The zombie flings a detached clump of corpses at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it becomes entombed in dead flesh.

A creature entombed in the dead flesh is restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the dead flesh, and takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature can be freed if the dead flesh is destroyed. The dead flesh is a Large object with AC 10, 25 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The zorbo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Natural Armor
entries: The zorbo magically absorbs the natural strength of its surroundings, adjusting its Armor Class based on the material it is standing or climbing on: AC 15 for wood or bone, AC 17 for earth or stone, or AC 19 for metal. If the zorbo isn't in contact with any of these substances, its AC is 10.

action.name: Destructive Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature wearing armor, carrying a shield, or in possession of a magic item that improves its AC, it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, one such item worn or carried by the creature (the target's choice) magically deteriorates, taking a permanent and cumulative âˆ’1 penalty to the AC it offers, and the zorbo gains a +1 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield or magic item that drops to a 0 AC increase is destroyed.

name: Zuggtmoy, Queen of Rot
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Creeping Mycelia
entries: When a creature ends its turn within 10 feet of Zuggtmoy, she may extend a tendril of mycelia from the ground, forcing the creature to succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled in place (escape DC 21).
While grappled in this way, a creature is charmed by Zuggtmoy and takes 11 (2d10) poison damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Demonrot Toxin
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of Zuggtmoy must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or lose any Resistance or Immunity to poison or disease that it has for the next 24 hours and be unable to gain Resistance or Immunity to poison or disease until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Zuggtmoy has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Zuggtmoy fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zuggtmoy makes two attacks with her Queen's Caress, one of which she may replace with her Sprouting Doom or Rotted Regenesis.

action.name: Queen's Caress
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic plus 18 (4d8) poison damage and the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws until the end of Zuggtmoy's next turn.

action.name: Sprouting Doom
entries: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5 foot radius centered on a point Zuggtmoy can see within 120 feet.

The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

action.name: Rotted Regenesis
entries: Zuggtmoy's body rapidly blackens and withers, then explodes in a cloud of spores. Each nonplant creature within 10 feet of her must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
Zuggtmoy reappears in an unoccupied space affected by Sprouting Doom, forming a new body from the fungi there.

action.name: Burrowing Sporeflood (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Zuggtmoy's torso distends and splits, expelling a torrent of flesh-burrowing spores in a 60 foot cone. Each nonplant creature in the area must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) piercing plus 27 (6d8) poison damage and is infected with Brittle Lung, or takes half as much damage on a successful save.

action.name: Garden of Rot and Ruin (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Each area affected by Sprouting Doom within 120 feet of Zuggtmoy releases a cloud of hallucinogenic spores in a 30 foot radius centered on itself that lasts until the area is destroyed or Zuggtmoy loses concentration.

The area is heavily obscured, and each nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, a creature treats all creatures it is not charmed by as hostile.

reaction.name: Rot Mother's Rebirth
entries: As a reaction when one or more creatures die within 60 feet of Zuggtmoy, she immediately  raises each of them with 20 hit points. The creatures' type becomes plant/undead, and they act under her control.

reaction.name: Consumptive Bloom
entries: As a reaction when zuggtmoy is targeted with an attack or spell, she may kill one friendly plant creature within 30 feet of her. If she does, she immediately uses her Rotted Regenesis.

legendary.name: Sprouting Doom
entries: Zuggtmoy uses her Sprouting Doom.

legendary.name: Feast on the Fallen
entries: A carpet of fungal growths spreads over one prone creature Zuggtmoy can see within 30 feet and takes root in its flesh.
Until a creature clears them as an action, whenever the affected creature would receive any amount magical healing it instead receives half as much.

legendary.name: Cultivator's Reap
entries: Zuggtmoy moves up to half her speed. If she ends this movement within 10 feet of a friendly plant creature, it loses half its current hit points and Zuggtmoy gains temporary hit points equal to the hit points lost.

legendary.name: Breed Ruin (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Zuggtmoy creates a Deathbloom Sporocyte in an unoccupied space affected by Sprouting Doom.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The biote casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

action.name: Echoing Scratch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw, taking 1 slashing damage on a failure or ending the recurring slashing damage on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The gonbun casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d8 - 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Spit Fire (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The GonBun spits a wave of flames that cover a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The m'aw can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny or Small creature, or back into its true form. Each form resembles a beast, but has strange features like vibrant colors, extra eyes or legs, or other unnatural traits. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Swallow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage and the target is swallowed. The swallowed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 3 (1d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the m'aw's turns. During this time, the target creature exists in a pocket dimension.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the m'aw.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The nyart's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Untraceable
entries: The nyart cannot be targeted by any divination magic, perceived through magical scrying sensors, and all attempts to teleport to the nyart automatically fail.

trait.name: Wormhole
entries: As a bonus action, the nyart can create a small, inky black wormhole within 5 feet of itself. The wormhole can lead to anywhere in the universe the nyart desires, provided there is at least 1 square foot of darkness near the destination. Only the nyart can use the rift, and it lasts until the end of the nyart's next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Whispers of Doom
entries: The nyrat targets one creature within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 4 (2d4) psychic damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Create Young
entries: The shub breaths out a primordial fog that spawns 1d4 young. A young is a tiny aberration with an AC of 12, 1 hit point, and a flying speed of 15 feet. They have a +2 to attack and deal 1 necrotic damage. On the shub's turn, it can use a bonus action to command any young within 30 feet of it to attack one enemy of its choice. A shub can have up to 10 young.

trait.name: Enigmatic Nature
entries: The skinti is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.

action.name: Noodle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Meatball
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Latch On
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocating. While grappling a creature this way, the skull tick is also restrained. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claim Host
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature the skull tick is latched on to. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points, the skull tick kills the target by taking control of their brain. As long as the skull tick is attached to this body, it can control the body and gains the same statistics as a zombie. It can choose to detach itself as an action. The skull tick dies if the zombie is slain while it is attached.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The soth's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d8 - 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chaotic Tune
entries: The thoth ball plays a timeless melody that overlaps itself. Every creature within 30 feet of it that can hear the tune must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or take 7 (1d10 + 2) psychic damage. A creature that succeeds on this save is immune to this ability for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Scratch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Evoke Madness (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The tulu targets one creature within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by it for the duration. While the target is charmed in this way, its blood appears black, and a madness glows in its eyes. A target that succeeds on the saving throw becomes immune to the ability for 24 hours.

The charmed creature must use its action before moving on each of its turns to make a melee attack against a random creature other than itself and the tulu. The creature becomes prone and babbles incoherently if no targets can be found.
The creature can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Otherwise, the effect lasts for one minute.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute.

action.name: Alien Surgery
entries: If the yetling is within 5 feet of another creature that died less than a minute ago, it can spend its action stealing sections of the body. It regains 1d8 missing hit points by doing this, and can make two attacks on its next attack action.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The axolotl regains 1d4 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the axolotl has lost any part of its body but is not killed, including a portion of its brain, it can regrow it during a long rest

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The butterfly has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the crab can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 ft.

trait.name: Pinch
entries: When the crab takes the Help action to grant an attack advantage against a target within 5 ft. that is Concentrating, the target must make a DC 11 Concentration check.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the crab may grapple the target (escape DC 11)

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature grappled by the crab must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the crab moves up to 5 ft. If this movement puts the crab out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the crab is unaffected.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The albertonykus' long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Lightweight
entries: The aquilops is immune to falling damage for up to 30 feet.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The compsognathus has advantage on Perception (Wisdom) checks that rely on hearing and smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The compsognathus has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the compsognathus' allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Born Companion
entries: Creatures friendly to the dog that can see it add 1d4 to saving throws against being frightened.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dog makes one bite attack and takes the Help action, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Intimidating Bark
entries: The dog snarls and barks defiantly at a creature it can see. If the creature has an Intelligence score of 4 or lower, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the dog's next turn.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. -3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Ominous Aura (Recharge 6)
entries: The duck emits an otherworldly sense of dread for no comprehensible reason. Each creature within 15 feet of the duck must succeed on a DC 8 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the duck until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Poisonous
entries: A creature that hits the toad with a melee attack using Natural Weapons takes 4 (1d8) poison damage. If this damage reduces the toad to 0 hit points, the attacker must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air and water

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the toad remains motionless, it resembles a rock and may attempt to hide without obscurement.

trait.name: Useless
entries: The koala requires 16 hours of sleep to benefit from a long rest. In addition, after attacking, the koala suffers one level of exhaustion.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Frantic Escape
entries: The lobster can double its swimming speed while moving backwards.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

trait.name: Oceanic Traveler
entries: The manta ray can always recall the general layout, flora, and fauna of locations it has visited

trait.name: Humble Guide
entries: The manta ray has 1d6 tiny fish that occupy its space alongside it.

action.name: Herd
entries: The manta ray targets one medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity check or be moved up to 10 feet in a direction the manta ray chooses.

trait.name: Faint
entries: As a reaction to any attack made against the opossum that does not kill it, the opossum's body instinctively fakes death. For the next minute, the opossum appears dead to all outward inspection and to spells used to determine the opossum's status. During this time, the opossum is paralyzed.

trait.name: Opossum Resilience
entries: The opossum has advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Plead
entries: The piglet chooses one creature within 30 feet of it. The creature must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes charmed until the end of its next turn. While the creature is charmed, it cannot attack the piglet. On a success, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The raccoon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Rabid
entries: The raccoon has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to appear friendly. It may use its Deception bonus in place of Initiative rolls.

trait.name: Nosy
entries: The racoon may use its natural weapons as Thieves Tools, and is considered proficient with them.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be infected with lyssavirus.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Relaxing Aura
entries: If there are more than 10 capybaras within 60 feet of each other, they all benefit from the sanctuary spell (DC 13).

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Dowsing Sense
entries: The beaver can detect, by sound and scent, each source of running water within 1,000 feet.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While the beaver has more than half of its hit points, it has resistance to cold and fire damage.

entries: As a reaction to a creature the titanoboa has grappled with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the titanoboa crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the allosaurus moves at least 30 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the allosaurus can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Jab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The megalania can hold its breath underwater for up to 20 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The megalania has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The megalania makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage + 4 (1d8) acid damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The deinosuchus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deinosuchus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the crocodile. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The mosasaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mosasaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Leaping Pounce
entries: The utahraptor's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start. If the deinonychus jumps at least 15 ft. then hits a creature with a claw attack, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Foe-Climber
entries: If the utahraptor hits a Huge or larger creature with a claw attack, instead of grappling it climbs on to the creature. While climbing on a creature, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that target the utahraptor.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The utahraptor makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Crushing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 17-20 against a prone creature.

action.name: Terrible Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

reaction.name: Mantle
entries: As a reaction to a prone creature within 5 ft. attempting to stand, the utahraptor makes a claw attack against it. On a hit, the target fails to stand.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the baryoynx moves at least 30 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the baryoynx can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). The baryonyx has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 39 (5d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (6d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the kronosaurus moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 16 (3d10) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The kronosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kronosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the buffalo moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and pushed 5 ft.

trait.name: Unpredictable
entries: The buffalo has advantage on saving throws against any effect that would control what action it would take, such as the charmed condition.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the ox moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The ox is considered to be a Huge animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Peck
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hummingbird makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The cyclonosaurus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cyclonosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Talons attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the cyclonosaurus can't Bite another target.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Wing Gusts (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The cyclonosaurus beats its wings, creating bursts of thunderous force. Each creature within 10 feet of the aerosaur must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) thunder damage, is pushed up to 30 feet horizontally from the cyclonosaurus, and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed up to 15 feet horizontally from the cyclonosaurus.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The altisaurus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The altisaurus makes one Stomp attack and one Tail attack. The altisaurus can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (7d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (8d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the altisaurus.

action.name: Earthquake Stomp (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The altisaurus stomps its feet, sending tremors through the ground around itself.  Creatures on the ground within 60 feet of it must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw or fall prone and take 38 (7d10) bludgeoning damage, taking half as much damage and not being knocked prone on a successful save.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The regisaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The regisaur makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack. The regisaur can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 47 (6d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the regisaur can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swallow (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one Huge or smaller creature grappled by the regisaur. Hit: The regisaur swallows the target, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the regisaur, and it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The regisaur can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time.

If the regisaur takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the regisaur must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 5 feet of the regisaur is knocked prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The titanoceratops has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The titanoceratops makes one Gore attack and one Stomp attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage. If the titanoceratops moved at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 11 (2d10) piercing damage; if the target is a creature, it also must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet from the titanoceratops and be knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Brutal Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The titanoceratops moves up to twice its speed in a straight line.  It can make one Gore attack against each creature in its path, gaining advantage on the attack roll.

name: Grolantor, Mouth of the Giants
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Runic Fury (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Grolantor would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points, he recharges his Inhale, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, Grolantor can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Grolantor fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Grolantor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Grolantor deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grolantor makes one Great Tree Club attack and two Slam attacks, or he makes three Boulder attacks.

action.name: Great Tree Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 47 (7d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be pushed horizontally up to 100 feet straight away from Grolantor and be knocked prone.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (7d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boulder
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 48 (6d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Inhale (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Grolantor inhales a vortex of air in a 120-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area that is Huge or smaller must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 120 feet straight towards Grolantor and be swallowed. A swallowed creature is restrained and blinded, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Grolantor, and takes 38 (11d6) acid damage at the start of each of Grolantor's turns.

Grolantor's stomach can hold up to two creatures at a time. If Grolantor takes 100 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, he must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of him and are knocked prone. If Grolantor dies, any swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Grolantor makes one Slam attack.

legendary.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries: Grolantor moves up to his speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 90-foot-radius circle centered on himself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration and be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: All creatures within Grolantor's stomach take 18 (5d6) acid damage and Grolantor regains hit points equal to the total damage dealt.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Grolantor casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythicHeader: If Grolantor's Runic Fury trait has activated in the last hour, he can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Devour (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Grolantor recharges his Inhale and uses it.

mythic.name: Earthquake (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Grolantor slams into the ground, creating a massive shockwave in a 120-foot radius centered on himself.  The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain. Each creature on the ground that is concentrating must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's concentration is broken.

Each creature on the ground must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.  Fissures open throughout the area. A total of 1d6 such fissures open in locations chosen by the DM. Each is 1d10 x 10 feet deep, 10 feet wide, and extends from one edge of the area to the opposite side. A creature standing on a spot where a fissure opens must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or fall in. A creature that successfully saves moves with the fissure's edge as it opens.

A fissure that opens beneath a structure causes it to automatically collapse.  The tremor deals 50 bludgeoning damage to any structure in contact with the ground in the area. If a structure drops to 0 hit points, it collapses and potentially damages nearby creatures. A creature within half the distance of a structure's height must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 5d6 bludgeoning damage, is knocked prone, and is buried in the rubble, requiring a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action to escape. The DM can adjust the DC higher or lower, depending on the nature of the rubble. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone or become buried.

name: Skoraeus Stonebones, Hand of the Giants
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Runic Fury (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Skoraeus would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points, he recharges his Entombing Grasp, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, Skoraeus can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Skoraeus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Skoraeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Skoraeus deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Skoraeus makes one Crystal Club attack and two Slam attacks, then uses Entombing Grasp if available. Alternatively, he makes three Runic Boulder attacks.

action.name: Crystal Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 55 (7d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage. Whether the attack hits or not, the club flares with bright light, and the target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (5d8) radiant damage and be blinded until the start of Skoraeus' next turn.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 43 (6d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Runic Boulder
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (6d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage. The boulder then explodes, and any creature within 30 feet of the target must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 26 (4d12) force damage and is knocked prone, taking half as much damage and not being knocked prone on a successful save.

action.name: Entombing Grasp (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Skoraeus wreathes his hand in petrifying magic and touches one Huge or smaller creature he can see within 20 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw or take 38 (11d6) force damage and be grappled (escape DC 22). At the start of Skoraeus' next turn, if the target is still grappled, the target becomes petrified.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Skoraeus makes one Slam attack.

legendary.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries: Skoraeus moves up to his speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 90-foot-radius circle centered on himself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration and be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Stone Spikes (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Skoraeus causes the ground in a 20-foot square within 90 feet of himself to sprout crystal spikes until the start of hus next turn. The area becomes difficult terrain for the duration. A creature takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage for each 5 feet it moves on this terrain.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Skoraeus casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythicHeader: If Skoraeus' Runic Fury trait has activated in the last hour, he can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Crystal Flare (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Skoraeus causes the crystals on his body to flare with light. Each creature within 30 feet of him must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (8d6) radiant damage and be blinded condition until the end of Skoraeus' next turn.

mythic.name: Shattering Battlecry (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Skoraeus lets out a painfully load roar. Each creature within 60 feet of him must make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 49 (9d10) thunder damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

name: þrym, Heart of the Giants
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Runic Fury (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Þrym would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points, he recharges his Glacial Upheaval, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, Þrym can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Þrym fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Þrym has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Þrym deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Þrym makes one Ice Axe and two Slam attacks, or he makes three Glacier Throw attacks.

action.name: Ice Axe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Glacier Throw
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Glacial Upheaval (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Þrym digs his hands into the ground at a point he can see within 30 feet of himself and launches a magically conjured mass of ice into the air. Each creature other than Þrym in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) cold damage and is pushed vertically to the top of the cylinder, at which point the creature falls. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder with no additional effects.

At the start of Þrym's next turn, a mass of ice plummets to the ground on a point Þrym can see within 60 feet of the point he dug his hands into. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Þrym makes one Slam attack.

legendary.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries: Þrym moves up to his speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 90-foot-radius circle centered on himself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration and be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Chilling Mist (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Þrym magically conjures a cloud of chilling mist that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 90 feet of himself. The mist spreads around corners. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) cold damage and be unable to use reactions until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Þrym casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythicHeader: If Þrym's Runic Fury trait has activated in the last hour, he can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Ice Wolves (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Þrym magically summons 1d4 wolves made of ice (use the Dire Guardian Wolf stat block to represent them, but they are elementals rather than beasts). The wolves appear in unoccupied spaces Þrym can see within 30 feet of himself. The wolves take their turn immediately after Þrym on the same initiative count, and they obey Þrym's commands. The wolves gain a +6 bonus to their attack and damage rolls while they are within 30 feet of Þrym. The wolves disappear after 1 minute, when Þrym dies, or when Þrym uses this action again.

mythic.name: Freezing Breath (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Þrym exhales a blast of frost in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 71 (11d12) cold damage, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. If this damage would reduce the target to 0 hit points, the target drops to 1 hit point instead and is petrified, turning into a frozen statue.
If the statue takes bludgeoning damage, it shatters, killing the frozen creature. If the statue would take fire damage, it instead takes no damage and thaws, ending the petrification.

name: Surtr, Arm of the Giants
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Runic Fury (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Surtr would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points, he recharges his Lava Wave, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, Surtr can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Surtr fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Surtr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Surtr deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Surtr makes one Lava Blade and two Slam attacks, or he makes three Lava Ball attacks.

action.name: Lava Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (5d10 + 11) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) fire damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 44 (6d10 + 11) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lava Ball
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (4d12 + 11) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 28 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Lava Wave (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Surtr emits a wave of lava from his blade, hands, or mouth in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 77 (14d10) fire damage and is restrained in hardening rock (escape DC 27). The rock has AC 17 and 40 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Surtr makes one Slam attack.

legendary.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries: Surtr moves up to his speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 90-foot-radius circle centered on himself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration and be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Incendiary Smoke (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Surtr causes smoke and white-hot embers to billow from its skin, filling a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on himself that lasts until the start of his next turn. While Surtr's skin billows smoke, ranged attacks against him are made with disadvantage. A creature that moves into the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Surtr casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythicHeader: If Surtr's Runic Fury trait has activated in the last hour, he can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Volcanic Fury (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Surtr causes any volcanic rock created by his Lava Wave action to become lava once again.  Creatures restrained by the rock take 77 (14d10) fire damage, and the lava cools once again in 1 minute.  While it is liquid, the lava is difficult terrain and creatures that enter it or start their turn there take 30 (5d10) fire damage.

mythic.name: Ragnarok (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Surtr causes a masssive fiery explosion centered on himself.  Each creature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered him must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes 80 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.  The ground within this area becomes covered in lava that cools after 1 minute.  While it is liquid, the lava is difficult terrain and creatures that enter it or start their turn there take 30 (5d10) fire damage.

name: Memnor, Face of the Giants
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Runic Fury (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Memnor would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points, he recharges his Thunderous Vortex, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, Memnor can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Memnor fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Memnor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Memnor deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Memnor makes one Cloud Morningstar and two Slam attacks, or he makes three Wind Javelin attacks.

action.name: Cloud Morningstar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d10 + 11) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (4d10) thunder damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 44 (6d10 + 11) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wind Javelin
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 50 (6d12 + 11) thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 28 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Thunderous Vortex (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Memnor magically creates a vortex of wind in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 120 feet of himself. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be pulled straight toward the sphere's center, ending in an unoccupied space as close as possible to the center. Then a burst of thunder erupts in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the same point. Each creature in that area takes 65 (10d12) thunder damage and must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or be stunned condition until the end of their next turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Memnor makes one Slam attack.

legendary.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries: Memnor moves up to his speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 90-foot-radius circle centered on himself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 28 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration and be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Fog of Deception (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Memnor conjures a magical cloud that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 90 feet of himself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is charmed by Memnor until the end of their next turn. While a creature is charmed in this way, the creature must use its action to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself of Memnor's choice. If no creature is within its reach, the affected creature makes a ranged attack against a creature of Memnor's choice, throwing its weapon if necessary. On a successful save, a creature is immune to Memnor's Fog of Deception for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Memnor casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythicHeader: If Memnor's Runic Fury trait has activated in the last hour, he can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Thunderous Rebuke (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Memnor creates a blast of thunder around himself.  Creatures within 30 feet of him must make a DC 28 Constitution saving throw.  On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is pushed 30 feet away from Memnor and knocked prone, taking half as much damage and not suffering any additional effects on a successful save.

mythic.name: Vortex (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Memnor conjures a vortex of wind at a point he can see within 90 feet of himself. The wind vortex is a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point. Each creature other than Memnor in that area must make a DC 28 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 84 (13d12) bludgeoning damage and is restrained within the vortex. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder. The vortex lasts until the start of Memnor's next turn. A creature restrained in the vortex falls prone when the vortex ends.

A creature restrained in the vortex can use its action to try to escape. The creature makes a DC 21 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a successful check, the creature escapes and moves 3d6 x 10 feet away from the vortex in a random direction.

name: Stronmaus, Mind of the Giants
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Runic Fury (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Stronmaus would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points, he recharges his Vengeful Storm, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, Stronmaus can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Stronmaus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Stronmaus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Stronmaus deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Stronmaus makes one Lightning Sword and two Slam attacks, or he makes three Hailstone attacks.

action.name: Lightning Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (4d12 + 11) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) lightning damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 44 (6d10 + 11) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hailstone
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +20 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 28 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Vengeful Storm (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Stronmaus conjures a churning storm cloud in a 30-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within 120 feet of himself. The cloud's area is heavily obscured. The cloud lasts for 1 minute, until Stronmaus dies, or when Stronmaus chooses to end it (no action required).

When the cloud appears, and as an action on later turns, Stronmaus can cause bolts of lightning to strike down from it.  Each creature below the cloud must succeed on DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) lightning damage and be stunned condition until the end of their next turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Stronmaus makes one Slam attack.

legendary.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries: Stronmaus moves up to his speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 90-foot-radius circle centered on himself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration and be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Booming Step (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Stronmaus crackles with thunder and then magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Each creature within 10 feet of the space the cradle left must make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Stronmaus casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythicHeader: If Stronmaus' Runic Fury trait has activated in the last hour, he can use the options below as legendary actions.

mythic.name: Acid Rain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Stronmaus summons his Vengeful Storm if it doesn't already exist, and causes it to pour acidic liquid.  Each creature below the cloud must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute or until a creature uses its action to remove the acid from itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 26 (4d12) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

mythic.name: Freezing Storm (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Stronmaus summons his Vengeful Storm if it doesn't already exist, and causes it to blow freezing rain.  Each creature below the cloud must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) cold damage and be hindered by ice formations for 1 minute or until it or another creature within reach of it uses an action to break away the ice. A creature hindered by ice has its speed reduced to 0.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the corpse starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, unless it took radiant damage or a critical hit since its last turn. On a success, the corpse gains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corpse makes two attacks with its Grasp of the Dead, one of which it may replace with a use of its Predigest.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mote of Corruption
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take an additional 10 (3d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the end of the corpse's next turn.

action.name: Predigest (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The corpse vomits acidic slime in a 20 foot cone. Each creature in that cone must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Rupture
entries: When the corpse drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to use its Predigest, if available, before falling unconscious.

trait.name: Chillborne Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of one or more chillborn zombies takes 4 (1d8) cold damage for each chillborn zombie within 10 ft. of it.

trait.name: Supercooled
entries: If the zombie takes any bludgeoning damage, after taking damage it gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Ice Reaper Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) cold damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Flash Freeze (Recharge 6)
entries: When a creature within 5 feet has its movement speed reduced to 0, the zombie can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the zombie's next turn.

trait.name: Corrupted Bloat
entries: If the zombie takes at least 10 points of slashing or piercing damage in a turn, a gout of toxic gas erupts from it. Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage.

trait.name: Volatile
entries: If the zombie takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or explode. Each creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two attacks with its grasp of the dead.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one grappled creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the zombie starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, unless it took radiant damage or a critical hit since its last turn. On a success, the zombie gains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

trait.name: Decaying Wings
entries: If the zombie is hit with a critical hit, it permanently loses the ability to fly.

trait.name: Abductor's Build
entries: The zombie is not slowed while grappling a Medium or smaller creature.

action.name: Swooping Snatch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one grappled creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Sudden Drop
entries: When the zombie takes any damage, it can release a creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Sudden Lunge
entries: The zombie's attacks have a reach of 10 feet for the purposes of making opportunity attacks. When it makes an opportunity attack, it moves up to 5 feet towards its target as part of the attack.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 11). This DC increases by 1 for each zombie that added to this attack beyond the first.

action.name: Plague Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one grappled creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract ravenous wasting.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the gravehound starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, unless it took radiant damage or a critical hit since its last turn. On a success, the zombie gains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

action.name: Lockjaw Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both the gravehound and at least one of the gravehound's allies must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or fall prone and take 9 (2d8) piercing damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Rotted Baying
entries: The gravehound begins a frantic, distorted barking that attracts undead in a 500 ft. radius to its current location. It may continue baying each turn as a Bonus Action. When the gravehound stops baying, undead with an intelligence score of 6 or lower stop approaching it.

reaction.name: Jaws of Death
entries: When the gravehound is reduced to 0 hit points, it can make an attack with its lockjaw Bite. if this attack hits, the gravehound maintains this grapple even while dead or unconscious.

name: Zombie Greatwyrm
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Deteriorating Form
entries: Absent its innate draconic magics, mere necromancy is unable to sustain the zombie for long. Whenever the zombie makes an attack, it loses 10 hit points. Whenever the zombie uses its breath weapon, it loses 40 hit points.

trait.name: Putrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Ponderous Strikes
entries: Whenever a creature succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid taking damage from one of the zombie's attacks, it may use its reaction to attempt to climb onto the zombie.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the zombie may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 22 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zombie. While climbing on the zombie, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the zombie, and the zombie has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Festering Bite

action.name: Rotgrasp Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 22).
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Decayed Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon.
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Gore Breath (Recharge 5-6)

entries: While flying, the zombie must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or fall prone.

items.name: Broken Limb
entries: The zombie makes one fewer attack with its multiattack after this turn.

items.name: Dislocated Jaw
entries: The zombie cannot use its Festering Bite after this turn.

items.name: Severed Tail
entries: The zombie cannot use its Decayed Tail after this turn, and it drops its severed tail in the nearest unoccupied space. The tail is an improvised heavy weapon that can be wielded by a creature with at least 19 Strength and deals 2d12 + STR bludgeoning damage on a hit.

name: Moon Wraith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Lunar Wrath
entries: While in moonlight or starlight, the wraith's attacks are made at advantage and its Crescent Arc recharges on a 4-6.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wraith makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its crescent arc, if available.

action.name: Touch of Lunacy
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) radiant plus 5 (1d10) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to take the attack action targeting a creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Crescent Arc (Recharge 6)
entries: The wraith moves up to its speed. Each creature whose space the wraith passes through with this movement takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to see the wraith until the end of the wraith's next turn.

action.name: Create Wraith
entries: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a Wisp Wraith under the wraith's control.

reaction.name: Moon Glide
entries: When the wraith takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can move up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Mad Wraith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Radiance Sensitivity
entries: If the wraith takes radiant damage, it loses its damage resistances and it is temporarily made corporeal until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Maddening Whispers
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of one or more mad wraiths takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from Wisdom saving throws it makes before the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
