trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The wisp can alter the radius as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wisp attacks twice with its Ghostflame Ignition.

action.name: Ghostflame Ignition
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The creature is wreathed in ghostly flames and begins burning (2d6 fire plus 1d10 necrotic).

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

reaction.name: Ghostflare
entries: When the wisp is missed with a melee attack, it can make an attack with its Ghostflame Ignition.

reaction.name: Reignite
entries: When the wisp reduced to 0 hit points, before falling unconscious it can force one burning creature it can see within 30 feet to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

name: Feu-Follet Wisp
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Grounding Weakness
entries: If the wisp makes an attack while within 15 feet of a metal object speared into the ground (such as a dagger), it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be dissipated into the earth and destroyed.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The wisp can alter the radius as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Sparkjump
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) lightning damage and the wisp teleports up to 15 feet to a location it can see.
If the wisp ends this movement within 5 feet of a creature it has not attacked this turn, it may make an attack against it as part of this action.

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

reaction.name: Draw Blood
entries: When a creature within 15 feet fails a death saving throw, the wisp can force the creature to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or lose one unexpended hit die.
When the wisp uses its Sparkjump, it may teleport an additional 5 feet for each hit die it has drained this way in the last minute.

name: Shadow Wisp
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Reactive Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds dim light in a 20-foot radius  while illuminated by no other sources. While illuminated by a source of dim light other than itself, the wisp is invisible. While illuminated by a source of bright light other than itself, the wisp shines twice as bright, casting dark shadows.

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

action.name: Shadow Betrayal
entries: The wisp briefly flares with light and incites the shadows of each creature within its illumination to attack the creatures that cast them.

Each creature within 20 feet of the wisp must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or take  9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage and have its Strength score reduced by 2 (1d4) until it completes a Short or Long Rest. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0.

name: Wheep
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ceaseless Wail
entries: At the start of each of the wheep's turns if it is not incapacitated, each creature within 60 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 2 (1d4), to a minimum of 1, until the wheep is destroyed or the creature completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Weep Black Bile
entries: When the wheep fails a saving throw, poisonous black bile gushes from its empty eye sockets and over its face and body.
Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that hits the wheep with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the wheep's next turn.

trait.name: Turning Resistance
entries: The wheep has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wheep makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its shrieking bite.

action.name: Shrieking Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 7 (2d6 + 5) piercing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the wheep latches onto the target (escape DC 17).

While the wheep is latched onto a creature, its ceaseless wail ends, and the target cannot speak or breathe as a breathless, endless scream of horror tears out of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or drop to 0 hit points.

action.name: Broken Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

trait.name: Eyes Everywhere
entries: The area in a 500 ft. radius around the drinker is surveilled from above by a murder of spectral crows. The drinker can see everything seen by any of the crows, and by any creature affected by its Curse of Stolen Sight.

trait.name: Piercing Gaze
entries: The drinker can read the surface thoughts of any creature it can see.

trait.name: Blind Weakness
entries: If the drinker fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind it, it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, the creature most recently affected by its Curse of Stolen Sight is freed from the effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drinker makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Curse of Stolen Sight.

action.name: Lashing Tongue
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Curse of Stolen Sight
entries: One creature grappled by the drinker must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed, causing one of its eyes cloud over and giving it disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

action.name: Descent of Crows (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature within 500 ft. that the vitrous drinker can see is mobbed by spectral crows. The creature is blinded until it moves at least 5 ft., and must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Dimension Door (3/Day, 4th level spell)
entries: The drinker teleports up to 500 feet.

languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Vital Tithe
entries: Whenever a creature takes necrotic damage within 15 feet of the vampire, the vampire gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

trait.name: Blood Eternal
entries: If the vampire is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than Bonus Actions, and cannot regain any hit points until it completes a Long Rest in its resting place. If it does not return to its resting place by the following dawn, the vampire is destroyed.

trait.name: Vampiric Traits

action.name: Enchain Essence (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the vampire can see must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained and has vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. The creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Lacerating Rain (6th Level Spell)
entries: A hail of jagged blades formed from blood rain down in a 15 foot radius centered on a point the vampire can see. Each creature in the area make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 (7d8) slashing damage and begins to bleed, losing 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns for the next minute, or until it receives any magical healing. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much slashing damage.

action.name: Blood Puppeteering (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the vampire can see must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or have its body controlled by the vampire for the next minute.

On each of the creature's turns, the creature takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, then moves up to its speed and takes the attack action. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Bestow Wound (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When the vampire is hit with an attack, it can force a creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw.
On a failure, the vampire takes half as much damage from the attack and the target takes the same amount.

reaction.name: Command Ichor (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the vampire can see within 60 feet takes piercing or slashing damage, the vampire can force the creature to succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in a direction of the vampire's choice.

legendary.name: Reaping Glide
entries: The vampire moves up to its fly speed. Each creature that makes an attack of opportunity provoked by this movement takes 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Dweomer Rupture (0th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the vampire can see within 60 feet must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage the next time it casts a spell before the end of the vampire's next turn.

legendary.name: Blood Drain (Costs 2 Actions)

legendary.name: Rend Magic (3rd Level Spell, Costs 2 Actions)

If the magical effect was produced by an item, the item may not be activated again until the end of the wielder's next turn.

A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the ulgurstasta must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the beginning of its next turn. On a success, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Suffocating Bulk

trait.name: Necromantic Acid
entries: A creature killed by acid damage dealt by the ulgurstasta has its flesh slough off and rises at the beginning of the ulgurstasta's next turn as a Decrepit Skeleton under the ulgurstasta's control. Skeletons are immune to acid damage dealt by the ulgurstasta.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the ulgurstasta, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the ulgurstasta takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, an opening in its side large enough to permit escape is created. Until the ulgurstasta completes a Short or Long Rest, each creature in the ulgurstasta's stomach may attempt to escape (escape DC 18) by spending its full movement.

action.name: Body Slam

action.name: Storm of Tendrils (Concentration)
entries: The ulgurstasta unfurls millions of hair-thin 40 foot long tendrils coiled within its pores that whip about in a frenzy.

For the next minute, or until it take any radiant damage, attacks made by living creatures within 40 feet are made at disadvantage, and ranged attacks against the ulgurstasta made from outside that area roll three dice and take the lowest result.

action.name: Skeletonizer Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ugurstasta forcefully expels the contents of its stomach in a 30 foot cone.

Each living creature in the ulgurstasta's stomach and 5 (2d4) Decrepit Skeletons are expelled in the area, then each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be coated in the ulgurstasta's necromantic acid, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to scrape it off.

trait.name: Infested Flesh
entries: If the spawn is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.
On a success, it loses its Burrowing Worm action, and for the next minute regains twice as many hit points with its Regeneration, after which it dies.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The spawn regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the spawn takes acid, fire, or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the spawn's next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Noxious Breath, if available.

action.name: Writhing Embrace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with the touch of kyuss.

action.name: Burrowing Worm
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 1 piercing damage as a worm (AC 6; 1 HP) latches on and begins to burrow into its flesh. At the beginning of the spawn's next turn, the worm slithers into the creature, infecting it with a Worm of Kyuss.
The spawn may use this ability as a Bonus Action against a grappled or incapacitated target.

action.name: Noxious Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The spawn exudes the scent of its worm-riddled innards in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the spawn's next turn.

reaction.name: Plead for Death
entries: When a creature grappled by the spawn targets it with a melee attack, the spawn can allow the attack to hit it without a roll.
The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for as long as it remains grappled.

reaction.name: Worm of Kyuss
entries: A creature infected by one or more Worms of Kyuss takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns for each worm infesting it. A creature killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Wretch of Kyuss.

A burrowing worm may be located and destroyed with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or by a friendly creature dealing 10 or more damage to the infected creature with a weapon that deals piercing damage. Any magical effect that cures disease destroys all worms infesting a creature.
A creature cured of this disease must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

name: Wretch of Kyuss
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Worm-Riddled
entries: If the wretch is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, it dies.

trait.name: Tortured Cries
entries: The wretch screams raggedly and calls for help as it attacks. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of 3 or more wretches that can hear them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened.

action.name: Frantic Clawing (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Wretched Plea
entries: When the wretch is targeted with a melee attack by a creature within 5 feet, it can allow the attack to hit it without a roll.
The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be infected with the touch of kyuss.

name: The Angry
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The angry has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

trait.name: Pacifism Weakness
entries: If a creature within 15 feet of the angry that is not incapacitated ends its turn without taking any hostile action, the angry takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.

trait.name: Rising Fury
entries: Whenever the angry takes damage from a source other than its Pacifism Weakness, its fury increases by one level. Whenever the angry deals damage, its fury decreases by one level.

items.name: 0. Seething
entries: The angry has disadvantage on attacks made against creatures other than itself.

items.name: 1. Enraged
entries: The angry's attacks have advantage.

items.name: 2. Maddened
entries: The angry's attacks have advantage. On a hit, its attacks deal an additional 19 (3d12) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angry makes two attacks with its Hook.

action.name: Hook
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d12 + 3) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Shrieking Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The angry moves up to  its speed toward the creature that most recently took hostile action against it and makes a melee attack.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to take the attack action on its following turn.

reaction.name: Vicious Outburst
entries: When the angry becomes Maddened, it can move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

name: The Hungry
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Life Hunger
entries: If a creature the hungry can see regains hit points, the hungry gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. The hungry has disadvantage on attack rolls made against creatures with no unexpended hit dice.

trait.name: Ruinous Consumption
entries: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the hungry must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature loses 2d4 unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 hit points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining. The hungry gains 5 temporary hit points for each hit die expended in this way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hungry makes two attacks with its Claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 16).
While grappling a creature, the hungry can't attack another creature with its claws.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: The hungry begins to swallow a Large or smaller creature that is incapacitated and grappled by it.
At the beginning of the hungry's next turn, the target is swallowed and its body is destroyed, and the hungry regains 30 hit points.
This action is disrupted if the hungry takes any radiant damage, suffers a critical hit, is knocked prone, or is incapacitated, or if the creature it is swallowing regains any hit points.

reaction.name: Wave of Exhaustion (1/Day)
entries: When the hungry is reduced below 83 hit points, it can force each creature within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn.

name: The Lonely
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Psychic Leech
entries: At the start of each of the lonely's turns, each creature either grappled by it or within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

trait.name: Thrives on Company
entries: The lonely has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. The first time each turn that a creature leaves the lonely's reach, the lonely takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lonely makes two attacks with its Harpoon Arms, each of which it may replace with a use of its Sorrowful Embrace.

action.name: Harpoon Arms
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).
The lonely's harpoon arms can be attacked (AC 16; 15 hit points). Destroying an arm deals no damage to the lonely, which can grow a replacement  on its next turn.

action.name: Sorrowful Embrace
entries: Each creature grappled by the lonely takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is pulled up to 15 feet towards it.

action.name: Branching Barbs (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lonely causes its harpoon arms to grow branching barbs of jagged bone. Each creature grappled by it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Wretched Sobbing
entries: When a creature attempts to leave its reach, the lonely can let out a wretched sob.
Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move away from the lonely until the beginning of the lonely's next turn.

name: The Lost
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Disorienting Wail
entries: Creatures within 500 ft. of the lost that can hear it wailing have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Wisdom as their vision blurs and sounds become distorted and unintelligible.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lost makes five attacks with its arm spikes and uses its embedding embrace. It makes one fewer attack for each arm spike that is grappling a creature.

action.name: Arm Spike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). A creature grappled by three or more of the lost's arms is restrained. The lost has five arm spikes, but may grapple only a single creature at a time, and cannot release a creature voluntarily.

action.name: Embedding Embrace
entries: One creature grappled by the lost takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage for each arm grappling it and must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the lost's next turn.
If a creature succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more the lost is stunned until the end of its next turn and releases any creature grappled by it.

reaction.name: Psychic Flood
entries: When the lost takes any damage while it has a creature grappled, it can force the grappled creature to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take an equal amount of psychic damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Swarming Overrun
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of three or more of the wretched must succeed on DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
A creature within 5 ft. of five or more of the wretched makes this saving throw at disadvantage, and cannot stand from prone this turn if it fails.

action.name: Latching Bite (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 piercing damage and the wretched attaches to the target.
While attached, the wretched can't attack, and at the start of each of the wretched's turns, the target takes 5 necrotic damage. The wretched can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is wrapped around a creature, the skin kite takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature grappled by the skin kite takes the other half.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The skin kite can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the skin kite wraps itself around the target (escape DC 13). While the skin kite is wrapped around it, a creature cannot speak or breathe, and the skin kite moves with the target.

action.name: Steal Skin
entries: One creature the skin kite is wrapped around must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving score or have its Charisma score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Long Rest.
The skin kite gains a cumulative 5 temporary hit points for each point of Charisma lost in this way. A creature reduced to 1 Charisma in this way immediately drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Launch Kite
entries: The skin kite tears itself in two, losing all of its temporary hit points and creating  a new skin kite in an adjacent space with maximum hit points equal to the temporary hit points lost.

name: Bonecrusher Skeleton
resist: piercing and slashing damage from attacks made without advantage
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the skeleton may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the skeleton. While climbing on the skeleton, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the skeleton, and the skeleton has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Crushing Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Claw Snatch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Ragdoll Smash (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The skeleton repeatedly slams a grappled creature into the ground, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the giants next trn, or take half as much damage on a success.

name: Skeletal Liberator
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The liberator can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the liberator with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The liberator makes two attacks with its Fleshstripper Blade.

action.name: Fleshstripper Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) slashing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or fall prone as its bones spasm within its body.

action.name: Wake the Bones (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 feet that the skeleton can see must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have its skeleton rattle within its flesh, taking 21 (6d6) points of bludgeoning damage and being dragged up to 10 feet in a direction of the skeleton's choice on a failure, or taking half as much damage on a success.

items.name: An creature with 0 hit points that fails this saving throw dies. At the begining of its following turn, the creature's skeleton tears itself out of the creature's body, rising as an independant
entries: Skeleton Warrior**.

reaction.name: Dark Martyr
entries: When the skeleton is reduced to 0 hit points, it may use its Wake the Bones ability if available, targeting an unconscious creature within range, before being destroyed.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

name: Tomb Guard
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The tomb guard can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the tomb guard with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tomb guard makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Ancient Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Cascade of Steel (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The tomb guard makes four melee attacks. If all of them miss, the tomb guard falls prone and ends its turn.

reaction.name: Parrying Flurry
entries: When the tomb guard is targeted with a melee attack by a creature it can see, it increases its AC by 2 against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the tomb guard regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the tomb guard can see reduces an undead ally of the tomb guard's to 0 hit points, the tomb guard can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

name: Blazing Bones
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Burning Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the blazing bones or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Regrow Nerves
entries: If the blazing bones would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing, and instead gains disadvantage on attack rolls for the next minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blazing bones makes two attacks with its blazing claw.

action.name: Blazing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Hurled Flame
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage and the target begins burning (1d10).
A humanoid creature that dies while burning in this way has its flesh burn away, rising as a Blazing Bones with 10 hit points at the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

name: Boneshard Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the skeleton with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

trait.name: Marrowseal
entries: If the skeleton would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing, and instead loses the ability to use its Boneshard for the next minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton makes two attacks with its bound blades, one of which it may replace with a use of its Boneshard.

action.name: Bound Armblades
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Boneshard
entries: One creature the skeleton can see within 20 ft. must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and has its movement speed reduced by 5 ft. until a creature takes an action to remove the shard, or takes half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Boneshard Burst
entries: When the skeleton is reduced to 0 hit points, it can use its Boneshard targeting each creature within 10 feet of it before being destroyed.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

name: Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the skeleton with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Grave Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Creakwood Bow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

name: Dust Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Unliving Warriors
entries: The skeleton has proficiency in all martial weapons and armor.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the skeleton with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Dredged Breath
entries: The skeleton exhales a 15-foot cone of blinding dust. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

name: Decrepit Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Bone Dust Burst
entries: When the skeleton dies, it explodes in a cloud of dust, heavily obscuring the area in a 5 ft. radius around itself for the next minute, or until cleared away by a strong wind.

action.name: Rusted Blade (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 slashing damage. On a roll of 1, the blade breaks and becomes unusable.

action.name: Clattering Grasp (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target is grappled (escape DC 12). A creature that escapes this grapple with a successful ability check can destroy one of the skeletons grappling it when it does so.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: As a reaction when a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton moves up to 10 ft. towards the creature.

name: Shade Puppeteer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shade can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shade can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Light Dependance
entries: While in darkness, the shade is invisible and can use its strength drain. While in bright light, the shade has advantage on attack rolls, but loses its damage resistances.

action.name: Rend Strength (Darkness only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) necrotic damage and the target's Strength score is reduced by 3 (1d6) until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. A humanoid killed by this attack has its shadow rise as a shade stalker at the beginning of its following turn.

action.name: Puppeteer
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the shade must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have the shadow attach itself to it (escape DC 12), displacing the creature's natural shadow.

While the shadow is attached in this way, it moves with the creature, and at the beginning of each of the creature's turns the shade can force it to succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or act under the shade's control this turn.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light only)
entries: When the shade takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet and turn invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

name: Shade Strangler
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shade can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shade can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Light Dependance
entries: While in darkness, the shade is invisible and can use its strength drain. While in bright light, the shade has advantage on attack rolls, but loses its damage resistances.

action.name: Shadow Choke (Dim or Bright Light only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage, and the target is grappled and cannot breathe (escape DC 10). This grapple is broken if the shadow is in darkness.
If the target was already grappled, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or lose its held breath and begin to suffocate.

action.name: Strength Drain (Darkness only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target's Strength score is reduced by 2 (1d4) until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. A humanoid killed by this attack has its shadow rise as a shade stalker at the beginning of its following turn.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light only)
entries: When the shade takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet and turn invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Destroyed by Light
entries: If the shadow starts its turn in bright light, it may not take actions that turn other than to Dash or Hide. A shadow that ends its turn in bright light is destroyed.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Ephemeral Shove (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 6 Strength saving throw or take an additional 2 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Strength Siphon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target's Strength score is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and the shadow is destroyed.
A creature whose Strength is reduced to 1 in this way cannot stand from prone without a creature using an Action to assist it.

action.name: Douse
entries: The shadow reduces a source of bright light it can see within 60 feet to dim light, or extinguishes a source of dim light it can see in the area. If the shadow is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The serpentir can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The serpentir rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Churning Ribs
entries: A prone creature that ends its turn grappled by the serpentir is passed into its churning ribs. While there, a creature is restrained (escape DC 14) and takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of the serpentir's turns.

action.name: Scrabbling Arms
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Anklebite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Scuttling Overrun (Recharge 6)
entries: The serpentir moves up to its speed in a straight line, and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature.
Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and passed into the serpentir's Churning Ribs, ending the serpentir's movement on a success.

reaction.name: Spine Lash
entries: When a creature enters the serpentir's reach, it can force the creature to succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally knocked prone.

name: Revenant King
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Immortal Blood
entries: If the revenant is destroyed and its body is not interred in its ancestral crypt, its soul lingers. After 1d10 years, the soul inhabits and animates another humanoid corpse on the same plane of existence and regains all its hit points.

trait.name: Vengeful Tracker
entries: The revenant knows the distance to and direction of any creature against which it seeks revenge, even if the creature and the revenant are on different planes of existence. If the creature being tracked by the revenant dies, the revenant knows.

trait.name: Betrayer's Doom (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the revenant is reduced to 0 hit points, it appears to die or fall unconscious but does not. Instead, at the beginning of its next turn it resets to 136 hit points and rises once more, and immediately recharges its Revenant's Breath.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The revenant makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Thirsting Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage. A target against which the revenant has sworn vengeance takes an extra 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Pronouncement of Guilt
entries: One creature within 30 ft. against which the revenant has sworn vengeance must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the creature's movement speed is halved, it can't teleport, and it has vulnerability to necrotic damage. When a cursed creature takes the dash action, it must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Revenant's Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The revenant exhales a freezing mist that creeps across the ground in a 30 ft. cone, then is drawn into any humanoid corpses in the area. Each living creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) cold plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.
Humanoid corpses in the area rise as Revenant Retainers under the revenant's control.

reaction.name: Vengeful Smash
entries: When a creature misses the revenant with a melee attack, the revenant can make a Shield Bash attack against it.
If it hits, the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the revenant's next turn.

reaction.name: Swear Vengeance
entries: When the revenant is targeted with an attack or harmful spell, it swears vengeance against the attacker or spell caster.

legendary.name: Call Upon Oaths
entries: One allied creature that died since the end of the revenant's last turn returns to life with one hit point.

legendary.name: Seething Glare
entries: One creature within 60 feet the revenant can see must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the revenant's next turn.

legendary.name: Betrayal's Debt
entries: One creature affected by the revenant's Pronouncement of Guilt must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 15 feet directly toward the revenant. A frightened creature that fails this save additionally takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

mythic.name: Rend Flesh From Bone (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 5 feet that the revenant has sworn vengeance against must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way must immedietely succeed on an additional DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have its flesh boil away, leaving only shattered and blackened bones.

name: Questing Revenant
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the revenant is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to use its multiattack and releases all grappled creatures, and must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns or die.
If the revenant takes radiant or fire damage while at 0 hit points, it is killed immediately.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: When the revenant's body is destroyed, its soul lingers. After 24 hours, the soul inhabits and animates another humanoid corpse on the same plane of existence and regains all its hit points. While the soul is bodiless, a wish spell can be used to force the soul to go to the afterlife and not return.

trait.name: Vengeful Tracker
entries: The revenant knows the distance to and direction of any creature against which it seeks revenge, even if the creature and the revenant are on different planes of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The revenant makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). A target against which the revenant has sworn vengeance takes an extra 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Pronouncement of Guilt
entries: One creature that is grappled by the revenant and against which it has sworn vengeance must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be cursed.

While cursed in this way, its movement speed is halved, it can't teleport, and it has vulnerability to necrotic damage. When a cursed creature takes the dash action, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

name: Revenant Retainer
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the revenant is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious immediately. Instead, it survives until the end of its next turn before dying. If the revenant takes radiant or fire damage while at 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

trait.name: Oathrisen
entries: If the revenant is released from its oaths, either through completion of its task, or by the assent or destruction of its liege lord, it is destroyed and crumbles to dust.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Spiteful Shove
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 bludgeoning plus 3 necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Greaved Stomp (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 7 bludgeoning plus 3 necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Pile On (Group Reaction)
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the revenant attempts to stand from prone, the revenant can fall prone in the creature's space.

The creature must succeed on Strength saving throw with DC equal to 8 plus the number of revenants that took this reaction or stay prone and be restrained until the end of its next turn (escape DC 14).

name: Ragewind
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Storm of Blades
entries: The ragewind may enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. A creature that starts its turn in the ragewind's space, or whose space the ragewind enters for the first time in a turn, must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) slashing damage and be carried aloft and restrained within the ragewind (escape DC 19).

trait.name: Weapon Trove
entries: Whenever the ragewind misses a creature with a melee weapon attack, the creature may use its reaction to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature wrests the weapon from the ragewind's grasp.

trait.name: Conductive Array
entries: Attacks that deal lightning damage have advantage against the ragewind, and it has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal lightning damage.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the ragewind fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ragewind makes six attacks, no more than two of which may be with the same weapon.

action.name: Ragetouched Geistblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage and the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must attack the ragewind on its following turn or else take 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Shieldcleaver Axe, +2
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the AC bonus granted by the target's armor or shield is permanently and cumulatively reduced by 2.

action.name: Bladeshaving Shrapnel
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of the ragewind's next turn.

action.name: Cannonball (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the Ragewind's next turn.

action.name: Chipped Sword Flurry
entries: Each creature in the ragewind's space must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Thieving Wind
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the ragewind forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have its weapon wrenched away.
The ragewind may wield any weapon dropped in this way as though it were both proficient with and attuned to the weapon.

name: Quell
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The quell's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Quelling Field
entries: If the quell is not in sunlight, the quell and each creature within 15 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects with a divine source, such as those cast by clerics or paladins, and resistance to damage dealt by such magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quell makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bitter Glare.

action.name: Wispy Clutch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 8). A creature may attempt to escape this grapple as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Bitter Glare
entries: One creature the quell can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or take 13 (3d8) psychic damage as it experiences the true alienness and amorality that belies the gods' benevolent demeanor.
A cleric or paladin targeted with this ability has advantage on saving throws against this effect, but vulnerability to the damage dealt by it.

reaction.name: Intercession
entries: When a creature the quell can see within 60 feet casts a spell or produces a magical effect with a divine source, the quell can force the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or have the spell or magical effect fail.

name: Nightcrawler
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightcrawler must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, or 21 (6d6) if it inside the nightcrawler.

trait.name: Light Eater
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightcrawler is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 3rd level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightcrawler starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

trait.name: Anti-Life Nature
entries: If the nightcrawler would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success. On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightcrawler have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The nightcrawler can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the nightcrawler may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nightcrawler. While climbing on the nightcrawler, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the nightcrawler.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the nightcrawler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightcrawler attacks twice with its Utterblack Bile.

action.name: Corpsechurn Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, and its attacks bypass the nightcrawler's damage resistances.

If the nightcrawler takes 20 or more radiant damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the nightcrawler. If the nightcrawler dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Utterblack Bile
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and the target is coated in inky black bile. Until a creature takes an action to clear it, if the creature casts a spell, the spell doesn't take effect until the beginning of its following turn.

action.name: Terror From the Deep (Recharges when the Nightcrawler uses its Rotting Regurgitation)
entries: The nightcrawler moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half damage on a success. As a Bonus Action, the nightcrawler may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this saving throw.

action.name: Rotting Regurgitation (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A tide of corpses spews forth from the nightcrawler in a 30 foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
At initiative count 0, 10 (3d6) of the corpses rise as Zombie Rotters.

name: Nightwing
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwing must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Light Eater
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightwing is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightwing starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

trait.name: Darkness Made Flesh
entries: If the nightwing would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightwing have advantage until the beginning of its next turn and the nightwing becomes momentarily insubstantial, dropping each creature it is grappling and forcing each creature climbing on it to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or fall off.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the nightwing fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightwing makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Insubstantiate or Writhing Wake, if available.

action.name: Shadow Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

action.name: Rain of Rot
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target directly below the nightwing. Hit: 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.
A creature grappled by the nightwing has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Insubstantiate
entries: The nightshade turns to shadow until it makes an attack. While in this form, corporeal creatures climbing on it fall through it, its speed is doubled, and it can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Writhing Wake (Recharges when the Nightwing uses its Death Scream)
entries: The nightwing moves up to its fly speed, and the shadows in a 15-foot wide section of the ground it passes over darken and begin to writhe, coalescing into four Shadows that appear in unoccupied spaces, act on the nightwing's turn, and last for a minute..

action.name: Death Scream (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nightwing lets forth a horrid scream that melts flesh and shatters bones. Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (8d6) necrotic plus 18 (4d8) thunder damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more has blood well up from its eyes, ears and nose, and is blinded until it takes an action to clear its eyes or receives any magical healing.

reaction.name: Swooping Doom (1/Day)
entries: When the nightwing is reduced below 116 hit points, it can use its Insubstantiate and dive up to 80 feet.
Each creature it passes within 30 feet of with this movement must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be afflicted with a Curse of Doom.

While Cursed in this way, the creature acquires a Doom Counter each time it takes necrotic damage. If the creature drops to 0 hit points while cursed, it immediately fails one death saving throw for each Doom Counter it has.

name: Salt Mummy
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Water Weakness
entries: If the mummy is doused in water, it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 hit points must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two attacks with its Desiccating Slam and uses its Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Desiccating Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target gains a point of exhaustion that lasts for a minute.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally paralyzed fr the same duration.

reaction.name: Warding Hex
entries: When the mummy is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 7 (2d6) necrotic damage to the creature.

name: Mummy Guardian
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 hit points must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy attacks once with its Rotting Fist and uses its Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be infected with mummy rot.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally paralyzed for the same duration.

reaction.name: Warding Hex
entries: When the mummy is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 7 (2d6) necrotic damage to the creature.

name: Mummy Retainer
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: To Dust
entries: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 hit points with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn as the mummy bursts into a spray of dust and sand.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Trembling Grasp (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 12). At the start of each of the creature's turns, it takes 2 necrotic damage for each Mummy Retainer grappling it.

name: Baelnorn
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

trait.name: Norn Rejuvenation
entries: If the baelnorn is destroyed, one of its descendants may perform a ritual in which they invite the baelnorn's spirit to assume their body. The descendant remains for a time as a passenger in its former body, and may pass into death at will at any point.

trait.name: Entangling Aura
entries: A creature that hits the lich with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 21) until the end of the lich's next turn as vines burst forth from the nearest surface to entangle it.

trait.name: Water Walk
entries: The baelnorn can walk across any liquid surface as if it was solid ground.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the baelnorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The baelnorn uses its Lignify and makes three attacks with its Wraithblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Forced Growth or Splinterburst.

action.name: Wraithblade
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) necrotic damage. This attack treats the target as unarmored (An unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier).

action.name: Lignify (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 120 feet the baelnorn can see must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its flesh begin to turn to wood, gaining the Plant type in addition to its other creature types, plus one additional effect of the baelnorn's choice until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic:
The creature's movement speed is reduced by half and it cannot fly.
The creature can't take bonus actions or reactions.
The creature gains vulnerability to fire damage.
The creature takes 11 (2d10) fire damage whenever it deals fire damage.

action.name: Forced Growth (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lich causes a tree 15 feet across and up to 100 feet tall to burst forth from the ground at a point it can see within 120 feet.
Each creature in the tree's space when it appears and each flying creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is launched to the tree's top. A creature that failed this save by 5 or fewer may use its reaction to grasp a branch and avoid falling.

action.name: Splinterburst (Recharges when the baelnorn uses its Forced Growth)
entries: One tree the baelnorn can see within 60 feet explodes in a hail of massive splinters.
Each creature within 15 feet of the tree must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Briar Shield
entries: When the baelnorn is targeted with an attack, it can conjure a barrier of thorny vines, gaining 20 temporary hit points that last until the beginning of its next turn.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 5 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Withering Wail (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: When the baelnorn is reduced below 112 hit points, it can sing out a cruel and keening note.
Each plant within 60 feet withers and blackens, and each plant creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Zephyr Step
entries: The baelnorn gains a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the beginning of its next turn and moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Hollowheart Harvest
entries: One plant creature or elf the baelnorn can see within 5 feet loses up to 3 unexpended hit dice. The baelnorn regains 1d8 hit points for each hit die lost in this way.

legendary.name: Deadwood Awakening (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The baelnorn reanimates the wooden portion of a weapon or shield it can see, transforming it into a Vine Blight that acts on the baelnorn's turn under its control.
If the weapon was magical, it transforms back after the vine blight is destroyed, and cannot be affected by this ability again.

legendary.name: Wraithstorm Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The baelnorn moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and makes two attacks with its Wraithblade.
It may pass through solid objects and creatures with this movement.

name: Arcane Lich
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

trait.name: Paralyzing Aura
entries: A creature that hits the lich with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the lich's next turn, or until the creature takes any damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Wilting Ray
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Freezing Claw
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) cold damage.

action.name: Fireball (3rd Level Spell)
entries: An explosion of arcane flame erupts in a 20 foot radius centered on a point within 120 feet that the lich can see.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Dimension Door (4th Level Spell)
entries: The lich and up to one willing creature within 5 feet teleport up to 500 feet.

action.name: Immolation (5th level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the lich can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 30 (7d6 + 5) fire damage and catch fire, or take half as much damage on a success.
A burning creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failure, or ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Finger of Death (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lich extends its finger toward a creature it can see within 60 feet and the creature is engulfed in a sickly green light. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 62 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

items.name: A creature killed by this damage rises at the beginning of the lich's next turn as a
entries: Zombie Rotter** under the lich's control.

action.name: Disintegrate (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the lich can see must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 80 (10d6 + 45) force damage, or half damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage turns to dust.

reaction.name: Shield (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the lich is targeted with an attack, it can add +5 to its AC until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the lich can see within 60 feet begins to cast a spell, the lich can make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, causing the spell to fail on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the lich succeeds automatically.

reaction.name: Murderous Glare (1/Day, 9th Level Spell.)
entries: When the lich is reduced below 51 hit points, it can unleash a torrent of negative energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet. If the creature has fewer than 100 hit points, it dies.

legendary.name: Wilting Ray
entries: The lich uses its Wilting ray

legendary.name: Freezing Claw
entries: The lich uses its Freezing Claw.

legendary.name: Shadow Walk
entries: The Lich teleports up to 30 feet to a location it can see.

legendary.name: Drain Magic (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lich ends a spell of 3rd level or lower affecting a target it can see within 60 feet.

name: Archlich
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

trait.name: Fated Escape
entries: A destroyed archlich's remains Teleport (7th Level Spell) away to the location its essence is hidden. If it is able to teleport and its essence is undisturbed, a destroyed archlich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the essence.

trait.name: Soporific Aura
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the archlich that hits it with an attack must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or fall asleep until the end of the archlich's next turn, or until the creature takes any damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the archlich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Transporting Touch (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) force damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the archlich can see.

action.name: Spiritual Arsenal (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 60 ft., any number of creatures. Hit: 13 (3d8) radiant damage. The archlich may repeat this attack as a Bonus Action on each of its turns for the next minute.

action.name: Blessed Unrest (6th Level Spell)
entries: The archlich impels the soul of one sleeping creature it can see within 5 feet to depart from its body, forcing it to make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw.

On a failure, the creature remains sleeping until woken, its body rises under the archlich's control for as long as it is asleep, and it repeats this saving throw whenever it would wake, remaining asleep on a failure.

action.name: Turn the Living
entries: The archlich forces each living creature of its choice within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be Turned for the next minute, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Misdirection (4th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the archlich can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the archlich and one of its illusory copies within 60 feet teleport to switch places. If the spell targeted the archlich, its new target becomes the copy.

reaction.name: Hallowed Balance (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: When the archlich is reduced below 86 hit points, each creature of its choice that it can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or lose half its current hit points.
The archlich may restore a number of hit points up to the total amount lost this way, divided as it chooses between creatures in range.

legendary.name: Transporting Touch
entries: The archlich makes an attack with its Transporting Touch.

legendary.name: Projected Likeness
entries: The archlich creates an illusory copy of itself in its space, then moves up to half its speed. The copy lasts for a minute and uses the archlich's statistics but dissipates if it takes any damage.
The archlich can see and hear through this copy, may move each of them up to 30 feet on its turn, and when the archlich casts a spell it may do so through one of its copies.

legendary.name: Bring Low (3rd Level Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature the archlich can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) radiant damage, or 36 (8d8) radiant damage if it has more than half its hit points.

name: Frostlich
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

trait.name: Cryonic Return
entries: If the frostlich is destroyed, its spirit possesses the corpse of a humanoid creature trapped in its Glacier Tomb after 1d10 days, consuming the creature's soul in the process.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The frostlich can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Black Ice Aura
entries: The area in a 10 foot radius around the frostlich is difficult terrain. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The frostlich uses its Ice Needle Hail twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bleak Aurora or Glacier Tomb, if available.

action.name: Frostbite Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (10d6) cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with Frostbite.

action.name: Ice Needle Hail (4th Level Spell)
entries: Needles of glittering ice rain down in a 10 foot-radius, 40 foot-tall cylinder centered on a point the frostlich can see within 120 feet.
Each creature in the area takes 10 cold damage, then must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Bleak Aurora (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Dull, shifting lights fill the air in a 40 foot radius centered on a point within 120 feet the frostlich can see, flaring brightly when they contact magic.

Ranged attacks that pass through the area are made at disadvantage, and a creature that casts a spell in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Glacier Tomb (7th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 feet that the frostlich can see must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or gain 40 temporary hit points as translucent ice begins to encase it, or half as much on a success.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it suffers the following effects:
It is restrained and has vulnerability to fire damage.
It cannot speak or breathe.
It cannot rest or die.
