It must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or have its Strength and Dexterity scores reduced by 7 (2d6), to a minimum of one, until it is released.

reaction.name: Numbing Torpor
entries: When the frostlich is hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or drop its weapon.
If the attacker picks up the weapon this turn, the frostlich can make a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Freeze the Blood (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: When the frostlich is reduced below 107 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) points of exhaustion, or half as many on a success.

legendary.name: Polar Burst
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the frostlich must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 13 (3d8) cold damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

legendary.name: Sapping Cold
entries: One creature the frostlich can see must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be unable to gain advantage on any roll for the next minute.

legendary.name: Bitter Stride (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The frostlich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and makes an attack with its Frostbite Touch.

trait.name: Sickening Aura
entries: Whenever the lich is hit with an attack, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the creature's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Brittle Lung.

trait.name: Spore Seeding
entries: When the lich is destroyed, it begins to release spores. Unless the lich's body and the surrounding area are cleansed with fire or acid within the next minute, the spores drift far and wide, taking root in a fresh corpse and raising it as a new body for the lich after 1d10 days.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich makes two attacks and uses its Sprouting Doom.

action.name: Horrid Growth
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) poison damage and fungal growths root the creature in place, grappling it to the nearest surface (escape DC 19).

action.name: Demonrot Barbs
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) piercing damage and the target suffers one effect of the lich's choice:
The creature loses any resistance or immunity to Poison damage or the poisoned condition for the next minute.
One spell effect on the creature ends.
The creature has disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes in the next minute.

action.name: Sprouting Doom
entries: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5 foot radius centered on a point the lich can see within 120 feet.

The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

action.name: Sudden Wasting (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the lich may expend any number of hit dice to heal itself (without adding its Constitution modifier), then the lich may force it to succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 88 (16d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
If the target is killed by this damage, its flesh rots away into a putrid slurry, and the lich immediately uses its Sprouting Doom centered on the creature's corpse.

reaction.name: Mycellia Snare
entries: When a creature ends its turn within 15 feet of an area affected by Sprouting Doom, the lich can force it to succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or fall prone and be dragged up to 15 feet towards the area.

reaction.name: Brainrot (1/Day)
entries: When the lich is reduced below 94 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature becomes hostile to all creatures for the next minute, then dies. This effect can be removed by any effect that cures disease.

legendary.name: Horrid Growth
entries: The lich uses its Horrid Growth against a creature in its reach, or against one it can see in an area affected by Sprouting Doom.

legendary.name: Parasitic Ruin
entries: One creature grappled by the lich's Horrid Growth takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A creature that takes 15 or more damage from a use of this ability becomes restrained for as long as it remains grappled.

legendary.name: Sporeflight (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lich transforms into a cloud of spores and moves up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.
It can pass through the spaces of other creatures with this movement, and each creature the lich moves through must make a saving throw against its Sickening Aura.

trait.name: Far Realm Parasite
entries: The lich's body harbors a far realm parasite which safeguards its consciousness. If the lich is incapacitated, the parasite can be extracted with a successful DC 16 Strength (Medicine) check, at which point it can be attacked and damaged (AC 14; 50 HP).
If the lich starts its turn with 0 hit points, its body implodes and the parasite Plane Shifts (7th Level Spell) to the Far Realm, creating a new body for the lich in 1d10 days.

trait.name: Impossible Angles
entries: The space in a 10 foot radius around the lich is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the lich's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries, additionally causing the following effects:

A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 1d10 psychic damage and be poisoned until the beginning of its next turn.
Ranged attacks made by non-aberrations that pass through the area are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich uses its Touch of the Far Realm twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Unspeakable Insight or Fold Space.

action.name: Touch of the Far Realm
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the creature's Wisdom score is reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Fold Space (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The lich teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the lich's next turn.

action.name: Unspeakable Insight (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that the lich can see must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or gain 20 temporary hit points.

While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, its Intelligence score increased by 5, to a maximum of 25. At the end of its turn, a creature loses all of these temporary hit points and takes psychic damage equal to twice the temporary hit points lost.

action.name: Foetid Fusation (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the lich's choice must make a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. Each creature that failed has its initiative reduced to 0, then teleports to an unoccupied space that the lich can see within 60 feet.
The lich may teleport any two creatures that failed this save into the same space, fusing them together into a single malformed body for the next minute.

While fused, creatures act on the same turn, and only one of them may use movement, use a bonus action, or take reactions in a turn. Whenever one of them takes damage, the other takes the same damage. One of the fused creatures may repeat this saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect and moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Psychic Rebound (3rd Level Spell)
entries: When the lich takes damage from an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take an equal amount of psychic damage.

reaction.name: Batrachian Metamorphosis (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: When the lich is reduced below 83 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 30 feet to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature's flesh begins to roll in upon itself as the creature's body slowly turns itself inside out, gaining vulnerability to all damage and disadvantage on all attacks and saving throws.

An affected creature makes a DC 17 Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect after three successes, or transforming into a gibbering mouther under the DM's control after three failures until cured by a Wish spell or similar magic.

legendary.name: Fold Space
entries: The lich uses its Fold Space.

legendary.name: Unbearable Glimpse
entries: One creature within 10 feet of the lich must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its full speed directly away from it.

legendary.name: Detestable Clarion (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lich telepathically broadcasts a discordant melody that brings reality into unbearable focus. Each creature within 120 feet with a Wisdom score lower than 10 must use its reaction to make a melee attack against itself.

name: Jiangshi Sealbonded
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak them

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that is holding its breath may attempt to hide from the jiangshi without being obsucred.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the jiangshi takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the jiangshi takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of the jiangshi's turns, and its attacks deal an additional 4 (1d8) fire damage.

trait.name: Hopping Movement
entries: The jiangshi is always facing a single direction, and must spend 5 feet of movement to change its facing. Additionally, it may spend 5 ft. of movement to stand from prone. The jiangshi's reach extends only in the direction it is facing.

trait.name: Graceless
entries: If the jiangshi is struck with a melee attack from a direction it is not facing, it is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jiangshi makes two attacks, one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claw Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. in the direction it is facing, one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the jiangshi adds one of the following effects:
The target is grappled.
The target is pushed 10 ft. away.
The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Ki Draining Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone, grappled, or incapacitated creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Whip Around
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack by a creature it is not facing, the jiangshi turns to face it and makes a claw attack.

name: Huecuva
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Revealed by Moonlight
entries: The huecuva appears as it did in life, though any clothes it wears darken to black over the course of a day. The touch of moonlight strips away its flesh, revealing its true undead nature.
While in moonlight, the huecuva loses its damage immunities and gains vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage from Magical Attacks.

trait.name: Profaner of Blessings
entries: Whenever a living creature within 30 feet of one or more huecuvas would add a bonus to its attack or saving throw due to a spell or magical effect, it instead subtracts that amount.

trait.name: Turning Resistance
entries: The huecuva has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The huecuva makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Mocking Benediction.

action.name: Bony Gouge
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Huecuva Blight.

action.name: Mocking Benediction (Concentration)
entries: Up to three creatures the huecuva can see receive its blessing, adding 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws they make for the next minute. An unwilling creature makes a DC 15 Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.
Whenever a creature affected by this blessing fails a saving throw, it takes 1d10 necrotic damage.

action.name: Litany of Forsaken Vows (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The huecuva begins a wretched chant that corrupts a mortal's connection to the divine. Each creature of the huecuva's choice within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be cursed.

Whenever the cursed creature receives magical healing, it gains the same amount of temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the creature is hostile to all living creatures.

name: Tormenting Ghost
resist: damage other than the type that killed it
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: Any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The ghost's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the ghost is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions. After 1d4 hours, the ghost recovers all of its hit points.
While at 0 hit points, the ghost can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unfinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Interring its remains with the Ceremony spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghost uses its Withering Touch twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Etherealization.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealization
entries: The ghost or a creature within 5 feet of it magically shifts into the Border Ethereal from the Material Plane, or vice versa. At the end of each of its turns, an unwilling creature makes a DC 17 Charisma saving throw, returning to the material plane on a success.
Creatures in the Border Ethereal can be seen from the Material Plane and vice versa, but can't affect or be affected by creatures on the Material Plane.

action.name: Horrifying Visage (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each living creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 28 (8d6) Psychic damage and be frightened until the end of the ghost's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also ages by 1d4 x 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the ghost is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Consuming Possession (1/Day)
entries: When the ghost is reduced below 62 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 15 feet to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be possessed.

While Possessed in this way, a creature has its Charisma score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, at the beginning of each of its turns, and repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, expelling the ghost on a success.
This reduction lasts until the creature completes a Short or Long Rest.

name: Trap Haunt
resist: damage other than the type that killed it
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The haunt can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The haunt's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the haunt is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions. After 1d4 hours, the haunt recovers all of its hit points.
While at 0 hit points, the ghost can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unfinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Interring its remains with the Ceremony spell.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Horrifying Visage (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each living creature within 60 feet of the haunt that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and be frightened until the end of the haunt's next turn,or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also ages by 1d4 x 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the haunt is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Possession (1/Day)
entries: When the haunt is reduced below 37 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 15 feet to succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed until it is reduced to 0 hit points.

name: Ghostly Legionnaire
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Echo of History
entries: The legionnaire's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored. If a creature correctly identifies and speaks the legionnaire's origin, it loses this trait and its damage immunities until the next dawn.

trait.name: Soul Link
entries: When initiative is rolled, each legionnaire that rolls initiative pools its hit points into a single sum. Damage to a legionnaire deducts from that total. When the shared sum of hit points reaches zero, each legionnaire that pooled its hit points dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The legionnaire makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its terror grip.

action.name: Spectral Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Terror Grip
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 9 (2d8) psychic damage and be frightened until the beginning of the legionnaire's next turn. A creature frightened in this way has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Battle Visions (1/Day)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must make a DC
15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature becomes indifferent to undead creatures and hostile to all living creatures as it hallucinates a long-forgotten battlefield.

The creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 9 (2d8) psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save has advantage on Intelligence (History) checks to determine the legionnaire's origin.

name: Ghoul Adept of Orcus
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Demonic Hunger
entries: If the ghoul uses its ghoulish bite on a corpse, it gains resistance to all damage and advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature grappled, it may Dash as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul makes three attacks, one of which may be with its ghoulish bite.

action.name: Ghoulish Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing plus 5 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the ghoul's next turn.

action.name: Wretched Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). On a critical hit, the target is additionally knocked prone.

action.name: Call to Feast
entries: The ghoul targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the target may use its reaction to make a melee attack against it.

action.name: Litany of Flesh Devoured (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the ghoul's choice within 30 feet that can hear it must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw.

On a failed save, the next time that creature takes damage before the end of the ghoul's next turn, it takes the same amount of psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more takes a point of exhaustion, additionally.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: When a creature grappled by the it begins to cast a spell, the ghoul can force the spellcaster to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the spell fails.

reaction.name: Uneasy Grave
entries: When a friendly ghoul the adept of Orcus can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, the adept of Orcus can reanimate it as a Horde Ghoul.

trait.name: Demonic Hunger
entries: If the ghoul uses its ghoulish bite on a corpse, it gains resistance to all damage and advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature grappled, it may Dash as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul makes two attacks, one of which may be with its ghoulish bite.

action.name: Ghoulish Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 5 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the ghoul's next turn..

action.name: Wretched Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). On a critical hit, the target is additionally knocked prone.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: When a creature grappled by the it begins to cast a spell, the ghoul can force the spellcaster to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the spell fails.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature grappled, it may Dash as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul makes two attacks, one of which may be with its fleshripper bite.

action.name: Fleshripper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Sodden Grip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

action.name: Pry Mouth
entries: One creature grappled by the ghoul must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and lose its breath, if it were holding it, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Murky Dive
entries: When the ghoul takes damage while submerged, it can move up to half its swim speed and attempt to hide.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature grappled, it may Dash as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Fleshripper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Death Grip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). A creature that ends its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Snatching Horde
entries: A Medium or smaller creature grappled by three or more horde ghouls can be dragged without requiring additional movement. A creature grappled by five or more horde ghouls is restrained.

action.name: Ravenous Bites (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.

action.name: Clawed Grip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 12).

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the gaunt with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the gaunt moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The gaunt may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

action.name: Grave Chill
entries: Each creature within 10 feet that is not riding the gaunt must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw  or suffer one of the following effects of the gaunt's choice until the end of the gaunt's next turn.

items.name: Leaden Steps
entries: The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet.

items.name: Numbed Fingers
entries: The first attack the target makes before the end of the gaunt's following turn is made at disadvantage. If the attack misses, the creature drops its weapon if it is wielding one.

items.name: Chattering Teeth
entries: If the creature casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, the spell does not take effect until the end of the gaunt's next turn.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the gaunt that benefits from flanking it, the gaunt can make an Hooves attack against the attacker.

name: Gashadokuro
resist: piercing and slashing damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the gashadokuro  may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the gashadokuro's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the gashadokuro's legs to its back, or from its back to its head.

items.name: Legs
entries: While climbing on the gashadokuro's legs, a creature must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw at the start of its turn or fall off.

items.name: Back
entries: While climbing on the gashadokuro's back, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the gashadokuro, and the gashadokuro had disadvantage on attacks against it.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the gashadokuro's head, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the gashadokuro, and the gashadokuro has vulnerability to bludgeoning damage the creature deals. If a creature on the gashadokuro's head scores a critical hit against it, the gashadokuro falls prone at the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Stalker on the Road
entries: The gashadokuro is invisible to creatures more than 15 ft. away from it.

trait.name: Rattling Wail
entries: A creature that the gashadokuro can see hears a faint chittering ringing in its ears that increases in volume as the gashadokuro approaches.

trait.name: Famished Aura
entries: Creatures within 5 miles of a gashadokuro must eat twice as much to avoid suffering exhaustion.

trait.name: Sustained by Rage
entries: If the gashadokuro is reduced to 0 hit points while it has unexpended hit dice, it does not die. Instead, it falls prone and cannot stand, and deals half as much damage with melee attacks. Whenever the gashadokuro makes an attack or starts its turn in sunlight, it must expend two hit dice. If it cannot, it dies.

trait.name: Ravenous Resistance
entries: If the gashadokuro fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead by expending four of its hit dice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gashadokuro makes two attacks with its sweeping claws.

action.name: Sweeping Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (6d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Chattering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 64 (10d10 + 9) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be decapitated.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a creature grappled by it, the gashadokuro forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 30 (6d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Returning Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small creature.
At the beginning of the swarmes turn, it and each other undead creature  in the swarm's space regains 5 hit points.

action.name: Sweeping Mass
entries: The swarm moves up to half its speed. Each creature whose space it moves through takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone if it is Medium or smaller.

action.name: Wave of Fear (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each living creature within 20 feet that can see the swarm must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the swarm's next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally stunned until the end of the swarm's next turn.

reaction.name: Fill Mouth
entries: When a creature in the swarm's space attempts to speak or otherwise opens its mouth, dozens of moths pour into its mouth. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or begin choking until it clears them as an action.

trait.name: Keeper of the Ashen Covenant
entries: If a humanoid creature that the eye can see within 60 feet would die, it instead regains half its maximum hit points, its creature type becomes undead, and it acts under the eye's control.

trait.name: Deathpact
entries: When a living creature makes a deal with the eye, the eye may seal it with powerful necrotic magics. The first time that either creature acts in a manner directly counter to the terms of the deal, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or die.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eye makes two attacks with its Flameharrow's Touch and uses either its Eye of Fear or Eye of Flame.

action.name: Flameharrow's Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
If the target was frightened, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or act under the Flameharrow's control on its following turn.

action.name: Eye of Fear
entries: One creature the eye can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of the eye's next turn.
While frightened in this way, a creature's movement speed is halved and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Eye of Flame
entries: One creature the eye can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and be Burning (1d10).
If the target was frightened, each creature within 10 feet of it must make this saving throw.

reaction.name: Invocation of the Bloodlord (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a friendly creature drops to 0 hit points, the eye can prevent it from falling unconscious until the end of the target's next turn.

reaction.name: Deadfire Escape (5th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: When the eye is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling unconscious, it can teleport to Thanatos.
Each creature within 10 feet of the space the eye departed must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage.

name: Ephemeral Swarm
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature or object's space and vice versa.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The swarm's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Foul Tide
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space or affected by its Invade Body must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the beginning of its following turn.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is infected with Wraithplague.

action.name: Gnaw From Within
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (10d4) necrotic damage and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to retch blood, and cannot speak or breathe until the end of the swarm's next turn.

action.name: Invade Body
entries: One creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or have the swarm pour into its body through its mouth and any open wounds, disappearing.

At the end of each of the creature's turns, it repeats this saving throw, ejecting the swarm and causing it to reappear within 5 feet of the creature on a success, or having its Constitution score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest on a failure.

name: Dread
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Unliving Warrior
entries: The dread has proficiency with all weapons.

trait.name: Habitual Height
entries: The dread can fly only so long as it is within 5 ft. of a solid surface.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The dread can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

action.name: Dread Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the creature is grappled (escape DC 12).
A creature grappled in this way cannot speak or breathe, and must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One creature grappled by the dread must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and lose its breath, if it was holding it, or take half as much damage on a failure.

reaction.name: Wrest Weapon
entries: When it is missed with a melee weapon attack by a creature it has grappled, the dread can force the creature to make a DC 12 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the grapple ends and the dread pulls the attacker's weapon from from its hands.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The dracolich can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Black Ice Aura
entries: The area in a 10 foot radius around the dracolich is difficult terrain. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Soul Vessel
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is stunned, it must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away from the dracolich.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Ice Tomb Breath (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Blizzard Breath)
entries: The dracolich exhales a burst of ice in a 90-foot cone that clings to living creatures, sapping their vitality. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or gain 45 (10d8) temporary hit points.

While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature is restrained and must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns. On a failed save, a creature loses two unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 hit points if it cannot.

action.name: Blizzard Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dracolich exhales a blast of ice and thrashing winds in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the end of the dracolich's next turn, the area is difficult terrain and heavily obscured.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature within 80 feet of the dracolich ends its turn further away from the dracolich than it started, the dracolich can move up to its speed toward the creature and make a claw attack against it.
If the target is frightened, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reaction.name: Consume Vitality
entries: When the dracolich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, it can force the spellcaster to make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw.

On a failed save, the spell caster loses two unexpended hit dice and the dracolich regains 18 (1d20 + 8) hit points for each hit die lost this way. If the spell caster can't expend any hit dice, it instead drops to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Raise Hackles
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or lose any immunity it has to the dracolich's Frightful Presence or the frightened condition..

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One frightened creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage. On the creature's next turn, it must use its full movement to run away from the dracolich.

legendary.name: Uttercold
entries: The dracolich draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dracolich deals ignores damage resistance, and the dracolich loses one of its legendary resistances.

trait.name: Searing Aura
entries: When a creature without fire resistance or immunity starts its turn within 10 feet of the dracolich, it catches fire and begins burning (1d10).

trait.name: Soul Vessel
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage. If the target was stunned, it must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath of Dying Flames (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Necrofire Wake)
entries: The dracolich breathes malicious intent into all flames in a 90-foot cone, extinguishing them and summoning a |Belker that lasts for a minute and acts on initiative count 20 in the space of each creature in the area that was on fire.

action.name: Necrofire Wake (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dracolich moves up to its fly speed, and a 15-foot wide section of the ground it passes over erupts in a wall of black flames that lasts until the end of the dracolich's next turn as it strafes with its breath.

A creature that starts its turn in the wall's area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 91 (26d6) fire damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature in the wall that would receive any healing instead takes an equal amount of necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Wilting Glare
entries: When the dracolich is hit with an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reaction.name: Billowing Wings
entries: When the dracolich takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it may shroud itself in smoke, heavily obscuring the area in a 40 foot radius until the end of its next turn, then immediately move up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Manipulate Flames
entries: One creature within 90 feet of the dracolich and within 30 feet of a flame must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (1d10) fire damage and catch fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

legendary.name: Inhale (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dracolich rolls to recharge its necrofire wake.

legendary.name: Tail Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the dracolich must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and pushed up to 15 feet away from the dracolich.

trait.name: Forest Walk
entries: The dracolich's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage.

trait.name: Fouling Aura
entries: A creature that imbibes a potion within 30 feet of the dracolich takes 14 (4d6) poison damage, in addition to the potion's other effects. The poison damage occurs before any other effects.

trait.name: Soul Vessel
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

If the target is resistant or immune to poison damage or the poisoned condition, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or lose its resistance or immunity. A creature immune to Poison damage makes this saving throw at advantage.

action.name: Paralyzing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target was stunned, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Entangling Breath (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Miasma Breath)
entries: The dracolich exhales a flurry of blackened seeds in a 90-foot cone, causing barbed vines to burst from the earth. Each creature in the area when it appears must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be restrained.
Until the dracolich uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain and whenever a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 18 (4d8) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Miasma Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dracolich exhales a poisonous cloud in a 90-foot cone that lasts until th ened of its next turn, heavily obscuring the area.

A creature in the area when it appears or that ends its turn  in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 77 (22d6) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or falls immediately prone, retching.

reaction.name: Adapt Camouflage
entries: When the dracolich is hit with a ranged attack, it can cloak itself in illusory magics to match its surroundings.
Until the end of its next turn, the dracolich becomes invisible to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

reaction.name: Savage
entries: When a creature the dracolich can see within 20 feet resists or negates a source of poison damage, the dracolich can move up to half its speed toward and make a bite attack against the creature.

reaction.name: Murderous Glare (1/Day
entries: When the dracolich is reduced below 100 hit points, the dracolich unleashes a torrent of negative energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet. If the creature has fewer than 100 hit points, it dies.

legendary.name: Blinding Spit
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

legendary.name: Snatch
entries: The dracolich moves up to 15 feet and makes a Paralyzing Claw attack against a creature that it is hidden from. If the attack hits, the target is grappled, stunned, and hidden from its allies until the beginning of its next turn. If the dracolich was hidden, this attack does not automatically reveal its position.

legendary.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dracolich moves up to half its fly speed. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage. If it ends this movement in  cover, it may immediately attempt to hide.

trait.name: Building Charge
entries: When the dracolich rolls to recharge its Breath Weapons, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage.
If it successfully recharges its Breath Weapons, each of those creatures takes an additional (2d6) lightning damage.

trait.name: Soul Vessel
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage. If the target was stunned, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or become paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dracolich uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Animating Lightning Breath
entries: The dracolich exhales lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 (16d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Each corpse in the affected area rises at the beginning of the dracolich's next turn as a
entries: Flesh Golem under the dracolich's control. A creature with 0 hit points that would take damage from this ability instead regains 1 hit point.

action.name: Desiccation Breath
entries: The dracolich inhales, draining the moisture from a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that cone must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 81 (18d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is unaffected by the next source of healing it would receive in the next minute. Each potion in the affected area turns to sand.

reaction.name: Wilting Glare
entries: When the dracolich is hit with an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reaction.name: Discharge
entries: When the dracolich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, the dracolich can force the spell's caster to take 5 (1d10) lightning damage per level of the spell.

legendary.name: Ionic Attunement
entries: One creature within 60 feet must succeed a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or lose any resistance to lightning damage that it has for the next minute and suffer disadvantage on the next Dexterity saving throw it makes in that time.

legendary.name: Gather Charge
entries: The dracolich moves up to half its speed. If it is hit with an attack in the course of this movement, it may immediately roll to recharge its Breath Weapons.
The dracolich may move through creations of magical force such as those created by the Wall of Force spell with this movement, destroying them.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dracolich beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dracolich must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dracolich can then fly up to half its flying speed.

name: Demilich Derelict
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the demilich is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Weightless Careening
entries: Whenever the demilich takes damage from a source it is not resistant to, it is pushed 30 feet away from the source. If it hits a wall or object, it bounces.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: The demilich targets up to three creatures that it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or lose a number of unexpended hit dice equal to the amount it failed by. A creature that cannot instead drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Howl (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The demilich emits a bloodcurdling howl. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the howl must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. On a successful save, the creature is frightened until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Mindlost Cackle
entries: When the demilich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, it can force the spellcaster to succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.

legendary.name: Chatter
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that is concentrating  and can hear the demilich must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

legendary.name: Choking Dust
entries: The area within 10 feet of the demilich becomes heavily obscured until the end of its next turn. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

name: Defacer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The defacer can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the defacer doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Frightful Keening
entries: The faces that whirl around a defacer's featureless head constantly wail and scream, a terrible sound that travels through solid rock and stone as easily as air. Creatures within 300 ft. of the defacer that can hear it have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The defacer makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Claw of Horrid Countenance
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d6 + 3) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or have its face replaced with the screaming, ghostly face of one of the defacer's previous victims. Until the end of the defacer's next turn, the target cannot see, speak, or breathe.

action.name: Steal Face (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or take 44 (8d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this damage has its face stolen, as its features melt off and slide away leaving only blank flesh behind until the defacer is slain. A faceless creature can still breath and speak, though it is difficult to tell how.

reaction.name: Screaming Chorus
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the defacer forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the defacer's next turn.

name: Giant Crawling Claw
languages: understands Common and Jiganti but can't speak

trait.name: Delicate Joints
entries: If the claw takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or fall prone and release any creatures it has grappled.

action.name: Giant Flick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Grasping Pounce
entries: The claw leaps toward a Medium or smaller creature within 20 feet and attempts to grasp it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature grappled by the claw must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: When the claw would make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to 10 feet.
If this movement puts the claw out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the claw is unaffected.

trait.name: Awful Fingers
entries: A creature in the swarm's space has disadvantage on checks to maintain Concentration and must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration at the end of each of its turns.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Diminutive creature.

action.name: Tide of Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft ., up to four creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 12 (4d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be grappled and restrained (escape DC 12).

action.name: Squick
entries: One creature grappled by the swarm must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened of the swarm until the end of the swarm's next turn, and must use its action to try to kill or escape the swarm.

name: Crawling Apocalypse
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Binding Seals
entries: Whenever the apocalypse takes 20 or more fire damage from a single source, it may attempt a DC 25 Charisma saving throw. On a success, its bursts its binding seals. The apocalypse loses its vulnerability to fire damage, its attacks are made at advantage, and it loses 11 (2d10) hit points whenever it makes an attack.

trait.name: Titanic Scale
entries: A creature adjacent to the crawling apocalypse may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 15 Dexterity (Athletics) or Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the apocalypse's tentacles. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the apocalypse's tentacles to its body, or from its body to its head.

items.name: Tentacles
entries: While climbing on the apocalypse's tentacles, a creature has advantage on attacks against it. Whenever the apocalypse makes an attack or uses its Rotting Tentacle Sweep, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall off.

items.name: Body
entries: While climbing on the apocalypse's body, a creature has advantage on attacks against it, and can't be affected by the apocalypse's Rotting Tentacle Sweep.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the apocalypse's head, a creature has advantage on attacks against it, can't be affected by the apocalypse's Rotting Tentacle Sweep, and its attacks against the apocalypse score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The apocalypse has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the apocalypse fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The apocalypse makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Rotting Tentacle Sweep or its Despairing Glare.

action.name: Crushing Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone.
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

action.name: Rotting Tentacle Sweep
entries: Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 19). A creature that ends its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract Mummy Rot.
A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to climb onto the apocalypse's tentacles.

action.name: Despairing Glare
entries: The apocalypse inflicts a portion of its anguish and resentment upon a creature it can see within 120 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage and subtract 1d6 from the next saving throw it makes in the next minute.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls prone and cannot stand, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Breath of Ages (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 60 foot cone must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose 1d10 unexpended hit dice, or gain a point of exhaustion and age 11 (2d10) years if it cannot. The aging effect can be reversed with a Greater Restoration spell.

name: Caller in Darkness
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The caller can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The caller's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Spirit Void
entries: Spirits drawn into the caller are subsumed within it, and are destroyed if it is destroyed. A spirit destroyed in this way can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.
If the caller in darkness would receive any magical healing, it instead receives no healing and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or release the spirit most recently absorbed into it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The caller uses its withering touch four times, one of which it may replace with a use of its Soul Calling.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage.

action.name: Soul Calling
entries: One creature within 30 feet with 0 hit points must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 2 (1d4) for the next minute. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way dies and has its soul drawn into and absorbed by the caller.

action.name: Soulstorm (Concentration)
entries: The caller turns invisible until the beginning of its next turn, and each Large or smaller unattended object within 60 feet begins to levitate and thrash about. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Visage of Shared Misery (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the caller that can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the caller's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls prone and loses hit points equal to half its maximum as a screaming fragment of the creature's soul tears itself free and is absorbed into the caller.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the caller is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Draw Forth
entries: When a creature within 30 feet fails a death save, the caller can use its Soul Calling, targeting that creature.

trait.name: Bone-Scent Ravening
entries: While within 30 ft. of a living creature with bones, the bonedrinker may Dash as a Bonus Action, and melee attacks made against it by creatures it is not grappling are made at advantage.

trait.name: Weeping Sores
entries: The bonedrinker is covered in sores that weep a clear fluid, and develops more for each day it goes without feeding.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonedrinker makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bonesoftening bite or its drink bones.

action.name: Bonsoftening Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have its bones soften for the next minute, reducing the creature's speed by half.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). The bonedrinker has two tentacles, each of which may grapple a single creature.

action.name: Drink Bones
entries: One creature with softened bones and grappled by the bonedrinker must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 5 (2d4). A creature that has its Constitution reduced to 0 in this way collapses into a pile of loose flesh and dies.

name: Boneclaw Night Terror
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources while in dim light or darkness
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: While its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw gains a new body in 1d10 hours, with all its hit points. The new body appears within 1 mile of the boneclaw's master.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The boneclaw can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the boneclaw can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Shadewarded (3/Day)
entries: If the boneclaw fails a saving throw while in Dim Light or Darkness, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneclaw makes two attacks with its Ghastly Claws, each of which it may replace with a use of its Douse or Shadowsink, if available.

action.name: Ghastly Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the boneclaw and grappled (escape DC 18).

action.name: Douse
entries: The boneclaw reduces a source of Bright Light it can see within 60 feet to Dim Light, or extinguishes a source of Dim Light it can see in the area.
If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

action.name: Shadowsink (Recharge 5-6)
entries: If the boneclaw is in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadows around it deepen to a pure black and it sinks through to the world of shadow, emerging at another location in Dim Light or Darkness within 60 feet.

Each creature within 5 feet of the boneclaw must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be drawn through this passage behind it, taking 32 (5d12) necrotic damage and emerging in the nearest unoccupied space to the boneclaw. A grappled creature makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Shadow Snatch
entries: When a creature the boneclaw is hidden from enters its reach, the boneclaw can make an attack with its Ghastly Claws against it.

If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the boneclaw's next turn and Hidden from any creature the boneclaw is hidden from. If the boneclaw is hidden, this attack does not reveal its location.

legendary.name: Douse
entries: The boneclaw uses its Douse ability. It may take this Legendary Action even while incapacitated.

legendary.name: Change Orientation
entries: The boneclaw changes the orientation of gravity toward an surface it can see within 30 feet for itself and for any creatures grappled by it.

legendary.name: Claw Skewer
entries: If the boneclaw is not in bright light, it extends a finger through the nearby shadows. One creature the boneclaw can see within 15 feet of an area of dim light or darkness must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) piercing damage. If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

name: Bodak Mind Killer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Death Gaze
entries: The bodak's eyes reflect the horror that frightened it to death. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the bodak and can see its eyes must succeed a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (4d10) psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead drops to 0 hit points. A creature that is immune to the frightened condition makes this save at advantage.
The bodak is forced to close its eyes while in sunlight, disabling this trait.

trait.name: Aura of Annihilation
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the bodak fail death saving throws automatically, cannot be stabilized without regaining at least one Hit Point.
Additionally, creatures of the bodak's choice that start their turn in the aura take 5 (1d10) necrotic damage. A creature that dies in this aura rises as a bodak after 24 hours.

trait.name: Fear is Where It Lives
entries: The bodak is always frightened. If another effect would subject the bodak to the frightened condition, it instead gains 36 (8d8) temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bodak uses its Soul Drain twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Share Horror, if available.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the bodak must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Share Horror (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bodak opens its mind to those around it. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed and frightened by the bodak until the end of its next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature cannot avert its eyes.

reaction.name: Consume Spirit (Concentration)
entries: When a creature drops to 0 hit points within 5 feet of it, the bodak can grapple the creature and begins to draw the creature's soul out from its body.

At the beginning of the bodak's next turn, if the creature is still unconscious and grappled, the creature dies and cannot be resurrected by any means short of a Wish spell, as the bodak devours its spirit.

trait.name: Terror Dive
entries: If the blackwing is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the blackwing's next turn.

trait.name: Empty Bones
entries: If the blackwing takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose its fly speed until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blackwing makes two attacks with its Abductor Talons, one of which it may replace with its Throatripper Beak or Wail of Despair, if available.

action.name: Throatripper Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing plus 11 (1d10) necrotic damage.

If the target is grappled, it additionally begins to bleed profusely. At the end of each of its turns, the target loses 4 (1d8) hit points and must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, with advantage if it received any magical healing since the end of its last turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Abductor Talons
entries: Talons. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). The blackwing may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a frightened creature.

action.name: Wail of Despair (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The blackwing lets out a terrible cry. Each living creature within 60 feet that can hear it has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws it makes before the end of the blackwing's next turn.

name: Baigujing
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Flesh of Snow
entries: Whenever the baigujing takes radiant damage, each creature within 5 ft. takes the same amount of radiant damage.

trait.name: Bones of Jade
entries: The baigujing's true form is that of a jade skeleton. She can hide in the shed flesh of other humanoid skeletons, taking on their former voice and appearance.

trait.name: Voice of Two Mouths
entries: When the baigujing speaks, she may say two things at once. The baigujing chooses individually which statement each creature that is not hidden from it hears. A creature hidden from the baigujing hears both statements.

action.name: Draining Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 HP.

action.name: Shake Bones (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its skeleton rattle within its flesh, taking 28 (8d6) points of bludgeoning damage and moving up to 5 feet in a direction of the baigujing's choice on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.
An unconscious creature that fails this save dies. At the beginning of its next turn, its skeleton tears itself out of the creature's body, acting on its initiative.

reaction.name: Feign Death
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the baigujing appears to die.

hp.formula: half the hit point maximum of its summoner

trait.name: Inevitable
entries: The avatar knows the exact positon of its creator, and can't be hidden from by any means.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Creeping Return
entries: When the avatar is reduced to 0 hit points it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions and silently leaves. Whenever its summoner attempts to rest while it has no unexpended hit dice, roll a d100. On a roll of 5 or below, the avatar is summoned once more.

action.name: Touch of the Inevitable
entries: One creature within 5 feet has its Charisma score reduced by 3 (1d6) for the next minute, then the avatar teleports at least 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way dies and can't be restored to life by any means.

name: Atropal Scion
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Aura of Unmaking
entries: Creatures within 30 ft. of the atropal that make death saving throws roll three dice and take the lowest result. A creature in the area with no unexpended hit dice that rolls a 1 on a death saving throw fades out of existence and cannot be returned to life by any means other than a Wish spell.

trait.name: Quelling Aura
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the atropal is warded from the influence of the divine. Deities cannot sense or communicate with creatures in the area, divine interventions in the area fail except on a roll of 00, and cleric and paladin spell slots count as two levels lower in the area.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The atropal can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the atropal may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the atropal. While climbing on the atropal, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the atropal.

trait.name: Anti-Life Nature
entries: If the atropal would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage. If the atropal takes any radiant damage, attacks made against the atropal have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Implacable (5/Day)
entries: If the atropal fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The atropal makes two attacks with its life suppressing touch, one of which it may replace with its end magic or its death gaze.

action.name: Life Suppressing Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (6d10 + 5) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced to its current hit points until it completes a short or long rest.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature climbing on the atropal.

action.name: Ray of Death
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: End Magic
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the atropal can see must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the atropal ends each spell and magical effect affecting the creature, each spell it is concentrating on, and destroys one nonartifact magical item the creature is carrying.

action.name: Death Gaze
entries: One creature within 120 ft. that the atropal can see must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. A creature under the effects of Protection from Evil and Good or Death Ward has advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Necrotizing Beam (Recharge 5-6)
