entries: Each creature in a 300 ft. long, 15 ft. wide line from the atropal must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 105 (10d10 + 50) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more loses 1d20 unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 hit points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining.

reaction.name: Spawn Godling (2/Day)
entries: When the atropal takes 100 or more damage in a single turn, a piece of it rips off and rapidly grows into an atropal godling with no legendary actions that acts on initiative count 0.

legendary.name: Shroud of Death
entries: One creature the atropal can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. This curse ends early if the target receives magical healing.

legendary.name: The Dead Yet Live
entries: One undead creature within 30 feet that was destroyed since the end of the atropal's last turn returns to undeath with 33 (6d10) hit points, and is under the atropal's control.

legendary.name: Atropos Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The atropal releases a burst of negative energy centered on a dead or unconscious creature within 60 feet Each living creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

entries: The atropal releases a burst of negative energy centered on a dead or unconscious creature within 60 ft. Each living creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Angel of Decay
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Festering Presence
entries: If the angel has at least 105 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be infected with festering necrosis.

trait.name: Parasitic Presence
entries: If the angel has 105 HP or fewer, it regains 10 hit points at the beginning of its turn for each corpse and each creature within 60 feet infected with festering necrosis.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its foul unraveling, if available.

action.name: Rotting Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. This attack scores a critical on a 16-20 against a creature with fewer than 100 hit points.

action.name: Foul Unraveling (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The angel lashes out with tendrils of vile corruption, making a rotting touch attack against each creature within 15 feet On a hit, a creature is dragged up to 10 feet towards the angel and grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until the end of the angel's turn.

reaction.name: Wave of Decay (1/Day)
entries: When the angel is reduced below 105 hit points, it unleashes a wave of negative energy. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Vegepygmy Fission
entries: When the vegepygmy dies, three vegepygmy scavengers that act on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Moldy Fury
entries: Allied vegepygmies within 30 ft. can make a ranged or melee attack each turn as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Mucid Command, if available.

action.name: Livewood Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Mucid Command (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each other friendly plant creature within 15 ft. may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Chest Tendril Lash
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the vegepygmy forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. away.

reaction.name: Recolonize (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 60 hit points, the vegepygmy releases a cloud of infectious spores. Each non-plant creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be infected with russet mold contagion.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Vegepygmy Fission
entries: When the vegepygmy dies, two vegepygmy scavengers that act on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Livewood Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Rampant Growth
entries: A 10 ft. radius of ground centered on a point within 60 ft. becomes difficult terrain. Non-plant creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Plant creatures in the area regain 7 (2d6) hit points.

action.name: Lashing Vine (4th level spell, concentration)
entries: The vegepygmy conjures a thorny vine that sprouts from the ground in space within 30 ft. One creature within 30 ft of the vine must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) piercing damage and be pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine.
The vegepygmy can direct the vine to lash out at the same creature or another one as a bonus action each turn.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Vegepygmy Fission
entries: When the vegepygmy dies, a vegepygmy scavenger that acts on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Braining Sling
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the beginning of the target's next turn.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Spore Burst
entries: When the vegepygmy dies, it releases a cloud of infectious spores. Each non-plant creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be infected with russet mold contagion.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Cyclospore Anima
entries: At the beginning of each of the sporocyte's turns, one  creature the sporocyte can see within 60 ft. gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, a creature has disadvantage on Constitution and Death saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sporocyte makes two attacks with its fecund slam.

action.name: Fecund Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of the sporocyte's next turn.

action.name: Pallid Rooting (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the sporocyte can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute. A creature poisoned in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 28 (8d6) piercing damage and being restrained (escape DC 15) until the end of its next turn on a failure.

reaction.name: Spore Gout (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be infected with russet mold contagion.

trait.name: Corpse Drainer
entries: If the sporocyte starts its turn within 5 ft. of one or more dead or unconscious creatures, it gains 5 (1d10) temporary hit points and each creature in the area takes an equal amount of necrotic damage. On a roll of 10, a random corpse within 5 ft. of the sporocyte dissolves.

action.name: Rotting Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a Death saving throw.

action.name: Unfurl Mycelia
entries: The sporocyte spreads a carpet of mycelia over a 15 ft. square centered on itself. While unfurled, the sporocyte's movement speed is 0, the affected area is difficult terrain, and if the sporocyte would gain temporary hit points, it instead gains twice as many temporary hit points. The sporocyte may retract its mycelia as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Spore Gout (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be infected with russet mold contagion.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the shambler is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt. The shambler cannot trigger this with its own abilities.

trait.name: Lightning Aura
entries: A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the shambler takes 1d6 lightning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lightning Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone must succeed on a DC 15 dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success. A grappled creature makes this save at disadvantage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it.

reaction.name: Entangling Hide
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shambling mound can force the attacker to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled.

trait.name: Fiendlight Pattern
entries: The flowers of the rotroots display a dancing pattern of colors visible only to fiends and those under the effects of the Detect Magic spell.
A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the rotroots that can see this pattern must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement to approach the rotroots.

trait.name: Corpsebed Fertilizer
entries: When first encountered, the roots of the rotroots are entwined among 4 (1d4 + 2) grappled fiendish corpses.
While it has at least two corpses remaining among its roots, the rotroots has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Weaponized Cadavers
entries: The rotroots can't make attacks unless it has at least one corpse or creature grappled with its roots. A corpse used to make an attack is destroyed on a roll of 1. A creature used to make an attack takes the attack's damage on a hit or miss.

action.name: Corpse-Club Bash (requires a corpse or Grappled creature)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Flesh (requires a corpse or Grappled creature)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
A creature thrown with this attack falls prone in the nearest unoccupied space to the target.

action.name: Crawling Root Snare
entries: One creature within 15 feet of the rotroots must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone, dragged up to 10 feet toward the rotroots, and grappled (escape DC 16).
While grappled in this way, a creature takes 5 (1d10) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Devour Corpse
entries: The rotroots consumes one fiendish corpse entwined in its roots, which immediately softens and liquefies, produceing one effect of its choice:

items.name: Nourishing Rot
entries: The rotroots regains 10 hit points, and each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take an equal amount of necrotic damage.

items.name: Deathlurch
entries: Each other corpse entwined in the roots spasms and lurches, moving the rotroots up to 10 feet per remaining corpse.

trait.name: Poor Turner
entries: The plague brush must move at least 10 feet in a straight line before turning, unless it hits a solid surface. It cannot make turns sharper than 45 degrees.

trait.name: Mostly Air
entries: Any critical hit agains the plague brush becomes a normal hit. A natural roll of 1-7 always misses the plague brush.

trait.name: Woody Body
entries: If the plague brush takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the plague brush and all creatures grappled by it take 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of the plague brush's turns. Whenever the plague brush takes fire damage, each creature grappled by it may use its reaction to attempt to escape.

trait.name: Scoop
entries: The plague brush may move through the space of any Huge or smaller creature or object. A creature whose space the plague brush moves through must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 21) and restrained. Unsecured objects are grappled automatically.

action.name: Shed Spores
entries: Each creature grappled by the plague brush must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with greensickness.

trait.name: Host-Seeking
entries: Whenever a nonplant creature within 60 feet of the globe starts its turn, the globe may move up to 5 feet towards it.

action.name: Toxic Effluvia
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the globe must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with burrow-diver mycosis.

resist.preNote: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the gulthias tree may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the treant. While climbing on the gulthias tree, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the it.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the gulthias tree takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the gulthias tree and all creatures climbing on it take 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of the treant's turns, and all attacks against the gulthias tree are made at advantage. While on fire, the gulthias tree's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gulthias tree makes two attacks with its earthshaking slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Vile Birth or Grasping Roots, if availale.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage and falling prone on a failed save.

action.name: Vile Birth
entries: The Gulthias Tree spawns 3 (1d4 + 1) Twig Blights that appear within 5 ft. of it.

action.name: Grasping Roots (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 20 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, grappled and restrained until the end of the gulthias tree's next turn (escape DC 19). A creature that was already prone makes this save at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Stakes From The Earth
entries: Wooden stakes rise from the earth in two 5-ft. radius areas. The areas become difficult terrain, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

legendary.name: Frightful Keening
entries: Blood oozes from the gulthias tree as it releases a low keening moan. Each creature of the tree's choice in a 120 ft. radius must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the gulthias tree's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more ages 1d20 years.

legendary.name: Blood Drain (costs 2 actions)
entries: Black tendrils worm out of the tree's roots, piercing into flesh. Each creature that is prone and within 50 ft. of the tree must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 HP. The Tree gains 5 temporary hit points for each hit die expended this way. A creature that dies this way rises the next day as a vampire spawn.

trait.name: Spirit Tether
entries: The gravesnag begins life tied to the manitou that created it with a faintly perceptible tether of spectral energy, which is invisible to any creature with a Passive Perception of 19 or lower.

If the gravesnag begins its turn more than 30 feet away from its creator or if the tether is targeted with Dispel Magic or a similar effect, the tether snaps, and the gravesnag is incapacitated for 1 hour and is freed from the manitou's control.

trait.name: Slithering Vines
entries: The gravesnag may enter and move through the space of any creature or any space wide enough for a single vine without squeezing.

action.name: Strangleroot Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
If this attack was made at advantage, the gravesnag immediately use its Tangled Lunge against the same target.

action.name: Tangled Lunge
entries: The gravesnag lurches up to 15 feet, then forces a creature in its space to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 15).
A creature restrained by two or more gravenags can't speak or breathe.
A creature restrained by three or more gravesnags in this way is blinded and has total cover from outside effects.

action.name: Rending Twist
entries: One creature that is grappled or restrained by both the gravesnag and at least one other creature or effect must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage is torn in half.

name: Fungal Behemoth
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Greater Spore Host
entries: 1d4 Rounds after it is killed, the behemoth's body releases 1d12 Spore Globes.

trait.name: Creature of the Dark
entries: Attacks that deal Fire or Radiant damage are made at advantage against the behemoth.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the behemoth may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behemoth. While climbing on the behemoth, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the behemoth, and the behemoth has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Behemoth uses its spore breath and makes two Slam Attacks. It may replace one of its slam attacks with an Engulf.

action.name: Spore Breath
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and be afflicted with Ophidomycosis, or take half damage on success.

action.name: Slam
entries: Each creature in a 5 ft. radius centered on a point within 15 ft. must succeed on a  DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 19 (2d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. A prone creature hit with this attack is grappled (escape DC 18). A creature that succeeds may use its reaction to move out of the area. Otherwise, they take half damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The Behemoth engulfs a Medium or smaller creature that is grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the Behemoth's turns or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or half as muich on a success. If the Behemoth moves, the engulfed target moves with it.

legendary.name: Roil
entries: A tidal wave of mycelia spill out from the Behemoth. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. The affected area becomes difficult terrain.

legendary.name: Burgeoning
entries: The Behemoth rapidly buds and splits off 1d8 Spore Globes. They may immediately move up to 10 feet.

legendary.name: Blue Dreaming (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Behemoth lowers itself and a cavernous maw tears open in its front. Each creature infected with Ophidomycosis must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or use its following turn to climb into the behemoth, becoming subject to its Engulf ability. The behemoth's Mycelia core revealed, granting attacks against it advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Carpet of Thorns
entries: Each creature of the battlebriar's choice that is not riding it treats the area within 5 ft. of the battlebriar as difficult terrain, and takes 5 (2d4) damage for each 5 ft. the creature moves through that area.

trait.name: Enraged By Fire
entries: If the battlebriar takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to distinguish friend from foe until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Swathe of Carnage
entries: The battlebriar may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature without penalty. When the battlebriar enters a creature's space for the first time on a turn, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The battlebriar makes three attacks, one of which may be either with its goring tusks or replaced with a use of its thorngrasp tongue.

action.name: Goring Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Spined Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Thorngrasp Tongue
entries: One Large or smaller creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) piercing damage and be pulled up to 25 ft. towards the battlebriar.

action.name: Thorn Burst (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) piercing damage and have its movement speed reduced by 5 until a creature takes an action to remove the embedded thorns, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Carpet of Thorns
entries: Each creature of the battlebriar's choice that is not riding it treats the area within 5 ft. of the battlebriar as difficult terrain, and takes 5 (2d4) damage for each 5 ft. the creature moves through that area.

trait.name: Enraged By Fire
entries: If the battlebriar takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to distinguish friend from foe until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The battlebriar makes two attacks, one of which may be with its goring tusks.

action.name: Goring Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Spined Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Thorn Burst (Recharge 6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) piercing damage and have its movement speed reduced by 5 until a creature takes an action to remove the embedded thorns.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the Alraune remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a large flower.

trait.name: Loam Scent
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Alraune must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can do nothing but use its movement to safely approach the Alraune. While within 5 feet of the Alraune, the creature uses its action to begin digging itself a shallow grave, or climbs into an open grave and lies prone. A creature repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. A creature that passes this save is immune to the alraune's Loam Scent for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the alraune takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the alraune takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of the its turns. While on fire, the alraune's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alraune makes four vine lash attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Dig Grave or Draining Tomb if its Enticing Lure is active.

action.name: Vine Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Dig Grave
entries: The alraune magically excavates a 10 ft. deep, 5 ft. wide column of earth within 10 ft. of it. A creature standing in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall in. A creature may climb out as an action with a successful DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check.

action.name: Draining Tomb (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The alraune fills in a grave within 10 ft. of it, burying any creatures within. A buried creature cannot speak or breathe, and takes 28 (8d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns if the Alraune is within 30 ft., as the alraune's roots drain its blood.

bonus.name: Enticing Lure
entries: The alraune produces an outgrowth that appears within 5 feet of its central flower, appearing as a humanoid creature. For all purposes the alraune is the outgrowth and occupies its space. The outgrowth is tethered to the main body by vines that spread along the ground and extend up to 30 feet. The Alraune can have only a single outgrowth active at a time, and can destroy its outgrowth as a bonus action.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Gargantuan vehicle or structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Vehicle or Structure Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary vehicle or structure.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Explorable
entries: The mimic may allow other creatures to enter or exit its space without hinderance. It may suspend this property as a bonus action.
If the mimic takes 30 or more damge in a turn, each creature trapped inside it may use its reaction to attempt a DC 20 Strength saving throw, escaping into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the mimic fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes five Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw. It makes one fewer attack for each mimic under its control.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mimic may grapple the target (escape DC 19).

action.name: Ravening Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target not in the mimic's space. Hit: 18 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the mimic's space.

action.name: Digest (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 45 (10d8) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Bloodied Roil (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 174 hit points, the mimic writhes and shakes. Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or fall prone and be grappled (escape DC 19) in place.

legendary.name: Blinding Spray
entries: One creature within 20 ft. of the mimic must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn.

legendary.name: Slam Door
entries: The mimic raises a barrier between two interior portions of its body, seperating creatures on either side of it from each other. The barrier is an object and can be destroyed (AC 17; 20 HP; Immunity to Acid damge)

legendary.name: Absorb Vestige
entries: The mimic absorbs a friendly ooze in its space, gaining 30 temporary hit points. The ooze is destroyed.

legendary.name: Spawn Mimic (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Part of the mimic splits off, becoming an Object Mimic under the house hunter mimic's control for the next hour, after which it withers and dies. The house hunter mimic loses 30 hit points.

trait.name: Shapechanger

If the mimic takes 30 or more damge in a turn, each creature trapped inside it may use its reaction to attempt a DC 17 Strength saving throw, escaping into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes three Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw. It makes one fewer attack for each mimic under its control.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mimic may grapple the target (escape DC 17).

action.name: Engulfing Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target not in the mimic's space. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the mimic's space.

action.name: Digest (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Treasure Lure
entries: The mimic offers a glimpse of fantastic treasure deep within it. One nonhostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the next minute.
While charmed, a creature uses its turn to try to try to enter the mimic's space and convince others to do the same. This effect ends early if the creature takes any damage.

legendary.name: Blinding Spray
entries: One creature within 20 feet of the mimic must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn.
While the mimic is submerged, this ability can only target creatures in the mimic's space.

legendary.name: Absorb Vestige
entries: The mimic absorbs a friendly ooze in its space, destroying it and gaining 30 temporary hit points.

legendary.name: Spawn Mimic (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Part of the mimic splits off, becoming an Object Mimic under the ship mimic's control for the next hour, after which it withers and dies. The ship mimic loses 30 hit points.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Large dragon or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Gas Bladders
entries: Whenever the mimic takes any piercing damage, its fly speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
If its fly speed is reduced to 0 in this way, the mimic becomes size Medium and makes one fewer attack with its Multiattack until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance (Dragon Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary dragon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes three Clawed Pseudopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Outsize Maw or Gurgling Roar.

action.name: Outsize Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a grappled creature.

action.name: Clawed Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Gurgling Roar
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the mimic must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.
A creature that knows the mimics true nature has advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Acid Glob (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The mimic spits forth a piece of itself at a point it can see within 30 feet. The mimic loses 10 hit points, and each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth
entries: As a reaction when a creature misses the mimic with a melee attack or attempts to touch it, the mimic makes a Outsize Maw attack against it.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Large object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes two Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw or its Engulf ability.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Ravening Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature grappled by the mimic.

action.name: Engulf
entries: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be engulfed in the mimic's space. A grappled creature makes this save at disadvantage.
While engulfed, a creature is blinded and takes 18 (4d8) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic's turns.

reaction.name: Adhesive Secretion
entries: As a reaction when a creature touches the mimic or hits it with an unarmed attack, the mimic grapples the creature (escape DC 15).

reaction.name: Blinding Spray
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 68 hit points, the mimic launches a spray of blinding acid. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) acid damage and be blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Small creature or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Creature Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary creature.

action.name: Outsize Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage and the mimic attaches itself to the creature (remove DC 13).

action.name: Puppy Eyes (Creature Form Only)
entries: The mimic gazes endearingly at a humanoid creature within 30 feet that can see it. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or use its action to pet the mimic on its following turn.
A creature that knows the mimic's true nature makes this save at advantage.

action.name: Invade Space (Amorphous Form Only)
entries: One humanoid creature the mimic is attached to must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or have the mimic enter its clothing or armor.

While the mimic is in the creature's attire, it has three quarters cover against outside effects, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws, and an attack that misses the mimic makes a new attack roll, targeting the creature.
At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw, dislodging the mimic in the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth
entries: As a reaction when a creature misses the mimic with a melee attack or attempts to touch it, the mimic makes a Outsize Maw attack against it.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Small bladed weapon or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Weapon Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary weapon. Attacks made with the mimic deal an additional 3 (1d6) acid damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes two attacks with its Corrosive Slash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Gnaw Palm or Tumbling Advance.

action.name: Gnaw Palm
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target that is holding the mimic. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

action.name: Corrosive Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

action.name: Tumbling Advance
entries: The mimic moves up to its speed, tumbling end-over-end. Until the beginning of its next turn, melee attacks are made at disadvantage against it, and a creature that misses the mimic with a melee attack takes 4 (1d8) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Adhesive Grip
entries: As a reaction when a creature holding the mimic attempts to drop it, the mimic adheres to it.
As an action, the creature may attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check, dropping the mimic on a success.

reaction.name: Wobbling Riposte
entries: As a reaction when a creature misses with a melee attack that uses the mimic as a weapon, the mimic makes a Corrosive Slash attack against it.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Medium object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

action.name: Ravening Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature grappled by the mimic.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Sudden Lunge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The mimic jumps up to 20 feet and may land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. A creature whose space the mimic lands in must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 13).
A creature grappled in this way is blinded, can't speak or breathe, and takes 9 (2d8) acid damge at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Adhesive Secretion
entries: As a reaction when a creature touches the mimic or hits it with an unarmed attack, the mimic grapples the creature (escape DC 13).

reaction.name: Blinding Spray
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 46 hit points, the mimic launches a spray of blinding acid. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 4 (1d8) acid damage and be blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a container of liquid or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Drink Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary container of liquid. If it is disguised as a potion, a simple taste test indicates that it is the potion it is pretending to be, though an Identify spell reveals its true nature.

trait.name: Foe Climber
entries: The mimic may spend half its movement to attempt a contested Strength (Athletics) check against a Medium or larger creature within 5 feet.

On a success, the mimic climbs onto the creature. While climbing on a creature, the mimic has advantage on attack rolls against it, and the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against the mimic.

action.name: Acrid Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

action.name: Invade Mouth
entries: The mimic attempts to force its way into the mouth of a Medium creature it is climbing on. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or drink the mimic.

reaction.name: Throat Lodge
entries: As a reaction to a creature drinking it, the drink mimic leaps into the creatures throat and lodges there.
Until the mimic is removed, the creature cannot speak or breathe and takes 4 (1d8) acid damge at the start of each of its turns, and the mimic has total cover from outside effects.
As an action, an affected creature may attempt a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, expelling the mimic into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

name: Gelatinous Symbiote Shadow Wisp
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: The symbiote can't wear or carry anything.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The symbiote can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Reactive Illumination
entries: The symbiote sheds dim light in a 20-foot radius  while illuminated by no other sources. While illuminated by a source of dim light other than itself, the symbiote is invisible. While illuminated by a source of bright light other than itself, the wisp shines twice as bright, casting dark shadows.

trait.name: Ooze Swimmer
entries: The symbiote is not restrained while engulfed.

trait.name: Protective Cube
entries: The symbiote has full cover from ranged attacks made from outside the cube. Melee attacks against the symbiote from outside the cube are made at disadvantage. Likewise, creatures outside the cube have full cover against ranged attacks made by the symbiote, and the symbiote makes melee attacks against creatures outside the cube at disadvantage.

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the symbiote must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the symbiote until the end of the symbiote's next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature can do nothing but use its movement to approach the symbiote.

action.name: Shadow Betrayal
entries: The symbiote incites the shadows of each creature within its illumination to attack the creatures. Each creature within 20 feet of the Wisp must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or take  9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Partially Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide, though it must squeeze to do so.

trait.name: Rolling Graveyard
entries: If the bone ooze takes at least 15 necrotic damage from a single source, the ooze and each creature engulfed by it lose 10 (3d6) hit points as the skeletons within it briefly reanimate and thrash around.
If the ooze is killed by this damage, 1d8 skeletons reanimate and erupt from the ooze, appearing in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes three pseudopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Engulf.

action.name: Osteokinetic Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) acid damage. A target with bones is dragged 10 ft. toward the ooze.

action.name: Engulf
entries: Up to two creatures creatures within 5 ft. must each succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be dragged into the ooze's space and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappled in this way, a creature is blinded and takes 18 (4d8) acid damage at the beginning of each of the ooze's turns.

action.name: Bone Meld (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature grappled in the ooze must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) slashing damage and has its Constitution score reduced by 5 (2d4) until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic as some of its bones are drawn out through its skin, or takes no damage and half as much reduction on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skeleton torn out and its flesh ejected from the ooze.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The amniote can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Coagulate
entries: If the amniote takes any cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any temporary hit points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the amniote may not use its amorphous trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

trait.name: Blood Siphon
entries: Whenever one or more creatures grappled by the amniote take any necrotic damage, the amniote gains an equal number of temporary hit points. If it gains temporary hit points while it already has temporary hit points, the amniote adds them together, to a maximum of 30.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The amniote makes four attacks with its rupturing tendrils.

action.name: Rupturing Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is dragged up to 10 ft. toward the amniote and grappled (escape DC 15). A creature grappled by the amniote takes 5 (1d10) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Blood Call (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Up to two creatures grappled by the ooze must each succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage as its blood wells up from its pores and orifices, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When the amniote starts its turn with at least 20 temporary hit points, it loses all temporary hit points and spawns a new

reaction.name: Engulf
entries: When a Medium or smaller creature the amniote has grappled falls unconscious, the amniote pulls the creature into its space. While in the amniote's space, a creature cannot stabilize.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Coagulate
entries: If the ooze takes any cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any temporary hit points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the ooze may not use its amorphous trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

trait.name: Blood Siphon
entries: Whenever a creature grappled one or more bloodrot oozes takes any necrotic damage, one bloodrot ooze grappling it gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two attacks with its blood tendril.

action.name: Blood Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Exsanguinate (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature grappled by the ooze must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage as its blood wells up from its pores and orifices, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When the ooze starts its turn with at least 15 temporary hit points, it loses all temporary hit points and spawns a new

name: Vlaakith CLVII, Lich-Queen of the Astral Sea
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Vlaakith's phylactery is intact, when destroyed she gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all her hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of her phylactery.

trait.name: Banishing Backlash
entries: A creature within 30 feet of vlaakith that fails a saving throw against one of her spells or abilities by 5 or more takes 11 (2d10) force damage and is banished to the depths of the astral void, returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Vlaakith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vlaakith makes three attacks, one of which she may replace with her Gravity Gash, if available.

action.name: Grasp of the Lich Queen
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) cold damage and the target loses two unexpended hit dice.
If the target has no unexpended hit dice, it instead must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or die and crumble into a fine dust.

action.name: Dancing Silver Greatblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

action.name: Crippling Barrage
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +13 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 5 feet until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Gravity Gash (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A 60 foot line of concentrated gravity that is 5 feet wide extends from Vlaakith. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) force damage and fall prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Necropulse Salvo (9th Level Spell, Recharges when Vlaakith uses her Gravity Burst)
entries: The veil is rent and three torrents of negative energy spill forth in 20 foot cones emerging from points within 120 feet that Vlaakith can see.
For each of these areas a creature is in, it must succeed on a 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) necrotic damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: Vlaakith gains one of the following benefits until she uses this ability again.

items.name: Share Pain
entries: Vlaakith forges a psychic bond to a friendly creature she can see within 30 feet. Whenever she would be dealt damage, she instead takes half as much damage and the bonded creature takes the other half.

items.name: Warp Space
entries: Ranged attacks against Vlaakith are made at disadvantage, and the area in a 10 foot radius around her is difficult terrain for creatures of her choice.

items.name: Shadow in the Weave
entries: When a creature casts a spell of 1st level or higher while within 30 feet of Vlaakith, it must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or take 3 (1d6) psychic damage per level of the spell.

reaction.name: Repulsion Burst
entries: When Vlaakith is hit with a melee attack while her Warp Space is active, she can end the effect and force the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away and stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Twist Spell (6th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature fails its saving throw against her Shadow in the Weave, Vlaakith can choose new targets for the spell.

legendary.name: Psionic Shift
entries: Vlaakith uses her Psionic Empowerment and regains her reaction.

legendary.name: Susurration of the Damned
entries: Each creature of Vlaakith's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened. A creature that fails by 5 or more must use its reaction to move its full speed away from her, if available.

legendary.name: Consume the Faithful (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One willing creature Vlaakith can see within 30 feet dies, and Vlaakith gains temporary hit points equal to half its current hit points. While she has these temporary hit points, Vlaakith has advantage on attack rolls.

legendary.name: Ethereal Shuffle (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Up to four creatures within 60 feet are each teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied location that Vlaakith can see. An unwilling creature may make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

name: Baba Yaga, Mother of All Witches
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Archfey Resistance
entries: Baba Yaga succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know her name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Oppressive Fog
entries: The area within 5 miles of Baba Yaga is filled with a heavy, shifting fog. Creatures other than her treat anything greater than 20 feet away as heavily obscured.

trait.name: Feast of Terror (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Baba Yaga is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she resets to 252 hit points and her chest splits open, revealing the roiling void within.

For the next hour, a frightened creature that ends its turn within 60 feet of Baba Yaga must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or gain a point of exhaustion if it cannot. For each hit die lost in this way, Baba Yaga regains 10 hit points.

trait.name: Unliving Hair
entries: Baba Yaga can have up to six locks of hair active at a time. Each lock can be attacked (AC 17; 20 HP). Destroying a lock deals no damage to Baba Yaga, who can extrude any number of replacement locks on her turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Baba Yaga would fail a saving throw, she may choose to succeed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Baba Yaga makes makes three melee attacks, or makes one attack and uses her Terror Unbound, if available.

action.name: Erdblack Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of Baba Yaga's next turn.

action.name: Slithering Locks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one additional effect of Baba Yaga's choice.

items.name: Bind
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 22).

items.name: Snare
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving or be knocked prone.

items.name: Reel
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 20 feet directly toward Baba Yaga.

items.name: Wick
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw or have one spell affecting it end.

action.name: Terror Unbound (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature that has seen Baba Yaga in the last minute becomes frightened until the end of her next turn, then must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from her, or take 44 (8d10) psychic damage if it cannot.

action.name: Horrific Lament (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: Each frightened creature within 60 feet of Baba Yaga begins to uncontrollably weep acrid black tears, becoming poisoned for the next minute.

At the end of each affected creature's turn, it must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and being blinded until the end of its next turn on a failure, or ending the effect for itself on a success.

reaction.name: Wraithdrift
entries: When she is hit with an attack, Baba Yaga can turn briefly insubstantial, gaining resistance to the attack's damage and moving up to her fly speed.

reaction.name: Bloodied Terror (1/Day)
entries: When her mythic trait becomes active, Baba Yaga can recharge and immediately use her Terror Unbound.

legendary.name: Slithering Locks
entries: Baba Yaga makes an attack with her Slithering Locks.

legendary.name: Strangle
entries: One creature grappled by Baba Yaga must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe for as long as it remains grappled.

legendary.name: Elude
entries: Baba Yaga moves up to her fly speed and regains her reaction.

mythic.name: Consuming Void (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One grappled creature within 5 feet of Baba Yaga must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be forced into the endless void within her (escape DC 22).
A creature in the void can take no actions other than to attempt to escape, and loses 2 unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or dies if it cannot.

name: Halaster Blackcloak, Master of Undermountain
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Halaster dies in Undermountain, he revives after 1d10 days, with all his hit points and any missing body parts restored. His new body appears in a random safe location in Undermountain.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Halaster has advantage on saving throws against  spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sharpen Focus (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Halaster is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 212 hit points.
For the next minute, Halaster gains two additional legendary actions on each of his turns and has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Halaster fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Halaster makes three attacks with his Twisting Drakebolt, each of which he may replace with a use of his Flying Portal or Half-Forgotten Spell.

action.name: Twisting Drakebolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +14 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.
This attack ignores half and three-quarters cover, and can target creature behind full cover.

action.name: Flying Portal (6th Level Spell)
entries: Halaster creates a 10 foot wide flat portal that lasts for a minute in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. Any creature or ranged attack that enters one of these portals emerges from another of Halaster's choice.

action.name: Half Forgotten Spell
entries: Roll a d20, subtracting 1 for each legendary resistance that Halaster has expended. Halaster casts the corresponding spell on the Half-Forgotten Spells table.
On a result of 0 or lower, nothing happens. On a result of 20, he may choose any spell on the list to cast.

action.name: Blast with Madness (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Halaster opens his mind and releases a fragment of the eldritch knowledge imprisoned there, becoming a window to the Far Realm for a fraction of an instant.

Each creature within 30 feet that can see or hear Halaster must succeed on a DC 22 Intelligence saving throw or take 63 (6d20) psychic damage and have its proficiency bonus reduced by 2 until it completes a Short or Long rest, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way is afflicted with an effect from the Indefinite Madness table (DMG p. 258) until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Delay Spell (5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature Halaster can see casts a spell, Halaster delays the spell's effect until the end of his next turn.
The spell's caster must maintain concentration on the spell until then or have the spell fail.

reaction.name: Emergency Clone (9th Level Spell, Recharges when Halaster's Mythic Trait Activates)
entries: As a reaction when Halaster is targeted with an attack or  spell, he creates an imperfect copy of himself in an unoccupied space within 5 feet that becomes the new target of the attack or spell.
The copy rolls its own initiative, has 100 hit points, and doesn't have legendary actions or resistances, but otherwise uses his statistics.
At the beginning of each of his turns, Halaster must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or become mutually hostile with the copy until the beginning of his next turn.

legendary.name: Smoke Bomb!
entries: Halaster sends a burst of illusory smoke roiling forth from his feet, heavily obscuring the area in a 5 foot radius until the beginning of his next turn, then moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Move Portal (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Halaster moves one of the portals created with his Flying Portal up to 30 feet. Each creature whose space the portal moves through is teleported to the nearest unoccupied space to another Flying Portal of Halaster's choice.
An unwilling creature may make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Half-Forgotten Spell
entries: Halaster uses his Half-Forgotten Spell ability.

mythic.name: Hasten Spell
entries: Halaster reduces the duration of an active spell effect within 30 feet by 1d4 minutes. If this reduces the effect's duration to 0, the effect ends.

mythic.name: One of the Classics! (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Halaster casts any spell of 6th level or below.

name: Elminster Aumar, Chosen of Mystra

trait.name: Sage's Escape
entries: When elminster drops to 0 hit points or dies, his body, mind, and soul separate and each independently teleport to a hidden refuge in a secluded demiplane, where they recombine and are immediately restored to 1 hit point.

trait.name: Mystic Clarity
entries: If Elminster has at least 115 hit points, his attacks score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Weave Anchor
entries: Antimagic fields have no effect within 120 ft. of Elminster. His spells and magic items created by him cannot be dispelled, disabled or destroyed by any spell. He requires no verbal or somatic components to cast spells, and makes saving throws to maintain concentration at advantage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Elminster can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless he wishes to be. He has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Elminster fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Thunderstrike Longsword
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 7) slashing plus 14 (4d6) thunder damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. If elminster strikes a construct of force with this attack, the construct's creator must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have it shatter.

action.name: Silverfire Barrage
entries: Elminster unleashes a swarm of magical missiles that strike a creature within 120 feet, dealing 27 (5d8 + 5) force damage. A creature may halve this damage with the Shield spell.

action.name: Sculpt the Weave
entries: Elminster casts any spell of 5th level or below.

action.name: Silverfire Nova (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Elminster channels raw, unfiltered magic directly from the weave into a concentrated sphere and hurls it, where it explodes in a 60 ft. radius centered on a point within 300 feet. Each nonmagical object and surface that is not worn or carried disintegrates, leaving a circular crater. Each creature in the area regains all of its expended spell slots, then must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 88 (16d10) force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage disintegrates.

action.name: Shapechange (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Elminster changes his form into that of any creature of his CR 20 or lower, adopting the new form's statistics, other than its hit points, retaining his own traits and actions, and gaining temporary hit points equal to the new form's maximum hit points. When he loses these temporary hit points, he reverts to his normal human form.

reaction.name: Reactive Metamagic

reaction.name: Sage's Spelltweak (6th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, Elminster may make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, gaining control of the spell and choosing a new target for the spell on a success. If the spell requires concentration, Elminster must concentrate to maintain it.

reaction.name: Desperate Wish (1/Day, 9th Level Spell.)

legendary.name: Temporal Undoing

legendary.name: Staff of Spheres (4th Level Spell)

entries: The phalanx can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a medium creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Engraved Rapier
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is pushed up to 5 feet and must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

action.name: Call to Service
entries: The noble calls to a friendly creature within 30 feet, allowing it to use its reaction to move up to half its speed or make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Deft Parry
entries: When the noble would be hit with a melee attack, it can add +2 to its AC against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Bon Mot

The target gains disadvantage on the next attack it makes against the noble this turn.

reaction.name: Seamless Riposte
entries: When the noble is missed with a melee attack, it can move up to 5 feet and make an attack with its Engraved Rapier.

trait.name: Graveway Traveler
entries: Once on its turn, the necromancer can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into a Large or larger area of loose earth and emerge from any area of loose earth within 60 feet, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second space.

trait.name: Dread Revels
entries: The necromancer has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are frightened.

trait.name: Ghostly Chill
entries: The first time each turn that a wraith or specter passes through a living creature within 60 feet of the necromancer, the creature takes 4 (1d8) cold damage.

trait.name: Clinging Spirit (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the necromancer is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it gains 175 temporary hit points, and gains resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical sources that aren't Silvered for the next minute.

trait.name: Reclaim Anima (3/Day)
entries: If the necromancer fails a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead creature it controls to succeed instead, reducing the creature to 0 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The necromancer uses its Grave Bolt four times.

action.name: Grave Bolt (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) necrotic damage and the target is afflicted with clinging shadows for the next minute, reducing any sources of bright light within 5 feet of it to dim light.

action.name: Wrench Heart (7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the necromancer can see feels a spectral hand sink into its chest and grip its heart.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns it takes 45 (10d8) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn, ending the effect on a success..

action.name: Ghastly Scourge (6th level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 93 (6d10 + 60) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it immediately fails one death save.

reaction.name: Necromiasma (1st Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the necromancer can see  within 30 feet fails a Constitution save by 5 or more, the necromancer can corrupt the wound, making the creature unaffected by the first source of healing it receives before the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Heartstop (8th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: When a creature reduces the necromancer below 88 hit points, the necromancer can attempt to crush the creature's heart within its chest.
The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. A creature with no unexpended hit dice makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

entries: If the mohrg would receive any magical healing, it recives no healing and instead dies.

entries: The mohrg makes two attacks with its Bony Grasp.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 0 slashing damage.

entries: The mohrg can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it.

A creature that has less than half its hit points while grappled in this way is additionally frightened of the mohrg.

action.name: Visceral Intrusion
entries: The mohrg spears its clawed entrails into a grappled or incapacitated creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 55 (10d10) piercing damage and begins choking until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that is killed by this damage rises on its following turn as a Zombie under the mohrg's control.

reaction.name: Deadly Caress
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the mohrg misses it with an attack, it can force the attacker to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the mohrg's next turn.

entries: Friendly skeletons within 30 feet of the boneyard can use its attack bonus (+12) in place of their own.

trait.name: Bone Feast
entries: The boneyard absorbs bones, corpses, and skeletons that enter its space, destorying them. The boneyard regains 10 hit points for each corpse or skeleton destroyed in this way.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the boneyard fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Ghastly Thrash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20).
If the boneyard uses its Clattering Torrent or Restless Return, each creature grappled by it is released.

action.name: Corrupt Marrow (4th Level Spell)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the end of the boneyard's next turn.

action.name: Clattering Torrent (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The boneyard churns, flying up to its speed, during which it can move through the space of other creatures. Each creature whose space it enters during this move must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage and being knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Restless Return
entries: When the boneyard takes 20 or more non-radiant damage from a single source, it can create one Skeleton for each 10 damage it took that acts on initiative count 0 in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

trait.name: Graveway Traveler
entries: Once on its turn, the necromancer can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into a Large or larger area of loose earth and emerge from any area of loose earth within 60 feet, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second space.
