entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and the target is dragged 10 feet toward the necromancer, then must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute. A frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Corrupt Marrow (4th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the end of the necromancer's next turn.

reaction.name: Shield of Bones (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the necromancer or a friendly undead creature is targeted with a ranged attack, the necromancer can raise a shield of bones and earth, granting the target 3/4 cover against ranged attacks until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: To Dust (3rd Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: When the necromancer is reduced below 68 hit points, it can cause any number of skeletons or skeletal corpses within 60 feet to explode in a cloud of shrapnel and choking dust.

Each creature within 10 feet of one or more exploding skeletons must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the necromancer's next turn.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The witch can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Biting Cold
entries: A creature that takes any cold damage while within 10 feet of one or more frost witches takes an additional 4 (1d8) cold damage for each frost witch within 10 feet of it.

trait.name: Frozen Magic
entries: If the frost witch takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be unable to cast spells until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witch makes two attacks with its hoarfrost cudgel, one of which it may replace with a use of its Snow Blindness.

action.name: Hoarfrost Cudgel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

action.name: Snow Blindness (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) cold damage and the target is blind beyond a 15 foot radius until the end of the witch's next turn.

action.name: Icy Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The witch sends forth a tide of flash-freezing water in a 30 foot line that is ten feet wide, turning the area into difficult terrain. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) Cold damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is restrained by ice until the end of the witch's next turn (escape DC 15).

reaction.name: Freeze Weapon (1st Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to being hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, the witch forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) cold damage and drop its weapon. If the creature attempts to pick the weapon up this turn, it must repeat the save.

reaction.name: Armor of Winter (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the witch is reduced below 59 hit points, the witch gains 59 temporary hit points as crystals of jagged ice spiderweb across its body in shapes hinting at murals of death and dormancy.
While it has these temporary hit points, the witch has vulnerability to fire damage and a creature that hits the witch with a melee attack takes 9 (2d8) cold damage.

trait.name: Familiar Face
entries: The enchanter does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and appears familiar and friendly to any creature that has not seen the enchanter make an attack or cast a hostile spell in the last hour.

trait.name: Supernal Speech
entries: The enchanter can be heard and understood even by creatures that are deaf or cannot ordinarily understand any language. Creatures with an Intelligence score lower than 6 obey the enchanter's spoken commands.

trait.name: Enchanted Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the enchanter fails a saving throw against a hostile spell or magical effect, it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, one randomly selected creature charmed by it is freed from the effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The enchanter makes three attacks with its Memory Drain, each of which it may replace with its Word of Command or a use of its Compel Conflict.

action.name: Memory Drain (5th Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) nonlethal psychic damage and the target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the target has its Proficiency Bonus reduced by 1 for the next minute. A creature that has its bonus reduced to 0 in this way loses its memories of the last 24 hours.

action.name: Compel Conlflict (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Two creatures the enchanter can see within 60 feet must each make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, each creature is charmed by the enchanter until the end of the enchanter's next turn and must use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward the other.

If both creatures failed this save, they become hostile to each other for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Word of Command (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the enchanter can see within 60 feet that is charmed by it may use its reaction to move up to its speed and take an Action.

action.name: Power Word
entries: The enchanter speaks a word of power, targeting a creature it can see within 60 feet, then must make a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level or be unable to speak or cast spells until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Burn (5th Level Spell)
entries: The target taks 28 (8d6) fire damage.

items.name: Serve (6th Level Spell)
entries: If the target has fewer than 100 hit points, it is charmed by the enchanter and acts under the enchanter's control. Whenever the creature takes damage, it may make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw, freeing itself on a success.

action.name: Fiendish Shuffle (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each fiend within 60 feet of the conjurer must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the conjurer can see.

reaction.name: Conjure Demon (6th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 79 hit points, the conjurer summons a demon from one of its summoning circles of a maximum CR based on the number of active summoning circles the conjurer has:
1 Summoming Circle: CR 5
2 Summoning Circles: CR 7
3+ Summoning Circles: CR 9

legendary.name: Planar Detritus (1st Level Spell)
entries: The conjurer rains down a mass of planar junk that forms a barrier (10 ft. wide; 5 ft. high; 5 ft. thick) in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet The wall provides partial cover to creatures sheltering behind it, and counts as difficult terrain for creatures climbing over it.

legendary.name: Baleful Transpositon (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the conjurer can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the conjurer can see.

legendary.name: Summoning Circle (7th Level Spell, 4/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The conjurer magically engraves a circle of glyphs on the ground around it that lasts for a minute.

At the end of each of the conjurer's turns, an Abyssal Scavenger that acts on initiative count 0 appears in the circle. If the conjurer has no active summoning circles, each creature summoned through one of them disappears.

trait.name: Liminal Straddle
entries: Whenever the conjurer takes damage, roll a d20. On a 14-20, the conjurer disappears into the ethereal plane, reappearing at the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

trait.name: Essence Warder
entries: Elementals within 30 feet of the conjurer add +1 to their AC and saving throws, and have resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage.

trait.name: Chaos Shutter (3/Day)
entries: If the conjurer fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, each summoned creature under its control is pulled 15 feet towards the nearest Summoning Circle. A creature drawn into the circle in this way is destroyed.

action.name: Acid Dart
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) acid damage.

action.name: Chaos Sphere (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A 5 foot diameter sphere of elemental energy appears in an unoccupied space the conjurer can see within 60 feet and lasts for a minute. The sphere's damage type can be the conjurer's choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning.
A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) damage of the chosen type, or half as much on a success.
As a Bonus Action, the conjurer may move its chaos sphere up to 30 feet and change its damage type to the conjurer's choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning.

action.name: Elemental Shuffle (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each friendly elemental within 60 feet of the conjurer may use its reaction to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the elemental can see.

reaction.name: Conjure Elemental (5th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 79 hit points, the conjurer summons an elemental from one of its summoning circles of a maximum CR based on the number of active summoning circles the conjurer has:
1 Summoming Circle: CR 2
2 Summoning Circles: CR 5
3 Summoning Circles: CR 7

entries: The conjurer rains down a mass of planar junk that forms a barrier (10 ft. wide; 5 ft. high; 5 ft. thick) in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet The wall provides partial cover to creatures sheltering behind it, and counts as difficult terrain for creatures climbing over it.

legendary.name: Baleful Transpositon (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the conjurer can see within 90 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the conjurer can see.

legendary.name: Summoning Circle (7th Level Spell, 3/Day, Costs 2 Actions)

trait.name: Liminal Straddle
entries: Whenever the conjurer takes damage, roll a d20. On a 14-20, the conjurer disappears into the ethereal plane, reappearing at the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

trait.name: Animated Arsenal
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns, the conjurer animates up to two unattended Small objects it can see within 30 feet under its control, to a maximum of four. Each object has a fly speed of 30 ft. and can be attacked (AC 16; 20 hit points).

trait.name: Imbuer's Knack
entries: Objects animated by the conjurer use its statistics for making saving throws, and take no damage on a successful Dexterity saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The conjurer moves each of its animated objects up to 30 feet and makes an animated assault attack with it.

action.name: Animated Assault
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Effects Betrayal (3rd Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the conjurer's choice in a 20 foot radius centered on a point the conjurer can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or suffer one effect of the conjurer's choice.
One object it is wearing or carrying makes an animated assault attack against it.
One object it is wearing or carrying is flung up to 30 feet in a direction of the conjurer's choice.
The creature suffers disadvantage on attack rolls made with one object it is wearing or carrying until the beginning of the conjurer's next turn.

reaction.name: Interposed Object
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack or harmful spell while within 15 feet of one of its animated objects, the conjurer moves the object up to 10 feet towards it and causes the object to become the new target of the attack.

reaction.name: Bloodied Betrayal (3rd Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 46 hit points the arsenalist immediately recharges and uses its Effects Betrayal.

trait.name: Tide of Numbers
entries: When the mob moves, each creature in the mob's space must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be moved with it.

trait.name: Crushing Bodies
entries: A prone creature that starts its turn in the mob's space must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have its movement reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The mob can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the mob can move through any opening large enough for a medium creature. The mob can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Improvised Weapons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (6d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the mob has more than half of its hit points, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Trample
entries: Each prone creature in the mob's space takes 1 bludgeoning damage for each 5 hit points the mob has.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The bone knight scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on attacks made against a creature that is frightened.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bone knight uses its Fearsome Gaze and makes two attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Shake Bones (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its skeleton rattle within its flesh, taking 35 (10d6) points of bludgeoning damage and moving up to 5 feet in a direction of the bone knight's choice on a failure, or take half damage on a success.
An unconscious creature that fails this save dies. At the beginning of its next turn, its skeleton tears itself out of the creature's body, acting on the creature's initiative.

reaction.name: Turn The Living (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 77 hit points, the bone knight forces each living creature within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the bone knight for the next minute. While frightened in this way, a creature must use its action to dash away from the bone knight, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The bone knight scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on attacks made against a creature that is frightened.

trait.name: Master of the Pallid Banner
entries: While within 60 feet of the knight, friendly skeletons and zombies have advantage on attack rolls and on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bone knight uses its Fearsome Gaze and makes two attacks.

action.name: Pike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Grave Command (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Up to four friendly skeletons or zombies within 60 ft. may each use their reaction to make an attack. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Brace
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the bone knight forces the creature to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be unable to move closer to the bone knight this turn.

name: Mageslayer Assassin
languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The asssassin can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: The assassin can take the Dash, Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes two longblade sica attacks.

action.name: Longblade Sica
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage and 28 (8d6) poison damage. Attacks with this weapon ignore any AC benefit granted by a shield.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage and 28 (8d6) poison damage.

action.name: Study Mark
entries: The assassin examines the vulnerabilities of a creature it is hidden from. The assassin's critical range for attacks made against the target increases by 3 for the next minute, to a minimum of 11. As a reaction, the target may attempt a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot the assassin.

action.name: Behead
entries: The assassin removes the head from a corpse within 5 ft. to prevent its resurrection.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by an attacker that it can see, the assassin halves the attack's damage against it.

reaction.name: Spell Denial
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 ft. attempting to cast a spell, the assassin makes a melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the spell fail.

trait.name: Frantic Charge
entries: When the anchorite takes the Dash action, it may make one melee attack as a Bonus Action. If this attack hits,  the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the anchorite can polymorph into a boar or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics are the same in each form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anchorite makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Thunderclaw Gauntlet (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing plus 4 (1d8) thunder damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Tusks (Boar Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. A prone creature takes an additional 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Crackling Animus (Humanoid Form Only, 1/Day, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The anchorite releases a bolt of lightning in a 100 foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
Then, each creature in the area that died since the end of the anchorite's last turn is returned to life with 1 hit point.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance (Boar Form Only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage that would reduce it to 0 hit points, the anchorite makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the anchorite is instead reduced to 1 hit point.
If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Baying Pack
entries: A group of two or more worgs has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

trait.name: Predatory Bearing
entries: A creature that starts its turn with no adjacent allies and that can see the gulvoorg must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Crushing Weight
entries: The gulvoorg may enter the space of a prone creature. A prone creature that starts its turn in the gulvoorg's space must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 5 (1d10) bludgeoning damage and be unable to stand this turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worg makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the gulvoorg can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the gulvoorg.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both the gulvoorg and at least one of the gulvoorg's Large or larger allies must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 49 (14d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Tomb Tainted
entries: If the spider would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes three attacks, one of which may be with its tainted bite.

action.name: Tainted Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the spider's next turn.
If a creature poisoned in this way would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The spider launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by webbing (escape DC 15). The webbing can attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 5).

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The spider uses its webbing to restrain a prone or grappled creature within 5 feet (escape DC 15). If the target is Medium or smaller, the spider may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The mummy can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Tomb Spider Hatchery
entries: When the web mummy's hit points are reduced to 0 by a damage type other than fire or radiant, a Tomb Spider Broodling Swarm emerges in its space.

action.name: Adhesive Grasp (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage and the mummy sticks to the target (escape DC 11). While stuck, the mummy moves with the target, and the target has its movement speed reduced by 10 for each mummy stuck to it.

reaction.name: Broodrage
entries: When the tomb spider that created the mummy is killed, the mummy can a melee attack at advantage. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the mummy dies.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The broodswarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the broodswarm can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The broodswarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The broodswarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the broodswarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Tomb Tainted
entries: If the broodswarm would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing, or 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage if the swarm has fewer than half its hit points.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: When the broodswarm would make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to 10 feet.
If this movement puts the broodswarm out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the broodswarm is unaffected.

trait.name: Lie Dormant
entries: The tomb scarab can go an indefinite period of time without food or water, so long as it has somewhere dry and dark to hibernate.

trait.name: Horrid Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

A creature whose space the swarm enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.  On a success, the creature may use its reaction to move up to half its speed.

action.name: Tunneling Bites
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have 1d4 scarabs tunnel under its flesh. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage per scarab infesting it.

Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills these tomb scarabs. After this time, these tomb scarabs can only be extricated with a DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check, dealing 3 (1d6) points of piercing damage to the afflicted creature as it is removed. Any effect that cures disease destroys all tomb scarabs infesting the target.

trait.name: Lie Dormant
entries: The tomb scarab can go an indefinite period of time without food or water, so long as it has somewhere dry and dark to hibernate.

action.name: Tunneling Bite
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or have the scarab tunnel under its flesh. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage per scarab infesting it.

Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills the tomb scarab. After this time, the tomb scarab can only be extricated with a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check, dealing 3 (1d6) points of piercing damage to the afflicted creature as it is removed. Any effect that cures disease destroys all tomb scarabs infesting the target.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is invisible to the stirge queen. A creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge queen.

trait.name: Weakness-Seeker
entries: The stirge queen has advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Miasmatic Hemorrhaging
entries: A non-stirge creature that has fewer than half its hit points and starts its turn within 30 feet of the stirge queen must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be bleeding (1d4, Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the stirge queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stirge queen makes two attacks with her Pinning Talons.

action.name: Pinning Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the stirge queen may knock the target prone and grapple it (escape DC 15).

action.name: Blood Spear:
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Plague Blood Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The stirge spews forth a torrent of contaminated blood in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 17 (5d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Redding Ague.

reaction.name: Awaken Their Hunger (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 62 hit points, the stirge queen lets out a frantic hypersonic signal.
Each other stirge within 30 feet that can hear her may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Fend Off
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked prone.

legendary.name: Feed Your Queen
entries: The stirge queen consumes one stirge in her reach that has fed in the last minute, killing it and gaining 14 (4d6) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Skull Symbiote
entries: The hive tender's skull is fused with and houses a parasitic monstrosity, which can be targeted with attacks (AC 16, HP 40, vulnerability to fire damage). If the parasite dies, the hive tender dies.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The hive tender's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

action.name: Lunging Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, the hive tender moves up to 5 feet toward the target, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13)

action.name: Needle's Kiss (Recharge 5-6)
entries: If the hive tender's proboscis is extended, it slams its head repeatedly into a creature grappled by it.
The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and be infected with Redding Ague, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Extend Proboscis
entries: A needle-like proboscis extends from the hive tender's mouth until it retracts it as a bonus action.
While extended, attacks against the hive tender's Skull Symbiote are made at advantage, and the hive tender may use its Needle's Kiss, if available.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is invisible to the stirge. A creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The stirge's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

action.name: Pierce Vein
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage and the stirge becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 14).

action.name: Draw Blood
entries: One creature the stirge is Attached to loses 5 hit points, then must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

action.name: Essence Transfusion (Recharges when the stirge uses its Draw Blood)
entries: The stirge revitalizes itself or a creature it is attached to with stored blood, restoring 7 (2d6) hit points.

reaction.name: Pierce Skull
entries: As a reaction when a humanoid creature the stirge is Attached to drops to 0 hit points, the stirge repositions itself, piercing the creature's head and gaining control of its body.
An affected creature is not incapacitated while at 0 hit points, and fails death saving throws automatically.
On each of the affected creature's turns, it moves under the stirge's control and takes the Attack action against a target of the stirge's choice.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is invisible to the stirge. A creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The stirge's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creaature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Pierce Vein (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 piercing damage and the stirge becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 13).

action.name: Draw Blood
entries: One creature the stirge is Attached to loses 2 hit points. Then, if the creature has lost 6 or more hit points in this way this turn, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

trait.name: Lost in the Mob
entries: If the sovereign starts its turn within 10 feet of one or more other skiurids, it becomes hidden from each creature with a Passive Perception lower than 20 until the beginning of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the sovereign is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sovereign makes four attacks with its Shadow Gnaw.

action.name: Shadow Gnaw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage. If the skurid is in dim light or darkness, it may teleport up to 20 feet before or after making this attack.

action.name: Rite of the Nugget-Keeper
entries: One creature the sovereign can see must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) necrotic damage for each sciurid scurrier within 5 feet of it, plus 10 (4d4) necrotic damage for each skiurrid swarm within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Echoing Chitter
entries: The sovereign fills the air with sourceless, menacing chittering and red eyes gleam from every shadow. Each creature of the sovereign's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Skittering Shadows
entries: As a reaction when a creature the skiurid can see makes an attack of opportunity, the skiurid forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or instead make an attack against a creature of the skiurid's choice.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature.

trait.name: Umbral Aura
entries: Nonmagical lights and lights produced by spells of 2nd level or below within 30 feet of the swarm produce only dim light, and the light they produce extends no further than 15 feet form its source.

trait.name: Skittish
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the swarm that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

action.name: Strip Flesh
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 30 (12d4) piercing damage, or 15 (6d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Skeletonize
entries: One creature with 0 hit points in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or die and have its flesh stripped away, leaving only a skeleton.
On a successful save, the creature fails one death save.

reaction.name: Shadow Scamper
entries: As a reaction when the swarm takes damage while in dim light or darkness, it teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Zig-Zag
entries: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the skiurid, it may move up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Skittish
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the skiurid that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

action.name: Shadow Gnaw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the skurid is in dim light or darkness, it may teleport up to 20 feet before or after making this attack.

action.name: Scolding Alarm
entries: The skiurid chirps forth a complex alarm signal. Each creature that the squirrel can see ceases to be hidden from any creature that can hear the squirrel.

action.name: Apocrine Shadowglyph (1/Day)
entries: The skiurid rubs its cheeks on a surface, magically leaving a faintly visible mark upon it. Nonmagical lights and lights produced by spells of 2nd level or below within 30 feet of this glyph produce only dim light, and the light they produce extends no further than 15 feet form its source.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the sharktopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The sharktopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Deception (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

trait.name: Test Bite
entries: If the sharktopus starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may Dash or Disengage as a bonus action this turn.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The sharktopus has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sharktopus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace one attack with a use of its Fling.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose 5 (2d4) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

action.name: Fling
entries: Each creature grappled by the sharktopus is thrown up to 30 feet. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

action.name: Blanket (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. radius sphere must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 17) and pulled up to 5 ft. toward the sharktopus. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. A creature without a swim speed makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Circle
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 64 hit points, the sharktopus moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. Each creature of its choice within 50 ft. that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 87 hit points while underwater, the sharktopus exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the sharktopus can use the Dash or Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Dust Drinker
entries: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature within 1 mile that has been damaged by the antennae of it or another rust monster annihilator. A creature may shed this scent only by means of a Regenerate spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Annihilating Wake
entries: The rust monster can burrow through any nonmagical, nonliving material at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Disintigrating Touch
entries: Any nonmagical weapon that hits the rust monster disintigrates after dealing damage. A creature that hits the rust monster with an unarmed attack must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (1d10) force damage.

trait.name: Clinging Dust Armor
entries: Whenever the rust monster uses its Shed Detritus ability, its AC decreases by 1 to a minimum of 15. Whenever the rust monster hits a creature or object with its annihilating antennae its AC increases by 1 to a maximum of 20.
If the rust monster takes any lightning damage, its AC is reduced to 15.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The rust monster has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rust monster makes two attacks with its annihilating antennae, one of which it may replace with a use of its Disrupt Magic, if available.

action.name: Annihilating Antennae
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target creature, object, or construct of magical force. Hit: 36 (6d10 + 3) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage disintigrates.

A nonmagical object or construct of magical force hit with this attack disintigrates. If the target is a nonmagical object that is worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.

action.name: Disrupt Magic (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The rust monster temporarily disrupts the magic of a nonartifact magic item within 5 feet. For the next minute, the item's magic is suppressed, and the item behaves as if it were nonmagical.

reaction.name: Shed Detritus
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the rust monster shakes loose the dust that clings to it. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the rust monster's next turn.

trait.name: Iron Scent
entries: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 60 feet of it.

trait.name: Rust Metal
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

trait.name: Oxide Armor
entries: Whenever the Rust Monster takes any acid or lightning damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the end of its next turn. Whenever the Rust Monster takes any fire damage, its AC is improved by 2 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rust monster uses its antennae once and makes two attacks with its bite. It may use its disrupt magic ability in place of its antennae.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Antennae
entries: The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.

If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

action.name: Disrupt Magic (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The rust monster temporarily disrupts the magic of a nonartifact magic item within 5 feet. For the next minute, the item's magic is suppressed, and the item behaves as if it were nonmagical.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Mesmeric Display
entries: A creature that can see the roper has disadvantage on  Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive anything other than the roper, and on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to perceive hostile intent in the roper if it has not yet attacked.

trait.name: Dweomer Scintilation
entries: Whenever the roper makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that does not deal damage, each creature within 30 ft. that can see the roper must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of the roper's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roper makes six attacks and uses its vision drain.

action.name: Mindlink Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. Hit: Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) poison plus 5 (1d10) psychic damage. A medium or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 15) and can hear the surface thoughts of each other creature grappled by the roper.
Whenever a grappled creature casts a spell, each other creature grappled by the roper takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Vision Drain
entries: Each creature grappled by the roper must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the range of its Darkvision reduced by 15 ft. until it completes a Long Rest.
A creature without Darkvision is instead blinded while in Dim Light until it completes a Long Rest.

action.name: Nervebore Jolt (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature grappled by the roper must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 35 (10d6) piercing plus 35 (10d6) psychic damage, or half the piercing and none of the psychic damage on a success.

reaction.name: Ichor Spray
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, the roper releases a spray of ichor that flares with incandescence for an instant. The attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the roper's next turn.

name: Storoper
resist: piercing damage from nonmagical ranged attacks

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the storoper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: The storoper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the storoper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The storoper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The storoper makes six attacks, up to one of which may be with its stonetooth bite, and uses its whipping reel, if available.

action.name: Stonetooth Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) piercing damage. This attack is made with advantage against a grappled creature.

action.name: Numbing Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target subtracts 1d6 from its Dexterity score for each tendril attached to it. A creature reduced to 0 Dexterity in this way is paralyzed and has its skin take on a stony grey pallor until it is freed.

action.name: Wrench
entries: One creature grappled by at least two tendrils must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapples.

action.name: Whipping Reel (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature grappled by the storoper must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be moved up to 30 ft. in a direction of the storoper's choice, or take half as much damage on a success

name: Peryton Nog Hind
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: Common and Elvish but can't speak except with its Thought Mimicry trait

trait.name: Brutal Dive
entries: If the peryton is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee attack, the attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Thought Mimicry
entries: The peryton can speak the current surface thoughts of any creature whose heart it carries, using that creature's voice. It cannot otherwise read thoughts.

trait.name: Shadow Scent
entries: The peryton knows the direction and distance to each creature on the same plane of existence that has been affected by its Shadow Mark.

trait.name: Hidden Hearts (3/Day)
entries: Tucked beneath the peryton's feathers are several still-beating hearts stolen from living creatures. If the peryton fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to have a creature whose heart it carries affected in its stead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The peryton makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Gory Bite, and uses its Ironbeam Antler Rush, if available.

action.name: Shadowtaker Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
A humanoid creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is cursed. A creature cursed in this way casts no shadow or reflection.

action.name: Vicious Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Ironbeam  Antler Rush (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The peryton lunges up to 15 feet directly towards a creature within 20 feet with antlers lowered, forcing it to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 16 (3d10) piercing damage, is pushed up to 15 feet away, and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Collect Heart
entries: The peryton magically and nonlethally scoops the heart from the chest of an unconscious creature within 5 feet of it, regaining a use of its Hidden Hearts ability and leaving a ragged yet bloodless void in the creature's chest.

A creature with its heart removed in this way cannot gain class levels until its heart is returned or replaced, and dies if its heart is destroyed. While a creature has its heart replaced with that of another creature, it uses that creature's class levels, rather than its own.

bonus.name: Shrill Scream
entries: The peryton lets out a mocking, melodramatic scream, imitating an injured humanoid.
Each frightened creature within 30 feet that can hear it must use its reaction to move half its speed away from the peryton.

bonus.name: Wingbeat Gust
entries: The peryton beats its wings mightily, kicking up a powerful wind in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away.

reaction.name: Shadow Mark
entries: As a reaction when the peryton flies directly over a humanoid creature it can see, it changes its shadow to mimic that creature's shadow.
A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of a peryton mimicking its shadow in this way must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Thunderous Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 93 hit points, the peryton lets out a thunderous screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it must must succeed on a DC 16 Constitiution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) thunder damage, or half as much damage on a success.
If a creature that fails this save misses with an attack on its following turn, it immediately falls prone.

languages: understands Common and Elvish but can't speak

trait.name: Shadow Scent

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Gory Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
A humanoid creature killed by this attack has its heart torn out and devoured.

action.name: Vicious Talons

On a critical hit, the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Ironbeam  Antlers

reaction.name: Shadow Mark
entries: As a reaction when the peryton flies directly over a humanoid creature it can see, it changes its shadow to mimic that creature's shadow.
A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of a peryton mimicking its shadow in this way must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shed Velvet
entries: If the peryton eats the heart of a humanoid creature, the velvet covering its antlers splits and begins to peel, and the peryton becomes a Peryton Heart-Plucker, retaining its current hit points.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Talon Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Velveted Skittishness
entries: As a reaction when the peryton is hit with a melee attack, it flies up to 15 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

reaction.name: Pluck Heart
entries: As a reaction when the peryton scores a critical hit with its Gory Bite, it makes another Gory Bite attack against the same target.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Bad Flier
entries: The owlbear falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

trait.name: Concussive Strength

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Beak

action.name: Windclaws

action.name: Meteor Drop (Recharge 5-6)

On a success, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space and takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Wind Howl

trait.name: Web Walker

A creature wearing metal armor that ends its turn restrained by the webbing takes 11 (2d10) fire damage and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC its armor offers. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 10; vulnerability to cold damage).

entries: When a creature that can see the gorgon's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the gorgon, the gorgon can force it to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be restrained. The restrained creature repeats this saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on a success, or becoming petrified on a failure. The gorgon is not immune to its own gaze.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the initial saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the gorgon until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Curative Blood
entries: The gorgon's blood, for 24 hours after its death, can be applied to the lips of a petrified creature to remove the petrified condition.

trait.name: Hidden Killer

name: Malukant
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: piercing damage from nonmagical ranged attacks

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the malukant may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the malukant's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the malukant's legs to its back, or from its back to its head.

items.name: Legs
entries: While climbing on the malukant's legs, a creature has advantage on attacks against it. If the malukant moves at least 20 ft. on its turn, each creature climbing on its legs must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or fall off.

items.name: Back
entries: While climbing on the malukant's back, the malukant cannot target the creature with melee attacks.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the malukant's head, the creature has advantage on melee attacks against the malukant and the malukant cannot target the creature with melee attacks.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: The malukant may move through the space of a Huge or smaller creature without penalty. When the elephant enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Howdah
entries: The malukant carries a mobile fortress on its back. Up to eight Medium or smaller creatures can ride the malukant. Creatures riding the malukant have three-quarters cover against attacks made from the ground.

trait.name: Spear Maddened
entries: Weapon attacks against the malukant with the Reach property are made at advantage. Whenever the malukant takes damage from a spear, glaive, pike, or similar long, bladed weapon, it must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the malukant attacks the nearest creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The malukant makes two attacks; one with its bladed tusks and one with its stomp.

action.name: Bladed Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 34 (6d8 + 7) slashing damage and the target is pushed 15 ft. away and knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 16 (3d10) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Tusk Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 34 (6d8 + 7) slashing damage, be pushed 15 ft. away and knocked prone, or take half as much damage and be knocked prone on a success. A creature that succeeds by 5 or more takes no damage and can climb onto the malukant's head as a reaction.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 136 HP, the malukant thrashes. Each creature riding or climbing on it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone in an unoccupied space adjacent to the malukant.

name: Venerable Lock Lurker
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ethereal Body
entries: The vast majority of the lock lurker's body, including its stinger and vital organs, extends into the ethereal plane, it is normally hidden. A creature that can see invisible creatures, or one that can see into the etheral plane, can see the full creature. Only a Tiny portion of it extends into the material plane.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the lock lurker's legs are folded in, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary coin.

trait.name: Creeping Vermin
entries: The lock lurker can enter the space of any small or larger creature and climb onto it with the portion of itself that extends into the material plane. While doing so, the lock lurker moves with the creature.

action.name: Abductor Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be teleported into the lock lurker's stomach in the ethereal plane.

A living creature in the lock lurker's stomach is incapacitated and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, returning to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space on a success, or taking 28 (8d6) acid damage on a failure.

action.name: Hidden Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute. A poisoned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or being paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn on a failure.
This attack is made at advantage against any creature that cannot see the stinger.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the lock lurker moves up to 10 ft. If this movement puts the lock lurker out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the lock lurker is unaffected.
