A poisoned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or being paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn on a failure.
This attack is made at advantage against any creature that cannot see the stinger.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the lock lurker moves up to 5 ft. If this movement puts the lock lurker out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the lock lurker is unaffected.

trait.name: Shapechanging Mimic
entries: As a bonus action, the leucrotta can Polymorph into any Medium or Large beast, or back to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form.
It can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Man-Taker
entries: A creature that mounts the leucrotta must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the leucrotta for as long as it is mounted, and the leucrotta can't target the creature with attacks. While charmed, a creature is unable to voluntarily dismount.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the leucrotta reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the leucrotta can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Hit-and-Run
entries: If the leucrotta ends its turn more than 30 ft. from any hostile creature, it may take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leucrotta makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its hooves.

action.name: Jagged Steel Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer a bleeding wound. At the beginning of each of its turns, a bleeding creature loses 5 (2d4) hit points, then repeats this saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the creature can't make attacks of opportunity this turn.

action.name: Buck
entries: The leucrotta throws a creature that is mounting it from its back, knocking it prone. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the leucrotta's next turn.

reaction.name: Disquieting Cackle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the leucrotta moves up to 20 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the leucrotta this turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lilim can take on the illusory appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid.

trait.name: Scornful Gaze
entries: If a creature makes eye contact with the lilim, the lilim learns, in broad terms, the creature's greatest doubts, fears, and insecurities.

trait.name: Light-Blinded
entries: If the lilim takes radiant damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Sinnuous Escape
entries: When the lilim is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a source it cannot see while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

trait.name: Beguiling Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lilim fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, each creature affected by its Beguiling touch regains half of its lost Wisdom, rounded up.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lilim makes two attacks, one of which may be with its barbed tongue.

action.name: Draining Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19).

action.name: Barbed Tongue
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage and the target is magically Cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Plague Chant (6th Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. Hit 28 (8d6) necrotic damage. If this attack hits, the plague chant leaps to another creature within 15 feet of the previous target. The lilim makes a new attack roll against the new target, which could cause this ability to leap again. Each creature can be targeted no more than once with each casting of this spell.

action.name: Torment of Scarabs (7th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lilim sends forth a wave of flesh eating scarabs in a 30 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 45 (10d8) piercing damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature with 0 hit points that fails this saving throw is reduced to bones.

reaction.name: Torn Loyalty
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or attack, the lilim may force a creature within 5 feet that is cursed by it to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes the new target of the spell or attack.

reaction.name: Claim Thrall
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 128 hit points, the lilim uses her Entrancing Sigh ability. A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more remains under her control for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Life Drain
entries: One creature grappled by the lilim must succeed on a DC 17 Constitutiton saving throw or be forced to expend a hit die. If the creature does, the lilim gains 8 (1d8 + 4) temporary hit points. If it cannot, the creature instead drops to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Passing Grasp
entries: The lilim moves up to half its speed and makes an attack with its draining claws.

legendary.name: Beguiling Touch
entries: One creature the lilim can see within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 3 (1d6) until it completes a Short or Long rest, to a minimum of 1.

legendary.name: Entrancing Sigh (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature the lilim can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the lilim until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more additionally follows the lilim's verbal directions until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: Shapechanger. As a Bonus Action, the lamia can take on the illusory appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lamia makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Constrict, and uses its beguiling touch or its compel ability.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).
A creature grappled in this way is restrained and takes 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and the lamia can't constrict another target.

action.name: Cursewright Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is magically Cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all Ability Checks.

action.name: Beguiling Touch
entries: One creature the lamia can see within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 3 (1d6) until it completes a Short or Long rest, to a minimum of 1.
A creature that has its wisdom score reduced to 1 with this ability is charmed by the lamia.

action.name: Compel
entries: One creature charmed by the lamia must use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a single weapon attack.

reaction.name: Torn Loyalty
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or attack, the lamia may force a creature within 5 feet that is cursed by it to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes the new target of the spell or attack.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lamia can take on the illusory appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lamia makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its beguiling touch.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Cursewright Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is magically Cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all Ability Checks.

action.name: Beguiling Touch
entries: One creature the lamia can see within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 3 (1d6) until it completes a Short or Long rest, to a minimum of 1.
A creature that has its wisdom score reduced to 1 with this ability is charmed by the lamia.

reaction.name: Torn Loyalty
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or attack, the lamia may force a creature within 5 feet that is cursed by it to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes the new target of the spell or attack.

trait.name: Ferocious Opportunist
entries: The krenshar may use its Multiattack when making Attacks of Opportunity.

trait.name: Tempered Skull
entries: While its skull is exposed and it is within 5 feet of only a single hostile creature, the krenshar has resistance to piercing and slashing damage dealt by that creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The krenshar makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its throat-ripper bite.

action.name: Throat-Ripper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).
If the target was already grappled by the krenshar, it takes an additional 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Gnaw to the Bone (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature that is both prone and grappled by the krenshar must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) piercing damage and have its speed reduced by half until it completes a Short or Long Rest, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Retract Face
entries: The krenshar peels back its face, revealing the musculature and hardened bone beneath for the next minute.
Each creature within 5 feet of the krenshar must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the krenshar.

bonus.name: Unnerving Yowl
entries: Until the beginning of the krenshar's next turn, creatures within 30 feet that can hear it have disadvantage on saving throws against any other krenshar's Retract Face ability.

trait.name: Ferocious Opportunist
entries: The krenshar may use its Multiattack when making Attacks of Opportunity.

trait.name: Tempered Skull
entries: While its skull is exposed and it is within 5 feet of only a single hostile creature, the krenshar has resistance to piercing and slashing damage dealt by that creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The krenshar makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its throat-ripper bite.

action.name: Throat-Ripper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
If the target was already grappled by the krenshar, it takes an additional 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

bonus.name: Retract Face
entries: The krenshar peels back its face, revealing the musculature and hardened bone beneath for the next minute.
Each creature within 5 feet of the krenshar must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the krenshar.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Snapping Throng (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.
On a hit or miss, the target may move up to 5 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity from krenshar harriers.

bonus.name: Retract Face
entries: The krenshar peels back its face, revealing the musculature and hardened bone beneath for the next minute.
One creature within 5 feet of the krenshar must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the krenshar.

name: Astral Kraken
immune: damage from attacks made without advantage
languages: telepathy (can communicate with any creature on the same plane of existence)

trait.name: Tentacles from Beyond
entries: Each creature that the kraken can see is treated as within its reach as space stretches and warps before its attacks.

trait.name: Incomprehensible Horror
entries: A creature that can see the kraken and is not afflicted with any sort of madness or reduction to its Wisdom score is frightened.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Madness Titan
entries: When the kraken is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, the kraken chews a hole through reality and teleports to the far realm at the beginning of its following turn.
A creature that starts its turn within 500 feet of this screaming wound in space must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to make a melee attack against itself or its ship.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes three attacks with its Tentacle Lash and uses its Absorb Psyche.

action.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage, and if the kraken is within 30 feet of the target, the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 26).

action.name: Absorb Psyche
entries: Each creature grappled by the kraken must succeed on a DC 23 Charisma saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Long Rest.
A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way is charmed by the kraken and hostile to all other creatures, though it endeavors to conceal this fact if possible.

action.name: Blot Out the Stars (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The kraken warps space, twisting until the kraken entirely envelops a 100 foot radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 50 feet, surrounding it in a blanket of black eyes and roiling flesh.

A creature in the sphere cannot leave by any means short of a Wish, its attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances, and it takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must succeed on a DC 23 Charisma saving throw or have its mind lost to the Far Realm until restored by a Wish or equivalent magic.

legendary.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: The kraken makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash.

legendary.name: Whelming Pulse
entries: The kraken sends a wave of pure force out in each direction. Each creature within 60 feet takes 16 (3d10) force damage and must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

legendary.name: Unbearable Lucidity
entries: One creature the kraken can see within 100 feet has any reduction to its Wisdom score end, and takes 5 psychic damage for each point of Wisdom restored to it in this way.

legendary.name: Black Gaze of Madness (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature the kraken can see within 100 feet that has a reduction to its Wisdom score must use its reaction to make a melee attack against itself.

name: Kraken (Underwater)
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kraken can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: While the kraken remains motionless,  it is indistinguishable from natural terrain to observers more than 30 feet away.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The kraken can move through a space as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Eternal Titan
entries: When the kraken is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it cannot take actions other than to dash unless it is in its lair.
While at 0 hit points and in its lair, it can killed by collapsing its lair with an Earthquake spell or equivalent magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes three attacks with its Tentacle Lash, each of which it can replace a use of its Fling, and attacks once with its Cavernous Maw.

action.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 25).

action.name: Fling
entries: The kraken flings an object or creature grappled by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled.
A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

action.name: Cavernous Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage and the target is swallowed.
While swallowed, the creature is blinded, its attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances, and it takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns.
If it takes 50 damage or more in a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

action.name: Tentacle Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 30 foot radius around the kraken must succed on a DC 25 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 91 (26d6) bludgeoning damage and be shoved 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Tentacle Lash or Fling
entries: The kraken makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash or uses its Fling.

legendary.name: Blanket
entries: Each creature within 50 feet of the kraken must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled by one of its tentacles.

legendary.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The kraken expels a cloud of toxic ink, heavily obscuring the area in a 60-foot radius centered on itself until the end of its next turn.
Each other creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Kraken (From Surface)
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kraken can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Tentacles
entries: The kraken has 10 tentacles, each of which behaves as a seperate creature that acts on the kraken's initiative and have the following properties:

items.name: Length
entries: Each tentacle is 100 feet long.

items.name: Hit Points
entries: Each tentacle has AC 18 and 75 hit points. When reduced to 0 hit points, the tentacle drops anything it is grappling and retreats to the kraken's body.

items.name: Resistances and Immunities
entries: Each tentacle has Immunity to Lightning damage and Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From nonmagical sources

items.name: Movement
entries: Each tentacle has a speed of 15 feet.

items.name: Senses
entries: Each tentacle has blindsight 5 ft. (blind beyond that radius).

items.name: Grappling
entries: The tentacle may grapple one creature or object each turn (escape DC 18). A creature may make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw to avoid this grapple. A tentacle may grapple multiple creatures or objects. If the tentacle crosses the full deck of a ship or encounters a mast, it may grapple the ship.

items.name: Fling
entries: The tentacle flings an object or creature grappled by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled.
A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Eternal Titan
entries: When the kraken is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it cannot take actions other than to dash unless it is in its lair. While at 0 HP and in its lair, it can killed by collapsing its lair with an Earthquake spell or equivalent magic.

action.name: Surface
entries: The kraken surfaces, creating an enormous tidal wave. Each creature without cover must make a DC 18 Dexterity save or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and be pushed overboard.
A creature that is not surprised may use its reaction to clutch onto something sturdy and gain advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Clutch
entries: The kraken grips a ship, reducing its movement to 0. While it has a ship clutched in this way, it is has full cover from creatures on the ship.

action.name: Crush
entries: Each creature and object the kraken's tentacles have grappled takes 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A ship grappled by two or more tentacles must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw (a typical sailing ship has +3 to this roll) or begin to split.

action.name: Capsize
entries: The kraken capsizes a ship that has begun to split. Each creature on board or grappled by the tentacles must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the kraken's mouth and be swallowed as the ship is ripped apart.

action.name: Submerge
entries: The kraken descends up to 60 feet, leaving a massive whirlpool in its wake that lasts for a minute, 250 feet wide and 25 feet deep.

A creature or object that starts its turn in the vortex must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 feet towards the vortex's center, take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage, and be unable to move away from the vortex's center until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Lightning Storm
entries: The kraken magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target the kraken can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Tentacle
entries: One of the kraken's tentacles attempts to grapple a creature or object, or flings a creature or object it is grappling.

legendary.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The kraken uses its Lightning Storm.

legendary.name: Shipbreaker (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The kraken uses its Clutch or Crush, if available.

name: Polar Kraken
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kraken can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Transparent
entries: If the kraken has not eaten in the last week, it is invisible to creatures more than 30 feet away from it, and can attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Freezing Grip
entries: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the kraken loses two unexpended hit dice. If it cannot, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the beginnning of its next turn.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The kraken can move through a space as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing, and its movement is not hindered by its Razor Lattice.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes three attacks with its Tentacle Lash, each of which it can replace a use of its Fling.

action.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 18).

action.name: Fling
entries: The kraken flings an object or creature grappled by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled.
A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

action.name: Cavernous Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing plus 9 (2d8) cold damage and the target is swallowed.
While swallowed, the creature's attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances and it takes 21 (6d6) cold damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns.
If it takes 40 damage or more in a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

action.name: Razor Lattice (6th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The kraken freezes the water in a 30 foot radius centered on a point it can see into an open latice of razor-sharp crystals, which last for a minute. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature pushed or flung into or through it takes an additional 10 (3d6) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Freeze Breath (2nd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature the kraken can see within 60 feet attempts to cast a spell, the kraken forces the creature to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature must use a spell slot of one level higher to cast the spell, or have the spell fail.

legendary.name: Tentacle Lash or Fling
entries: The kraken makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash or uses its Fling.

legendary.name: Glacier Shard (4th Level Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The kraken conjures a 10 foot radius shard of ice at a point it can see within 120 feet, which rockets to the surface, moving 15 feet toward the surface at the beginning of each creature's turn.

Whenever it moves, each creature whose space it enters must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet toward the surface, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

legendary.name: Shatter Lattice (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The kraken shatters the matrix of crystals created by its razor lattice. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (4d6) slashing plus 18 (4d8) cold damage, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Polukranos, World Eater
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: Polukranos has five heads. Whenever Polukranos takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, Polukranos dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, Polukranos has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, Polukranos makes a DC 17 Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head Polukranos has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Polukranos may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 21 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Polukranos. While climbing on Polukranos, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Shed Head
entries: When Polukranos fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

trait.name: Escape from the Underworld (Mythic Trait; 1/Day)
entries: If Polukranos is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 198 hit points, its creature type becomes undead, and any creature hit with an attack by Polukranos must expend two unexpended hit dice or else take an additional 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Polukranos makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d12 + 8) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 21) and pulled up to 10 ft. towards Polukranos. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: Polukranos makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

While swallowed, the creature is blinded and grappled (escape DC 21) in Polukranos's craw, its attacks bypass Polukranos' damage resistances, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Polukranos, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of Polukranos's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever Polukranos loses a head.
Polukranos can take three legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendary.name: Trampling Charge
entries: Polukranos moves up to half its speed. Creatures in its path must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or fall prone. On a success, the creature may use its reaction to move up to 10 ft. to an unoccupied space out of Polukranos' path.

legendary.name: Eat Head
entries: Polukranos eats one of its shed heads, gaining 10 temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, it has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

legendary.name: Worry (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature grappled by at least two of Polukranos' heads must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution throw or take 55 (10d10) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more of Polukranos' heads. A creature killed by this damage is ripped into pieces.

mythic.name: Unchained (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, whenever Polukranos is hit with an attack by a creature within its reach, it may move up to 10 ft. and make an attack as a reaction.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has four heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, the hydra has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, the hydra makes a DC 14 Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning of its last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a use of its swallow, or three bite attacks with a use of its worry ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (1d10 + 6) piercing plus 9 (2d8) acid damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Flaming Acid Spit
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) acid damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

entries: As a reaction when the hydra fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the hydra may choose to succeed. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

reaction.name: Flaming Acid Bloodspurt
entries: As a reaction to losing a head to a melee attack, the hydra forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) acid plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the harpy is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19 or 20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes three attacks.

action.name: Grasping Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Pinion Quarrel
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Flocking Song (concentration)
entries: The harpy sings a magical melody, choosing one of the following effects. The harpy may continue the song as a Bonus Action on each of its turns, and may choose a new effect when it does:

items.name: Murmuration
entries: Each friendly harpy within 120 ft. moves 10 ft. toward the harpy queen. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

items.name: Mobbing
entries: The harpy queen chooses a creature she can see within 120 ft. Each friendly harpy has advantage on attacks that target that creature.

items.name: Rattle
entries: Attacks that target the harpy queen have disadvantage until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Subsong
entries: Each friendly harpy within 120 ft. may Disengage as a Bonus Action on its following turn.

action.name: Thunderous Screech (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) thunder damage and be deafened until the end of the harpy's next turn. If the harpy was singing, it stops.

reaction.name: Dash Upon the Rocks
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a creature it has grappled while flying, the harpy folds its wings and falls up to 500 feet.

If it ends this drop on a solid surface, the grappled creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the harpy takes no damage from falling, and the grappled creature takes twice as much.
If it ends this drop in water, the grappled creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be unable to hold its breath.

reaction.name: Take Flight
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the harpy moves up to half its fly speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

reaction.name: Jink
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack while at least 10 feet in the air, the harpy may halve the attack's damage.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the siren is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19 or 20.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The siren can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The siren makes two attacks with its grasping claws.

action.name: Grasping Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Siren Song (Concentration)
entries: The siren begins to sing a magical melody. When a creature that can hear the song starts its turn within 120 feet of the harpy, the harpy can force it to succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the siren until the end of the siren's next turn and suffer one additional effect of the siren's choice. The harpy may continue the song as a Bonus Action on each of its turns, and may choose a new effect when it does.

items.name: Alluring
entries: The target must use its turn to Dash toward the siren by the most direct route.

items.name: Longing
entries: At the end of the target's next turn, it takes 3 (1d6) nonlethal psychic damage for each 10 ft. away from the siren that it is.

items.name: Melancholic
entries: The target's movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Dirgeful
entries: The target has disadvantage on Death saving throws it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Thunderous Screech (Recharge 5-6)

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: The harpy may choose not to be slowed by carrying a medium or smaller creature on its turn. If it does, it releases its grapple at the end of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes two attacks with its wrenching claws.

action.name: Wrenching Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and cannot stand on its following turn.

action.name: Deadly Screech (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The harpy lets out a dreadful screech. Each creature of the harpy's choice that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly toward the nearest hazardous terrain it can see, or away from the harpy if it can't see any hazardous terrain.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The gulon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the gulon cannot stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Opportunistic Feeder
entries: The gulon scores a critical on a 16-20 against a prone creature.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The gulon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gulon makes one attack with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Ravenous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the gulon gains 25 temporary HP. While it has this temporary HP, its speed is 15 ft. and it can't use its Multiattack.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Disgorge
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success. If the gulon had any temporary hit points, it loses them and this ability does an additional 14 (4d6) poison damage to a creature that fails its save.

name: Brazen Bull
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the bull can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is stunned until the beginning of the bull's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bull makes two attacks, one of which may be with its searing gore, and uses its Brazen Blossom, if available.

action.name: Searing Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Carp's Tongue Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
The bull may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a prone creature.

action.name: Thrashing Horns
entries: Two creatures on opposite sides of the bull must each succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 32 (5d12) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Brazen Blossom (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The plates of the bull's armored flesh unfold and part, revealing its fiery core, reducing its AC to 10, and giving it vulnerability to cold damage until it uses its Abductor Grasp.

reaction.name: Abductor Grasp
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 40 feet hits it with an attack while its Brazen Blossom is active, the bull moves up to its speed toward the creature. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be dragged into and restrained within the bull (escape DC 18).
A creature restrained within the bull takes 11 (2d10) fire damage at the end of each of its turns. Whenever the bull takes cold damage, a sealed creature may attempt to escape as a reaction.

reaction.name: Snort Flame
entries: As a reaction when the bull succeeds on a saving throw, it snorts flame in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed ona DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Thunderous Charge
entries: If the bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target and each Medium or smaller creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the bull can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gorgon makes two attacks with its Skycrusher Hooves, one of which it may replace with a use of its Charged Gore or Thrashing Horns.

action.name: Charged Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Skycrusher Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) thunder damage.

entries: Two creatures on opposite sides of the bull must each succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 19 (3d12) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Storming Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bull exhales billowing clouds that crackle with thunder and lightning in a 30-foot cone, heavily obsucring the area until the start of its next turn.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take  21 (6d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

entries: If the bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

A petrified target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or shatter.

action.name: White-Iron Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
The bull may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a prone creature.

action.name: Thrashing Horns
entries: Two creatures on opposite sides of the bull must each succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 19 (3d12) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bull exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained until the end of the bull' next turn.

A creature that fails this save by 5 or more must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on a success. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the Greater Restoration spell or other similar magic.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Shock Susceptibility
entries: If the froghemoth takes lightning damage, it suffers several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity saving throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both.

trait.name: Toxic Secretions
entries: A creature that makes an attack that benefits from flanking the froghemoth must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or suffer 7 (2d6) poison damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the froghemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The froghemoth makes two attacks with its tentacles and one with its bite. It can replace its bite with a use of its Tongue or Lob Mucous

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns. The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth. If the froghemoth dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tongue
entries: The froghemoth targets one Medium or smaller creature that it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth, and the froghemoth can make a bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Lob Mucous
entries: The froghemoth expels a large glob of mucous, covering a 20-foot radius area within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity saving throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. A creature in the froghemoth's gullet when it uses this ability may attempt a DC 16 Athletics or Acrobatics check. On a success, the creature is launched out with mucous and must immediately save against it.

reaction.name: Legendary Reactions
entries: The froghemoth may make a legendary reaction whenever its conditions are met, without using its reaction.

reaction.name: Fling
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a grappled creature, the froghemoth may throw the creature up to 40 feet away. The creature must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Reel
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a grappled creature, the froghemoth may pull the creature up to 20 feet straight towards it.

reaction.name: Slam
entries: As a reaction to a creature casting a spell that targets the froghemoth, the froghemoth may lift the creature and slam it into the ground. The creature must make a DC 17 constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. If the creature was concentrating on a spell, it makes its save to maintain concentration at disadvantage.

trait.name: Spiderkind
entries: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Trapdoor
entries: Over the course of an hour, the ettercap can construct a trapdoor of web and debris that makes an opening up to 10 feet across indistinguishable from natural terrain.

trait.name: Spider Trainer
entries: Whenever a friendly spider within 30 feet makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with either its Bite or Silken Noose, if available.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage to a surprised creature.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Silken Noose (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing (escape DC 12). While restrained in this way, the ettercap may drag the restrained creature 15 feet toward it at the beginning of each of the ettercap's turns.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: Attack rolls the doppelganger makes with advantage deal an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

trait.name: Mind Reader
entries: The doppelganger can magically read the surface thoughts of  creatures within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The doppelganger makes two slam attacks and uses its perfect replica ability.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Perfect Replica
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the doppelganger must make a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is stunned until the end of the doppelganger's next turn, and the doppleganger takes on its appearance. While the doppelganger is adjacent to a stunned creature whose appearance it is mimicking, attack rolls directed at it have a 50% chance of hitting the copied creature instead. A creature that fails this save becomes immune to the effect for 24 hours.

action.name: Cloud Mind (concentration)
entries: The doppelganger becomes invisible to creatures within 15 feet of it for the next hour, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

reaction.name: Uncanny Mimicry
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature taking an action, the doppleganger may memorize that action. On its next turn, it may take that action. If the action included a weapon, the doppleganger grows an appendage to mimic it. If the action was to cast a spell, the doppleganger can cast it innately without a spell slot, using the mimicked creature's attack bonus and save DC.

trait.name: Canopy Stalker
entries: The displacer beast has advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

trait.name: Teleportation Weakness
entries: The displacer beast takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Displacement
entries:
While the displacer beast is not grappled or incapacitated and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects:
  • Attacks against it are made at disadvantage.
  • When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the displacer beast treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The displacer beast makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

action.name: Spinal Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Any hit with this attack against a target that is both prone and grappled is a critical hit.

action.name: Hexapod Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
A prone target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Tendril Pads
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: If the displacer beast is in dim light or darkness, it attempts to Hide.

bonus.name: Lithe Pounce
entries: The displacer beast leaps up to 15 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Slinking Retreat
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the displacer beast, the displacer beast moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Feline Fluidity
entries: The displacer beast can squeeze through any space larger than its skull.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the displacer beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries: The displacer beast makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

Any hit with this attack against a target that is both prone and grappled is a critical hit.

action.name: Hexapod Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
A prone target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Tendril Pads
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or have one melee weapon it is wielding wrenched from its grasp.
If the displacer beast is wielding weapons in both its tentacles, it can't use this attack.

action.name: Displacement Expansion (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: The displacer beast's eyes flash with green light as it warps the light around it, creating several shifting, warped duplicates of each creature and object in the area.
For the next minute, creatures within 30 feet of the displacer beast that rely on sight have disadvantage on checks and saving throws that use Wisdom.
A creature that attempts to move into or through the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

bonus.name: Stolen Weapon
entries: The displacer beast makes an attack with a stolen weapon wielded in its tentacles, using the weapon's statistics (+9 to hit, +4 to damage).

bonus.name: Terrorize
entries: The displacer beast reveals itself to any number of creatures it can see within 30 feet that it is hidden from.
Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the displacer beast's next turn.

bonus.name: Devour Id
entries: One frightened or unconscious creature within 5 feet of the displacer beast must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage and gain immunity to the frightened condition for the next minute.

reaction.name: Slinking Retreat
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the displacer beast, the displacer beast moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

legendary.name: Lithe Pounce
entries: The displacer beast leaps up to 20 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Shadowy Vault
entries: The displacer beast leaps up to 20 feet. If it ends this movement in dim light or darkness, it may immediately attempt to hide, and may do so without obscurement.

legendary.name: False Retreat
entries: The displacer beast magically produces an illusion of it leaping up to 20 feet, then makes an attack with its Hexapod Claws against a creature in range, or two attacks if the target attempted to make an attack of opportunity against the illusion.

name: Disenchanter
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Sense
entries: The disenchanter can pinpoint, by scent, the location of each magic item and active spell within 60 feet of it.

trait.name: Swaying Stride
entries: If the disenchanter moves at least 30 ft. in a straight line on its turn, it may Dodge as a Bonus Action this turn.

trait.name: Translucent Scales
entries: Attacks that deal radiant damage are made at advantage against the disenchanter.

action.name: Plodding Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A prone creature takes an additional 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone.
A creature that fails by 5 or more cannot stand or breathe until the end of the disenchanter's next turn.

action.name: Prehensile Tongue
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target creature or object. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), and each spell affecting the target ends. Spells cast by a creature grappled in this way fail.

action.name: Disenchant
entries: The disenchanter begins to consume the magic of one magic item of Very Rare or lesser quality that is held by the disenchanter or a creature it has grappled. If the disenchanter is still holding the object or creature at the beginning of its next turn, the item is destroyed.

trait.name: Filter Feeder
entries: A body of water in which a cistern fiend resides is extraordinarily clean and free of impurities.

trait.name: Translucent Body
entries: While submerged, the cistern fiend has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
While out of water, attacks that deal piercing damage score a critical against it on a 19-20. On a critical hit, one swallowed creature is freed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fiend makes three attacks with its filtration tendrils; one of which it may replace with a use of either its bite or its filter blood ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is grappled, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be swallowed.
A swallowed creature is restrained (escape DC 17), and takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of the fiend's turns.

action.name: Filtration Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Filter Blood
entries: One creature grappled by the fiend must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 4 (1d8) as the fiend's filtration tendrils burrow into its body and turn its blood to water. The target dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the fiend's reach, it may force the creature to succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the fiend, if it can.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The chwidencha can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chwidencha knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Burrowing Ambusher
entries: The chwidencha has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide while at least partially buried in loam or dark soil.

trait.name: Fruitless Devotion
entries: If a creature the chwidencha can see uses its action to brandish a holy symbol of Lolth, the chwidencha must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed and frightened by it until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes six attacks, or makes two attacks and uses its Nettling Bristles, if available.

action.name: Leg Barbs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the Chwidencha may grapple the target.

action.name: Scuttling Overrun
entries: The chwidencha moves up to half its speed, and may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. A creature whose space it enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone and be frightened for the next minute.
While frightened in this way, a creature can stand from prone only as an action, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Nettling Bristles (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The chwidencha scrapes off some of its barbed bristles, ejecting them in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing damage and be blinded until it takes an action to clear its eyes, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Buried Horror
entries: As a reaction when a creature the chwidencha is hidden from enters its reach, the chwidencha uses its Scuttling Overrun or makes four attacks with its Leg Barbs.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the choldrith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The choldrith makes four melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. A grappled or restrained target takes an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

action.name: Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 7 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Web
entries: The choldrith launches webbing in a 10 foot radius cetered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by webbing (escape DC 16). The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 15; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

action.name: Black Rain (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Inky black poison rains down in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) Poison damage, or half as much on a success. Lights in the area are extinguished.

action.name: Creeping Ruin (1/Day, 5th level spell)
entries: A mass of tiny spiders begins to swarm around the choldrith in a 15 ft radius. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 poison damage, or half as much on a success. The spell lasts 8 hours, or until it has dealt a total of 100 damage.

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The choldrith uses its webbing to restrain a grappled or prone target (escape DC 15).

reaction.name: The Queen's Will (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 ft. miss with an attack or fail a saving throw, the choldrith deals 5 (1d10) psychic damage to it. The target may reroll the attack or saving throw.

reaction.name: Lolth's Favor (1/Day, 3rd level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 feet die, the choldrith causes the friendly creature to explode in a torrent of venomous spiders. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

trait.name: Web-Dweller

action.name: Multiattack
