action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. A grappled or restrained target takes an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

action.name: Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 7 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Web
entries: The choldrith launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by webbing (escape DC 13). The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 5 HP; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

action.name: Black Rain (3rd level spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Inky black poison rains down in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) Poison damage, or half as much on a success. Lights in the area are extinguished.

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The choldrith uses its webbing to restrain a grappled or prone target (escape DC 12).

reaction.name: The Queen's Will
entries: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 ft. miss with an attack or fail a saving throw, the choldrith deals 5 (1d10) psychic damage to it. The target may reroll the attack or saving throw.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The chitine can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chitine knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the chitine has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pitfall
entries: Over the course of an hour, the chitine can construct a covering of web and debris that makes a pit up to 20 feet across indistinguishable from natural terrain. The first time a creature not able to safely traverse webs steps on it, the covering collapses and the creature falls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chitine makes two attacks.

action.name: Web Shot
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target's movement is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Wall of Webs
entries: The chitine raises an opaque wall of webs on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 5 ft. thick and up to 15 ft. long and 15 ft. high. When the wall appears, each creature in its space is pushed to a side of its choice.

Each 15 foot section of wall can be damaged and breached (AC 5; 20 HP; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage). A creature that hits the web with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 13).

reaction.name: Web Labyrinth
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 30 ft. of the chitine, the chitine uses its Wall of Webs ability.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The chitine can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chitine knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Swarmer
entries: If at least two other friendly chitine are within 10 ft., the chitine may attempt to Grapple or Shove a creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the chitine has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chitine makes two attacks with its daggers.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Bind (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One grappled and prone creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained in place by webbing (escape DC 14). A creature that succeeds by 5 or more is no longer grappled and may use its reaction to stand.

reaction.name: Shank
entries: As a reaction to a creature grappled by the chitine missing it with an attack, the chitine uses its multiattack.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: The chimera has three reactions each round. Whenever it takes 20 or more damage from a single source it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose one of its reactions.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the chimera fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d8) fire damage

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon head exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Headbutt
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the chimera may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the chimera's next turn.

reaction.name: Rake
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the chimera may make a claws attack against it. If the attack hits, the target is knocked prone.

reaction.name: Roar
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the chimera may let out a terrifying roar. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the chimera until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The chimera makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The chimera beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the chimera must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

name: Century Worm, That Which Turns in the Depths
resist: weapon attacks not made from inside it

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Earth Quaker
entries: When the worm burrows 30 feet or fewer below the surface, 10 foot wide, 10 foot deep fissures open at the surface above where it passes. Creatures in the space where a fissure opens must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone in the trench. On a success, a creature may use its reaction to move up to 10 feet to avoid falling in.

trait.name: Worm Keening
entries: At the beginning of the worm's turn, each creature within 30 feet of the worm takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage and is deafened. Structures in the area instead take maximum damage.

trait.name: Shock Sensitivity
entries: If the worm, or the ground within 30 feet of it is subjected to lightning damage, it cannot use its Terror From the Deep or Swallow Earth actions on its next turn, and must use all of its movement to surface.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the worm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm attacks twice with its Spit Bile.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Spit Bile
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) acid damage. Additionally on a hit, if the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Swallow Earth
entries: While burrowing no more than 20 feet beneath the surface, the worm begins to swallow the earth above it. A 5 foot radius pit appears on the surface above the worm; each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall in and have the worm immediately make a bite attack against it, or move to the nearest adjacent space on a success.

action.name: Terror From the Deep (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The worm moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half damage on a success. As a bonus action, the worm may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this saving throw.

legendary.name: Writhing Dive
entries: The century worm moves up to half its burrow speed. Each creature that makes an attack of opportunity provoked by this movement must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the tunnel left in its wake.

legendary.name: Bile Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature swallowed by the century worm must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (5d8) acid damage. On the worm's following turn, attacks it makes with its Spit Bile are at advantage.

legendary.name: Wriggling Progeny (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature swallowed by the century worm must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution modifier reduced by 1d6, to a minimum of 1. A creature that has its Constitution modifier reduced to 1 in this way takes 28 (8d6) piercing damage and has a century worm larva burrow into its body and attach to its spine, then is ejected from the century worm.
While it has a larva burrowed in it, a creature is charmed by the worm and must use its action to dash each turn until it finds soft earth in which to dig a hole and bury itself alive.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

trait.name: Harbinger of Tragedy
entries: A creature that sees a catoblepas must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed, becoming immmune to this curse for the next 24 hours on a success. A creature cursed in this way dies after two failed death Saving Throws, rather than three.

trait.name: Inevitable Call
entries: At the beginning of each of the catoblepas' turns, each creature within 100 ft. that does not have all of its hit points is dragged 15 ft. toward it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Catoblepas makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Final Glance, if available.

action.name: Whipneck Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (5d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (5d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand or swim for the next minute.

action.name: Final Glance (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead suffers vulnerability to all damage until it completes a long rest.

reaction.name: Withering Gaze (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 82 hit points, the catoblepas forces one creature it can see within 30 feet to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this ray.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

trait.name: Harbinger of Tragedy
entries: A creature that sees a catoblepas must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed, becoming immune to this curse for the next 24 hours on a success. A creature cursed in this way dies after two failed death Saving Throws, rather than three.

action.name: Whipneck Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand or swim for the next minute.

action.name: Final Glance (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead suffers vulnerability to all damage until it completes a long rest.

trait.name: Calming Presence
entries: Each creature within 5 ft. of the carbuncle has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration or to resist an effect that would Frighten it.

trait.name: Head Gem
entries: The carbuncle has a worthless translucent horny growth in its forehead that resembles a large ruby or garnet. A creature that pries it off with a successful DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or contract leprosy.

action.name: Disarming Lick
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the carbuncle until the end of its next turn, or until the creature is hit with an attack. Attack rolls against a creature charmed in this way are made at advantage.

reaction.name: End Life
entries: As a reaction to a creature targeting the carbuncle with an attack or harmful spell, the carbuncle keels over and dies. The attacker may choose a new target.

reaction.name: Feign Death
entries: As a reaction to a creature targeting the carbuncle with an attack or harmful spell, the carbuncle keels over and appears to die. A creature may attempt a DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) or Wisdom (Insight) check as a Bonus Action to determine it is faking. The attacker may choose a new target.

name: Godeater Bulette
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Apex Tunneler
entries: The bulette can burrow through solid rock or metal at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.
The bulette may spend half its movement to shatter a Wall of Force or similar creation of magical force within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Shock Attack
entries: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without tremorsense may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Godflesh Devourer
entries: The bulette has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects with a divine origin, such as those cast by clerics or paladins.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
entries: If the bulette fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Godeater Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 39 (5d12 + 7) piercing plus 11 (2d10) force damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20).
The bulette may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

action.name: Seismic Scrutiny
entries: The bulette directs its mind's eye toward a 30 foot radius location on the Astral, Ethereal, or Material plane, learning the number and type of creatures in the area.
The earth in the area begins to shake, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Planequake Eruption (Recharges when the bulette uses its Seismic Scrutiny)
entries: The bulette chews a hole that remains open until the beginning of its next turn to a location chosen with its Seismic Scrutiny, bursting forth in a spray of shattered fragments of reality.

Each creature within 30 feet of the bulette when it emerges is pushed up to 15 feet away, then each creature still within 30 feet of it must succeed DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) thunder plus 22 (4d10) force damage, or  half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Deadly Leap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bulette leaps up to 30 feet and can land in the space of any Large or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space the bulette lands in must succeed on a DC 17 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Dweomersense
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of 4th level or above, the bulette may move up to its burrow speed. If it is no longer a valid target for the spell, the spell caster must choose a new target or lose the spell.

legendary.name: Earthen Dive
entries: The bulette moves up to half its burrow speed directly downward.

legendary.name: Gather Strength
entries: The earth within 5 feet of the bulette becomes difficult terrain and the bulette gains 20 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the bulette's attacks are made at advantage.

legendary.name: Lateral Rend (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The bulette shakes a grappled creature back and forth, forcing it to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 26 (4d12) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the bulette's next turn.

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

A non-lawful creature hit with this attack is poisoned until the beginning of the bulette's next turn. While poisoned in this way, a creature treats any roll it makes  above a 10 as a 10.

action.name: Unstoppable Ram (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bulette moves up to its speed in a straight line. Each creature in its path is pushed ahead of it, then must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 additional feet.
A creature pushed in this way takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning plus 5 (1d10) force damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

action.name: Platonic Rejection (Recharges when the bulette succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect)
entries: The bulette releases the magic stored in its carapace in a burst of cosmic force.

action.name: Create Pitfall
entries: While burrowing, the bulette excavates a 5 foot wide pocket of earth above it and just beneath the surface, leaving a thin skin untouched above that collapses when significant weight is placed on it.

A Medium or larger creature in this space or that that enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or sink partially into the earth and be restrained in place until it spends its full movement to extract itself.
While restrained in this way, a creature can be targeted with melee attacks by creatures burrowing beneath the surface.

trait.name: Earthsteed
entries: The bulette can form a magical bond to a creature over the course of a long rest, which lasts until it uses this ability again.
A bonded creature can ride the bulette while it burrows, and while riding gains tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet. A creature riding a burrowing bulette cannot speak or breathe.

entries: As a reaction when it is targeted with an attack or makes a saving throw, the bulette curls into a ball, gaining the following effects until the beginning of its next turn.
The bulette is blinded.

Whenever the bulette takes 10 or more damage from a single source, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the behir may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behir. While climbing on the behir, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the behir.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 6)

reaction.name: Rip-Claw Retort
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack of opportunity, the behir forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

name: Abyssal Basilisk
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ossifying Gaze
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk that can see it (or its reflection) must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained until the beginning of its next turn.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The basilisk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Magic Resistance

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Stonecrushing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
If the target is petrified, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose a limb of its choice.

action.name: Claw Swipe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Petrify

reaction.name: Darting Snap

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Shadow Diver
entries: The banderhobb treats areas of dim light or darkness as arbitrarily deep, interconnected pools of water. It can be faintly seen and targeted while submerged in these shadow-pools, though other creatures cannot ordinarily pass into them unless carried by a banderhobb.

A creature that starts its turn in the demiplane takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

The walls of the demiplane have AC 20 and 30 hit points. If ruptured, each creature in the demiplane appears within 10 ft. of the banderhob. If the banderhobb is submerged in a shadow pool, the creatures appear at the surface of the nearest entrance.
If ruptured, the banderhobb's gullet is restored on a short or long rest.

trait.name: People Sack

The sack is an extradimensional space that can hold up to 4 Medium creatures. The weight and appearance of the sack are not affected by the creatures in it.
A creature that starts its turn in the sack must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or fall asleep until a creature takes an action to wake it.

action.name: Acid Nectar (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ankheg releases any creatures it has grappled and regurgitates a glob of resinous, honey-like nectar in a 30 foot cone.

The area becomes difficult terrain, and a non-ankheg creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 36 (8d8) acid damage, then must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the beginning of its next turn (escape DC 17).

bonus.name: Swallow Whole
entries: One creature grappled by the ankheg must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be swallowed. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, and its attacks bypass the ankheg's resistances.
If the ankheg takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the ankheg regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

bonus.name: Mockery Drone Spawning
entries: Each creature swallowed by the ankheg must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) acid damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage has its skull and spine disolved and replaced with a Ankheg Mockery Drone, then is immediately regurgitated by the ankheg.

reaction.name: Seething Vitriol
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Nectar.

reaction.name: Spell Turning
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell that targets only it, the ankheg avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

name: Ankheg Mockery Drone
languages: Speaks common but doesn't understand it

trait.name: Flesh Suit
entries: The mockery drone is ensconced in a perfect disguise of flesh, indistinguishable from a normal humanoid. While disguised, the ankheg Scything Barbs and Brittle exoskeleton traits are inactive, its AC is 11, and it cannot use its Spiral Constriction. It may emerge from its disguise as a Bonus Action on its turn.

trait.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
entries: If the ankheg takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 3, to a minimum of 11, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Scything Barbs
entries: Whenever the ankheg moves into a space for the first time on a turn, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) acid damage.

action.name: Spiral Constriction
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The the ankheg enters the target's space and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).
While it has a target grappled in this way, the ankheg's speed is 0 and whenever it takes damage, the grappled creature takes an equal amount of slashing damage.

action.name: Terrifying Chatter
entries: The ankheg cheefully speaks an incomprehensible stream of inane and nonsensical chatter. Each creature that is concentrating on a spell that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or lose concentration.

reaction.name: Punishing Barbs
entries: As a reaction to a creature failing at an attempt to escape its grapple, the ankheg forces it to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) piercing damage and be stunned until the end of the ankheg's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Burrowing Terror
entries: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Clutchmother
entries: When the ankheg dies, 10 Ankheg Nymphs that act on its turn burst from its corpse at the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ankheg makes two attacks with its Spined Claw Strike, one of which it may replace with its Fleshmelter Mandibles or its Burial Store.

action.name: Fleshmelter Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).
While grappled in this way, a creature takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Spined Claw Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned until the end of the ankheg's next turn.

action.name: Burial Store
entries: The ankheg rapidly excavates a 5 foot deep hole, shoves a creature it has grappled in it, then buries it (escape DC 16). While buried, a creature is blinded, restrained, and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Acid Drench (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ankheg spits steaming acid in a 40 foot long, 10 foot wide line. Each creature in that line must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature grappled by the Ankheg fails this save automatically.

reaction.name: Seething Vitriol
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Drench.

trait.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
entries: If the ankheg takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 11 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Burrowing Terror
entries: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

action.name: Fleshmelter Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).
While grappled in this way, a creature takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Spined Claw Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned until the end of the ankheg's next turn.

action.name: Acid Drench (Recharge 6)
entries: If the ankheg has no creature grappled, it spits steaming acid in a 30 foot long, 5 foot wide line. Each creature in that line must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage, or half as much on a success.
If the ankheg has a creature grappled, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 17 (5d6) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Seething Vitriol (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Drench.

trait.name: Half-Formed Exoskeleton
entries: Attacks with weapons that deal bludgeoning damage are made at advantage against the ankheg.

trait.name: Acid Burst
entries: When the ankheg is killed, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 2 acid damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Gnawing Mass (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 damage.
If at least three ankhegs contributed to this group attack and the target is wearing leather or cloth armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers.

name: Alkada
languages: understands Common but can't speak it.

trait.name: Suction Feet
entries: The alkada can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. While doing so, it makes a loud popping noise with each step.

trait.name: Slippery Mind
entries: The alkada is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the alkada dies, beams of psionic energy lance out in every direction. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d10) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alkada makes 9 attacks with its noodle hooks.

action.name: Noodle Hooks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d8 - 1) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 9).
If a creature escapes this grapple, the alkada loses 5 (2d4) hit points and makes one fewer attack with its multiattack until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Flap Arms
entries: The alkada frantically flaps its arms, generating a small field of antimagic around itself. Until the beginning of its next turn, the alkada can't be affected or detected by spells or magical effects.

reaction.name: Flailing Magic
entries: As a reaction to taking damage while not flapping its arms, the alkada forces each creature within 10 ft. of it to roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (PHB p. 104)

name: Werewolf Pack Leader
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the werewolf can transform into a wof-humanoid hybrid, into a wolf, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the werewolf is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pack leader has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Pack Leader
entries: Other werewolves have advantage on attacks against creatures adjacent to the pack leader.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The werewolf makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite (Hybrid or Wolf Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw Rake
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Dread Howl (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The werewolf emits a keening howl in a 30-foot radius. Each non-allied creature in the area that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the werewolf's next turn.
A creature frightened in this way must take the Dash action and move away from the werewolf by the safest available route on its turn, unless there is nowhere to move.

reaction.name: Rapid Retaliation
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the werewolf moves up to half its speed. If it ends this move adjacent to the attacker, it may make a bite attack against it as part of this reaction.

name: Wereshark
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The wereshark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the wereshark takes 10 or more lightning damage from a single source, it has disadvantage on attacks until the end of its following turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the wereshark can transform into a shark-humanoid hybrid, into a shark, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wereshark is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wereshark makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Serrated Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed.
At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or lose 2 (1d4) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Claw (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Tail Slam (Shark Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away from the wereshark.

action.name: Ram (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The wereshark moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards a creature that does not have all its hit points and makes a bite attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the wereshark's next turn.

reaction.name: Circle (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 56 hit points, the wereshark moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity and recharges its Ram.
Each creature of its choice within 30 feet that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Wereserpent
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the wereserpent can transform into a serpent-humanoid hybrid, into a Large snake, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wereserpent is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

trait.name: Braille
entries: While in hybrid or snake form, the wereserpent's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being blinded.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wereserpent makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Venomous Bite (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Recurve Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Constrict (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

reaction.name: Crush (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
entries: As a reaction to a creature the wereserpent has grappled with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the wereserpent crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

name: Werecrocodile

walk.condition: (20 ft., swim 30 ft. in crocodile or hybrid form)

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Hold Breath (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The werecrocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The werecrocodile makes two Tail Swipe or Khopesh attacks, or it makes one Bite attack and one Tail Swipe attack.

action.name: Bite (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the werecrocodile can't bite another target. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werecrocodile lycanthropy.

action.name: Tail Swipe (Crocodile or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target not grappled by the werecrocodile. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Khopesh (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The werecrocodile transforms into a Large crocodile or into a crocodile-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form, which is Humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. If the werecrocodile dies, it reverts to its true form.

name: Werebadger
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the werebadger can transform into a badger-humanoid hybrid, into a Large badger, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Poppy Weakness
entries: If hit with a weapon coated in poppy oil, the werebadger must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be forced to revert to its humanoid form and be poisoned for the next minute. While poisoned, the werebadger cannot use its shapechanger trait.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: If the werebadger drops to 0 hit points, it makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a success, it gains 1 hit point. The werebadger makes this save at advantage if at least one hostile creature is adjacent to it.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the werebadger is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The werebadger makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Snarling Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Scything Shovelclaws (Badger or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Loosen Skin
entries: As a reaction when the werebadger would make an attack with disadvantage due to being restrained, it instead makes an attack at advantage.

reaction.name: Relentless Assault
entries: As a reaction to a creature attempting to leave its reach, the werebadger makes a claw attack. If the attack hits, the target is grappled.

name: Wereyeti
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the wereyeti can transform into a Huge ape-giant hybrid or into a Huge yeti, or back into its true form, which is giant. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the wereyeti can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The wereyeti's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the wereyeti jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any large or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the wereyeti's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the wereyeti may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the wereyeti. While climbing on the wereyeti, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the wereyeti, and the wereyeti has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wereyeti is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wereyeti makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Brutal Shove, if available.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tree Trunk
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Body Slam
entries: The wereyeti throws itself prone in a 15 foot square. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature that is climbing on the wereyeti has disadvantage on the save, and takes maximum damage if it fails. A creature that succeeds takes half damage, but may use its reaction to move up to ten feet, taking no damage if it ends this movement outside the area of effect. The wereyeti can't stand from prone this turn.

action.name: Brutal Shove (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Up to two creatures within 15 feet of the giant and 15 feet of each other must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 20 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall prone as a reaction to gain advantage on this save.

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the wereyeti, the wereyeti forces it to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, pushed 10 feet away, and lose concentration if it was holding it.

name: Rolywere
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the rolywere can transform into a Small pillbug-humanoid hybrid, or back into its Small pillbug form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its pillbug form if it dies.

trait.name: Moist Underside
entries: The rolywere can breathe only while its torso is slightly damp. While in a dry environment, the rolywere must dampen its chest at least once every twelve hours to maintain its moisture.

trait.name: Rolystone Bearer
entries: The rolywere can tell, by touch, how long a plant or creature has been dead.

action.name: Prickly Antennae
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage and the rolywere learns what organic items the target is carying, what it ate for its last meal, and if it is afflicted with any disease.

action.name: Curl Up
entries: The rolywere curls its body into a small ball, gaining the following effects until it uses an action to uncurl:
The rolywere's AC is increased to 16
Attacks of opportunity against the rolywere and checks made to grapple it are made at disadvantage.
The rolywere can't take actions other than to Dash or uncurl.

reaction.name: Anxious Scrunch
entries: As a reaction when a creature ends its movement within 15 feet of the rolywere, the rolywere uses its Curl Up ability.

name: Jackalwere
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The jackalwere can use its action to polymorph into a specific Medium human or a jackal-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form (that of a Small jackal). Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The jackalwere has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The jackalwere has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackalwere's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Sleep Gaze
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more jackalweres that can see it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes early if it takes damage, or if another creature uses its action to wake it.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the jackalwere until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Vicious Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. On a critical hit, this attack deals an additional 7 damage.

trait.name: Indifferent Disposition
entries: The aldani always counts as a willing target for any spell.

trait.name: Ductile Carapace
entries: Whenever the aldani takes any bludgeoning damage,, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 9, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aldani makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) and dragged up to 5 feet towards the aldani.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Feeding Frenzy (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the aldani can see within 30 feet is swarmed by spectral piranhas for the next minute.
At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it takes 5 (1d10) piercing damage, or 11 (2d10) piercing damage if it is underwater. A creature killed by this damaged is reduced to a skeleton.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the aldani moves up to 10 feet. If this movement puts the aldani out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the aldani is unaffected.

reaction.name: Molt
entries: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the aldani bursts from its shell, reducing its AC to 9 and ending all conditions on itself, then moves up to half its speed.
This reduction lasts until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and it make take this reaction even while incapacitated.

trait.name: Indifferent Disposition
entries: The aldani always counts as a willing target for any spell.

trait.name: Ductile Carapace
entries: Whenever the aldani takes any bludgeoning damage, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 9, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Vice Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11).
At the beginning of the aldani's turns, a creature grappled in its Vice Claw takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Scissor Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.
If the target is grappled, the aldani may shear through part of its armor, reducing the AC offered by it by a permanent and cumulative 1.

reaction.name: Molt
entries: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the aldani bursts from its shell, reducing its AC to 9 and ending all conditions on itself, then moves up to half its speed.
This reduction lasts until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and it make take this reaction even while incapacitated.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The anathema has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Slither Strike
entries: Other creatures can't take reactions on the yuan-ti's turn.

trait.name: Blessed and Chosen
entries: When the anathema dies, its six heads each tear away from the body and immediately travel 15 feet. They act on the anathema's initiative, have AC 17 and 1 HP, and can't take actions other than to dash. If any remain alive after 24 hours, one reforms into a new body for the anathema, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anathema makes two claw attacks, one constrict attack, and one Flurry of Bites attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Constrict

reaction.name: Tail Lash

reaction.name: Vanishing Slide

entries: If the moth starts its turn within 30 feet of a source of bright light, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to voluntarily move away from the light until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Erratic Flight

entries: If the nagpa is killed, it is reborn within 1d10 days from the black egg of a vulture, in a location it has never been before. It grows to adulthood over the course of 6-8 months, though it may take years or decades to fully recover its memories.

trait.name: Corruptive Aura
entries: Each creature with a Wisdom score lower than 14 within 20 miles of a Nagpa becomes gradually more indifferent to the long-term consequences of its own actions, regaining its previous conscientiousness over the course of a week after exiting the nagpa's aura.

trait.name: Ruin Sage

action.name: Purge Thoughts (5th level spell)

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target can cast spells, it must succeed on a DC 18 saving throw using its spellcasting modifier or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot. If the creature loses a spell slot of 5th level or above, the nagpa regains a use of one of its expended spells.

action.name: Enchain in Shadow (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature that the nagpa can see within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and be restrained (escape DC 18) as chains of seething shadow envolop its body. A creature may repeat this save as an action, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Curse of Agony (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature that the nagpa can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or suffer a curse of agony for the next minute. A creature cursed in this way takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage whenever it takes an action.

action.name: Immolation (5th Level Spell, concentration, 1/Long Rest)
entries: One creature that the nagpa can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 30 (7d6 + 5) fire damage and the creature begins to burn, or half damage on a success. A burning creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failure, or ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Plague Chant (6th Level Spell, 1/Long Rest)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. Hit 28 (8d6) necrotic damage. If this attack hits, the plague chant leaps to another creature within 15 feet of the previous target. The nagpa makes a new attack roll against the new target, which could cause this ability to leap again. A creature can be targeted no more than once with each casting of this spell.

reaction.name: Steal Magic

reaction.name: Mark the Wrong!
entries: As a reaction when a creature the grudgekeeper can see within 60 feet takes any hostile action against a dwarf, the grudgekeeper makes a note, adding the creature's crime and likeness to its grudgeledger.

reaction.name: Right the Wrong!
entries: As a reaction when a creature the grudgekeeper can see within 60 feet that is recorded in the grudgekeeper's grudgeledger is hit with a melee attack, the grudgekeeper removes the creature from the grudgeledger and the creature takes an additional 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Spirit-Bearer
entries: If the dwarf takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it catches fire.
Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the dwarf takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes two attacks with its Dreg-Soaked Mallet, one of which it may replace with a use of its Spile Tap, if available.

action.name: Dreg-Soaked Mallet
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Drink to Victory!
entries: The brewmaster shares out a cask of its Grand Reserve, the fumes of which are mightily toxic to non-dwarves.
Each friendly dwarf within 5 feet of the brewmaster gains 10 temporary hit points that last for an hour.
Each nondwarf within 5 feet of the brewmaster must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the brewmaster's next turn.

action.name: Spile Tap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) piercing damage and have a barbed keg tap hammered into it.
A creature loses 5 (2d4) hit points at the end of each of its turns for each tap embedded in it. As an action, a creature may attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check, removing a tap on a success.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: World-Worn
entries: The dwarf cannot be charmed or frightened by any creature less than a century old.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes two attacks with its Deepstone Hammer.

action.name: Deepstone Hammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Dweomerbreaker Strike
entries: The dwarf makes a melee attack at advantage. On a hit, the target loses any effect that provides a temporary magical enhancement to its AC and any temporary hit points, before taking damage.

reaction.name: Stubborn Defiance
entries: As a reaction when it succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the dwarf uses its Dweomerbreaker Strike.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Impassable
entries: Hostile creatures treat the area within 5 feet of the dwarf as difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes two attacks with its Steelclad Fist.

action.name: Steelclad Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Chargebreaker Greatshield
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Pound Shield
entries: The dwarf pounds its armored fist into its shield, gaining 5 temporary hit points that last until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shield Song
entries: As a reaction when a anvileer within 30 feet uses its Pound Shield, the dwarf may use its Pound Shield.

reaction.name: Grumbling Thrust
entries: As a reaction when a creature is pushed into the dwarf's reach, the dwarf makes a Chargebreaker Greatshield attack against it.

A dwarven merchant caravan is in a panic after a cask of their Grand Reserve ale was stolen while traveling through a human trading post. Though the merchant is taking great care to performatively decry and swear vengeance upon the thief, privately they are seeking some seedy underworld sorts to seek out and rescue the thief from their own foolishness, as even a strong whiff of the Grand Reserve can be fatal to humans.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Armor-Miner
entries: The dwarf's attacks score a critical on a 18-20 against prone targets.

action.name: Digging Bar (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 3 damage on a critical hit.

action.name: Set Blasting Charge (1/Day)
entries: The dwarf places a blasting charge in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. At the beginning of the dwarf's next turn, the charge explodes, dealing 5 fire damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.
A creature that attempts to move or disarm the blasting charge must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check or have the charge immediately explode.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a bonus action, the duergar gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Telekinetic Leap
entries: The duergar's standing long jump and standing high jump both become equal to its movement speed.

items.name: Force Imbuement
entries: The next time the duergar hits a creature with a melee attack, the creature must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 ft. away.

action.name: Ghostflame Lance
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage. On a hit or miss, the target takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Ghostflame Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
entries: From its fire lance, the duergar shoots a 15-foot cone of fire or a line of fire 30 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Ancestral Rage
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or psionic effect, the duergar flies into a magically empowered rage.
For the next minute, the duergar's size increases to Large, it scores a critical on a 15-20, and it makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage.

reaction.name: Alchemical Preparation
entries: As a reaction when initiative is rolled, if the duergar is not surprised it may gain resistance to one damage type of its choice for the next minute.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: War Pick Flurry (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Shout Down (Group Reaction)
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 15 ft. that the duergar can see begins to cast a spell, the duergar lets out a shout of wild rage.
The spell caster must make a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to 8 plus the number of peons using this reaction. On a failed save, the spell fails.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Venomlink Aura
entries: A Drow, Drider, Spider, or Ettercap that starts its turn within 60 feet of the drow does an additional 3 (1d6) poison damage with each of its attacks, and its attacks have advantage against poisoned creatures.

action.name: Wrack
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 45 (10d8) necrotic damage and be poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the creature's movement speed is halved.

action.name: Charnel Haze (concentration)
entries: A cloud of viscous black fog spreads from a point within 60 feet to fill a 20-foot-radius sphere for the next minute. The fog is difficult terrain and heavily obscures the area, though the drow priestess' vision is not impaired by it. The drow may target creatures in or adjacent to the fog with her Wrack ability as though they were within 5 feet of her.

action.name: Tide of Dreams (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The drow sends a wave of soporific magic out in a 60 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep until the end of the drow's next turn, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to wake the sleeper. A poisoned creature makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Hazy Escape
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a harmful spell, the drow teleports to an unoccupied space within its Charnel Haze. If it is no longer a valid target for the spell, the spell fails.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Excruciating Stab
entries: If the drow deals 20 or more damage with a single attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the drow's next turn.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage and 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The drow makes a Scimitar attack against each creature in range.

reaction.name: Counterattack
entries: The drow adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. If this causes the attack to miss, the drow may make a scimitar attack as part of this reaction.

trait.name: Brace of Daggers

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drow makes two attacks, or three attacks if it is in darkness.

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Dousing Gloom
entries: Magical shadows spread from a point within 60 feet to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. Magical lights of 1st level or below in the area are extinguished, and nonmagical lights in the area produce only dim light. If the drow is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

reaction.name: Shadowy Dodge
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the drow may halve the attack's damage if it's in dim light or darkness.

entries: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

entries: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Dirty Fighting

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

action.name: Darkfire Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is wreathed in writhing shadows for the next minute. As long as the creature is in dim light or darkness, attacks against it are made at advantage and the creature can't benefit from invisibility.

name: Dragonborn Mural-Crowned
resist: one type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry

trait.name: Honor-Bonded
entries: The dragonborn has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature that has not hit the dragonborn with an attack in the last minute.

trait.name: Tip of the Spear
entries: While the dragonborn is within 10 feet of at least three hostile creatures, it has advantage on all saving throws.

trait.name: Battle Beacon
entries: Whenever the dragonborn hits a creature with a melee attack, up to one friendly creature within 30 feet that can see the dragonborn may use its reaction to move up to half its speed or make a melee attack.

trait.name: Cohort Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw while within 30 feet of three or more allied creatures, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Runefang Jaegerstock
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, plus additional damage equal to the amount the attack roll exceeded the target's AC by.

action.name: Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragonborn exhales elemental fury in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) damage of a type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Sudden Feint
entries: As a reaction when the dragonborn misses with a melee attack, it makes another melee attack at advantage.

reaction.name: Valorous Intercession
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet of it being hit with an attack, the dragonborn changes the attack's target to itself.

legendary.name: Challenging Blow
entries: The dragonborn makes a melee attack. If the attack hits, the target has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature other than the dragonborn until the beginning of the dragonborn's next turn.

action.name: Forebear's Claw (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The dragonborn sweeps a massive spectral claw in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) slashing damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Dragonwreath (Concentration, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The dragonborn wreaths a weapon it touches in elemental energy for the next hour. Until this spell ends, attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 7 (2d6) damage of a type of the dragonborn's choice.

action.name: Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragonborn exhales elemental fury in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) damage of a type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Titan's Roar (1/Day, 4th Level Spell)
entries: The dragonborn lets forth a magically amplified roar in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage and must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the dragonborn's next turn.

reaction.name: Safeguard
entries: As a reaction when another creature within 20 feet of it is hit with an attack, the dragonborn ensconces the creature in a barrier of magical energy, granting it resistance to that attack's damage.

reaction.name: Bolster Fury (2nd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature casts a spell or produces an effect that deals damage in a cone within 30 feet of the dragonborn, the dragonborn magically augments it, adding one of the following effects.

items.name: Elemental Blending
entries: The effect deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage of a type of the dragonborn's choice.

items.name: Breath Shaping

items.name: Energy Torrent

This attack is made at advantage against a creature that dealt damage to the dragonborn since the end of its last turn.

action.name: Pommel Strike

action.name: Mental Scourge (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the derro can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 28 (8d6) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more has its movement controlled by the derro on its following turn. The creature can take its action before or after moving.

action.name: Window to Madness (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The derro creates an 10 ft. by 10 ft. illusory portal to the far realm in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. that lasts for a minute. Each non-derro creature within 30 ft. of the portal that can see it takes 1d4 psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature that starts its turn within the area of the portal itself must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 36 (8d8) psychic damage and be stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Draw of The Far Realm
entries: Each creature within 60 ft. of the derro's Window to Madness must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be drawn 10 ft. towards it.

entries: The derro gives one creature within 60 ft. that it can see disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes this turn. The derro takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
