entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Indistinct
entries: The thicket shura does not reveal its position automatically when it is hidden and makes a ranged attack. Instead, a creature must discover its position by succeeding on a DC 16 Perception (Wisdom) check as an action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bugbear makes two attacks with its bolas.

action.name: Bolas
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or have its movement speed halved until it takes an action to remove the bolas.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

action.name: Skullthumper
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made with advantage, the target must make a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked prone and unable to stand on its next turn.

action.name: Hand Axe
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

trait.name: Vicious Attack
entries: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19 or 20.

trait.name: Brittle Bones
entries: If the aarakocra starts its turn grappled, it takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The aarakocra doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aarakocra makes three attacks with its shocking claw.

action.name: Shocking Claw
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Fury of the Storm (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 120 ft. that is flying is pushed up to 15 ft. in a direction of the aarakocra's choice. Then, each creature in a 10 ft. radius, 100 ft. high cylinder within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Take Flight
entries: As a reaction to taking damage from a melee attack, the aarakocra moves up to half its fly speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Vicious Attack
entries: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19 or 20.

trait.name: Brittle Bones
entries: If the aarakocra starts its turn grappled, it takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aarakocra makes three attacks with its flight lance.

action.name: Flight Lance
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone if it is a medium or smaller creature.

reaction.name: Take Flight
entries: As a reaction to taking damage from a melee attack, the aarakocra moves up to half its fly speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Grandmother Sea Hag
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The hag may Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action while submerged in water.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can perfectly mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid affected by its Steal Voice.

trait.name: Shipbreaker Coven
entries: The sea within 10 miles of a coven of sea hags is filled with dangerous riptides, jagged reefs, and vicious storms that raise with little warning. Creatures on a ship or shore have disadvantage on ability checks made to spot or assess these dangers.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two attacks with her rotflesh claw, one of which she may replace with a use of her sargassum grasp.

action.name: Rotflesh Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and an illusory corruption begins to spread rapidly from the wound, giving the appearance of rotting, waterlogged flesh.
The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the hag's next turn.

action.name: Sargassum Grasp
entries: One creature the hag can see within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be blinded and restrained (escape DC 15) as seaweed cocoons it. While restrained in this way, a creature sinks 15 ft. at the beginning of each of its turns.
The seaweed can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 15; immunity to bludgeoning and psychic damage).

action.name: Stolen Spell
entries: The sea hag casts a spell known by a creature affected by its steal voice, using the creature's spell slots.

action.name: Steal Voice (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. of the hag must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be unable to speak. If a creature fails this saving throw voluntarily, the hag does not require concentration to maintain the effect.

reaction.name: Courage to Dread
entries: As a reaction to a creature succeeding on a saving throw against its rotflesh claw, the hag makes the illusion real, dealing 27 (6d8) necrotic damage to the creature. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a death saving throw.

reaction.name: Death Gaze (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 90 hit points, the hag attempts to send a creature into a delirious panic. The creature must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. A frightened creature makes the initial saving throw at disadvatage.

A creature that fails this saving throw is frightened and stunned for the next minute, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more drops to 0 hit points.

name: Grandmother Night Hag
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it knows the name of. A creature can discern the nature of this illusion with a successful DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Debt Keeper
entries: A creature that is indebted to the hag is psychically connected to it. The hag can telepathically communicate with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through its senses. Once per day, the hag can force an indebted creature to reroll an attack, ability check, or saving throw, taking the second result.

trait.name: Soultaker Coven
entries: Humanoid creatures within 100 miles of a coven of night hags feel drawn to the coven's location in times of desperation. While part of a coven, the hag's hellish portal does not close when a creature falls into it.

trait.name: Soporific Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the hag's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag, the hag can force it to succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep until it takes any damage, or until another creature uses its action to wake it. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to the effect for the next 24 hours.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the  saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the hag until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Legendary Soultaker (3/Day)
entries: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to release one of the souls it has trapped in its soul bag. If it does, it succeeds instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Fiendish Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). While grappled in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Hellish Portal (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hag opens a rift to a hellish demplane, 10 ft. long and 5 ft. wide, on a surface within 60 ft. A creature standing in the rift's space when it appears or that enters it must succeed on a DC 14 Dextery saving throw or fall prone in an unoccupied space adjacent to the rift. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls in. If one or more creatures fall into the rift, the rift closes.

A creature that falls into the rift takes 31 (9d6) psychic damage, 31 (9d6) fire damage, and ages 31 (9d6) years, and is incapacitated until the beginning of its next turn, when it reappears in the space it left. The aging Effect can be reversed with a Greater Restoration spell.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

action.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day)
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane, afflicting it with dreadful nightmares. If this contact persists for an hour, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from its rest, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 10 (2d10).

If this effect reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and if the target was indebted to the hag, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

A creature that is wearing a silver protective talsiman, or one that has had a Protection From Good And Evil spell cast on it in the last 8 hours makes this save at advantage. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more awakes, dragging the hag into the waking world with it. The hag appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and cannot use its Etherealness ability for the next minute.

reaction.name: Offer Bargain
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see  failing a saving throw, the hag grants it the ability to choose to succeed instead. A creature that does is Indebted to the hag.

reaction.name: True Magic
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see wihthin 60 ft. casting a spell, the hag disrupts the magic. The spell fails, and the spell caster takes 5 (1d10) force damage per level of the spell and must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned.

name: Grandmother Green Hag
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Swampwalk
entries: The hag is unaffected by difficult terrain caused by swampy terrain or vegetation.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it has killed. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Glimmer of Hope
entries: Whenever one or more creatures the hag can see within 30 ft. succeed on a saving throw against a spell the hag controls, the hag gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Earthdrinker Coven
entries: The earth within 10 miles of a coven of green hags gradually softens and becomes waterlogged over the course of a week. The roots of food crops begin to rot away, livestock sicken, and the area becomes difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two melee attacks, one of which she may replace with either her Hurl to Earth or her Grasping Muck.

action.name: Swampgift Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be cursed.
While cursed, a creature glows with a pale blue light, attracts biting insects, and swamp-dwelling creatures have advantage on attack rolls against the cursed creature.

action.name: Hurl to Earth
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be teleported 60 ft. in the air and knocked prone.

action.name: Grasping Muck
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 15) as it begins to sink into the earth. A prone creature has disadvantage on this saving throw. A creature already affected by this ability is additionally blinded and unable to speak or breathe as it sinks fully beneath the surface.

action.name: Stagnant Miasma (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ground in a 10 ft. radius within 60 ft. begins to bubble, exuding a cloud of toxic gas that remains for a minute, or until cleared with a strong breeze. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (5d8) poison damage.

action.name: Invisible Passage (Concentration)
entries: The hag magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell. While invisible, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic.

reaction.name: Poisoned Cup
entries: As a reaction to a creature she can see within 30 ft. receiving a source of magical healing, the hag fouls the magic. The creature receives no healing and instead takes an equal amount of necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Hope to Despair
entries: When a creature that the hag can see within 30 ft. makes a saving throw against a spell the hag (or a member of her coven) cast, she may expend all temporary hit points from her Glimmer of Hope ability and subtract the number expended from the creature's saving throw.

name: Grandmother Bheur Hag
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Graystaff Magic
entries: The hag carries a graystaff, a length of gray wood that is a focus for her inner power. She can ride the staff as if it were a broom of flying. If the staff is lost or destroyed, the hag cannot use its rime burst and must craft another, which takes a year and a day. Only a bheur hag can use a graystaff.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The hag can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra moment.

trait.name: Sapping Cold
entries: Each time a creature hits the bheur hag with a melee attack, it must expend one unexpended hit die. If it cannot, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end its next turn.

trait.name: Embrittle
entries: On a roll of 1 with a melee attack agains the hag, a weapon that isn't named shatters in the wielder's hands, dealing 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Wintergiver Coven
entries: The area within 50 miles of a coven of bheur hags drops 1 degree every hour until it reaches 10 degrees below the lowest natural winter temperature of the area. Creatures in the area without cold resistance or immunity subtract 1d4 from the result of saving throws they make.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag uses its Rime Burst or Maddening Feast. Then, if one or more creatures within 30 ft. are frightened, it may use its Onset of Desperation or Curse of Paranoia.

action.name: Rime Burst (Greystaff only)
entries: The hag sends forth an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creatue that starts its turn in it or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Maddening Feast
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5ft., one incacitated or dead target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage and 36 (8d8) cold damage. Each creature of the hag's choice that can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for a minute. A frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Onset of Desperation
entries: One frightened creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the hag for the same duration. While charmed in this way, the creature uses its action to feed on the nearest beast or humanoid corpse it can see within 30 ft., or to attack the nearest living humanoid or beast it can see if there are no corpses in range.

action.name: Curse of Paranoia
entries: Each frightened creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A cursed creature cannot target friendly creatures with spells. If the cursed creature is targeted with a spell by a friendly creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unaffected by the spell.

reaction.name: Feed on Greed
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. targeting itself with a spell, the bhuer hag changes the spell's target to itself.

reaction.name: Chill the Weave
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft targeting the hag with a spell, the hag forces the caster to expend an additional spell slot of the same or higher level. If it cannot, the hag chooses a new target for the spell.

name: Grandmother Annis Hag
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Skinktaker Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any humanoid it has skinned. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Corruptor Coven
entries: Children within 10 miles of a coven of annis hags are slowly incited to misbehave in ever-escalating ways, up to and including things like destruction of food stores, killing pets and livestock, arson, and even murder.
Additionally, a fog settles in the area that never lifts. Creatures other than the annis hag in the area are blind beyond a 30 ft. radius.

trait.name: Eyes of Black
entries: A creature the hag can see must spend 1 extra foot for every foot it moves away from the hag.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The annis makes three attacks: one with her teeth of iron and two with her corkscrew claws.

action.name: Teeth of Iron
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 10 (3d6) damage against a prone creature.

action.name: Corkscrew Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage and the hag may grapple the target (escape DC 19). While the hag has a creature grappled in this way, it cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Crushing Hug
entries: One creature grappled by the hag must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 65 (10d12) bludgeoning damage, falls prone, and cannot stand on its following turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot stand until it completes a short or long rest. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Grisly Display
entries: As a reaction when the hag kills a creature with a melee attack, the hag rips the creature's skin off in a single piece. Each creature that can see the display must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. While frightened in this way, a creature uses its movement and action to dash in a random direction.

reaction.name: Swallow Magic
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of fifth level or below, the hag snaps at the spell with her iron teeth, disrupting it. On her following turn, the annis hag's attacks are made at advantage and deal force damage, instead of any other type.

trait.name: Hidden-Stepper
entries: The verbeeg may hide in any cover large enough to hide a Small or larger creature.

trait.name: Word-Twister
entries: As long as the verbeeg tells no direct lies, it has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The verbeeg makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its get 'em! ability.

action.name: Kingfisher Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or have one object it is carrying but not wielding cut loose and flung 15 ft. in a direction of the verbeeg's choice.

action.name: Distracting Greatbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) piercing damage. On a miss, up to one creature within range may use its reaction to make a melee attack against the target.

action.name: Get 'Em!
entries: Up to three friendly creatures within 60 ft. may each move up to half their speed toward a creature of the verbeeg's choice.

reaction.name: Shin Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the verbeeg, the verbeeg forces it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Hidden-Stepper
entries: The verbeeg may hide in any cover large enough to hide a Small or larger creature.

trait.name: Word-Twister
entries: As long as the verbeeg tells no direct lies, it has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The verbeeg can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The verbeeg makes two attacks with its spear.

action.name: Kingfisher Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or have one object it is carrying but not wielding cut loose and flung 15 ft. in a direction of the verbeeg's choice.

action.name: Vine Snare (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that the verbeeg can see must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone,  hoisted 15 ft. into the air by vines and restrained (escape DC 13).
The vines are an object that can be destroyed (AC 12, HP 10, Vulnerability to Fire).

action.name: Concealing Mists (Concentration)
entries: The verbeeg conjures thick and shifting mists in a 100 ft. radius centered on a point within 60 ft. Creatures in the area can see no further than 30 ft., and verbeegs in the area may Hide as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Hidden-Stepper
entries: The verbeeg may hide in any cover large enough to hide a Small or larger creature.

trait.name: Word-Twister
entries: As long as the verbeeg tells no direct lies, it has advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The verbeeg makes two attacks with its spear.

action.name: Kingfisher Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or have one object it is carrying but not wielding cut loose and flung 15 ft. in a direction of the verbeeg's choice.

action.name: Sweeping Trip (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

reaction.name: Stay Down
entries: As a reaction to a creature standing from prone within 15 ft. of the verbeeg, the verbeeg may make a melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the creature is knocked prone again and cannot stand this turn.

name: Blood Troll
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The troll rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Rapid Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that does not deal fire or acid damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a Troll Budling. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the troll may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the troll. While climbing on the troll, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the troll, and the troll has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 9 (2d8) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Claw Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Reckless Whirlwind (Recharge 6)
entries: Each creature climbing on the troll must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or fall off, then each creature within 10 feet of the troll that is not climbing on it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 33 (6d10) slashing damage and be knocked prone. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks that target the troll are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Secret Arm
entries: As a reaction when a creature attempts to leave its reach, the troll extends a hidden arm from one of its mouths. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled until the beginning of the troll's next turn.

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals piercing or slashing damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a Troll Budling. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Reckless Thrash (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the troll must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks that target the troll are made at advantage.

trait.name: Oversized Limb
entries: The troll can grapple as if it were once size larger, and acts on initiative count 0 instead of rolling.

trait.name: Clone Merger
entries: An injured troll that starts its turn within 5 feet of a budling merges with it, partial absorbing the budling into its body. A merged budling's speed is 0, it moves with its host troll, and uses its host troll's AC.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Flailing Strikes (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The oni's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The oni regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack (Oni Form Only)
entries: The oni uses makes one blade attack and uses its invisibility.

action.name: Hidden Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. This attack deals an additional 21 (6d6) damage if it was made with advantage.

action.name: Freezing Blast (1/Day, 5th level spell)
entries: Each creature in a 60 ft cone must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 41 (9d8) cold damage, or half damage on a success.

action.name: Lightning Strike
entries: Creatures in a 5 ft radius of a point within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Creeping Sleep
entries: Up to two creatures within 15 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature falls asleep until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead falls asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

action.name: Change Shape

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Battleready Ordning
entries: When initiative is rolled, the jarl and each friendly giant within 60 ft. may move up to its speed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The frost giant makes two attacks with its runebearded story-axe, one of which it may replace with a use of its pillar of ice.

action.name: Runebearded Story-Axe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) cold damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. On a critical hit, the creature's name is inscribed on the axe, and future attacks made against the creature with this weapon are made at advantage. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Hurl Iceberg
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning plus 27 (6d8) cold damage and the target is knocked prone. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Pillar of Ice
entries: The Jarl raises a 20 ft. high, 10 ft. across pillar of ice from a point it can see within 60 ft. A creature in the pillar's space when it appears must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) cold damage and be lifted by the pillar. The pillar has AC 12, 30 hit points, and vulnerability to fire damage.

action.name: Freezing Fog Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant exhales a gout of freezing fog in a 20-foot radius centered on itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes heavily obscured for the next minute, or until cleared away by a strong wind.

legendary.name: Grip of Winter
entries: Swirling ice and snow descends in a 10 ft. radius centered on a point within 60 ft. for the next minute. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 5 (1d10) cold damage and has its movement reduced by half.

legendary.name: Eyes of the Storm
entries: The giant or one friendly creature within 30 ft. that it can see gains the ability to see unimpeded through fog and snow until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Sliding Cleave
entries: If the giant is not prone, it falls prone, slides 30 ft., and makes a melee attack. Large or smaller creatures in its path are pushed into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Frost Rune
entries: The giant has a frost rune inscribed on a chunk of ice or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Ice Wolves action and Ice Armor reaction.

The object bearing the rune has AC 16; 40 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a frost rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes three attacks using Greataxe, Freezing Ray, or a combination of them.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

action.name: Freezing Ray
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) cold damage, and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Ice Wolves (Requires Frost Rune)
entries: The giant magically summons 1d4 wolves made of ice (use the winter wolf stat block in the Monster Manual to represent them, but they are Elementals instead of Monstrosities). The wolves appear in unoccupied spaces the giant can see within 30 feet of itself. The wolves take their turn immediately after the giant on the same initiative count, and they obey the giant's commands. The wolves gain a +6 bonus to their attack and damage rolls while they are within 30 feet of the giant. The wolves disappear after 1 minute, when the giant dies, or when the giant uses this action again.

reaction.name: Ice Armor (Requires Frost Rune)
entries: When a creature the giant can see makes an attack roll against it, the giant can form a coat of ice around itself, granting it a +6 bonus to its AC against that attack. After the attack hits or misses, the ice shatters, and each creature within 5 feet of the giant must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) cold damage.

name: Frost Giant Skald
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The giant can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Inspiring Prowess
entries: Whenever the giant reduces a creature to 0 hit points with an attack, each creature within 30 ft. makes attacks at advantage until the end of the giant's next turn.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks with its twisted ivory warhorn, one of which it may replace with a use of its compose verse ability.

action.name: Twisted Ivory Warhorn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) budgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Compose Verse
entries: The frost giant declaims a verse of battle-poetry. Up to two friendly frost giants within 30 ft. that can hear it may use their reaction to make a melee attack.

action.name: Recite Refrain (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature that understands Jotunise and can hear the giant within 30 ft. gains 10 temporary hit points. While a creature has these temporary hit points, its attacks score a critical on a 19-20.

reaction.name: Frosthunder Sounding (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 81 hit points, the giant sounds its warhorn, releasing a blast of sound and cold in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The ground in the area sprouts icy spikes, becoming difficult terrain for the next minute. When a Large or smaller creature moves into or within the area, it takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

name: Stone Giant Thane
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The giant can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the giant doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Ordning of Artistry
entries: When initiative is rolled, time stops for each creature other than the giant. The giant may take three turns to inspect its surroundings and use its stone shaper ability to alter them. This effect ends early if the giant interacts with another creature in any way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks with its crushing grasp, one of which it may replace with its stillness of stone ability, if available.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the creature is grappled (escape DC 18). While grappled in this way, a creature takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Living Burial
entries: The giant scoops out a hollow in the earth and attempts to seal a creature in it. One grappled creature must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, sealed in a shallow grave of solid stone. The stone covering the creature is an object and can be destroyed  (AC 20; HP 30; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage)

action.name: Stillness of Stone (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (6d10) thunder damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be petrified.

legendary.name: Fling Pest
entries: The giant forces one creature that is climbing on it to succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be hurled 20 feet away, take 14 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

legendary.name: Shelter of Stone
entries: If no creatures are currently climbing on it, the giant moves up to half its burrow speed.

legendary.name: Seal Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The stone giant seals its wounds with stone, gaining 22 (4d10) temporary hit points.

name: Stone Giant Runesinger
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Runesong
entries: Over the course of an hour, the giant can sculpt a natural cavern to channel wind into beautiful and haunting melodies. Stone giants in the cavern have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone giant makes two attacks with its Launch Quakestone.

action.name: Enruned War-Chisel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing plus 22 (4d10) force damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or have a rune inscribed upon its flesh, imposing one of the following effects. The creature may repeat this saving throw whenever it receives magical healing, ending the effect on a success.
Until the creature receives magical healing, it suffers one of the following effects of the giant's choice.

items.name: Rune of Stony Sleep
entries: Whenever the creature regains hit points, it turns partially to stone and is restrained until the end of its next turn. While asleep, the creature appears to be petrified, and wakes only if a creature takes an action to wake it.

items.name: Rune of Thundering Echo
entries: Whenever the creature takes bludgeoning damage, it and each other creature within 5 ft. of it takes 11 (2d10) thunder damage.

items.name: Rune of Grasping Stone
entries: The creature treats surfaces of solid stone as difficult terrain, as hands continuously reach from the stone to slow its passage.

action.name: Launch Quakestone
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, each creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Grounding Stance
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the giant forces each Large or smaller creature within 30 ft. to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Hill Giant Master of the Feast
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Easily Confused
entries: While at least three hostile creatures are within 5 feet of the giant, all attacks against it are made at advantage. While at least two creatures are speaking to the giant, it has disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to detect deception.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Ordning of Plenty
entries: When initiative is rolled, each friendly giant within 60 ft. gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points. While a giant has these temporary hit points, it has immunity to poison and to being frightened, and makes Wisdom saving throws at advantage.

action.name: Dwarf-Driver Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 ft. away, or half as far on a success.

action.name: Snatch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

action.name: Savor
entries: The giant slowly chews. Each creature in its mouth must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Call to the Feast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Up to four hill giants within 60 ft. may each use their reaction to make a bite attack using the Master of the Feast's attack bonus, dealing 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage on a hit.

legendary.name: Snatch
entries: The giant makes a snatch attack.

legendary.name: Stuff
entries: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the giant must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be stuffed into the hill giant's mouth and restrained (escape DC 18).

legendary.name: Earthshaker Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The giant moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Gargantuan. Each creature within 30 ft. of where it begins or ends this movement must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature whose space the giant passes through has disadvantage on this saving throw.

name: Hill Giant Chef-Soul
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Easily Confused
entries: While at least three hostile creatures are within 5 feet of the giant, all attacks against it are made at advantage. While at least two creatures are speaking to the giant, it has disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to detect deception.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Runescribed Cauldron
entries: The giant carries a 15 ft. across magic cauldron that can fill with water and heat on command. A creature that enters the caudron for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 11 (2d10) fire damage. A creature may exit the cauldron by spending half its movement, landing prone in an unoccupied adjcacent space of its choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hill giant makes two melee attacks, up to one of which may be with its sample bite.

action.name: Sample Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage and the giant has advantage on saving throws against spells cast by the creature until the beginning of the giant's next turn.

action.name: Hog Splitter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. A creature killed by this weapon is split in half.

action.name: Snatch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the giant, the giant forces it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, pushed 10 feet away, and lose concentration if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Into the Cauldron!
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a grappled creature while within 30 ft. of its cauldron, the hill giant tosses the creature.
The creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, falling into the cauldron on a failed save or taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The giant casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

trait.name: Hill Rune
entries: The giant has a hill rune inscribed on a rock or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Stone Avalanche action and Hill Rebuff reaction.

The object bearing the rune has AC 15; 20 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a hill rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes one Greatclub attack and uses Stone Bolas.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

action.name: Stone Bolas
entries: The giant conjures three stone balls connected by lines of magical force and throws them at one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the start of the giant's next turn, and the stones erupt in a burst of thunderous energy that deals 14 (4d6) thunder damage to the target and each creature within 10 feet of the target. On a successful save, the stones vanish without erupting.

action.name: Stone Avalanche (Requires Hill Rune)
entries: The giant conjures a hail of rocks in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point on the ground it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
The rocks turn the ground in that area into difficult terrain until the start of the giant's next turn, when the rocks vanish.

reaction.name: Hill Rebuff (Requires Hill Rune)
entries: Immediately after the giant takes damage from a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) force damage and be pushed horizontally 10 feet away from the giant.

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The ettin rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

action.name: Bonechopper Hack-Axe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
If the ettin's Rage Song is active, this attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Wicked Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
If the ettin's Rage Song is active, the target is additionally pushed up to 10 feet away on a hit.

action.name: Rage Song (Concentration)
entries: The ettin begins a magical chant, recounting millenia of grievances and evoking uncontrollable rage in all who hear it.
Attacks made by creatures within 30 feet of the ettin deal an additional die of damage, and have disadvantage if the attacker doesn't speak Jiganti, Goblish, Orcish, or Abyssal.

reaction.name: Lash Out
entries: When the ettin succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to half its speed toward the spell caster or make a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Invoke Fury
entries: When the ettin is targeted with an attack by a creature affected by its Rage Song, it can force the attacker to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target or lose the attack. If the creature fails this saving throw by 5 or more, the ettin chooses the new target.

name: Vargouille Swarm
languages: and Infernal but is unable to speak

trait.name: Screeching Flock
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. of the swarm must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

trait.name: Poor Vision
entries: The swarm has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. As an action, a creature may attempt a DC 8 Charisma (Deception) check to convince the swarm that something inedible is edible.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature.

action.name: Locking Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing plus 21 (6d6) poison damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer, and the swarm attaches to the target.
While attached, the swarm can't attack another target, and may free itself as an Action or Bonus Action.

action.name: Manic Shrieking (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The swarm unleashes a cacaphony of piercing shrieks. Each creature within 20 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the Vargouille's next turn. A frightened creature makes this save at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Cursed Kiss
entries: One incapacitated creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature loses 1 point of Charisma for each hour it spends in dim light or darkness. A creature that has its Charisma reduced to 0 in this way has its head tear free of its body and sprout wings, becoming a vargouille.

name: Rakshasa Rajah
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Master of Treachery
entries: The rakshasa can sense the presence and nature of conflict between creatures it can see.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sinister Heart
entries: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical.
If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 hit points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (1/Day)
entries: If the rakshasa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws and uses its Mastermind's Insight, if available.

action.name: Reversed Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and the target is Cursed.
A creature Cursed in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

action.name: Sudden Spoiling (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the rakshasa can see within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 49 (11d8) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
If this spell was cast as a reaction on the target's turn, the target is additionally stunned until the end of the rakshasa's next turn.

action.name: Mastermind's Insight (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then each of those characters must succeed on a DC 24 Charisma (Deception) check or have the rakshasa learn that information.

action.name: Displace Soul (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration.)
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the rakshasa must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or fall unconscious as its soul forced is out of its body and into the Border Ethereal (Save Ends at end of turn).

The affected creature can still see, hear, and speak faintly across the barrier. A creature that fails three consecutive saving throws against this effect is trapped outside its body until returned by a Wish spell or similar magic.

bonus.name: Master of Appearances
entries: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

bonus.name: Wreath With Flame (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Until the end of the rakshasa's turn, its melee attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage.

bonus.name: Sneering Command
entries: Up to two creatures the rakshasa can see within 60 feet may each use their reaction to move up to half their speed an make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Saw it Coming (Recharges when the rakshasa uses its Mastermind's Insight)
entries: As a reaction when a creature it can see begins to take an action, the rakshasa moves up to its speed and takes an action or a bonus action.

reaction.name: Deceptive Demise (4th Level Spell, 2/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the rakshasa takes damage, it teleports up to 30 feet to a location it can see, turns invisible until the beginning of its next turn, and may attempt to Hide.
A corpse-like duplicate of the rakshasa is left in its place, which dissolves into mist at the end of the rakshasa's next turn, or if it takes any damage.

legendary.name: Prepared Trap
entries: The rakshasa moves up to 10 feet, then activates a trap that it set earlier in anticipation of its enemies' actions, targeting a creature it can see within 60 feet and choosing one of the following effects.
A creature targeted with one of these effects cannot be targeted with the same effect until it moves.

items.name: Spiked Pit
entries: A false floor over a 10 foot deep spiked pit drops away beneath a creature within 60 feet, which must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall in, taking 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

items.name: poisoned Potion
entries: One creature within 60 feet that ingested a consumable magic item since the end of the rakshasa's last turn must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

items.name: Glyph Mine
entries: One creature within 60 feet and each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) damage of a type of the rakshasa's choice.

items.name: Tailored Bane
entries: Choose a spell in secret. The first time a creature within 60 feet casts that spell before the beginning of the rakshasa's next turn, the spell targets its caster.

name: Rakshasa Ak'Chazar
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Eternal Servitude
entries: A living creature that dies while under the rakshasa's control rises at the beginning of its next turn under the rakshasa's control with 30 hit points.
The creature's type becomes undead and its alignment becomes lawful evil, but its statistics otherwise remain unchanged and it retains its memories.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sinister Heart
entries: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical.
If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 hit points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws and uses its Fiendish Insight.

action.name: Reversed Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and the target is Cursed.
A creature Cursed in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

action.name: Fiendish Insight
entries: One player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then the target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma (Deception) check or have the rakshasa learn that information.

action.name: Twist the Heart (Recharge 5-6)

The target must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone.

entries: The myconid forces a creature it is grappling to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While poisoned in this way, myconids have advantage on attack rolls against the target.

action.name: Speed Decay
entries: The myconid forces a poisoned creature within 30 feet of it to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, taking half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Shudderspore Rain
entries: When the myconid hits a creature with a melee attack, it can deal 5 (2d4) poison damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: If the myconid ends its turn in sunlight or takes any radiant damage, it has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Rapport Spores
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the myconid gains telepathy to a range of 60 feet for 1 hour. It can use this only to communicate with myconids or with other affected creatures.

action.name: Contaminator Bond
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
A creature hit with this attack takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage the first time it deals any damage in the next minute.

action.name: Pacifying Touch
entries: The myconid touches a creature within 5 feet of it and forces it to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is dazed for 1 hour or until it takes any damage. While dazed in this way, the target can't take any hostile actions.

action.name: Sporesong (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each friendly myconid within 60 feet of the sovereign can use its reaction to move up to half its speed. An affected myconid that has any number of temporary hit points can additionally make an attack as a part of this reaction.

action.name: Circle's Roots (1/Day)
entries: Each friendly myconid within 1000 feet of the sovereign gains 10 temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Shudderspore Rain
entries: When the myconid hits a creature with a melee attack, it can deal 5 (2d4) poison damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

reaction.name: Gather Growths (1/Day)
entries: When the myconid is reduced to half of its maximum hit points or less, it creates four friendly Myconid Scavengers in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Galvanotaxis
entries: If the merrow takes any amount of lightning damage, it loses its reaction, or is dazed until the end of its next turn if it can't.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The merrow makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Harpoon Skewer.

action.name: Drowner's Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the merrow can grapple the target (escape DC 14).

action.name: Harpoon Skewer
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
If the target is Large or smaller, it is dragged up to 15 feet towards the merrow.

bonus.name: Spiral Dive
entries: The merrow swims up to half its speed directly downward, and then each creature grappled by it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is poisoned until the end of the merrow's next turn, and loses its breath if it was holding its breath.

bonus.name: Primeval Surge
entries: If the merrow is submerged at the surface of a body of water, it leaps up to 20 feet out of the water, and can then make an attack with its claws or harpoon.

name: Merrow Shipbreaker
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Galvanotaxis
entries: If the merrow takes any amount of lightning damage, it loses its reaction, or is dazed until the end of its next turn if it can't.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: Attacks made against the merrow by a creature attached to it have advantage, and the merrow has disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures attached to it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The merrow makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Anchor-Flail Crash.

action.name: Razorfin Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Anchor-Flail Crash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.
This attack has disadvantage against a target within 10 feet of the merrow.

action.name: Raise Breaker (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The merrow lashes its tail through water, sending a wave roiling forth in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and the taret is pushed up to 10 feet away if it is Large or smaller, taking half as much damage on a success.
Creatures with cover apply the cover bonus to this saving throw.

bonus.name: Primeval Surge
entries: If the merrow is submerged at the surface of a body of water, it leaps up to 20 feet out of the water, and can then make an attack with its claws or anchor-flail.

trait.name: Razor Reflex
entries: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the cultist takes damage, the culist can move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Sawblade Clawknife (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 slashing damage.
If three or more cultists contributed to this attack, the target additionally begins bleeding (1d6).

action.name: Pin Down
entries: The cultist grasps at a creature within 5 feet of it, granting advantage to all attacks made against the target this turn.
If the target is not hit by an attack this turn, at the end of this turn, it can make an opportunity attack against the cultist.

name: Cult Fanatic of the Profane Tormentor

trait.name: Razor Reflex
entries: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the cultist takes damage, the culist can move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Amplify Agony.

action.name: Ritual Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, one non-humanoid ally of the fanatic within 30 feet gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Amplify Agony
entries: The fanatic forces one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that is dazed, frightened, or stunned. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is paralyzed until the start of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Bleed For Your Master
entries: When a non-humanoid ally of the fanatic within 30 feet of it takes damage, the fanatic can make an attack against itself. On a hit, the attack is automatically a critical hit.

reaction.name: Bestow Wound (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When the fanatic is hit with an attack, it can force a creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw.
On a failure, the fanatic takes half as much damage from the attack and the target takes the same amount.

trait.name: Razor Reflex
entries: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the cultist takes damage, the culist can move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Spirit Breaker
entries: When the cultist deals psychic damage to a creature, it can impose disadvantage on attacks that creature makes until the end of the cultist's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes two attacks with its Illusory Skewer, one of which it can repalce with a use of its Mindkiller Probe or Drown in Blood.

action.name: Illusory Skewer (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage plus one additional effect of the target's choice:

items: The target is dazed until the end of its next turn, or is stunned until the end of its next turn if it was already dazed.
The target takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage the first time it moves or is forced to move at least 5 feet before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Mindkiller Probe (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The devoted rips into the mind of a creature it can see within 30 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 7 (2d6) poison damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage and the target is frightened for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
If the target fails its saving throw by 5 or more, while frightened in this way, the target must answer any question asked of it.

action.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the devoted can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and begin choking as blood wells up in its mouth and lungs (Save Ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Needling Link
entries: One creature affected by a spell the devoted is concentrating on takes 4 (1d8) psychic damage.

entries: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the cultist takes damage, the culist can move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Spirit Breaker
entries: When the cultist deals psychic damage to a creature, it can impose disadvantage on attacks that creature makes until the end of the cultist's next turn.

trait.name: Purge Fault (2/Day)
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the cultist can end one condition affecting it, then takes 10 psychic damage for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks with its Illusory Skewer, one of which it can replace with a use of its Drown in Blood, or Power Word Suffer, if available.

action.name: Illusory Skewer (2nd Level Spell)

items: The target is dazed until the end of its next turn, or is stunned until the end of its next turn if it was already dazed.
The target takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage the first time it moves or is forced to move at least 5 feet before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and begin choking as blood wells up in its mouth and lungs (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Power Word: Suffer (Recharge 5-6, 5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 feet takes 25 psychic damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn. This damage can't reduce a creature below 1 hit point.

action.name: Blood to Vitriol (1/Day, 6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The chosen forces a creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's blood turns acidic and it is stunned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
Whenever the stunned creature fails a saving throw to end this condition, it takes 22 (5d8) acid damage.

legendary.name: Needling Link
entries: One creature affected by a spell the chosen is concentrating on takes 4 (1d8) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Sudden Spasm
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 30 feet has its speed reduced by a cumulative 10 feet until the end of its next turn, or 20 feet if it has half its maximum hit points or fewer.
A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 in this way is considered restrained.

legendary.name: Threads of Torment (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The chosen forces a creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and is moved 15 feet in a direction of the chosen's choice.
If the chosen is concentrating on a spell affecting the target, the target has disadvantage on its saving throw.

trait.name: Razor Reflex
entries: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the cultist takes damage, the culist can move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Spirit Breaker
entries: When the cultist deals psychic damage to a creature, it can impose disadvantage on attacks that creature makes until the end of the cultist's next turn.

trait.name: Dark Urge
entries: The first time the cultist deals damage to an incapacitated or restrained target, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Purge Fault (3/Day)
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the cultist can end one condition affecting it, then takes 10 psychic damage for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes three attacks with its Illusory Skewer, one of which it can replace with a use of its Drown in Blood, or Blood to Vitriol, if available.
