entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +11 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage plus one additional effect of the target's choice:

items: The target is dazed until the end of its next turn, or is stunned until the end of its next turn if it was already dazed.
The target takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage the first time it moves or is forced to move at least 5 feet before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and begin choking as blood wells up in its mouth and lungs (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Blood to Vitriol (Recharge 5-6, 6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The exarch forces a creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's blood turns acidic and it is stunned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
Whenever the stunned creature fails a saving throw to end this condition, it takes 22 (5d8) acid damage.

action.name: Unendurable Agony (1/Day, 8th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The exarch causes perception to distort in a 20-foot radius sphere around it, exuding with physical and mental pain. Each creature in the area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes hostile to itself and indifferent to all other creatures for 1 minute.
An affected creature can repeat its saving throw whenever it takes 10 or more damage from a single source, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Anguished Break
entries: When the exarch deals damage that would reduce a creature to 0 hit points, it can cause the target to take no damage and instead become dominated by the exarch for 10 minutes. This effect ends early if the target or the exarch becomes incapacitated.

reaction.name: Shrivel Tongue
entries: When a creature the exarch can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell that involves verbal components, it can force the target to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and can't speak until the end of its next turn, taking half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Needling Link
entries: One creature affected by a spell the exarch is concentrating on takes 4 (1d8) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Sudden Spasm
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 30 feet has its speed reduced by a cumulative 10 feet until the end of its next turn, or 20 feet if it has half its maximum hit points or fewer.
A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 in this way is considered restrained.

legendary.name: Threads of Torment (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The exarch forces a creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and is moved 15 feet in a direction of the exarch's choice.
If the exarch is concentrating on a spell affecting the target, the target has disadvantage on its saving throw.

name: Belial, Lord of Suffering
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lord of the Fourth
entries: The first time each turn that an allied devil within 30 feet dies, Belial gains one additional legendary action that he can use before the end of his next turn.
If Fierna is reduced to 0 hit points, Belial gains one additional legendary action on each of his turns for the next hour.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (3/Day)
entries: When Belial would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
If he does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Belial immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Belial makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Vicious Reap or Lava Geyser.

action.name: Ishlech, the Blighted Pike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away, plus one of the following effects.

items.name: Sunder
entries: The target's AC is reduced by 2 until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Tremble
entries: The target takes an additional 10 psychic damage.

items.name: Wither
entries: If the target has no levels of exhaustion, it gains one level of exhaustion.

action.name: Vicious Reap
entries: Belial leaps up to 20 feet, then forces each creature in a 15-foot cone extending from him to make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) slashing damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away, taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Lava Geyser (5th Level Spell)
entries: Belial causes a torrent of lava to spew up from the earth in a 60-foot high, 15-foot radius cylinder. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) fire damage and is knocked prone, taking half as much damage on a success.
For the next minute, any creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area or steps onto it for the first time on a turn must make the same saving throw.

action.name: Seal of Tyranny (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature Belial can see within 60 feet of him is dominated by him. At the start of each of the target's turns, it can make a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and Belial gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt. On a success, this effect ends for the creature.

reaction.name: Cling to Power
entries: When Belial makes a saving throw to maintain concentration, he can choose to make the saving throw at advantage, but he has disadvantage on all further saves made to maintain concentration until the start of his next turn.

legendary.name: Blighted Strike
entries: Belial moves up to half his speed and can then make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Insidious Shroud
entries: One creature of Belial's choice within 60 feet of him becomes invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it takes any hostile action, and then it can move up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Unworthy Allotment (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each allied devil within 30 feet of Belial that has all of its hit points gains 15 temporary hit points.

name: Glasya, Princess of Hell
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lord of the Sixth
entries: Devils under Glasya's control are immune to the charmed and frightened conditions, and use her bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws, instead of their own.

trait.name: Intoxicating Presence
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Glasya must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against her until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Scornful Gaze
entries: If a creature makes eye contact with Glasya, she learns the creature's greatest desires, doubts, fears, and insecurities.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Glasya has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
entries: When Glasya would fail a saving throw, she can choose to succeed.
If she does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Glasya immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Glasya makes two melee attacks, each of which she can replace with the Dash, Dodge, or Hide action.

action.name: Nettle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) poison and 33 (6d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Vile Embrace
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 22).
While Glasya is grappling a creature charmed by her, the creature is additionally dominated by her.

action.name: Power Word: Dismiss (8th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature Glasya can see within 60 feet of her must make a DC 25 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is banished to the outer void until the end of its next turn, at which point it returns to the nearest unoccupied space to the one it departed.
A creature that starts its turn in the outer void takes 105 (10d10 + 50) force damage. A creature killed by this damage is rent asunder, cast across the void, and does not return.

action.name: Name Champion (Recharge 5-6, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Glasya attempts to infuse a creature charmed by her with vast infernal power, forcing it to make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points. On a success, the creature is dominated by Glasya for as long as she maintains concentration, and acts on her initiative in addition to its own.

reaction.name: Torn Loyalty
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or attack, Glasya may force a creature charmed by her within 5 feet of her to become the target of the spell or attack.

reaction.name: Bloodied Naming (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 179 hit points, Glasya rolls to recharge and immediately uses her Name Champion ability, if available.

legendary.name: Beguiling Whisper
entries: One creature Glasya is grappling must make a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Wisdom score is reduced by 3 (1d6), to a minimum of 1, until it finishes a short or long rest.

legendary.name: Infernal Dispatch
entries: One ally or creature charmed by Glasya that she can see is teleported to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of her.

legendary.name: Innocent Request
entries: One creature charmed by Glasya moves up to half its speed and makes a melee attack, both under Glasya's control.

legendary.name: Parting Caress (Costs 2 Actions).
entries: Glasya moves up to half her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature she passes within 5 feet of as part of this movement takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage if she ends this movement more than 5 feet from it.

name: Levistus, the Frozen Prince
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lord of the Fifth
entries: Devils under Levistus' control are immune to cold damage, and can burrow through ice at half their movement speed.

trait.name: Curse of the Vault
entries: At the beginning of each of his turns, if Levistus has less than 100 temporary hit points, he gains 20 cumulative temporary hit points as thick ice magcially begins to grow outward from him.
While Levistus has any amount of temporary hit points, he can't take reactions. While he has 40 or more temporary hit points, he is restrained and can't cast spells or concentrate.

trait.name: Prince of Betrayal
entries: Levistus has advantage on attacks against a creature within 5 feet of one of his allies or a creature charmed by him.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
entries: When Levistus would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
If he does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Levistus immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Levistus makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with a use of his Iced Earth.

action.name: Frost-Fair Épée
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage and the target suffers one of the following additional effects:

items.name: Bladebeat
entries: The creature's AC is reduced by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Stacatto Remise
entries: The creature takes an an additional 13 (3d8) piercing damage.

items.name: Second Intent
entries: The next attack Levistus makes against the same target before the beginning of his next turn is made at advantage.

action.name: Iced Earth (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Crystals of slick ice spread across the ground at Levistus' feet. Whenever another creature is hit with a melee attack within 5 feet of Levistus, it must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Flesh to Ice (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Levistus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) cold damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage transforms into a statue of glittering ice, and is considered petrified until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic, or until it takes any amount of fire damage.

action.name: Freeze the Blood (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Levistus forces one creature he can see within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) levels of exhaustion, or half as many on a success.

reaction.name: Passata Sotto
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack while he has no temporary hit points, Levistus imposes disadvantage on the strike as he dives beneath it.
If the attack misses, he may make an attack at advantage as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Spell Parry
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell, Levistus makes a melee attack roll against the spell caster's Save DC. On a success, Levistus chooses a new target within 15 feet of him for the spell.

reaction.name: Bloodied Vigor (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 274 hit points, Levistus gains two additional Legendary Actions on each of his turns for the next minute.

legendary.name: Graceful Advance
entries: Levistus moves up to half his speed. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Offer Aid
entries: One creature with 0 hit points within 5 feet of Levistus regains 20 hit points as he helps it stand from prone, and must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or be dominated by him until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Induce Paranoia
entries: One creature Levistus can see within 60 feet must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature cannot be the willing target of a spell or magical effect until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Spirited Exchange (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Levistus makes two attacks with his Frost-Fair Épée. If any of these attacks miss, up to one creature may use its reaction to make a melee attack against him.

legendary.name: Suppress Curse (Costs 2 Actions, Concentration)
entries: Levistus suppresses the effect of one spell or magical effect within 30 feet for as long as he maintains concentration.

name: Fierna, Lady of Flame
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lord of the Fourth
entries: The first time each turn that an allied devil within 30 feet dies, Fierna gains one additional legendary action that she can use before the end of her next turn.
If Belial is reduced to 0 hit points, Fierna gains one additional legendary action on each of her turns for the next hour.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (3/Day)
entries: When Fierna would fail a saving throw, she can choose to succeed.
If she does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Fierna immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Fierna makes three melee attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Wrack or Hurl Meteor.

action.name: Glire, the Profane Flame
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage, plus one of the following effects.

items.name: Scar
entries: The target's hit point maximum is reduced to equal its current hit points.

items.name: Sear
entries: The target begins burning (1d10) or has its burning value increased by 1d10 if it was already burning.

items.name: Slash
entries: The target takes an additional 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

action.name: Wrack (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Fierna forces a creature she can see within 60 feet of her to make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls prone and can't stand up on its following turn.
If the target fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it additionaly subtracts 1d4 from all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws it makes in the next minute.

action.name: Hurl Meteor (6th Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +14 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (10d6) bludgeoning plus 35 (10d6) fire damage.
Against a target at lower elevation than Fierna, this attack has advantage and pushes the target up to 15 feet away on a hit.

action.name: Marrowflame Candle (Recharge 5-6, 8th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Fierna can see within 60 feet of her must make a DC 24 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is cursed. While cursed in this way, whenever the target takes any amount of fire damage, it begins burning (1d10) or has its burning value increased by 1d10 if it was already burning.

entries: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against effects that it or its allies control.

trait.name: Infernal Wrath
entries: The cultist's spell attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

Additionally, once per turn when the cultist scores a critical hit, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet of it to make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the end of the cultist's next turn.

trait.name: Grinding Advance
entries: Whenever the cultist hits a creature with an attack, the next attack that one of its allies makes against the same target before the start of the cultist's next turn is made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Dedication of Flame or Waygate Assault, if available.

action.name: Hellfire Slash (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) fire damage. On a critical hit, the exarch can immediately make an additional attack.

action.name: Siege-Thunder Salvo (5th Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +11 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) thunder damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
This attack deals maximum damage to a target made of inorganic material.

action.name: Dedication of Flame (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The exarch or one willing creature it can see within 30 feet erupts in a torrent of shining flames. The target and each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage, taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Waygate Assault (Recharge 5-6, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The exarch forges a magical gateway to a point it can see within 400 feet, teleporting each willing creature of its choice within 20 feet to an unoccupied space within 20 feet of the chosen point. Each creature teleported in this way can use its reaction to make a weapon attack.

action.name: Light of War Eternal (1/Day, 8th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The exarch begins to glow with a terrible fury in a 30 foot radius. For 10 minutes, whenever an ally of the exarch's is reduced to 0 hit points within this aura, the exarch can restore 1 hit point to it and allow it to stand if it is prone.

reaction.name: Unflinching Resolve
entries: When the exarch makes a saving throw against a spell cast by a creature it can see, it can choose to voluntarily fail the saving throw, then can move up to its speed and make an attack with its Hellfire Slash before suffering the effects of the spell.

reaction.name: Infernal Reserves (1/Day)
entries: When a non-minion ally the exarch can see is reduced to 0 hit points, the exarch summons up to 5 Barbazu Shelltakers to unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the ally.

legendary.name: Goad of Purpose
entries: The chosen or an ally within 30 feet of it gains 10 temporary hit points, then can make a saving throw against an effect that ends on a successful saving throw. The chosen can take this legendary action even while incapacitated.

legendary.name: Into the Fray
entries: The chosen moves up to half its speed directly towards the nearest enemy, then makes an attack with its Hellfire Slash. If the chosen ends its movement within 5 feet of at least two enemies, this attack is made at advantage.

legendary.name: Scorched Earth
entries: The chosen teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then each creature within 1 0feet of it takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Blood's Burden
entries: A creature that kills the cultist has its speed cumulatively reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
A creature that has its speed reduced to 0 in this way falls prone if it is carrying at least 1,000 gp worth of coinage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Branding Die (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 fire damage.
If at least three cultists took this action, the target additionally begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Miser's Mantra (Group Action)
entries: One creature within 30 feet of the cultist that can hear it is cursed until the end of its next turn. While cursed in this way, whenever it expends a resource that recovers on a short or long rest, it takes 3 psychic damage for each cultist that contributed to this action.

name: Cult Fanatic of the Gilded Sovereign

A creature that has its speed reduced to 0 in this way falls prone if it is carrying at least 1,000 gp worth of coinage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Extract Service.

action.name: Tallyman's Axe

If this damage reduces a creature below half of its maximum hit points, attacks are made against it at advantage until the start of the fanatic's next turn.

action.name: Extract Service
entries: One creature in the cultist's debt within 60 feet of it must use its reaction, if available, to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the cultist's choice.

action.name: Coin-Shot Blast (Recharge 5-6, 2nd Level Spell)
entries: The cultist blasts flecks of golden shrapnel forth in a 15-foot cone, forcing each creature in that area to make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) piercing damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away, taking half as much damage on a success.
If only a single creature is affected by this spell, the damage dealt to it is maximized, instead of rolling.

entries: When an ally the fanatic can see within 60 feet of it is reduced to 0 hit points, the fanatic can regain 11 (2d10) hit points.

entries: The cultist has advantage on the first attack roll it makes each turn against the last creature to deal damage to it.

entries: One creature that the devoted can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's AC is reduced by 3 (1d6) and the devoted's AC is increased by the same amount for the next minute.

entries: The exarch thrusts forward a barbed spear of obsidian. One creature within 120 feet must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 69 (6d12 + 30) piercing damage and the exarch can drag it any distace towards it, taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Blood Covenant (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: The exarch touches a creature within 10 feet of it, cursing it. Whenever the cursed creature deals damage to the exarch, it takes psychic damage equal to twice the damage dealt, and the target can make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw, ending the curse on a success.

legendary.name: Borrow Time
entries: The exarch can cause one ally within 60 feet to be stunned until the end of the ally's next turn; if it does, the exarch can immediately use its Trovebond Toll or Sovereign Scales.

legendary.name: Extract Service

name: Paeliryon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Desecrating Presence
entries: Creatures of the devil's choice within 30 ft. of it subtract 1d4 from any saving throws they make.

trait.name: Retractable Claws
entries: As a bonus action, the devil may extend or reduce the reach of its claws by 5 ft., to a maximum of 15 ft.

trait.name: Befuddling Haze
entries: Creatures within 30 ft. of the devil have disadvantage on Insight, Investigation, and Perception ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes three attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its corrupting imprecation.

action.name: Torment Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage and 14 (4d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Corrupting Imprecation
entries: One creature within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or suffer a Curse of Corruption for the next minute. At the beginning of each of a cursed creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Desperate Measures
entries: One friendly devil or dominated creature within 30 ft. may use its reaction to make a melee attack against a creature in range. If the paeliryon has fewer than 169 hit points, each friendly devil and dominated creature in range may instead use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Sway the Corrupt
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is afflicted with a Curse of Corruption must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or act under the devil's control until the end of its following turn.

legendary.name: Doom the Corrupt (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is afflicted with a Curse of Corruption must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or have its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores each reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a short or long rest.

name: Lolth, Queen of the Demonweb
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Nexus of the Great Web
entries: Lolth knows the location, identity, and current hit points of any creature in contact with a spider's web, and cannot be Surprised.
Lolth can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.

trait.name: By the Dark Mother's Design
entries: Lolth does not roll initiative. Instead, if she has not yet taken a turn this round, Lolth may take her turn directly after any other creature's turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Lolth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Lolth fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lolth makes three attacks with her Impaling Legs, one of which she may replace with a use of her Kiss of Lolth or Insidious Embrace.

action.name: Kiss of Lolth
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target is Cursed.
While Cursed in this way, a creature is poisoned, loses any immunity to the poisoned condition or poison damage, and takes 5 (1d10) poison damage at the end of each of its turns.
This curse is suppressed for 24 hours by any effect that cures the poisoned condition.

action.name: Impaling Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage and Lolth may either grapple the target (escape DC 23) or push it 10 feet away.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a death save.

action.name: Insidious Embrace
entries: One creature within 15 feet of Lolth must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 23) in a cocoon of silk.

While restrained in this way, a creature is blinded and has its Charisma score reduced by 5 (2d4) at the end of each of its turns, which lasts until it escapes. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way immediately emerges as a |Chwidencha under Lolth's control.

action.name: Darkfire Abyss (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A burst of black fire erupts in a 15 foot radius centered on a point Lolth can see within 120 feet, leaving behind an area of magical darkness that lasts until dispelled.
Each light in the area is extinguished, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 70 (20d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
At the beginning of each of Lolth's turns, if a source of Bright Light is within 15 feet of the area its radius expands by 5 feet, then each creature in the area takes 17 (5d6) fire damage.

reaction.name: Strands of the Demonweave (5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature she can see within 60 feet casts a spell, Lolth weaves a portion of the expended magic into threads of binding silk.
Any damage dealt by the spell is reduced by half, and the spell's caster must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 23) until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Compelled Betrayal
entries: As a reaction when Lolth is targeted with a ranged attack, she causes the attack to swerve and instead target a creature in the attack's range affected by her Kiss of Lolth.

legendary.name: Bounding Strike
entries: Lolth leaps up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space, then makes a Impaling Legs attack.

legendary.name: Bide Time
entries: Lolth moves up to half her speed and gains 20 temporary hit points.

legendary.name: Lolth's Fickle Favor (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One friendly creature Lolth can see may use its reaction to move up to its speed and make an attack. If the attack misses, the creature explodes in a torrent of venomous spiders.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Spider's Embrace (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Lolth teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space she can see, then forces one creature within 5 feet to make a DC 23 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is grappled (escape DC 23) and Lolth makes an attack against it with her kiss of Lolth.

name: Kerzit, Guardian of the Tome
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Keeper of the Black Lore
entries: Kerzit's spirit is bound to the Tome of the Black Heart. If he is destroyed, whenever a creature dies within 30 feet of the tome he may make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw.

On a success, a rift forms in the creature's body and Kerzit tears forth from it in a new body with half his hit points. For the next minute, Kerzit can't use Legendary Resistances or Legendary Actions.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: Kerzit may move through any space larger than his skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Kerzit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If Kerzit fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kerzit makes three attacks, one of which may be with his Black-Toothed Bite.

action.name: Black-Toothed Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be infecting with Aldinach's Vile Wasting.

action.name: Wormlash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strengh saving throw or be pulled up to 5 feet towards Kerzit and grappled (escape DC 20).

action.name: Chitinous Blades
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Halving Draw (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature grappled by both of Kerzit's Wormlashes must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 65 (10d12) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies and is ripped in two.

bonus.name: Rending Flurry
entries: Kerzit makes two attacks with his Chitinous Blades against a creature grappled by him. If both attacks hit, the creature is afflicted with an abyssal wound.
Until the wounded creature receives magical healing, it loses 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Blightning Strike (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature Kerzit can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity save or take 14 (4d6) lightning plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is unaffected by the first source of healing it recives before the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Maddened Slaver
entries: As a reaction when Kerzit ends his turn without reducing a creature to 0 hit points, he beginst to build up a frothing, foul smelling slaver around his jaws.
Until the end of his next turn, Kerzit has advantage on melee attacks and his speed is doubled.

legendary.name: Weirding Glint (Concentration)
entries: Kerzit creates an illusory terrain feature that fits within a 15 foot radius centered on a point he can see within 60 feet.
The terrain lasts for a minute, and Kerzit may interact with the illusion as though it were real. A creature other than Kerzit physically interacting with the terrain reveals it to be an illusion.

legendary.name: Ignite Dweomer
entries: One creature kerzit can see that is concentrating on a spell must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or burst into flames.
Until a creature takes an action to douse the flames, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

legendary.name: Brutal Charge (Cost 2 Actions)
entries: Kerzit moves up to his speed in a straight line, and may move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. A creature whose space Kerzit enters for the first time on a turn in this way must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze scion can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze scion can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Formless Grace
entries: If the ooze scion would take half damage due to succeeding on a saving throw while within 120 ft. of Juiblex, it takes no damage instead.

trait.name: Acrimony of the Faceless Lord
entries: A creature that takes acid damage while within 5 ft. of one or more ooze scions takes an additional 4 (1d8) acid damage for each ooze scion within 5 ft. of it.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the ooze scion can grapple the target (escape DC 13)

reaction.name: Split
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the ooze scion creates another ooze scion that acts on Juiblex's initiative in the nearest unoccupied space with maximum hit points equal to the original ooze scion's current hit points.

name: Yochlol
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The yochlol can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The yochlol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack (Spider Form Only)
entries: The yochlol makes two attacks with its Venomous Bite.

action.name: Venomous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. (10 ft. in demon form), one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing in spider form damage plus 18 (5d6) poison damage.

action.name: Demonweb Metamorphosis (Demon Form Only)
entries: The yochlol breathes a foul miasma into the lungs of a charmed creature within 5 feet.

The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 4 (1d8) for the next minute, to a minimum of 1. A creature whose Constitution is reduced to 1 in this way transforms into a Drider.

action.name: Charm (Drow Form Only, Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the yochlol can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed.
While charmed in this way, a creature acts under the yochlol's control and repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.
When the yochlol's charm ends on a creature, the creature takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and is immune to this yochlol's Charm for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Compel
entries: One creature charmed by the yochlol must use its reaction to move up to its speed and make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Shift Form
entries: The yochlol transforms into a Medium or Large form that resembles a female drow, a giant spider, or back into its true demonic form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth (Demon or Drow Form Only)
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the yochlol may make a bite attack against the attacker.

reaction.name: Toxic Dissolution (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 111 Hit Points, the Yochlol dissolves into a cloud of poisonous gas and moves up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

A creature whose space it moves through in this way must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. At the beginning of its next turn, the yochlol reverts to its true form.

name: Whisper Demon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The demon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The demon's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Multitattack
entries: The demon makes two attacks with its maddening touch and uses its whispers of madness, if available.

action.name: Maddening Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 2) psychic damage and the target's Wisdom is reduced by 2 (1d4) until it completes a short or long rest. A creature reduced to 0 Wisdom in this way becomes hostile to all living creatures, including itself, until it recovers.

action.name: Whispers of Madness (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each non-fiend, non-undead creature within 30 ft. must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature uses its reaction to move up to make a melee attack against a living creature in range.

action.name: Create Allip
entries: One unconscious humanoid creature within 10 ft. of the demon must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or make a melee attack against itself. If the attack hits, the creature dies and rises as an allip at the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light Only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the wraith may teleport up to 60 feet and turn invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

name: Quantum Warp
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Quantum Body
entries: The warp can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and end its turn there there, and can move through any gap that isn't air tight without squeezing.

trait.name: Unstable Core
entries: Whenever the warp deals or takes damage, flip a coin. If it comes up heads, the warp explodes in a 10-foot radius. All creatures in the area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage and be pulled 10 feet towards the warp, or half as much damage on a success.
If it explodes, flip a coin at the start of its next turn. If it comes up heads, the warp reforms in the same location with 1 hit point. If this trait was caused by radiant damage, it can't reform.

trait.name: Event Horizon
entries: Creatures that start their turn within 5 feet of the warp take 2 (1d4) force damage.

action.name: Grav-Shear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) force damage and the target is pulled 5 feet towards the warp.

name: Void Siphon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Vacuum Body
entries: The siphon can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and end its turn there there, and can move through any gap that isn't air tight without squeezing.
While the siphon occupies the space of another creature, that creature is choking, deafened, and immune to thunder damage.

trait.name: Silent Invisibility
entries: The siphon is invisible and silent.

trait.name: Pressure Differential
entries: The area within 10 feet of the siphon is considered difficult terrain and slowly drains of warmth. A creature who moves there for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 (1d10) force damage and must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet closer to the siphon. If thisw movement lifts it into the air, it begins levitating.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The siphon makes two attacks with its Gravitic Claws, one of which may be replaced with its Siphon Heat, if available.

action.name: Gravitic Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Siphon Heat (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The siphon drains the thermal energy of its surroundings. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) cold damage and has disadvantage on Strength ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success. Nonmagical flames within the area are extinguished.

bonus.name: Siphon Air
entries: If a creature in the same space as the siphon is choking, it must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or stop holding its breath.

reaction.name: One with Nothing
entries: When a creature enters the siphon's space due to its Pressure Differential feature, the siphon can attach the target to it (remove DC 16).

name: Dark Matter Debility
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Vacuum Body
entries: The debility can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and end its turn there there, and can move through any gap that isn't air tight without squeezing.
While the debility occupies the space of another creature, that creature is choking, deafened, and immune to thunder damage.

trait.name: Silent Invisibility
entries: The debility is invisible and silent.

trait.name: Pressure Differential
entries: The area within 10 feet of the debility is considered difficult terrain and slowly drains of warmth. A creature who moves there for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 (1d10) force damage and must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet closer to the debility. If thisw movement lifts it into the air, it begins levitating.

trait.name: Withering Drain
entries: Whenever the debility deals necrotic damage to a creature, the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its hit point maximum is reduced by an equal amount until cured with a greater restoration spell or similar magic.

action.name: Non-Baryonic Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is choking, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or stop holding its breath.

action.name: Entropic Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, range 50 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) necrotic damage and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the debility's next turn.

action.name: Dark Halo (Recharge 6)
entries: The debility releases a wave of invisible energy around it. Creatures within 30 feet of the debility must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) force damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Axionic Propulsion
entries: The debility moves up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. If the debility moves through the space of a creature during this movement, the creature takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Entropic Barrage (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The debility uses its Entropic Bolt three times.

reaction.name: Vacuum Field
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the debility ends its turn without having moved, the debility may envelop it in a vacuum field for 1 minute. While the creature remains in the vacuum field, it is choking, deafened, and immune to thunder damage, and it takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.
An affected creature can make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Anomaly
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Vacuum Body
entries: The anomaly can occupy another creature's space and vice versa and end its turn there there, and can move through any gap that isn't air tight without squeezing.
While the anomaly occupies the space of another creature, that creature is choking, deafened, and immune to thunder damage.

trait.name: Silent Invisibility
entries: The anomaly is invisible and silent.

trait.name: Pressure Differential
entries: The area within 30 feet of the anomaly is considered difficult terrain and slowly drains of warmth. A creature who moves there for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 13 (2d12) force damage and must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet closer to the anomaly. If thisw movement lifts it into the air, it begins levitating.

trait.name: Duality
entries: The anomaly has two states - Phase Shift and Nullfield. While in Phase Shift state, the anomaly can't be targeted by weapon attacks. While in Nullfield state, the anomaly projects an antimagic field within 20 feet of it.
Whenever the anomaly takes any amount of force damage, it switches between states.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the anomaly fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it takes 25 force damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anomaly makes four attacks in any combination of its Multi-State Rip and Phase Through. It can also replace one of its attacks with Reality Tear.

action.name: Multi-State Rip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) force damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

If the anomaly is in Phase Shift state, any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. If the anomaly is in Nullfield state, the target has disadvantage on Strength ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the anomaly's next turn.

action.name: Phase Through
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) force damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If the target is choking, it must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or stop holding its breath.

action.name: Reality Tear (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The anomaly opens a tear in reality at a point within 60 feet of it. Creatures within 20 feet of the tear must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) force damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

In addition, the closest creature to the tear which fails its saving throw, picking at random if multiple creatures tie for closest, is pulled through it. The creature is banished to a harmless demiplane for 1 minute, after which time it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space to where it left. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, returning early on a success.

reaction.name: Gravitational Pulse
entries: When the anomaly switches states, it can release a ripple in space-time. Each creature within 30 feet of the anomaly must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw or become restrained (escape DC 19).

trait.name: Ash Body
entries: The astigator can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Ash Glide
entries: While burrowing through ash, the ashtigator doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

action.name: Ashgrip Nip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage plus 1 cold damage, and if the target is a Tiny or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 10). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the ashtigator can't bite another target.

reaction.name: Lunge
entries: When a creature moves within 20 feet of the ashtigator, it may move up to its movement speed towards that creature and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Ash Body
entries: The astigator can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While the ashtigator occupies a creature's space, that creature is blinded, choking, and takes 3 (1d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Ash Glide
entries: While burrowing through ash, the ashtigator doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries: If the ashtigator is reduced to 0 hit points by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Ashgrip Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the ashtigator can't bite another target.

reaction.name: Lunge
entries: When a creature moves within 20 feet of the ashtigator, it may move up to its movement speed towards that creature and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Ash Body
entries: The lurker can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While the lurker occupies a creature's space, that creature is blinded, choking, and takes 3 (1d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Ash Glide
entries: While burrowing through ash, the lurker doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries: If the lurker is reduced to 0 hit points by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Ashen Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and pulled 15 feet towards the lurker.

bonus.name: Reel
entries: The lurker pulls a creature grappled by it up to 15 feet towards it.

trait.name: Ash Body
entries: The catalytic can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While the catalytic occupies a creature's space, that creature is blinded and choking. A creautre that starts its turn within 30 feet of the catalytic takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

trait.name: Ash Glide
entries: While burrowing through ash, the catalytic doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries: If the catalytic is reduced to 0 hit points by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (11d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Catalytic Air
entries: The air within 30 feet of the catalytic is rendered volatile by its presence. Fire spells and effects that create an area that originate within this aura have their area of effects doubled. In addition, single-target fire spells or effects that deal damage, detonate, dealing the same damage in a 10-foot radius centered on the original target. Creature other than the target can make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, halving the damage on a success.

action.name: Dizzying Punch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage and the target has disadvantage on Dexterity ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of the catalytic's next turn.

action.name: Excessive Weathering (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The catalytic erodes the flesh of nearby creatures, causing it to flake off as pieces of ash. Creatures within 30 feet of the catalytic must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Ashen Refraction
entries: When the catalytic is targeted by a spell or included in the area of one, it can fill the area within its Catalytic Air aura with a cloud of ash. The caster of the spell must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, if the caster targteted the catalytic, it must choose a new target. If the caster targeted a point within the aura, the spell's point of origin is moved to a new point of the catalytic's choice on the outer edge of its aura.
When the catalytic uses this reaction, until the start of its next turn, the area within its aura is lightly obscured.

trait.name: Ash Body
entries: The wolf can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While the wolf occupies a creature's space, that creature is blinded and choking. A creautre that starts its turn within 30 feet of the wolf takes 14 (4d6) cold damage.

trait.name: Ash Glide
entries: While burrowing through ash, the wolf doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries: If the wolf is reduced to 0 hit points by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 80 (23d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Relentless Hunt
entries: The wolf always knows the exact location of a creature it has dealt damage to.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The wolf has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Indolent Haze
entries: The area around the wolf is filled with falling flakes of ash. The wolf and creatures within 30 feet of it are considered dazed.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: When the wolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Ash-Cold Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage and the target cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Ashen Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) cold damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 22).

action.name: Howl of the Ashes (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The wolf emits a loud, long howl that can heard 1 mile away. Creatures within 120 feet of it must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is deafened and frightened of the wolf for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Ashen Jaunt
entries: The wolf disappears and reppears in an unoccupied space within 100 feet of a creature it has dealt damage to before, regardless of distance or plane.

reaction.name: Ashen Pursuit
entries: When a creature the wolf has dealt damage to before teleports or uses any form of extraplanar travel, the wolf can choose to follow it. If the effect was caused by a spell of 4th level or lower, the wolf appears within 15 feet of the target.

If the effect was caused by a spell of 5th level or higher, the teleportation is slowed, and all those involved are instead teleported to a demiplane. The wolf and every creature involved are under the effects of the Time Stop spell and can interact with each other freely without ending the spell. Teleportation and extraplanar travel fail for the duration, and when the spell ends, the creatures reach their intended destination. The wolf can accompany them if it chooses, or it can remain on the demiplane.

If a creature is knocked unconscious or dies during the spell, unless it is being carried by a conscious creature, it remains in the demiplane. A creature grappled by the wolf remains grappled by it, and remains in whichever plane the wolf is in.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The wolf makes an attack.

legendary.name: Jaunt
entries: The wolf moves up to its speed or uses its Ashen Jaunt.

legendary.name: Grim Advance (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The wolf moves up to its speed in a straight line. Any creature whose space it moves through during this movement must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) cold damage and being knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Whiteout Pulse (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Ash erupts outwards from the wolf. Until the end of its next turn, the area within 30 feet of it is heavily obscured for creatures other than it.

name: Salty Puppy
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Vulnerability
entries: The puppy takes double damage from water-based attacks. Water spells that do not ordinarily inflict damage deal 3 (1d6) acid damage per level of spell. If the puppy starts its turn immersed in water, it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Salt Glide
entries: While burrowing through salt, the puppy doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

action.name: Jagged Nip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 piercing damage plus 1 necrotic damage.

name: Salty Hound
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Vulnerability
entries: The hound takes double damage from water-based attacks. Water spells that do not ordinarily inflict damage deal 3 (1d6) acid damage per level of spell. If the hound starts its turn immersed in water, it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Salt Glide
entries: While burrowing through salt, the hound doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

action.name: Jagged Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Salt Shake (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hound shakes its body back and forth, shedding razor-sharp salt crystals. Creatures within 10 feet of the hound must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) slashing damage and becoming blinded until the end of its next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Sel Gris Falcon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Vulnerability
entries: The falcon takes double damage from water-based attacks. Water spells that do not ordinarily inflict damage deal 3 (1d6) acid damage per level of spell. If the falcon starts its turn immersed in water, it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Salt Glide
entries: While burrowing through salt, the falcon doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Salt Body
entries: The falcon can enter another creature's space and end its turn there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While the falcon occupies a creature's space, that creature is blinded, choking, and takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Sipping Peck
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Crystalline Feather
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest, and the target begins bleeding (1d8).

reaction.name: Body Block
entries: When the falcon is targeted by an attack made by a creature within 5 feet of it, it can move into that creature's space.

name: Saltbite Basilisk
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Vulnerability
entries: The basilisk takes double damage from water-based attacks. Water spells that do not ordinarily inflict damage deal 3 (1d6) acid damage per level of spell. If the basilisk starts its turn immersed in water, it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Salt Glide
entries: While burrowing through salt, the basilisk doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Withering Gaze
entries: If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature can't regain hit points until the start of its next turn.

A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the basilisk sees its reflection within 30 feet of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basilisk makes two attacks with its talons and one attack with its bite.

action.name: Salt Snap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If the target is petrified, the basilisk regains hit points equal to the amount of piercing damage dealt, and the target suffers a slashing injury.

If the target is not petrified, it must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained as its flesh begins to turn to crystalline salt. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

action.name: Raking Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If a creature is hit with two talon attacks in the same turn, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the start of its next turn.

name: Exsiccator
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Vulnerability
entries: The exsiccator takes double damage from water-based attacks. Water spells that do not ordinarily inflict damage deal 3 (1d6) acid damage per level of spell. If the exsiccator starts its turn immersed in water, it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Salt Glide
entries: While burrowing through salt, the exsiccator doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Dessicating Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the exsiccator takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and its hit point maximum is reduced by the same amount.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exsiccator makes three attacks with its Enervating Blow, one of which can be replaced with its Deep Breath or its Crystalshard Breath if available.

action.name: Enervating Blow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.

On a hit, target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its Strength score is reduced by 1d4. A creature whose Strength score is reduced to 0 in this way dies, and its body is drained of all moisture.

action.name: Deep Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The exsiccator takes a deep breath in, absorbing all moisture in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage, its hit point maximum is reduced by an equal amount, it gains a level of exhaustion, and it is pulled 30 feet towards the exsiccator. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and its hit point maximum is still reduced.
After using this action, the exsiccator gains the ability to use its Crystalshard Breath on a following turn.

action.name: Crystalshard Breath
entries: The exsiccator exhales rapidly, breathing out hardened shards of salt in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Creatures in the area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 (12d6) slashing damage and begins bleeding (2d10), or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Drain Potion
entries: When a creature within 120 feet of the exsiccator drinks a potion, the exsiccator can drain the potion of its moisture, gaining its effects as if it had drank it.

name: Saltstorm Imperator
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from magical sources
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Vulnerability
entries: The imperator takes double damage from water-based attacks. Water spells that do not ordinarily inflict damage deal 3 (1d6) acid damage per level of spell. If the imperator starts its turn immersed in water, it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Salt Glide
entries: While burrowing through salt, the imperator doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Dessicating Storm
entries: Surrounding the imperator is a storm of razor-sharp salt crystals. The area within 60 feet of the imperator is heavily obscured and is considered a strong wind. A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the imperator takes 14 (4d6) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until it finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Imperator makes three attacks with its with its Shardstorm Slam and one with its Sirocco Lash.

action.name: Shardstorm Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.

On a hit, target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its Strength score is reduced by 1d4. A creature whose Strength score is reduced to 0 in this way dies, and its body is drained of all moisture.

action.name: Sirocco Lash
entries: The imperator swings a lash of salt crystals in a 40-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, it gains a level of exhaustion, and its maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Salt Crusting
entries: The imperator launches balls of sticky salt towards a creture within 60 feet of it which break apart on impact and cover the target. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, its maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest, and it is restrained (escape DC 18). If the target takes any amount of bludgeoning damage, it is freed from its restraints.

reaction.name: Shed Salt
entries: When the imperator takes 25 or more damage from a single source, it can use its Salt Crusting.

name: Halite Kraken
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from magical sources
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Vulnerability
entries: The kraken takes double damage from water-based attacks. Water spells that do not ordinarily inflict damage deal 3 (1d6) acid damage per level of spell. If the kraken starts its turn immersed in water, it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage.

trait.name: Salt Glide
entries: While burrowing through salt, the imperator doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Tentacles
entries: The kraken has 10 tentacles, each of which behaves as a seperate creature that acts on the kraken's initiative and have the following properties:

items.name: Length
entries: Each tentacle is 300 feet long.

items.name: Hit Points
entries: Each tentacle has AC 18 and 81 hit points. When reduced to 0 hit points, the tentacle drops anything it is grappling and retreats to the kraken's body.

items.name: Movement
entries: Each tentacle has a speed of 15 feet.

items.name: Senses
entries: Each tentacle has blindsight 5 ft. (blind beyond that radius).

items.name: Grappling
entries: The tentacle may grapple one creature or object each turn (escape DC 20). A creature may make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to avoid this grapple. A tentacle may grapple multiple creatures or objects.

items.name: Fling
entries: The tentacle flings an object or creature grappled by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled.
A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

trait.name: Siphoning Aura
entries: The area within 120 feet of the kraken is constantly drained of moisture. A creature that starts its turn within the area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and gains a level of exhaustion, or half as much damage on a success. Its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a short or long rest, and the kraken regains an equal number of hit points.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it takes 25 damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken can use its Gaping Maw and Crush if it is available.

action.name: Gaping Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) necrotic damage, and the target's maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until the target finishes a short or long rest.

On a hit, target is swallowed. While swallowed in this way, it takes 11 (2d12) necrotic damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns, and its maximum hit points is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until it finishes a short or long rest.

If the kraken takes more than 20 damage from a creature swallowed by it in a single turn, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures in the nearest unoccupied spaces.

action.name: Crush (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature the kraken's tentacles have grappled takes 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage until it finishes a short or long rest.
Each creature must also make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or suffer a bludgeoning injury.

action.name: Salt Eruption (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The kraken erupts salt from the ground in a 60-foot radius centered on itself. Each creature must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 66 (12d10) slashing damage and is dazed until the beginning of the kraken's next turn, taking half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The kraken moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Tentacle
entries: One of the kraken's tentacles attempts to grapple a creature or object, or flings a creature or object it is grappling.

legendary.name: Salt Jet (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The kraken expels a cloud of abrasive salt in a 60-foot radius sphere centered on itself. The area is heavily obscured and lasts until the end of the kraken's next turn. When a creature other than the kraken enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

name: Razor Flake
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Aquan and Auran but can't speak

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The flake has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in icy or snowy environments.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The flake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Embed
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) slashing damage and the flake attaches to the target (remove DC 13). When the flake becomes attached in this way, the target starts bleeding (1d4). If it is already bleeding, its bleeding value increases by 1d4. The bleeding cannot be stopped until the flake is removed or dies.

At the start of each of the flake's turns while it remains attached, it regains 1d4 hit points. If the flake hits a target it is attached to with this attack, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the flake's next turn.

reaction.name: Explosive Exit
entries: When the flake takes any amount of damage while it is attached to a creature, it can detach itself and fly up to half its speed, dealing 1d4 slashing damage to the creature it was attached to.

name: Hoarfrost Bull
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Brittle Form
entries: If the bull takes any amount of bludgeoning or thunder damage, the next attack against it ignores its damage resistances.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bull makes three attacks, two with its Chillgore and one with its Frostbite, or one attack with its Chillgore and a use of its Subzero Snort if available. It can replace its Chillgore attacks with Frigid Thrash attacks if it is grappling a target with its bite.

action.name: Chillgore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.
If the bull moved at least 20 feet towards its target before making this attack, the target takes an additional 15 (4d8) cold damage and must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Frostbite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) and must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be restrained while it remains grappled.

action.name: Frigid Thrash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target grappled by the bull. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) cold damage.
Alternatively, the bull can swing the grappled creature to hit another target within 10 feet, dealing 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage to both on a hit.

action.name: Subzero Snort (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bull snorts out a freezing fog in a 20-foot radius around itself, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

The fog remains for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind and heavily obscures the area. A creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 7 (2d6) cold damage.

reaction.name: Bellowing Kick
entries: If the bull is hit with an attack by a creature within 5 feet of it, it can drop any creatures it is grappling and make a Chillgore attack against the attacker. On a hit, the target is additionally pushed 10 feet away.

name: Whiteout
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Snowswirl Form
entries: The whiteout can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing and can move through the space of other creatures and end its turn there. A creature whose space the whiteout enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn within takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.

trait.name: Living Blizzard
entries: The area within 120 feet of the whiteout is a constant, relentless blizzard. The area is heavily obscured and is considered difficult terrain. Ranged attacks made within or targeting a point within the blizzard are made at disadvantage. Nonmagical flight is impossible. Water within the area freezes. A creature that enters the blizzard for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 3 (1d6) cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The whiteout makes three attacks with its Dendrite Shards, of which any can be replaced with Avalanche Slam.

action.name: Dendrite Shards
