entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) cold damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the whiteout's next turn.

action.name: Avalanche Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) cold damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away.

action.name: Snowsquall Gale (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The whiteout releases a powerful blast of freezing wind in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) cold damage and is restrained (escape DC 17), or half as much on a success. A restrained creature that takes any amount of bludgeoning, fire, or thunder damage is freed.

bonus.name: Violent Vortex
entries: The whiteout swirls violently, bringing forth a much stronger blizzard. Until the end of the whiteout's next turn, the blizzard within 30 feet of it intensifies, applying a random one of the following effects.

items.name: 1. Acid Sleet
entries: Creatures that enter the blizzard for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage and begin burning (1d10 acid).

items.name: 2. Blood Snow
entries: A creature that enters the blizzard for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there has its Constitution score reduced by 1d4 until it finishes a long rest. A creature whose Constitution score is reduced to 0 dies, and is frozen solid.

items.name: 3. Death Hail
entries: Creatures that enter the blizzard for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and have their maximum hit points reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt until they finish a short or long rest.

items.name: 4. Electric Storm
entries: Creatures that enter the blizzard for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 10 (3d6) lightning damage and drop any metal objects they are holding.

items.name: 5. Howling Winds
entries: Creatures that enter the blizzard for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage and are frightened of the whiteout for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: 6. Negation Flurry
entries: Creatures that enter the blizzard for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage and any spells of 3rd-level or lower on it ends.

items.name: 7. Razor Sleet
entries: Creatures that enter the blizzard for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 10 (3d6) slashing damage and begin bleeding (1d10).

items.name: 8. Thundersnow
entries: Creatures that enter the blizzard for the first time on a turn or start their turn there take 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 10 (3d6) thunder damage and are dazed until the end of their next turn.

name: Snowdrift Stalker
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ice Glide
entries: While burrowing through ice or snow, the stalker doesn't disturb the material it moves through.
Additionally, the stalker can move across difficult terrain composed of ice or snow without expending extra movement, and it can't slip on ice.

action.name: Snow Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

action.name: Snowball
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) cold damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the stalker's next turn.

action.name: Snowy Tomb (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The stalker attempts to engulf a creature of its size or smaller. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage and be engulfed within the stalker. Engulfed creatures are restrained, blinded, choking, and take 4 (1d8) cold damage at the start of each of their turns. A creature can attempt a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check to escape.
If the stalker is in snowball form, the target has disadvantage on its saving throw.

bonus.name: Rolling Snowball
entries: The stalker reshapes itself into a giant snowball, or back into its humanoid form. While in snowball form, it gains an additional 10 feet of movement.

name: Blackice Lurker
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Ice Glide
entries: While burrowing through ice or snow, the lurker doesn't disturb the material it moves through.
Additionally, the lurker can move across difficult terrain composed of ice or snow without expending extra movement, and it can't slip on ice.

trait.name: Glacial Polish
entries: In dim light or darkness, the lurker is treated as invisible, even to those with darkvision, truesight or ways to see invisibility, unless a creature rolls a DC 19 (Wisdom) Perception check or their passive perception is 19 or higher.

In bright light, the reflective surface of the lurker can cause blindness. If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the lurker and can see it, it must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is blinded until the start of its next turn.

A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the lurker until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the lurker in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Brittle Form
entries: If the lurker takes any amount of bludgeoning or thunder damage, the next attack against it ignores its damage resistances, and its Glacial Polish trait is suppressed until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: On Thin Ice
entries: Any ground or water surface within 20 feet of the lurker becomes coated with a thin layer of black ice, creating difficult terrain. Creatures who end their turn on the black ice must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lurker makes two attacks with its Blackglaze Impact.

action.name: Blackglaze Impact
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 16). If the target takes any amount of bludgeoning or fire damage, it is freed from its restraints. If the target was freed as a result of this attack, it does not need to make the saving throw.

action.name: Frozen Coat (1/Day)
entries: Prone creatures within 20 feet of the lurker begin to be covered in black ice, restraining them (escape DC 16). If a creature takes any amount of bludgeoning or fire damage, it is freed from its restraints.

bonus.name: Slip Trip
entries: The lurker forces one grounded creature within 20 feet of it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

reaction.name: Coat Weapon
entries: When the lurker takes damage from a melee weapon, it can use its reaction to coat the weapon in a layer of black ice. The weapon's wielder must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or drop the weapon as it becomes painfully cold to the touch.

name: Wastrilith Chthonian
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the wastrilith and can see it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or lose the ability to feel compassion or empathy.

An affected creature cannot target a friendly creature with a spell or magical effect, and any friendly creature that attempts to cast healing magic within 10 feet of the affected creature must succeed on a Dexterity check contested by the affected creature or have the affected creature become the magic's new target.
An affected creature can repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Villiform Teeth
entries: The wastrilith does not automatically release creatures grappled by its Bonescraper Bite when incapacitated.
A creature grappled in this way that attempts to escape takes 13 (2d12) piercing damage, and a creature freed from this grapple by forced movement takes 26 (4d12) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the wastrilith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wastrilith makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bonescraper Bite. It may replace any number of attacks with uses of its Gulp Down.

action.name: Bonescraper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 46 (6d12 + 7) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 22).

action.name: Carcass Hooks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Gulp Down
entries: One creature grapppled by the wastrilith takes 13 (2d12) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be restrained for as long as it remains grappled.
If the creature was already restrained, it instead takes 26 (4d12) piercing damage and becomes Swallowed for as long as it remains grappled on a failed save.

action.name: Polluted Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The wastrilith breathes forth a torrent of black bile in a 60 foot cone, heavily obscuring the area until the beginning of its next turn.

Each creature swallowed by the wastrilith and each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) acid plus 21 (6d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
Each creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, a creature is stunned.

legendary.name: Gulp Down
entries: The wastrilith uses its Gulp Down.

legendary.name: Pressure Pulse
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the wastrilith must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away.

legendary.name: Sinuous Slice (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The wastrilith moves up to half its swim speed and makes two attacks with its Carcass Hooks.

name: Wastrilith Krasis
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Corrupt Water
entries: At the start of each of the wastrilith's turns, exposed water within 30 feet of it is corrupted. Underwater, this effect lightly obscures the area until a current clears it away.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be unable to distinguish friend from foe until the beginning of its next turn.
On a success, a creature becomes immune to the effect for 24 hours.

trait.name: Villiform Teeth
entries: The wastrilith does not automatically release creatures grappled by its Bonescraper Bite when incapacitated.
A creature grappled in this way that attempts to escape takes 6 (1d12) piercing damage, and a creature freed from this grapple by forced movement takes 13 (2d12) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wastrilith uses Grasping Spout and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bonescraper Bite.

action.name: Bonescraper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Carcass Hooks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Grasping Spout (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The wastrilith launches a spout of water at one creature it can see within 60 feet, which must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage and be pulled up to 30 feet toward the wastrilith.

action.name: Boiling Breath (6th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The wastrilith exhales a torrent of boiling water in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 42 (12d6) fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Each Medium or smaller creature in the area is pushed up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Oceanic Assault (1/Day, 7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The wastrilith transforms an unoccupied 5 foot radius space filled with water that it can see within 30 feet into a Water Weird that lasts for a minute and acts on the wastrilith's initiative and under its control.
On each of its turns for the next minute, the wastrilith may repeat this action, summoning an additional Water Weird.
While the wastrilith has three or more summoned water weirds active at a time, it has disadvantage on saves to maintain concentration.

reaction.name: Rime Sphere (5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 111 hit points, the wastrilith raises a 30 foot radius spherical barrier of ice centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, pushing each creature in the barrier's space to a side of the creature's choice.

The barrier can be damaged and destroyed (AC 10, 100 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage), and whenever a creature deals 25 or more damage to the barrier in a turn it may open a breach large enough for a Medium creature to squeeze through at a point in the attack's reach or range.

name: Vrock Desecrator
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fleshgorger Rampage
entries: When the vrock reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the vrock gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.
If the creature was a demon, the vrock instead gains twice as many temporary hit points and can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make an attack with its Burning Beak.

trait.name: Inevitable Betrayal
entries: The vrock has advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against an allied creature.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vrock has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vrock makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Burning Beak.

action.name: Burning Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

action.name: Gnarled Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Felloil Rain (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 5 foot radius column extending beneath the vrock is doused in a fine mist of glistening oil, and must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (8d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

If an affected creature takes any fire damage in the next minute, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Wheel of Ruin (1/Day, 6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The vrock conjures an abyssal storm that lasts for a minute and follows its movement as it flies.

On each of the vrock's turns, it may call down demonic lightning as a bonus action. The vrock and each creature encircled by the movement the vrock took this turn must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) lightning plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Fiendripper Mites
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the vrock scatters a hail of venomous, biting parasites from its feathers, covering the attacker.

Until a creature takes an action to remove them, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw and the beginning of each of its turns or take 1d10 poison damage and be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 hit points, the vrock emits a horrific screech. Each other creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

name: Vrock Schemer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fleshgorger Rampage
entries: When the vrock reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the vrock gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.
If the creature was a demon, the vrock instead gains twice as many temporary hit points and can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make an attack with its Serrated Beak.

trait.name: Inevitable Betrayal
entries: The vrock has advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against an allied creature.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vrock has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vrock makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Serrated Beak.

action.name: Serrated Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage.
This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

action.name: Gnarled Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
entries: The vrock emits a horrific screech. Each other creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

reaction.name: Fiendripper Mites
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the vrock scatters a hail of venomous, biting parasites from its feathers, covering the attacker.

Until a creature takes an action to remove them, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw and the beginning of each of its turns or take 1d10 poison damage and be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Winds of Conflict
entries: At the beginning of the vrock's turns, each non-vrock creature within 30 feet of 3 or more vrock kettlers must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 3 bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet toward the nearest non-vrock creature.

action.name: Flocking Rake (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 slashing damage.
If at least two other vrocks added to this attack, attacks of opportunity the target makes this turn are made at disadvantage.

name: Uzollru
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The uzullru has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Colossal Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the uzollru may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the uzollru. While climbing on the uzollru, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the uzollru is staggered by the magnitude of its insignificance, and must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw.

On a failed saving throw, a creature loses all sense of self preservation. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks against the affected creature have advantage, and the creature cannot voluntarily move away from the uzollru.
On a successful saving throw, a creature becomes immune to this effect for 1 hour.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the uzollru fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The uzollru makes two melee attacks; one with its Seizer Claw and one with its Crusher Claw.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20) and dragged up to 25 feet towards the uzollru. A creature grappled in this way takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 51 (8d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Feeder Tendrils
entries: the uzullru's feeder tendrils burrow into the body of a creature grappled by it, injecting digestive enzymes.
The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 10 (3d6) until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
The target's maximum hit points are not affected by this reduction, and it dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0.

legendary.name: Searing Gaze
entries: One creature affected by the uzollru's Form of Madness must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the uzollru's next turn.

legendary.name: Angle Armor Plating
entries: The uzollru chooses a direction, increasing its AC by 5 against attacks made from that direction by creatures that are not climbing on it until the beginning of its turn.

legendary.name: Sudden Revelation (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature immune to the uzollru's Form of Madness must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn and lose any immunity it has to the uzollru's Form of Madness.

legendary.name: Design Intent: Angles of Attack
entries: The direction as indicated by the Angle Armor Plating legendary action behaves as a cone of arbitrary size extending from the center of the uzollru's space.
The intent is that creatures trying to keep their distance should have difficulty repositioning to avoid it, but creatures that are close should be able to see and play around it without issue.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the tanarukk can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tanarukk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Burning of Aeons
entries: Whenever the tanarukk takes fire damage, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tanarukk makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose an ear.

action.name: Fireburst Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one of the following effects:
If the target was not on fire, it catches fire. Until a creature takes an action to extinguish it, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

If the target was on fire, an explosion of flame flares out from it. Each creature within 20 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage and be knocked prone, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Fury Unleashed
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the tanarukk erupts into flame.
For the next minute, the tanarukk takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns, and deals an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage with each of its attacks.

name: Succubus Castle-Toppler

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the succubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The fiend can communicate with a creature charmed by it over any distance.

trait.name: Untouchable Poise
entries: Attacks made against the succubus do not add the attacker's proficiency bonus.

action.name: Barbed Command
entries: Up to two creatures charmed by the succubus each take 16 (3d10) psychic damage, then use their reaction to move up to their speed and take an action.

action.name: Devouring Charm
entries: One humanoid the succubus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed and under the succubus' control.

At the beginning of each of its turns, if the charmed creature has any unexpended hit dice it repeats this saving throw, losing three unexpended hit dice on a failure or ending the effect on a success. When the succubus' charm ends on a creature, the creature takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage and is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Withering Glare
entries: As a reaction when a creature the succubus can see targets it with an attack or harmful spell, the succubus eyes flash with power and disdain. The attacker must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone and have the attack or spell fail.

entries: If the fiend takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 13 until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Spiderlike
entries: The fiend can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.

trait.name: Jealous Hunter

action.name: Venom Globe

name: Miska, the Wolf-Spider
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Archon of Carnage
entries: Whenever Miska reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each demon within 60 feet of him that can see him gains advantage on attacks and ignores the effects of the charmed and frightened conditions until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: Miska can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, Miska knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Ichor Unchained (5/Day)
entries: If Miska fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. The first time each turn a creature hits Miska with a melee attack, it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage for each remaining use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Miska makes four attacks, two of which can be with his Chaos Tether.

action.name: Fork of Havoc
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.
A creature killed by this damage explodes, dealing 22 (4d10) fire damage to each creature within 15 feet of it.

action.name: Chaos Tether (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +13 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d8) force damage, then the target and Miska make a contested Charisma saving throw. The creature with the lower result teleports to the nearest unoccupied space to the other creature.

action.name: Scatterspell Bombardment (6th Level Spell)
entries: The evoker launches a cascade of shimmering orbs in a 60 foot cone that detonate as they hit the ground, forcing each creature in the area to make three DC 21 Dexterity saving throws.
For each failed saving throw, a creature takes 14 (4d6) damage of one type of the evoker's choice; acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

action.name: Demon Warp (8th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Miska can see within 60 feet of him other than himself gains 150 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the creature is transformed into a Glabrezu Persecuter and is hostile towards all creatures.
An unwilling creature can make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw to resist this effect.

action.name: Wound Reality (1/Day, Concentration, 9th Level Spell)
entries: Miska carves a ragged tear in the fabric of reality in a 10-foot long, 5-foot wide line within 15 feet of him. When Miska casts this spell and at the start of each of his turns for the next 10 minutes, each creature other than him within 60 feet of the tear takes 22 (4d10) force damage and is dragged up to 20 feet towards it.

A creature that ends this movement within 5 feet of the tear must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is dragged into the Astral Plane. The creature can repeat this saving throw as an action, returning through the tear on a success. If this spell ends while a creature is on the Astral Plane, it remains trapped there.

bonus.name: Devour Essence
entries: Miska reduces a demon of CR 10 or below that is grappled by him to 0 hit points and devours it, regaining hit points equal to the number of hit points the target lost.

bonus.name: Gush Venom
entries: Each creature grappled by Miska takes 14 (4d6) poison damage. Then, if a creature is below half of its maximum hit points, it must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is stunned until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Roar Forth Chaos (1/Day)
entries: If Miska's Wound Reality is active, 2d4 Spyder Fiend Raklupises that act on initiative count 0 emerge from the tear, appearing in the nearest unoccupied spaces.

legendary.name: Insatiable Maw
entries: Miska snaps at a creature within 10 feet of him, forcing it to make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage and is grappled (escape DC 21).

legendary.name: Skittering Stomp
entries: Miska moves up to his speed, then forces a creature within 5 feet of him to make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.

legendary.name: Howl to Ruin (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Miska lets out a haunting howl. Each other creature within 20 feet of Miska must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage is frightened of Miska until the end of its next turn.
While frightened in this way, a creature's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) force damage on a hit.

trait.name: Dread Presence
entries: At the beginning of each of the demon's turns, it may reveal its presence to each creature within 60 feet that it is Hidden from.
If it does, each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the demon's next turn.

trait.name: Light-Repulsed
entries: At the end of each creature's turn, if the demon is in Bright Light it takes 7 (2d6) radiant damage, releases any creatures grappled by it, and is pushed 10 feet away from the nearest source of Bright Light.

action.name: Multattack
entries: The demon makes two attacks with its Light-Rending Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Plunging Grasp.

action.name: Light-Rending Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
This attack can target an area of Bright Light in the demon's reach (AC 10, or equal to the spell caster's Save DC if the light is produced by a spell).
An area of light hit with this attack has the radius it projects from its source  reduced by 5 feet.

action.name: Plunging Grasp
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the demon must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and is grappled (escape DC 13) as the demon plunges its spectral claws into the creature's chest.
A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and is frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Shredding Swoop (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Until the end of its turn, the demon can move through creatures and objects as though they were difficult terrain, and may make an attack at advantage with its Light-Rending Claws against each target it passes through.

reaction.name: Shifting Shadows
entries: As a reaction when a fiend it can see dies within 60 feet, the demon summons three Shadow Demon Scrabblers in unoccupied spaces it can see within 20 feet of the fallen fiend.

reaction.name: Sudden Disappearance
entries: As a reaction when the demon ends its turn in Dim Light or Darkness, the demon attempts to Hide and may do so without obscurement.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Fleeting Shadow
entries: While in Bright Light, the demon is blinded. If  it ends its turn in an area of Bright Light, it dies.

action.name: Lightsbane Assault (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 necrotic damage.
This attack can target an area of Bright Light in the demon's reach (AC 10, or equal to the spell caster's Save DC if the light is produced by a spell).
An area of light hit with this attack has the radius it projects from its source  reduced by 5 feet.

action.name: Shadow Teleport
entries: The demon teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space of Dim Light or Darkness that it can see.

trait.name: Face of Ruin
entries: The skyblight's faces resemble the creatures its members hatched from. A fiendish or humanoid creature killed by the skyblight spawns a new Ruin Demon Caricature from its corpse after 1d4 rounds.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The skyblight can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the skyblight can move through any opening large enough for a tiny creature. The shredling can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skyblight makes a Gleeful Gnashing attack against each non-ruin-demon creature in its space.

action.name: Gleeful Gnashing
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage, or 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage if the skyblight has fewer than half its hit points.

action.name: Song of Ruin (4th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: Each non-ruin-demon creature within 60 feet that can hear the skyblight must succeed on DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become hostile to a random creature within 15 feet of it and indifferent to all other creatures for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
This effect ends early if the affected creature takes damage from any source other than another affected creature, or if a creature takes an action to shake the affected creature out of its fury.

bonus.name: Split Off
entries: The skyblight loses 54 hit points and spawns a Ruin Demon Caricature in its space that acts on its initiative.

trait.name: Face of Ruin
entries: The caricature's faces resemble the creatures its members hatched from. A fiendish or humanoid creature killed by the caricature spawns a new Ruin Demon Caricature from its corpse after 1d4 rounds.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The caricature can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the caricature can move through any opening large enough for a tiny creature. The shredling can't gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Gleeful Gnashing
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (4d4 + 2) piercing damage, or 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage if the caricature has fewer than half its hit points.

action.name: Vile Infestation
entries: One creature in the caricature's space must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.  On a failed save, the caricature becomes Attached to the creature (remove DC 12) and begins to force its way into the creature's mouth, eyes, ears, and wounds.

A creature the caricature is attached to must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or take 10 (3d6) piercing damage and be blinded and poisoned until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Ruinous Meld
entries: If the caricature is in the space of another ruin demon, it may meld into that ruin demon, adding its current hit points to the target's current and maximum hit points.
Then, if the target is a Ruin Demon Caricature with more than 110 hit points, it transforms into a Ruin Demon Skyblight with full hit points.

action.name: Infest Wound
entries: The shredling lands on a creature in its space, becomes Attached to it (remove DC 12), and attempts to burrow into its wounds.
A creature the shredling is attached to that does not have all of its hit points takes 1 damage at the end of each of its turns.

name: Quasit Megalomaniac
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the quasit can transform into a form resembling any beast, or back into its true form. Its size and statistics are the same in each form, except that it gains a fly, climb, or swim speed equal to its movement speed if appropriate to the form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sticky Claws (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a frightened creature.

action.name: Mastermind's Command
entries: The quasit chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet and shouts a shrill command. The first attack made against that creature before the beginning of the quasit's next turn is made at advantage.

reaction.name: Protect Me, Mount!
entries: As a reaction when the quasit is targeted with a melee attack while riding on a Medium or larger creature, it changes the attack's target to its mount.

reaction.name: Demonic Benediction (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when a creature it is riding on makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the quasit grants the creature advantage on its saving throw.

action.name: Irritating Toxin (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The quasit secretes an itch-inducing toxin from glands near its shoulders and rubs it over its claws.
For the next minute, a creature hit by the quasit's Sticky Claws subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws it makes until the beginning of the quasit's next turn.

reaction.name: Verminous Skitter
entries: As a reaction when a creature targets the quasit with a melee attack, the quasit uses its Shapechanger ability and moves up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.
The attacker must choose a new target or lose the attack.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: The quasit magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses its Scare.

action.name: Jump Scare (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature the quasit can see within 20 feet feet must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the quasit's next turn and drop one item it is holding of the quasit's choice.

reaction.name: Panicked Hiss
entries: As a reaction when a creature targets the quasit with a melee attack while the quasit is invisible, the quasit immediately recharges and uses its Jump Scare. If it does, the quasit is frightened of the target until the end of its next turn.

name: Nashrou Slayer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Carnage Stalker
entries: The nashrou can detect, by scent, the number and direction of any dead or unconscious creatures within 1000 ft.

trait.name: Weak Spot
entries: If the nashrou is hit by an attack roll of 26 or higher, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.

trait.name: Spindly
entries: The nashrou can move through the space of any creature smaller than Large without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nashrou makes three attacks with its goring spikes, one of which it may replace with a use of its scything swipe.

action.name: Goring Spikes
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained.

action.name: Scything Swipe
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Linebreaker Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nashrou moves up to its speed in a straight line, thrashing and tumbling as it goes. Each creature whose space the nashrou passes through must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) slashing and 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Harry
entries: As a reaction to a creature leaving its reach, the nashrou moves up to half its speed and makes a goring spikes attack.

name: Nalfeshnee Magistrate

resist.preNote: damage from attacks made without advantage

immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Spell Resistant Hide
entries: The nalfeshnee has resistance to damage from spells of sixth level or below. It has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Hungry Gaze
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee that can see it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.
While frightened in this way, a creature can sense the nalfeshnee's surface thoughts and emotions.

trait.name: Fate of the Faithless
entries: Whenever the nalfeshnee kills a demon, it may shout a magically empowered command. Each other demon that can hear it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or follow that command until the beginning of the nalfeshnee's next turn.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the nalfeshnee may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 21 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nalfeshnee. While climbing on the nalfeshnee, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the nalfeshnee, and the nalfeshnee has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nalfeshnee makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Ravenous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a prone creature.

action.name: Claw Smash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Consume Fear (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 15 feet that is frightened must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 93 (6d10 + 60) psychic damage, or half as much damage on a success.
Additionally on a failure, the creature's movement speed is reduced by half and it can't make more than one attack during its following turn.

reaction.name: Reckless Greed
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails its saving throw against the nalfeshnee's Hungry Gaze by 5 or more, the nalfeshnee moves up to 10 feet towards the creature and makes a Ravenous Bite attack against it.
Until the beginning of the nalfeshnee's next turn, attacks against it are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Horrific Apparition
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet directly toward the attacker to an unoccupied space it can see.
Then, each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone.

reaction.name: Judge Worthy
entries: As a reaction when a frightened non-fiend creature the nalfeshnee can see within 60 feet dies, the nalfeshnee forces it to succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or transform into a demon of CR 5 or lower.

trait.name: Ruin Traveler
entries: The nabassu treats any two doorways that are at least 20 ft. tall in the abyss or material plane as connected, so long as no non-fiend creature has laid eyes upon it in the last 24 hours.

trait.name: Demonic Shadows
entries: Non-sunlight sources of Bright Light within 120 ft. of the nabassu are reduced to Dim Light.

trait.name: Consuming Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the nabassu starts its turn within 30 ft. of it, the nabassu can force it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature expends two hit dice, or takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage if it cannot, and the nabassu gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the nabassu until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nabassu makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its devouring bite.

action.name: Grasping Claws

action.name: Devouring Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

If this attack hits a corpse that died in the last hour, the creature's soul is devoured and the corpse dissolves into putrid slime, and for the next minute the nabassu gains resistance to all damage while it has temporary hit points.

action.name: Unlife Exchange (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nabassu loses all temporary hit points, animating three Shadows within 60 ft., each of which acts on the nabassu's initiative and has maximum hit points equal to the temporary hit points lost.

reaction.name: Baleful Displacement (7th level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell, the nabassu forces a creature within 30 ft. to succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or teleport to switch places with the nabassu, becoming the new target of the spell.

name: Myrmyxicus
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Hateful Ichor
entries: A nonfiend creature that deals any piercing or slashing damage to the myrmyxicus is covered in its blood.
Until a creature takes an action to clear the blood, the affected creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage whenever it ends its turn without dealing damage.

trait.name: Vulnerable Midsection
entries: If the myrmyxicus takes 30 or more piercing or slashing damage from a single source, it must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the myrmyxicus takes 27 (6d8) additional slashing damage and is cut in half, losing the ability to make attacks with its Lamprey Bite and releasing each creature grappled by it .

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The myrmyxicus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the myrmyxicus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmyxicus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Lamprey Bite.

action.name: Lamprey Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19).

action.name: Blasphemous Scythes
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
This attack ignores enhancements to AC from spells or magic items. Damage from this attack bypasses temporary hit points and can't be reduced in any way.

action.name: Billowing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A torrent of dense black vapor pours from the myrmyxicus' mouth in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) poison damage, and is poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn), or takes half as much damage on a success. While poisoned in this way, a creature is blinded and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Chaos Immortal (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: One allied creature the myrmyxicus can see is wreathed in foul abyssal energies for the next minute, after which it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points.
For the next minute, its melee attacks deal an additional 11 (2d10) fire and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and it does not fall unconscious when reduced to 0 hit points.
The creature makes death saving throws while at 0 hit points, even if it ordinarily would not, and regains 10 hit points at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Unholy Enthrallment (4th Level Spell)
entries: One fiend or undead creature grappled by the myrmyxicus must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the myrmyxicus and under its control.
The creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Shredling Infusion
entries: One creature grappled by the myrmyxicus' Lamprey Bite must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature's Charisma score is reduced by 2 (1d4), to a minimum of 1, and numerous boils raise and burst from its body, expelling a Ruin Demon Caricature in the creature's space.
A creature that has its Charisma score reduced below 5 in this way counts as a fiend until the reduction ends.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Sycthe
entries: The myrmyxicus makes an attack with its Blasphemous Scythes.

legendary.name: Breath of the Abyss (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One allied demon the myrmyxicus can see takes 15 slashing damage and a gout of burning toxic fumes emerges from its wound in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Tendrilous Slither (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The myrmyxicus moves up to its speed. Each creature whose space it moves within 5 feet of must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened and poisoned until the end of its next turn.

name: Serpentine Overseer
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Eyes of the Master
entries: Anything the overseer sees or hears is known to the demon lord that created it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The overseer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Serpent's Kiss
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing plus 14 (2d6) poison damage.

If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, its body begins to bloat and distend until it regains any hit points, claws and faces appearing to strain within its flesh. An affected creature that dies bursts in a spray of gore, disgorging 5 (2d4) Mane Wretches that act on its initiative.

action.name: Voice of the Master
entries: The overseer's master speaks a dread command through it, producing one of the following effects.

items.name: Consuming Hatred
entries: If the molydeus can hear the overseer, the next attack it makes deals an additional 21 (6d6) fire damage on a hit.

items.name: Power Overwhelming
entries: If the molydeus can hear the overseer, it gains 15 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, attacks made by and against the molydeus are made at advantage.

items.name: Might of the Black Heavens
entries: A bolt of lightning leaps from the sky to strike a creature the overseer can see within 60 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Ravenous Flurry
entries: If a creature the maw demon can see within 30 feet of it is reduced to 0 hit points, it may make a melee attack as a bonus action on each of its turns for the next minute.

trait.name: Blastopore Maw
entries: Being prone does not impose disadvantage on the maw demon's attacks.

trait.name: Flailing Charge
entries: If the maw demon moves at least 20 feet in a straight line on its turn, at the end of the turn the maw demon and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maw demon makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Lurching Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage and the demon moves up to 10 feet toward the target.
The maw demon must be prone to target a creature that is not flying with this attack.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: The maw demon begins to swallow a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet that is incapacitated or grappled by it.

At the beginning of the maw demon's next turn, the target is swallowed and lost to the depths of the abyss, and the maw demon gains 18 (4d8) temporary hit points. This action is disrupted if the maw demon takes any poison damage, if it is prone, or if the target escapes its grapple.

trait.name: Ravenous Flurry
entries: If a creature the maw demon can see within 30 feet of it is reduced to 0 hit points, it may make a melee attack as a bonus action on each of its turns for the next minute.

trait.name: Flailing Charge
entries: If the maw demon moves at least 20 feet in a straight line on its turn, at the end of the turn the maw demon and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maw demon makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its Slavering Bite.

action.name: Slavering Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: The maw demon begins to swallow a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet that is incapacitated or grappled by it.

At the beginning of the maw demon's next turn, the target is swallowed and lost to the depths of the abyss, and the maw demon gains 18 (4d8) temporary hit points. This action is disrupted if the maw demon takes any poison damage, if it is prone, or if the target escapes its grapple.

trait.name: Poor Balance
entries: If the maw demon moves more than 20 feet on its turn, at the end of the turn it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Gnaw Flesh (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.
A creature killed by this damage is utterly devoured, its flesh and bone scattered across the infinite Abyss.

name: Marilith Battle Tyrant
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The marilith regains its reaction at the beginning of each turn.

trait.name: More Fearsome Than Death
entries: If another demon within 60 feet would fail a Wisdom save, the marilith may choose for it to succeed. If it does, the demon is frightened of the Marilith until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marilith uses its Heartless Summoning if available, then uses Spur the Horde or makes seven attacks, one of which may be with its constrict.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the marilith can grapple the target (escape DC 20).

action.name: Trophytaker Blades
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage. A creature killed by this attack is beheaded.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the marilith can't make constrict attacks against other targets.

action.name: Spur the Horde
entries: Up to six demons of CR 10 or below that the marilith can see each take 10 psychic damage, then may use their reaction to move up to half its speed away from her and make a melee attack.

action.name: Heartless Summoning (6th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One demon of CR 10 or below the marilith can see must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be wreathed in runic magic. If the demon dies before the beginning of the marilith's next turn, another demon of equal or lesser CR is summoned in its space.

reaction.name: Deflect
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a weapon attack, the marilith adds 5 to its AC against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Overwhelm
entries: As a reaction to missing a creature it is grappling with a melee attack, the marilith may add 5 to its attack roll.

reaction.name: Tail Lash
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the marilith may force the creature to succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet backwards and knocked prone.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the marilith has grappled with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the marilith crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature immediately begins to suffocate.

reaction.name: Flickering Charge
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell, the marilith magically teleports up to 30 feet directly towards to the spell's caster.

name: Marilith Decimator
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The marilith can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

trait.name: More Fearsome Than Death
entries: If another demon within 60 feet would fail a Wisdom save, the marilith may choose for it to succeed. If it does, the demon is frightened of the Marilith until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marilith makes seven attacks, one of which may be with its constrict.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the marilith can grapple the target (escape DC 17).

action.name: Trophytaker Blades
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. A creature killed by this attack is beheaded.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the marilith can't make constrict attacks against other targets.

reaction.name: Deflect
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a weapon attack, the marilith adds 5 to its AC against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Overwhelm
entries: As a reaction to missing a creature it is grappling with a melee attack, the marilith may add 5 to its attack roll.

reaction.name: Tail Lash
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the marilith may force the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet backwards and knocked prone.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the marilith has grappled with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the marilith crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature immediately begins to suffocate.

reaction.name: Flickering Charge
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell, the marilith magically teleports up to 30 feet directly towards to the spell's caster.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on its turn, the manitou can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one Large or larger tree within 5 feet and emerge into a  an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second tree within 60 feet.

trait.name: Brittle Growths
entries: Whenever the manitou takes 15 or more damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or lose one of its Living Weapons and release one creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The manitou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the manitou fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manitou makes one Living Weapon attack for each Living weapon it has active, one of which it may replace with a use of its Hurl Creature.

action.name: Living Weapon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the manitou may grapple the target (escape DC 20)

action.name: Terror Vines
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and the target is restrained in place (escape DC 20).
While restrained in this way, a creature levitates 15 feet off the ground and is frightened.

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

bonus.name: Spasmodic Growth (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Part of the manitou bulges and distends, growing into a Living Weapon and pushing each other creature within 5 feet of the manitou that isn't grappled by it 5 feet away.
The manitou may have up to three of the weapons active at any time. While it has two or more of these Living Weapons active, the manitou is size Huge.

legendary.name: Forced Growth
entries: The manitou rolls to recharge its Spasmodic Growth. If it succeeds, it may immediately use its Spasmodic Growth as a reaction.

legendary.name: Terror Vines
entries: The manitou makes an attack with its Terror Vines.

legendary.name: Murderous Drag
entries: The manitou forces one creature grappled with one of its its Living Weapons to make a DC 20 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone, then the manitou moves up to half its speed in a straight line.
For each 5 feet the manitou moves in this way, the grappled creature takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Sow Demonseed (Costs 2 Legendary Actions)
entries: The manitou plants a spectral seed in a Medium or Large plant within 5 feet, transforming it into a gravesnag.

name: Manitou Withergast
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The manitou can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The manitou's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The manitou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multitattack
entries: The manitou makes three attacks with its terror vines.

action.name: Terror Vines
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) piercing plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and the target is restrained in place (escape DC 13).
While restrained in this way, a creature levitates 15 feet off the ground and is frightened.

action.name: Rend Nature
entries: Each creature or plant restrained by the manitou's Terror Vines must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A beast, fey, or plant creature has vulnerability to this damage.

action.name: Sow Demonseed (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The manitou plants a spectral seed in a Medium or Large plant within 5 feet, transforming it into a gravesnag.

action.name: Fey Possession (1/Day)
entries: The manitou forces a fey creature in its space to succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be Possessed by the manitou, transforming it into a Manitou Befouled until the manitou is expelled.
An unconscious creature has disadvantage on this saving throw.

trait.name: Acidic Cloud
entries: Whenever the mob takes 10 or more damage from a single source, a cloud of acrid vapor issues forth from it, dealing 9 (2d8) acid damage to it and each other creature within 5 feet.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The mob can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the mob can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The mob can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mob makes two attacks with its Maddening Claws.

action.name: Maddening Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) slashing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage if the mob has fewer than half its hit points, and the target has disadvantage on attacks that don't target a manes on its following turn.

reaction.name: Mindless Hate
entries: If a creature falls prone within 5 feet of the mob, the mob must use its reaction to make a melee attack against it, if possible.

reaction.name: Essence Frenzy
entries: As a reaction when the mob kills a fiend of CR 2 or higher, it falls upon the fiend, thrashing in a mad frenzy to consume it

The mob loses 28 (8d6) hit points as manes in it die in failed attempts to absorb the fiend's essence, then if the mob has any hit points remaining a demon of equal or lesser CR to the killed fiend appears in the mob's space as one of its members transforms.

trait.name: Acidic Cloud
entries: When a manes dies, it dissolves into a cloud of acrid vapor, dealing 4 (1d8) acid damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manes makes two attacks with its Maddening Claws.

action.name: Maddening Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage and the target has disadvantage on attacks that don't target a manes on its following turn.

action.name: Panicked Charge (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The manes moves up to its speed, and may make a melee attack at disadvantage against each creature it passes within 5 feet of with this movement.

reaction.name: Mindless Hate
entries: If a creature falls prone within 5 feet of the manes, the manes must use its reaction to make a melee attack against it, if possible.

reaction.name: Consume Essence
entries: As a reaction when the manes kills a fiend of CR 2 or higher, it attempts to absorb the fiend's essence, making a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the manes transforms into a demon of equal or lesser CR to the killed fiend. On a failure, the manes keels over, bursts, and dies.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Acidic Cloud
entries: When a manes dies, it dissolves into a cloud of acrid vapor, dealing 3 acid damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Maddening Claws (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 slashing damage and the target has disadvantage on attacks that don't target a manes on its following turn.

name: Lilitu
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lilitu transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back to her true fiendish form. Her statistics are the same in each form.

trait.name: Curseborn
entries: If the lilitu is targeted with a Remove Curse spell, she takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and attacks against her are made at advantage until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Hate Beyond Death
entries: If the lilitu is destroyed and the community cursed by her remains, her spirit lingers and is eventually reborn as a child conceived in that community. After 13 (3d8) years, she regains her full demonic statistics and abilities.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lilitu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the lilitu fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lilitu makes three attacks, each of which she may replace with a use of her Frenzied Compulsion or Heretical Brand.

action.name: Ashen Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Tendrils of Anguish
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the target is dragged up to 5 feet toward the lilitu.

action.name: Frenzied Compulsion
entries: One creature that can hear the lilitu and is charmed by her may use its reaction to move up to half her speed and make a weapon attack at advantage.
If it does not, the creature instead takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Heretical Brand
entries: One creature within 5 feet that is charmed by the lilitu takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, then must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed.
While Cursed in this way, a creature's alignment becomes Chaotic Evil, it is Dominated by the lilitu, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by nonmagical weapons.
The creature repeats this saving throw whenever it regains hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Seal of Misery (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lilitu raises an opaque barrier of crimson light enclosing a 20 foot radius sphere that lasts for an hour.

A creature that moves or is moved out of the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and be pushed up to 20 feet toward the area's center, or take half as much damage on a success.
If the sphere contains only a single creature that is not incapacitated, the effect ends.

action.name: Corruptive Emblem (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: The lilitu imbues an object with evil power that radiates palpably in a 30 foot radius.

A creature with a Wisdom score of 13 or lower that starts its turn in the area and can see the object is charmed by the lilitu until it takes any damage, or until the object is moved or destroyed (AC 20, 20 HP; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid this effect. If it does, it treats each creature within 10 feet of the object as invisible.

legendary.name: Frenzied Compulsion
entries: The lilitu uses her Frenzied Compulsion.

legendary.name: Whisperstride
entries: The lilitu moves up to half its speed, then one creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by it until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Drown in Blood (Costs 2 Actions, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Blood wells up in the mouth and lungs of a creature the lilitu can see within 60 feet, suffocating it.

The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Laghathti
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the laghathti and can see it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be convinced that is memories have been stolen and replaced.
An affected creature can't count as a willing or friendly target for any spell or magical effect, and can repeat this save as an action, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Weight of Memory
entries: If the laghathti starts its turn outside the waters of the Styx, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until it returns to the waters.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The laghathti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The laghathti makes four attacks with its Spined Tentacles, one of which it may replace with either its Devour Memories or Regurgitate Memories.

action.name: Spined Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Devour Memories
entries: One creature grappled by the laghathti must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by 1d4 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way loses all biographical memories and can't benefit from any feat until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Regurgitate Memories (Recharges when the laghathti uses its Devour Memories)
entries: One creature grappled by the laghathti must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage, be stunned until the end of the laghathti's next turn, and gain disadvantage on Intelligence saving throws for the next minute.

reaction.name: Screeching Wail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 106 hit points, the laghathti lets out an agonized telepathic wail, that is echoed by the voices of each creature grappled by it.
Each creature grappled by the laghathti must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or lose concentration and its breath, if it was holding either, and be frightened until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Aura of Spite
entries: Whenever the jovoc takes damage, each non-jovoc creature within 10 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jovoc has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jovoc makes three attacks with its Crimson Claws.

action.name: Crimson Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the jovoc may grapple the target.
If this attack targets a jovoc, it hits automatically.

action.name: Charflesh Immolation
entries: The jovoc sets itself on fire. Until a creature takes an action to douse it, at the beginning of each of its turns the jovoc and each creature grappled by it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

reaction.name: Fake Out
entries: As a reaction when the jovoc leaves a creature's reach without being hit with an Attack of Opportunity, the jovoc moves up to 10 feet toward the creature and makes an attack against it.

trait.name: Bladed Berg
entries: If the jarrlak takes 15 or more fire damage from a single source, its Icicle Gore does half as much piercing damage until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Freezing Flesh
entries: If the jarrlak is doused in water, it gains 10 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the jarrlak is restrained.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jarrlak has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jarrlak makes three attacks with its Icicle Gore, one of which it may replace with a use of its Frostshatter Bite or Frozen Death, if available.

action.name: Frostshatter Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage.
A target affected by the jarrlak's Frozen Death drops to 0 hit points, then must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or shatter into pieces and die.

action.name: Icicle Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) piercing plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

action.name: Frozen Death (Recharge 4-6)
entries: One creature the Jarrlak can see within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be petrified as it freezes solid (Save Ends at end of turn).
This effect ends early if the creature takes any fire damage.

reaction.name: Glacial Eruption (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 111 hit points, the jarlak causes a contiguous wall of ice composed of up to six 20 foot by 20 foot, 5 foot thick panels to burst forth from the earth within 100 feet of it.
When the wall appears, each creature in the wall's space is pushed to a side of its choice. Each panel of the wall is an object an can be attacked (AC 5, 50 HP, vulnerability to fire damage).

name: Incubus Ephialtes
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the incubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Crushing Terror
entries: A creature that starts its turn prone and in the incubus' space takes 11 (2d10) nonlethal psychic damage and cannot speak, breathe or stand until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The incubus makes two attacks with its Night's Caress, one of which it may replace with a use of its Waking Dream or Incubate Fears, if available.

action.name: Night's Caress (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target falls asleep for the next minute.
A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

action.name: Waking Dream (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
