entries: One unconscious creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or rise under the incubus' control for the next hour, or until it regains consciousness, and can perceive and take actions as though conscious for the duration.
Whenever the creature would wake, the incubus may make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the creature remains unconscious.

action.name: Incubate Fears (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The incubus draws forth and congeals the fears of a frightened or unconscious creature within 5 feet, conjuring a Living Nightmare that lasts a minute in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The incubus enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

name: Incubus Atonian
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the incubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Crushing Terror
entries: A creature that starts its turn prone and in the incubus' space takes 11 (2d10) nonlethal psychic damage and cannot speak, breathe or stand until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Night's Caress (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target falls asleep for the next minute.
A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

action.name: Sink Into Earth (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the incubus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or fall prone and be blinded for the next minute.
If the creature stands from prone, the effect ends and the creature takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Steal Dreams (4th Level Spell)
entries: One unconscious or blinded creature within 5 feet must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw.
On a failed save, the incubus learns one closely held secret of the creature's, and the creature takes 33 (6d10) nonlethal psychic damage.

A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way is Cursed. A creature cursed in this way cannot gain levels or otherwise advance through experience. When this curse ends, the creature gains any levels prevented by the curse.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The incubus enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Fear-Born
entries: The nightmare is immune to any damage dealt by a frightened creature.

action.name: Rend Psyche (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the nightmare's next turn.

If at least three nightmares contributed to this attack, a creature that fails this saving throw is instead frightened for the next minute, and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Immolith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Unstable Fusion
entries: If the immolith takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The immolith makes four attacks with its Searing Slash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Manifest Soul or Cursed Flare, if available.

action.name: Searing Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Manifest Soul
entries: The immolith manifests a charred appendage from its body, mirroring that of a creature consumed by its Fuel for the Fire in the last minute, and makes a melee attack using that creature's statistics.

action.name: Cursed Flare (Recharges when the immolith uses its Fuel for the Fire)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the immolith must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed. A creature cursed in this way loses any Resistance to fire damage, and takes an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage whenever it takes fire damage.

reaction.name: Fuel for the Fire
entries: As a reaction when a demon within 30 feet is destroyed, the immolith forces it to make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature's spirit is absorbed into the immolith and the immolith gains 20 temporary hit points.

name: Hezrou Hollerer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Deafened
entries: The hezrou is permanently deafened. If cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic, it loses this trait and gains the Lickspittle trait.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks with its Chaos Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Guard Me! or its Get in Line!

action.name: Chaos Slam
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) force damage, then the hezrou and each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Guard Me!
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, while it is next to another hezrou attacks against the hollerer are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Get in Line!
entries: Each other hezrou within 30 feet that can hear the hollerer must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failure, the hezrou's initiative is reduced by 5 if it is higher than the hollerer's.

reaction.name: Sickening Ichor
entries: As a reaction when the hezrou takes any piercing or slashing damage, it magically causes a noxious gas to boil out of its spilt blood. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.
If the hezrou has fewer than 73 hit points, a creature that fails this save must use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the hezrou.

name: Hezrou Toady
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lickspittle
entries: The hezrou follows the most recent verbal command it received since the beginning of its last turn.
If the command was given by a non-demon, the hezrou may make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw to negate this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Shrouding Snap.

action.name: Shrouding Snap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the hezrou may use its reaction to belch forth a cloud of Magical Darkness in a 10 foot radius around itself that lasts for a minute.

action.name: Gloomletter Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) necrotic damage if the hezrou is in Magical Darkness.

reaction.name: Sickening Ichor
entries: As a reaction when the hezrou takes any piercing or slashing damage, it magically causes a noxious gas to boil out of its spilt blood. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.
If the hezrou has fewer than 69 hit points, a creature that fails this save must use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the hezrou.

trait.name: Lickspittle
entries: The hezrou follows the most recent verbal command it received since the beginning of its last turn.
If the command was given by a non-demon, the hezrou may make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw to negate this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Frenzied Snaps (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.
If three or more hezrou contributed to this attack, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or fall prone and take an additional 4 piercing damage.

name: Haures
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Spiderkind
entries: The haures can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the haures knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Gleeful Carnage
entries: While adjacent to three or more hostile creatures, the haures has advantage on attack rolls. If the haures takes or deals damage, it treats all adjacent creatures as hostile until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The haures' long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The haures has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haures makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Ravenous Bite. It may replace one of its attacks with either a use of its Web Grab or its Goring Charge, if available.

action.name: Ravenous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the haures gains resistance to all damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: War Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save.

action.name: Web Grab
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. radius centered on a point within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or be dragged up to 30 ft. toward the haures.

action.name: Goring Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The haures moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 33 (6d10) piercing damage and be pushed ahead of the haures for the rest of this move. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is also knocked prone.

action.name: Quick Pick
entries: As a reaction to a hostile creature moving into the haurus' range, the haurus makes a war pick attack against it.

name: Guecubu Soul Haunt
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lurking Presence
entries: Unless it is encircled with salt, the guecubu is invisible, immune to any damage dealt by a creature that cannot see it, and can't be grappled or forced to move.

trait.name: Guecubu Weaknesses
entries: The guecubu has the following weaknesses.

items.name: Salt-Warded
entries: The guecubu cannot cross a line of salt unless it is Attached to or Possessing another creature.

items.name: Blessing-Burned
entries: When a creature the guecubu is possessing is targeted by a spell with a divine source, the creature and the guecubu each take 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

items.name: Mirror-Trapped
entries: A guecubu that is forced to move into the space of Medium or larger mirror must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be imprisoned in the mirror until the mirror is broken.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The guecubu can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guecubu makes three attacks with its Frenetic Claw.

action.name: Frenetic Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that can see the guecubu. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is blinded until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clutch Back
entries: One humanoid creature in the guecubu's space must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or have the Guecubu become Attached to it. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours.

While the guecubu is Attached to a creature, it can mimic that creature's voice, and that creature can't see the guecubu by any means. If a creature the guecubu teleports, the guecubu teleports with it.

action.name: Profane Sleep
entries: One Sleeping creature the guecubu is attached to must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature ignores the effects of being incapacitated and acts under the Guecubu's control for the next hour.
When the creature wakes or on a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Cruelty's Reward
entries: As a reaction when a creature the guecubu is attached to commits an act of cruelty, the guecubu increases the creature's Strength by 1, to a maximum of 25.

Then, if the creature has a Strength score higher than 22, it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or become Possessed by the Guecubu and transform into a Guecubu Cackle-Fiend until the guecubu is expelled.

trait.name: Unholy Strength
entries: While restrained, the cackle-fiend has its Strength and Dexterity scores reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1, for each holy talisman draped over it.

trait.name: Sadistic Fixation
entries: The cackle-fiend's attacks deal no additional damage on a critical hit. Instead, on a critical hit the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose a limb of the target's choice.

action.name: Rending Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that can see the guecubu. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.
A creature killed by this damage is rent limb from limb.

action.name: Madness Overflowing (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Erratic bolts of crackling fire leap from the mouth and eyes of the fiend in a 15 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on  DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) fire plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage and be frightened until the end of the cackle-fiend's next turn.

name: Goristro Living Siege
immune: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Impossible Size
entries: The goristro occupies a 60 foot square area of ground and is 200 feet tall. It can occupy the space of any creature smaller than Gargantuan.

trait.name: Thick Skull
entries: While the goristro is not prone, it is immune to the effects of any mind-affecting spells or abilities not controlled by a creature on its head.

trait.name: Living Siege
entries: The goristro has palisaded fortifications built into its back, shoulders, and head, sufficient to serve as a fighting platform for up to 40 medium creatures.

A creature adjacent to the goristro may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the goristro's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the goristro's legs to its back, or from its back to its head.

items.name: Legs
entries: While climbing on the goristro's legs, a creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw whenever the goristro uses its Stride or fall off.

items.name: Waist
entries: While climbing on the goristro's waist, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro.

items.name: Back
entries: While climbing on the goristro's back, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro and the goristro cannot target it.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the goristro's head, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro and on saving throws against its abilities. If a creature on the goristro's head scores a critical hit against it, the goristro falls prone at the end of its next turn.

trait.name: The Bigger They Are..
entries: If the goristro falls prone, it takes 70 (20d6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Panicked Fury
entries: While the goristro is frightened, attacks against it are made at advantage and it cannot distinguish friend from foe.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The goristro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that deal non-psychic damage.

action.name: Crater Fist
entries: The goristro swings its armored fist, striking a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 65 (10d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage on a failure or moving to the nearest space outside the area on a success.
A creature may use its reaction to gain advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Mountain Hurl
entries: The goristro hurls a Gargantuan building or similar object up to 300 feet at a point it can see. At the beginning of the goristro's next turn, it lands.

Each creature within 15 feet of that point is knocked prone, and must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 49 (6d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature riding on the object has advantage on this saving throw.
A creature with at least 15 Passive Perception knows precisely where the strike will land.

action.name: Titanic Stride
entries: The goristro takes a single step, moving up to 60 feet, or standing from prone and moving up to 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of where it ends this movement that is not climbing on it must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 26 (3d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Earthbreaker Leap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The goristro leaps high into the sky. At the beginning of its next turn, it lands prone in a space within 120 feet.

Each creature climbing on it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or fall off, then each creature within 30 feet of it that is not climbing on it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 34 (8d10) bludgeoning plus 35 (10d6) fire damage, be pushed up to 30 feet away, and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Stride
entries: The goristro uses its Titanic Stride.

legendary.name: Brush Off
entries: The goristro attempts to dislodge a creature climbing on it. The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 32 (5d12) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 30 feet away.

name: Goristro Ram-Raider
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the goristro may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the goristro. While climbing on the goristro, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro, and the goristro has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Hard Faller
entries: The goristro has vulnerability to damage from falling. While the goristro is within 5 feet of a precipice at least 10 feet high, it has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that would Frighten it.

trait.name: Panicked Fury
entries: While the goristro is frightened, attacks against it are made at advantage and it cannot distinguish friend from foe.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The goristro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that deal non-psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goristro makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Ravenous Bite, and uses its Goring Charge, if available.

action.name: Ravenous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the goristro gains resistance to all damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Wrecking Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Hoof Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Goring Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The goristro moves up to 40 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Large.

The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 33 (6d10) piercing damage and be pushed ahead of the goristro for the rest of this move, or move to the nearest unoccupied space outside the goristro's path on a success.

reaction.name: Sadistic Stomp
entries: As a reaction to a prone creature within 5 feet of it regaining any hit points, the goristro makes a Hoof Stomp attack against it.

reaction.name: See Red (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 156 hit points, the goristro immediately recharges and uses its Goring Charge.

trait.name: Worm-Bonded
entries: The worm-shadow is bonded to a golothoma, granting it the following traits:

The worm-shadow is Attached to its golothoma and cannot move or be moved more than 5 feet away from it. If the worm-shadow starts its turn more than  5 feet away from the golothoma, it teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the golothoma and takes 11 (2d10) force damage.
While in Dim Light or Darkness, the worm-shadow may move any distance at any time with no action required.
Whenever the worm-shadow would take any non-radiant damage, it may have the golothoma take that damage in its stead.

trait.name: Ephemeral Presence
entries: The worm-shadow can move through and occupy the space of other creatures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm-shadow makes two attacks with its Shadow Barbs.

action.name: Shadow Barbs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shadow Feeding
entries: Thrashing umbral spines lash upward from the worm-shadow.
Each creature of its choice within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Corpse Consumption
entries: Each corpse in the worm-shadow's space slips into it and is devoured utterly. The worm-shadow and its golothoma (if still alive) each regain 10 hit points for each corpse consumed in this way.
If the worm-shadow devours its golothoma in this way, it regains all of its hit points and loses its Worm-Bonded trait.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the golothoma and can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or believe itself to be the shadow of a greater creature cast from a distant realm.
The affected creature is frightened while in Bright Light or Darkness and can repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golothoma has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golothoma makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Corrosive Tar Strike.

action.name: Perforating Barbs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Corrosive Tar Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and covered in acidic sludge.
Until a creature takes an action to remove it, the target's movement is reduced by half and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Flatten Reality (3rd Level Spell, Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A line of distorted space 150 foot long line and 5 feet wide extends from the golothama's eye.

Until the end of the golothoma's next turn, each creature in the area counts as being within 5 feet of each other creature in the area, and may teleport to any unoccupied space in the area as a Bonus Action.

name: Glabrezu Sire of Woe
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Aura of Disarray
entries: A creature that casts a spell targeting an area that contains the glabrezu must first make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the spell's area of effect scatters 25 (2d4 x 5) feet in a direction of the glabrezu's choice before taking effect.

trait.name: Bioreinforced Carapace
entries: If the glabrezu takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 16 until it completes a Long Rest.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
entries: If the glabrezu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The glabrezu makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Crackling Frenzy, if available.

action.name: Crusher Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19) and pulled up to 5 feet toward the glabrezu.

If the target was already grappled by the glabrezu, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take an additional 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and lose the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

action.name: Gut Punch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Crackling Frenzy (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) lighting damage and be stunned until the end of its next turn.

A creature that succeeds on this saving throw instead gains 14 (4d6) temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the creature's melee attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Corrupted Offering (9th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: One nonfiend creature within 10 feet of the glabrezu must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the glabrezu and hostile to each nonfiend creature it can see for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
While charmed in this way, the creature's Strength score permanently increases by 1, to a maximum of 22, whenever it reduces a humanoid former ally to 0 hit points.

reaction.name: Sow Chaos (1/Day, 7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: As a reaction when the glabrezu is reduced below 127 hit points, it unleashes a disorienting burst of chaotic psychic force in a 15 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by each other creature that failed this saving throw and hostile to each creature that did not for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
This save cannot be failed voluntarily.

legendary.name: Brutalize
entries: The glabrezu makes two attacks with its Gut Punch against a grappled target.

legendary.name: Profane Fate (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the glabrezu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed.
Whenever a creature Cursed in this way that the glabrezu can see succeeds on a saving throw, the glabrezu can end the curse on that creature and cause the creature to fail instead.

legendary.name: Abyssal Abduction (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The glabrezu and up to one creature grappled by it teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

legendary.name: Crackling Frenzy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The glabrezu uses its Crackling Frenzy, if available.

name: Glabrezu Corruptor
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Aura of Disarray
entries: A creature that casts a spell targeting an area that contains the glabrezu must first make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the spell's area of effect scatters 25 (2d4 x 5) feet in a direction of the glabrezu's choice before taking effect.

trait.name: Brittle Carapace
entries: If the glabrezu takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a Long Rest.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The glabrezu makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Seizer Claw.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) and pulled up to 5 feet toward the glabrezu.

action.name: Flickerbolt (6th level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +9 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) lightning plus 11 (2d10) force damage.
Before or after making this attack, the glabrezu may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Chaos Revels (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature casts a spell targeting an area the glabrezu can see, the glabrezu teleports to an unoccupied space in that area.

name: Glabrezu Persecutor
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Brittle Carapace
entries: If the glabrezu takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a Long Rest.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The glabrezu makes two attacks with its Crushing Claws.

action.name: Crusher Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) and pulled up to 5 feet toward the glabrezu.

If the target was already grappled by the glabrezu, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take an additional 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and lose the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

action.name: Gut Punch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Brutalize
entries: The glabrezu makes two attacks with its Gut Punch against a grappled target.

bonus.name: Abyssal Abduction (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The glabrezu and up to one creature grappled by it teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

name: Ghour
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the ghour moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

trait.name: Desecrated Aura
entries: A creature that attempts to cast divine magic (such as a Cleric or Paladin spell) within 15 ft. of the ghour takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage and is poisoned until the end of the creature's following turn.

trait.name: Ferocity
entries: When the ghour is reduced to 0 hit points, it may use its multiattack before falling unconscious.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ghour has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the ghour fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghour makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with Baphomet's Rage.

action.name: Cleaving Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) slashing damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, any excess damage can be applied to another creature within reach that has an AC equal to or below the initial attack roll.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Baphomet's Rage
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the ghour can see must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must use its reaction to move up to 20 feet in a direction of the ghour's choice. If it ends this movement within 5 ft. of one or more creatures, it must make a melee attack against one of them.

action.name: Sickening Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. wide, 30 ft. long line must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 45 (10d8) Poison damage and be poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Gouging Toss
entries: As a reaction to a creature moving within 5 ft. of it, the ghour forces the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) piercing damage and be  knocked prone.

reaction.name: Maddened Roar (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 137 hit points, the ghour lets out an earsplitting scream. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the ghour's next turn and deafened for the next minute.

name: Gau Ding
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Careening Slosh
entries: If the Gau Ding moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line, then moves in an opposed direction, it begins to slosh. Until the end of its turn, each creature that it passes within 5 ft. of must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) fire and 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Dinner Bell
entries: A creature that misses the gau ding with a melee weapon attack is overcome with visions of itself being torn apart by hungry dogs. The attacker must succeed on a DC Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Cauldron
entries: The top of the gau ding is a boiling cauldron of bones and broth. A creature that starts its turn in the cauldron takes 22 (5d8) fire and 22 (5d8) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage can be disgorged as a wight under the cauldron's control. When encountered, the gau ding has 7 (2d4 + 2) corpses in its cauldron.

trait.name: Affection Weakness
entries: As bonus action, a creature that did not attack the gau ding this turn may attempt a DC 20 Animal Handling check. On a success, the Gau Ding must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the next minute by the creature, or until the creature deals damage to it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The gau ding can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Spiritlinked Resistance
entries: If the gau ding fails a saving throw, it may consume one of the corpses contained within it to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gau ding makes two attacks with its snatching claws.

action.name: Snatching Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (1d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (Escape DC 23). The gau ding has two arms capable of grappling.

action.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the gau ding bites off a hand or foot of the target.

action.name: Bay
entries: The gau ding lets out a terrifying polyphonic howl as flames burst from its mouths and eyes and its cauldron bubbles and sputters. Each creature within 120 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the gau ding for the next minute and drop what it's holding. A frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Disgorge Animus (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Roll a d20. on a 1-10, the gau ding births a Wight from its cauldron. On an 11-17, it births a Deathlock Wight. On an 18-20, it births a Slaughter Wight.

reaction.name: Bones for the Broth
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack of opportunity by a frightened creature, the gau ding makes a snatch attack against the attacker.

reaction.name: Bloodied Birth
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 238 hit points, the Gau Ding immediately recharges and uses its Disgorge Animus twice.

legendary.name: Into the Pot!
entries: The gau ding tosses one creature grappled by its Snatching Claws into its cauldron.

legendary.name: Spirit Breath
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 20) by long, many-jointed spectral arms that extend from nearby surfaces. A flying creature has advantage on this saving throw. A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage.

legendary.name: Body Breath
entries: The gau ding emits a torrent of slimy, half-dissolved flesh from one of its mouths. Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. away and take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Corrosion Weakness
entries: If the ferrolith takes 10 or more acid damage from a single source, it loses its resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ferrolith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ferrolith makes three attacks with its Adamantine Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Compel.

action.name: Adamantine Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

action.name: Compel
entries: One creature charmed by the ferrolith must use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a weapon attack.

action.name: Enticing Charm (Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the ferrolith can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed and under the ferrolith's control.

The charmed creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. When the ferrolith's charm ends on a creature, the creature takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Razor Barrage (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ferrolith flings razor-sharp flakes of rust from its wings in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 45 (10d8) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the ekolid and can see it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or automatically fail Intelligence checks and saving throws to maintain Concentration, as it feels parasites squirming within its flesh.
A creature may repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ekolid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ekolid makes five attacks with its Stinging Flurry.

action.name: Stinging Flurry
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +1 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Exultant Chitter (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the ekolid and is infected with Ekolid Parasitism takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage, then must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the disease ends for the creature and it spawns an Ekolid Nymph in its space.

bonus.name: Implant Egg
entries: One creature the ekolid hit with its Stinging Flurry this turn must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Ekolid Parasitism.
A target hit with three or more Stinging Flurry attacks this turn makes this save at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Screeching Choir
entries: The ekolid lets out a discordant wail. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it and is Concentrating must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose Concentration.

trait.name: Wound Intrusion
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the space of one or more ekolid nymphs must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage and is infected with Ekolid Parasitism, and one ekolid nymph in its space is removed from play.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Lacerating Collision (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage.
This attack is made at advantage if each creature that contributed to it moved at least 20 feet this turn.

action.name: Cannibalize
entries: The ekolid kills and devours a Small or smaller creature with the Minion trait in its space.
Then, if the ekolid has killed two or more creatures this way in the last minute, it may form a coccoon around itself, increasing its AC to 18 until the beginning of its next turn.
At the beginning of its next turn, the ekolid emerges from its coccoon transformed as an Ekolid Carnifex with full hit points.

trait.name: Devouring Haze
entries: The horde is surrounded by a cursed aura in which wounds become infested with dretch larvae. A non-dretch creature in the horde's space that takes any damage takes an additional 5 piercing damage.
A creature killed within 5 feet of the horde has a new dretch hatch from its corpse after 24 hours.

trait.name: Poisoned Path
entries: Whenever the horde takes 10 or more damage from a single source, the ground within 10 feet of it is cursed and corrupted. Plants in the area wither and die, and magical healing that a creature in the area receives is reduced by half.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The horde can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the horde can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The horde can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Rotten Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (6d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage if the horde has fewer than half its hit points.

action.name: Maddening Melee (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Each other creature in the horde's space must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet in a direction of the horde's choice. Then, each of those creatures may use its reaction to make a melee attack.
If the horde has more than half its hit points, this save is made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Larvae Haze
entries: The dretch is surrounded by a cursed aura in which wounds become infested with dretch larvae. A non-dretch creature that takes any damage takes an additional 1 piercing damage for each dretch within 5 feet of it.
A creature killed within 5 feet of a dretch has a new dretch hatch from its corpse after 24 hours.

trait.name: Befoul Earth
entries: When the dretch dies, the ground within 10 feet of it is cursed and corrupted. Plants in the area wither and die, and magical healing that a creature in the area receives is reduced by half.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dretch makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Rotten Bite.

action.name: Rotten Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Curling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Goading Shove
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the dretch must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and is pushed 5 feet, then may use its reaction to make a melee attack.
On a successful save, the target must use its reaction to make an attack against the dretch. A creature may not voluntarily fail this saving throw.

reaction.name: Groveling Whinge
entries: As a reaction when a creature targets the dretch with an attack, the dretch falls prone. The creature must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target for its attack, or else do half as much damage with it.

trait.name: Larvae Haze
entries: The dretch is surrounded by a cursed aura in which wounds become infested with dretch larvae. A non-dretch creature that takes any damage takes an additional 1 piercing damage for each dretch within 5 feet of it.
A creature killed within 5 feet of a dretch has a new dretch hatch from its corpse after 24 hours.

trait.name: Befoul Earth
entries: When the dretch dies, the ground within 10 feet of it is cursed and corrupted. Plants in the area wither and die, and magical healing that a creature in the area receives is reduced by half.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Broken-Tooth Bites (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

name: Draudnu
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the draudnu and can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be poisoned until it takes any piercing or slashing damage, as it feels something living swelling within it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The draudnu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Flesh Hooks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing plus 14 (4d6) acid damage.
On a hit, the draudnu may lose 10 hit points and detatch its head, pinning the target to an adjacent surface and Restraining it (escape DC 15). While its head is detached, the draudnu is blinded.
The head is an object and can be attacked (AC 15, 15 HP), and once detached the draudnu can't use this attack again until it regrows its head.

action.name: Infested Birth (3/Day)
entries: One of the draudnu's pustules bursts in a spray of acid, then releases 3 (1d4 + 1) Ekolid Nymphs that act on the draudnu's initiative.
Up to one creature within 5 feet of the draudnu must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage.

bonus.name: Mindfire Gaze
entries: One creature restrained by the draudnu's head must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Regrow Head
entries: If the draudnu has no head, it grows a new one, gaining 10 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Spiderkin
entries: The draegloth can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the draegloth knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Brutal Grace
entries: If the draegloth takes the Dash or Dodge action, until the end of the turn it may make a melee attack against any creature that makes an attack of opportunity against it.

trait.name: Light-Enraged
entries: The first attack the draegloth makes each turn while in Bright Light is at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draegloth makes four attacks with its Savage Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Flaying Scream or Snap Limb, if available.

action.name: Savage Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
If this attack was made at advantage, the target suffers one additional effect:
The target is grappled (escape DC 18).
The target is pushed 10 feet away.
The target is knocked prone.

action.name: Snap Limb (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and loses the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

action.name: Flaying Scream (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The draegloth's eyes blaze with abyssal flame as it holds a grappled creature aloft and screams at it.
Each light the creature is carrying is doused, then the creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire plus 27 (6d8) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage has its skin peeled off and blown away in a spray of gore.

action.name: Maddening Shadows (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Whispering darkness boils forth in a 20 foot radius from a point the draegloth can see within 60 feet, extinguishing all lights in the area.

A creature other than the draegloth that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage and be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls prone, additionally.

bonus.name: Web Grab
entries: One creature the draegloth can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be dragged up to 30 feet toward the draegloth.

bonus.name: Exultation of Blood (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The draegloth gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature it hit with an attack this turn. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the draegloth's attacks are made at advantage.

trait.name: Brutal Grace
entries: If the draegloth takes the Dash or Dodge action, until the end of the turn it may make a melee attack against any creature that makes an attack of opportunity against it.

trait.name: Light-Enraged
entries: The first attack the draegloth makes each turn while in Bright Light is at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draegloth makes three attacks with its Savage Claws.

action.name: Savage Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.
If this attack was made at advantage, the target suffers one additional effect:
The target is grappled (escape DC 16).
The target is pushed 5 feet away.
The target is knocked prone.

action.name: Glyph of Light's Bane (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature grappled by the draegloth must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage and be Cursed for the next mintue.
While cursed in this way, the creature takes 7 (2d6) fire plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage whenever it ends its turn illuminated by Bright Light

action.name: Flaying Scream (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The draegloth's eyes blaze with abyssal flame as it holds a grappled creature aloft and screams at it.
Each light the creature is carrying is doused, then the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire plus 27 (6d8) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage has its skin peeled off and blown away in a spray of gore.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Drone
entries: The chasme produces a horrid magical droning sound. A non-chasme creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more  chasmes that can hear them must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks until the end of its next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls asleep until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The chasme has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target is frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Dream Desecration
entries: One sleeping creature the Chasme can see within 15 feet takes 14 (4d6) nonlethal psychic damage, then must make on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, this damage does not wake the creature from its sleep, and the chasme discovers one fact which the creature wishes to keep hidden from it.

action.name: Demonic Abduction
entries: One demon of CR 5 or lower that the chasme has seen in the last 10 days must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or teleport to switch positions with the chasme.
A creature that succeeds on this save is immune to the effect for 24 hours.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Plaguebearer Bites (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage plus 2 necrotic damage.
If at least two other chasmes attacked with it, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with fading ague.

reaction.name: Droning Chorus
entries: As a reaction when a creature the chasme can see within 30 feet makes a saving throw against another chasme's Drone, the chasme forces it to subtract one from its result.

name: Cerebrilith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The cerebrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Thought-Taster
entries: If the cerebrilith runs its tongue across a creature's exposed brain, it learns each of that creature's deepest secrets.

trait.name: Independent Lobes
entries: The cerebrilith can concentrate on up to four separate effects simultaneously. If it fails a saving throw to maintain concentration, it loses concentration on each effect it is concentrating on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerebrilith attacks four times with its Brainrake Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Searing Probe or Thought Mine.

action.name: Brainrake Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. A creature killed by this damage has the upper part of its skull removed.

action.name: Searing Probe (Concentration)
entries: The cerebrilith viciously delves into a creature's mind, telepathically relaying its secret weaknesses to the cerebrilith's allies.
One creature the cerebrilith can see within 60 feet must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, attacks made against the creature score a critical on an 17-20 for the next minute.

action.name: Thought Mine (Concentration)
entries: The cerebrilith sets a bomb of psionic energy in the mind of a creature it can see within 120 feet, forcing it to make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the first time in the next minute that the creature casts a spell of 1st level or above or uses a psionic ability, it takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage.

action.name: Desecration Stride (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: For the next minute, whenever the cerebrilith takes damage it may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each other creature within 10 feet of that space takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell, 1/Day)
entries: The cerebrilith and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet of it teleport to another plane of existence.

bonus.name: Multilobe Psionics
entries: The cerebrilith gains one of the following benefits for as long as it maintains concentration on it:

items.name: Thought Backup
entries: The cerebrilith has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration.

items.name: Shadow in the Weave
entries: A creature other than the cerebrilith that casts a spell of 1st level or higher while within 30 feet of the cerebrilith must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or take 3 (1d6) psychic damage per level of the spell.

items.name: Mindslice
entries: The cerebrilith's melee attacks have a reach of 60 feet and deal psychic damage instead of any other type.

items.name: Psionic Mirage
entries: Attacks made against the cerebrilith from more than 30 feet away are made at disadvantage.

name: Caligrosto
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Invisible
entries: The caligrosto is invisible. To creatures that ignore the effects of its invisibility, a weapon possessed by the caligrosto appears to be seething with coils of lightning-flecked mist.

trait.name: Masked Nature
entries: While the caligrosto is possessing a weapon, its creature type can't be detected by spells or magical effects.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The caligrosto can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Blade Haunting
entries: A blade Possessed by the caligrosto grows in power, cumulatively gaining the following traits as the caligrosto consumes hit dice lost to its abilities, and resetting to 0 hit dice at dawn:

items.name: 0 Hit Dice
entries: As an action, the weapon's wielder may lose two unexpended hit dice, feeding the blade.

items.name: 2 Hit Dice
entries: The weapon deals an additional 1d6 fire damage and scores a critical on a 19-20.

items.name: 4 Hit Dice
entries: The weapon's wielder gains 10 temporary hit points whenever it reduces a creature to 0 hit points.

items.name: 6 Hit Dice
entries: While incapacitated, the weapon's wielder ignores the effects of being incapacitated and acts under the caligrosto's control.

items.name: 8 Hit Dice
entries: On each of the caligrosto's turns, it may move the blade up to the caligrosto's fly speed and make two attacks with it (+7 to hit, +4 to damage rolls).

action.name: Lifeblood Empowerment
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the caligrosto must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and lose two unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.
While Possessing a weapon, the caligrosto may only target a creature that is wielding it with this ability.

action.name: Spawn Blood Echo
entries: If the caligrosto has consumed at least six hit dice since the last dawn, it creates a Blood Echo under its control in an unoccupied space within 5 feet, and the blade it is possessing flies into the blood echo's grasp.
While wielded by a Blood Echo, the effects of the caligrosto's Blade Haunting are represented in the Blood Echo's stat block and are not cumulative with it.

action.name: Blade Possession (1/Day)
entries: The caligrosto enters a nonartifact weapon within 5 feet that deals piercing or slashing damage and Possesses it until the caligrosto is expelled or the weapon is destroyed.

If the weapon is magical, the caligrosto must immediately succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be expelled from the weapon. Once expelled from a weapon, the caligrosto can't enter that weapon again.

reaction.name: Brutal Triumph
entries: As a reaction when a weapon the caligrosto is possessing reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the caligrosto consumes one of the creature's hit dice.

name: Blood Echo
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Blood Mimic
entries: When created, the blood echo takes on a fiendishly warped version of the appearance of the last creature hit with a melee attack by its creator (or by its creator's wielder).

trait.name: Echo Parasite
entries: The blood echo uses the attack bonus and saving throw bonuses of whichever creature it is mimicking with its Blood Mimic trait.
Whenever the blood echo takes damage of a type it is resistant to, the creature it is mimicking takes the same amount of damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blood echo makes two attacks with its Haunted Blade.

action.name: Haunted Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +X to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
This attack scores a critical on a 19-20.
If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the blood echo gains 10 temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Echo Shift
entries: As a reaction when the blood echo hits a creature with a melee attack, the blood echo takes on the creature's appearance as per its Blood Mimic trait.

trait.name: Shed Flesh
entries: If the bulezau is affected by the Fiendish Rot ability of another bulezau, its AC increases by 2, to a maximum of 16, and it gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage until it completes a Long rest.

trait.name: Fading Torpor
entries: Each time the bulezau reduces a creature to 0 hit points, its movement speed increases by 10 feet until it completes a Short or Long Rest, to maximum speed of 60 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bulezau makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Barbed Tail, and may use its Undying Hate if available.

action.name: Giantbreaker Greathammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Barbed Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become infected with Flitrot and be poisoned until the end of its next turn as it retches a gout of flies.

action.name: Undying Hate (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The bulezau's eyes burn with bloodshot fury as it glares at a creature within 5 feet of it. Until the end of the bulezau's next turn, it cannot be reduced below 1 hit point while that creature remains within 5 feet of it.

reaction.name: Infuriated Bellow
entries: As a reaction when the bulezau misses with an attack, it lets out an enraged scream.

Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks against the bulezau are made at advantage and whenever the creature it missed hits it with an attack, the bulezau may may make an attack with its Giantbreaker Greathammer against that creature.

trait.name: Shed Flesh
entries: If the bulezau is affected by its Fiendish Rot ability or by that of another bulezau, its AC increases by 2, to a maximum of 16, and it gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage until it completes a Long rest.

trait.name: Fading Torpor
entries: Each time the bulezau reduces a creature to 0 hit points, its movement speed increases by 10 feet until it completes a Short or Long Rest, to maximum speed of 60 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bulezau makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Barbed Tail.

action.name: Outsize Ranseur
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Barbed Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become infected with Flitrot and be poisoned until the end of its next turn as it retches a gout of flies.

action.name: Fiendish Rot (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature (including the bulezau) within 15 ft. that does not have all of its hit points must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Fend off
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the bulezau may make an attack against it with its Outsize Ranseur. If the attack hits, the creature's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

name: Blood Fiend
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Demonic Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the fiend polymorphs into any Large demon, a Large cloud of crimson mist with a 20 ft. fly speed, or back to its true form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form.

trait.name: Bloodmist Rebirth
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points, the fiend bursts into a 30 foot radius of crimson mist that heavily obscures the area for 1d4 rounds, after which the fiend may consume a demonic corpse in the area to gain a new body with 1 hit point and take on the corpse's appearance.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fiend makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Blood Drain.

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled, incapacitated, restrained, or willing creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or lose three unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot. The fiend gains 10 hit points for each hit die lost this way by a demon.

action.name: Razor Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit. reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

action.name: Concussive Slam
entries: The fiend slams up to two creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface.
Each of the creatures must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the fiend's next turn.

action.name: Terror Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the fiend can see must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
While frightened in this way, any attack that hits the creature becomes a critical hit.

reaction.name: Raise Abyssal Thrall (4th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the fiend reduces a Medium or Large demon of CR 10 or below to 0 hit points with its Blood Drain, it immediately raises the demon as an Abyssal Thrall.

reaction.name: Fiendish Glare (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 137 hit points, the fiend immediately recharges and uses its Terror Gaze.

legendary.name: Bowl Over
entries: The fiend moves up to its speed directly toward a creature it can see. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Hurl
entries: The fiend hurls a Medium or smaller creature that is grappled by it up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Savage (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The fiend makes two Razor Claw attacks against creature within 5 feet, or three Razor Claw attacks if the target is prone.

name: Abyssal Thrall
languages: understands Abyssal but can't speak it

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Bound Thrall
entries: Whenever it attempts to attack the creature that raised it or one of that creature's allies, the thrall must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the thrall is charmed by its target for the next hour and must choose a new target or lose the attack.

action.name: Rip and Tear (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Blood-Crazed Advance
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet takes piercing or slashing damage, the thrall moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Bebilith Ruinarch
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Scent Paragon
entries: The bebilith can track the aproximate location, by scent, of each creature in a 5 mile radius. A creature that does not mask its scent has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from the bebiith.

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the bebilith to 0 hit points must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the creature is unaffected by any magic that would return it to life.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The bebilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the bebilith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bebilith makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Fusevenom Bite, or makes one attack and uses its Soulchar Web, if available.

action.name: Fusevenom Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature poisoned in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or taking 11 (2d10) force damage on a failure.

A creature that dies while poisoned in this way explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Rending Forelegs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) slashing damage, and the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Soulchar Web (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bebilith launches webbing in a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 21).

A creature restrained in this way takes 10 (3d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature that teleports out of the web takes 22 (4d10) force damage and must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the bebilith's next turn.
The webbing can be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; 20 HP; immunity to bludgeoning, fire, poison, and psychic damage)

bonus.name: Soulchar Bind
entries: One prone creature within 15 feet of the bebilith must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be wrapped in its webbing and restrained. (escape DC 21).

If the target is Huge or smaller, the bebilith may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action. A creature restrained in this way takes 10 (3d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Rattling Hiss
entries: The bebilith lets out a fearsome hiss at a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the bebilith and be frightened until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Titanic Shift
entries: The bebilith moves up to half its speed. Each Medium or larger creature whose space it moves through with this movmeent must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Sap and Sicken
entries: One creature restrained in the bebilith's webs must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or lose any resistance or immunity to Poison damage or the poisoned condition that it has.

legendary.name: Blinding Bristles
entries: The bebilith ejects some of its barbed bristles, forcing one creature within 5 feet to succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing damage and be blinded until it takes an action to clear its eyes.

legendary.name: Leaping Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The bebilith jumps up to 60 feet and makes a Rending Forelegs attack.

name: Bebilith Charblood

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 piercing damage.
For the next minute, if the target would teleport any distance, it instead teleports half as far.

trait.name: Invisible Terror
entries: The barlgura is invisible. Whenever the barlgura reduces a creature within 5 feet to 0 hit points, it becomes splattered with blood and visible until it takes an action to clear the blood.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The barlgura's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the barlgura jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any medium or smaller creature.

A creature whose space the barlgura enters in this way must must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage, or be pushed into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The barlgura makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Mauling Bite.

action.name: Mauling Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose an eye, nose, lip, or ear (target's choice).

action.name: Studded Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Wild Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Slam
entries: The barlgura slams a grappled creature into a wall or floor. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the barlgura's next turn, or taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The barlgura hurls a grappled creature up to 40 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature whose space the thrown creature lands in must make the same saving throw, taking no damage and moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Reckless Tumble
entries: As a reaction when the barlgura misses with a melee attack, it may immediately make a Wild Fist attack at advantage, then fall prone and end its turn.

reaction.name: Bloodthirsty Howl
entries: As a reaction when the barlgura reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it lets out a terrifying howl and gains 15 temporary hit points.

While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the barlgura that can see it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the barlgura until the beginning of the creature's next turn.
