name: Balor Scion of Brutality
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Blazing Gaze
entries: When a creature that the balor can see and that can see the balor's eyes starts its turn within 15 feet of it, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 11 (2d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the balor until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the balor may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 22 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the balor. While climbing on the balor, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the balor, and the balor has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. On saving throws against magical effects that would Blind it, the balor has disadvantage, instead of advantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the balor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The balor makes two melee attacks with different weapons, one of which it may replace  with a use of its Teleport.

action.name: Headripper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be decapitated.

action.name: Lightning Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. On a critical hit with this attack, the balor rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Burning Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 43 (10d6 + 8) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.
For each roll of 6 on the damage dice, this attack deals an additional d6 fire damage.

action.name: Teleport (7th Level Spell)
entries: The balor and each creature climbing on it magically teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Brutal Display
entries: As a reaction when a friendly creature within 30 feet misses with an attack, the balor makes an attack against it with its Burning Lash. Each other demon within 30 feet gains advantage on the first attack it makes on its following turn.

legendary.name: Meteor Stride
entries: The balor moves up to half its fly speed, then drops to the ground. Each creature in the space where it lands is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space and must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Wrathful Devotion (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The balor lets out a teeth-rattling roar of challenge. Each creature of the balor's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to target creatures other than the balor with attacks or harmful spells until the beginning of the balor's next turn.

legendary.name: Inspire Bloodlust (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The balor teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and makes an attack.
Each demon within 120 feet of the balor that can see it may use its reaction to move up to half its speed directly toward the attack's target.

name: Balor Warmongerer

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The balor makes two attacks: one with its lightning blade and one with its burning lash. It may replace one of its attacks with a use of its Teleport.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. On a critical hit with this attack, the balor rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

For each roll of 6 on the damage dice, this attack deals an additional d6 fire damage.

action.name: Teleport (7th Level Spell)
entries: The balor and each creature climbing on it magically teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Liar's Guile
entries: The adaru can detect lies told by creatures within 30 feet of it by scent.

trait.name: Vent Evil
entries: The pores in an adaru's carapace constantly vent an vile miasma that warps the minds of all it touches. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the adaru must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature is poisoned and frightened until the beginning of its next turn if it is non-evil, or charmed and under the adaru's control for the same duration if it is evil.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The adaru has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The adaru makes two attacks with its Skittering Coils, one of which it may replace with its Dripping Mandibles or the Dodge action.

action.name: Dripping Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

action.name: Skittering Coils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
While grappled in this way, a creature is restrained and must immediately answer any question asked of it.

reaction.name: Devour Lies
entries: As a reaction when a creature grappled by the adaru tells a lie, the adaru attaches its sucking organ to the creature's face.
The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage and lose any proficiency it has in Deception until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The scavenger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Death Shriek
entries: When the scavenger drops to 0 hit points, each other scavenger within 15 ft. can make a melee attack as a reaction.

action.name: Engulfing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). If the target is a Medium or smaller creature that isn't grappled by another scavenger, its head is engulfed in the scavenger's mouth and it is blinded and can't speak or breathe while grappled in this way.

action.name: Frenzied Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. Each other scavenger within 30 ft. can move up to 10 ft. toward the target as a reaction.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both the scavenger and at least one of the scavenger's allies must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall prone and take 10 (3d6) piercing damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Adapt Resistance
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it doesn't have resistance to, the scavenger gains resistance to that damage type until the start of its next turn.

name: Chicken Tree
resist: bludgeoning and piercing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: telepathy 60 ft. (Works Only With Creatures That Understand Abyssal)

trait.name: Boiling Blood
entries: Whenever the tree takes any slashing damage, the tree and one creature of its choice within 10 feet each take 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tree makes two attacks with its Meaty Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Spawn Chicken.

action.name: Meaty Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead stunned until the end of the tree's next turn.

action.name: Spawn Chicken
entries: The tree loses 5 hit points as one of the fleshy sacs that hang from the its branches tears open in a shower of blood and amniotic fluid, spawning an Abyssal Chicken in the tree's space that acts on initiative count 0.

action.name: Hurl Sac (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The tree hurls a sac of putrefied demonflesh at a point within 60 feet, where it showers the area in a 10 foot radius in foul gore. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (5d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Horrid Scream
entries: As a reaction when the chicken tree takes 15 or more damage from a single source, a garbled, squawking scream issues forth from its wounds.
Each abyssal chicken within 60 feet that can hear the tree may make a Razor Talon attack on its following turn as a bonus action.

name: Swarm of Abyssal Chickens

trait.name: Swarm

action.name: Razor Talons

name: Cerunnos, Master of the Wild Hunt
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Moonlit Raed
entries: While lit by moonlight, the first time each turn Cerunnos leaves a creature's sight that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or lose all clear memories of him, recalling him only as a dim and distant dream.

trait.name: Archfey Resilience
entries: Cerunnos succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Cerunnos would fail a saving throw, he may choose to succeed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cerunnos makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dubh Smàladh, the Smoldering Cloud
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage and Cerunnos adds an additional effect of his choice:
The target takes an additional 14 (4d6) lighting damage.
The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be levitated up to 30 feet into the air until the beginning of Cerunnos' next turn.
The target must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or switch places with a willing creature within 60 feet of it that Cerunnos can see.

action.name: Wild Terror (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Cerunnos lets loose a wild cry that plants the frantic terror of a hounded beast. Each creature of his choice that can see or hear him must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened. A frightened creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is polymorphed into a Hart for as long as it remains frightened, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Flush Quarry
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails at an attempt to Hide from Cerunnos, Cerunnos uses his Scouring Moonfire targeting it, if available.

reaction.name: Horn of the Wild Hunt (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 179 hit points, Cerunnos blows the Horn of the Wild hunt, summoning five Hounds of the Wild Hunt that act on his initiative to unoccupied spaces he can see.

legendary.name: Scouring Moonfire
entries: One creature illuminated by moonlight that Cerunnos can see must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) radiant damage. A flying or levitating creature makes this save at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Blood Hunt
entries: Up to two of Cerunnos' hound allies, or up to one of his non-hound allies, may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Invective of the Thrice-Cursed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 30 feet that Cerunnos can see must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 1d4 until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic, to a minimum of 1.
A creature that dies with its Wisdom score reduced to 1 in this way is claimed as a rider of The Wild Hunt, and cannot be revived by any means short of a Wish spell.

entries: The windigo fails all Charisma saving throws without rolling.

trait.name: Heart of Ice
entries: If the windigo is killed and its body is not burned, it returns to life with full hit points after 1d10 days, though this does not cause it to regrow any lost body parts.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the windigo may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the windigo. While climbing on the windigo, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the windigo, and the windigo has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Grasping Claws

action.name: Brutal Slam

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)

reaction.name: Insatiable Craving

reaction.name: Terrible Scream (1/Day)

On a failed save, a creature falls asleep for the next minute, or until it takes any damage or another creature uses its action to wake it. On a success, the creature is instead blinded until the end of the windigo's next turn.

legendary.name: Light-Footed Lope
entries: The windigo moves up to half its speed. Until the end of its next turn, it may treat any surface as solid ground.

legendary.name: Snatch
entries: The windigo makes an attack with its Grasping Claws.

legendary.name: Swallow Whole (Costs 2 Actions)

At the beginning of the windigo's next turn, if the creature is still grappled it is swallowed and the windigo regains 10 hit points and an expended Legendary Resistance. The swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) cold damage at the end of each of its turns.
A creature that deals 20 or more piercing or slashing damage to the windigo in a turn may use its Bonus Action to cut a hole through which swallowed creatures may attempt to escape (escape DC 20).

entries: An unconscious creature automatically fails Dexterity and Strength saving throws.

entries: A bush or shrub that contains one or more snipes gains the statistics of an Animated Shrub.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: The snipe is  invisible to any creature with less than 20 Passive Perception. Whenever the snipe is hit with an attack or grappled, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

action.name: Curious Nip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage and the target may use its reaction to attempt to grapple the snipe.

reaction.name: Panic

trait.name: Watery Rebirth

A creature charmed in this way uses its movement to approach the rusalka on its turn. A charmed target repeats saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Tickle

reaction.name: Vengeful Smash

reaction.name: Flickering Rampage (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 95 hit points, the rider hurls its shield at a creature within 20 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.
For the next minute, whenever the rider makes an attack it may teleport up to 15 feet as part of the attack, and it loses all damage resistances and its Limited Magic Immunity.

trait.name: Never There
entries: When the rider succeeds on a saving throw made against a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Slithermist (4th Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, ranged 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and the rider may make another attack against a creature within 15 feet of the previous target. A creature may be the target of this spell only once per turn.

action.name: Moon Virtues
entries: The rider targets a creature it can see within 60 feet, choosing one of the following effects:

items.name: Confounding Lurch
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet.

items.name: Hazy Transposition
entries: One target creature within 60 feet must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or switch positions with one of the rider's Mist Reflections.

items.name: Shifting Silhouettes
entries: A stark silver light reduces everyone to shadowy silhouettes for the creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or treat all creatures as hostile until the end of the rider's next turn.

items.name: Treacherous Footing
entries: The creature must succeed on DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 18) until the end of the rider's next turn as the ground beneath it becomes briefly insubstantial.

items.name: Moonstruck
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented by the dancing moonlight, suffering disadvantage on its next attack roll. If the attack misses, the creature falls prone.

reaction.name: Vaporize
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the rider reduces the projectile to wisps of vapor, reducing the attack's damage to 0.

reaction.name: Mist Reflections (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 55 hit points, the rider gains 55 temporary hit points, splits into five Mist Reflections that each appear at an unoccupied location within 60 feet, and gains resistance to all damage as long as it has at least two Mist Forms.

A Mist Reflection dissipates when it is dealt damage, and when only one remeains it becomes corporeal and this effect ends. If all remaining Mist Reflections are dealt damage simultaneously, the rider is slain.

trait.name: False Appearance

trait.name: Outsize Strength

A creature that fails this save by 10 or more loses an eye.

action.name: Rouse Blood (5th level spell, Recharge 5-6)

entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the oread may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

trait.name: Sure-footed
entries: The oread has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

trait.name: Mountain Echo
entries: Whenever a spell is cast within 30 ft. of the oread, the spell takes effect twice. The oread chooses the targets for the duplicate spell. If the spell requires concentration, the oread must concentrate on it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oread makes three attacks with its elusive bow, one of which it may replace with a Rough Shove.

action.name: Elusive Bow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the oread becomes invisible to the target until the end of the oread's next turn. This bow can fire arrows, bolts, or javelins.

action.name: Rough Shove
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 25 (6d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 20 ft. away. A creature that cannot see the oread makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Catch Token
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a ranged weapon attack, the oread catches the projectile. As long as it holds this projectile, it gains +3 AC against the attacker's attacks. If the oread fires the projectile back at its owner, the attack hits automatically.

trait.name: Captivating Visage
entries: A creature that can see the nymph treats all other creatures and objects as invisible.

A creature that isn't charmed or Surprised by the nymph can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the beginning of its turn, instead treating the nymph as invisible until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Eldritch Grace
entries: While the nymph is moving on her turn, she becomes indistinct and insubstantial, gaining resistance to all damage.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the nymph may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

action.name: Whisper Game
entries: One creature within 10 feet of the nymph must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
Whenever a charmed creature succeeds on a saving throw to end this effect, the nymph may force one creature within 10 feet of it to make a saving throw against the same effect.

action.name: Borrow Dreams
entries: One unconscious creature within 5 feet of the nymph must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 21 (6d6) nonlethal psychic damage.
If the creature fails this saving throw by 5 or more, this damage does not wake it, and the nymph gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
If the unconscious creature awakes, the nymph loses any of these temporary hit points that it has and the creature gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

action.name: Ensnare (1/Day)
entries: The nymph sets a faintly visible magical trap that lasts for a minute in a 5 foot radius centered on herself, which triggers the first time a nonfey creature enters the area.
The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious until it takes any damage or a creature uses its action to wake it.

bonus.name: Parting Touch
entries: The nymph touches a charmed creature within 5 feet. Until the charmed effect ends for it, the creature takes 7 (2d6) nonlethal psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns for each 5 feet away from the nymph that it is.

bonus.name: Entreat
entries: One creature charmed by the nymph must use its reaction to move up to its speed toward and make an attack against a target of the nymph's choice.

reaction.name: Blinding Beauty (1/Day)

trait.name: Trickster's Tumble
entries: The nilbog can take the Dodge action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Healing Reversal
entries: If the nilbog would receive a source of magical healing, it instead loses that many hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nilbog makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with its Distorted Perception, if available.

action.name: Fool's Scepter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. For the next minute, the target falls prone and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage whenever it misses with an attack.

action.name: Distorted Perception (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 ft must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, for the next minute whenever the creature moves the nilbog chooses the direction of that movement. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Trade Weapon
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee weapon attack, the nilbog trades weapons with the attacker. It is considered attuned to any magic weapons that require attunement.

reaction.name: Damage Reversal
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack or hostile spell, the nilbog activates its damage reversal, taking no damage and instead being healed for the same amount. The nilbog receives healing beyond its maximum hit points as temporary hit points.

trait.name: Gifted Token
entries: The naiad may gift a lock of her hair to a creature. For the next year and a day, while it bears this token the creature gains a +2 bonus to its Charisma score. If the creature takes any action the naiad considers dishonorable, this magic ends.

trait.name: Polymorph Weakness
entries: Spells and magical effects that would polymorph the naiad persist until dispelled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The naiad uses its aquatic aid twice, one of which it may replace with the dash action.

action.name: Aquatic Aid
entries: One creature that the naiad can see within 10 ft. of a body of fresh water must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. in a direction of the nymph's choice.

action.name: Parting Touch
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the next minute. While charmed in this way, a creature takes 3 (1d6) nonlethal psychic damage at the start of each of its turn for each 5 ft. away from the nymph that it is.
A charmed creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Blood to Water
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the naiad forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature submerged in fresh water must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or acquire a point of exhaustion.

action.name: Shadow Teleport

trait.name: Blessed Death

action.name: Shifting Stone

action.name: Dancing Shadows

action.name: Iron Braid
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or suffer one effect of the korred's choice.
The target is restrained (escape DC 17). While the korred has a creature restrained in this way, the korred cannot use its iron braid.
The target falls prone. If it is grappling a creature, the target releases its grapple.
The target is pulled up to 20 ft. toward the korred.

entries: If it is underground, the korred changes the orientation of gravity toward an earthen or stone surface within 30 ft. for itself, and for any creatures grappled by it.

This effect ends early if the creature is more than 5 ft. from the korred, or if the creature ends its turn prone.

action.name: Cudgeleer's Jig (Recharge 5-6)

entries: The huldra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. While she is grappled by the tail, this trait is suspended.

trait.name: Blessings of the Treewarden
entries: The huldra's blessing may be gained by treating her with respect and deference, and by strictly following any and all rules set by her. A creature loses the huldra's blessing if she perceives a violation, however minor, of her rules. A creature with the huldra's favor gains the following benefits until it leaves her home forest:

items.name: Warded Rest
entries: A blessed creature will wake if approached by a hostile creature.

items.name: Kinmarked
entries: Giants friendly to the huldra treat a blessed creature as a trusted ally.

items.name: The Forest's Aid
entries: A blessed creature has advantage on Survival (Wisdom) checks made to navigate, hunt, fish or forage.

trait.name: Hollow Back
entries: The huldra has vulnerability to fire damage dealt by a creature that is flanking it.

action.name: Multiattack

reaction.name: Bend Iron

entries: The huldra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. While she is grappled by the tail, this trait is suspended.

trait.name: Hollow Back
entries: The huldra has vulnerability to fire damage dealt by a creature that is flanking it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The huldra makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Huntersbane Breath, if available.

action.name: Hammerblow Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or fall prone.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the huldra's next turn.

action.name: Hurl Boulder
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Huntersbane Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The huldra exhales a mighty wind in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area is pushed 10 ft. away and must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature subtracts 1d4 from any attack rolls it makes until the next dawn.

reaction.name: Bend Iron
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack made with a nonmagical metal weapon, the huldra catches and bends the weapon, applying a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.

name: Hound of the Wild Hunt
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Moonhunter's Baying
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of three or more hounds of the wild hunt that can hear them subtracts 1d4 from saving throws it makes agains being frightened.

action.name: Snarling Bite (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the hound can grapple the target (escape DC 16).

action.name: Worry (Group Action)
entries: One creature grappled by both the hound and at least one of the hound's allies must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or fall prone and take 12 damage per creature grappling it.

action.name: Harry
entries: One frightened creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from it.

reaction.name: Planelock Howl (Group Reaction)
entries: As a reaction when a creature it can see attempts to teleport, the hound begins to howl forcing the creature to succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have its teleportation fail.
Up to four other hounds may join this reaction, increasing the DC by 1 for each additional hound.

name: The Green Man, Patron of Renewal
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Archfey Resistance
entries: The green man succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on his turn, the green man can use 10 feet of his movement to step magically into one living tree within his reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

trait.name: Wilding Pollen
entries: A non-fey, non-plant creature that starts its turn within 15 ft. of the green man must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be beset on all sides by illusory foes. Until the beginning of its next turn attack rolls of odd numbers (after modifiers) made by an affected creature always miss.

trait.name: Stormshield
entries: Whenever the green man would take lightning damage, he can channel and direct the lightning through his shield. One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the lightning damage in his stead.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the green man would fail a saving throw, he may speak a secret name of the forest to succeed. If he uses his third legendary resistance, the forest ceases to aid him until the next dawn.
Will, Will, Weald
You Who Know The Gate
The Everclosing All and One

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archfey makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Gáe Dearg, The Reddened Root
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have rootlike tendrils sprout from the wound, preventing its closure.
Magical healing that the creature receives is halved until a creature uses its action to remove the roots with a successful DC 18 Wisdom (Medicine) or Intelligence (Nature) check.

action.name: Briar Tomb (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The green man creates a 20 ft. radius, 1 ft thick hemisphere of thorny vines centered on a point within 60 feet. Creatures on the other side of the barrier are considered to have half-cover.

A creature whose space is intersected by the thorns when they appear must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity save or take 18 (4d8) slashing damage, moving to a side of its choice on a success. A creature may push through the vines by spending 20 feet of movement and taking 18 (4d8) slashing damage.
The vines are an object that can be damaged and thus breached. They have AC 18 and 30 hit points, and are vulnerable to fire damage.

reaction.name: Thorny Retort
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the green man may cause the attacker's weapon to sprout thorns, dealing 9 (2d8) piercing damage to the attacker. The attacker must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or drop their weapon. If the attacker picks up its weapon this turn, the green man may immediately make a melee attack against it at advantage.

legendary.name: Spear
entries: The green man makes a melee attack.

legendary.name: Call Lightning (costs 2 actions)
entries: The green man is struck with a bolt of lightning. He and each creature within 5 ft. of him must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (3d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Nourish the Earth (costs 2 actions)
entries: Rootlike tendrils worm out of the green man's briar tomb, piercing the flesh of those within it. Each creature inside the briar tomb must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, its maximum hit points are reduced to its current hit points. The nearest plant creature friendly to the green man gains 5 temporary hit points for each hit die expended this way.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the dryad may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

trait.name: Fervent Protectors
entries: While a creature that is charmed by the dryad is within 5 feet of it, attacks against the dryad have disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dryad makes two attacks with its club, and uses either its soporific fragrance or its entreat ability.

action.name: Club
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target has no adjacent allies, this attack is made at advantage and deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

action.name: Soporific Fragrance
entries: One humanoid creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. While charmed, the creature moves towards the dryad by the most direct path. Each time the target takes damage, it may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Entreat
entries: One creature charmed by the dryad moves up to its speed and makes an attack against a target of its choice.

action.name: Briar Cage (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Dryad creates a 15 ft radius hemisphere of thorny vines within 60 feet, 1 ft thick. A creature whose space is intersected by the thorns when they appear must succeed on a DC 15 dexterity save or be restrained, moving to a side of its choice on a success. A creature may push through the vines by spending 20 feet of movement and taking 18 (4d8) slashing damage. The vines are an object that can be damaged and thus breached. They have AC 12 and 30 hit points, and are vulnerable to fire damage.

reaction.name: Thorny Retort
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the dryad may cause the attacker's weapon to sprout thorns, dealing 1d8 piercing damage to the attacker. The attacker must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or drop their weapon. If the attacker picks up its weapon this turn, the dryad may immediately make a club attack against it.

trait.name: Poison Vulnerability
entries: The centaur has disadvantage on saving throws against drunkenness and the poisoned condition.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the centaur moves at least 20 ft. before attacking, its attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur attacks three times with its longbow, or makes one melee attack and takes the disengage action.

action.name: Bastard Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The centaur may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

action.name: Centaur Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target is pushed back 5 ft.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the centaur that benefits from flanking it, the centaur makes a hooves attack.

trait.name: Poison Vulnerability
entries: The centaur has disadvantage on saving throws against drunkenness and the poisoned condition.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the centaur moves at least 20 ft. before attacking, its attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Pike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The centaur may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the centaur that benefits from flanking it, the centaur makes a hooves attack.

trait.name: Home Defender
entries: Whenever a creature passes through a threshold in a home that contains one or more brownies, the brownie can force the creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

items.name: Triptwine
entries: The creature takes 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.

items.name: Fingerstinger
entries: The creature takes 2 (1d4) poison damage and drops one object it is carrying.

items.name: Pepperpouch
entries: The creature is blinded and unable to speak or breathe until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: The brownie is  invisible to creatures with less than 20 Passive Perception. Whenever it is hit with an attack, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The brownie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brownie makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with its Brownie's Cunning.

action.name: Toe-Stubber
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone if it is Medium or smaller and has its movement speed reduced by 10 for the next minute.

action.name: Rubber Sling
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Brownie's Cunning
entries: The brownie makes a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Dexterity (Stealth) check.

reaction.name: Trick Shot
entries: As a reaction when a creature the brownie can see within 30 feet drops an object, the brownie makes an attack with its rubber sling against an AC of 20. On a hit, the dropped object is pushed 15 feet in a direction of the brownie's choice.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The dog has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dog makes two bite attacks. It may replace one with a use of its teleport.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) piercing damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then makes a bite attack at advantage. If this attack hits, the creature must make a DC 12 strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Waterveiled Assassin
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Whelming Wave
entries: The assassin can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

A Huge or smaller creature whose space the assassin enters for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn in the assassin's space, must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be grappled and restrained (escape DC 19).

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the assassin takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the assassin ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Shipbreaker Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 84 (12d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Tumbling Churn
entries: Each creature in the assassin's space must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A target that was holding its breath and fails this saving throw by 5 or more loses its breath and begins suffocating.

reaction.name: Surge Wave
entries: When the assassin is missed with a melee attack, it can move up to 10 feet directly toward the attacker.

reaction.name: Liquid Dodge
entries: When the assassin would make a saving throw, it can make a Dexterity saving throw of the same DC instead. On a success, the assassin suffers no harmful effects.

name: Voidwraith
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Airless Aura
entries: Creatures within 15 feet of the voidwraith can't speak or breathe, and the voidwraith's movement makes no sound.

trait.name: Voidform
entries: It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While fully obscured, the voidwraith may attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Shifting Nothingness
entries: If the voidwraith would roll at the end of its turn to end a magical effect, it may roll at the beginning of its turn to end the effect as well.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The void wraith makes two attacks with its void intrusion.

action.name: Void Intrusion
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 8 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.
A creature hit by this attack that is out of breath must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

action.name: Wheezing Reclamation (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The voidwraith attempts to wrench forth the air from the lungs of creatures nearby. Each creature within 15 feet of the voidwraith that is holding its breath must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage and lose its held breath, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Howling Void
entries: When the voidwraith fails a saving throw, it can briefly intensify the sucking winds that surround it.
Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the voidwraith.
Until the beginning of its next turn, the area within 30 feet of the voidwraith is difficult terrain for creatures attempting to move away from it.

name: Salamander Noble
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that hits the salamander with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Trail of Flame
entries: Whenever the salamander moves, the space it left catches fire until the end of the salamander's next turn. A creature that enters the space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salamander makes two attacks, one of which may be with its tail, and uses its guardian flames ability.

action.name: Ashen Sarissa
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire damage).

action.name: Guardian Flames
entries: One creature the salamander can see within 60 ft. that is immune to fire damage is wreathed in protective flames. The next time the creature is attacked before the end of the salamander's next turn, the attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (3d10) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the salamander can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the salamander can't make tail attacks against other targets.

reaction.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the salamander reduces the attack's damage to 0.

name: Salamander Flame-Archer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that hits the salamander with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salamander makes two attacks, one of which may be with its tail.

action.name: Blazing Bow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit,range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire damage).

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the salamander can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the salamander can't make tail attacks against other targets.

action.name: Rain of Ruin (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The salamander makes a blazing bow attack against each creature in a 20 ft. radius.

reaction.name: Tail Lash
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the salamander's reach, the salamander forces the creature to succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet backwards and knocked prone. A creature has advantage on this save if the salamander has used its drop tail ability.

reaction.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the salamander reduces the attack's damage to 0.

name: Salamander Lancer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that hits the salamander with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salamander makes two attacks, one of which may be with its tail.

action.name: Snake-Tongue Ranseur
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) fire damage).

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
A creature grappled in this way takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the beginning of each of the salamander's turns.

action.name: Whirlwind of Fire (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 10 ft. of the salamander must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) fire damage and be pushed 10 ft. away, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Brace
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the salamander forces the creature to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have its movement reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the salamander reduces the attack's damage to 0.

name: Pyroclasm Vortex
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the vortex takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the vortex can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the burning condition.

trait.name: Fire Incarnate
entries: The vortex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can move through and stop in the space of other creatures.
A creature who has the vortex enter its space for the first time in a turn takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and begins burning (1d10).

trait.name: Raze-Winds
entries: A Large or smaller creature whose space the vortex enters for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn in the vortex's space, must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be carried aloft and restrained (escape DC 18) in the vortex.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the vortex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vortex makes four attacks with its Fiery Windspike, or makes two attacks and uses its Burning Whorl.

action.name: Fiery Windspike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning plus 5 (1d10) fire damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the vortex's center. A flammable object hit with this attack catches fire.

action.name: Burning Whorl
entries: Each creature in the vortex's space must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
A burning creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its burning value increase by a cumulative 1d10 until it leaves the vortex's space.

action.name: Fireburst (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The vortex flares explosively, searing each creature within 10 feet of it. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d8) fire damage, or take half as much damage on a success.
On a success or failure, each creature restrained in the vortex is hurled 30 feet in a random direction and takes an additional 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Guttering Revival
entries: When the vortex uses its Implacable trait, it can teleport up to 90 feet to a space that contains an open flame, then make two melee attacks.

reaction.name: Scorch Lungs
entries: When a creature in the vortex's space speaks or casting a spell with a verbal component, the vortex can force the creature to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) fire damage and begin suffocating (save ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Dampened Flames
entries: If the phoenix takes 10 or more cold damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Fiery Rebirth
entries: When the phoenix is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die. Instead, its body crumbles to ash, revealing a new phoenix fledgeling. This trait is suspended in an area infused with unholy power by the Hallow spell. If the phoenix's body is completely destroyed while this trait is suspended, the phoenix dies.

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: The phoenix can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage and 5 (1d10) fire damage. On a critical hit, the target is blinded until the end of the phoenix's next turn.

name: Mud Lasher
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mud lasher can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Caking Mud
entries: Whenever the mud lasher takes fire damage, its speed is reduced by 10 and its AC increases by 2 for the next minute. The mud lasher dies if its speed is reduced to 0 in this way.

action.name: Drowning Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Mud Ball
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature knocked prone in this way must spend its full movement to stand.

reaction.name: Shifting Form
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the mud lasher moves up to 15 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity.

reaction.name: Stuff Face
entries: As a reaction to a creature it has grappled attempting to speak or cast a spell, the mud lasher forces it to make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature's mouth and throat filled with mud, preventing it from speaking or breathing until the beginning of its next turn.

name: Lava Child
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the lava child dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

trait.name: Metal Immunity
entries: The lava child can move through metal without hindrance, and it has advantage on attack rolls against any creature wearing metal armor or using a metal shield.

trait.name: Molten Body
entries: If the lava child takes any cold damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be petrified. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the lava child melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lava child makes two attacks: one with its Furnace Grin and one with its obsidian claws.

action.name: Furnace Grin Gape
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) fire damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the lava child's next turn.

action.name: Obsidian Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage and the target ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: The lava child begins to swallow a Medium or smaller creature that is incapacitated. At the beginning of the lava child's next turn, the target is swallowed and incinerated, and the lava child regains all hit points. This action is disrupted if the lava child takes any cold damage.

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the dao dies, its body disintegrates into crystalline powder, leaving behind only equipment the dao was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The dao can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dao doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Earth Mastery
entries: Earth and unworked stone in a 15 ft. radius around the Dao moves at its whim. A creature that starts its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. in a direction of the dao's choice.

trait.name: Rooted Stance
entries: If the dao does not use its multiattack on its turn, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dao has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dao makes three stone fist attacks.

action.name: Stone Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) slashing damage, the target is knocked prone, and must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Stonewall Eruption
entries: The dao raises a wall of stone on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 1 foot thick and up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high. When the wall appears, creatures in its space are pushed to a side of their choice and must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
The wall can be damaged and breached; each 10-foot section has AC 20, 30 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage.

action.name: Shockwave Stomp (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 83 (14d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the Dao's next turn. The ground in a 15 ft. radius around the dao becomes difficult terrain, and each other creature within that radius is pushed 10 ft. away.

reaction.name: Fissures
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 151 hit points, the dao opens up to four fissures in the earth, each 5 ft. wide, 20 ft. long, and 15 ft. deep. A creature in one or more of the areas when they open must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or fall in, moving to an adjacent space on a success.

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the dao dies, its body disintegrates into crystalline powder, leaving behind only equipment the dao was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Earth Mastery
entries: Earth and unworked stone in a 15 ft. radius around the Dao moves at its whim. A creature that starts its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. in a direction of the dao's choice.

trait.name: Rooted Stance
entries: If the dao does not use its multiattack on its turn, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dao makes three stone lash attacks.

action.name: Stone Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the dao.

action.name: Shockwave Stomp (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 83 (14d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the Dao's next turn. The ground in a 15 ft. radius around the dao becomes difficult terrain, and each other creature within that radius is pushed 10 ft. away.

reaction.name: Dismaying Whip
entries: As a reaction to a creature in range standing from prone, the dao makes a stone lash attack against it.

reaction.name: Mountain Strength Slam
entries: As a reaction to a creature involuntarily moving within 5 ft of it, the dao forces the creature to succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and unable to stand on its following turn.

reaction.name: Fissures
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 126 hit points, the dao opens up to four fissures in the earth, each 5 ft. wide, 20 ft. long, and 15 ft. deep. A creature in one or more of the areas when they open must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or fall in, moving to an adjacent space on a success.

trait.name: Flail Tentacles
entries: The flail snail has five flail tentacles. Whenever the snail takes 10 or more damage from a single source, one of its tentacles dies.  If the snail has no tentacles remaining, it retracts into its shell and begins to wail loudly.

trait.name: Salt-Shriveled
entries: If a creature casts salt on the flail snail with an improvised weapon attack, the flail snail takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and gains a level of exhaustion on a hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flail snail makes as many flail tentacle attacks as it has flail tentacles, then uses its Shift Harmonics.

action.name: Flail Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If this attack misses by 5 or more, the target may use its reaction to make a single melee attack against the snail.

action.name: Shift Harmonics
entries: The snail shifts the swirling patterns of its shell, adopting two of the following effects until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Resistance
entries: The snail has advantage on saving throws against spells.

items.name: Diffraction
entries: Spell attacks made against the snail have disadvantage.

items.name: Reflection
entries: If the snail is missed with a spell attack, the spell is reflected back at its caster.

items.name: Refraction
entries: If the snail succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, the spell's energy is converted into a magical explosion. Each creature within 30 ft. of the snail must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 force damage per level of the spell, or half as much on a success.

items.name: Absorption
entries: If the snail is targeted with a spell, it gains 10 (3d6) temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Shell Defense
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged weapon attack, the snail withdraws into its shell, gaining a +4 bonus to AC until the beginning of its next turn. It cannot attack while withdrawn.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

trait.name: Void Aura
entries: The area within 5 feet of the myrmidon is magically silent and devoid of air. Creatures in the area are choking.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Hollow Out.

action.name: Void Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet towards the myrmidon. This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying creature.

action.name: Hollow Out
entries: The myrmidon drains the life force from a creature within 10 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target loses 3 (1d6) unexpended hit dice, or gains a level of exhaustion if it can't.

reaction.name: Nullify
entries: When the myrmidon would be affected by a spell of 2nd level or lower, it can choose to be unaffected by the spell.

name: Steam Myrmidon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

trait.name: Condense
entries: If the steam myrmidon takes cold damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Boiler Veil.

action.name: Hazeblade Pike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
This attack is made at advantage against any creature not proficient in Perception.

action.name: Boiler Veil (Concentration)
entries: Sweltering fog swells in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the myrmidon, heavily obscuring the area for 1 minute or until cleared by a strong wind.

A creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10 (3d6) fire damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Misty Rush
entries: When the myrmidon is targeted by a ranged attack, it can teleport up to 30 feet directly towards the attacker.

trait.name: In the Wind
entries: When the myrmidon is hit with an attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks.

action.name: Sooty Garotte
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
If this attack was made at advantage, the target is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the target is choking.

action.name: Cinder Swell
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the myrmidon must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Strangle
entries: One creature grappled by the myrmidon must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the target takes 10 (3d6) slashing damage and stops holding its breath, or half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Billow (Concentration)
entries: Smoke swirls around the myrmidon in a 5-foot radius sphere, heavily obscuring the area until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Slipstride
entries: The myrmidon's movement is not hindered by difficult terrain, and it can attempt to escape from a grapple as a bonus action.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with its Acrid Clash.

action.name: Glistening Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Acrid Clash
entries: The myrmidon moves up to 10 feet, then each creature within 5 feet of it must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is grappled (escape DC 15).
While two or more creatures are grappled in this way, the myrmidon and each creature grappled by it are considered restrained.

bonus.name: Slime Surge
entries: Slime seethes and foams around the myrmidon, dealing 9 (2d8) acid damage to each creature grappled by it.

trait.name: Soluble
entries: If the myrmidon is doused in water, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose half of its current hit points.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks and can use its Stinging Spray or Parch.

action.name: Saltcrust Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Stinging Spray
entries: The myrmidon flings salt at a creature within 15 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 5 (1d10) necrotic damage and its blinded until the end of the myrmidon's next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Parch
entries: The myrmidon forces a creature within 5 feet of it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is dazed until the end of its next turn.
A creature who has less than half of their maximum hit points and fails a saving throw against this effect additionally gains a level of exhaustion.

reaction.name: Salt the Wound
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the myrmidon would regain any number of hit points, it can reduce the hit points regained by half.

trait.name: Slipstride
entries: The myrmidon's movement is not hindered by difficult terrain, and it can attempt to escape from a grapple as a bonus action.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Mire Down.

action.name: Mudslide Maul
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
If the target is in difficult terrain, this attack is made at advantage.

action.name: Sludge Shot
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 40 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the area within 10 feet of the target becomes difficult terrain.

action.name: Mire Down
entries: The myrmidon forces a creature in difficult terrain within 60 feet of it to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or become restrained (escape DC 15).

trait.name: Inner Brilliance
entries: If the myrmidon takes any amount of radiant damage, each creature within 10 feet of it is blinded until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Dazzling Display.

action.name: Crystalline Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.
This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 against a creature concentrating on a spell.

action.name: Dazzling Display
entries: Scintillating colors danced through the air in a 30-foot cone extending from the myrmidon, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is dazed until the end of the myrmidon's next turn. While dazed in this way, attacks made against a creature are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Harden Facet
entries: When the myrmidon is targeted with an attack, it adds +5 to its Armor Class agains the triggering attack.

trait.name: Molten Core
entries: If the myrmidon takes 20 or more cold damage from a single source, it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use if its Molten Fissure.

action.name: Magma Hammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

action.name: Molten Fissure
entries: A spray of magma bursts from the ground in a 20-foot long line that is 5 feet wide extending from the myrmidon. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage and falls prone, or half as much damage on a success.
A prone creature has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Eruption Blast
entries: Molten debris explodes from the myrmidon in a 15-foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 (5d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
Then, the myrmidon moves up to half its speed without provking attacks of opportunity.

reaction.name: Melt Weapon
entries: When the myrmidon is hit with a melee attack using a nonmagical metal weapon, the myrmidon can impose a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to attack and damage rolls to the weapon. If this penalty reaches -5, the weapon melts into useless slag and is destroyed.

trait.name: Charged Body
entries: A creature that hits the myrmidon with a melee attack can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Bridgebolt.

action.name: Static Lance
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Bridgebolt
entries: The myrmidon hurls a bolt of electricity at a creature it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
If the target is wearing metal armor, the myrmidon can teleport to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it.

reaction.name: Spiteful Jolt
entries: When the myrmidon is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 7 (2d6) lightning damage to the target and impose disadvantage on its next attack roll.

trait.name: Revealing Radiance
entries: The myrmidon sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. Creatures in the radius of bright light cannot benefit from invisibility.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Blistering Glare.

action.name: Sunstrike Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.
On a critical hit, the target is blinded until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.

action.name: Blistering Glare
entries: The myrmidon shines an unbearable light in a 15-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage and the next attack against it is made at advantage, or half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Bolster Life
entries: The myrmidon loses 10 hit points, then one creature within 15 feet of it gains 10 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the target has advantage on attack rolls and Constitution saving throws.

reaction.name: Sudden Flash
entries: When the myrmidon is targeted with a melee attack, it can impose disadvantage on the attack roll. If the attack misses, the myrmidon can make an attack against the attacker as a part of the same reaction.

trait.name: Springmelt
entries: While the myrmidon is below half of its maximum hit points, it has vulnerability to fire damage.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Frost Lock.

action.name: Rimecast Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

action.name: Hailstream
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) cold damage.

action.name: Frost Lock
entries: One creature within 60 feet takes cold damage equal to twice the number of temporary hit points it has, then must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. In a failed save, the target is restrained until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.

reaction.name: Freezing Retort
entries: When the myrmidon is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 13 (3d8) cold damage to the attacker. The attacker then gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

trait.name: Molten Repair
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Clearshine Veil or Mirrorwalk.

action.name: Razor Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins bleeding (1d6).

action.name: Mirrorwalk
entries: The myrmidon touches a Medium or larger flat, reflective surface, transporting through it to the Border Ethereal from its current plane, or vice versa.

While on the Ethereal Plane, the myrmidon can only affect and be affected by other creatures on that plane. Creatures that aren't on the Ethereal Plane can't perceive the myrmidon and can't interact with it, unless a special ability or magic has given them the ability to do so.
