The myrmidon ignore all objects and effects that aren't on the Ethereal Plane, allowing it to move through objects it perceives on the plane it originated from.

action.name: Clearshine Veil
entries: If the myrmidon is not below half of its maximum hit points, it turns invisible until the end of its next turn, then moves up to half its speed. This effect ends early if the myrmidon takes any amount of damage.

reaction.name: Refract Mana
entries: When the myrmidon is targeted by a spell of 2nd level or lower, it causes the spell to target one additional creature within 15 feet of it.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Dust Clog or Tomb Gout.

action.name: Cramblade Stiletto
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If this attack is made at advantage, it deals an additional 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Dust Clog
entries: The myrmidon forces a creature within 5 feet of it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target begins choking for 1 minute, or until it uses an action to cough violently and end the effect.

action.name: Tomb Gout
entries: Decayed dust spews from the myrmidon in a 15-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and is blinded until the end of the myrmidon's next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Detonate
entries: When the myrmidon would take any amount of fire damage, it can double the damage it would take.

If it does so, each other creature within 15 feet of the myrmidon must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an equal amount of fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Chained Essence
entries: Whenever the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the charmed or possessed conditions, or banish it, it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes two attacks and can use its Ember Crash or Snuff Out.

action.name: Ashwake Halberd
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing or slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a burning target.

action.name: Ember Crash
entries: The myrmidon slams into a creature within 5 feet of it, forcing it to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pushed up to 10 feet and begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Snuff Out
entries: One burning creature within 15 feet stops burning, then must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 9 (2d8) cold damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Wheeze Cinder
entries: When the myrmidon is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 5 (1d10) fire damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

name: Slag-kin
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Ignan and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: Quench
entries: If the slag-kin takes any cold damage or it is doused in water, the magma in its body cools; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances, its speeds are reduced to 10 feet and its abilities do not cause fire damage or the burning condition.

action.name: Slag Spit
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 20 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage and the target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Sinter Hop
entries: The slag-kin jumps up to 15 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

reaction.name: Secrete Toxins
entries: When the slag-kin is hit with a melee attack, it can secrete toxins from the slag within its body, causing the attacker to become poisoned until the end of its next turn.

name: Pyroclast
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Quench
entries: If the pyroclast takes any cold damage or it is doused in water, the magma in its body cools; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances, its speeds are reduced to 10 feet and its abilities do not cause fire damage or the burning condition.

trait.name: Lava Drip
entries: Lava constantly drips from the pyroclast. Any creature that starts its turn directly beneath the pyroclast and within 30 feet of it, or moves there for the first time on a turn, takes 4 (1d8) fire damage.

trait.name: Magma Balloon
entries: If the pyroclast is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a shower of lava, forcing all creatures within 10 feet of it to make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Searing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Lava Bomb
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) fire damage and the target begins burning (1d10).

name: Incandescent Oozer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Quench
entries: If the oozer takes any cold damage or it is doused in water, the magma in its body cools; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances, its speeds are reduced to 10 feet and its abilities do not cause fire damage or the burning condition.

trait.name: Lavaform
entries: The oozer can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can move through and stop in the space of other creatures.
A creature whose space the oozer enters for the first time on a turn takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and begins burning (1d10).
Creatures that hit the oozer with a melee attack take 5 (1d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Magma Tubes
entries: When the oozer burrows, it leaves a tunnel in its wake. The sides of the tunnel remain burning hot for 10 minutes, after which time the tunnel collapses. When a creature enters the tunnel for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oozer makes two attacks with its Lava Whip, one of which it can replace with a use of its Erupting Surge or Pyroclastic Flow, if they are available.

action.name: Lava Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).
While grappled in this way, a creature takes 9 (2d8) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Erupting Surge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The oozer burrows up to it speed, then erupts violently from the ground, sending lava flying in a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Pyroclastic Flow (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The oozer moves up to its speed in a straight line. Each creature who it moves within 5 feet of during the move must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

The area the oozer moved through using this action becomes molten terrain until the end of the oozer's next turn. A creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 11 (3d6) fire damage and begins burning (1d10).

reaction.name: Melt Weapon
entries: When the oozer is hit with a melee attack using a nonmagical metal weapon, the oozer can impose a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to attack and damage rolls to the weapon. If this penalty reaches -5, the weapon melts into useless slag and is destroyed.

name: Cinderslime Slug
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Quench
entries: If the slug takes any cold damage or it is doused in water, the magma in its body cools; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances, its speeds are reduced to 10 feet and its abilities do not cause fire damage or the burning condition.

trait.name: Molten Trail
entries: The slug secretes a sticky lava that leaves behind a 15-foot wide trail of molten slag in its wake. This trail remains superheated for 1 minute, creating difficult terrain.
Creatures that enter the trail for the first time on a turn or start their turn there takes 14 (4d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Flowing Form
entries: The slug can move through spaces as narrow as 5 feet wide without squeezing. It can also move up walls and upside down on ceilings.
When a creature touches the slug or hits it with a melee attack, it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Toxic Fumes
entries: The slug emits toxic fumes within 20 feet of it. A creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 13 (3d8) poison damage and is poisoned until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slug makes three attacks with its Lava Jet. It can replace one Jet with its Lava Maw and one with a use of Combust if available.

action.name: Lava Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 19).

A creature already grappled by the slug is swallowed. While swallowed in this way, a creature takes 18 (4d8) fire damage at the beginning of each of the slug's turns. If a creature inside the slug deals 20 or more damage to the slug in a turn, the slug immediately regurgitates each creature swallowed by it.

action.name: Lava Jet
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 50/100 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) fire damage and the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Combust (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The slug releases a wave of molten lava and fiery debris, igniting its toxic fumes. Each creature within 20 feet of the slug begins burning (1d10) and must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) fire damage and is blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Defensive Cooling
entries: When the slug takes any amount of cold damage, it can gain a +4 bonus to its Armor Class until the start of its next turn. If it does so, its Molten Trail, Flowing Form, and Toxic Fumes traits are suppressed until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Freeze
entries: Whenever the mephit takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 and it gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a wave of crashing water. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Watery Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mephit can grapple the target (escape DC 12). This attack has advantage against a creature submerged in water.

action.name: Drench (Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit spews a stream of cold water in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. If this damage causes a creature to make a concentration check, it makes it at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Crashing Wave
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the mephit can make a melee attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked prone.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Void Aura
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the mephit cannot speak or breathe.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it implodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) Thunder damage and be pulled 10 feet towards the mephit.

action.name: Dragging Winds
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet towards the mephit. This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying creature.

action.name: Cavitate (Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: For the next minute, the mephit is surrounded by sucking winds. A creature that start its turn within 5 feet of the mephit must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be unable to move away from it until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Vaccuum Channel
entries: As a reaction to an allied creature within 15 feet being targeted with an attack, the mephit may pull the allied creature 10 feet closer. If the allied creature ends this movement out of range of the triggering attack, the attack misses.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mephit can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a wave of ooze. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (2d4) acid damage and be covered in acid until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 2 (1d4) acid damage at end of each of its turns.

action.name: Sticky Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. This attack is made at advantage against a grappled creature.

reaction.name: Stick (Recharge 6)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet, the mephit forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be grappled. While grappled by the mephit in this way, the target takes 2d4 acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a mephit that is small or larger is subjected to slashing damage, it splits into two new tiny mepits. Each new mephit has hit points equal to half the original mephit's, rounded down.

trait.name: Soluble
entries: If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or disintegrate.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of salt. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (2d4) slashing damage and gain vulnerability to the next source of acid damage it would take.

action.name: Salt Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Dessicate (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The creature is unaffected by the next source of healing it would receive before the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Salt the Wound
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet of it taking 5 or more slashing damage, the mephit may cause it to take an additional 3 (1d6) poison damage.

trait.name: Stoneglide
entries: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical stone. While doing so, the mephit doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of minerals. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (2d4) slashing damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Sparkling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage to a charmed creature.

action.name: Fool's Greed (Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit holds out a worthless gem. Each creature within 5 feet that can see it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the mephit until the end of the mephit's next turn, or until the creature takes damage. While charmed in this way, a creature can do nothing but stare greedily at the gem.

reaction.name: Scratchproof Facing
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a weapon attack that deals piercing damage, the mephit may gain a +5 bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

trait.name: Electrified
entries: A creature that hits the mephit with a melee attack can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lightning. Each creature within 10 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) lightning damage. A creature wearing metal armor makes this save at disadvantage.

action.name: Static Shock
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) lightning damage and the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Charge Weapon (Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit charges a weapon that isn't held or carried with electricity. The next creature to touch the weapon must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) lightning damage and be stunned until the end of the mephit's following turn.

reaction.name: Numbing Sparks
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the mephit may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) Lightning damage and drop whatever it is holding and be unable to pick up dropped objects until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Revealing Radiance
entries: The mephit sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. Creatures in the radius of bright light cannot benefit from invisibility.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of light. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) radiant damage and be blinded until the end of its next turn. A creature that averts its eyes at the beginning of its turn succeed automatically on this save.

action.name: Illuminating Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) radiant damage and the next attack roll made against this target in the next minute is made at advantage.

action.name: Sunstrike
entries: Each creature in a 5 ft. radius centered on a point within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) fire and 3 (1d6) radiant damage. A creature that is averting its eyes has disadvantage on this save.

reaction.name: Dazzling Flash
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting the mephit with a melee attack, the mephit may emit a bright flash, dazzling the creature. Until the end of the mephit's next turn, the attacker treats the mephit as invisible.

trait.name: Molten Repair
entries: Whenever the mephit is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The mephit treats reflective objects as doorways to extradimensional spaces resembling the space reflected by them. While in a mirrored surface, the mephit can control what images appear reflected in it. If a mirrored surface containing a mephit ceases to be reflective, the mephit is expelled into an unoccupied adjacent space and stunned until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of glass. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (2d4) slashing damage and have glass shards embedded in its flesh. Until a creature takes an action to remove the shards, the creature's movement speed is reduced by 10.

action.name: Slice
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the mephit may use its invibility as a bonus action this turn, if available.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit magically turns invisible until it attacks.

reaction.name: Reflect
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of first level or below, the mephit may make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the mephit may change the spell's target to another creature within 15 feet.

trait.name: Fire Step
entries: Surfaces the mephit moves over ignite and burn for 1 minute. A creature that starts its turn in a burning area, or enters it for the first time on a turn, takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of fire. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or catch fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Glowing Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) fire damage. If the target is wearing metal armor, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Burning Steel (Recharge 6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone that is wielding a metal weapon takes 4 (1d8) damage and must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or drop its weapon in an adjacent space.

reaction.name: Wind-Whipped
entries: As a reaction to a creature making an opportunity attack against it, the mephit may impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the attacker is pulled 5 feet towards the mephit.

trait.name: Earthglide
entries: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the mephit doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of earth. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait ceases to function for the next minute.

action.name: Dirty Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Earthbreak (Recharge 6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 6 (1d12) bludgeoning damage and fall prone, or half as much damage on a success. The affected area becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Durable
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a weapon attack, the mephit may gain resistance to that attack's damage. If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait ceases to function for the next minute.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of ash. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) fire damage and be blinded until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Choking Ash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) fire damage and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be unable speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Ember Gout (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or catch fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Cinder Wheeze
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the mephit may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) fire damage and be blinded until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of air. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a DC 9 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Gust
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away. This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying creature.

action.name: Updraft (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be levitated 5 ft. off the ground until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Current-Dancer
entries: As a reaction to a creature being pushed out of its range, the mephit may move up to 10 ft. towards it and make a gust attack against it.

name: Earthrazer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dust Form
entries: The earthrazer can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The interior of the earthrazer is heavily obscured.

trait.name: Hacking Expulsion
entries: At the beginning of the earthrazer's turn, each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away and blinded until the beginning of the earthrazer's next turn.

trait.name: Steel to Stone
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the earthrazer turns to stone after dealing damage. A creature with a strength score lower than 19 has disadvantage on attacks made with it, and on a roll of 1 the weapon shatters.

trait.name: Earth-Sickened
entries: While touching a solid surface of earth or stone, the earthrazer gains vulnerability to each damage type to which it is not resistant or immune.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The earthrazer uses its Choking Sweep twice, one of which it may replace with its Decay to Dust or its Dust Burial, if available.

action.name: Choking Sweep
entries: Each creature in a 20 foot cone extending from the earthrazer must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) slashing plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Until the end of the earthrazer's next turn, the affected area becomes heavily obscured and difficult terrain, and creatures in the area can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Decay to Dust
entries: One creature within 30 feet must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, one piece of nonmagical armor the creature is wearing crumbles to dust, one spell affecting the creature ends, and it loses all temporary hit points. If a creature with 0 hit points fails this save, it dies and turns to dust.

action.name: Dust Burial (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The earthrazer turns the ground to dust in a 10 foot radius, 40 foot deep cylinder extending from a point it can see within 60 feet.

A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or sink 5 feet into the earth and be restrained (escape DC 18). A creature restrained in this way is blinded and can't speak or breathe, and sinks an additional 5 feet into the dust at the end of each of its turns.
A creature that is not restrained may move through the dust at half its swim speed.

reaction.name: Wheezing Draw
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the earthrazer draws in a labored, wheezing breath. Each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be drawn up to 30 feet toward the earthrazer.

trait.name: Cursed Thirst
entries: Water recedes from the desiccator as though magnetically repelled, and is destroyed if the dessicator touches it. If the desiccator begins its turn fully submerged in water, it explodes in a hail of jagged salts.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Parch the Weak
entries: The desiccator's attacks score a critical on an 18-20 against a creature with a Constitution score of 10 or lower.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The desiccator makes two attacks with its crumbling touch.

action.name: Crumbling Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this attack crumbles to dust.
On a critical hit, the target gains a point of exhaustion that lasts for a minute.

action.name: Desiccation Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The desiccator inhales, draining the moisture from a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
A creature with its Constitution score reduced in this way that would receive any healing instead receives half as much and repeats this save, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Ragged Panting
entries: When the dessicator takes any fire damage, it falls prone and rolls to recharge its Desiccation Breath.

trait.name: Extinguishing Presence
entries: Flames in a 15 foot radius around the cinderspawn are extinguished as they enter or appear in the area. Spells that deal fire damage that affect the area or pass through it deal half as much damage.

trait.name: Rekindle
entries: When the cinderspawn reduces a living humanoid or elemental creature to 0 hit points, it makes a DC 20 Charisma saving throw. On a success, the cinderspawn transforms into a Fire Elemental, retaining its current hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cinderspawn makes two attacks with its steal warmth.

action.name: Steal Warmth
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) cold plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the creature's movement is reduced by 10 until the beginning of the cinderspawn's next turn.

action.name: Snuff Out (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One living creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

reaction.name: Gout of Ash
entries: When the cinderspawn takes any cold damage, it can release a gout of ash.
Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and be blinded until the end of the Cinderspawn's next turn.

trait.name: Smoke Form
entries: As a Bonus Action, the belker may disperse into a large cloud of smoke, or coalesce back to its true elemental form.

While in this form, the belker can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, can move through any opening that air can pass through without squeezing, and has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical sources.

trait.name: Asphyxiant Presence (Smoke Form Only)
entries: A creature in the belker's space is blinded and cannot breathe.

action.name: Multiattack (Elemental Form Only)
entries: The belker makes two attacks with its smoke claws.

action.name: Smoke Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shred Lungs (Concentration, Smoke Form Only)
entries: One creature in the belker's space must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have a claw of smoke form in its lungs and begin tearing at them, dealing 13 (3d8) slashing damage to the creature at the start of each of its turns for the next minute.
An affected creature may repeat this save as an action, coughing the claw out on a success.

action.name: Sedative Fume (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in the belker's space must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

name: Zmey (12-Headed)
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Sulphureous Strikes
entries: A creature struck by the zmey has a shock of its hair turn white.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the zmey may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 21 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zmey. While climbing on the zmey, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the zmey.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The zmey has twelve heads. While it has more than one head, the zmey has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the zmey takes 30 or more damage from a single source, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the zmey dies.

trait.name: Death Curse
entries: The blood of a slain zmey pools upon the ground and resists being absorbed. If the ground is not blessed by a Ceremony or other means within 10 days, the Zmey returns to life with a new body and three additional heads at the site of its death.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the zmey fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zmey makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d10 + 8) piercing damage and the target is grappled. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The zmey makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and grappled in the zmey's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zmey, its attacks ignore the zmey's damage resistances, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zmey's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the zmey loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by at least two zmey heads must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution throw or take 188 (16d10 + 100) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more zmey heads.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The zmey exhales fire in a number of 300-foot long, 15-foot wide lines equal to the number of heads that it has. Each creature in one or more lines must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 260 hit points, the zmey immediately recharges and uses its fire breath.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: The zmey makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Inhale
entries: The zmey rolls to recharge its breath weapon.

legendary.name: Mountain Drop
entries: The dragon folds its wings and drops to the ground. Each creature beneath it must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 21). This grapple ends if the dragon moves.

legendary.name: 7-Tailed Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 25 (7d4 + 8) bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and pushed up to 15 feet away from the dragon.

name: Zmey (6-Headed)
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Sulphureous Strikes
entries: A creature struck by the zmey has a shock of its hair turn white.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the zmey may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zmey. While climbing on the zmey, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the zmey.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The zmey has six heads. While it has more than one head, the zmey has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the zmey takes 30 or more damage from a single source, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the zmey dies.

trait.name: Death Curse
entries: The blood of a slain zmey pools upon the ground and resists being absorbed. If the ground is not blessed by a Ceremony or other means within 10 days, the Zmey returns to life with a new body and three additional heads at the site of its death.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the zmey fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zmey makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target is grappled. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The zmey makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and grappled in the zmey's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zmey, its attacks ignore the zmey's damage resistances, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zmey's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the zmey loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by at least two zmey heads must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution throw or take 88 (16d10) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more zmey heads.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The zmey exhales fire in a number of 90-foot long, 10-foot wide lines equal to the number of heads that it has. Each creature in one or more lines must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 136 hit points, the zmey immediately recharges and uses its fire breath.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: The zmey makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Mountain Drop
entries: The dragon folds its wings and drops to the ground. Each creature beneath it must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 21). This grapple ends if the dragon moves.

legendary.name: 7-Tailed Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 (7d4 + 7) bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and pushed up to 15 feet away from the dragon.

trait.name: Sulphureous Strikes
entries: A creature struck by the zmey has a shock of its hair turn white.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the zmey may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zmey. While climbing on the zmey, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the zmey.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The zmey has three heads. While it has more than one head, the zmey has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
Whenever the zmey takes 30 or more damage from a single source, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the zmey dies.

trait.name: Death Curse
entries: The blood of a slain zmey pools upon the ground and resists being absorbed. If the ground is not blessed by a Ceremony or other means within 10 days, the Zmey returns to life with a new body and three additional heads at the site of its death.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zmey makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The zmey makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and grappled in the zmey's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zmey, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zmey's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the zmey loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by at least two zmey heads must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution throw or take 55 (10d10) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more zmey heads.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The zmey exhales fire in a number of 60-foot long, 5-foot wide lines equal to the number of heads that it has. Each creature in one or more lines must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Sound Killer
entries: An aura of magic silence surrounds the scalamagdrion, preventing any sound from being produced within 10 feet of it.

trait.name: Tomeguard
entries: The scalamagdrion can bind itself to guardianship of an illustration in a book or other medium. Whenever a creature looks upon the illustration, the scalamagdrion is made aware of the creature's identity and may teleport to the creature's location.

trait.name: Armorbreaker
entries: The scalamagdrion's attacks score a critical on an 18-20 against a creature wearing heavy armor.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The scalamagdrion has advantage on saving throws against spell and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite, and may replace each of them with a use of its Savage Thrash.

action.name: Locking Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Prying Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage. On a critical hit, a piece of the targets armor, if it is wearing any, is ripped off and flung away, reducing the AC it provides by 2 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Tail Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Savage Thrash
entries: One creature grappled by the dragon must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is stunned until the end of the dragon's next turn and knocked prone.

reaction.name: Spell Turning
entries: As a reaction when the scalamagdrion succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of 7th level or lower that targets only it, the scalamagdrion avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to rebound, targeting its caster..

trait.name: Glory-Destined
entries: If the drakkoth would be reduced to 0 hit points by damage not from a melee attack, it is instead reduced to 1 hit point.

trait.name: Treacherous Winds
entries: A flying creature that ends its movement within 80 feet of one or more drakkoths must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or fall prone, or be pushed 30 feet downward if it is immune to the prone condition

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drakkoth makes three attacks, then may use its Spit Venom or Tail Thagomizer, if available.

action.name: Wingripper Bow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the targets fly speed, if it has one, is reduced by 10 for the next minute.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: One creature the drakkoth can see within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the beginning of the drakkoth's next turn.

action.name: Tail Thagomizer (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the drakkoth's choice within 5 feet  that it did not make an attack against this turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Crack the Sky (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 119 hit points, the drakkoth magically rends the sky, calling down a bone-shaking wave of thunderous sound.

Each creature within 300 feet of the drakkoth must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) thunder damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. A flying creature makes this save at disadvantage.

trait.name: Glory-Destined
entries: If the drakkoth would be reduced to 0 hit points by damage not from a melee attack, it is instead reduced to 1 hit point.

trait.name: Drakkoth Rage
entries: Whenever the drakkoth deals damage to a creature with a melee attack, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drakkoth makes two attacks, then may use its Spit Venom or Tail Thagomizer, if available.

action.name: Tempest-Kissed Spear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: One creature the drakkoth can see within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the beginning of the drakkoth's next turn.

action.name: Tail Thagomizer (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the drakkoth's choice within 5 feet  that it did not make an attack against this turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Countercharge
entries: As a reaction when a Medium or smaller creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the drakkoth, the drakkoth forces it to succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and be grappled (escape DC 15) as  the drakkoth moves into its space.

reaction.name: Clad in Fury (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the drakkoth takes damage from a magical effect that affects more than one creature, the drakkoth prevents half the damage that would be dealt each creature of its choice by the effect, and takes additional damage equal to the damage prevented.

name: Dragon Eel
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Slender Body
entries: The dragon eel may move through any space large enough for a Large creature without squeezing.

trait.name: Surface Nerves
entries: If the dragon eel takes 30 or more bludgeoning damage in a turn, it is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the dragon eel may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the dragon eel. While climbing on the dragon eel, a creature has advantage on melee attacks made against it.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dragon eel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon eel makes three wriggling ram attacks, one of which it may replace with its gulping bite or stunning shock.

action.name: Massive Gulp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be swallowed.

While swallowed, the target's attacks bypass the dragon eel's resistances and it takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the dragon eel's turns. If the dragon eel takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the dragon eel regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Wriggling Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. Before or after making this attack, the dragon eel may move up to a quarter of its speed.

action.name: Stunning Shock
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) lightning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Broadcast Current (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon eel briefly electrifies the water in a 20 ft. radius around itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the dragon eel's next turn.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the dragon eel forces each creature within 15 ft. to succeed on a DC 20 Strenght saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. away.

reaction.name: Bloodied Current (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 149 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses its Broadcast Current.

legendary.name: Dive
entries: The dragon eel moves up to half its speed. If it is submerged, each creature climbing on it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or fall off.

legendary.name: Suction Feeding
entries: One creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 ft. toward the dragon eel. A creature that fails by 5 or more is immediately swallowed.

legendary.name: Coil Up (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon eel rolls to recharge its broadcast current, reducing its movement on its following turn to 0. If the dragon eel uses its broadcast current on its following turn, its range is doubled and its damage is increased by 18 (4d8).

legendary.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon eel rocks a boat or ship within 10 ft. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 ft. in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered prone.

name: Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Godlike Resistance
entries: If Bahamut fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If he does, he regains two fewer legendary action on his following turn.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless he wishes to be affected, Bahamut is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. He has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Titanic Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Bahamut may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Bahamut. While climbing on Bahamut, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against him, and he can make no more than one bite attack against that creature each turn.

trait.name: Multitrack Machinations
entries: Bahamut may concentrate on up to five spells simultaneously. He regains one fewer legendary action at the beginning of his turn for each spell he is concentrating on beyond the first. If he fails a concentration check, he loses concentration on all spells he is concentrating on.

trait.name: Platinum Brilliance (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If Bahamut would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points. Additionally, Bahamut can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 155,000 XP (310,000 XP total) for defeating Bahamut after his Platinum Brilliance activates.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Bahamut can use his Godly Presence. He then makes five attacks: two with his bite, two with his claws, and one with his tail. He may replace all of his bite and claw attacks with a use of his Celestial Command ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26), and Bahamut can only attack that target with Bite attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26) and restrained. Each other creature within 15 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 25 feet away and knocked prone. Each creature within 20 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take half as much damage, be pushed back 10 feet and be knocked prone.

action.name: Celestial Command
entries: Bahamut utters a one-word divine command at a creature that can hear him within 120 feet of him.  The target must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to do as Bahamut says, even if the command would be directly harmful to them.

action.name: Godly Presence
entries: Each creature of Bahamut's choice that is within 240 feet of Bahamut and aware of him must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and must use its turn to either dash away or attempt to hide. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Bahamut's Godly Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Radiance Breath
entries: Bahamut exhales pure white light in an 300-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 (16d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.  A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is blinded until the end of Bahamut's next turn.

action.name: Freezing Breath
entries: Bahamut exhales an icy blast in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw, taking 108 (24d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creatue that starts its turn in it or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Gaseous Breath
entries: Bahamut exhales mystical gas in a 300-foot cone.  Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or be transformed into a gaseous state for 1 minute.  While in a gaseous state, a target is under the effects of the Gaseous Form spell, and they can repeat their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on themselves on a success.

action.name: Purifying Breath
entries: Bahamut exhales the holy winds of Mount Celestia in a 300-foot cone.  Each creature of Bahamut's choice in that area regains 108 (24d8) hit points.  If a dead creature is affected, it returns to life and regains an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Disintegrating Roar
entries: Bahamut produces a roar so loud and fierce that it shakes the bonds between atoms.  Each creature within a 300-foot cone must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw, taking 105 (30d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.  A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is disintegrated, killing them instantly, and the roar permanently deafens all other creatures who fail their save.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Bahamut makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack
entries: Bahamut beats his wings. Each creature within 30 feet of him must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Bahamut can then fly up to half his flying speed

legendary.name: Breath Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Bahamut uses one of his breath weapons or his Disintegrating Roar.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Bahamut casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythic.name: Celestial Lances (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Bahamut conjures four enormous lances of magical force that plummet to the ground at four different points he can see within 150 feet of him and then disappear. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on each point must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (4d8 + 10) radiant damage. A creature in the area of more than one lance is affected only once.

mythic.name: Royal Guard (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Bahamut summons a member of his royal guard, a gold Greatwyrm (its name is Gruemar, Kurya, Marroshok, Sonngrad, Troannaxia, Urgala, or Vulcan).  The Greatwyrm moves on Bahamut's initiative and takes its turn directly after him.  It cannot be influenced to disobey Bahamut by any means and obeys his commands without question.  The Greatwyrm remains until it takes its turn, upon which time it disappears.

name: Mystryl, the Weave Manifest
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mistress of the Weave
entries: Mystryl can innately cast any spell of 6th level or lower at will, requiring no components. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 27, +19 to hit with spell attacks).
Additionally, when Mystryl casts a spell, she can choose to cast it as if she used a spell slot of one level higher.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless she wishes to be affected, Mystryl is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Multitrack Machinations
entries: Mystryl may concentrate on up to five spells simultaneously. She regains one fewer legendary action at the beginning of her turn for each spell she is concentrating on beyond the first. If she fails a concentration check, she loses concentration on all spells she is concentrating on.

action.name: Arcane Burst (Recharge 5-6, 9th Level Spell)
entries: Mystryl releases a burst of raw magic in a 60-foot radius centered on herself. Each creature within that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw or take 90 (20d8) force damage on a failed save, taking half as much on a success.

action.name: Manipulate the Weave (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Mystryl casts a spell of her choice of 7th or 8th level that has a casting time of 1 action, requiring no components.

action.name: Arcane Ascendancy (Recharge 6)
entries: Mystryl casts a spell of her choice of 9th level that has a casting time of 1 action, requiring no components.

legendary.name: Spellcasting
entries: Mystryl casts a spell of her choice of 6th level or lower that has a casting time of 1 action, requiring no components.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Mystryl teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet of her.

legendary.name: Sunder the Weave (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Mystryl alters the Weave in a 1-mile radius centered on herself. Any spells and magical effects in the area end, and creatures other than her can't cast spells or activate magical effects until the end of her next turn.

resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Godlike Resistance
entries: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. If she does, she regains two fewer legendary action on her following turn.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Chromatic Wrath (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If Tiamat would be reduced to 0 hit points, her current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points. Additionally, Tiamat can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tiamat can use her Maddening Presence. She then makes five attacks: four with her bite and one with her tail. She may replace all of her bite attacks with a use of her Rip and Tear ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26). While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26) and restrained. Each other creature within 15 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 25 feet away and knocked prone. Each creature within 20 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take half as much damage, be pushed back 10 feet and be knocked prone.

action.name: Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw, taking 80 (18d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Rip and Tear
entries: One creature grappled by at least two of Tiamat's heads must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution throw or take 110 (20d10) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more of Tiamat's heads. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is ripped in half and dies.

action.name: Maddening Presence
entries: Each creature of Tiamat's choice that is within 240 feet of Tiamat and aware of her must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and must use its turn to either dash away or attempt to hide. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Tiamat's Maddening Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath
entries: Tiamat's black head spews a jet of caustic acid in a 300-foot long, 15-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 99 (22d8) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers an acid injury. A creature killed by this damage disintegrates.

action.name: Winterglass Breath
entries: Tiamat's white head exhales an icy blast in a 300-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or take 90 (20d8) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the Tiamat's blue head in a 300 foot long, 15 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 110 (20d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Lungripper Miasma Breath
entries: Tiamat's green head exhales poisonous gas in a 300-foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or take 98 (28d6) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is blinded and choking until the end of the dragon's next turn.

action.name: Slagflame Breath
entries: Tiamat's red head exhales rippling flames in a 300-foot cone, turning each surface in the area to molten slag.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity or take 105 (30d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
For the next minute, the ground in the area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Tiamat makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack
entries: Tiamat beats her wings. Each creature within 30 feet of her must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Tiamat can then fly up to half her flying speed

legendary.name: Breath Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat uses one of her breath weapons.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Tiamat casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythic.name: Hurl Through Avernus (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat targets a creature she is grappling. The creature must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or take 44 (8d10) psychic damage and be banished to Avernus. At the start of Tiamat's next turn, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of her.

mythic.name: Chromatic Flare (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Tiamat flares with elemental energy. Each creature of her choice in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on her must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 126 (36d6) damage of a type chosen by Tiamat: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

name: Sardior, the Ruby Dragon
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Godlike Resistance
entries: If Sardior fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If he does, he regains two fewer legendary action on his following turn.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity

While climbing on Sardior, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against him, and he can make no more than one bite attack against that creature each turn.

trait.name: Multitrack Machinations
entries: Sardior may concentrate on up to five spells simultaneously. He regains one fewer legendary action at the beginning of his turn for each spell he is concentrating on beyond the first. If he fails a concentration check, he loses concentration on all spells he is concentrating on.

trait.name: Ruby Trickery (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If Sardior would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points. Additionally, Sardior can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 155,000 XP (310,000 XP total) for defeating Sardior after his Ruby Trickery activates.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sardior can use his Psychic Presence. He then makes five attacks: two with his bite, two with his claws, and one with his tail. He may replace all of his bite and claw attacks with a use of his Celestial Command ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26), and Sardior can only attack that target with Bite attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26) and restrained. Each other creature within 15 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 25 feet away and knocked prone. Each creature within 20 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take half as much damage, be pushed back 10 feet and be knocked prone.

action.name: Magicmelt
entries: Sardior targets a magic item he can see within 120 feet of him.  The wielder of the item (or the item itself if it's sentient) must make a DC 26 Charisma saving throw.  On a failed save, the item loses its magical properties for 1 minute.  The saving throw can be repeated at the end of each of the wielder's turns, ending the effect on a success.  The save is made at disadvantage if the item was within the target area of one of Sardior's breath weapons since the start of Sardior's last turn.

action.name: Psychic Presence
entries: Each creature of Sardior's choice that is within 240 feet of Sardior and aware of him must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and must use its turn to either dash away or attempt to hide. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Sardior's Psychic Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Heat Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Sardior exhales superheated gas in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 105 (30d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The stone and metal in the affected area begins to melt, becoming difficult terrain. At the beginning of Sardior's next turn, the affected area becomes lava, and remains in that state until the beginning his following turn. A creature that starts its turn in lava or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 33 (6d10) fire damage.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Sardior makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack
entries: Sardior beats his wings. Each creature within 30 feet of him must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Sardior can then fly up to half his flying speed

legendary.name: Breath Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Sardior uses one of his breath weapons.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Sardior casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythic.name: Psionic Blast (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Sardior assaults the minds of creatures within 90 feet of him.  Creatures of Sardior's choice must succeed on a DC 26 Intelligence saving throw or take 44 (8d10) psychic damage or half as much damage on a successful save.  Also on a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d8 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

mythic.name: Illusory Self (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Sardior conjures an illusory duplicate and turns invisible himself.  The illusory duplicate has 100 hit points and lasts 1 minute or until it is destroyed, and the true Sardior is invisible until it disappears.  While it persists, Sardior can take a bonus action each of his turns to command the illusion to make a single Claw attack against a creature within 5 feet of it, and all of his other attacks seem to emanate from the illusion instead of the invisible dragon, no matter Sardior's actual location.

If the creature's shadow receives any healing, the shadow is banished to the shadow realm. The creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow dies, the creature is lost forever to the realm of shadow.

action.name: Slowing Breath
entries: Null exhales gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: Null exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 300-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 26) as it begins to sink into the stone.
A creature already affected by this ability that fails the saving throw sinks entirely beneath the surface, and is blinded and cannot speak or breathe until it escapes.

action.name: Weakening Breath
entries: Null exhales gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Chains of Carceri

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the dragon. action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Nightmare Spore Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a cloud of spores in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 77 (14d10) psychic damage and is covered in spores until a creature takes an action to remove them. While covered in these spores, a creature is frightened.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 300-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 21) as it begins to sink into the stone.
A creature already affected by this ability that fails the saving throw sinks entirely beneath the surface, and is blinded and cannot speak or breathe until it escapes.

reaction.name: Phantasmagoria
entries: As a reaction when a frightened creature fails a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, the dragon forces the creature to succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the dragon's choice.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 166 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Awful Scuttle
entries: The dragon moves up to half its climb speed. If it ends this movement out of sight of any hostile creatures, it may attempt a Dexterity (Stealth) check to hide.

legendary.name: Acrid Spore Burst
entries: One creature that is covered in spores from the dragon's breath weapon takes 27 (6d8) acid damage as the spores rupture and slough off in a caustic spray.

legendary.name: Hysterical Blindness
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or lose its darkvision for the next minute.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The dragon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Extinguishing Aura
entries: The dragon is surrounded by an aura of light-eating microbes. At the beginning of the dragon's turn, each light source within 5 ft. diminishes one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.
