entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 15 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to the number rolled.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and attacks of opportunity made against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Reserved Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Its save DCs are reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Sparking Bite or Ridgetail Sweep, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Sparking Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) piercing plus 16 (3d10) lightning damage.

If the target was grappled, the dragon may force it to succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be swallowed. While swallowed in this way, a creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage at the beginning of each of the dragon's turns.
If a creature inside the dragon deals 50 or more damage to the dragon in a turn, the dragon immediately regurgitates each creature swallowed by it.

action.name: Sandhoned Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26).
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Ridgetail Sweep
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 30 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed up to 10 feet on a success.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 300 feet of it must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to three creatures the dragon can see within 300 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 60 (11d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 300 foot long, 15 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 110 (20d10) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Battle of Wits
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can push a creature grappled by it up to 20 feet into the attack's path.
The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence (Insight) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the pushed creature.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 332 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Sand Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its burrow speed. Then, if it started this movement submerged in earth, it can make a Sandhoned Claw attack.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: The dragon inhales, draining the moisture from a creature grappled by it. The creature takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage, and each potion and other liquid the target is carrying turns to dust until rehydrated.

legendary.name: Skyfury Drop (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon flies up to half its fly speed, then can drop up to 60 feet into an unoccupied space.
If it does, each other creature within 15 feet is pushed up to 15 feet away and must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet the dragon descended.

A sludge-drenched creature is blinded, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

reaction.name: Thunderous Roar (1/Day)

A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is also stunned for the same duration.

legendary.name: Shuddering Step
entries: The King of Feathers shakes the earth with a step, cocks its head and pauses to listen, gaining 30 ft. of Blindsight until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Through the Mist
entries: The King of Feathers turns to mist and disappears. The next time another creature ends its turn within 60 feet of where the King of Feathers departed, the King of Feathers reappears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the creature.

legendary.name: Thrash (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature grappled by the King of Feathers must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be stunned until the end of the King of Feathers' next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead paralyzed until the end of the King of Feathers' next turn.

action.name: Rending Claws

action.name: Stomp

reaction.name: Impale

reaction.name: Puff Up

trait.name: Throat Pouch

action.name: Scoop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it's a Medium or smaller creature.

action.name: Battering Wings (Recharge 5-6)

reaction.name: Flip Back
entries: As a reaction to a creature falling prone within 10 ft. of it, the pterodactyl makes a Scoop attack against the creature.

trait.name: Outsize Head

action.name: Dark Water Ambush
entries: The liopleurodon moves up to its speed in a straight line towards a creature it is hidden from and makes an attack against it with its Shellcrusher Bite.
If the attack hits, the target takes an additional 13 (2d12) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the plesiosaurus' next turn.

action.name: Bucking Thrash (Recharge 5-6)

A creature that fails this save by 10 or more has a limb of its choice torn off and is released from the grapple, then drops to 0 hit points.

reaction.name: Circle (1/Day)

Each creature of its choice within 50 feet that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the liopleurodon's next turn.

entries: If the centrosaurus moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a goring horns attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Bony Frill
entries: While the centrosaurus is not flanked, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by melee attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centrosaurus makes up to two attacks; one with its gore and one with its stomp, if available.

action.name: Goring Horns
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Dominance Display
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a creature within 30 ft., the centrosaurus shakes its horn. The attacker may use its reaction to drop prone; if the creature does not, or if it stands before the end of its turn, the centrosaurus may move up to 30 ft. towards it and make a gore attack.

name: Umbral Blot
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Supernal but does not speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The umbral blot is nearly indistinguishable from a Sphere of Annihilation. A creature may attempt a DC 22 Wisdom (Insight) check to determine that it is not what it appears.

trait.name: Planar Portal Vulnerability
entries: If the blot contacts a planar portal, such as an active Gate spell or a portable hole, both the blot and the portal are destroyed.

trait.name: Hostile Void
entries: A creature that touches the blot, or whose space the blot enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is disintegrated.
Unattended nonartifact objects whose space the blot enters are disintegrated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blot uses its Vortex and makes one attack with its disintegrating touch.

action.name: Disintegrating Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 110 (20d10) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is disintegrated.

action.name: Vortex
entries: The blot briefly suspends the field that protects the air around it from destruction. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled 30 ft. toward the blot. Until the beginning of the blot's next turn, a creature must use 2 ft. of movement for every 1 ft. it moves away from the blot.

action.name: Plane Shift
entries: The blot teleports to a location on this or another plane that it is familiar with.

reaction.name: Deceptive Response
entries: As a reaction to a creature attempting to mentally control it, the blot moves up to half its speed in the direction indicated by the creature.

reaction.name: Pure Entropy
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a nonartifact weapon, the blot forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or have the weapon wrenched from its grip and destroyed.

name: Tomb Tapper Hulkdriver
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
languages: understands Common and Undercommon but can't speak

trait.name: Petrified Death
entries: A tomb tapper reduced to 0 hit points turns into a lifeless stone statue. Obects it is wearing or carrying are not transformed.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The tomb tapper can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: If the tomb tapper takes any thunder damage, it is deafened until the end of its next turn. While deafened, the tomb tapper is also blinded.

trait.name: Magic Sense
entries: The tomb tapper knows the precise location of each source of magic within 240 ft. of it.

trait.name: Hulk Driver
entries: While not incapacitated, the tomb tapper telepathically controls each umber hulk within 60 ft. At the beginning of each of the tomb tapper's turns, each umber hulk within 60 ft. may use its reaction to move up to its burrow speed.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the tomb tapper may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the tomb tapper. While climbing on the tomb tapper, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the tomb tapper, and the tomb tapper has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tomb tapper makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its stoneshock hammer drive.

action.name: Arenite Sledgehammer
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) force damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save. As a bonus action, the tomb tapper can return the hammer to its hand.

action.name: Sweeping Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the creature is grappled (escape DC 19). A creature that attempts to cast a spell while grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 19 saving throw using its spellcasting modifier or have its spell fail.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the tomb tapper must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 66 (12d10) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is swallowed whole. A creature with proficiency in Perception can see and target the swallowed creature with ranged abilities. As an action, a creature can pry the tomb tapper's mouth open with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

action.name: Stoneshock Hammer Drive (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant throws its hammer. Each creature in a 10 foot wide, 120 ft. long line must suceed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 39 (6d12) bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success. Walls of Wood or Stone up to 10 ft. thick in the area are destroyed.

reaction.name: Hunt Magic
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. casting a spell, using a psionic ability, or activating a magic item, the tomb tapper makes a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Telepathic Shriek (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 119 hit points, the tomb tapper lets out a telepathic shriek. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or fall prone and lose concentration, if it was holding it. Each umber hulk in the area is freed from the tomb tapper's control until the end of its following turn.

reaction.name: Hunt Magic
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. casting a spell, using a psionic ability, or activating a magic item, the tomb tapper makes a melee attack against it.

name: Tomb Mote
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Curious Climber
entries: The mote may climb onto any adjacent Medium or larger creature by spending 15 feet of movement. An unwilling creature may prevent this with a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. While climbing on a creature, the creature has disadvantage on attacks that target the mote.

trait.name: Hateful Helper
entries: When the mote uses the help action to grant an attack advantage, the attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shin Kick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) nonlethal bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target falls prone if it is Large or smaller.

action.name: Yank Ear
entries: One creature the tomb mote is crawling on must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on attacks it makes before the end of the mote's next turn.

reaction.name: Mischievous Trip
entries: When a creature leaves its reach, the tomb mote can force the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

name: Stone Cursed
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Lithified
entries: If the stone cursed would take 15 or fewer damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

trait.name: Tormented Echoes
entries: A creature that kills the stone cursed must succeed on a DC 10 Intelligence saving throw or fall prone and be blinded until the end of its next turn as it relives one of the stone cursed's memories.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stone cursed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

action.name: Stony Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Petrifying Sludge
entries: The stone cursed covers one grappled creature in petrifying sludge. The creature's speed is reduced to 10, and at the end of each of its turns the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constituiton saving throw or be petrified for 24 hours, or until it takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage.
This effect ends when a creature clears the sludge away as an action with a successful DC 12 Strength (Survival) check.

reaction.name: Shambling Pursuit
entries: As a reaction when a creature the stone cursed can see makes a ranged attack, the stone cursed moves up to its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Shardsoul Avatar
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Deranging Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more shardsouls must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature makes attacks at disadvantage and its attacks deal an extra die of damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shardsoul Release
entries: When the shardsoul dies, up to one shardsoul within 30 feet gains 22 (4d10) temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the shardsoul takes two actions on its turn, instead of one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shardsoul makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Meteor Stomp.

action.name: Fell-Iron Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
A creature hit by four or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain a point of exhaustion.

action.name: Meteor Stomp
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the shardsoul must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage, is pushed 10 feet away, and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Starsick Beam (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The shardwoul emits a beam of sickening starlight. Each creature in a 60 foot line that is 5 feet wide must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 42 (12d6) radiant damage and is poisoned for the next minute, or takes half as much damage on a success.
A creature poisoned in this way has its speed reduced by half, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Deranged Thrash
entries: As a reaction when it is missed with an attack by a creature affected by a Deranging Aura, the shardsoul causes the creature to make a new attack roll without disadvantage against another creature in range of the shardsoul's choice.

reaction.name: Bloodied Starshriek (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 hit points, the shardsoul forces each creature within 15 feet of it to succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and be stunned until the end of the Shardsoul's next turn.

name: Shardsoul Slayer
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Deranging Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more shardsouls must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature makes attacks at disadvantage and its attacks deal an extra die of damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shardsoul Release
entries: When the shardsoul dies, up to one shardsoul within 30 feet gains 22 (4d10) temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the shardsoul takes two actions on its turn, instead of one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shardsoul makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Fell-Iron Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
A creature hit by four or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain a point of exhaustion.

reaction.name: Deranged Thrash
entries: As a reaction when it is missed with an attack by a creature affected by a Deranging Aura, the shardsoul causes the creature to make a new attack roll without disadvantage against another creature in range of the shardsoul's choice.

name: Scarecrow Effigy
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Wicker Cage
entries: As a Bonus Action, the scarecrow may shove each Large or smaller creature grappled by it into its chest cavity, which knits shut to seal the creature in.
A trapped creature that deals 10 or more slashing damage to the scarecrow in a turn cuts a hole through which a creature may attempt to escape by spending half its movement (escape DC 18).

trait.name: Oil-Soaked Body
entries: If the scarecrow is exposed to fire, it is immediately engulfed in flame for the next minute. While the scarecrow is burning, a creature inside of climbing on the scarecrow takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of its turn, and the scarecrow's attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Volatile Spores
entries: If the scarecrow is killed while on fire, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet must must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the scarecrow may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the scarecrow. While climbing on the scarecrow, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the scarecrow, and the scarecrow has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Paralyzing Glare or Knit Together.

action.name: Abductor Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., each target in a 5 foot radius. Hit: 13 (3d4 + 6) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

action.name: Wrecking Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., each target is a 5 foot radius. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage and each target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Paralyzing Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature is paralyzed.

action.name: Knit Together
entries: The effigy gains 22 (4d10) temporary hit points, and any holes that have been cut in its wicker cage close. Each creature in its Wicker Cage takes 22 (4d10) nonlethal psychic damage.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Questing Scarecrow
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

trait.name: Moved by Ill Intent
entries: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

trait.name: Volatile Spores
entries: If the scarecrow is killed by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet must must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Relentless Tracker
entries: The scarecrow knows the distance to and direction of the creature whose clothes it wears as long as it is on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two attacks with its Harvest Blade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Paralyzing Glare.

action.name: Harvest Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. On a critical hit, this attack rolls its damage dice three times, instead of twice.

action.name: Paralyzing Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature is paralyzed.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Scarecrow Haunter
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

trait.name: Moved by Ill Intent
entries: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

trait.name: Volatile Spores
entries: If the scarecrow is killed by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two attacks with its Bramble Claws and uses its Horrid Glare.

action.name: Bramble Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is frightened, it takes an additional 5 (2d4) psychic damage.

action.name: Horrid Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the next minute.
While frightened in this way, the creature has its movement speed reduced by half, and must use its all of its movement to move directly away from the scarecrow on its turn.
A frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Scarecrow Shambler
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

trait.name: Moved by Ill Intent
entries: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two attack with its Bramble Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Terrifying Glare.

action.name: Bramble Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage. If the target is frightened, it takes an additional 5 (2d4) psychic damage.

action.name: Terrifying Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.
While frightened in this way, the creature has its movement speed reduced by half, and must use all of its movement to move directly away from the scarecrow on its turn.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Shrapnyl
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the shrapnyl takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Jagged Encasement
entries: A creature the shrapnyl is attached to has its AC increased to 18, if it was lower, and takes an additional 7 (2d6) piercing damage whenever it or the shrapnyl is hit with an attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shrapnyl makes two attacks with its Clinging Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Refit.

action.name: Encasing Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage and the shrapnyl wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape DC 15).

action.name: Persistent Refit
entries: One creature the shrapnyl is attached to must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest without the shrapnyl attached to it.

A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws.  A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the shrapnyl's telepathic control while the shrapnyl is attached to it.

action.name: Cloud of Steel (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The shrapnyl explodes outward in a spray of metal. Each creature within 10 feet of the shrapnyl that it is not attached to must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a success, then each creature it was attached to is freed and the shrapnyl reforms in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the gutterspite takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Glitterglass Core
entries: A creature that hits the gutterspite or a creature it is attached to with a melee attack cannot benefit from Invisibility for the next 24 hours, or until rendered clean by magical means.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gutterspite makes two attacks with its Clinging Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Refit.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the gutterpite wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape DC 14).

action.name: Refit
entries: One creature the gutterpite is attached to must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until the gutterpite is removed.
A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws.  A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the gutterpite's telepathic control.

reaction.name: Glitterburst
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits it with a melee attack, the gutterspite expels a puff of glitter, forcing the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the gutterspite's next turn.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the tatterdemanimal takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Handsome Attire
entries: A non-humanoid creature under the tatterdemanimal's control has advantage on Charisma checks.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or smaller creature. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the tatterdemanimal may wrap around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape DC 14).

action.name: Refit
entries: One creature the tatterdemanimal is attached to must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until the tatterdemanimal is removed.
A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws.  A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the tatterdemanimal's telepathic control.

name: Nimblewright
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Graceful Lander
entries: If the nimblewright would take damage from falling, it instead takes half as much and is not knocked prone.

trait.name: Unexpected Attacker
entries: The nimblewright has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that has not yet taken a turn in the combat.

trait.name: Temperature Sensitive
entries: If the nimblewright takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 for the next minute.
If the nimblewright takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nimblewright makes four melee attacks.

action.name: Fold-Out Rapiers
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. On a critical hit, the target drops one item is is holding or carrying.

action.name: Repair Protocols
entries: The nimblewright restores 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points to one construct within 5 ft.

action.name: Adopt Disguise (3/Day, 2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The nimblewright transforms its appearance to that of a Medium humanoid for the next 8 hours.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The nimblewright adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The secundus may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the secundus is within 30 feet of Primus, it uses Primus' attack bonus instead of its own.

trait.name: Iterative Order
entries: Whenever a creature deals damage to the secundus, the creature and the secundus each teleport up to 15 feet to unoccupied spaces the secundus can see.

action.name: Gaze of Purest Law
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw or be incapacitated if it is of non-lawful alignment.
As an Action, an affected creature may attempt a DC 22 Charisma (Deception) check to feign a change of alignment, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Revolve the Cosmic Gears (Concentration)
entries: The secundus chooses one school of magic. Until it or another secundus uses this ability again, spells of that school fail, and magical effects of that school cease to function.

action.name: Voice of the One and the Prime (1/Day)
entries: The secundus relays the words of Primus, which though incomprehensible remain forever impressed upon the minds of those who hear them.

Each creature who can hear the secundus must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature takes 25 psychic damage the first time each day that engages in non-lawful behavior.
This curse can be removed only by a Wish spell or equivalent magic.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction when Primus dies, the secundus may transform into Primus, retaining its current hit points. No more than one secundus may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The tertian may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the tertian is within 30 feet of a secundus, it uses the secundus' attack bonus instead of its own. If the secundus is using Primus' attack bonus, the tertian uses that instead.

action.name: Tertian Gavel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is pushed up to 30 feet away and must make three DC 21 Constitution saving throws.
For each save it fails, the creature takes force damage equal to a third of its maximum hit points.

action.name: Impose Order
entries: Each spell effect with a duration other than Until Dispelled within 30 feet of the tertian ends. Each harmful condition affecting a creature in the area ends. Each creature with 0 hit points in the area stabilizes.

action.name: Inescapable Judgement (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the tertian can see within 60 feet is bound in an opaque cocoon of force. While bound in this way, the creature is blinded, restrained and has full cover from all outside effects.
As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the tertian may move the coccoon up to 60 feet.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a secundus within 60 feet die or transform, the tertian may transform into a secundus, retaining its current hit points. No more than one tertian may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The quarton may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the quarton is within 30 feet of a tertian, it uses the tertian's attack bonus instead of its own. If the tertian is using a secundus' attack bonus, the quarton uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quarton makes two attacks with its Reordering Strike.

action.name: Reordering Strike
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. Hit: 15 bludgeoning damage plus 25 force damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the quarton can see.

action.name: Command Chain (Recharge 4-6)
entries: One of each other type of modron within 60 feet of the quarton may use its reaction to make an attack.

reaction.name: Count the Cost
entries: As a reaction to seeing a modron under its command be destroyed, the quarton gains 10 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the quarton's attacks deal an additional 10 force damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a tertian within 60 feet die or transform, the quarton may transform into a tertian, retaining its current hit points. No more than one quarton may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The quinton may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the quinton is within 30 feet of a quarton, it uses the quarton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the quarton is using a tertian's attack bonus, the quinton uses that instead, and so on.

trait.name: Keeper of the Ledger
entries: The quinton has advantage on saving throws against any spell that a modron has seen that spell's caster cast.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quinton makes three attacks with its Axiomatic Bolt and uses its Stickler for Procedure.

action.name: Axiomatic Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +11 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: The target loses 1/5 of its maximum hit points.

action.name: Stickler for Procedure
entries: The quinton identifies some procedural error, invalidating one Declaration of Hostile Intent that it has seen in the last minute.

action.name: Convene Meeting (1/Day)
entries: The quinton teleports itself and any number of other modrons it can see within 60 feet to a private demiplane to discuss how to procede.
As an action, the quinton may end this effect, and each modron in the demiplane reappears in the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed.

reaction.name: Check Papers
entries: As a reaction when a creature the quinton can see within 30 feet makes an attack against a modron, the quinton demands a written Declaration of Hostile Intent.

An attacker with such a declaration on its person may use its reaction to reveal it. If the attacker does not, the attack fails. As a Bonus Action, a creature may write a Declaration of Hostile Intent.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a quarton within 60 feet die or transform, the quinton may transform into a quarton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one quinton may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The septon may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the hexton is within 30 feet of a quinton, it uses the quinton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the quinton is using a quarton's attack bonus, the hexton uses that instead, and so on.

trait.name: Lockstep
entries: The hexton may spend 5 feet of its movement to move any number of modrons under its command within 60 feet 5 feet in the same direction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hexton makes two attacks with its Grip of Utmost Law.

action.name: Grip of Utmost Law
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escpae DC 18).
While grappled in this way, a non-lawful creature takes 10 necrotic plus 10 radiant damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Rain of Gears (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The hexton conjures a Huge flying gear factory that lasts for a minute in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

When it casts this spell and at the beginning of each of the hexton's turns, it may move the factory up to 30 feet. A each creature that starts its turn beneath the factory must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 30 bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Heximate (8th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hexton bombards a creature it can see within 60 feet with the pure force of cosmic Law, forcing each particle of its being into a rigid and baleful alignment.

The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or have its hit point total set to 1/6 of its hit point maximum, or to 5/6 of its hit point maximum on a success. A construct succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a quinton within 60 feet die or transform, the hexton may transform into a quinton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one hexton may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The septon may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the septon is within 30 feet of a hexton, it uses the hexton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the hexton is using a quinton's attack bonus, the septon uses that instead, and so on.

trait.name: Safety Protocols
entries: Attacks and damaging spells that target the septon deal minimum damage, instead of rolling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The septon makes four attacks with its Clockwork Clipboard.

action.name: Clockwork Clipboard
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Curse of Self-Reporting
entries: One creature the septon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature that engages in any non-Lawful behavior has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until it records and reports those transgressions to a figure of Lawful authority.

action.name: Stop Order (1/Day)
entries: The septon sends forth a pulse of temporal stasis in a 60 foot radius, ending each spell or magical effect of 8th level or below in the area.

Each creature in the area of the septon's choice must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be frozen in time until the end of the septon's next turn. While frozen, a creature is incapacitated and immune to all damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a hexton within 60 feet die or transform, the septon may transform into a hexton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one septon may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The octon may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the octon is within 30 feet of a septon, it uses the septon's attack bonus instead of its own. If the septon is using a hexton's attack bonus, the octon uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The octon makes four attacks with its Teetering Tubes.

action.name: Teetering Tubes
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 bludgeoning damage.
On a roll of 1, the octon falls prone. This attack is made at disadvantage if the octon is flying.

action.name: Spinlift Collar
entries: The octon extends its tubes and begins to rapidly spin its collar, gaining a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the end of its next turn.
Each creature within 10 feet of the octon must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 slashing damage and be pushed 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Cut Ribbon (1/Day)
entries: The octon reveals a set of magical, springloaded scissors that emerge from a door in its chest, cutting open a portal through which twelve monodrones immediately tumble forth, falling prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces before the portal seals itself shut.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a septon within 60 feet die or transform, the octon may transform into a septon, retaining its current hit points. No more than one octon may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The nonaton may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the nonaton is within 30 feet of an octon, it uses the octon's attack bonus instead of its own. If the octon is using a septon's attack bonus, the nonaton uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nonaton makes four attacks with its Flailing Tubes.

action.name: Flailing Tubes
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Interrogate Loyalties
entries: One creature the nonaton can see within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failed save, the creature takes 25 psychic damage and the nonaton learns its alignment and surface thoughts.

action.name: Torpedo Toss
entries: The nonaton spits out a small torpedo, then rapidly spins and tosses it to a space it can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 15 radiant damage and be blinded until the end of the nonaton's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Seal of Approval
entries: As a reaction when a creature voluntarily fails its saving throw against the nonaton's Interrogate Loyalties, the nonaton affixes a gold star sticker to it.
Until the creature completes a Long Rest, it has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a octon within 60 feet die or transform, the nonaton may transform into a octon, retaining its current hit points. No more than one nonaton may take this reaction.

trait.name: Shuffling Gait
entries: The decaton's walking speed is reduced to 0 while in difficult terrain.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The decaton may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the decaton is within 30 feet of a nonaton, it uses the nonaton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the nonaton is using a octon's attack bonus, the decaton uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The decaton makes three attacks with its Flailing Tubes, one of which it may replace with a use of its Oil Joints.

action.name: Flailing Tubes
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Oil Joints
entries: One friendly modron within 10 feet gains 10 temporary hit points that last for 10 minutes. While it has any of these temporary hit points, a modron has vulnerability to fire damage and can make a melee attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Pruning Cull
entries: The decaton destroys one friendly pentadrone it can see, then restores each modron that transformed as a result to full health.

reaction.name: Gas Up
entries: As a reaction when it is hit with a melee attack, the decaton fills itself with a buoyant gas, immediately rising 10 feet directly upward.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a nonaton within 60 feet die or transform, the decaton may transform into a nonaton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one decaton may take this reaction.

name: Magesteel Sealwarden
languages: understands The languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Dweomercore Reactor
entries: The sealwarden is stunned while it has no Charge Counters. At the beginning of each of its turns, the sealwarden gains three Charge Counters if it has no Charge Counters.

trait.name: Supercritical Overload
entries: If the sealwarden starts its turn with 10 or more Charge Counters, it must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the sealwarden is destroyed, and each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) force plus 9 (2d8) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Magehunter's Gaze
entries: The sealwarden can sense what the highest level unexpended spell slot of any creature it can see is.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sealwarden makes two attacks with its Magebreaker Fist.

action.name: Magebreaker Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the sealwarden gains one charge counter per level of the target's highest level unexpended spell slot.

items.name: Overcharge (Costs 3 Charge Counters)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose attunement to a random item it is attuned to..

action.name: Spellpurge Glare (Costs 4 Charge Counters)
entries: The sealwarden's face folds inward, and from it emerge flickering tendrils of baleful blue light toward a creature it can see within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) radiant damage and lose its highest level unexpended spell slot, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Dampening Field (Costs 9 Charge Counters)
entries: The sealwarden's armor flares open, releasing a cloud of glowing motes in a 60 foot radius that last for ten minutes or until cleared by a strong wind.
A creature in the area that casts a spell of 1st level or above must expend one additional spell slot (of any level) or have the spell fail.

reaction.name: Waste-Magic Cycling
entries: When the sealwarden is targeted with a spell, it may gain one charge counter that lasts for a minute.

name: Living Meteor
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Quench
entries: If the meteor takes any cold damage or it is doused in water, the magma in its body cools; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances, its speeds are reduced to 10 feet and its abilities do not cause fire damage or the burning condition.

trait.name: Thick Crust
entries: The meteor is immune to damage from falling and can crash into solid surfaces without taking damage.

trait.name: Fiery Wake
entries: Whenever the meteor flies at least 30-feet in a straight line, it leaves behind a burning trail of superheated gas. The trail remains until the start of the meteor's next turn. Any creature that enters the trail for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Additionally, any creature that comes within 5 feet of the meteor for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The meteor makes three attacks in any combination of its Molten Flare and Superheated Slam. It can replace one with its Meteoric Impact if it moved at least 30 feet in a straight line.

action.name: Superheated Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet. If the target is burning, it takes additional fire damage equal to its burning value.

action.name: Molten Flare
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) fire damage and the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Meteoric Impact
entries: The meteor slams into the ground, forcing each creature within 20 feet of it to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, is pushed 10 feet away, knocked prone, and begins burning (1d10), or half as much damage on a success.
The impact creates a 20-foot wide crater. Craters are difficult terrain, and a creature that enters a crater for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
If the meteor fell at least 200 feet before using this action, it deals 78 (6d12 + 7) plus 21 (6d6) fire damage.
After the meteor uses this action, its speed drops to 0.

reaction.name: Crack Crust
entries: When the meteor takes 30 or more bludgeoning, force, lightning, piercing, or thunder damage from a single source, it can cause its crust to crack and release pressure. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Volcanic Ravager
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from magical sources
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Quench
entries: If the ravager takes any cold damage or it is doused in water, the magma in its body cools; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances, its speeds are reduced to 10 feet and its abilities do not cause fire damage or the burning condition.

trait.name: Molten Titan
entries: A creature that hits the ravager with a melee attack takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and begins burning (1d10).

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the ravager fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Violent Retaliation
entries: Whenever the ravager takes 25 or more damage from a single source, it may choose one of the following effects to happen. It can't choose the same effect twice in a row.

items.name: Heatwave
entries: Each creature within 20 feet of the ravager must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

items.name: Pyroclastic Surge
entries: Each creature within a 30-foot cone must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

items.name: Smoldering Backhand
entries: The ravager makes a melee attack.

items.name: Toxic Fumes
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the ravager must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

items.name: Volcanic Haze
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the ravager must make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is choking until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

items.name: Volcanic Thunderclap
entries: Each creature within 50 feet of the ravager must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) thunder damage and is frightened of the ravager until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ravager makes four attacks.

action.name: Ultra-Plinian Blow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) fire damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 22) and begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Magma Lob
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target begins burning (1d10) or is knocked prone (ravager's choice).

name: Volcano Tortoise
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from magical sources
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Quench
entries: If the tortoise takes any cold damage or it is doused in water, the magma in its body cools; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances, its speeds are reduced to 10 feet and its abilities do not cause fire damage or the burning condition.

trait.name: Molten Shell
entries: A creature that moves within 20 feet of the tortoise for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and begins burning (1d10).

trait.name: Volcanic Craters
entries: The tortoise's shell has 5 volcanic craters on it. Whenever it takes 30 or more cold damage from a single source, one of the craters is quenched until the end of the tortoise's next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the tortoise fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tortoise makes four attacks, one of which can be with its Lockjaw Cinderbite, and one of which it can replace with a use of its Volcanic Fury.

action.name: Lockjaw Cinderbite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (5d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 24) and begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Earthshatter Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage and each grounded creature within 60 feet of the tortoise must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Volcanic Fury
entries: The tortoise's shell erupts in a volcanic blast, causing one of the following effects of the tortoiuse's choice. For each of the tortoise's craters that is quenched, a random one of these actions is unavailable.

items.name: Molten Boulder
entries: The tortoise launches a hunk of molten rock towards a creature within 150 feet of it. The target must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage and is knocked prone, or half as much damage on a success.

items.name: Pyroclastic Surge
entries: Each creature within a 90-foot cone must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 (12d6) fire damage, or half as much damage on a success. The area is covered in molten rock, becoming difficult terrain for 1 minute. A creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

items.name: Toxic Fumes (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The tortoise exudes a thick smog in a 120-foot radius sphere centered on it. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute. A creature that enters the smog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 18 (4d8) poison damage, begins choking, and must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: Volcanic Lightning (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Red lightning arcs towards a creature within 150 feet of the tortoise. Three bolts leap from that creature to as many as three other creatures within 30 feet of the first target. A creature can only be affected once by this effect.
A creature targeted by this effect must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

items.name: Volcanic Thunderclap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 80 feet of the tortoise must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 (12d6) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or half as much damage on a success.

legenadry.name: Lava Surge
entries: The tortoise moves up to 30 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity, leaving a trail of lava in its path. The trail remains for 1 minute. A creature that enters the trail for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 14 (4d6) fire damage.

legenadry.name: Tighten Grip (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The tortoise makes an attack with its Lockjaw Cinderbite against a creature it is grappling. If it hits, the target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or suffer a piercing injury.

legenadry.name: Volcanic Fury (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The tortoise uses its Volcanic Fury.

name: Magesteel Lenser
languages: understands The languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Dweomercore Engine
entries: The lenser is stunned while it has no Charge Counters. At the beginning of each of its turns, the lenser gains one Charge Counter if it has no Charge Counters.

trait.name: Haywire Short
entries: Whenever the lenser takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it takes an additional 1 lightning damage for each Charge Counter it has, then loses each of its Charge Counters.

action.name: Searing Lance
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage.
This attack can target one additional target directly behind the first target for each Charge Counter the lenser has.

action.name: Collapse Ceiling (Costs 1 Charge Counter)
entries: The lenser uses its cutting beams to carve a 15 foot line into a ceiling it can see within 60 feet, causing a rain of rubble.
Each creature directly beneath the line must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Cutting Sweep (Costs 3 Charge Counters)
entries: The lenser sweeps its cutting beams in a 60 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) radiant damage, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has one nonmagical item it is wielding bisected, destroying it.

reaction.name: Waste-Magic Cycling
entries: When the suppressor is targeted with a spell, it may gain one charge counter that lasts for a minute.

name: Magesteel Suppressor
languages: understands The languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Dweomercore Engine
entries: The suppressor is stunned while it has no Charge Counters. At the beginning of each of its turns, the suppressor gains one Charge Counter if it has no Charge Counters.

trait.name: Haywire Short
entries: Whenever the suppressor takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it takes an additional 1 lightning damage for each Charge Counter it has, then loses each of its Charge Counters.

action.name: Charged Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage for each Charge Counter the sentry has.

items.name: Overcharge (Costs 1 Charge Counter)
entries: The target takes an additional 3 (1d6) lightning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Submission Shock (Costs 2 Charge Counters)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) lightning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally stunned until the end of the suppressor's next turn.

action.name: Share Charge
entries: The supressor loses each of its Charge Counters, and a friendly magesteel automata within 5 feet of it gains that many Charge Counters plus 1.

reaction.name: Waste-Magic Cycling
entries: When the suppressor is targeted with a spell, it may gain one charge counter that lasts for a minute.

name: Magesteel Sentry
languages: understands The languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Dweomercore Engine
entries: The sentry is stunned while it has no Charge Counters. At the beginning of each of its turns, the sentry gains one Charge Counter if it has no Charge Counters.

trait.name: Haywire Short
entries: Whenever the sentry takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it takes an additional 1 lightning damage for each Charge Counter it has, then loses each of its Charge Counters.

action.name: Detaining Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).
A creature grappled in this way by two or more sentries is restrained.

action.name: Intrusive Gaze
entries: The sentry learns each spell affecting one creature grappled by it and each magic item it is carrying.

items.name: Overcharge (Costs 2 Charge Counters)
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

action.name: Blaring Klaxon
entries: The sentry sounds a piercing alarm, audible to each creature within 500 feet, that lasts until the sentry takes any damage.
Creatures within 30 feet of the sentry that can hear the alarm are deafened to all other sounds and have disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration.

reaction.name: Waste-Magic Cycling
entries: When the sentry is targeted with a spell, it may gain one charge counter that lasts for a minute.

name: Quarut
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Space-Time Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the quarut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. If a creature within 60 ft. alters the flow of time for itself, either through Haste, Time Stop, Wish, or similar magic, the quarut is affected by the same magic.

trait.name: Unyielding Form
entries: The quarut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quarut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Time Sense
entries: The quarut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has traveled through time or circumvented the restrictions of the Wish spell, even if the creature and the quarut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the quarut dies, the quarut knows.

action.name: Slow Time Bubble (6th Level Spell)
entries: The quarut creates a permanent 30 ft. diameter bubble of slowed time. A creature that starts its turn in the bubble, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or suffer the following effects until the end of its turn.
The creature's movement speed is reduced by half.
The creature cannot make more than a single attack on its turn.
If the creature casts a spell, the spell doesn't take effect until the beginning of its following turn.

action.name: Magics Undone
entries: The quarut ends each magical effect of the quarut's choice affecting one creature or object it can see within 60 ft.

action.name: Stasis Lock (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature in the quarut's slow time bubble must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or be unaffected by the passage of time until the quarut releases it. A stasis locked creature is incpacitated and immune to all damage and the effects of aging, and does not need to eat, drink, breathe, or sleep.

action.name: Temporal Purge (9th Level Spell, 1/day)
entries: One creature affected by the Quarut's stasis lock must make a DC 23 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is removed from the flow of time. It ceases to exist and cannot be returned to life by any known magics, and the marks it left on the material plane fade and are forgotten.

action.name: Curse of Contemporality (9th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the quarut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be cursed to experience time conventionally, suffering the following effects:
The creature can no longer voluntarily be the target of spells of 8th level or above, or of equivalent effects.
If this curse is removed, another quarut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell)
entries: The quarut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

name: Varakhut
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dimensional Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the varakhut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. The varakhut's own abilities are not subject to this trait.

trait.name: Unyielding Form
entries: The varakhut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The varakhut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable Tracker
entries: The varakhut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has exceeded its natural lifespan, even if the creature and the varakhut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the varakhut dies, the varakhut knows.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The varakhut uses its disintegration ray twice, one of which it may replace with its disjunctive blast or curse of diminished ambition, if available.

action.name: Disintegration Ray (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature or object the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 50 force damage and each nonmagical item it is wearing or carrying turns to dust. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is also reduced to dust.

action.name: Disjunctive Blast (8th Level Spell)
entries: One creature or object the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, all spells of 8th level or below affecting the target end, and one magic item that the target is carrying (target's choice) becomes inert and nonmagical for the next minute.

action.name: Purge Mind (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the varakhut removes one piece of knowledge related to process of ascending to divinity from the creature's mind.

action.name: Curse of Diminished Ambition (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the varakhut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be cursed to be barred from divinity, suffering the following effects:
While a cursed creature is outside its home plane, it must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or be returned to its home plane.
While a cursed creature is concentrating on a spell or ritual, it takes one psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell)
entries: The Varakhut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

name: Zelekhut
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dimensional Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the zelekhut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. The zelekhut's own abilities are not subject to this trait.

trait.name: Unyielding Form
entries: The zelekhut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The zelekhut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Lawkeeper's Awareness
entries: The zelekhut knows what laws a creature it can see has broken.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zelekhut makes two chain attacks and uses its Subduing Shock.

action.name: Spiked Chains
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. automatic hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d10) slashing damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 19). The zelekhut has two chains, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Subduing Shock
entries: Each creature grappled by the zelekhut must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) lightning damage. This damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

action.name: Curse of Inevitable Justice (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the zelekhut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be cursed with a mark of judgement, suffering the following effects:
Any creature that can see the cursed creature knows what laws it has broken.
If this curse is removed, another zelekhut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Justify (7th Level Spell)
entries: One creature grappled by the zelekhut and affected by its Curse of Inevitable Justice must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be teleported to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. A target fails automatically if it has 1 or fewer hit points. If the target is teleported in this way, the zelekhut teleports with it to the circle.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell)
entries: The zelekhut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

name: Kolyarut
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dimensional Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the kolyarut. Any attempt to do so is wasted.

trait.name: Unyielding Form
entries: The kolyarut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The kolyarut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable Tracker
entries: The kolyarut knows the distance to and direction of each creature whose contract or oath it is sworn to enforce, even if the creature and the kolyarut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the kolyarut dies, the kolyarut knows.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kolyarut makes two unerring clutch attacks, either of which it may replace with a use of its claim damages, if available.

action.name: Unerring Clutch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. automatic hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 force damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained.

action.name: Exemplary Damages
entries: One creature grappled by the kolyarut must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or permanently lose one hit die or its lowest level spell slot (kolyarut's choice). This can be recovered only through the use of a Wish spell or equivalent magic, or by appealing its case at one of the civil courts of Mechanicus.

action.name: Curse of the Oathkeeper (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature grappled by the kolyarut must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or take 18 (4d8) radiant plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage and be cursed to keep its oaths, suffering the following effects.
The cursed creature cannot voluntarily renege on an oath or valid contract it is a party to.
The cursed creature is branded an oathkeeper. A creature proficient in History or Arcana is aware of the cause and effects of the creature's curse.

action.name: Curse of the Oathbreaker (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature grappled by the kolyarut must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage and be cursed to be mistrusted, suffering the following effects.
The cursed creature cannot voluntarily enter into oaths or contracts.
The cursed creature has disadvantage on Charisma checks made to declare its intent.
The cursed creature is branded an oathbreaker. A creature proficient in History or Arcana is aware of the cause and effects of the creature's curse.

name: Homunculus
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

trait.name: Unobtrusive
entries: The homunculus may attempt to hide as a bonus action when adjacent to two or more creatures that are one size larger than it.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

name: Grisgol
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the grisgol to 0 hit points must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be cursed.

While cursed, a creature becomes obsessed with the idea that the wrappings of the grisgol to contain an important secret, if only they can be properly pieced together, and has its Intelligence score reduced by one each week until the curse is removed.
If the grisgol takes 40 or more fire damage from a single source, this trait ceases to function until the grisgol is repaired.

trait.name: Imprisoned Lich
entries: The grisgol is animated by life force drained form a defeated lich's phylactery, preventing the lich from returning to life. If the grisgol is defeated and the phylactery is not destroyed, the lich gains a new body in 1d10 days.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The grisgol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grisgol makes two attacks with its Wilting Touch.

action.name: Wilting Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (5d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

action.name: Vent Magic
entries: The grisgol vents raw weave in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) force damage and roll on the Wild Magic Table (PHB p. 103), or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Erratic Fireball (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The grisgol chooses a direction, launching a fireball that explodes in a 20 foot radius centered on a point 35 (2d6 x 5) feet away from the grisgol.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 (10d6) fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Mindwrack Binding (8th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: Each creature of the grisgol's choice within 30 feet must succeed on  DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of the grisgol's next turn.

reaction.name: Containment Breach
entries: When the grisgol succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can use its Vent Magic.

reaction.name: Mycotoxin Dust
entries: When the grisgol is hit with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning or slashing damage, the grisgol can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract Mind Fog.

name: Tombstone Golem
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Huge Stature
