entries: A creature adjacent to the golem may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the golem. While climbing on the gome, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the golem, and the golem has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the golem fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three attacks with its Slab Slam, one of which it may replace with its Golem's Gravemark.

action.name: Slab Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Golem's Gravemark
entries: One creature the golem can see must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the golem hits a cursed creature with a melee attack, the creature takes an additional 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Smash to Dust (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem throws itself prone onto a prone  creature within 10 feet and ends its turn. If the creature has fewer than 100 hit points, it drops to 0 hit points and must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or immediately fail two death Saving Throws.

reaction.name: Stonecrack Epitaph
entries: When the golem takes 30 or more damage from a single source, an ominous crack rings out from deep within the golem.
Each living creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

name: Stone Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands The Languages Of Its Creator but can't speak

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Brittle Body
entries: If the golem takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it can no longer use its multiattack until it completes a short or long rest. If it takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source a second time, it falls prone and cannot stand until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Implacable Advance
entries: At the beginning of its turn, the golem may end all effects that would reduce its speed or incapacitate it. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Richochet
entries: A ranged weapon attack that misses the golem by 5 or more instead targets another creature within 15 ft., making a new attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same Large or smaller creature, the creature has its movement speed halved and is unable to make more than a single attack in a turn until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature grappled by the golem must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 66 (12d10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skull crushed.

reaction.name: Hurl
entries: As a reaction to being damaged by a creature it is grappling, the golem hurls the creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage on be knocked prone, or half as much on a success. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

trait.name: Leadlight Blessing
entries: The golem emits Bright Light in a 15 ft. radius, and Dim Light for an additional 15 ft. If a living creature within the light would take half damage for succeeding on a saving throw against a spell, it instead takes no damage.

trait.name: Sharper When Shattered
entries: If the golem has fewer than 53 hit points, its attacks score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two razor edge attacks.

action.name: Razor Edge
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of the targets turns, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or lose 4 (1d8) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Keen
entries: As a reaction to taking slashing damage, the golem releases a terrible sound. Each creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the golem's next turn.

reaction.name: Shard Storm
entries: As a reaction to taking bludgeoning or thunder damage, golem flings shards of itself in every direction. Each creature within 15 ft. of the golem must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Flesh Golem Assimilator
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Graft-Host
entries: For each additional limb attached with its Claim Flesh ability, the golem's speed is reduced by 5. The golems limbs, if removed and attached to another creature within 1 minute, will magically attach to that creature.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Resilient Animus
entries: If the golem would take 12 or fewer damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three attacks with its Slam, one of which it may replace with a Throttle or Hurl.
It makes an additional attack with its Wild Flailing for each limb attached with its Claim Flesh ability.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning plus 11 (3d10) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Wild Flailing
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One grappled creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the golem's next turn.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The golem hurls a grappled creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

action.name: Claim Flesh (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem attempts to tear a limb from a living creature and attach it to its own body. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 66 (12d10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that failed this save and is reduced to 0 hit points in this way has one of its limbs torn off and magically attached to the golem.

name: Dragonflesh Golem
languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Clumsy Flier
entries: The golem falls at the end of a turn if it is airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed. Attacks it makes while airborne are made at disadvantage

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Nested-Jaw Bite or its Tail Bash.

action.name: Nested-Jaw Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.

action.name: Claw Swipe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

action.name: Tail Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Explosive Breath (1/Day)
entries: The golem exhales an explosive mixture of elements in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire and 27 (6d8) thunder damage and being pushed 30 ft. away on a failed save, or take half as much damage on a successful one.
The golem's jaw splits and breaks, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls made with its bite.

reaction.name: Wing Thrash (Recharge 5-6)
entries: When the golem takes any necrotic damage, it can force each creature within 10 feet of it to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

name: Clockwork Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Electricity Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to electricity damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the electricity damage dealt.

trait.name: Geared Construction
entries: When subjected to the Grease spell or a similar effect, the Clockwork Golem gains the effects of the Haste spell for the next minute. It loses these effects early if it takes cold or acid damage. If it takes fire damage while under this effect, it catches fire, taking 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until the flames are extinguished.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Nonslip
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws that would force it to move or knock it prone.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two grind attacks.

action.name: Grind
entries: The Clockwork Golem attempts to grapple an opponent. On a success, it suffers 2d10 + 7 slashing damage as razor-sharp gears and blades emerge from its body to grind and slice its foe.

action.name: Axe Sweep
entries: +11 to hit. Targets each creature within 15 feet of the golem (make a separate attack roll for each). 2d10 + 7 damage and the target must make a DC16 Strength Save or be shoved 10 feet back. If it misses one of these attacks, all subsequent attacks it makes this turn are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Wall of Gears
entries: The clockwork golem folds into a whirling wall of grinding gears, composed of 4 10x10-ft segments. Anyone passing through or starting their turn in the wall takes 8d6 points of slashing damage. If the wall appears in a creature's space, that creature can attempt a DC 16 Dexterity save to leap to one side and avoid the damage entirely. The clockwork golem can take no actions while in this form except to resume its normal form as a bonus action. A clockwork golem's AC and immunities remain the same while it is in this form. A creature grappled by the golem stays grappled by it in this form.

name: Bone Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes five attacks with its Bone Spur Strike, each of which it may replace with its Osseous Grasp or Creeping Bone, if available.

action.name: Bone Spur Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Osseous Grasp
entries: The golem leaps up to 20 feet and may move into the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature whose space the golem lands in must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 14).

action.name: Creeping Bone (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature grappled by the golem must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or gain 11 (2d10) cumulative temporary hit points as plates of bone begin to grow over its skin.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is restrained. While a creature has 30 or more of these temporary hit points, it is petrified.

reaction.name: Splintering Vengeance
entries: When the golem takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it can make an attack with its Bone Spur Strike, afterwards making one fewer attack whenever it uses its multiattack.

name: Clockwork Caretaker
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Electricity Absorption
entries: Whenever the caretaker is subjected to electricity damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the electricity damage dealt.

trait.name: Nonslip
entries: The caretaker has advantage on saving throws that would force it to move or knock it prone.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The caretaker's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Oil Spray
entries: Slick oil covers the ground in a 30-foot cone and turns it into difficult terrain until cleared. When the oil appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must also succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Adhesive Spray
entries: Sticky gunk covers the ground in a 30-foot cone and turns it into difficult terrain. When the gunk appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 13).

action.name: Pressure Wash
entries: High pressure water blasts in a 30-foot line, dousing any flames in its path. A creature in the path must succeed on a DC13 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or suffer half damage on a success.

trait.name: Numinous Presence
entries: If the unicorn has at least 86 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the unicorn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the unicorn until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the unicorn since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The unicorn has advantage on stealth checks to hide from non-good-aligned creatures.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn. If it has 85 or fewer HP, it instead makes three attacks with its hooves and one with its horn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Healing Touch
entries: The unicorn magically restores 22 (4d8 + 4) hit points to a creature within 5 feet. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

action.name: Teleport (1/Day)
entries: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

reaction.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature make an attack, the unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +3 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

legendary.name: Hooves
entries: The unicorn makes one attack with its hooves.

legendary.name: Skittish Dash (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The unicorn moves up to half its speed. Opportunity attacks it provokes with this movement are made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Healing Touch (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The unicorn uses its healing touch.

name: Radiant Idol
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The radiant idol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Aura of False Divinity
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the radiant idol must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the radiant idol until the beginning of its next turn. A creature that passes this save becomes immune to this radiant' idol's aura of false divinity for 24 hours.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the radiant idol while immune to its aura of false divinity must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the radiant idol until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the radiant idol may  transform into a humanoid or angelic form, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).

trait.name: Chained to the Earth
entries: Creatures and objects within 30 ft. of the radiant idol may not fly by any magical means.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The radiant idol makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Crippling Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be unable to make more than one attack on its next turn. On a critical hit, the target's shield is destroyed, if it is wearing one.

action.name: Radiant Strike (1/Day)
entries: The radiant idol chooses a point on the ground it can see within 60 feet of it. A 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of bright light appears there until the start of the radiant idol's next turn. Each creature in the cylinder when it appears or that ends its turn there must make a DC: 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Curse of Exalted Blood
entries: As a reaction to taking at least 15 points of piercing or slashing damage, the radiant idol forces one creature within 5 feet to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A cursed creature takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage the first time each turn it disobeys a command of the radiant idol.

trait.name: Icon of Peace
entries: If the ki-rin has at least 135 hit points, a creature that targets the ki-rin with an attack or harmful spell  must first make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.
While it has at least 135 hit points, the kirin will not use its breath weapon.

trait.name: Weightless Step
entries: Whenever the ki-rin takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The ki-rin knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Harbinger of Bounty
entries: A good-aligned creature that sees a ki-rin is blessed. For the next 24 hours, the creature maximizes any magical healing it receives and automatically succeeds on Wisdom (Survival) checks to forage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ki-rin uses its numinous command twice.

action.name: Numinous Command
entries: The ki-rin speaks a word of divine power. One creature within 60 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one effect of the ki-rin's choice.

items.name: Desist
entries: The creature flings one object of the ki-rin's choice that it is holding 30 ft. in a random direction.

items.name: Reflect
entries: The creature takes 38 (7d10) psychic damage as it is confronted with every harm it has ever done through negligence or ill intent. The damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

items.name: Repent
entries: The creature falls prone and cannot stand. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature makes this save with advantage if it uses its action to make an honest apology.

action.name: Divine Fury Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ki-rin exhales holy fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area of neutral or evil alignment must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire and 36 (8d8) radiant damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Ascendant Breeze
entries: The ki-rin grants one creature within 60 ft. that it can see a fly speed equal to its movement speed that lasts for the next hour, or until the creature moves more than 60 ft. away.

legendary.name: Swords to Plowshares
entries: One weapon within 60 ft. that deals slashing or piercing damage magically blunts. For the next minute, the weapon deals bludgeoning damage instead of any other type and loses the finesse property.

legendary.name: Tranquility
entries: The ki-rin ends one magical on it that would incapacitate or immobilize it. It may use this ability while incapacitated.

trait.name: Icon of Peace
entries: If the ki-rin has at least 26 hit points, a creature that targets the ki-rin with an attack or harmful spell  must first make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.
While it has at least 26 hit points, the kirin will not use its breath weapon.

trait.name: Weightless Step
entries: Whenever the ki-rin takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

action.name: Numinous Command
entries: The ki-rin speaks a word of divine power. One creature within 30 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one effect of the ki-rin's choice.

items.name: Desist
entries: The creature drops one object of the ki-rin's choice.

items.name: Reflect
entries: The creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage as it is confronted with every harm it has ever done through negligence or ill intent. The damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

items.name: Repent
entries: The creature falls prone and cannot stand on its following turn.

action.name: Divine Fury Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The ki-rin exhales holy fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area of neutral or evil alignment must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) fire and 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Harbinger of Bounty (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature within 60 ft. receive magical healing, the ki-rin causes the healing to be maximized.

name: Deathpact Angel
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Beneficent Presence
entries: If the angel has at least 103 hit points, a creature in the angel's debt that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the angel until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if the angel attacked it in the last minute.

trait.name: Exacting Presence
entries: If the angel has 102 hit points or fewer, a creature frightened by the angels Visions of Death is additionally paralyzed.

trait.name: Debt Keeper
entries: A creature that is indebted to the angel is psychically connected to it. The angel can telepathically communicate with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through its senses. Once per day, the angel can force an indebted creature to reroll an attack, skill check, or saving throw, taking the second result.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shed Asset (3/Day)
entries: If the angel fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to shift the effect to a creature in its debt within 30 feet. If it does, that creature is freed from the angel's debt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Visions of Death, if available, and uses its Debt to the Deathless.

action.name: Golden Scythe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target loses 2 (1d4) unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 hit points and loses an extremity if it cannot.

action.name: Debt to the Deathless
entries: One creature within 30 feet that is in the angel's debt loses 11 (2d10) hit points, and the angel gains that many temporary hit points.

action.name: Visions of Death (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the angel can see must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is blinded and frightened until the end of the angel's next turn as it begins to vividly hallucinate its own gruesome death at the angel's hands.

action.name: Touch of Life (3/Day)
entries: The angel touches a living creature or one that has been dead no longer than ten days. The creature returns to life in the angel's debt if it was dead, then regains hit points equal to half its maximum.

reaction.name: Offer Relief
entries: When another creature it can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw, the angel grants it the ability to choose to reroll the saving throw, taking the second result. A creature that does so is indebted to the angel.

reaction.name: Recall Obligations
entries: When a creature in the angel's debt that the angel can see casts a spell, the angel forces the creature to expend an additional spell slot of any level. If the creature cannot, the spell fails.

name: Couatl Cloud Serpent
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The couatl has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Dream Traveler
entries: The couatl can appear in the dreams of any creature it is familiar with. While in a creature's dream, the couatl may appear however it wishes, can communicate with the creature, and can free it from any poison, disease, or curse it is afflicted with.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the couatl may transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).

trait.name: Leaf on the Wind
entries: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement adjacent to the couatl, the couatl may move up to 15 feet. Opportunity attacks that it provokes with this movement are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The couatl attacks once with its bite and once with its constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage and 27 (6d8) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target perceives its reality as though in a dream, has a fly speed of 60 feet, and deals only half damage with weapon attacks. The target may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. When the effect ends, the target retains no memory of events that transpired while it was poisoned.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the couatl can't constrict another target.

action.name: Crack the Sky (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 120 feet of the couatl, and up to three creatures within 30 feet of the first target, must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) radiant damage and 22 (5d8) lighting damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Sword Archon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the archon is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 18, 19, or 20.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes two attacks with its holy flameblades.

action.name: Holy Flameblades
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) fire damage and 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be banished to a prison demiplane until the archon uses this ability again or is incapacitated, reappearing in the nearest unoccupied space to the space it departed.

action.name: Wing Buffet
entries: Each creature within 15 ft. of the archon must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Hallowed Blood (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 hit points, the archon blesses the weapons of each friendly creature within 30 ft. Weapon attacks made by those creatures for the next minute do an additional 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a hit.

name: Trumpet Archon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Rallying Presence
entries: If the archon has fewer than 85 hit points, creatures within 60 feet that can hear the archon have advantage on Wisdom saving throws, and regain the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes three attacks with its trumpet blade, one of which it may replace with its Clarion Call, if available.

action.name: Trumpet Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and 9 (2d8) radiant damage. Before or after this attack, the archon's trumpet may become a greatsword, or vice versa.

action.name: Clarion Call (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 60 ft. that can hear the archon has its life essence bolstered. Non-undead creatures affected by this ability cannot be reduced below 1 HP until the beginning of the archon's next turn. Fiends  have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws until the beginning of the archon's next turn.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Trumpet Blast
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the archon forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) thunder damage and be deafened for the next minute. A Celestial or Fiend that fails this save by 5 or more is banished to its home plane.

name: Warden Archon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Menacing Presence
entries: If the archon has fewer than 69 hit points, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the archon must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the archon until the beginning of the archon's next turn. A creature that passes this save is immune to the Menacing Presence of this archon for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Far-Seeing
entries: The archon cannot be surprised. If it would otherwise be surprised, it acts on initiative count 20 this combat, instead of rolling initiative.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the archon must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage. This attack does an additional 9 (2d8) piercing damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Bear Hug
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 45 (9d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be grappled. While the archon has a creature grappled in this way, it cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the archon has grappled speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the archon crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature immediately begins to suffocate.

name: Hound Archon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Calm and Ready
entries: Creatures of the archon's choice within 30 ft. have advantage on initiative checks and on saving throws against Fear.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The archon can use its action to polymorph into any canine, such as a wolf, dog or fox, or back into its true form, which is celestial. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed, and isn't usable while polymorphed. It reverts to its celestial form if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone if it is a medium or smaller creature.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Loyal Defender
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 ft. being hit with an attack, the archon may cause the attack to hit it instead.

name: Lantern Archon
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Peaceful Illumination
entries: The archon sheds bright sunlight in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet. Creatures illuminated by it have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to deescalate conflict.

action.name: Celestial Aid
entries: Up to three creatures within 60 ft. each gain 10 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of those temporary hit points, its vision is not impeded by ordinary or magical darkness.

action.name: Light the Path
entries: One creature within 60 ft. sees the shortest and most direct physical route to their current destination illuminated before them for the next eight hours, if such a route exists.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Oppressive Radiance

A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is blinded until the end of the archon's next turn.

entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement to move in a straight line before taking an action. If this movement is arrested by a solid surface, the creature falls prone and ends its turn.

action.name: Stings (swarm has more than half HP)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (2d4) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage. If this damage causes a creature to make a saving throw to maintain concentration, it does so at disadvantage.

action.name: Stings (swarm has half HP or less)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage. If this damage causes a creature to make a saving throw to maintain concentration, it does so at disadvantage.

name: Grandmatriarch Bear
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Name of the Bear
entries: The bear knows the type and location of each creature that has heard her name in the last 24 hours. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the bear learns her name.
Those wishing to avoid using her name often refer to her as "The Brown One", "Honey-Eater", or "Ur-Mother".

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that kills the bear with an attack is cursed until a grand funeral has been held for her. While cursed, a creature makes Death saving throws at disadvantage. If this curse is removed by other means, the bear immediately returns to life with half of her hit points.

trait.name: You Will Know Her (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the bear is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she resets to 162 hit points and each other creature within 60 feet loses immunity to the frightened condition.
For the next hour, a prone creature that knows the bear's name and that starts its turn within 30 feet of her is frightened until the beginning of its next turn and takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the bear fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes three attacks, one of which may be with her bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 9 (2d8) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot stand on its following turn.

action.name: Hail of Splinters (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bear rakes her claws against a tree within her reach. Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 42 (12d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. If the tree is Huge or smaller, it is destroyed.

reaction.name: Run Down
entries: As a reaction to a hostile creature the bear can see ending its movement at least 20 feet further from her than it started, the bear moves up to her speed towards the creature.
If the bear ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

legendary.name: Rear Up
entries: The bear stands upright until the end of her next turn. While standing, the bear has advantage on attacks made with her claws, and ranged attacks against her are made at advantage.

legendary.name: Bluff Charge
entries: The bear moves up to her speed towards a creature. Each creature within 10 feet of where she ends this movement must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed away from her.

legendary.name: Ground Slap (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The bear makes a claw attack. If no creature is in her reach, each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

legendary.name: Endure (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The bear gains resistance to every damage type but Psychic until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the bear must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Rear Up

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Echolocation

action.name: Stonecutter Claws

action.name: Vacuum Tongue Flick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the anteater.
The target gains no benefit from cover or obscurement against this attack, so long as an uninterrupted path exists between it and the anteater.

action.name: Bristled Sweep
entries: The anteater sweeps its tail in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away.

bonus.name: Threatening Pose
entries: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls prone, its speed is reduced to 0.

bonus.name: Suck Up

A creature swallowed in this way takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the anteater's turns.

reaction.name: Clumsy Tumble

reaction.name: Perilous Hug

trait.name: In the Presence of the Queen

action.name: Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

action.name: Queen's Command
entries: Up to two friendly ants within 60 ft. may each move up to 20 ft. and make a melee attack.

action.name: Pheromonic Control (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 15 ft. of the queen must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be charmed by the queen for the next minute.
A charmed creature repeates this saving throw at the end of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Call To Arms (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the queen calls two soldier ants to burrow up from the earth, each appearing in an unoccupied space the queen can see within 60 ft.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The uvuudaum has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The uvuudaum can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 10 foot radius around the uvuudaum is difficult terrain, as the uvuudaum's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Four Dimensional
entries: Time does not seem to pass during the Uvuudaum's turn. It does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and its melee attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The uvuudaum makes three attacks with its head spike.

action.name: Head Spike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage and the target has its Wisdom score reduced by 1d6, to a minimum of 1. If this reduces the target below 10 Wisdom, the target suffers one additional effect of the uvuudaum's choice. The uvuudaum may not choose the same effect twice in a turn:

items.name: Amnesia
entries: The target loses a chunk of memory, reducing its proficiency bonus by 1 for the next minute.

items.name: Anoxia
entries: If the target cast a spell since the end of the uvuudaum's previous turn, it loses the ability to cast that spell until it completes a long rest.

items.name: Apnea
entries: The target forgets how to breathe. At the end of each of its turns, it may make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw, remembering how to breathe on a success.

items.name: Mania
entries: On the target's next turn, it may make one melee attack as a bonus action, but its targets are selected at random from those it can reach with its movement.

items.name: Paranoia
entries: The target becomes frightened of one of its allies until the end of its next turn. While frightened in this way, it cannot willingly accept assistance from that ally.

items.name: Seizure
entries: If the target casts a spell on its following turn, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or fall prone and end its turn.

reaction.name: Ruin Mind
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. hitting it with an attack, the uvuudaum uses its multiattack, targeting the attacker with each attack.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the uvuudaum moves up to half of its speed. If this movement puts the uvuudaum out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the uvuudaum is unaffected.

reaction.name: Psychic Storm
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 hit points, the uvuudaum lets out a telepathic shriek. Each creature within 60 ft. that has a Wisdom score of 1 is stunned until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Adamantine Shell
entries: The spirrax has a shell of pure adamantine that protects it from most harm. If it has fewer than 163 hit points, the spirrax cannot use its fly speed while encased in its shell and attacks against it are made at advantage while encased in its shell. While encased in its shell, the spirrax has the following traits:

items.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The spirrax can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

items.name: Critical Immunity
entries: Any critical hit against the spirax becomes a normal hit.

items.name: Increased AC
entries: The spirrax gains +6 to its AC (included).

items.name: Impenetrable Flank
entries: A creature receives no benefit from flanking the spirrax.

items.name: Constrained
entries: The spirrax makes four fewer attacks with its multiattack.

trait.name: Aura of Indifference
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 ft. of the spirrax must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become indifferent to the spirrax's presence until the beginning of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more retains no memory of the affected period after the spirrax leaves.

trait.name: Implosion
entries: When the spirrax dies, the dimensional gate contained within it implodes. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be sucked in and transported to a random plane. A creature that succeeds on this save may use its reaction to repeat the save to rescue a creature that failed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirrax makes two attacks with its lashing tendrils, or makes six attacks and takes the Dash action if it is out of its shell.

action.name: Lashing Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Instead of grappling a creature, the spirrax may force it to succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the spirax is thrown up to 60 feet and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Void Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature, object or creation of magical force within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 75 (10d6 + 40) force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated.

reaction.name: Foul Emergance (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage while below 163 hit points, the spirax surges out of its shell in a tide of whirling tentacles. As part of this reaction, the spirrax may move up to its speed and use its multiattack. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the spirax's next turn.

trait.name: Slitherer
entries: Outside of a host, the tsochar always counts as prone. It can enter or move through the space of any creature without spending additional movement.

trait.name: Dweomerbarbed Grip
entries: If a creature that it is grappling teleports, the tsochar teleports with it.

trait.name: Mindsight
entries: The tsochar knows the exact location of each creature with an Intelligence score of at least 2 within 120 feet. It has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive anything else.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tsochar makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Leaping Clutch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: The tsochar moves up to 15 ft. toward the target. If it ends this space in the target's space, the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

A creature that starts its turn grappled by the tsochar must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) nonlethal poison damage and be poisoned until the beginning of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Crush
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is restrained until the end of the tsochar's next turn.

action.name: Silence (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The tsochar is surrounded by a 5 ft. radius sphere of silence for the next minute. Creatures inside the sphere are immune to thunder damage and cannot perform the verbal components of spells.

action.name: Greater Invisibility (1/Day, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The tsochar and its host become invisible for the next minute.

action.name: Phantasmal Killer (1/Day, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 ft. that the tsochar can see must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or be frightened for the next minute as it hallucinates an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Memory Slip (1/Day 5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 30 ft.  must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or forget one event that occurred in the last minute. On a success, the creature knows it was targeted with a spell.

action.name: Wear Flesh
entries: One incapacitated humanoid grappled by the tsochar must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the tsochar begin to invade and take control of its body. At the beginning of the tsochar's next turn, the tsochar enters the grappled creature's body, bores into its nerve centers and takes control.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the tsochar may make an Charisma check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the tsochar succeeds automatically.
