action.name: Brutal Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The titanoceratops moves up to twice its speed in a straight line.  It can make one Gore attack against each creature in its path, gaining advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire mortar monkey takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Underfoot
entries: The monkey can take the Dodge or Hide action as a bonus action if it is within 5 feet of at least two Medium or larger hostile creatures, even if it is not obscured.

trait.name: Undersized
entries: While carrying mortar shell or another similarly heavy object, the monkey's speed is reduced by half and it can't take bonus actions.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Mortar Shell Bowl
entries: The monkey rolls a mortar shell it is carrying up to 30 feet. Each creature in the shell's path must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, leaping over the shot on a success.

action.name: Operate Mortar
entries: The monkey interacts with a Monkey Mortar within 5 feet, choosing one of the following options:

items.name: Load Mortar
entries: The monkey loads a mortar shell it is carrying into the Monkey Mortar.

items.name: Adjust Aim
entries: The monkey chooses a direction for the mortar to point, and a number of d6s for the shell to scatter when it fires.

items.name: Light Fuse
entries: The monkey sets a fuse and lights it. At the beginning of the monkey's next turn, the mortar fires.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire gulvoorg takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Baying Pack
entries: A group of two or more worgs has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

trait.name: Predatory Bearing
entries: A creature that starts its turn with no adjacent allies and that can see the gulvoorg must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Crushing Weight
entries: The gulvoorg may enter the space of a prone creature. A prone creature that starts its turn in the gulvoorg's space must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 28 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be unable to stand this turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worg makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (5d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the gulvoorg can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the gulvoorg.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by both the gulvoorg and at least one of the gulvoorg's Large or larger allies must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 87 (16d10 + 7) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire tomb spider takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Tomb Tainted
entries: If the spider would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes three attacks, one of which may be with its tainted bite.

action.name: Tainted Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 5) piercing plus 25 (4d10 + 5) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the spider's next turn.
If a creature poisoned in this way would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hits: 17 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The spider launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by webbing (escape DC 17). The webbing can attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 5).

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The spider uses its webbing to restrain a prone or grappled creature within 5 feet (escape DC 17). If the target is Medium or smaller, the spider may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire tomb spider broodswarm takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The broodswarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the broodswarm can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The broodswarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The broodswarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the broodswarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Tomb Tainted
entries: If the broodswarm would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d6 + 2) piercing, or 8 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has fewer than half its hit points.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: When the broodswarm would make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to 10 feet.
If this movement puts the broodswarm out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the broodswarm is unaffected.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the swarm takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Lie Dormant
entries: The tomb scarab can go an indefinite period of time without food or water, so long as it has somewhere dry and dark to hibernate.

trait.name: Horrid Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Diminutive creature.

A creature whose space the swarm enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.  On a success, the creature may use its reaction to move up to half its speed.

action.name: Tunneling Bites
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have 1d4 scarabs tunnel under its flesh. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 18 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage per scarab infesting it.

Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills these tomb scarabs. After this time, these tomb scarabs can only be extricated with a DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check, dealing 18 (3d10 + 3) points of piercing damage to the afflicted creature as it is removed. Any effect that cures disease destroys all tomb scarabs infesting the target.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire tomb scarab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Lie Dormant
entries: The tomb scarab can go an indefinite period of time without food or water, so long as it has somewhere dry and dark to hibernate.

action.name: Tunneling Bite
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or have the scarab tunnel under its flesh. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 17 (3d10 + 2) piercing damage per scarab infesting it.

Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills the tomb scarab. After this time, the tomb scarab can only be extricated with a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check, dealing 17 (3d10 + 2) points of piercing damage to the afflicted creature as it is removed. Any effect that cures disease destroys all tomb scarabs infesting the target.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire stirge queen takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is invisible to the stirge queen. A creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge queen.

trait.name: Weakness-Seeker
entries: The stirge queen has advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Miasmatic Hemorrhaging
entries: A non-stirge creature that has fewer than half its hit points and starts its turn within 30 feet of the stirge queen must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be bleeding (1d4, Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the stirge queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stirge queen makes two attacks with her Pinning Talons.

action.name: Pinning Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the stirge queen may knock the target prone and grapple it (escape DC 16).

action.name: Blood Spear:
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Plague Blood Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The stirge spews forth a torrent of contaminated blood in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 40 (7d10 + 5) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Redding Ague.

reaction.name: Awaken Their Hunger (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 62 hit points, the stirge queen lets out a frantic hypersonic signal.
Each other stirge within 30 feet that can hear her may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Fend Off
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked prone.

legendary.name: Feed Your Queen
entries: The stirge queen consumes one stirge in her reach that has fed in the last minute, killing it and gaining 14 (4d6) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire stirge skullpiercer takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is invisible to the stirge. A creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The stirge's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

action.name: Pierce Vein
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the stirge becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 14).

action.name: Draw Blood
entries: One creature the stirge is Attached to loses 5 hit points, then must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

action.name: Essence Transfusion (Recharges when the stirge uses its Draw Blood)
entries: The stirge revitalizes itself or a creature it is attached to with stored blood, restoring 24 (4d10 + 4) hit points.

reaction.name: Pierce Skull
entries: As a reaction when a humanoid creature the stirge is Attached to drops to 0 hit points, the stirge repositions itself, piercing the creature's head and gaining control of its body.
An affected creature is not incapacitated while at 0 hit points, and fails death saving throws automatically.
On each of the affected creature's turns, it moves under the stirge's control and takes the Attack action against a target of the stirge's choice.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire stirge harrier takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is invisible to the stirge. A creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The stirge's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creaature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Pierce Vein (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) and the stirge becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 13).

action.name: Draw Blood
entries: One creature the stirge is Attached to loses 2 hit points. Then, if the creature has lost 6 or more hit points in this way this turn, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire sharktopus takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the sharktopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The sharktopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Deception (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

trait.name: Test Bite
entries: If the sharktopus starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may Dash or Disengage as a bonus action this turn.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The sharktopus has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sharktopus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace one attack with a use of its Fling.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or lose 23 (4d8 + 7) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

action.name: Fling
entries: Each creature grappled by the sharktopus is thrown up to 30 feet. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 32 (5d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

action.name: Blanket (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. radius sphere must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 19) and pulled up to 5 ft. toward the sharktopus. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. A creature without a swim speed makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Circle
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 64 hit points, the sharktopus moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. Each creature of its choice within 50 ft. that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 87 hit points while underwater, the sharktopus exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the sharktopus can use the Dash or Hide action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire windclaw owlbear takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Bad Flier
entries: The owlbear falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the owlbear must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes three attacks, one of which may be with its beak. A medium or smaller creature hit with two claw attacks in a turn is knocked prone.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 28 (3d12 + 7) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Windclaws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 7) slashing and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Meteor Drop (Recharge 5-6)
entries: While flying, the owlbear folds its wings and drops, taking 32 (5d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Each creature within 5 ft. of where it landed must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 63 (8d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire malukant takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the malukant may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 21 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the malukant's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the malukant's legs to its back, or from its back to its head.

items.name: Legs
entries: While climbing on the malukant's legs, a creature has advantage on attacks against it. If the malukant moves at least 20 ft. on its turn, each creature climbing on its legs must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or fall off.

items.name: Back
entries: While climbing on the malukant's back, the malukant cannot target the creature with melee attacks.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the malukant's head, the creature has advantage on melee attacks against the malukant and the malukant cannot target the creature with melee attacks.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: The malukant may move through the space of a Huge or smaller creature without penalty. When the elephant enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Howdah
entries: The malukant carries a mobile fortress on its back. Up to eight Medium or smaller creatures can ride the malukant. Creatures riding the malukant have three-quarters cover against attacks made from the ground.

trait.name: Spear Maddened
entries: Weapon attacks against the malukant with the Reach property are made at advantage. Whenever the malukant takes damage from a spear, glaive, pike, or similar long, bladed weapon, it must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the malukant attacks the nearest creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The malukant makes two attacks; one with its bladed tusks and one with its stomp.

action.name: Bladed Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 43 (7d10 + 8) slashing damage and the target is pushed 15 ft. away and knocked prone.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., target. Hit: 38 (5d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 43 (5d12 + 8) damage to a prone creature.

A creature that succeeds by 5 or more takes no damage and can climb onto the malukant's head as a reaction.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 136 HP, the malukant thrashes. Each creature riding or climbing on it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 38 (6d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage and fall prone in an unoccupied space adjacent to the malukant.

action.name: Disarming Lick

reaction.name: Spell Turning

It may emerge from its disguise as a Bonus Action on its turn.

While it has a target grappled in this way, the ankheg's speed is 0 and whenever it takes damage, the grappled creature takes an equal amount of slashing damage.

action.name: Terrifying Chatter
entries: The ankheg cheefully speaks an incomprehensible stream of inane and nonsensical chatter. Each creature that is concentrating on a spell that can hear it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or lose concentration.

reaction.name: Punishing Barbs

action.name: Tail

trait.name: Dire Rage

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The therazinosaurus makes two attacks: one with its rending claws and one with its stomp. It may replace its rending claws with a use of its scything sweep, if available.

action.name: Rending Claws

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 29 (3d12 + 8) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Scything Sweep (Recharge 5-6)

reaction.name: Impale

reaction.name: Puff Up

If the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, it may instead make two attacks with its Earthgouge Claws.

On a hit or miss, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

action.name: Stonecutter Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 6) slashing damage.
This attack is made at disadvantage against any creature not grappled by the anteater.

action.name: Vacuum Tongue Flick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the anteater.
The target gains no benefit from cover or obscurement against this attack, so long as an uninterrupted path exists between it and the anteater.

action.name: Bristled Sweep
entries: The anteater sweeps its tail in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 36 (6d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away.

bonus.name: Threatening Pose
entries: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls prone, its speed is reduced to 0.

bonus.name: Suck Up
entries: Each Small or smaller creature within 10 feet of the anteater that it hit with its Vacuum Tongue Flick this turn must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 17).
A creature swallowed in this way takes 24 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the anteater's turns.

reaction.name: Clumsy Tumble
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls prone.

reaction.name: Perilous Hug
entries: As a reaction when a creature makes a melee attack against the anteater while the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, the anteater forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Pheromonic Control (Recharge 5-6)

A charmed creature repeates this saving throw at the end of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Call To Arms (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the queen calls two soldier ants to burrow up from the earth, each appearing in an unoccupied space the queen can see within 60 ft.

entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

action.name: Defensive Posture
entries: The spider rears up in a defensive posture. Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that attempts to enter its space must first make a DC 6 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is Frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Urticating Hairs (1/Day)
entries: The spider scrapes off some of its barbed bristles and flings them toward a creature within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or be Blinded for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn) or until it takes an action to clear its eyes.

reaction.name: Crushed Vengeance
entries: When the spider is reduced to 0 hit points by a melee attack, it can make a Bite attack with advantage against the attacker.

trait.name: Retract Head
entries: As a Bonus Action, the kyoka may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the beginning of its next turn, the kyoka's AC is increased to 19 and it can't take reactions.

trait.name: Laborious Rocking
entries: When the kyoka attempts to stand from prone, it must make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check in addition to spending half its movement, remaining prone on a failure.

action.name: Jagged Snap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d12 + 4) piercing damage.

If the target is wielding a nonmagical weapon made of wood or other organic material, instead of dealing damage the kyoka may bite the weapon, giving it a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to hit as the kyoka bites part of it off.

action.name: Push Onward
entries: Until the end of its turn, the kyoka may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. A creature whose space the kyoka enters is pushed to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet.

action.name: Obstinate Plant
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, the kyoka gains advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and a Gargantuan creature that attempts to move through its space must succeed on DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. 0 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target wielding a weapon made of wood or other organic material. Hit:The kyoka attaches to the weapon.

While attached, attacks with the weapon are made at disadvantage and the kyoka is dragged with the weapon until it releases its bite as a Bonus Action. A creature may attempt to remove the kyoka as an action with a DC 8 Strength (Athletics) check.

action.name: Obstinate Plant

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the servitor can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 feet.

trait.name: Drifting Hazard
entries: Whenever the servitor takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.
A creature that the servitor is pushed into must immediately save against its Stinging Tendrils.

action.name: Stinging Tendrils
entries: The jellyfish brushes its tendrils against a creature within 5 feet, discharging hundreds of microscopic, venom-coated needles into it.
The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage. A creature that fails by 5 or more is paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Resonance Bell
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet of the servitor makes a saving throw against a lemurian's song, the servitor amplifies the song, forcing the creature to subtract 1d4 from its rolled result.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the servitor can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 feet.

trait.name: Pinch
entries: When the servitor takes the Help action to grant an attack advantage against a target within 5 feet that is Concentrating, the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

action.name: Graspers
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:The servitor attaches itself to the target (remove DC 11).
A creature's swim speed is reduced by 5 for each servitor attached to it.

action.name: Echo Cannon
entries: If it is submerged in water, the servitor sends a brief pressure wave forth. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the servitor moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the servitor out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the servitor is unaffected.

name: Gravedigger Minion
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The gravedigger can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the gravedigger with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Shovel Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned.

action.name: Gravebreaker Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the armor bonus provided by any nonmagical shield the creature is wielding is reduced by 1.

action.name: Leaping Strike (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The gravedigger leaps up to 20 feet and makes an attack at advantage. If the attack misses, the gravedigger falls prone and ends its turn.

reaction.name: Stay Down
entries: As a reaction when a creature with 0 hit points regains hit points within 5 feet of the gravedigger, the gravedigger makes a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Creeping Refuse
entries: Ranged attacks made against the sporocyte from more than 15 feet away are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The sporocyte can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Stinging Spines
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Membranous Expansion
entries: The sporocyte fills its internal air sacks, inflating itself and regaining the use of its Spore Gout.
The next attack made against the detrivore before the beginning of its next turn is made at advantage.

reaction.name: Sudden Drop
entries: As a reaction when a creature passes directly beneath the sporocyte, the sporocyte falls from the surface it was climbing on, and the creature must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the sporocyte grapples the creature (escape DC 11) and takes no fall damage. On a success, the creature moves into the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Spore Gout (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 foot cone.
Each nonplant creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be infected with burrow-diver mycosis.

trait.name: Greater Spore Host
entries: When the behemoth dies, 2d4 + 1 Spore Globes that act on initiative count 0 emerge from its wounds.

trait.name: Creature of the Dark
entries: Attacks that deal acid, fire or radiant damage are made at advantage against the behemoth.

If the behemoth takes 10 or more acid, fire, or radiant damage from a single source, a hole is burned in it. Until it completes a long rest, a creature engulfed by the behemoth may escape it as an action with a successful DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the behemoth may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behemoth. While climbing on the behemoth, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the behemoth, and the behemoth has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the behemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The behemoth makes two attacks with its Stalk Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Engulf, and uses its Spore Breath, if available.

action.name: Stalk Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The behemoth engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it.
While engulfed, the creature is blinded, restrained, its attacks bypass the behemoth's damage resistances, and it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of the behemoth's turns.

action.name: Spore Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The behemoth releases a spray of toxic spores in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and be infected with burrow-diver mycosis, or take half as much damage on success.

legendary.name: Roil
entries: A tidal wave of thrashing mycelia spill out from the behemoth in a 20 foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

legendary.name: Burgeoning
entries: The Behemoth rapidly buds and splits off 1d4 + 1 spore globes, which appear in its space and may each immediately move up to 10 feet.

legendary.name: Dream of the Azure Abyss
entries: One creature infected with burrow-diver mycosis that the behemoth can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to its speed directly toward the behemoth, then fall prone.

trait.name: Spore Host
entries: When the spore servant dies, 1d4 - 1 Spore Globes that act on initiative count 0 emerge from its wounds.

trait.name: Sudden Lunge
entries: The spore servant's attacks have a reach of 10 feet for the purposes of making opportunity attacks.
When it makes an attack of opportunity against a creature more than 5 feet away, the spore servant moves 5 feet towards its target as part of the attack.

action.name: Shambling Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

action.name: Death Grip
entries: The spore servant dies, and one creature grappled by it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 12) as fungal shoots burst from the spore servant's body.
A creature restrained in this way takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the end of each of its turns.

trait.name: Struggling Flight
entries: The chicken falls 10 feet at the end of each of its turns if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its fly speed.

trait.name: Ephemeral Head
entries: If the chicken takes 5 or more slashing damage from a single source, its head turns to mist and disperses until the start of its next turn. The chicken must immediately use its reaction to move its full speed in a random direction or until it hits a solid object.
While its head is missing, the chicken is blinded and it can't use its Floaty Peck action.

action.name: Floaty Peck
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be levitated 10 feet into the air until the end of its next turn.
An affected creature can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing.

action.name: Lay Egg (1/Day)
entries: With a mighty squawk, the chicken abruptly lays a cloud egg. One creature directly beneath the chicken must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the chicken's next turn.
If the egg falls more than 5 feet and no creature fails this saving throw, the egg breaks.

bonus.name: Cloud Bath (1/Day)
entries: The chicken ruffles its feathers and shakes vigorously, absorbing air and moisture from its surroundings until it becomes nearly spherical.

The chicken gains 11 temporary hit points and its head is restored if it was missing. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the chicken has resistance to bludgeoning and slashing damage, and cannot use its fly speed.

trait.name: Stiffening Foam
entries: Whenever the egg takes bludgeoning damage, its speed is reduced by 5 feet for the next minute.
If the egg's speed is reduced to 0 in this way, the devilish spirit possessing it is exorcised and it transforms into an ordinary egg.

trait.name: Devilish Intolerance
entries: The egg cannot voluntarily cross a line of salt.
If a creature uses its bonus action to cast salt on the egg, the egg subtracts 1d4 from the first saving throw it makes before the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Sloshing Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the egg is pushed 10 feet directly away from the target.

action.name: Egg Wash
entries: The egg flings a translucent glob at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage and be encased in a glossy bubble.
For the next minute, ranged attacks made by or against the encased creature are at disadvantage. The bubble pops if the creature takes or deals any damage, ending the effect.

trait.name: Bouncy
entries: If the worker would take any fall damage, it instead takes half as much, and may jump up to 20 feet at the start of its next turn as a bonus action.

trait.name: Acidic Immune System
entries: The worker has advantage on saving throws to resist being poisoned or infected with a disease.

action.name: Makeshift Weapon
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Gummy Unity
entries: The worker touches a gummybear within 5 feet that was reduced to 0 hit points since the end of the worker's last turn, briefly sticking to and melding with it. The worker loses 5 hit points, and the target regains 1 hit point.

bonus.name: Sour Cloud (1/Day)
entries: The worker emits prickly sour particles in a 10-foot-radius.
Each other creature in the area that needs to breathe must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Featureless Anatomy (1/Day)
entries: When a creature it can see hits the worker with a critical hit, the worker can change it into a normal hit, then fall prone.

name: Marshmallow Golem
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Puffed-Up Expansion
entries: If the golem takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it expands, becoming size Large until the end of its next turn.
While it is enlarged in this way, the golem's melee attacks are made at advantage and deal an additional die of damage, and the golem has vulnerability to fire damage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects that target only it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks with its Pillowy Fist.

action.name: Pillowy Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:The target is pushed 10 feet away, then takes 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage if it is pushed into a solid object or if the target was grappled.
A Medium or smaller creature the target is pushed into is pushed 5 feet away.

reaction.name: Marshmallow Glop
entries: When the golem takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it flings a spray of molten globules in a 15 foot cone.

The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be grappled in place (escape DC 14)

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Soluble Form
entries: If the ooze is doused in at least one gallon of water, it takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns until a creature brushes the water off as an action.

trait.name: Shard Resorption
entries: If the ooze takes 10 or more bludgeoning or thunder damage, a shard (16 AC; 5 hit points; immunity to poison damage) of it breaks off and lands in an unoccupied space of the attacker's choice within 10 feet of the ooze.
When the ooze enters a space that contains one of these shards, it regains 10 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two attacks with its Sugar-Gem Slam.

action.name: Sugar-Gem Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).

action.name: Crystal Stasis
entries: One creature grappled by the ooze must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 13) as the ooze moves into its space and begins to engulf it.

A creature that starts its turn restrained in this must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be engulfed and petrified for as long as it remains restrained. A creature petrified in this way has total cover against outside effects.

action.name: Candy-Coated Control
entries: One creature petrified by the ooze's Crystal Stasis moves up to its speed and takes an action under the ooze's control.

trait.name: Bouncy
entries: If the owlbear would take any fall damage, it instead takes half as much, and may jump up to 20 feet at the start of its next turn as a bonus action.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked prone by the owlbear must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak.

action.name: Gummy Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
This attack does an additional 4 (1d8) damage to a prone creature.

action.name: Gummy Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
A creature that takes 10 or more damage from this attack is knocked prone.

reaction.name: Rippling Jiggle
entries: When the owlbear takes any bludgeoning damage, it can force one creature within 5 feet of it to make a DC 13 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the owlbear gains resistance to the triggering damage, and the target takes an equal amount of bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Caramel Weird
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Ignan and Terran but doesn't speak

trait.name: Invisible in Caramel
entries: The caramel weird is invisible while fully immersed in caramel.

trait.name: Rising Heat
entries: If the caramel weird takes any fire damage, it boils and darkens.
For the next minute, the caramel weird cannot benefit from invisibility and its melee attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Molten Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 13).
If the caramel weird takes any cold damage, this tendril freezes and shatters, releasing any creature grappled by it.

action.name: Scald Skin (Recharge 6)
entries: One creature grappled by the weird must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Sticky Seal
entries: When a creature the caramel weird can see within 15 feet begins to cast a spell, it sloshes a gob of sticky sugar into the creature's mouth.

For the next minute, whenever the target casts a spell it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to 10 + the spell's level or have the spell fail. On a successful saving throw, the effect ends.

name: Ogre Zombie Fleshsiege
languages: understands Common and Jogishk but can't speak

trait.name: Gatebreaker
entries: The zombie deals double damage to objects and structures.
If it reduces a Medium or larger object to 0 hit points, each creature in a 15 foot cone extending from the object takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage from shrapnel.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the zombie starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, unless it was dealt radiant damage or a critical hit since the end of its last turn. On a success, the zombie regains 1 hit point. .

action.name: Manthresher Morningstar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the target is pushed 10 feet away, knocked prone, and cannot stand for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn.)

action.name: Crushing Stomp
entries: One prone creature within 5 feet of the ogre must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 14) until the ogre moves.

A creature wearing metal armor that fails this saving throw has its armor deform. Until it doffs its armor, the creature is choking and may use a Bonus Action to ignore this effect until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Stumbling Sweep
entries: As a reaction when the zombie misses with a melee attack, it may make a second attack at disadvantage against another target in its reach. If the second attack misses, the zombie falls prone.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage from a single source, it loses a head. If none of this damage was bludgeoning damage, a Squirming Skull that acts on the hydra's turn appears in the nearest unoccupied space to it.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The head can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it can't see.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many Snapping Skull attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Snapping Skull
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).
The hydra cannot use this attack if it has no heads.

action.name: Skeletal Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the hydra's next turn.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature grappled by at least two of the hydra's heads must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution throw or take 55 (10d10) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature makes this save with disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more heads.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skull can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it can't see.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Squirming Snap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 piercing damage.

action.name: Reattach
entries: The skull attaches itself to a hydra within 5 feet of it, becoming one of the hydra's heads. The hydra regains 15 hit points and must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the angler remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a clump of kelp.

trait.name: Lodewarp Aura
entries: The angler distorts magnetic fields in a 500 foot radius around it, imposing disadvantage on any checks made to navigate using a compass and on Ranged Weapon Attacks that use metal projectiles in the area.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angler makes three attacks with its Dredge Fronds.

action.name: Dredge Fronds
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pulled into the angler's space.
A creature in the angler's space moves with it, and may spend 15 feet of movement and take 7 (2d6) poison damage to push its way out, escaping into the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Holdfast Latch
entries: The angler anchors itself to a vehicle within 5 feet of it, becoming Attached to it (remove DC 17). While the angler is attached to it, a vehicle cannot move more than 10 feet in a turn.

bonus.name: Inflate Bladders
entries: The angler briefly inflates the spined pneumatocysts lining its fronds, immediately rising up to 20 feet towards the water's surface if it is submerged.

Each creature in its space must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison damage and be restrained (escape DC 17) until the beginning of the angler's next turn.
If the angler is Attached to a vehicle, it lists wildly, pushing each unsecured creature and object up to 15 feet towards the vehicle's edge.

bonus.name: Explosive Regrowth (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The angler grows several new fronds, regaining 30 hit points.

reaction.name: Still Seas (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the angler would make a saving throw against a wave, current, or similar aquatic phenomenon, the angler magically disperses the effect, rendering it harmless.

reaction.name: Scatter Magic (4th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the angler would make a saving throw against a spell that targets only it, the angler causes the spell to additionally target each creature within 10 feet of it.
The spell's Save DC is reduced by 1 for each additional creature the spell targets in this way.

trait.name: Chill Dormancy
entries: If the basidirond would take any cold damage, it instead takes no damage and falls unconscious until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basidirond makes three attacks with its Bore-Stem Spike, one of which it may replace with a use of its Cap Slam.

action.name: Bore-Stem Spike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.
A prone target takes an additional 5 (1d10) piercing damage and is restrained (escape DC 16) until the basidirond moves.

action.name: Cap Slam
entries: The basidirond lurches forward, slamming its cap into a creature within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Absorb Vitality
entries: One creature restrained by the basidirond's Boring Stems must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or lose 5 (2d4) unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.  The basidirond regains 5 hit points for each hit die lost in this way.

reaction.name: Stranglespore Gout (Recharge 5-6)
entries: When the basidirond uses its Cap Slam, it can scatter sooty black spores in a 30 foot cone extending from the target.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the basidirond's next turn.

trait.name: Chill Dormancy
entries: If the basidirond would take any cold damage, it instead takes no damage and falls unconscious until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Phantasmagoric Spores
entries: A nonplant creature that consumes the basidirond's spores must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be infected with fungal phantasmagoria until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basidirond makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Teetering Cap-Butt
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
On a miss, the basidirond falls prone and ends its turn.

action.name: Needling Stems
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and the basidirond becomes Attached to the target.

action.name: Digestive Drain
entries: One creature the basidirond is Attached to loses 5 hit points and the basidirond gains 5 temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Stranglespore Puff (1/Day)
entries: When the basidirond makes an attack with its Cap Slam, it can release a puff of sooty black spores.
The attack's target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the basidirond's next turn.

trait.name: Rolling Trample
entries: If the ascomoid first moves at least 10 feet directly towards a Large or smaller creature, it may enter that creature's space.

A creature whose space the ascomoid enters must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

trait.name: Fungal Pores
entries: As an action, a creature within 5 feet may attempt to insert a potion, poison, or alchemical solution into one of the ascomoid's pores with a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check.
On a success, the ascomoid immediately suffers the item's effects, automatically failing any saving throws against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ascomoid uses its spore jet three times, one of which it may replace with a use of its Feeding Tendrils.

action.name: Feeding Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and the ascomoid gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

action.name: Spore Jet
entries: The ascomoid fires a jet of caustic spores in a 20 foot line that is 5 feet wide, pushing itself up to 10 feet in the opposite direction.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Shed Layer (1/Day)
entries: The first time the ascomoid is reduced below 86 hit points, it may shed its outer layers, transforming into an Ascomoid Wanderstone with full hit points and ending each condition affecting it.

trait.name: Rolling Trample
entries: If the ascomoid first moves at least 10 feet directly towards a Medium or smaller creature, it may enter that creature's space.

A creature whose space the ascomoid enters must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

On a success, the ascomoid immediately suffers the item's effects, automatically failing any saving throws against it.

action.name: Feeding Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and the ascomoid gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

action.name: Spore Jet
entries: The ascomoid fires a jet of caustic spores in a 10 foot line that is 5 feet wide, pushing itself up to 10 feet in the opposite direction.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Fungal Pores
entries: As an action, a creature within 5 feet may attempt to insert a potion, poison, or alchemical solution into one of the ascomoid's pores with a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check.
On a success, the ascomoid immediately suffers the item's effects, automatically failing any saving throws against it.

action.name: Feeding Tendrils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one prone target. Hit: 4 (1d8) necrotic damage and the ascomoid gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

action.name: Spore Jet
entries: The ascomoid fires a jet of caustic spores at a creature or object within 5 feet of it, pushing itself up to 5 feet in the opposite direction.
The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Startled Burst
entries: When the ascomoid is targeted with a melee attack while it has any Temporary Hit Points, it may lose any Temporary Hit Points it has and use its Spore Jet.
If this movement takes it out of the attacker's reach, the attack misses the ascomoid.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature or object's space and vice versa.

trait.name: Bloodsight
entries: A creature that has all of its hit points may attempt to hide from the swarm without obscurement.

action.name: Bloating Drain
entries: One creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or lose 10 (4d4) hit points, or half as much on a success.
If the target loses 11 or more hit points in this way, it loses an unexpended hit die, and the swarm loses 5 hit points as some of the bloodbloaters burst from consuming too much blood.

reaction.name: Amorphous Invasion
entries: As a reaction when a creature leaves its space, the swarm forces the creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or have the swarm slither into its clothing and armor.
Until a creature removes the swarm as an Action with a successful DC 13 Strength check, the swarm moves with the target and has 3/4 cover against all attacks.

trait.name: Strength from Sickness
entries: While it is poisoned, the exarch's attacks have advantage instead of disadvantage.

trait.name: Rot-Carrier
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw by 5 or more against an effect the exarch controls cannot benefit from resistance or immunity to poison damage or from immunity to the poisoned condition for the next hour.

trait.name: Aura of Delirium
entries: A poisoned creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the exarch must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed in a direction of the exarch's choice.

trait.name: Wretched Resilience (3/Day)
entries: If the exarch fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, the exarch loses any remaining legendary actions, is poisoned until the end of its next turn, and falls prone as it retches up the wasted magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes three attacks with its Cultivator's Touch, each of which it may replace with a use of its Spore Wind, and uses its Sprouting Doom, Pallid Rooting or Filth Harvest, if available.

action.name: Cultivator's Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) poison damage.
A poisoned creature hit with this attack becomes paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Spore Wind
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 19 (3d12) poison damage and be poisoned until the end of the exarch's next turn.

action.name: Sprouting Doom (3rd Level Spell)
entries: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5 foot radius centered on a point the exarch can see within 120 feet.

The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

action.name: Pallid Rooting (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

Whenever a creature poisoned in this way fails a saving throw to end the effect at the end of its turn, it takes 21 (6d6) piercing damage and is restrained (escape DC 19) until the end of its next turn on a failure.

action.name: Filth Harvest (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 30 feet that is paralyzed poisoned, or infected with a disease must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) necrotic damage.
The exarch gains temporary hit points equal to the half the damage dealt.

reaction.name: Inexorable Growths
entries: When a creature the exarch can see within 120 feet dies, it can use its Sprouting Doom, targeting an area centered on the creature.

reaction.name: Endurance of the Mother's Faithful (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: When the exarch is reduced below 191 hit points, it releases a burst of reanimating spores in a 30 foot radius from each area created by its Sprouting Doom.
Each creature in one or more of these areas that died in the last minute is restored to life with 15 hit points and is poisoned for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Cultivator's Touch
entries: The exarch makes an attack with its Cultivator's Touch

legendary.name: Sporeflight
entries: The exarch transforms into a cloud of spores and moves up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

It can move through the spaces of other creatures with this movement, and each creature the exarch moves through must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Growing Hunger
entries: The exarch chooses a creature it can see within 120 feet.
Up to two plant or undead creatures within 30 feet of it may each use their reaction to move up to its speed toward that creature or make a melee attack against it.

name: Cult Fanatic of the Rot Mother

trait.name: Strength from Sickness
entries: While it is poisoned, the fanatic's attacks have advantage instead of disadvantage.

action.name: Spore Censer Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
On a hit or miss, the target takes 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Corrupted Cleansing
entries: One creature the fanatic can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to consume the most toxic substance it can reach.

bonus.name: Draught of Blooming Life
entries: The fanatic administers a fetid concoction to a willing, restrained or incapacitated creature within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

entries: Mycelia tendrils snake from the fanatic to drain the vitality from a corpse or creature with 0 hit points within 5 feet.

The fanatic gains 9 (2d8) temporary hit points, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fail two death saving throws, or one on a success. A corpse targeted with this ability desiccates to dust.

action.name: Belly-Tiller Sickle (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 slashing damage plus 2 poison damage.
If three or more cultists contributed to this attack, the target subtracts 1d4 from Constitution saving throws it makes until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Fecund Embrace (1/Day)
entries: The cultist begins to rapidly swell and distend, fungal growths emerging from its flesh.

If the cultist is alive at the end of its next turn, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 10 feet of it takes 5 poison damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Ascended Flesh (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the exarch is reduced to 0 hit points, up to four ghouls within 20 feet of it may move up to 15 feet toward it and take a bite of its flesh, then each ghoul that did so transforms into an Abyssal Ghoul with full hit points.
At the beginning of the exarch's next turn it returns to life with 180 hit points, its creature type becomes undead, and it gains vulnerability to radiant damage.

trait.name: Ward of the White Kingdom
entries: The exarch adds 1 to its AC for each undead creature under its control within 5 feet.
Whenever an attack misses the exarch, the attacker may choose for the attack to instead target an undead creature in its reach.

trait.name: Eternal Tide
entries: At the beginning of the exarch's turn, it can return 2d4 ghouls or ghasts within 60 feet that died since the end of the exarch's last turn to undeath with 1 hit point.

entries: If the exarch fails a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead creature it controls to succeed instead, reducing the creature to 0 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes 3 attacks with its Death's Beckon, one of which it may replace with a use of its Breath of Thanatos or Drown in Blood.

action.name: Death's Beckon (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +12 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

If this damage reduces a humanoid target to 0 hit points, a rift appears in the earth beneath it, disgorging a Horde Ghoul in the nearest unoccupied space that acts on the exarch's initiative and under its control.

action.name: Breath of Thanatos (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The ground beneath a creature the exarch can see within 60 feet cracks, spewing forth a hissing jet of putrid fumes.
The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) necrotic plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, or take half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage is dragged through a planar rift to Thanatos.

action.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and begin Choking as blood wells up in its mouth and lungs (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Doomed Sleep of Moil (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute.

While asleep in this way, the creature takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, and may repeat this saving throw whenever it takes damage or when a creature attempts to wake it as an action, ending the effect on a success.
A creature illuminated by Bright Light has advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Curse of Living Bones (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the exarch can see must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed.

A creature Cursed in this way has its skeleton animated within it, and must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw at the start of each of its turns or have its movement controlled by its skeleton until the beginning of its next turn.
If the creature dies while cursed in this way, a skeletal liberator tears free of its flesh at the beginning of its next turn.

entries: The reigar does not roll initiative. Instead, it may take its turn directly after any other creature's turn. It regains the ability to do this at initiative count 0 each round.

trait.name: Shift Perspective (Concentration)
entries: As a Bonus Action, the reigar twists reality around a creature it can see within 60 feet, maintaining the creature's appearance while altering its reality to produce one of the following effects:

items.name: Background
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away from the reigar and increase in size by one category until it ends its turn within 30 feet of the reigar. Attacks made by a creature enlarged in this way deal an additional 1d8 damage.

items.name: Foreground
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 30 feet toward the reigar and decrease in size by one category until it ends its turn more than 30 feet from the reigar. Attacks made by a creature reduced in this way deal half as much damage.

Each of the creatures must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) damage, divided equally between any two damage types of the reigar's choice (round down), or take half as much damage on a success.

When a creature attempts to exit the line's area for the first time on a turn, the reigar may teleport it to any unoccupied space within the line, or within any Transversal Beam contiguous with the line. An unwilling creature may make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or learning one secret or weakness of the reigar's on a failure. A creature that learns one or more secrets or weaknesses in this way has advantage on attacks made against the reigar.

action.name: Reflect the Real

reaction.name: Aesthetic Iteration (1/Day, 4th Level Spell)

If the spell deals damage, the reigar may change the damage type to a type of its choice. If the spell requires a saving throw, the reigar may change it to require a different saving throw of its choice.
