action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lakshu makes three attacks with its Ceremonial Blade.

action.name: Ceremonial Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Laser Vision (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lakshu emits a searing beam of light from its eyes in a 60 foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 77 (14d10) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Tandem Battleform (1/Day)
entries: The lakshu and at least three other lakshu with active shaktis within 15 feet fuse together for the next minute, granting the lakshu the following effects for the duration:
The lakshu's attacks have a reach of 15 feet, are made at advantage, and deal an additional 18 (4d8) force damage for each other lakshu fused with it.
The lakshu gains both effects of its shakti.
The lakshu and each lakshu fused with it share a pool of hit points, which is divided evenly between them when the effect ends.
When this effect ends, each fused lakshu appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the lakshu.

trait.name: Engineered Synchronicity
entries: The lakshu acts on initiative count 20, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

trait.name: Blade-Dancer's Focus
entries: On its turn, the Lakshu has resistance to all damage and can't be knocked prone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lakshu makes three attacks with its Ceremonial Blade.

action.name: Ceremonial Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Balanced Carnage (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Whenever the Lakshu moves at least 5 feet this turn, it may make a melee attack against a creature it has not yet targeted this turn with an attack.

reaction.name: Restore Order
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the lakshu begins concentrating on a spell, the lakshu can move up to half its speed towards that creature and make an attack against it.

reaction.name: Grab Blade
entries: When the lakshu is hit with a melee weapon attack, it can take an additional 4 (1d8) damage of the attack's type and force the attacker to make a DC 17 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the Lakshu grabs the weapon, and the creature is grappled (escape DC 17) and can't make attacks with that weapon until it escapes or relinquishes the weapon.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: While the hobgoblin is within 5 feet of at least two allied creatures, the first attack it hits a creature with each turn deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

trait.name: Coordinated Advance
entries: The hobgoblin acts on initiative count 10, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

trait.name: Shield Bearer
entries: The Phalangite grants half cover to friendly creatures within 5 feet of it that don't have this trait.

action.name: Longspear
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. This attack can't target a creature within 5 feet.

action.name: Shield Wall Shove
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the hobgoblin must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away.
A creature makes this save at disadvantage if the hobgoblin is within 5 feet of at least two of the hobgoblin's allies.

reaction.name: Brace
entries: When a creature enters its reach, the phalangite can force the creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or have its movement reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Coordinated Advance
entries: The hobgoblin acts on initiative count 10, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

action.name: Threshing Flails (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Saturation Volley (Group Attack)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is frightened, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

trait.name: Generous Host
entries: A creature that has eaten any of the halfling's cooking in the last hour has disadvantage on attacks that target it.

trait.name: Buzgut
entries: If the halfling would gain temporary hit points while it has existing temporary hit points, it gains additional temporary hit points equal to its previous total.
The halfling cannot gain more than 25 temporary hit points in this way.

trait.name: Well-Fed Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the halfling fails a saving throw while it has at least 10 temporary hit points, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, it loses half of its temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes two attacks with its Stew-Paddle Whop, each of which it may replace with a use of its Battlefeast.

action.name: Stew-Paddle Whop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Battlefeast
entries: The halfling feeds a bite of food to a willing creature within 5 feet, granting it 10 temporary hit points.
While the creature has any of these temporary hit points, it gains one effect of the halfling's choice.

items.name: Dodgy Jammer
entries: The creature's AC is increased by 2.

items.name: Meaty Hoggan
entries: The creature's melee attacks deal an additional die of damage.

items.name: Gazy Pie
entries: The creature may attempt to detect hidden creatures as a bonus action.

items.name: Revel Bun
entries: The creature regains its reaction at the beginning of each other creature's turn.

action.name: Gruzzling Gust (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The halfling fans forth a delicious breeze in a 30 foot cone, stoking the appetites of all who can smell it.
Each creature in the area with any temporary hit points may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

Each creature in the area without any temporary hit points must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage and deal half as much damage with attacks that use Strength until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Try This
entries: When a creature misses the halfling with a melee attack, the halfling can use its Battlefeast, targeting the attacker.

reaction.name: Lucky Break.
entries: When the halfling fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, it may roll one additional die, taking the second result.
If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

legendary.name: Whop
entries: The halfling makes an attack with its Stew-Paddle Whop.

legendary.name: Eat Up
entries: The halfling moves up to 10 feet and uses its Battlefeast.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is frightened, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

trait.name: Sneakthief's Prowl
entries: The halfling can treat any Medium or larger creature as half cover, and can hide without obscurement from creatures within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes three attacks with its Shearblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Boldfaced Sneakery.

action.name: Shearblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins bleeding (1d4, Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Leadkiss Sling
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Boldfaced Sneakery
entries: The halfling takes the Hide action, then up to one creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check or have the halfling take one item it is carrying but not wielding.
If the item requires attunement, the halfling may immediately attune to it.

reaction.name: Shadowed Steps
entries: When a Medium or larger creature within 5 feet of the halfling that the halfling is hidden from moves, the halfling may mirror its movements until the end of the turn.
The halfling may not move more than its speed in this way.

reaction.name: Lucky Break.
entries: When the halfling fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, it may roll one additional die, taking the second result.
If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is frightened, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes two attacks with its Smoke Ring.

action.name: Smoke Ring
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage.
This attack has disadvantage while the halfling is outdoors.

action.name: Shared Fortune (2nd level spell, Concentration)
entries: The halfling chooses one friendly creature and one hostile creature it can see, blessing each of them with good luck.
For the next minute, attacks that target one of those creatures always miss on a roll of  1-10.

action.name: Stoke Feud (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Two creatures the halfling can see within 60 feet must each succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or treat the other as hostile for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
A creature that succeeds on this saving throw may end the effect on the other creature as an action.

action.name: Belch Smoke (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The halfling belches a cloud of smoke in the face of a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded and poisoned until the end of the halfling's next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more enters an uncontrollable coughing fit and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Lucky Break

If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is frightened, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

trait.name: Provincial Guard
entries: While it is within 10 miles of its birthplace, the halfling's attacks against creatures not born in the area have advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes two attacks with its Buldrystave, one of which it may replace with a use of its Stubborn Disbelief.

action.name: Buldrystave
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target takes an additional 4 (1d8) thunder damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Scrappy Scowl
entries: The halfling hunkers down, adopting a practiced scowl.
Until the end of its next turn, the halfling's movement speed is reduced to 0, and it may make an attack with its Buldrystave against any creature that enters its reach for the first time on a turn.

action.name: Stubborn Disbelief (Concentration)
entries: The halfling treats one creature or object it can see as invisible for the next minute.
While concentrating on this ability, the halfling cannot be charmed or frightened by the target, and gains immunity to psychic damage dealt by the target.

entries: While it is frightened, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes three attacks with its Pummel, one of which it may replace with a use of its Plucky Rummage or Kneecap Lunge, if available.

action.name: Pummel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and attacks the halfling makes against the target have advantage until the end of the turn.

action.name: Plucky Rummage
entries: One prone creature within 5 feet of the halfling must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have the halfling take one item it is carrying but not wielding.
Until the end of its next turn, the halfling may use the item as though it were attuned to it.

action.name: Kneecap Lunge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One size Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of the halfling must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw, with disadvantage if the target is size Medium.
On a failure, the target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone, and the halfling falls prone in the creature's space.

reaction.name: Lucky Break
entries: When the halfling fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, it may roll one additional die, taking the second result.
If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

entries: While it is frightened, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

action.name: Shepherd's Sling (Group Attack)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 piercing damage.
If three or more halflings contributed to this attack, the target cannot take reactions this turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The scion can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the scion gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again.

items.name: Customary Guise (Concentration)
entries: The scion transforms into a semblance of its pre-transformation humanoid appearance. This ability ends early if it makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash, or uses its Flare Mouth.

items.name: Electroacuity
entries: Living creatures within 20 feet of the scion cannot be hidden from it, and creatures submerged in the same water as the scion have disadvantage on attacks that target it.

items.name: Call of the Deep
entries: Whenever the scion hits a creature that is holding its breath with an attack, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or stop holding its breath.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scion may use its Flare Mouth if available, then makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Facelatch Bite.

action.name: Facelatch Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

If the target is Medium or smaller and the scion used its Flare Mouth this turn, the scion may grapple the creature instead of dealing damage (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the target is blinded and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Drowner's Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet in a direction of the scion's choice.

action.name: Tentacle Sparklash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Flare Mouth (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The scion suddenly flares its mouth open in a gaping display. Each creature within 10 feet of the scion must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the scion's next turn.

reaction.name: Pelagic Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the scion is reduced below 64 hit points while submerged, it emits a telepathically encoded scream that echoes through the sea.
Each other creature within 300 feet that is submerged in the same body of water must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of the scion's next turn.
The scion's master learns any information that the scion has learned since the last time they communicated.

entries: The scion suddenly flares its mouth open in a gaping display. Each creature within 10 feet of the scion must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the scion's next turn.

name: Crypt-Back Cauchemar
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Embrace of Flames
entries: A creature riding the cauchemar has resistance to fire damage.

trait.name: Bearer of the Dead
entries: The cauchemar may carry any number of dead and undead creatures without difficulty. A dead creature the cauchemar touches is drawn onto its back and grappled there (escape DC 18).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the cauchemar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cauchemar makes three attacks with its Hellshod Hooves, one of which it may replace with a use of its Viperous Bite or Burning Trail, if available.

action.name: Viperous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

Unless it is first magically revived, a creature killed by this damage returns as a Questing Revenant at the next new moon, and is consumed with thoughts of vengeance toward a creature that recently wronged it.

action.name: Hellshod Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Burning Trail (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The cauchemar moves up to 60 feet in a straight line, leaving a trail of hellfire behind it. Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
Until the beginning of the cauchemar's next turn, a creature that starts its turn in the affected area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 16 (3d10) fire damage.

action.name: Hellfire Revival
entries: The cauchemar wreaths one of the corpses carried on its back in necromantic flames, burning away its flesh and animating it for the next minute as a Blazing Bones that acts on the cauchemar's turn and under its control.
The cauchemar can have up to three corpses animated in this way at a time.

action.name: Haunting Squeal (Recharges when the cauchemar uses its Ember-Way Break)
entries: The cauchemar rears up and lets out a hollow squeal, conjuring forth a tide of vengeful spirits.

Each creature within 60 feet of a portal created by the cauchemar's Ember-Way Break must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and be dragged up to 15 feet toward the nearest such portal.
Each creature dragged into a portal's space in this way is carried through to the Ethereal Plane and ages 1d4 x 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Fleshmad Frenzy
entries: When the nightmare reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a Viperous Bite attack, it can make another Viperous Bite attack against the same target.

reaction.name: Burn Out
entries: When the cauchemar is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling unconscious it begins to shake and squeal, its flesh cracking with flame.

At the beginning of the cauchemar's next turn, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Brimstone Fume
entries: Foul wisps of ash and shadow spill from the cauchemar's flesh, creating a 15 foot radius area of magical darkness centered on it that lasts until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Snort Flame
entries: The cauchemar snorts a gout of flame in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) fire damage.

legendary.name: Ember-Way Break
entries: The cauchemar moves up to half its speed, then may lunge against the barrier between the Ethereal and Material plane, taking 11 (2d10) force damage and tearing open a ragged portal large enough for it to pass through that seals itself shut after a minute.

name: Nightmare Hellsteed
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Embrace of Flames
entries: A creature riding the nightmare has resistance to fire damage.

action.name: Hellshod Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Burning Trail (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nightmare moves up to 60 feet in a straight line, leaving a trail of hellfire behind it. Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
Until the beginning of the nightmare's next turn, a creature that starts its turn in the affected area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 16 (3d10) fire damage.

action.name: Ember-Way Break
entries: The nightmare lunges against the barrier between the Ethereal and Material plane, taking 11 (2d10) force damage and tearing open a ragged portal large enough for it to pass through that seals itself shut after a minute.

reaction.name: Offer Service
entries: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling unconscious it can kneel and offer its service to a creature it can see.
If the creature accepts, the creature loses half its current hit points and the nightmare regains an equal amount of hit points.

reaction.name: Burn Out
entries: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling unconscious the nightmare can begin to shake and squeal, its flesh cracking with flame.
At the beginning of the nightmare's next turn, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire damage.

name: Nightmare Cursebearer
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Embrace of Flames
entries: A creature riding the nightmare has resistance to fire damage.

trait.name: Mourning Haunt
entries: The nightmare appears in the dreams of those who have recently lost a close companion, Cursing those who choose to mount the nightmare in their dreams.
A creature Cursed in this way is plagued by terrible dreams, and the nightmare takes form on the Material Plane after 1d10 days, appearing to the creature at a moment when it is alone.
If this Curse is removed, the nightmare vanishes, returning to the Ethereal Plane.

action.name: Hellshod Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Leech Sorrow (1/Day)
entries: One creature Cursed by the nightmare takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage, then both that creature and the nightmare gain an equal number of temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Gift of Wounds
entries: When the nightmare is hit with an attack, it can force a creature Cursed by its Mourning Haunt ability to make a DC 12 Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, the nightmare takes half as much damage from the attack and the creature takes the same amount.

reaction.name: Ashen Demise
entries: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 hit points, its flesh turns to toxic ash and bursts  in a 15 foot radius, leaving only charred bones behind.
Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and begin choking until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Heart Sight
entries: The sprite can magically sense the emotional state of creatures it can see, and knows when it hears a lie.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: While it is not incapacitated, the sprite is invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature a Passive Perception below 16.

trait.name: Shilly-Shally (5/Day)
entries: If the sprite would take any damage or fail a saving throw, it may teleport to switch places with any Tiny object it can see within 30 feet of it and be unaffected by the triggering damage or saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sprite makes three attacks with its Dead-Nettle Switch, two of which it may replace with its Lullwright's Whisper.

action.name: Dead-Nettle Switch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Saving throws to maintain concentration that are triggered by this damage are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Lullwright's Whisper
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the sprite must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone and be unable to take hostile actions until the end of the sprite's next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls asleep for the next hour.
These effects end early if a creature takes an action to shake the creature awake, or if it takes any damage.

action.name: Weave Glamer (6th Level Spell, 1/Day, Concentration)
entries: The sprite weaves a subtle illusory charm, affecting the area within 60 feet of it for the next hour.

Each creature or object in the area of the sprite's choice appears to be a different creature or object of similar size, and creatures in the area subtract 1d4 from the result of any Wisdom saving throws they make.
A creature that successfully disbelieves the illusion as an action with a successful DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check is unaffected.

bonus.name: Trooping Trounce
entries: Each friendly sprite within 20 feet of a prone or unconscious creature the sprite can see within 60 feet may use its reaction to move up to 15 feet towards the creature and kick it repeatedly.
The creature takes 2 bludgeoning damage per sprite within 5 feet of it, or twice as much damage if the creature was unconscious.

bonus.name: Spirit Away (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One unconscious creature the sprite can see within 60 feet is wreathed in dancing lights and begins to levitate 15 feet off the ground until it wakes or leaves the forest the sprite is bound to.
At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it floats 20 feet in a direction of the sprite's choice.

reaction.name: Expand Truth (1/Day)
entries: When the sprite hears a creature make a true statement using a word or phrase with multiple possible meanings, the sprite can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed for a year and a day.
While the creature is Cursed in this way, its statement becomes true under another meaning of that word or phrase.

reaction.name: Animate Lie (1/Day)
entries: When the sprite hears a creature tell a lie or voice a wish relating to its abilities, intentions, or memories, the sprite can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be Cursed for a year and a day.
While Cursed in this way, the creature's statistics, class levels, proficiencies, intentions, and memories change to fit the lie.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: While it is not incapacitated, the sprite is invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

trait.name: Trifling Strength
entries: The sprite can grapple and shove creatures up to three sizes larger than it, and may wield improvised weapons that are up to one size larger than it without penalty.

action.name: Improvised Weapon
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Collar Grab
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
A creature grappled in this way that the sprite attempts to lift into the air may make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a success, the sprite cannot lift the creature this turn.

action.name: Instigating Shove
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the sprite must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is pushed up to 10 feet, then must make a melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

reaction.name: Brazen Theft
entries: When a creature misses the sprite with a melee weapon attack, the sprite can force the creature to make a DC 14 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the sprite wrenches one object the attacker is carrying free from its grasp.

reaction.name: Go Limp
entries: When the sprite takes damage from a weapon attack or from a spell that did not target it, the sprite reduces that damage to 0.
Then, the sprite is pushed up to 15 feet from the source of that damage and falls prone.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: While it is not incapacitated, the sprite is invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Needleblade Slice (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

action.name: Gossamer Hobble
entries: The sprite flies around the legs of a Small or larger creature within 5 feet, trailing a length of clear silk.
The first time each turn that the creature moves more than 30 feet, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.
This distance is reduced by 5 feet each additional time the creature is affected by this ability, and the effect ends when the creature succeeds on the saving throw or removes the silk as an action.

trait.name: Captivating Visage
entries: A creature that can see the nymph treats all other creatures and objects as invisible.

A creature that isn't charmed or Surprised by the nymph can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the beginning of its turn, instead treating the nymph as invisible until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the nymph may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

action.name: Parting Touch (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
A creature charmed in this way takes 3 (1d6) nonlethal psychic damage at the start of each of its turn for each 5 feet away from the nymph that it is.

action.name: Entreat
entries: One creature charmed by the nymph must use its reaction to move up to its speed toward and make an attack against a target of the nymph's choice.

action.name: Ensnare (1/Day)
entries: The nymph sets a faintly visible magical trap that lasts for a minute in a 5 foot radius centered on herself, which triggers the first time a nonfey creature enters the area.
The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious until it takes any damage or a creature uses its action to wake it.

reaction.name: Blinding Beauty (1/Day)
entries: When a creature that can see the nymph hits it with a melee attack, the nymph may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: While it is not incapacitated, the sluagh is invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The slaugh can occupy another creature or object's space and vice versa. The slaugh can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Cram with Ashes
entries: The sluagh stuffs the mouth of a prone creature in its space with ashes, forcing it to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) poison damage and begin Choking (Save Ends at end of turn)

action.name: Follydrop Deadfall
entries: The sluagh touches a Huge or smaller object, creature, or building and magically causes it to fly up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the sluagh can see.
If supported by nothing but air, the target falls at the end of the sluagh's turn, otherwise the target balances weightlessly in place until it moves or a creature passes beneath it, then falls.
A creature the object falls on must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Synchronized Snort
entries: As a reaction when the sluagh is forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it vociferously inhales a portion of the magic, reducing the effect's save DC by 5.

reaction.name: Pestpoker Palisade
entries: As a reaction when a creature moves into or through the sluagh's space, the sluagh forces it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (2d4) piercing damage and fall prone.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: While it is not incapacitated, the killmoulis is invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

trait.name: Scent Crimes
entries: When the killmoulis eat's a creature's food, it learns the last evil act that creature committed.

action.name: Poisoned Pestpoker Pin
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
A Tiny or prone target takes an additional 4 piercing damage.

action.name: Taste of Ashes
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:The target is Cursed for the next 24 hours.
While cursed in this way, any food the creature touches is coated in a fine layer of ashes and the creature does not recover spent hit dice when it completes a Long Rest.

action.name: Quernstone Deadfall
entries: The killmoulis touches a Medium or smaller object and magically causes it to fly up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the killmoulis can see.
If supported by nothing but air, the object falls at the end of the killmoulis' turn, otherwise the object balances weightlessly in place until a creature passes beneath it, then falls.
A creature the object falls on must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Snuffling Snort
entries: As a reaction when the killmoulis is forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it vociferously inhales a portion of the magic, reducing the effect's save DC by 1.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: While it is not incapacitated, the killmoulis is invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

trait.name: Scent Crimes
entries: When the killmoulis eats a creature's food, it learns the last evil act that creature committed.

entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
A Tiny or prone target takes an additional 4 piercing damage.

action.name: Taste of Ashes
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:The target is Cursed for the next 24 hours.
While cursed in this way, any food the creature touches is coated in a fine layer of ashes and the creature does not recover spent hit dice when it completes a Long Rest.

entries: As a reaction when the killmoulis is forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it vociferously inhales a portion of the magic, reducing the effect's save DC by 1.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Reflective Rampart
entries: Whenever a nerra within 60 feet of the silit nerra  is missed with a spell attack, the nerra may force the attacker to make a new attack roll for the spell against a target of the silit nerra's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nerra makes three attacks with its Quicksilver Helix, one of which it may replace with a use of its Fractalize.

action.name: Quicksilver Helix
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) slashing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
The nerra may choose for this attack's source to be any reflective surface it can see within 100 feet.

action.name: Fractalize
entries: The nerra shatters one non-minion nerra it can see within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) slashing damage, then three new

action.name: Steal Reflection (Concentration)
entries: One creature the nerra can see within 60 feet must make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the nerra changes its appearance to match the creature, and whenever the nerra takes damage, the creature takes half as much damage of the same type.

action.name: Mirrorspace Banishment (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the nerra can see within 60 feet that is within 5 feet of a reflective object must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma save or be dragged into that object's mirrorspace and trapped there.
The creature may repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, and is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space on a success, or when the object ceases to be reflective.

bonus.name: Mirror Portal
entries: The nerra teleports itself or a creature it can see up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface. An unwilling creature may make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.
If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Mirrorweave Symmetry
entries: As a reaction when a creature the nerra can see casts a spell, the nerra casts the same spell, choosing new targets (Spell Attack Bonus +11, Save DC 19).

reaction.name: Infinite Reflections (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 127 hit points, the nerra causes up to four 10 foot by 10 foot flat surfaces that it can see within 100 feet to smooth and shimmer, reaching a mirror polish.

name: Kalareem Nerra
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nerra makes four attacks with its Glessine Greatblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Liquimetal Encasement.

action.name: Glessine Greatblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the blade shatters, dealing 10 (3d6) slashing damage to the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it. The nerra can extrude a new blade as a Bonus Action on its turn.

action.name: Liquimetal Encasement
entries: The nerra enters the space of a creature within 5 feet and engulfs it (escape DC 18). An unwilling creature may make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.
An engulfed creature can't have an AC lower than 20, takes 21 (6d6) poison damage at the end of each of its turns, and has its movement speed reduced by half.
While it has a creature engulfed, the nerra moves with the creature, can't make attacks, and may exit the creature's space as a Bonus Action.

reaction.name: Mercurial Double
entries: As a reaction when a creature makes an attack against a creature within 5 feet of the nerra, the nerra warps its body and the light around it, changing the target to itself.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Reflected Assassin
entries: While inside of a mirrorspace, the nerra treats any creature reflected in that mirrorspace as adjacent to it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nerra makes two attacks with its Honed Shard, one of which it may replace with a use of its Mirror Grasp.

action.name: Honed Shard
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins bleeding (2d6).
This attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) slashing damage to a Bleeding target.

action.name: Mirror Grasp
entries: One creature the nerra can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding or carrying teleport into the nerra's hands.

bonus.name: Mirror Step
entries: The nerra teleports up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface.
If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Razor Claws (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 slashing damage. If at least two other meerak nerras attacked with it, the target begins bleeding (2d6).

bonus.name: Mirror Step
entries: The nerra teleports up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface.
If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Shroud of Cosmic Revulsion
entries: A creature with a Wisdom score of 10 or higher must avert its gaze from the scion if it is more than 10 feet away, treating the scion as invisible.

trait.name: Invoker of the Vengeful Endless
entries: The scion must maintain Concentration to avoid recalling what dwells in Gibbeth.

When it loses Concentration on this effect or ends its turn while not Concentrating on this effect, formless limbs spring from the scion's body to lash at it, dealing 5 (1d10) force damage to it and restraining it until it regains Concentration on this ability.

trait.name: Knowledge of the Coming Hour
entries: At the end of each creature's turn, the scion may take 4 (1d8) psychic damage.
If it does, the scion immediately makes a saving throw to end each effect on it that ends on a successful saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scion makes two attacks with its Unbearable Touch and uses its Dread Fascination or Mind-Splinter, if available.

action.name: Unbearable Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit. reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) psychic damage and the target must use its reaction to move 15 feet directly away from the scion, if available.

action.name: Dread Fascination
entries: One creature the scion can see within 120 feet must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature must use all of its movement on its following turn to approach the scion by the most direct route available.

action.name: Mind-Splinter (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each other creature within 10 feet of the scion must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against itself, if available.
On a hit, this attack deals an additional 13 (3d8) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Squamous Lurch
entries: The scion moves up to its speed, then each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 13 (3d8) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of the scion's next turn.
While frightened in this way, a creature makes Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Suppress Memories
entries: The scion hastily attempts to clear thoughts of Gibbeth from its mind, making a DC 10 Intelligence check. On a success, the scion regains Concentration on its Invoker of the Endless ability.
Glimpses of Gibbeth
When the scion loses concentration on its Invoker of the Endless ability, it causes one of the following effects, which lasts until it regains concentration or dies:

bonus.name: Unmaking Gaze
entries: The scion assaults the mind of one creature that can see it, revealing a fragmentary vision of infinite possible futures converging unerringly toward the moment of Gibbeth's inevitable birth.
The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or become hostile toward each creature it can see (Save Ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Embrace of Ancient Hate
entries: Slivers of a being outside of time violently extrude through reality, squirming across a 10 foot radius column that is 60 feet high and centered on a point the scion can see within 120 feet.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or that enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area.

bonus.name: Veil of the Clinging Void
entries: An obscuring wall of starry void crashes into existence within 120 feet of the scion. The wall is 60 feet long, 10 feet wide, and arbitrarily high.

A creature that starts its turn in the wall or enters its space for the first time on a turn takes 18 (6d8) cold damage, and is blinded and Choking until the beginning of its next turn as clinging tendrils of black nothing envelop it.

trait.name: Stilling Glow
entries: Colors fade and motion stills within 20 feet of the glare.
Spells and ranged weapon attacks that target a creature or point in the area deal half as much damage.

trait.name: Unseasonable Flare
entries: When the glare loses concentration on a spell, it flares with freezing light.
Each other creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) cold damage and be blinded until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Boreal Gaze
entries: The glare turns its impassive gaze upon a creature it can see within 30 feet and an evil chill begins to creep through the creature's veins.
The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 45 (10d8) cold damage and have its movement reduced by half until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Hateful Silence (6th Level Spell, Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A horrid magical silence descends in a 30 foot radius extending from the glare, stifling all sound but that of a creature's own thunderous heartbeat.
A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage and be frightened until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Doom of Delban (9th Level Spell, Concentration, 1/Day)
entries: The glare calls down a shaft of freezing starlight on a space it can see. Each creature in the space when it appears, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw
On a failed save, a creature takes 66 (8d8 + 30) cold plus 33 (6d10) radiant damage and is paralyzed until the end of the glare's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.
While concentrating on this spell, the glare takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, then may use its action to move the effect up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Rim of the Void
entries: The maw projects Dim Light in a 5 foot radius, blocking out all other light sources.
Creatures in the area are immune to Radiant damage, and a creature must spend 20 additional feet of movement to leave the area.

action.name: Devouring Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (6d10) force damage.

action.name: Endless Hunger of Acamar (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in the area of the maw's Rim of the Void aura must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Corpse-Star's Grip
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the maw's Rim of the Void aura must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be drawn up to 15 feet directly toward the maw.

bonus.name: Feed the Void
entries: The maw draws a Medium or Large corpse or other nonmagical object within 5 feet into its body, destroying it utterly.
For the next minute, the radius of its Rim of the Void aura increases by 10 feet.

reaction.name: Distort Time (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: The first time the maw is reduced below 90 hit points, it may warp the passage of time in the area affected by its Rim of the Void ability.

For the next minute, each creature in the area cannot make more than a single attack on its turn, and each creature in the area has advantage on saving throws against effects originating outside of it.

trait.name: Puppet of the Radiant Void
entries: When the hollowed is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it moves up to half its speed and makes a single attack with its Hammer Sanity on each of its turns, taking no other actions.
If it ends its turn while at 0 hit points without dealing damage, the hollowed dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hollowed makes three attacks with its Hammer Sanity.

action.name: Hammer Sanity (4th Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
If the damage dealt by this spell is greater than the target's Wisdom score, the target becomes indifferent to the hollowed and hostile to each other creature until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Visions of the Endless End (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 45 (10d8) psychic damage and be blinded until the end of the hollowed's next turn with visions of the infinite timeless void at the end of all things.
If the target is reduced to 0 hit points by this damage, it is instead blinded until cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic, and permanently gains Blindsight with a range of 5 feet.

action.name: Corpse-Light of Zhudun (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hollowed manifests a blank and flickering visage of the evershining absence left where Zhudun once burned, sending forth its screaming light in a 30 foot cone.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) psychic plus 22 (4d10) radiant damage and be frightened until the end of the hollowed's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Dread Shadows
entries: Areas within 30 feet of the herald that are not illuminated by Bright Light have their shadows thicken and twist into unsettling shapes, becoming difficult terrain.

trait.name: Cloak of Embers (1/Day)
entries: If the herald fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald makes two attacks with its Claws of Frenzied Dark, or makes one attack against each creature in the area of its Dread Shadows.

action.name: Claws of Frenzied Dark
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
This attack treats each creature in an area affected by the herald's Dread Shadows as though they were within 5 feet of the herald.

action.name: Hunger of Hadar (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The herald opens a path to the unknowable horrors that lair in the dark between the stars, filling a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 150 feet with chittering, tendrilous blackness for the next minute.
The area is heavily obscured and difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area takes 7 (2d6) cold damage.
A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Call to the Ebon Brood (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The herald sings to the darkness concealed in the body of a creature it can see within 30 feet, awakening its hunger.
The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6)  slashing plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has 5 (2d4) Star Spawn Grues spill forth from its eyes and mouth, appearing in the nearest unoccupied spaces. The grues act on the herald's initiative and under its control.

reaction.name: Breath of a Dying Star (1/Day)
entries: When the herald is reduced below 83 hit points for the first time, it can cast forth a stream of swirling, incandescent embers in a 15 foot cone that blacken and burn the very air around them.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) radiant plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Until the beginning of the herald's next turn, the area is filled with Magical Darkness, and creatures in the area can't regain hit points.

trait.name: Echoing Doom of Khirad
entries: When the doomsayer is reduced below 83 hit points, Khirad flares in the sky overhead, becoming visible even in daylight.
For the next minute, it and each other creature within 1 mile of it subtract 1d4 from any attacks or saving throws they make.

action.name: Starlight Lance
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d10) radiant damage.
If this attack hits, the doomsayer may make a second attack roll against another creature in range that is directly behind the first target.

action.name: Stammered Whisper
entries: The doomsayer clutches at a creature within 5 feet and attempts to share a fragment of its unbearable knowledge.
If the creature can hear and understand the doomsayer, it must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or gain 10 (3d6) temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature is Dominated by the doomsayer and takes 1d6 psychic damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Summons of the Radiant King
entries: A pillar of blue starfire pours down upon one creature the doomsayer can see within 120 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or begin Burning (3d10).
At the beginning of each of the Burning creature's turns, the doomsayer may teleport it up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the doomsayer can see.

action.name: Gruesome Illumination (Concentration)
entries: A blue flame flares upon the brow of the doomsayer, casting a Dim Light in a 30 foot radius that uncovers and awakens old wounds.
When a creature starts its turn in the area, the doomsayer may deal necrotic damage equal to the creature's level or challenge rating to it.

trait.name: Blessed Sight of the Guidestar
entries: The emissary knows the precise location of each creature that can see the night sky.

trait.name: Visions of the Final Hour
entries: While it is concentrating on a spell or magical effect that targets the emissary, a creature is blinded with visions of an unfamiliar constellation.

action.name: Touch of Creeping Despair (4th Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the target is Cursed.
The first time a creature Cursed in this way fails a saving throw, this curse ends and the creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

action.name: Fevered Certainty of Caiphon (Concentration, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The emissary foretells the impending doom of a creature it can see within 60 feet.
When the target makes a saving throw, it does not add any modifiers to its rolled result. When the target fails a saving throw, this effect ends.
The emissary has disadvantage on saving throws made to Concentrate on this spell.

action.name: Release of Dreams (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the emissary can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or regain its highest level expended spell slot, then take 13 (3d8) psychic damage per level of the spell slot regained.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more becomes hostile to all other creatures until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Steps Upon the Purple Stair (4th Level Spell)
entries: The emissary steps into a fleeting echo plane and disappears, taking 13 (3d8) psychic damage and emerging in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Forcebreaker
entries: The dragon can destroy an adjacent creation of magical force, such as that produced by Wall of Force or Forcecage, by spending 10 feet of movement.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 30 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 21.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 25) and restrained. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 20 ft. away from the dragon. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Shattergem Breath
entries: The dragon breathes forth a hail of luminous crystals in a 300-foot line that is 15 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 42 (12d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Singularity Breath
entries: The dragon creates a shining bead of gravitational force in its mouth, then releases the energy in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 81 (18d8) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Psychokinetic Hurl
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be flung up to 40 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes invisible to one creature it can telepathically communicate with until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Metabolic Overdrive
entries: The dragon gains advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature that it can telepathically communicate with.

reaction.name: Psychoport Inversion

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 327 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon uses its Psionic Empowerment.

legendary.name: Gravity Collapse
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of a line of gems created by the dragon's breath must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward it by the most direct route.

legendary.name: Detonate Gems (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One line of gems created by the dragon's breath detonates in a chained explosion of force. Each creature within 15 feet of the line must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or take 55 (10d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Translucent Camouflage
entries: The dragon may attempt to hide without being obscured. Checks the dragon makes to hide from creatures more than 30 feet away from it are made at advantage.

trait.name: Lifechannel Aura
entries: At the beginning of each of the dragon's turns, each creature within 15 feet of it gains 15 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 23) and restrained.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the dragon. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Breath of Life Overflowing
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of pure life energy in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 58 (13d8) radiant damage and regaining 10 (4d4) expended hit dice on a failure, or taking half as much damage on a success.

Then, if the creature has no unexpended hit dice, it incandesces, losing each of its unexpended hit dice, rolling a number of d8s equal to the number of hit dice lost in this way, and taking additional radiant damage equal to the result.

action.name: Breath of Inner Dawn
entries: The dragon blows a mighty breath in a 300 foot long, 15 foot wide line that stokes a blinding glow within all it touches.

The dragon and each creature and object in the area begins to emit sunlight in a 30 foot radius for the next minute, and a creature without resistance to radiant damage that targets an affected creature with an attack or spell must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Wind Scythe

items.name: Pacify (Concentration)

items.name: Psychic Intrusion (Concentration)

reaction.name: Predictive Flicker

entries: The millipede secretes a foul oil that coats its body.

For the next minute, a creature that hits the millipede with a melee attack or starts its turn in the millipede's space must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage and be poisoned until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Armored Coil
entries: The millipede coils into a tight spiral, gaining the following effects until it uses an action to uncurl:

• The millipede's AC is increased to 17.
  • The millipede's speed is reduced to 0.
  • Any creature grappled by the millipede is also restrained.

name: Puppeteer Parasite
languages: The languages of any creature it is attached to

trait.name: Custom Mimicry
entries: The puppeteer can add its Intelligence modifier to Charisma checks made to mimic behavior it has observed in the last 24 hours.

trait.name: Psionic Backlash
entries: If a creature the parasite is attached to succeeds on a saving throw against one of the parasite's abilities by 5 or more, the parasite falls prone and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clinging Flop
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage and the parasite becomes attached to the target (remove DC 12).

action.name: Drain Mind
entries: The parasite digs its ventral teeth into a humanoid creature it is attached to, connecting directly to the creature's nervous system. The creature takes 7 (2d6) piercing plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage, then must make a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw.
On a failure, the creature loses all memory of the parasite and the parasite becomes undetectable to the creature until the parasite is removed or deals any damage to the creature.

action.name: Insidious Suggestion (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The parasite telepathically whispers a command to a creature it is attached to. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or follow that command for the next hour, or until the parasite uses this ability again.

action.name: Assume Control (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: The parasite attempts to directly take control of the body of a humanoid creature it is attached to, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be dominated by the parasite for the next 24 hours.
While dominated in this way, a creature can't cast spells and uses the parasite's knowledge, mental statistics and proficiencies in place of its own.

reaction.name: Slither
entries: When a creature the parasite can see targets it with an attack while it is attached to a creature, it crawls deeper into the creature's clothing or armor, gaining half cover against the attack.
If the attack misses the parasite, the attacker makes a new attack roll targeting the creature the parasite is attached to.

trait.name: Poor Turner
entries: When the mauler begins moving on its turn, it must continue at least 20 feet in the same direction before turning, and may make a turn of no more than 90 degrees.
If this movement is arrested due to impacting a solid surface, the mauler immediately ends its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mauler makes three attacks, each of which must be against a different target.

action.name: Cartwheel Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and the mauler can immediately make a second attack against it.

reaction.name: Ramped Leap
entries: When the mauler moves at least 10 feet directly toward a prone creature and then enters its space, the mauler can deal 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage to it and jump up to 15 feet in the same direction.

Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or jump 5 feet directly away from the mauler and fall prone.

trait.name: Horrid Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

A creature whose space the swarm enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. On a successful saving throw, the creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the swarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, or 1 piercing plus 3 (1d6) poison damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
A creature that takes 6 or more poison damage in this way is poisoned until the end of the swarm's next turn.

action.name: Arachnophobic Terror
entries: The swarm scuttles over a prone creature in its space, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) nonlethal psychic damage and be frightened until the end of the swarm's next turn.

reaction.name: Crushed Vengeance
entries: When a creature hits the swarm with a melee attack, the swarm can deal 3 (1d6) poison damage to it.

action.name: Nettling Bristles (Recharge 5-6)

bonus.name: Leaping Tackle
entries: The spider jumps up to 15 feet and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature that is frightened.
A creature whose space the spider lands in must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
On a successful saving throw, the spider instead lands in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Grasping Legs

entries: When the spider is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she resets to 262 hit points.
For the next hour, whenever the spider kills a spider with her Stilling Bite, she regains 30 hit points and a Legendary Resistance.

On a failed save, the target is poisoned for the next minute (save ends at end of turn), and is incapacitated while poisoned if it is not illuminated by bright light.

action.name: Loathly Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or suffer one additional effect:

• The creature is knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 21) until the spider moves.
  • The target drops one object it is carrying and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

bonus.name: Dread Snare
entries: One creature the spider can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 30 feet toward her.

bonus.name: Darkwrought Vapors (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A smothering blackness issues forth in a 40 foot radius from vents at the back of the spider's head.

Until the end of her next turn, light sources in the area have the area they illuminate reduced by half, and a creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened and choking until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Tangle the Weave
entries: When the spider is targeted with a spell, she can cause the spell to leave a tangle of blackened silk in a 5 foot wide line in the air behind it.
Attacks that pass through the web have disadvantage, and a creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 21).
Each 5 foot section of the line can be attacked (AC 20, 15 HP, resistance to all but fire and magical slashing damage).

legendary.name: Loathly Lurch
entries: The spider moves up to half her speed and can make an attack with her Loathly Legs.

legendary.name: Devour Light
entries: The spider extinguishes a light source she can see within 15 feet of her or one of her webs, then she gains 15 temporary hit points.
If the light source is produced by a spell of 3rd level or above (or equivalent magic), this ability fails.

legendary.name: Nameless Progeny
entries: 1d4 Goliath Bristle Spiders that act on initiative count 0 emerge from their burrows in the spider's back and immediately crawl to unoccupied spaces within 15 feet of her.

mythic.name: Stilling Bite

mythic.name: Fatal Despair

The creature becomes immune to the frightened condition for the next minute and can't voluntarily move away from the spider, attempt to escape from restraints, or heal itself.

action.name: Painter's Flail
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage and the target begins bleeding (1d4).
If the target was already bleeding, its blood splatters to form an abyssal glyph spread across an unoccupied space within 5 feet.
The glyph is destroyed if it takes any damage or a creature enters its space.
A target hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the fanatic's next turn.

action.name: Glyph of Unshackled Sensation (1/Day)
entries: The fanatic touches a bloodglyph created with its Painter's Flail, causing it to pulse with unholy power.
For the next minute, creatures within 15 feet of the glyph have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and vulnerability to psychic damage.

reaction.name: Desparate Appetites
entries: When the fanatic takes any psychic damage, it can regain a use of its Glyph of Unshackled Sensation.

reaction.name: True Face of Pain
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the fanatic destroys a bloodglyph created with its Painter's Flail by entering its space, the fanatic can force the creature to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of the fanatic's next turn.

trait.name: Painfog Censer
entries: Whenever a creature within 15 feet of three or more creatures with this trait takes any non-psychic damage, it takes an additional 2 psychic damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Artful Incisions (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 nonlethal slashing damage. This damage bypasses temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Ecstatic Leap
entries: When the cultist sees two or more creatures within 30 feet of it die in one turn, it can force one creature within 5 feet of it to use its reaction to make an attack against the cultist, if available.
If the cultist is killed by this attack, the attacker takes 2 psychic damage.

trait.name: Abyssal Ascension (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the exarch is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she resets to 246 hit points and eight spindly legs burst from her back.
The exarch's type becomes fiend (demon), her speed is doubled, and she becomes immune to any effect that would reduce her speed.
If the exarch ends her turn outside the Abyss, she must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or be summoned to the depths of the Demonweb Pher.

trait.name: Kiss of Lolth
entries: The exarch's spells ignore resistance or immunity to poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition.

trait.name: Venemous Dweomer
entries: The first time each turn that a creature fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect the exarch controls, the exarch can deal 7 (2d6) poison damage to it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The exarch can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Ruthless Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the exarch fails a saving throw, she can force a friendly creature within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or suffer the effects of the saving throw in her stead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes two attacks with her Darkfire Bolt, each of which she may replace with a use of her Envenomed Touch.

action.name: Darkfire Bolt (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +13 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) fire damage, and the target is wreathed in writhing shadows for the next minute.
Whenever the creature is hit with an attack, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. This effect ends early if the target is illuminated by bright light.

action.name: Envenomed Touch (4th Level Spell)
entries: The exarch touches a creature within 5 feet, dealing 14 (4d6) poison damage to it and forcing it to succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Aura of Creeping Ruin (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A mass of tiny spiders swarms around the exarch in a 25 foot radius. When a creature starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn, the exarch can force it to succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 10 poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Poison Thoughts (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One poisoned creature that the exarch can see within 60 feet has the poisoned condition end for it, then must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be dominated by the exarch for the next minute (save ends at end of turn)

reaction.name: Bask in Her Esteem
entries: When the exarch kills one or more friendly creatures, she can gain 10 temporary hit points per friendly creature killed in this way.
If she does, attacks against the exarch are made at advantage until the beginning of their next turn.

reaction.name: Chasten Failure
entries: When a friendly humanoid creature misses the exarch with an attack, the exarch can force it to succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or transform into a Shunned under the exarch's control, retaining its current hit points.

reaction.name: Strands of the Demonweb (5th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature they can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the exarch weaves a portion of the expended magic into threads of binding silk.
Any damage dealt by the spell is reduced by half, and the spell's caster must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 21) until it takes any damage.

legendary.name: Darkfire Bolt
entries: The exarch uses her Darkfire Bolt.

legendary.name: Skulking Shift
entries: The exarch moves up to half her speed. If she is not illuminated by bright light, this movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Lolth's Favor (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)

Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

entries: The centipede anchors itself with its pincer-like rear legs and coils up, gaining the following effects until the end of its next turn:

• The centipede's speed is reduced to 0.
  • The centipede has advantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength.
  • The centipede's melee attacks have a reach of 30 feet and advantage.

reaction.name: Skittering Thrash
entries: When the centipede is hit with a ranged attack, it can move up to half its speed directly toward the attacker.
Opportunity attacks provoked by this movement have disadvantage.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the swarm takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The swarm sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The swarm has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

action.name: Thrash of Mandibles
