entries: If the book is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the book remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal book.

action.name: Heavy Thwack
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Release Spell
entries: The book releases a spell trapped in its pages, choosing new targets for it and using its own spellcasting ability (+2 to hit, DC 10).

reaction.name: Trap Spell
entries: When the book is targeted with a spell of 1st level or below, it can make a Constitution saving throw against the spell caster's Save DC.  The book can only have one spell trapped at a time.
On a success, the spell is negated and trapped within the book's pages, and the book takes 1 force damage at the beginning of each of its turns until it uses its Release Spell.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the broom is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the broom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal broom.

action.name: Bristled Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sweep Leg
entries: The broom forces one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Dust Up
entries: The broom furiously sweeps a dust-covered surface within 5 feet, kicking up a thick cloud in a 5 foot radius that lightly obscures the area and lasts for a minute, or until cleared by a strong breeze.

reaction.name: Splinter
entries: When the broom is hit with a melee attack, it can allow that attack to score a critical. If it does, the broom snaps in half, splitting into two Animated Brooms that each have hit points equal to half the original broom's, act on its initiative, and can't regain hit points.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the kettle is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the kettle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal kettle.

action.name: Heavy Crash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage, plus an additional 1 fire damage for each remaining use of its Scalding Splash.

action.name: Screaming Whistle
entries: The kettle produces an ear-splitting whistle, forcing each creature within 30 feet that can hear it to succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be Deafened and lose concentration, if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Scalding Splash (3/Day)
entries: When the kettle takes any non-cold damage, it can fling boiling water toward a creature within 5 feet, dealing 2 (1d4) fire damage to it. The kettle regains all uses of this ability whenever it takes any fire damage.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the candelabrum is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the candelabrum remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal candelabrum.

trait.name: Snuff Out
entries: If the candelabrum is subjected to strong wind, doused in water, or a creature blows on it as a bonus action, the candelabrum must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or have its flames extinguished.
Until it hits a target with its Sconce Flare, the candelabrum's attacks have disadvantage and it can't use its Set Flame.

action.name: Sconce Flare
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) fire damage.
A blinded, incapacitated, or surprised creature hit with this attack begins burning (1d10, Save Ends at end of turn)

action.name: Fling Wax
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) fire damage.

action.name: Set Flame
entries: The candelabrum sets a space within 5 feet of it aflame for the next minute.
A creature that starts its turn in the space or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the iron is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the iron remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal iron.

trait.name: Steam Off
entries: If the iron takes any cold damage while its Heat Up is active, it exudes a cloud of steam in a 5 foot radius, heavily obscuring the area until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Flatiron Smash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is not wearing armor, the iron can become attached to it (remove DC 12).

reaction.name: Heat Up
entries: If the iron would take any fire damage, it can reduce that damage to 0 and begin to glow a dull red, gaining the following effects for the next minute, or until it takes any cold damage:

• The iron's attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage.
  • A creature that grapples the iron or hits it with an unarmed attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.
  • A creature that starts its turn grappling the iron or with the iron attached to it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the armor is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

trait.name: Clattering Collapse
entries: When the armor takes or deals a critical hit, it falls prone in a heap and is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The armor makes two attacks with its Lurching Slam.

action.name: Lurching Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the armor can grapple the target (escape DC 12).

action.name: Twist Limbs
entries: One creature that is wearing or grappled by the armor must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and be restrained until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the door is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the door remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal door.

trait.name: Hinged Prison
entries: The door is ordinarily affixed to a doorway, and cannot move or be moved from its space.
At the beginning of any turn when the door does not have all of its hit points, it can make a DC 10 Strength saving throw, freeing itself on a success.

action.name: Sudden Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, plus one additional effect:

• The target is restrained (escape DC 13) until the door moves or makes another attack.
  • The target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Hardwood Endurance
entries: The door braces itself, gaining resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Knock Back
entries: When a creature hits the door with a melee attack while the door is affixed to a doorway, the door can make a Sudden Slam attack against it.

reaction.name: Knob Shock (1/Day)
entries: When a creature attempts to open or unlock the door, the door can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) lightning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the portrait is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the portrait remains motionless and silent, it is indistinguishable from a normal portrait.

trait.name: Whispering Walls
entries: The portrait can hear each other animated portrait in the same building as though it was within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Spinning Frame
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target that isn't restrained by the portait. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
If the portrait has a creature restrained with its Sacrificial Embrace, the restrained creature is dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Inchoate Shriek
entries: One creature within 15 feet that can hear the portrait must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is frightened until the end of the portrait's next turn. While the creature is frightened in this way, the portrait's attacks against it have advantage.

action.name: Sacrificial Embrace
entries: The portrait attempts to impale itself upon a creature within 5 feet, forcing the target to make a DC 12 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and is restrained (escape DC 12), and the portrait takes an equal amount of piercing damage.
The portrait maintains this restraint even if it is incapacitated or killed.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the head is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the head remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal trophy head.

trait.name: Unguarded Rear
entries: Whenever the head makes a melee attack, up to one creature within 5 feet other than its target may use its reaction to make an opportunity attack against the head.

action.name: Snarling Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
The head can make this attack as a bonus action against a prone target.

action.name: Toppling Assault (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The head moves up to its speed, then plunges downward, forcing up to one creature whose space it lands in to make a DC 12 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the target takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone, and the head takes no damage.
On a success, the target moves to the nearest unoccupied space and the head takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the coat rack is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the coat rack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal coat rack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The coat rack makes four attacks with its Oakhook Chain-Punch, one of which it can replace with a use of its Coat Call.

action.name: Oakhook Chain-Punch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
A creature hit with three or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Coat Call
entries: The rack regains an expended use of its Coatflare Whirl, then each creature within 30 feet that is wearing a coat, cloak, hat, or mantle must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, one such item the creature is wearing flies to the rack and becomes attached to it (remove DC 12).

action.name: Coatflare Whirl (1/Day)
entries: The rack spins, flinging clinging hats and cloaks at up to four creatures within 10 feet of it and forcing.
Each target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be blinded (Save Ends at beginning of turn). This effect ends early if the rack uses its Coat Call.

reaction.name: Base Trip
entries: When a creature leaves the rack's reach, it can force the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the cupboard is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the cupboard remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cupboard.

trait.name: Delicate Contents
entries: If the cupboard is knocked prone, it takes 9 (2d8) slashing damage and makes 1 fewer attack with its multiattack until it regains all of its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cupboard makes three attacks with its Fling Porcelain, one of which it can replace with a use of its Scraping Slide.

action.name: Fling Porcelain
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
On a miss, the target takes 1 slashing damage.

action.name: Scraping Slide
entries: The cupboard moves up to 15 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature in this way.
Each creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away.
On a success, a target takes half as much damage the cupboard's movement ends.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the clock is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the clock remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal clock.

trait.name: Cog Jam
entries: A creature swallowed by the clock can attempt to jam its gears with a successful DC 10 check with thieves' tools or tinker's tools, stunning it until the end of the clock's next turn on a success.

action.name: Pendulum Slice
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.
On a miss, the clock can make a second attack with this weapon against the same target.

action.name: Crushing Leap
entries: The clock jumps up to 10 feet, and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature.
Each creature whose space it lands in must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and be restrained (escape DC 13) until the clock moves.
On a success, a target takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Open Wide
entries: When a Medium or smaller creature misses the clock with a melee attack, the clock can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the clock (escape DC 16).

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the wardrobe is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the wardrobe remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal wardrobe.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wardrobe makes two attacks with its Questing-Garment Grasp.

action.name: Questing-Garment Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).
A target already grappled by the wardrobe that is hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be swallowed (escape DC 14).

action.name: Wardrobe Change
entries: One creature swallowed by the wardrobe takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage, then must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the wardrobe removes any armor or clothing the creature is wearing and replaces it with a different set of clothing, then expels the creature.

reaction.name: Open Wide
entries: When a Medium or smaller creature misses the clock with a melee attack, the clock can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the clock (escape DC 16).

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the bed is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the bed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal bed.

trait.name: Inviting Form
entries: Medium or smaller creatures can freely enter and move through the bed's space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bed makes three attacks with its Curtain Tendril, one of which it can replace with a use of its Headboard Smash or Swallow Sleeper.

action.name: Curtain Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is dragged up to 5 feet toward the bed.

action.name: Headboard Smash
entries: Each other creature in the bed's space must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally dazed until the end of the bed's next turn.

action.name: Swallow Sleeper
entries: One dazed or incapacitated creature that is grappled by the bed is drawn into its mattress and swallowed (escape DC 15).
The swallowed creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the bed's turns.

reaction.name: Shin Scoop
entries: When a creature enters a space within 5 feet of the bed, the bed can force it to succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or tumble onto the bed and be grappled (escape DC 15).

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the carriage is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the carriage remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal carriage.

trait.name: Selective Passage
entries: When a creature attempts to exit the carriage, the carriage can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

• The creature is grappled (escape DC 16) until the beginning of its next turn.
  • The creature is pushed up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Collect Passenger
entries: The carriage lurches to grasp a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be drawn into the carriage.  A creature can willingly fail this saving throw.

action.name: Doomride Rush
entries: The carriage moves up to its speed in a straight line, and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space the carriage enters in this way must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Spiteful Crash
entries: When the carriage moves within 5 feet of a wall or similar solid, vertical surface, it can take 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet it moved directly toward that surface this turn.
If it does, each creature in the carriage must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take an equal amount of damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the cauldron is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the cauldron remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cauldron.

trait.name: Boiling Brew
entries: The cauldron gains 1 level of heat whenever it takes any fire damage, to a maximum of 4, gaining the following cumulative effects.

1. Quivering. The cauldron's attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage for each level of heat it has.
  2. Simmering. The cauldron can use its Fire Up as a bonus action.
  3. Roiling. The cauldron's flying speed is increased by 5 feet for each level of heat it has.
  4. Superheated. Any attack that hits the cauldron becomes a critical.

action.name: Blistering Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Up
entries: The cauldron's gains one level of heat.

reaction.name: Scalding Slosh (Simmering or hotter)
entries: When the cauldron is hit with a melee attack, it can force one creature within 5 feet other than the attacker to make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage for each level of heat the cauldron has.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the chandelier is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the chandelier remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal chandelier.

trait.name: Mooring Chain
entries: A 40 foot long chain dangles beneath the chandelier. A creature grasping the chain is considered attached to the chandelier, and can spend half its movement to make a contested Strength (Athletics) check, dragging the chandelier up to 30 feet toward it on a success.

action.name: Crystal Shard Volley
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 40 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage.
On a miss, the chandelier can make a second attack against a creature directly behind the first target.

action.name: Chain Fling
entries: One creature that is grasping the chandelier's Mooring Chain must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be flung up to 30 feet.

reaction.name: Crystalline Drop
entries: When a creature enters a space directly beneath the chandelier, the chandelier can crash down onto it, forcing each creature whose space it lands in to make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet the chandelier fell and is knocked prone, and the chandelier takes no damage from falling.
On a success, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the swarm is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the swarm remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal swarm.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Fine creature.

action.name: Clattering Assault
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target swallowed by the clock. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

reaction.name: Cutlery Call
entries: The swarm targets a creature it can see within 30 feet that is carrying a dagger. Each nonmagical dagger the creature is carrying leaps into motion and joins the swarm, and the swarm regains 5 hit points for each dagger that joined it in this way.
A creature wielding an affected dagger can make a DC 12 Strength saving throw, preventing that dagger from animating on a success.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the rug is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

action.name: Smothering Wrap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 13).
While grappled in this way, the target is blinded and choking. If the rug has fewer than 28 hit points, the creature can attempt to escape this grapple as a bonus action.

action.name: Wild Thrash
entries: The rug thrashes wildly, lurching 15 feet in a random direction. Then, the rug and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Rug Pull
entries: When initiative is rolled, the rug can force each creature that is standing on it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone and reroll its initiative, taking the lower of the two rolls.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the rug is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rug makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Wild Thrash.

action.name: Smothering Wrap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).
While grappled in this way, the target is blinded and choking. If the rug has fewer than 42 hit points, the creature can attempt to escape this grapple as a bonus action.

action.name: Wild Thrash
entries: The rug thrashes wildly, lurching 15 feet in a random direction. Then, the rug and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Rug Pull
entries: When initiative is rolled, the rug can force each creature that is standing on it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone and reroll its initiative, taking the lower of the two rolls.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: If the chair is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the chair remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal chair.

action.name: Leg Smack
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tip Over
entries: A creature sitting in the chair must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone and fall out of the chair.

name: Xorn Minewaif
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Buoyant Burrower
entries: If the xorn is burrowing at the end of its turn, it is immediately expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Awkward Gnaw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
On a missed attack, the xorn falls prone.

action.name: Spinning Claw Fury
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the xorn must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Ducking Dive
entries: When the xorn would make a saving throw against an effect that did not target it, it may immediately move up to its burrow speed.
If it ends this movement outside the spell's area, the xorn is unaffected by it.

name: Earthmaw Xorn
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Flesh-Sickened
entries: While it has a dead or unconscious creature grappled in its Dorsal Maw, the xorn is poisoned.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals and stones within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The xorn makes three attacks with its Scrabbling Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Devour Weapon.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or drop one object it is carrying.

action.name: Dorsal Maw
entries: The xorn emerges into the space of a creature within 5 feet it is burrowing beneath, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 14), or move into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A creature grappled in this way takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage at the beginning of each of the xorn's turns.

action.name: Devour Weapon
entries: The xorn eats one weapon within 5 feet of it that isn't worn or carried, gaining 13 (3d8) temporary hit points.
While the xorn has any of these temporary hit points, its attacks deal an additional die of damage and gain any magical effects the weapon had.

reaction.name: Sink into Stone (1/Day)
entries: When the xorn is reduced below 36 hit points, it may move up to half its burrow speed.

name: Diamondhide Xorn
resist: piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical sources that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Crystalline Armor
entries: Whenever the xorn takes 15 or more acid or bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 19, until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Flesh-Sickened
entries: While it has a dead or unconscious creature grappled in its Dorsal Maw, the xorn is poisoned.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals and stones within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The xorn makes three attacks with its Scrabbling Claws.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or drop one object it is carrying.

action.name: Dorsal Maw
entries: The xorn emerges into the space of a creature within 5 feet it is burrowing beneath, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 16), or move into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A creature grappled in this way takes 21 (6d6) piercing damage at the beginning of each of the xorn's turns.

bonus.name: Devour Weapon
entries: The xorn eats one weapon within 5 feet of it that isn't worn or carried, gaining 13 (3d8) temporary hit points.
While the xorn has any of these temporary hit points, its attacks deal an additional die of damage and gain any magical effects the weapon had.

bonus.name: Strip Armor
entries: One creature grappled in the xorn's Dorsal Maw must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, one piece of nonmagical metal armor the creature is wearing takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers as part of it is torn away.

reaction.name: Sink into Stone (1/Day)
entries: When the xorn is reduced below 70 hit points, it may move up to half its burrow speed.

name: Magmin Firebug
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature and flammable object within 5 feet of it begins burning (1d10).

trait.name: Molten Body
entries: If the magmin takes any cold damage, it is petrified at the end of its next turn.
Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the magmin melts and warps if it is not petrified. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Burning Touch (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target begins burning (1d10).

reaction.name: Cackling Caprice
entries: When the magmin is missed with a melee attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Magmin Pyroclast
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

entries: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature and flammable object within 5 feet of it begins burning (1d10).

trait.name: Molten Body

Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the magmin melts and warps if it is not petrified. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

trait.name: Aura of Dancing Flames
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the magmin that is burning has disadvantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Magmin makes two attacks with its Burning Touch, one of which it may replace with a use of its Flaming Panic, if available.

action.name: Burning Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Flaming Panic (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The magmin stokes the flames around it to ever greater heights and brightness. Each creature creature within 30 feet of the magmin that is burning takes 10 (3d6) fire damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up its speed in a direction of the magmin's choice.

action.name: Magmatic Division (1/Day)
entries: The magmin crams as much earth and rock into itself as it can, darkening and growing larger as it does. At the beginning of its next turn, the magmin dies and seperates into 5 new Magmin Firebugs, which act on its turn.

reaction.name: Cackling Caprice
entries: When the magmin is missed with a melee attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Cinder Dance
entries: When a burning creature ends its turn within 30 feet of the magmin, the magmin can force another creature within 10 feet of that creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or begin burning (1d10).

trait.name: Boulder Guise
entries: While fully withdrawn into its shell, the geonid can't see and is indistinguishable from a small boulder.

trait.name: Stone Tell
entries: When the geonid touches a stone, it learns the number and type of creatures that have passed within 10 feet of it in the past 24 hours.

action.name: Furtive Snatch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 11).
While it has a creature grappled in this way, the geonid can't target another creature with attacks or abilities.
If the target was already grappled by the geonid, the geonid may instead steal one object it is carrying but not wielding.

action.name: Grinding Mouthstones
entries: One creature restrained by the geonid's Drag In ability must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Crush Toes
entries: The geonid lurches its shell heavily onto a creature grappled by it, forcing it to succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonus.name: Drag In
entries: The geonid attempts to drag a prone creature grappled by it partially into its shell, forcing it to succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 11).

A Small or smaller creature that fails this saving throw is dragged fully into the shell, and while restrained in this way is blinded, makes checks to escape at disadvantage, and the geonid has vulnerability to damage dealt by it.

trait.name: Elemental Balance
entries: Whenever the unraveler takes damage of a type it is resistant to, its elemental balance is disrupted, granting the following effects until it takes damage of another type it is resistant to, or until it uses its Restore Balance action:

• The unraveler's attacks deal an additional 2d6 of the triggering damage type.
  • The unraveler becomes immune to the triggering damage type.
  • The unraveler cannot use its Disjoin Soul action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unraveler makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Disjoin Soul or Restore Balance, if available.

action.name: Omnimental Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) cold plus 7 (2d6) fire plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Disjoin Soul
entries: One creature within 10 feet that the unraveler can see must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be cursed.
A creature cursed in this way begins to unravel into its raw elemental components, and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or take 9 (2d8) force damage.

A creature that succeeds on 3 of these saving throws has the effect abate for 24 hours, after which it returns and the creature must save against it anew. A creature killed by this damage collapses into a loose pile of water and minerals.

action.name: Restore Balance (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The unraveler restores itself to perfect order, ending any spells or magical effect on itself, and any ongoing effects from its Elemental Balance trait.

reaction.name: Disjoin Weapon
entries: When the unraveler is hit with nonmagical melee weapon attack, the unraveler can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or have the weapon disintegrate in its grasp, separating into its component elements.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Terror Dive
entries: If the pterafolk is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Scrabbleclaw Flurry (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Flocking Dart
entries: When the pterafolk is targeted with an attack by a creature it can see, it can change the attack's target to a different pterafolk within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Attack Sequence
entries: If the pterafolk hits a creature with a melee attack and then leaves its reach, attacks by other pterafolk against that creature have advantage until the beginning of the pterafolk's next turn.

trait.name: Terror Dive
entries: If the pterafolk is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pterafolk makes two attacks with its Claw Rake.

action.name: Claw Rake
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Hurl Stone (Recharges when the pterafolk ends its turn on the ground)
entries: One creature directly beneath the pterafolk must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Battering Wings (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The pterafolk beats its wings, sending a flurry of air and debris forward in a 10 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls prone, additionally. The pterafolk's speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Swoop
entries: When the pterafolk is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can impose disadvantage on the attack and move up to half its fly speed.

trait.name: Attack Sequence

trait.name: Terror Dive

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Slipnoose
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 12). While a creature grappled in this way is carried aloft by the pterafolk, it is restrained and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Hurl Stone (Recharges when the pterafolk ends its turn on the ground)

reaction.name: Sudden Drop
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a creature it has grappled, the pterafolk releases the grapple. The attacker must reroll the attack, taking the lower of the two rolls.

reaction.name: Swoop

trait.name: Tongue-Hearing
entries: While the yrthak has a creature grappled, the range of its blindsight is reduced to 15 feet.

action.name: Shoveljaw Snap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 17).

action.name: Resonation Chamber
entries: A humming whistle begins to build in the yrthak's horn-like protrusion. At the beginning of the yrthak's next turn, it chooses one of the following effects:

items.name: Sonic Lance
entries: A magically focused stream of vibrations bursts forth in a 60 foot long line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

items.name: Stoneburst
entries: The yrthak sonically shatters the earth in a 10 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (8d6) piercing damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Swoop
entries: When the yrthak is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can sense with its blindsight, the yrthak can impose disadvantage on the attack and moves up to half its fly speed.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal, albeit dead, tree.

trait.name: Deadwood Core
entries: Whenever the treant deals bludgeoning damage with a melee attack, it loses an equal amount of hit points. The treant cannot recover hit points by any means.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the treant takes any fire damage, it begins burning (1d10). While it is burning, attacks against the treant are made at advantage, the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Splintering Swing
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Slivered Shrapnel
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack that deals slashing damage, the treant forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the treant's next turn.

reaction.name: Toppling Vengenace
entries: When the treant drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to fall onto a creature within 10 feet before dying.
The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone and be restrained under the treant's corpse (escape DC 15), or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

name: Brasswood Treant
resist: bludgeoning and piercing damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal brasswood tree.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check, climbing onto it on a success. A creature climbing on the treant has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Sun-Soaked
entries: In bright sunlight, the treant gleams as though made of precious metals, reflecting glaring light in a 10 foot radius.
A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two attacks with its Earthshaking Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Sundrip.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Sundrip
entries: One creature within 20 feet of the treant must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a drop of sunsap. Until a creature takes an action to remove it, the creature takes 9 (2d8) radiant damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Grasping Roots (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succceed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 16) until the end of the treant's next turn. A creature that was already prone makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Kindled Lifeblood
entries: As a reaction to taking any fire or radiant damage, the treant uses its Sundrip against a creature in range.

name: Stronghollow Treant
resist: bludgeoning and piercing damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Greenweald Vitality
entries: At the end of each of its turns, nomagical fires within 10 feet of the treant are doused and each condition affecting it ends.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two attacks with its Earthshaking Slam and uses its Sprite Mischief.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Sprite Mischief
entries: The sprites that lair in the treant scamper invisibly, targeting a creature within 30 feet of the treant with one of the following effects:

items.name: Trick Trinket
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or become unattuned from one magic item is carrying.

items.name: Slip From Mind
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or forget the last spell it cast until it completes a short or long rest.

items.name: Distracting Tickle
entries: The creature has disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes on its following turn.

action.name: Safeguard Soul (1/Day)
entries: The treant secures a portion of the life essence of a willing fey creature within 5 feet inside of its trunk. Whenever the creature takes damage, it reduces that damage by 10, and the treant loses hit points equal to the damage prevented.
When the treant dies, each creature whose essence it carries must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or gain 2d6 levels of exhaustion, or half as much on a success.

resist: bludgeoning and piercing damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Rootspeech
entries: While in its home forest, the treant knows the number, type, and approximate location of each creature within 10 miles of it.

Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Hurl Stone
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone.

bonus.name: Hurl Creature
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

bonus.name: Grasping Roots (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succceed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 18) until the end of the treant's next turn. A creature that was already prone makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Forest Allies
entries: As a reaction to a creature that is within 10 feet of a mundane tree hitting the treant with a ranged attack, the treant magically impels the tree to make an Earthshaking Slam attack against the attacker, using the treant's statistics.

trait.name: Bladeridge Bark
entries: A creature that climbs onto the treant or makes a saving throw to avoid falling off takes 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

trait.name: Locust-Thorn Limbs
entries: The treant has four limbs (AC 20; 40 HP), each of which can grapple a single creature. Destroying a limb deals no damage to the treant, which regrows all lost limbs when it completes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bladeridge Bite.

action.name: Bladeridge Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be swallowed (escape DC 18).
A creature swallowed in this way takes 9 (2d8) slashing damage whenever it takes an action, and may attempt to escape as a reaction whenever the treant uses this attack.

action.name: Locust-Thorn Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).
A creature grappled in this way loses 5 hit points and is dragged up to 30 feet toward the treant at the start of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Ironplum Bushel Fling
entries: The treant hurls a cluster of ironplums at a point it can see within 60 feet, rolling a d4 to determine the effect:

items.name: 1: Unripe
entries: The ironplums scatter in a 15 foot cone emanating from the point of impact. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

items.name: 2 - 3: Ripe
entries: The ironplums shatter explosively in a 15 foot radius spray of shrapnel. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) fire plus 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

items.name: 4: Overripe
entries: The ironplums burst, exuding a foul stench reminiscent of carrion in a 15 foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned until the end of the treant's next turn.

name: Widowmaker Treant
resist: bludgeoning and piercing damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: False Appearance

trait.name: Bark Titan
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half its movmeent to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check, climbing 15 feet up the treant on a success.
While climbing on the treant at least 40 feet above the ground, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant can't target the creature with its Timber Stomp.

trait.name: Rootspeech
entries: While in its home forest, the treant knows the number, type, and approximate location of each creature within 10 miles of it.

trait.name: Flammable Crown
entries: If the treant takes 20 or more fire damage from a source that could reach its lower canopy (40 feet above the ground), it begins burning (1d10). If the treant was already burning, the burning damage increases by 1d10.
While it is burning, attacks against the treant are made at advantage, and the treant's melee attacks deal additional fire damage equal to its burning damage.

trait.name: Strength of Ages
entries: If the treant fails a saving throw against any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, alter its form, or reduce its speed, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two attacks with its Timber Stomp, each of which it may replace with a use of its Drop Widowmaker Seedcone.

action.name: Timber Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, plus an additional 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage if the target was prone.
On a hit or miss, the target and each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Drop Widowmaker Seedcone
entries: The treant drops an enormous seedcone from one of its high branches. One creature within 20 feet of the treant must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Sonorous Growth (Recharge 6, Concentration)
entries: The treant begins a slow and groaning chant in old treeish. When the treant uses this ability and at the beginning of each of its turns for the next minute, it may cause a size Huge nonmagical tree to burst from the earth at a point it can see within 120 feet.
Each creature in the tree's space is pushed 80 feet into the air, then may make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to catch hold of the tree's canopy and avoid falling.

bonus.name: Crumple Iron
entries: One creature wearing nonmagical metal armor that the treant hit with two Timber Stomp attacks this turn must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature's armor takes a permanent and cumulative penalty to the AC it offers equal to amount the creature failed by. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 in this way is destroyed.

bonus.name: Tear Stone
entries: The treant smashes through a barrier of nonmagical stone or softer material of up to 15 feet thick.
Each creature on the other side of the barrier within 20 feet of the treant takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Chittering Throng
entries: A mass of angry squirrels swarms over the treant's branches, forcing each creature climbing on the treant to succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall off.

reaction.name: The Boughs Shake
entries: As a reaction to taking 15 or more damage from a single source, the treant uses its Drop Widowmaker Seedcone ability.

entries: The bakunawa makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its Luminous Bite.

action.name: Luminous Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be swallowed.

While swallowed, the target's attacks bypass the bakunawa's resistances and it takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the bakunawa's turns. If the bakunawa takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the bakunawa regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Wriggling Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. Before or after making this attack, the bakunawa may move up to a quarter of its speed.

action.name: Horn Flash (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bakunawa's horns flash with stored moonlight. Each creature within 30 feet that can see the bakunawa must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) radiant damage and be blinded until the end of the bakunawa's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the bakunawa forces each creature within 15 feet to succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Bark-Breaker
entries: If the axe mad moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a logging axe attack on the same turn, the attack ignores the target's damage resistances

action.name: Logging Axe (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 slashing damage. This attack deals an an additional 1 slashing damage to a prone target.

bonus.name: Axe-Mad
entries: As a bonus action, the axe-mad can move up to its speed toward a plant or plant creature that it can see.

reaction.name: Savage Demise
entries: When the axe-mad drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to make a single attack before falling unconscious.

trait.name: Spell-Resistant Hide
entries: The branchbreaker has resistance to damage from spells of 3rd level or below.

action.name: Polesaw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage. This attack is made at disadvantage gainst a creature within 5 feet.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The branchbreaker attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 4 (1d8) damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

bonus.name: Juggernaut
entries: The branchbreaker may attempt to shove a creature as a bonus action. If it moves 20 feet before attempting to shove a creature, the branchbreaker has advantage on the contested check, and on a success the target is knocked prone and pushed 10 feet back.

trait.name: Coercive
entries: While the wagedriver is conscious, allied creatures that can see it will not flee or surrender.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wagedriver uses its Work Song and makes one melee attack.

action.name: Weighted Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing plus 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Work Song
entries: Until the end of the wagedriver's next turn, melee weapon attacks made by all creatures within 30 feet deal an additional 4 (1d8) damage.
Whenever a creature affected by the work song rolls a 1 to hit with an attack, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting itself.

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the forces, the wagedriver forces it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and lose concentration, if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Lead From the Rear
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the wagedriver causes the attack to instead hit an allied creature within 5 ft.

trait.name: Respirator
entries: The blightcaster is immune to damage from inhaled toxins while it wears its respirator. If the blightcaster suffers a critical hit, its respirator breaks.

trait.name: Cunning
entries: The blightcaster has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

action.name: Sprayer Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Blight Torrent (Recharge 5-6, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The blightcaster spews a toxic, defoliating fog from its hand sprayer in a 30 ft. cone that heavily obscures its area and lasts until the end of the blightcaster's next turn. Nonmagical plants in the area wither and die.
A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A plant creature makes this saving throw with disadvantage, and takes maximum damage on a failed save.

trait.name: High Tolerance
entries: If the rifler is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, the rifler instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Cunning
entries: The rifler has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rifler makes two attacks, either of which it may replace with a use of its Ignite Weapon.

action.name: Rifle Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dart Rifle
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: The target suffers one effect of the rifler's choice.

items.name: Stimulant Dart
entries: The target gains advantage on all melee attack rolls and attack rolls against it have advantage until the end of the rifler's next turn.

items.name: Motivator Dart
entries: The target becomes immune to the charmed and frightened conditions for the next minute.

items.name: Blight Dart
entries: The target takes 9 (2d8) poison and 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

items.name: Strikebreaker Dart (Recharge 5-6)
entries: If the target dies in the next minute, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) poison and 14 (4d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Ignite Weapon
entries: The rifler smears a volitile grease on the weapon of one creature within 5 feet, which then ignites. For the next minute, melee attacks made with the weapon deal an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

name: Nihileth
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The nihileth does not require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Infecting Telepathy
entries: If a creature communicates telepathically with the nihileth, or uses a psychic attack against it, the nihileth can spread its disease to the creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or become infected with the same disease caused by the nihileth's tentacle attack.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the nihileth to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the nihileth drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Void Aura
entries: The nihileth is surrounded by a chilling cloud. A living creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the nihileth must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be slowed until the start of its next turn. In addition, any creature that has been diseased by a nihileth or a nihilethic zombie takes 7 (2d6) cold damage every time it starts its turn within the aura.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nihilith makes three attacks with its Tentacle or Withering Touch.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute; during that time, it can be removed by lesser restoration or comparable magic. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy. The creature cannot regain hit points unless it is entirely underwater, and the disease can only be removed by heal or comparable magic. Unless the creature is fully submerged or frequently doused with water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes. If a creature dies while diseased, it rises in 1d6 rounds as a nihilethic zombie. This zombie is permanently dominated by the nihileth.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6+4) necrotic damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Enslave (3/Day)
entries: The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

reaction.name: Void Body
entries: When the nihileth would take damage, it can reduce the damage to 0, unless it is radiant damage, in which case it reduces the damage by half.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
entries: The aboleth makes one tail attack.

legendary.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

name: Nihilithic Zombie
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the zombie starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, unless it took radiant damage or a critical hit since its last turn. On a success, the zombie gains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

trait.name: Sudden Lunge
entries: The zombie's attacks have a reach of 10 feet for the purposes of making opportunity attacks. When it makes an opportunity attack, it moves up to 5 feet towards its target as part of the attack.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute; during that time, it can be removed by bless, lesser restoration or comparable magic. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy. The creature cannot regain hit points unless it is entirely underwater, and the disease can only be removed by heal or comparable magic. Unless the creature is fully submerged or frequently doused with water, it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes. If a creature dies while diseased, it rises in 1d6 rounds as a nihilethic zombie. This zombie is permanently dominated by the nihileth that controls the attacking zombie.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) necrotic damage.

action.name: Sacrifice Life
entries: The zombie sacrifices itself to heal a nihilith within 30 feet of it.  Its hit points are reduced to 0, and the nihilith is healed by an equal amoung.

reaction.name: Void Body
entries: When the zombie would take damage that is not radiant damage, it can reduce the damage by 1d12.

trait.name: Keen Scent
entries: The agropelter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on scent, and can detect the presence of creatures up to 120 ft. away.

trait.name: Boscage Brachiation
entries: The agropelter grappler doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach by climbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The agropelter makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks, or it makes three Rock Throw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit. reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the tentacle can't be used to attack a different target. The agropelter has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target. When the agropelter moves, it can drag a Medium or smaller target it is grappling at full speed.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 120/360 ft., one target. Hit: (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Juggernaut
entries: The blemmyes may attempt to shove a creature as a bonus action. If it moves 20 feet before attempting to shove a creature, the ogre has advantage on the contested check, and on a success the target is knocked prone and pushed 10 feet back.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the blemmyes can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it falls prone and is stunned until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Carnivorous Compulsion
entries: If it can see an incapacitated creature, the blemmyes must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom save or be compelled to move toward that creature and attack it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blemmyes makes three melee attacks, one of which can be with its Bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller incapacitated creature, that creature is swallowed. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects from outside the blemmyes, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the blemmyes' turns. If the blemmyes takes 20 damage or more during a single turn from a creature inside it, the blemmyes must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of the blemmyes. The blemmyes can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the blemmyes dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Haymaker
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Rock
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The blemmyes attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

name: Titivilius, Right Hand of the Second
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Titivilius is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Titivilius has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Meld with Text
entires: Titivillus can enter any book, scroll, or other written material and remain hidden there as long as he wishes. If the text is damaged or destroyed, he is ejected from it without suffering damage.

trait.name: Fear Aura
entires: Any creature hostile to Titivillus that starts its turn within 20 feet of him must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, unless Titivillus is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, it is immune to his Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Trust Aura
entires: Titivillus projects a 25-foot-radius trust aura. As long as Titivillus is talking, creatures in that area find his utterances so fascinating and compelling that they're affected as if by a sanctuary spell (affected creatures must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of their turns; if the saving throw fails, they can't attack Titivillus directly until the start of their next turn). This effect ends immediately and can't be renewed for 1 minute if Titivillus attacks physically.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Titivilius fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Titivilius makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Hellfire Bolt (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +15 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 65 (10d12) fire damage plus 33 (6d10) necrotic damage; a successful DC 20 Dexterity saving throw halves thunder damage.

legendary.name: Claws
entries: Titivilius makes a Claw attack.

legendary.name: Devil's Mark
entries: Titivillus sprays magical ink from his fingertips at a single target within 30 feet. The target must make a successful DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or receive a devil's mark: a tattoo in the shape of Titivillus' personal seal.
All devils have advantage when they make spell or spell-like attacks against the devil-marked creature, and the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against such attacks.

The mark can be removed by remove curse if the caster also makes a successful DC 23 spellcasting check. The mark reveals itself as desecrated to detect evil and good. It often shifts its position on the body, especially when it's concealed (and usually at the most inconvenient moment). Because such marks are sometimes placed on those who've made pacts with devils, paladins and clerics might assume that any character bearing a devil's mark is in league with evil forces.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions).
entries: Titivillus casts a spell from his list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

trait.name: Single Minded Focus
entries: When initiative is rolled, the fellforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the fellforged makes each turn against that creature is made at advantage.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the fellforged has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Unnatural Aura
entries: All animals, whether wild or domesticated, can sense the unnatural presence of fellforged at a distance of 30 feet. They do not willingly approach nearer than that and panic if forced to do so, and they remain panicked as long as they are within that range.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fellforged makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Necrotic Slam.

action.name: Retractable Armblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Necrotic Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the total damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

bonus.name: Violent Shrieking
entries:
The mechanisms of the fellforged shudder in a violent manner. Flywheels become unbalanced, gears shatter, and springs snap. Creatures within 5 feet of the fellforged must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

Each use of this ability reduces the fellforged's movement speed by 5 feet. If its speed is reduced to 0, it becomes paralyzed.

name: Castigas
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The castigas' innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The castigas makes two melee attacks, only one of which may be with its Bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained. Only two targets can be grappled by the automata devil at one time, and each grappled target prevents one whip from being used to attack.
An individual target can be grappled by only one whip at a time. A grappled target takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage at the start of its turn.

action.name: Punishing Maw
entries: Each of the creatures grappled by the castigas and the devil must make contested Strength (Athletics) checks. If the grappled creature succeeds, it takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage and remains grappled. If the devil succeeds, the grappled creature is dragged into the devil's stomach maw, a mass of churning gears, razor teeth, and whirling blades.

The creature takes 49 (4d20 + 7) slashing damage and is grappled, and the whip is free to attack again on the devil's next turn. The creature takes another 49 (4d20 + 7) slashing damage automatically at the start of each of the castigas' turns for as long as it remains grappled in the maw. Only one creature can be grappled in the punishing maw at a time. The castigas can freely spit out a creature or corpse (no action required), to free up the maw for another victim.

action.name: Fear Aura
entries: The castigas radiates fear in a 10-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the affected area must make a successful DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened. A creature that makes the save successfully cannot be affected by the same automata devil's fear aura again.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The wasgo has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that isn't at maximum hit points.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
