entries: The porcubear makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) slashing damage as the porcubear rips into the target.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Anaerobic Nature
entries: The shoggoth doesn't require air.

trait.name: Absorb Flesh
entries: When the shoggoth kills a creature while within 15 feet of it, the creature's body is absorbed into the shoggoth's. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a wish spell.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shoggoth can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Hideous Cacophony
entries: The shoggoth's many mouths constantly emit whistles, fluting, and other high-pitched noises. It has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to be unheard. Each creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the shoggoth and that can hear it must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented until the start of its next turn. A disoriented creature is incapacitated, and when it moves, it moves in a random direction.

Unless surprised, a creature can cover its ears to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't hear until the start of its next turn, when it can cover its ears again. If the creature uncovers its ears in the meantime while within 60 feet of the shoggoth, it must immediately make the save. A creature that is covering its ears and that has access to cloth, wax, or similar material can stuff its ears with the material as a bonus action to free up its hands, deafening itself while the material remains stuffed in its ears.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The shoggoth has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Limited Mutability
entries: Any spell or effect that would alter the shoggoth's form alters it for only 1 round. Afterward, the shoggoth returns to its amorphous blob form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoggoth makes four Slam attacks. It can replace two Slam attacks with a use of Crush.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18) if it is a Large or smaller creature.

action.name: Crush
entries: The shoggoth crushes up to two creatures it is grappling by rolling them beneath its bulk. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, be unable to breathe, and be restrained until the grapple ends. If the shoggoth moves, a creature beneath it is no longer restrained and is able to breathe, but it remains grappled.

trait.name: Detect Lies
entries: The suturefly knows if it hears a lie and can pinpoint the location of a creature within 60 feet of it that lied within the last minute.

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: The suturefly has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

action.name: Sew
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or the suturefly sews the target's mouth, nose, or one of its eyes closed (the suturefly's choice). With supernatural speed, the suturefly repeatedly pierces the target's face, each time threading a loop of the target's own skin through the previous hole. These skin loops rapidly blacken, shrink, and draw the orifice tightly closed. If a target's mouth is sewn shut, it can't speak. If its mouth and nose are sewn shut, it can't breathe, and if both eyes are sewn shut, it is blinded. A creature, including the target, can take its action to cut open one of the sewn orifices by succeeding on a DC 12 Dexterity check with an edged weapon or tool.

name: Uraeus
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The uraeus doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The uraeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned, the target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spit Fire
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) fire damage.

action.name: Searing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The uraeus exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in the area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Ward Bond
entries: The uraeus forms a magical bond with a willing creature within 5 feet of it. While bonded, the uraeus and its ward know the distance and direction to each other and the general state of each other's health, even if the two are on different planes of existence. The bond lasts until the uraeus or its ward dies, until the uraeus ends it as a bonus action, or until the uraeus uses this bonus action to create a bond with another creature.

reaction.name: Bonded Savior
entries: When the uraeus's bonded ward takes damage, the uraeus prevents the ward from taking the damage and loses hp equal to that amount instead, regardless of the type of damage dealt.

name: Valkyrie
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Aura of Valor
entries: Friendly creatures wielding weapons within 30 feet of the valkyrie have advantage on weapon attack rolls and ability checks. At the start of each of its turns, the valkyrie can choose to exclude any number of friendly creatures from this aura (no action required).

trait.name: Immortal Nature
entries: The valkyrie doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The valkyrie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Radiant Weapons
entries: The valkyrie's weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 16 (3d10) radiant damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The valkyrie can use its Gaze of Doom. It then makes two Longsword attacks and one Spear attack, or it makes three Radiant Bolt attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 16 (3d10) radiant damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 16 (3d10) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) radiant damage.

action.name: Gaze of Doom
entries: The valkyrie's gaze foretells a doomed fate for one creature the valkyrie can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
entries: The valkyrie touches another creature. The target magically regains 21 6d6 hp and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

reaction.name: Ascension
entries: When a friendly creature the valkyrie can see and within its Aura of Valor is reduced to 0 hp while engaged in melee combat, the valkyrie can reincarnate the creature as a gladiator. If the gladiator reduces at least three creatures to 0 hp within 1 minute of its reincarnation, it transforms into an einherjar. The valkyrie can provide ascension to up to two creatures each hour with this reaction.

trait.name: Darkness Regeneration
entries: While in an area of dim light or darkness, the voidling regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The voidling has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Void Traveler
entries: The voidling doesn't require air, food, drink, sleep, or ambient pressure.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The voidling makes four Shadow Tendril or Necrotic Bolt attacks. If two Necrotic Bolt attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Shadow Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shadow's Grasp (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The voidling releases a wave of small, grasping tendrils of shadow. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 49 (14d6) necrotic damage and is restrained by tendrils of shadow for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Shrouded Soul
entries: The cultist can't be prevented from lying or compelled to tell the truth through magic.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Sacrificial Blade (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 slashing damage.
If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, one non-minion ally of the cultist within 30 feet gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Rite of Supplication (Group Action, Concentration)
entries: One of the cultist's allies within 60 feet gains a cumulative +1 bonus to its AC and to the damage of its melee attacks, to a maximum of +5.
Whenever the affected ally is hit with an attack, one cultist that took this action drops to 0 hit points.

name: Cult Fanatic of the Reigning Serpent

trait.name: Shrouded Soul
entries: The cultist can't be prevented from lying or compelled to tell the truth through magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes two attacks with its Dark Scepter.

action.name: Dark Scepter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) psychic damage.
If the cultist is in darkness or dim light, this attack is made at advantage.

action.name: Perdition Flame
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.
If the target takes any hostile action before the end of its next turn, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the effect ends.

bonus.name: Invocation of Deepest Shadow (1st Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that is in dim light or darkness becomes invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it becomes illuminated by bright light.

bonus.name: Startling Glimpse (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The cultist touches a creature, forcing it to make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target must use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against a target other than itself of the cultist's choice. If the target can't use its reaction, it falls prone.

name: Hazvongel Crourjay
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Fickle Resistance
entries: The hazvongel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that do not impose the charmed condition.

trait.name: Wandering Eye
entries: The hazvongel has disadvantage on attacks against any creature it hit with an attack on its previous turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hazvongel makes four attacks.

action.name: Talon Stampede
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the hazvongel can knock the target prone or grapple it (escape DC 18).

action.name: Bloodrot Barbs
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage.

action.name: Blood Deluge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hazvongel flies up to half its speed, raining corrupted ichor from its wings. Each creature the hazvongel flies over in this way must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 47 (6d8 + 20) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: False Fall
entries: When the hazvongel is hit with a ranged attack, it can fall prone. The first time a creature moves within 10 feet of the hazvongel before the start of its next turn, the hazvongel can leap to its feet and make an attack with its Talon Stampede.

name: Hazvongel Gorelord
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Wandering Eye
entries: The hazvongel has disadvantage on attacks against any creature it hit with an attack on its previous turn.

trait.name: Demonic Purge (3/Day)
entries: The hazvongel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. At the start of each of its turns, it can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses this advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hazvongel makes four attacks, two of which can be with its Jagged Beak.

action.name: Talon Stampede
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the hazvongel can knock the target prone or grapple it (escape DC 21).

action.name: Jagged Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
This attack deals an additional 5 (1d10) damage to a prone target.

action.name: Bloodrot Barbs
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Blood Deluge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hazvongel flies up to half its speed, raining corrupted ichor from its wings. Each creature the hazvongel flies over in this way must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 47 (6d8 + 20) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: False Fall
entries: When the hazvongel is hit with a ranged attack, it can fall prone. The first time a creature moves within 10 feet of the hazvongel before the start of its next turn, the hazvongel can leap to its feet and make an attack with its Talon Stampede.

reaction.name: Murderous Shriek (1/Day)
entries: When the hazvongel is reduced below half of its maximum hit points, it can let out a fierce shriek. For the next minute, it can make one additional attack with its Talon Stampede whenever it takes its Multiattack action.

legendary.name: Crimson Omen
entries: One creature the hazvongel can see within 30 feet that has half its hit points or fewer must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is cursed for 8 hours. While cursed in this way, whenever it falls to 0 hit points, it immediately fails one death saving throw.
This curse can stack, and the target fails additional death saving throws for each stack of the curse it has.

legendary.name: Staggering Spray
entries: The hazvongel beats its wings, sending forth a gust of crimson mist in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area loses its reaction, then must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed up to 15 feet away.

legendary.name: Double Slam (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hazvongel moves up to 15 feet, then makes two attacks at advantage.

name: Myrkul, Lord of Bones
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Keeper of the Dead
entries: Creatures killed by Myrkul can't be returned to life by any means short of divine intervention, unless he allows it.

trait.name: Ossuary Call
entries: Skeletons within 90 feet of Myrkul of his choice use his attack bonus (+17) in place of their own, unless their own is already higher.

trait.name: Invincible Avatar (2/Day)
entries: If Myrkul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If he does, he regains one fewer legendary action on his following turn.
At the end of each of Myrkul's turns, he can end one spell or condition affecting him.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Myrkul makes two attacks with his Scythe of Ages, one of which he can replace with a use of his Maggot Feast, Eternity Reap, or Fray Time.

action.name: Scythe of Ages
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 52 (8d10 + 8) force damage.
This attack deals an additional 11 (2d10) necrotic damage for each level of exhaustion the target has.

action.name: Maggot Feast (7th Level Spell)
entries: Fat white worms spill from the wounds of creatures of Myrkul's choice within 60 feet of him. Each creature must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
If a creature that is poisoned, diseased, or below half of its maximum hit points fails a saving throw against this effect, it is additionally dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Eternity Reap (8th Level Spell)
entries: Myrkul sweeps his scythe in a wide arc, sending forth a wave of shrieking death in a 120 foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) force damage plus 27 (5d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Corpses in the area crumble to dust.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must immediately make three death saving throws.

action.name: Fray Time (8th Level Spell)
entries: Myrkul stretches seconds into days, forcing a creature he can see within 60 feet to make a DC 25 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains 3 (1d4 + 1) levels of exhaustion. On a success, the target gains 1 level of exhaustion.

action.name: Thousand Deaths (9th Level Spell)
entries: A torrent of howling spirits rushes around and through a creature Myrkul can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make three DC 25 Constitution saving throws. If the target fails the first saving throw, it takes 50 (1d100) cold damage. If the target fails the second saving throw, it takes 50 (1d100) psychic damage and is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If the target fails the third saving throw, it takes 50 (1d100) necrotic damage, then dies if it has 50 or fewer hit points.

bonus.name: Draw of the Void
entries: Each creature of Myrkul's choice within 120 feet must make a DC 25 STrength saving throw. On a failed save, a creautre takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage and is dragged up to 60 feet towards Myrkul.

bonus.name: Death Looms
entries: The last creature to hit Myrkul with a melee atack since the end of his last turn gains a level of exhaustion and must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target drops to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Inevitable Approach
entries: Myrkul moves up to his speed, then makes an attack with his Scythe of Ages. This movement can't be impeded or prevented by any means.

legendary.name: Judgement of the False
entries: One creature that Myrkul can see within 60 feet must make a DC 25 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the next time the target takes any amount of damage, it takes twice as much damage.
Creatures who have at least one level in a class or subclass that can use Divine spells are immune to this effect.

legendary.name: Unearth Attendants
entries: Myrkul conjures three Necromite Reapers that act on initiative count 0 in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet.

trait.name: One With Death
entries: When the necromite is reduced to 0 hit points, each other undead creature within 10 feet of it regains 10 hit points.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The necromite can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it.

action.name: Death's Head Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

action.name: Gravefrost (Cantrip)
entries: A creeping chill envelops a creature the necromite can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 5 (2d4) cold damage, plus an additional 11 (2d10) necrotic damage if it is below half of its maximum hit points.

reaction.name: Death Throes (1st Level Spell)
entries: When one of the necromite's allies within 30 feet of it is reduced to 0 hit points, the necromite can allow it to use its reaction to make one melee attack.

trait.name: One With Death
entries: When the necromite is reduced to 0 hit points, each other undead creature within 10 feet of it regains 10 hit points.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The necromite can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it.

action.name: Reaper's Greatscythe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target can't regain hit points until the start of the necromite's next turn.

action.name: Haunting Head (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +5 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and a chattering spectral head accosts the target. Until the end of the necromite's next turn or until the target fails a saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from each attack roll and saving throw it makes.

action.name: Invocation of Death Triumphant (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The necromite chatters a deadly curse, forcing a creature within 30 feet to make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes cursed until the end of the necromite's next turn. While cursed in this way, attacks made against the target automatically hit.

trait.name: One With Death
entries: When the necromite is reduced to 0 hit points, each other undead creature within 10 feet of it regains 10 hit points.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The necromite can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it.

trait.name: Reclaim Anima (1/Day)
entries: If the necromite would fail a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead ally within 30 feet to succeed instead, reducing the ally to 0 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The necromite makes two attacks with its Doom Slice.

action.name: Doom Slice
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, this attacks deals an additional 20 force damage and 20 necrotic damage.

action.name: Haunting Head (5th Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and a chattering spectral head accosts the target. Until the end of the necromite's next turn or until the target fails a saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from each attack roll and saving throw it makes.

action.name: Seal of Death's Gate (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the necromite can see wihtin 15 feet must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Danse Macabre (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Up to 5 corpses within 60 feet rise as Skeletons that act on the necromite's turn and under its control. When the spell ends, the skeletons drop to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Invocation of Death Triumphant (3rd Level Spell)

legendary.name: Tombstride (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The necromite turns to dust and crumbles away, then bursts from the earth in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of the space it departed must then make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is blinded until the start of the necromite's next turn.

trait.name: Shrouded Soul
entries: The cultist can't be prevented from lying or compelled to tell the truth through magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Dark Decree, Profane Fate, or Deceiver's Veil.

action.name: Perdition Flame
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.
If the target takes any hostile action before the end of its next turn, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the effect ends.

action.name: Dark Decree (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Magical darkness blooms in a 15-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet of the cultist. This darkness does not impede the vision of the cultist's allies.

action.name: Profane Fate (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the cultist can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be cursed.
Whenever a creature cursed in this way that the cultist can see succeeds on a saving throw, the cultist can end the curse on that creature and cause the creature to fail instead.

action.name: Deceiver's Veil (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Ominous shadows creep at the edges of perception for a creature of the cultist's choice within 60 feet of it for 1 minute. The first time each turn that the target makes an attack, the cultist can force it to make a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the cultist chooses the target for the attack.

bonus.name: Slithering Coils (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each creature in an area of magical darkness created by the cultist is dragged up to 10 feet in a direction of the cultist's choice.

bonus.name: Startling Glimpse (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The cultist touches a creature, forcing it to make a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target must use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against a target other than itself of the cultist's choice. If the target can't use its reaction, it falls prone.

bonus.name: Power Word: Hush (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the cultist can see within 30 feet drops to 0 hit points if it has 10 or fewer hit points. A creature with more than 10 hit points is unaffected.

entries: The cultist can't be prevented from lying or compelled to tell the truth through magic.

trait.name: Insidious Shift (2/Day)
entries: At the end of each of the cultist's turns, it can teleport to exchange places with a creature within 30 feet, and can transfer one condition or spell affecting it to the teleported creature.
An unwilling creature can make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw to resist the effect.

At the end of each of the target's turns, and whenever it takes damage, it can make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends.

action.name: Shackles of Agony (6th Level Spell)

On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and is paralyzed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a success, the target takes half as much damage and is dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Shadow Flash (2nd Level Spell)

legendary.name: Punishing Stride
entries: The cultist teleports up to 15 feet and uses its Perdition Flame.

legendary.name: Shatter Magic (5th Level Spell)
entries: The cultist attempts to end one spell effect within 60 feet, forcing the caster to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends and the caster takes 5 (1d10) force damage per level of the spell.

legendary.name: Hurl Through Hell (Costs 2 Actions)

action.name: Heartstop (Recharge 5-6, 8th Level Spell)

legendary.name: Hurl Through Hell (Costs 2 Actions)

On a failed save, the target takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and disappears until the end of the cultist's next turn, when it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space to where it left.

trait.name: Leaping Pounce
entries: If the war ostrich jumps at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the ostrich can make one Beak attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The war ostrich's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Intimidating Screech
entries: The war ostrich screeches at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, as the screech rattles it.

bonus.name: Skittish
entries: The war ostrich takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire dogmole takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Burrowed Tunnels
entries: If the dogmole burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 5-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dogmole makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Wormkiller Rage
entries: When the dogmole takes damage from a Small or larger insectoid Beast, such as a giant centipede, or when it deals damage to such a creature, it enters a special rage for 3 rounds. While in this rage, it has advantage on attack rolls and Strength checks and deals an extra 15 (3d8 + 3) piercing damage with its Bite attack, but its Armor Class is reduced by 2. The dogmole can't end this rage willingly.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire dogmole juggernaut takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Burrowed Tunnels
entries: If the juggernaut burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 10-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Stout
entries: The juggernaut has advantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws made against effects that would push it or knock it prone.

trait.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the juggernaut takes 15 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hp, it is reduced to 1 hp instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dogmole juggernaut makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. it: 18 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Wormkiller Rage
entries: When the juggernaut takes damage from a Small or larger insectoid Beast, such as a giant centipede, or when it deals damage to such a creature, it enters a special rage for 3 rounds. While in this rage, it has advantage on attack rolls and Strength checks and deals an extra 22 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage with its Bite attack, but its Armor Class is reduced by 2. The juggernaut can't end this rage willingly.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire angler worm takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Keen Touch
entries: The angler worm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on vibrations.

trait.name: Snare Walker
entries: The angler worm ignores movement restrictions caused by its snares or the snares of other angler worms.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The angler worm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Transparent Trap
entries: With 10 minutes of work, the angler worm can create a web of nearly transparent snares in a 20-foot cube. The web must be anchored between two solid masses or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling. A web of snares layered over a flat surface has a depth of 5 feet. The web is difficult terrain, and the snares forming it are nearly transparent, requiring a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice them.

A creature that starts its turn in the web of snares or enters the web during its turn must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the sticky snares. A creature restrained by the snares can use its action to free itself by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angler worm makes two Bite attacks or one Bite attack and one Coils attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 18 (3d10 + 3) acid damage.

action.name: Coils
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (4d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained by the angler worm, it can't breathe, it takes 28 (5d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the angler worm's turns, and the angler worm can't use its Coils on another target.

action.name: Ethereal Lure (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The angler worm creates an orb of faint, blue light on a point it can see within 20 feet of it. The light glows until the start of the worm's next turn. When a creature that isn't an angler worm starts its turn within 60 feet of the orb and can see the light, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of its next turn. While charmed, the creature must take the Dash action and move toward the light by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the light. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the charmed creature enters the worm's snares, it has disadvantage on the saving throw to avoid being restrained.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire annelidast takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Deep Earth Dweller
entries: The annelidast doesn't require air.

trait.name: Primordial Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the annelidast must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 29 (4d10 + 9) poison damage. A creature that finishes a long rest within 1,000 feet of the annelidast must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or develop tumors across its body and become poisoned until the tumors are removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The annelidast can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The annelidast makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (3d14 + 9) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the annelidast. A creature restrained by the annelidast automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

action.name: Crush (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The annelidast launches most of its massive bulk into the air and crashes down on the ground in a 20-foot line that is 10 feet wide. It then retracts itself into a space along that line and can occupy the space of one or more Large or smaller creatures. Each creature in the line must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 81 (9d16 + 9) bludgeoning damage, is knocked prone, and is restrained while it shares a space with the annelidast, as it is pinned beneath the annelidast's body. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed out of the annelidast's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice within 5 feet of the annelidast. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take its action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 22 Strength check. If the annelidast burrows along the surface of the earth at least 20 feet before using this action, creatures in the line have disadvantage on the saving throw.

reaction.name: Defensive Recoil
entries: When the annelidast takes damage, it can make one Slam attack against a creature restrained by it.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire bone crab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The bone crab can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Bone Camouflage
entries: The bone crab has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide among bones.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The bone crab can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with other bone crabs in its pack within 100 feet of it. While within 30 feet of another bone crab, the bone crab can't be surprised and has advantage on initiative rolls.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The bone crab has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the crab's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The bone crab's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: White Ghost Shivers
entries: A creature that eats the meat of the bone crab or that is bitten by a creature infected with the white ghost shivers disease must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become infected with the disease. An infected creature develops the first symptoms after 24 hours. Symptoms include a mild chill that escalates to a fever and frightful hallucinations that give the disease its name. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. The exhaustion lasts until the creature finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. A creature that succeeds on two saving throws against the disease recovers from it. Alternatively, the disease can be removed by the lesser restoration spell or similar magic.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d6 + 2) slashing damage.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire garroter crab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The garroter crab can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Strangling Divination
entries: A creature reduced to 0 hp while grappled by the garroter crab experiences a brief vision of the future. This effect works like the divination spell, except the reply is only as a mental vision and it can be about any specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 30 days. Once a creature has received a vision in this way, it can't do so again for 30 days.

action.name: Whip-Claw

trait.name: Elephants' Bane

trait.name: Jagged Hide
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the ngobou deals 24 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the ngobou can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn. If the ngobou detects an elephant within 120 feet of it, this trait is always active, and the ngobou can't choose to end it until it starts its turn more than 120 feet from an elephant.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the ngobou moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the ngobou can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Gore

action.name: Stomp

trait.name: Dire Rage

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The sand spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The sand spider has advantage on attack rolls against surprised targets.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sand spider makes two attacks with its impaling legs and one bite attack.

action.name: Impaling Leg
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d14 + 6) piercing damage. If the sand spider scores a critical hit with this attack, it rolls damage dice three times instead of twice. If both impaling leg attacks hit the same target, the second hit does an extra 20 (2d14 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 36 (5d12 + 6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage with a successful DC 18 Constitution saving throw.

reaction.name: Trapdoor Ambush
entries: When a creature walks over a sand spider's hidden burrow, the spider can use its reaction to attack that creature with two impaling leg attacks. The creature is considered a surprised target for both attacks. If one or both attacks hit and the target is a Medium or smaller creature, then the sand spider and the target engage in a Strength contest. If the creature wins, it can immediately move 5 feet away from the sand spider. If the contest results in a tie, the creature is grappled (escape DC 18). If the sand spider wins, the creature is grappled and dragged by the sand spider 30 feet into its lair. If the creature is still grappled at the start of the sand spider's next turn, it becomes restrained instead. The restrained creature can escape by using an action to make a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

action.name: Sew
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or the suturefly sews the target's mouth, nose, or one of its eyes closed (the suturefly's choice). With supernatural speed, the suturefly repeatedly pierces the target's face, each time threading a loop of the target's own skin through the previous hole. These skin loops rapidly blacken, shrink, and draw the orifice tightly closed. If a target's mouth is sewn shut, it can't speak. If its mouth and nose are sewn shut, it can't breathe, and if both eyes are sewn shut, it is blinded. A creature, including the target, can take its action to cut open one of the sewn orifices by succeeding on a DC 12 Dexterity check with an edged weapon or tool.

trait.name: Deathless Strut
entries: The first time the chicken is reduced to 0 hit points by bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it does not die or fall unconscious immediately.
Instead, the chicken is blinded for the next minute, then dies.

trait.name: Strugglesome Flight
entries: The chicken falls 10 feet at the end of each of its turns if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its fly speed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chicken makes two attacks with its Hooked Beak.

action.name: Hooked Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Wing Bash
entries: One Huge or smaller creature within 10 feet of the chicken must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 42 (6d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 feet away, and knocked prone.

action.name: Lay Egg (1/Day)
entries: With a thunderous cluck, the chicken lays an enormous egg.  Each creature directly beneath the chicken must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 30 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage, plus an additional 30 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage if the chicken was flying at least 20 feet above it.
If the chicken was flying and no creature failed this saving throw, the egg shatters and the ground directly beneath the chicken becomes difficult terrain.

bonus.name: Unearthing Scratch
entries: The chicken targets an area of loose earth within 5 feet of it that a burrowing creature passed through since the end of the chicken's last turn.
The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be dragged back to that space and knocked prone.

bonus.name: Broody Squat
entries: The chicken plops itself down, reducing its movement speed to 0 until it spends 5 feet of movement to end this effect.
Each prone creature in its space is grappled beneath the chicken (escape DC 17) until the chicken moves. While grappled in this way, a creature is blinded and has total cover against outside effects.

reaction.name: Henpeck
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the chicken regains any hit points or picks up a dropped object, the chicken can make a Hooked Beak attack against it.

name: Shipwreck Golem
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Damage Threshold (10)
entries: If the golem would take less than 10 damage, it instead takes no damage.

trait.name: Galley-Torn Deadwood
entries: If the golem is pushed into a Large or larger solid object or surface, it takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Sodden Hull
entries: If the golem takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it loses its resistance to fire damage until it is submerged in water.
If it takes 25 or more fire damage from a single source, it additionally gains vulnerability to fire damage for the same duration.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has disadvantage on saving throws to resist being pushed by wind or water, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the golem may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the golem. While climbing on the golem, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the golem, and the golem has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks with its Sharpened Anchor, one of which it can replace with a use of its Keelhaul Crush or its Rotary Cannonade, if available.

action.name: Sharpened Anchor
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Keelhaul Crush
entries: The golem slams a massive timber down on a creature it can see within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success.

A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally knocked prone and grappled until the end of the golem's turn, and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it is dragged by the golem this turn.

action.name: Rotary Cannonade (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem sends forth a volley of cannonfire, forcing up to three targets it can see within 120 feet to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Point-Blank Volley (1/Day)
entries: When the golem is reduced below 101 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Rotary Cannonade, then immediately use it if available, targeting a single creature within 10 feet.

name: Drowned Conscript
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The conscript can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Damned Crew
entries: If the conscript's captain is destroyed, the conscript is reduced to 0 hit points at the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The conscript's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored.

action.name: Cadaverous Blades (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 slashing damage.

action.name: Ghastly Pangs
entries: The conscript moves up to its speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks, dealing 3 necrotic damage to each frightened creature whose space it moves through in this way.

name: Drowned Crewmate
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The crewmate can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Damned Crew
entries: If the crewmate's captain is destroyed, the crewmate is reduced to 0 hit points at the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The crewmate's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored.

action.name: Ghostlit Pike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Ghastly Glare (Recharge 4-6)
entries: One creature the crewmate can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the crewmate's next turn.
An already frightened creature that fails this saving throw additionally takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the crewmate is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Mariners' Curse (1/Day)
entries: When an unconscious creature the crewmate can see within 30 feet awakens, the crewmate can force it to succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be cursed with a random effect from the following list until it steps upon dry land.

items.name: 1. Curse of the Black Spot
entries: Creatures with a swim speed become irrationally hostile toward the cursed creature, and can sense its presence from up to a mile away.

items.name: 2. Curse of Boiling Doom
entries: Roiling, heavy mists rise from open waters within 100 feet of the creature, heavily obscuring all vision beyond a 15 foot radius for creatures in the area.

items.name: 3. Curse of the Breathless Sails
entries: The creature requires concentration to hold its breath, and wind fails to propel any ship the creature is onboard.

items.name: 4. Curse of Deadman's Eye
entries: Creatures the cursed creature can see subtract 1 from death saving throws they make.

items.name: 5. Curse of the Dust-Dry Heart
entries: The creature must drink twice as much water to stave off exhaustion, and becomes indifferent to the suffering of its allies.

items.name: 6. Curse of the Godless Seas
entries: While at sea, the creature is unaffected by any divine magic that would end a condition affecting it, and regains the minimum amount of hit points from any healing magic.

items.name: 7. Curse of the Shackled Anchor
entries: While swimming, the creature sinks 20 feet at the beginning of each of its turns.

items.name: 8. Curse of the Stranger's Face
entries: The creature's face fades from the memory of those who know it; it has disadvantage on checks made to convince others of its identity.

items.name: 9. Curse of the Watch-Weary
entries: While awake at night, the creature must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution check at the end of each hour or fall asleep. While asleep, the creature sleepwalks, suffers terrible nightmares, and may attack its allies.

items.name: 10. Curse of the Wave-Chased
entries: Foul weather follows the creature for as long as it remains at sea.

name: Drowned Captain
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The captain can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The captain's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored.

trait.name: Damned Resistance
entries: If the captain is reduced to 0 hit points, it can reduce one friendly Drowned Crewmate it can see within 30 feet to 0 hit points.
If it does, the captain is instead reduced to 1 hit point and can end all conditions affecting it.

trait.name: Cursed Return
entries: When the captain is killed, each living creature within 60 feet is cursed with a random curse from the following list until it steps upon dry land.
If each of those creatures dies or has its curse removed, the captain and its crew are restored to undeath at the next full moon in the ocean where they first died.

items.name: 1. Curse of the Black Spot
entries: Creatures with a swim speed become irrationally hostile toward the cursed creature, and can sense its presence from up to a mile away.

items.name: 2. Curse of Boiling Doom
entries: Roiling, heavy mists rise from open waters within 100 feet of the creature, heavily obscuring all vision beyond a 15 foot radius for creatures in the area.

items.name: 3. Curse of the Breathless Sails
entries: The creature requires concentration to hold its breath, and wind fails to propel any ship the creature is onboard.

items.name: 4. Curse of Deadman's Eye
entries: Creatures the cursed creature can see subtract 1 from death saving throws they make.

items.name: 5. Curse of the Dust-Dry Heart
entries: The creature must drink twice as much water to stave off exhaustion, and becomes indifferent to the suffering of its allies.

items.name: 6. Curse of the Godless Seas
entries: While at sea, the creature is unaffected by any divine magic that would end a condition affecting it, and regains the minimum amount of hit points from any healing magic.

items.name: 7. Curse of the Shackled Anchor
entries: While swimming, the creature sinks 20 feet at the beginning of each of its turns.

items.name: 8. Curse of the Stranger's Face
entries: The creature's face fades from the memory of those who know it; it has disadvantage on checks made to convince others of its identity.

items.name: 9. Curse of the Watch-Weary
entries: While awake at night, the creature must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution check at the end of each hour or fall asleep. While asleep, the creature sleepwalks, suffers terrible nightmares, and may attack its allies.

items.name: 10. Curse of the Wave-Chased
entries: Foul weather follows the creature for as long as it remains at sea.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The captain makes two attacks with its Moonglare Cutlass, one of which it can replace with a use of its Blood-Thick Chill.

action.name: Moonglare Cutlass
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
This attack has advantage if its target is in moonlight.

action.name: Blood-Thick Chill
entries: One creature the captain can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the captain's next turn.
An already frightened creature that fails this saving throw additionally takes 27 (6d8) cold damage and is dazed for the same duration.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the captain is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Press-Gang
entries: When a cursed living creature the captain can see within 30 feet dies, it can immediately raise the creature as a Drowned Crewmate.
At the beginning of each of the raised creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 10 Charisma saving throw or be dominated by the captain until the beginning of its next turn.
After three failed saving throws, this domination lasts until dispelled.

legendary.name: Deny Rest
entries: The captain restores one Drowned Conscript or Drowned Crewmate within 60 feet that died in the last minute to undeath with 11 hit points.

legendary.name: Wicked Whispers
entries: The captain echoes forth a profane and tyrannous command, dealing 7 (2d6) psychic damage to a creature within 30 feet that can hear it.

If the target is undead, it can use its reaction either to make a melee attack or turn to mist and disappear, reappearing at the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

legendary.name: Moonglare Slash (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The captain moves up to 15 feet and makes an attack with its Moonglare Cutlass.

name: Ghost Ship
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Damage Threshold (15)
entries: If the ghost ship would take less than 15 damage, it instead takes no damage.

trait.name: Omen-Fog Harbinger
entries: Air within 1,000 is filled with a freezing and malevolent fog, heavily obscuring all vision beyond a range of 30 feet.
Creatures in the fog subtract 1d4 from saving throws they make against being frightened or against effects that deal cold damage.

trait.name: Ghostfire Wreath
entries: The ship is cloaked in dim, blue flames, and is visible as a faint glow from up to 120 feet away, even when heavily obscured by fog or water.

trait.name: Liquid Grave
entries: Frightened creatures within 120 feet of the ship must concentrate to hold their breath.

trait.name: Sunlit Decay
entries: While illuminated by sunlight, the ghost ship loses its damage resistances and damage threshold, and can't take reactions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ship makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Dread Ram.

action.name: Dread Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or larger target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or take 88 (16d10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
If this does not reduce the target to 0 hit points, the ship takes half the attack's damage.

action.name: Hangman's Rigging
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled and suspended 10 feet above the ship's deck (escape DC 20) until the rope is cut (AC 10, 5 hit point).
A creature grappled in this way is choking and takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Encrusted Cannonade
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 44 (8d10) bludgeoning damage.
Whenever the ship misses with this attack, it gains a cumulative +1 to hit with this attack for the next minute, to a total maximum bonus of +12.

action.name: Bleakrime Gust (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ship and each creature on it turn briefly to mist, then the ship moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

Each living creature it moves through in this way must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) cold plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage and be frightened until the end of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature can't be reduced below 1 hit point by this damage.

action.name: Nine Fathoms Tread (1/Day)
entries: The ship binds itself to a vehicle directly above it within 60 feet, cursing it until the vehicle moves more than 60 feet away. On a failure, the ship instead controls the vehicle's movement.

reaction.name: Leaden Plunge
entries: When the ship is targeted with an attack, it can dive 30 feet directly downward, adding +5 to its AC against the triggering attack.
If it does, the ship can't take actions on its following turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Volo is a 1st-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Acererak, Scourge of the Multiverse
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Acererak is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). Acererak has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Acererak carries the Staff of the Forgotten One. He wears a Talisman of the Sphere and has a Sphere of Annihilation under his control.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Acererak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: Acererak's body turns to dust when he drops to 0 hit points, and his equipment is left behind. Acererak gains a new body after 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of Acererak's phylactery, the location of which is hidden.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: Acererak has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Staff (+3 Quarterstaff)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage when used with two hands.

action.name: Invoke Curse
entries: While holding the Staff of the Forgotten One, Acererak expends 1 charge from it and targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be cursed. Until the curse is ended, the target can't regain hit points and has vulnerability to necrotic damage. Greater restoration, remove curse, or similar magic ends the curse on the target.

legendary.name: At-Will Spell
entries: Acererak casts one of his at-will spells.

legendary.name: Melee Attack
entries: Acererak uses Paralyzing Touch or makes one melee attack with his staff.

legendary.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Acererak fixes his gaze on one creature he can see within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target its immune to Acererak's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Talisman of the Sphere (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Acererak uses his Talisman of the Sphere to move the Sphere of Annihilation under his control up to 90 feet.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 20 feet of Acererak must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 42 (12d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Constructed Nature
entries: An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: The hut is incapacitated while the magic gem that animates it is in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the hut must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The hut deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hut makes three attacks with its Chicken Legs. It can replace one of these attacks with a rock attack.

action.name: Chicken Legs
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

name: Bel, Warlord of Avernus
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Bel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23). Bel can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Fear Aura
entries: Any creature hostile to Bel that starts its turn within 20 feet of him must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw, unless Bel is incapacitated. Unless the save succeeds, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to Bel's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Bel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Bel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Bel's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Bel makes three attacks: two with his greatsword and one with his tail.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that is not being held or worn, it catches fire.

action.name: Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Fireball
entries: Bel casts fireball.

legendary.name: Tactical Edge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Roll a d6 for Bel. The number rolled on the die is subtracted from the next attack roll made against Bel or an ally of his choice within the next minute.

legendary.name: Summon Narzugon (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Bel magically summons an narzugon riding a nightmare. The pair appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Bel, acts as Bel's ally, and can summon other devils if it has such power. The narzugon remains until Bel dies or until he dismisses it as an action.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: Captain N'ghathrod's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Captain N'ghathrod is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Captain N'ghathrod has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Captain N'ghathrod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15) and must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned until this grapple ends.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid grappled by Captain N'ghathrod. Hit: The target takes 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Captain N'ghathrod kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

action.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Captain N'ghathrod magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Illithid Head
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (can't see beyond this radius)

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The head has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Psychic Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Leech
entries: The head targets one creature within 5 feet of itself and forces the target to make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the head enters the target's space and attaches to the target. While the head is attached, the target takes 7 (3d4) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the head can't use Leech again until it detaches. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. As an action, the target or a creature within 5 feet of the target can detach the head by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check.

name: Crokek'toeck, Demonic Ferry of the Styx
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Crokek'toeck can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Crokek'toeck has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Crokek'toeck's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Secure Memory
entries: Crokek'toeck is immune to the waters of the River Styx as well as any effect that would steal or modify its memories or detect or read its thoughts.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Crokek'toeck's long jump is up to 60 feet and its high jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 44 (10d6 + 9) piercing damage.

action.name: Disgorge Allies (Recharge 6)
entries: Crokek'toeck opens its mouth and disgorges 1d4 barlguras, 3d6 gnolls led by 1 gnoll fang of Yeenoghu, 6d6 dretches, or 1d3 vrocks. Each creature it disgorges appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Crokek'toeck's mouth, or the next closest unoccupied space.

name: Ezmerelda d'Avenir, Protege of van Richten
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ezmerelda is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Ezmerelda has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the Ezmerelda can transform into a wolf-humanoid hybrid, into a wolf, or back into her humanoid form. Her statistics are the same in each form. She reverts to her humanoid form if she dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: Ezmerelda has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When Ezmerelda is reduced to 0 hit points, she does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, she loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If she takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, she is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ezmerelda makes three attacks, two of which can be with her rapier or bite.

action.name: Silvered Rapier (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite (Hybrid or Wolf Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw Rake
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Curse (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: Ezmerelda targets one creature that she can see within 30 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, the target has vulnerability to one type of damage of Ezmerelda's choice. The curse lasts until ended with a greater restoration spell, a remove curse spell, or similar magic. When the curse ends, Ezmerelda takes 3d6 psychic damage.

action.name: Evil Eye (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Ezmerelda targets one creature that she can see within 10 feet of her and casts one of the following spells on the target (save DC 14), requiring neither somatic nor material components to do so: animal friendship, charm person, or hold person. If the target succeeds on the initial saving throw, Ezmerelda is blinded until the end of her next turn. Once a target succeeds on a saving throw against this effect, it is immune to the Evil Eye power of all Vistani for 24 hours.

name: Gorthok, the Thunder Boar
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Gorthok takes 27 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gorthok makes two melee attacks: one with its lightning tusks and one with its thunder hooves.

action.name: Lightning Tusks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Thunder Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage.

action.name: Lightning Bolt (Recharge 6)
entries: Gorthok shoots a bolt of lightning at one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Iggwilv casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24, +16 to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Boon of Immortality
entries: Iggwilv is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Iggwilv fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Archfey Resistance
entries: Iggwilv succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know her name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Iggwilv wears an amulet of the planes and a robe of the archmagi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Iggwilv makes two Bewitching Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bewitching Bolt
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack. +16 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) lightning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Iggwilv until the start of her next turn.

action.name: Abyssal Rift (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Iggwilv opens a momentary Abyssal rift within 120 feet of her. The rift is a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, there is a 50 percent chance that 3 hezrous then appear in unoccupied spaces in the sphere. They act as Iggwilv's allies, take their turns immediately after hers, and can't summon other demons. They remain until they die or until Iggwilv dismisses them as an action.

bonus.name: Fey Step
entries: Iggwilv teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her.

reaction.name: Negate Spell (2/Day)
entries: When Iggwilv sees a creature within 60 feet of her casting a spell, she tries to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a spell using a spell slot of 8th level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a 9th-level spell, it must succeed on a DC 22 Intelligence saving throw, or the spells fails and has no effect.

legendary.name: Witchcraft
entries: Iggwilv uses Spellcasting or Fey Step.

legendary.name: Dark Speech (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Iggwilv utters a phrase in a forbidden language and targets one or two creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and be frightened of Iggwilv for 1 minute. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success and thereby becoming immune to Iggwilv's Dark Speech for 24 hours.

legendary.name: Fey Beguilement (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Iggwilv targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by a fey spirit. While possessed, the target must obey Iggwilv's commands. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, banishing the fey spirit and ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Imix, the Eternal Flame
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Imix's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Empowered Attacks
entries: Imix's slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

trait.name: Fire Aura
entries: At the start of each of Imix's turns, each creature within 10 feet of him takes 17 (5d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature also takes 17 (5d6) fire damage if it touches Imix or hits him with a melee attack while within 10 feet of him, and a creature takes that damage the first time on a turn that Imix moves into its space. Nonmagical weapons that hit Imix are destroyed by fire immediately after dealing damage to him

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: Imix can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. He can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing if fire could pass through that space.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: Imix sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Imix fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
