Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage if the spell fails.

reaction.name: Fell Rebuke
entries: In response to being hit by an attack, Vecna utters a fell word, dealing 10 (3d6) necrotic damage to the attacker, and Vecna teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

action.name: Sting
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3).

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire honeybee takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

name: Primus, Steward of Law
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: telepathy (can communicate with any creature on the same plane of existence)

trait.name: Godlike Resistance
entries: If Primus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If he does, he regains two fewer legendary action on his following turn.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless he wishes to be affected, Primus is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. He has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Multitrack Machinations
entries: Primus may concentrate on up to five spells simultaneously. He regains one fewer legendary action at the beginning of his turn for each spell he is concentrating on beyond the first. If he fails a concentration check, he loses concentration on all spells he is concentrating on.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: Primus may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Heart of Mechanus (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If Primus would be reduced to 0 hit points, his current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points. Additionally, Primus can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Primus can use his Lawful Presence. He then makes three attacks with his Unerring Slam, all of which he may replace with a use of his Revolve the Cosmic Gears ability.

action.name: Unerring Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. automatic hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 60 force damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. A creature that has legendary resistances loses one.

action.name: Revolve the Cosmic Gears
entries: Primus chooses one school of magic. Until he uses this ability again or chooses to dismiss it, spells of that school fail, and magical effects of that school cease to function.

action.name: Lawful Presence
entries: Each creature of Primus's choice that is within 240 feet of Primus and aware of him must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or be incapacitated if it is of non-lawful alignment.
As an action, an affected creature may attempt a DC 26 Charisma (Deception) check to feign a change of alignment, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Curse of Inevitable Death
entries: One creature Primus can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or be cursed to die, suffering the following effects:
If a cursed creature is restored to life, it dies.
If a cursed creature gains a new body, the new body is destroyed.
If this curse is removed, a marut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Curse of the Oathkeeper
entries: One creature Primus can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or take 18 (4d8) radiant plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage and be cursed to keep its oaths, suffering the following effects.
The cursed creature cannot voluntarily renege on an oath or valid contract it is a party to.
The cursed creature is branded an oathkeeper. A creature proficient in History or Arcana is aware of the cause and effects of the creature's curse.
If this curse is removed, a kolyarut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Curse of the Oathbreaker
entries: One creature Primus can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage and be cursed to be mistrusted, suffering the following effects.
The cursed creature cannot voluntarily enter into oaths or contracts.
The cursed creature has disadvantage on Charisma checks made to declare its intent.
The cursed creature is branded an oathbreaker. A creature proficient in History or Arcana is aware of the cause and effects of the creature's curse.
If this curse is removed, a kolyarut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Curse of Contemporality
entries: One creature Primus can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or be cursed to experience time conventionally, suffering the following effects:
The creature can no longer voluntarily be the target of spells of 8th level or above, or of equivalent effects.
If this curse is removed, a quarut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Curse of Diminished Ambition
entries: One creature Primus can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw or be cursed to be barred from divinity, suffering the following effects:
While a cursed creature is outside its home plane, it must succeed on a DC 26 Charisma saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or be returned to its home plane.
While a cursed creature is concentrating on a spell or ritual, it takes one psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns.
If this curse is removed, a varakhut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

legendary.name: Unerring Slam
entries: Primus makes a slam attack.

legendary.name: Purge Mind (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Primus can see within 60 feet must make a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, Primus removes one piece of knowledge from the creature's mind.

legendary.name: Curse of Law (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Primus inflicts one of his Curses.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th Level Spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Primus casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythic.name: Disjunction Blast (8th Level Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature or object Primus can see within 60 feet must make a DC 26 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, all spells of 8th level or below affecting the target end, and one magic item that the target is carrying (target's choice) becomes inert and nonmagical for the next minute.

mythic.name: Stop the Cogs (9th Level Spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Primus briefly stops the cogs of Mechanus, causing the multiverse to pause and producing the effects of the Time Stop spell.

name: Pandorym, the Void Awakened
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Godlike Resistance
entries: If Pandorym fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it regains two fewer legendary action on its following turn.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless it wishes to be affected, Pandorym is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Multitrack Machinations
entries: Pandorym may concentrate on up to five spells simultaneously. It regains one fewer legendary action at the beginning of its turn for each spell it is concentrating on beyond the first. If it fails a concentration check, it loses concentration on all spells it is concentrating on.

trait.name: Hunger of Nothingness (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If Pandorym would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 500 hit points. Additionally, Pandorym can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Pandorym can use its Aura of Madness. It then makes four attacks with its tendrils. It may replace all of these attacks with a use of its Void Blast ability.

action.name: Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +19 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) psychic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 26).

action.name: Void Blast
entries: Pandorym emits astral energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 26 Intelligence saving throw, taking 54 (8d10 + 10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
If a creature fails this saving throw by 5 or more, they are also stunned until the end of Pandorym's next turn.

action.name: Unbearable Lucidity
entries: One creature Pandorym can see within 100 feet has any reduction to its Wisdom score end, and takes 5 psychic damage for each point of Wisdom restored to it in this way.

action.name: Aura of Madness
entries: Each creature of Pandorym's choice that is within 120 feet of Pandorym and aware of it must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or suffer short-term madness for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Pandorym's Aura of Madness for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Tendril
entries: Pandorym makes a tendril attack.

legendary.name: Fling
entries: Pandorym flings an object or creature grappled by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 6 (2d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled.
A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

legendary.name: Call of the Void (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Pandorym uses its Void Blast or Unbearable Lucidity.

legendary.name: Lesser Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Pandorym casts any spell of 8th level or below.

mythic.name: Void Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature of Pandorym's choice that is within 240 feet of Pandorym and aware of it must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until it completes a long rest.
A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way is charmed by Pandorym and hostile to all other creatures.

mythic.name: Consume (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Pandorym retracts a tendril that is grappling an incapacitated creature or a creature charmed by Pandorym.  The grappled creature is pulled into the center of Pandorym.  If the grappled creature has 50 or fewer hit points, it is annihilated.

An annhilated creature cannot be restored to life by any means, and simply ceases to exist.  When Pandorym annihilates a creature, it gains one action from the annihilated creature's stat block of its choice.  It can have one such action at a time, and if it consumes an additional creature, this action is replaced.
A creature with more than 50 hit points instead takes 44 (8d10) force damage and is pulled to the nearest unoccupied space to Pandorym.

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Hard Freeze
entries: If the elemental takes any cold damage, it freezes solid, becoming petrified until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Brineswipe Dive
entries: The spraylark flies up to 10 feet in a straight line without provoking attacks of opportunity.
A creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) cold damage and be blinded until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frigid Cascade
entries: The spraylark begins to shed a spray of chilling droplets in a 5 foot radius. Until the beginning of its next turn, creatures in the area add 1d4 to saving throws against effects that deal fire damage, and subtract 1d4 from saving throws against effects that deal cold damage.

name: Water Weird
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Bound
entries: The weird dies if it begins or ends its turn more than 5 feet away from a body of water.

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the weird takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the weird ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Slithering Coil
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
A Medium or smaller creature hit with this attack is pulled into the weird's space and grappled (escape DC 13) until the weird uses this attack again.

action.name: Lung Gush
entries: The weird blasts a burst of water into the lungs of an air-breathing creature grappled by it, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and immediately begin suffocating.
As an action, it or a creature within 5 feet can allow it to repeat this saving throw, expelling the water and ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Twisting Arc
entries: The weird leaps up to 30 feet through the air from one space of open water to another.
At any point in this jump, the weird can use its action to make an attack with its Slithering Coils.

bonus.name: Laminar Shimmer
entries: If the weird is fully submerged in clear water and doesn't have a creature grappled, it can become invisible until the beginning of its next turn.
This invisibility ends early if the weird makes an attack or takes any cold damage.

name: Water Elemental
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Large or smaller air-breathing creatures in the elemental's space are choking.

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the elemental takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Crashing Slam, one of which it can replace with a use of its Whelm.

action.name: Crashing Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
A target that is holding its breath must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose its breath and begin suffocating.

action.name: Whelm (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The elemental lurches up to 10 feet, then can force each creature in its space to succeed on DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage, or be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A Large or smaller creature that fails this saving throw is additionally grappled (escape DC 15), and is restrained while grappled in this way.

reaction.name: Vengeful Surge
entries: When the elemental is missed with a melee attack, it can use its Whelm, if available.

name: Griptide
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The griptide can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Large or smaller air-breathing creatures in the griptide's space are choking.

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the griptide takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the griptide ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The griptide makes four attacks with its Hands of the Deep, or makes one attack and uses its Scouring Tide.

action.name: Hands of the Deep
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Scouring Tide
entries: The griptide sends a wave of sand and debris tumbling forth in a 30 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) slashing damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature released from the griptide's grapple as a result of failing this saving throw takes an additional 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Drag Out
entries: Each creature grappled by the griptide must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 20 feet toward the griptide's center.

bonus.name: Pressure Spike
entries: A pulse of intense pressure ripples through the griptide, forcing each other creature in its space to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) thunder damage.

name: Seamaw Vortex
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Vortex Trap
entries: The vortex can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Water revolves around the vortex in a 120 foot radius. Aquatic travel away from the vortex or against the direction of its spin costs three times as much movement.
A Gargantuan or smaller creature or vehicle that starts its turn in the area is dragged 10 feet toward its center and up to 30 feet in the direction of the vortex's spin.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the vortex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vortex makes two attacks with its Swiftwater Crash, one of which it can replace with a use of its Maelstrom Grind.

action.name: Swiftwater Crash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet in a lateral direction of the vortex's choice.
A creature or vehicle the target is pushed into in this way must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Maelstrom Grind
entries: Each creature and vehicle in the area of the vortex's Vortex Trap must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw.
On a failure, a target takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage and is dragged up to 5 feet in the direction of the vortex's spin for each point it failed by.

action.name: Yawning Void
entries: The vortex forces one creature or object within 10 feet of its center to succeed on a DC 21 Strength or Dexterity (target's choice) saving throw or be swallowed (escape DC 21).
At the beginning of each of the vortex's turns, each creature and vehicle swallowed by it takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and descends 100 feet toward the seafloor.

reaction.name: Raging Reversal (1/Day)
entries: When the vortex is reduced below 180 hit points, it can suspend the effect of its Vortex Trap until the beginning of its next turn, at which point the vortex begins spinning in the opposite direction.
If it does, the vortex can use its Yawning Void as a bonus action on each of its turns for the next minute.

name: Cloudscale Melozoa
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The melozoa can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any gap large enough for air to pass through without squeezing.

trait.name: Zephyr Tendrils
entries: The area within 10 feet of the melozoa counts as difficult terrain for creatures of its choice.
A creature that begins its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13) until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Cutting Jet
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the melozoa is pushed up to 10 feet from the target.

action.name: Skyhook Launch
entries: One creature grappled by the elemental is flung up to 40 feet upward.
A creature that collides with a ceiling or other solid surface takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and can make a DC 13 Strength saving throw, clinging to the surface on a success.

name: Air Elemental
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any gap large enough for air to pass through without squeezing.

trait.name: Updraft
entries: A Medium or smaller creature that starts its turn in the elemental's space must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or begin levitating until the beginning of its next turn.
When the elemental moves, each levitating creature in its space is moved with it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Buffeting Slam.

action.name: Buffeting Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying target.

action.name: Whirlwind Fling (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Each creature in the elemental's space must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and be flung up 20 feet away in a random direction and knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

A thrown target that strikes a creature or solid object takes an additional 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature struck by a thrown target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Abrupt Ejection
entries: When a creature levitating in the elemental's space hits it with an attack, the elemental can move up to half its speed, then push the creature up to 10 feet.

name: Invisible Stalker
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Common but doesn't speak it

trait.name: Innate Invisibility
entries: The stalker is invisible. If fine particles are scattered in its space, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it uses its Expel Debris.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The stalker can detect, by scent, the direction and distance to its summoner and to the target named as part of the spell to summon it, as long as each of those creatures are on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stalker makes two attacks with its Seal Throat, each of which it can replace with a use of its Hammer Lungs or Sudden Gust, if available.

action.name: Seal Throat
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).
While grappled in this way, a creature is choking.

action.name: Hammer Lungs
entries: The stalker attempts to smash the air from the lungs of a choking creature within 5 feet that is holding its breath.
The target takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage, then must succeed on DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose its held breath and immediately begin suffocating.

action.name: Sudden Gust (Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in a direction of the stalker's choice.
A creature the stalker is hidden from makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

bonus.name: Expel Debris
entries: When the stalker is reduced below 53 hit points, it can purge itself of particles suspended in its form, then can attempt to Hide.

name: Breathdrinker
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Innate Invisibility
entries: The breathdrinker is invisible. If fine particles are scattered in its space, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it uses its Expel Debris.

trait.name: Breath Tracker
entries: The breathdrinker can detect, by scent, the direction and distance to each creature on the same plane of existence that has been affected by its Breath Siphon.

action.name: Breath Siphon
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: An invisible tether of breath ties the creature to the breathdrinker.
Until the breathdrinker uses this ability again or the creature moves more than 40 feet away from it, the target is dazed.

action.name: Wind Scythe
entries: The stalker sends forth a plane of pressurized air in a 15 foot cone, cutting cleanly through each Medium or smaller unattended nonmagical object in the area.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) slashing damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Breath Mimicry (Concentration)
entries: The breathdrinker wrenches air from the lungs of a creature affected by its Breath Siphon, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or begin suffocating.
While using this ability, the breathdrinker appears as a misty, red-eyed duplicate of its target, and cannot benefit from invisibility.

bonus.name: Expel Debris
entries: The breathdrinker purges itself of particles suspended in its form, then can attempt to hide.

name: Havokwind
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Squallshield
entries: Ranged attacks made against creatures within 30 feet of the havokwind have disadvantage.

trait.name: Howling Gyre
entries: The havokwind can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.
A Huge or smaller creature that that starts its turn in the havokwind's space must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and begin levitating (escape DC 20).
When the havokwind moves, each levitating creature in its space is moved with it.

trait.name: Wandering Destruction
entries: Whenever the havokwind takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it moves up to 10 feet in a random lateral direction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The havokwind makes two attacks with its Downdraft Slam, one of which it can replace with a use of its Ploughwind Drive.

action.name: Downdraft Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
A levitating creature hit with this attack takes an additional 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and immediately stops levitating.

action.name: Ploughwind Drive
entries: The havokwind moves up to its speed in a straight line.  Each Huge or smaller creature whose space the havokwind enters in this way must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and begin levitating within the havokwind (escape DC 20).

action.name: Gyre Twist (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The cyclone's winds pick up, forcing each creature levitating within it to make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw.

On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage plus an additional 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage for each other creature levitating in the havokwind's space, or takes half as much damage on a success

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Eden attacks twice with her Firebolt. She may replace one Firebolt attack with a Spell.

action.name: Firebolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) fire damage.

action.name: Fireball (1/Day, 3rd level spell)
entries: 120 ft range, 30 ft cube, DC 15 DEX save. On a failed save, the target takes 32 (8d6 + 4) fire damage, or half damage on a success.

action.name: Hold Person (1/Day, 3rd level spell, concentration)
entries: 60 ft range, 2 targets, DC 15 WIS save. On a failed save, the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. One creature has disadvantage on its first save against this spell. The targets repeat the save at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Blindness (1/Day, 3rd level spell)
entries: 30 ft range, DC 15 CON save. On a failed save, the target is blinded. Target repeats the save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Misty Step (2/Day, 2nd level spell)
entries: Eden teleports 30 feet to a location she can see.

reaction.name: Shield (4/Day, 1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, Eden may add 5 to her AC until the beginning of her next turn.

name: Slingrock Blocklet
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the blocklet is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

trait.name: Living Weapon
entries: The blocklet takes no damage when used as a weapon.

action.name: Hurl Self
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
On a hit or miss, the blocklet lands prone in the target's space.

action.name: Stub-Toe Hazard
entries: The blocklet plants itself firmly and ends its turn. Until the beginning of its next turn, creatures in the blocklet's space fall prone if they fail a Strength or Dexterity-based check or saving throw, in addition to any other effects.

reaction.name: Skipping Tumble
entries: When the blocklet takes any damage that would not reduce it to 0 hit points, it can reduce that damage to 1.
If it does, the blocklet is pushed up to 20 feet away from the damage's source and falls prone.

name: Geoderm
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The geoderm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the geoderm is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

action.name: Jagged Crash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must choose one of the following:

items: The target is pushed 5 feet away.
The target takes an additional 4 (1d8) slashing damage.

action.name: Gleamvein Absorption
entries: The geoderm attempts to absorb a spell effect within 5 feet of it, making a Constitution saving throw against a DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level.
On a success, the spell ends and the geoderm's melee attacks have advantage for the next minute.
On a failure, the geoderm explodes in a spray of shrapnel, dealing 7 (2d6) slashing damage to each creature within 10 feet of it.

name: Earth Elemental
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the elemental is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Boulder-Fist Slam.

action.name: Boulder-Fist Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
A Medium or smaller creature hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Shatter Earth (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The elemental strikes the earth, sending forth a violent shockwave in a 30 foot cone.

The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and fall prone, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Earthen Impression
entries: When the elemental scores a critical hit with its Boulder-Fist Slam against a prone target, it can press the creature into an earthen surface beneath it.
The target is restrained (escape DC 16) as the surface conforms to its body. The restraining material can be broken (AC 17, 15 HP), freeing the creature.

name: Lodestone Marauder
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the marauder is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

trait.name: Ironflake Aura
entries: The marauder is surrounded by a cloud of razor-sharp metal flakes. Another creature that moves within 10 feet of the marauder takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage for each 5 feet it moves.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marauder makes three attacks with its Dipole Smash, each of which it can replace with a use of its Razor Sweep, if available.

action.name: Dipole Smash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
If the target is wearing metal armor, before making this attack the marauder can drag the creature up to 15 feet toward it.

action.name: Razor Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A torrent of metal flakes sweeeps forth from the marauder in a 20 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) slashing damage and begin bleeding (1d4).

bonus.name: Churn Grindfield
entries: The elemental magnetically shreds a nonmagical metal object Attached to it, recharging its Razor Sweep.

bonus.name: Lodestone's Claim
entries: Each Small or smaller metal object within 20 feet is magnetically dragged into the marauder's space and becomes attached to it (remove DC 18).
Each creature in the area can make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, preventing objects it is carrying from being affected on a success.

name: Rubblehulk
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The rubblehulk can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the rubblehulk is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

trait.name: Demolition Animus
entries: Whenever the rubblehulk deals any damage to a stone object, structure, or surface with a melee attack, it absorbs the rubble, regaining a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rubblehulk makes three attacks with its Pillar-Rock Press, one of which it can replace with a use of its Flagstone Bombardment.

action.name: Pillar-Rock Press
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
A prone target hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or suffer a bludgeoning injury.

action.name: Flagstone Bombardment
entries: The rubblehulk lobs a volley of stones at a target it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally knocked prone.

reaction.name: Rubblework Avalanche
entries: When the elemental destroys a wall or structure with a melee attack, it can send a cascade of rubble sliding forth in a 30 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 18).

name: Ogremoch, the Mountain that Walks
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Titanic Stature
entries: Ogremoch's body is divided into several connected zones; a creature Attached to a zone has advantage on attacks that target Ogremoch, and can use its full movement to make a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Athletics) check, climbing to an adjacent zone on a success.

items.name: Base
entries: A creature attached to Ogremoch's base has advantage on saving throws against its Skyblot Slam, and takes no damage on a success.

items.name: Trunk
entries: A creature that hits Ogremoch with a critical hit while attached to its trunk breaks open a crevice that a Medium creature can squeeze through, becoming swallowed.

items.name: Arms
entries: A creature that succeeds on a saving throw against Ogremoch's Skyblot Slam can use its reaction to attempt to climb onto Ogremoch arms.

items.name: Head
entries: When Ogremoch uses its Skyblot Slam, a creature attached to Ogremoch's head can use its action to shift the target by up to 25 feet.

trait.name: Gemheart Core
entries: A creature swallowed by Ogremoch can access its pulsing diamond heart; the heart has an AC of 25 and any hit against it becomes a critical against Ogremoch.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If Ogremoch fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Ogremoch deals double damage to objects and structures with its melee and ranged weapon attacks.

trait.name: The Earth Unceasing (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Ogremoch is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 253 hit points and the earth in a 500 foot radius around it becomes difficult terrain for the next hour. Additionally, Ogremoch can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

action.name: Skyblot Slam
entries: Ogremoch begins to swing a titanic fist at a 15 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet.
At the beginning of Ogremoch's next turn, each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 101 (2d100) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Tectonic Wade
entries: Ogremoch moves or burrows up to 50 feet in a straight line, tearing through the earth as it does.
Each creature and object in its path is pushed ahead of it, then must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or take 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Boulderfall Cascade
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of Ogremoch that isn't attached to its head must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is knocked prone.

legendary.name: Scrape Off
entries: Ogremoch forces one creature within 60 feet of it to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 26 (4d12) bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and be pushed up to 20 feet away.
On a success, the target takes no damage and Ogremoch takes half the effect's damage.

legendary.name: Raise Spire
entries: A 10 foot radius pillar of stone rises 60 feet from the earth, centered on a point Ogremoch can see within 300 feet.

legendary.name: Metamorphic Awakening
entries: Ogremoch creates up to two earth elementals from its flesh with a total CR of up to 2 (1d4), or of up to 5 (2d4) if Ogremoch's Mythic Trait is active.
The elementals act on initiative count 0, and Ogremoch loses 10 hit points per CR of elemental created this way.

mythic.name: Earthcrest Quakewave
entries: A wave of earth ripples out from Ogremoch in a 500 foot radius, forcing each creature on the ground in the area to succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be launched 20 feet into the air.

mythic.name: Creepstone Blight (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each creature attached to or swallowed by Ogremoch must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain 25 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature is restrained and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or become petrified until it loses them.

name: Scorchmort
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the scorchmort takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the scorchmort can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the burning condition.

action.name: Kindlescratch Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 fire damage. If the target has taken any other fire damage since the end of the scorchmort's last turn, it begins burning (1d10).

reaction.name: Snufflesmoke Remnant
entries: When the scorchmort is reduced to 0 hit points by a source it can see, it can turn into a wisp of dark smoke that dissipates at the end of its next turn.
If this smoke is dealt any fire damage, the scorchmort returns to life with full hit points.

name: Pyreling
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the pyreling takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the pyreling can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the burning condition.

action.name: Spit Fire
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target has taken any other fire damage since the end of the pyreling's last turn, it begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Devour Flames
entries: The pyreling ends the burning condition on a creature within 15 feet, consuming the flames and gaining 5 (1d10) temporary hit points that last for a minute.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, it can make an attack with its Spit Fire as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Skitterflame Leap
entries: When the pyreling or a creature within 10 feet of it is dealt any fire damage, the pyreling can jump up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Fire Elemental
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the elemental takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the elemental can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the burning condition.

trait.name: Fire Incarnate
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can move through and stop in the space of other creatures.
A creature who has the elemental enter its space for the first time in a turn takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Stoke
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage. A burning target takes an additional 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Seethe
entries: The elemental's flames darken and roil. The first time the elemental takes any non-cold damage before the beginning of its next turn, flame bursts forth from it in a 15 foot radius.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) fire damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Flashover (1/Day)
entries: When the elemental is reduced below 52 hit points, it can cause each creature and flammable object within 20 feet of it to begin burning (1d10).
A creature or object in the area that is already burning instead takes 16 (3d10) fire damage.

name: Plasmastrider
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the plasmastrider takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the plasmastrider can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the burning condition.

trait.name: Plasma Conduit
entries: The plasmastrider has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal lightning damage, and attacks that deal lightning damage have advantage against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plasmastrider makes two attacks with its Blueflame Impact, one of which it can replace with a use of its Lob Fluxflame or Incinerating Embrace.

action.name: Blueflame Impact
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.
On a hit or miss, each burning creature within 5 feet of the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Lob Fluxflame
entries: The plasmastrider hurls a glob of crawling blue flames at a point within 60 feet where it explodes in a 5 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage and begin burning (1d10).
A creature that the burning creature ends its turn within 5 feet of begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Incinerating Embrace (Concentration)
entries: The plasmastrider lunges at a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (escape DC 15) until the plasmastrider moves or loses concentration.
The restrained creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the end of each creature's turn. A creature killed in this way is reduced to ash.

name: Spitefire Crawler

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the crawler takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the crawler can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the burning condition.

trait.name: Blazing Trail
entries: When the crawler moves through a space, each flammable object and surface in that space begins burning.
Until extinguished, a creature that enters that space for the first time on a turn takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

action.name: Pureflame Slash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) fire plus 16 (3d10) force damage.
This attack has advantage against any creature not resistant or immune to fire damage.

action.name: Spitefire Flare
entries: A towering plume of arcane flame erupts from the ground beneath on a creature the crawler can see within 60 feet.
Each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (3d10) fire damage and begin burning (1d10).

bonus.name: Razing Rush
entries: The crawler moves up to its speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature.
Each creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 11 (2d10) fire damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

bonus.name: Spitefire Eruption (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The crawler uses its Spitefire Flare three times, choosing targets at random from hostile creatures it can see.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The rat may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Burning Tunnel
entries: The rat can burrow through any flammable material at half its movement speed and leaves a Tiny charcoal tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Undying Embers
entries: If the rat would take any fire damage or begins its turn within 5 feet of an open flame, it instead takes no damage and regains 1 hit point.

action.name: Char-Toothed Nip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
A burning target hit with this attack takes an additional 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

action.name: Cinder Scrabble
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The rat becomes attached to the target (remove DC 14).
At the beginning of each of the rat's turns, any creature or flammable object it is attached to it begins burning (1d10).

reaction.name: Ashen Fume
entries: When the rat is reduced to 0 hit points, it can shroud itself in a gout of ash, heavily obscuring its space until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Searing Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small creature.
At the beginning of each of its turns, the swarm and each creature in its space takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

trait.name: Ember Hive
entries: If the swarm would take any fire damage, it instead takes no damage and can regain 10 hit points or spawn an Ash Rat Limning with 1 hit point in its space.

trait.name: Chargnawed Route

action.name: Char-Toothed Frenzy
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing plus 14 (4d6) fire damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.
A burning target hit with this attack takes an additional 9 (2d8) piercing damage and is knocked prone.

action.name: Cultivate Flames
entries: The swarm flares brightly and moves up to its speed.  Each space it enters in this way ignites until the end of its next turn, and each creature whose space it enters must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or begin burning (1d10).

action.name: Spitfire Spray (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The swarm spits a flurry of dancing embers in a 20 foot long, 10 foot wide line.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage.
If the swarm has half its hit points or fewer, it can target only a single creature in the area with this ability.

reaction.name: Ashen Shroud
entries: When the swarm takes 10 or more damage from a single source, it can shroud itself in a gout of ash, gaining half cover against ranged attacks until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Smell

trait.name: Quick Squeeze

action.name: Multiattack

trait.name: Brittle Barb

action.name: Multiattack

This attack is made at advantage against a creature not wearing armor.

action.name: Ironbur Meteor Hammer

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing plus 22 (4d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia.

reaction.name: Tarsal Stomp
entries: When a Medium or smaller creature within 15 feet falls prone, the tlincalli can move up to 10 feet toward the creature and force it to make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and is grappled (escape DC 14) until the tlincalli moves.

action.name: Flensing Sandblast (7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A continuous, tearing wind issues forth from the tlincalli's hand, whipping sands forward in a 30 foot cone. A creature that starts or ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) slashing damage, be pushed 10 feet away, and be Blinded until the beginning of its next turn.
As a bonus action on its turn, the tlincalli may change the direction of the cone.

action.name: Vent Noonsun (8th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: The tlincalli expels stored sunlight from its exoskeleton, flaring with light and heat. Each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.
For the next minute, the tlincalli gains vulnerability to fire and radiant damage.

bonus.name: Bolthole Burial (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the tlincalli can see within 60 feet is teleported up to 10 feet directly downward through loose sand or earth to a snug cavity magically excavated for it.

An unwilling creature may make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw, avoiding the effect on a success. A creature may dig the buried creature out as an action with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

reaction.name: Shimmering Lure (3rd Level Spell)
entries: When a friendly creature the Tlincalli can see moves or teleports, the tlincalli can cause that creature to become invisible and hidden until the end of the creature's next turn, or until it makes an attack.

An illusory replica of that creature that lasts for a minute appears in the space vacated by it. If the replica takes any damage, it explodes in a burst of light, dealing 5 (1d10) radiant damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Claws

action.name: Necrovenom Stinger

reaction.name: Jink

name: Neifion, Lord of Bats
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Neifion fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Archfey Resilience
entries: Neifion succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Screeching Retinue
entries: Neifion is surrounded by a whirling torrent of semi-corporeal bats that continuously spill out from the shadows within 30 feet of him. Light sources in the area have their range reduced by half, and creatures have half cover against any ranged attack that passes through the area.

trait.name: Shadowflesh
entries: If Neifion is not in bright light, he may teleport up to 10 feet whenever he takes damage.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Lighteater Bite (Bat form only)

action.name: Blackthumb (Humanoid form only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Curling Grasp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 21).

action.name: Whispered Thunder (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Neifion sends out a precisely targeted pulse of subsonic energy that converges on a creature he can see within 60 feet, choosing one of the following effects:

items.name: Shaking Eyes
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of Neifion's next turn.

items.name: Quaking Heart
entries: The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of Neifion's next turn.

items.name: Shattered Arms
entries: The creature must succeed don a DC 20 Strength saving throw or have one nonartifact weapon or piece of armor it is carrying shatter. If the item is magical or named, this save is made at advantage.

bonus.name: Shift Form
entries: Neifion transforms into a form that resembles a Medium humanoid, or back into his true Large bat-like form. His statistics are the same in each form.

bonus.name: Burr-Bat
entries: A bat soars out from Neifion's retinue and crashes into a creature he can see within 60 feet, then bursts into a gnarled burr of hooked spines.
The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) piercing damage and have the burr stick to it (remove DC 20).

bonus.name: Burst-Bat (Humanoid form only)
entries: Neifion detonates each burr created by his Burr-Bat that is attached to a creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage and be pushed 10 feet in a direction of Neifion's choice for each burr attached to it.

reaction.name: Black Breath of the Earth (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when Neifion is reduced below 148 hit points, up to six 50 foot long, 10 foot wide, 30 foot deep trenches split open in the earth within 300 feet of Neifion, disgorging a torrent of bats into the air for the next minute.

A creature other than Neifion in the trench's space is immediately launched up to 50 feet in the air, then must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, landing on a side of the trench of its choice on a success, or a randomly selected side on a failure.

legendary.name: Burr-Bat
entries: Neifion uses his Burr-bat.

legendary.name: Traveler's Dust (Humanoid form only)
entries: One creature within 5 feet of Neifion must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, a creature takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage for each 5 feet it moves through dim light or darkness.

legendary.name: Plunge Into Night (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Neifion moves up to half his speed, then if he is in darkness may teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that is also in darkness.

At the start of each of Camlash's turns, each creature within 10 feet of Camlash takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the start of Camlash's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Camlash makes one Flaming Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack. Camlash can replace one of these attacks with Teleport.

action.name: Flaming Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) fire damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Camlash.

action.name: Lightning Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: Camlash magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Web Bomb.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Web Bomb
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, range 300 ft./600 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target and all creatures within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage and be restrained until the start of the spider's next turn.

reaction.name: Absorb Blow
entries: In response to being hit with an attack roll, the spider's carapace absorbs some of the blow, reducing the damage it takes by 11 (2d10).

name: Deadbark Dryad
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

trait.name: Bramble Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of vegetation, such as foliage or thorns, doesn't cost the dryad extra movement.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dryad makes two Poisonous Thorn attacks and one Sapping Vine attack.

action.name: Poisonous Thorn
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the dryad's next turn.

action.name: Sapping Vine
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit:The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the dryad can't use the same vine on another target. A creature restrained in this way takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage at the start of its turn.

The dryad has six vines. Each vine can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a vine deals no damage to the dryad, but any creature grappled by that vine no longer has the grappled condition. All vines immediately wither and disappear when the dryad is reduced to 0 hit points.

name: Deathwolf
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the deathwolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Moon's Grace
entries: When the deathwolf falls, it descends at a rate of 60 feet per round and takes no falling damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deathwolf makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Phantom Deathwolf if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on saving throws against the frightened condition. This curse lasts until removed by the Remove Curse spell or other magic.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Phantom Deathwolf (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The deathwolf creates a terrifying phantom of itself in the mind of a creature the deathwolf can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

While the target is frightened, the phantom deals 21 (6d6) psychic damage to the target at the start of each of the target's turns. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactionHeader: The deathwolf can take up to two reactions per round but only one per turn.

reaction.name: Imposing Slash
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the deathwolf makes an attack roll against it, the deathwolf forces the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on that roll. After the attack hits or misses, the deathwolf makes one Claw attack against the creature.

reaction.name: Phase Step
entries: Immediately after taking damage, the deathwolf teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is in dim light or darkness.

name: Degloth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The degloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The degloth makes two Razor Fist attacks.

action.name: Razor Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the degloth can't use this fist to grapple another target. The degloth has two fists.

bonus.name: Crush
entries: The degloth targets one creature currently grappled by it. The target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: False Lich
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The false lich casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the false lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The false lich has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The false lich makes two Death Rend attacks and uses Bloodcurdling Lament if available.

action.name: Death Rend
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

action.name: Bloodcurdling Lament (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The false lich emits a hideous shriek charged with malignant energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the false lich must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature also has the unconscious condition. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Soul Siphon
entries: The false lich targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw; if the target has the unconscious condition, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. The target takes 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The false lich then regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of force damage taken.

If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target immediately dies, its body disappears, and its soul is trapped inside one of the soul gems within the false lich's skull. After 24 hours, the gem transfers the soul to the false lich's creator.

When the false lich is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and disintegrates, leaving behind the gems. Crushing a gem releases any souls trapped within, at which point the soul's body re-forms in an unoccupied space nearest to the gem and in the same state as it was when its soul was trapped.

legendary.name: Spiteful Teleport
entries: The false lich, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of itself. It then makes one Death Rend attack if possible.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The false lich uses Spellcasting.

name: Hertilod
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the hertilod fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hertilod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shock Susceptibility
entries: If the hertilod takes lightning damage, its speed is halved until the end of its next turn, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or immediately regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hertilod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hertilod makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the hertilod. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hertilod. At the start of each of the hertilod's turns, each swallowed creature takes 13 (2d12) poison damage from the poisonous secretion in the hertilod's gullet.

The hertilod's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the hertilod takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the hertilod must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition. If the hertilod dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Sprint
entries: The hertilod moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The hertilod drains life from the creatures in its gullet to bolster itself. Each creature in the hertilod's gullet takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the hertilod regains a number of hit points equal to the damage.

name: Kas, the Betrayer
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Eager Betrayer
entries: Kas adds 1d10 to his initiative rolls. He has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has the frightened condition.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Kas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Kas regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Kas wears the Crown of Lies (see the Introduction of Vecna: Eve of Ruin).

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Kas can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Strength of the Night
entries: Kas doesn't require a coffin, and he drinks blood to sow terror rather than for sustenance. If destroyed, Kas revives in 1d100 nights in an unoccupied space in Tovag, his Domain of Dread. He can be permanently destroyed only by having a stake driven through his heart and then being beheaded. The stake must be cut from a tree growing in soil from Oerth, Kas's home world.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, Kas takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kas makes three Vengeful Sword attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with a Bite attack.

action.name: Vengeful Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d8 + 11) slashing damage. The sword scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Kas regains a number of hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Kas's control.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Kas transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Kas has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Kas can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. Kas has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage except the damage he takes as part of his Vampire Weaknesses trait. While in mist form, Kas can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

bonus.name: Menacing Glare
entries: Kas targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of Kas's next turn.

reaction.name: Parrying Riposte
entries: Kas adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack roll that would hit him. He then makes one Vengeful Sword attack against the attacker if it is within his reach. On a hit, the target takes an additional 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Kas moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Sword (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Kas makes one Vengeful Sword attack.

legendary.name: Rise, Fallen Soldier (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Kas magically summons a specter. The specter appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kas, whom it obeys. The specter takes its turn immediately after Kas. It lasts for 1 hour, until Kas dies, or until Kas dismisses it as a bonus action. Kas can't have more than two specters summoned at a time.

name: Mirror Shade
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the mirror shade is within 5 feet of a reflective surface - such as a mirror, glass pane, or still water - it has advantage on its initiative roll. If a creature hasn't observed the mirror shade move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the mirror shade isn't the creature's own reflection.

trait.name: Mirror Movement
entries: The mirror shade can move along the surface of reflective or translucent objects, such as mirrors, without provoking opportunity attacks. It can move through translucent objects as if they were difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mirror shade makes two Phantasmal Strike attacks and uses Reflect Fear.

action.name: Phantasmal Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) radiant damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

action.name: Reflect Fear
entries: The mirror shade targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself and projects an illusion of that creature's greatest fear. The target must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the mirror shade's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

bonus.name: Mirror Stealth
entries: While within 5 feet of a reflective surface, such as a mirror, the mirror shade takes the Hide action.

name: Moonlight Guardian
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The guardian is immune to any spell or other effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Radiant Absorption
entries: Whenever the guardian is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two Moonlight Slam attacks.

action.name: Moonlight Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Moonlight Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The guardian unleashes a magical blast of moonlight in a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. Creatures that aren't in their true form have disadvantage on the save. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (5d8) radiant damage, and if it isn't in its true form, it is forced into its true form and can't change forms until the end of the guardian's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

name: Relentless Impaler
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Bloodheart Stake
entries: The impaler is magically bound to the ceremonial stake and the sacrificed corpse the ritual caster used to create it. If the impaler is reduced to 0 hit points, it disappears, then re-forms 1d8 hours later in the nearest unoccupied space to the stake and regains all its hit points. The impaler dies only if it is reduced to 0 hit points while either the ceremonial stake is removed from the sacrifice's corpse or the impaler is on a different plane of existence from that corpse.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the impaler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The impaler makes one Spike attack and two Wicked Spear attacks.

action.name: Spike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the impaler's next turn.

action.name: Wicked Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

action.name: Spike Burst (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Twisted, spectral spikes shoot out from the impaler's body. Each creature within 30 feet of the impaler must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Speed Spike
entries: The impaler teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It can then make a Spike attack.

legendary.name: Deepen Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature whose speed is currently reduced by the impaler's Spike attack takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The spiderdragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spiderdragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spiderdragon ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spiderdragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Spiderling Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The spiderdragon exhales venomous spiderlings in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) piercing damage and 33 (6d10) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Stifling Webs (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The spiderdragon spins a 30-foot cube of strong, sticky webbing in an area adjacent to itself. The webbing lasts for 1 minute, is difficult terrain, and lightly obscures its area. A creature that starts its turn in the webbing or enters the webbing for the first time on its turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained while in the web. As an action, a creature can free itself or another creature from the web by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check.
A 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 10 acid, fire, or slashing damage on a single turn.

name: Star Angler
senses: blindsight 120 ft. (can't see beyond this radius)

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the star angler is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The star angler's lure sheds bright light in a 30- foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The star angler makes three Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Lure Charm
entries: The star angler's lure flares with enchanting starlight, targeting one creature the star angler can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the star angler's next turn.
