entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the thornblood's space. Hit:20 (4d6 + 6) piercing damage, and the tar get is entangled in thorny vines. While entangled, the target is restrained and moves with the thornblood, can't see outside their space, and takes 20 (4d6 + 6) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns. The target or another creature within 5 feet of them can use their action to take 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage and make a DC 20 Strength check, freeing the target on a success.

action.name: From Life, Lightning (2/Day)
entries: The thornblood must have at least one creature entangled to use this action. Each creature entangled by the thornblood must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Then the thornblood shoots a bolt of lightning at each enemy within 60 feet of them who isn't entangled by them. Each target must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: You're Mine
entries: The thornblood moves an entangled creature to a space occupied by the thornblood that isn't also occupied by another creature or object.

reaction.name: Hostile Roots
entries: When an enemy ends their turn in the thornblood's space, the thornblood attempts to pull them down. The target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the tormenauk's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the tormenauk must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The tormenauk can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the tormenauk reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the tormenauk consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the tormenauk's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a wish spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tormenauk makes two Slam attacks and one Many Maws attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 15), and they are restrained until the grapple ends. The tormenauk can grapple up to two targets at a time.

action.name: Many Maws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target grappled by the tormenauk. Hit:21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Agony Wail (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The tormenauk screeches, broadcasting a consumed soul's lifelong pain. Each creature within 30 feet of the tormenauk who can hear them must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who knew the owner of the burned soul have disadvantage on the saving throw.

reaction.name: Share Agony (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When the tormenauk takes damage, they choose a creature they can see within 30 feet of them to share the pain. The target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking psychic damage equal to the triggering damage taken by the tormenauk on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the limbjumble takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the limbjumble takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Arm and a Leg (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:2 bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller and if three or more limbjumbles joined the attack, the target is knocked prone.

name: Tusker Demon
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the demon's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the demon must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The demon can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the demon reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the demon consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the demon's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a wish spell.

trait.name: Trample
entries: The demon can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as if they were difficult terrain. When the demon enters a creature's space for the first time on the demon's turn, the demon can make a Stomp attack against that creature (no action required). Additionally, the demon can end their turn in the space of a prone creature who is Medium or smaller, and that creature can't stand up while in the demon's space.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage. The demon can burn 1 soul to push the target up to 40 feet directly away from the demon.

action.name: Stomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tongue
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit:16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet toward the demon.

reaction.name: Vengeful Charge (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When an enemy within 40 feet of the demon deals damage to the demon, the demon can move up to their speed straight toward them. If the demon ends this movement within 10 feet of the enemy, the demon can make a Gore attack against them.

trait.name: Acid Absorption
entries: Whenever the valochera is subjected to acid damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

trait.name: Unbearable Stench
entries: Any creature who starts their turn within 5 feet of the valochera must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The valochera makes two Mycelium attacks.

action.name: Mycelium
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 15).
Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

action.name: Chow Time
entries: The valochera douses a creature they have grappled with acid and then takes a bite. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage plus 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Poison Glob (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The valochera spits a glob of noxious sludge at a point they can see within 30 feet of them.

Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The voiceless talker manifests a power and makes one Tentacle or Psionic Pistol attack.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Psionic Pistol
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit:15 (2d10 + 4) force damage.

action.name: Memory Thief (4th-Order Power)
entries: The voiceless talker psionically plunders the mind of a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage, and until they finish a long rest or die, their proficiency bonus is cumulatively lowered by 1 and the voiceless talker gains a cumulative +2 bonus to damage rolls. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and doesn't have their proficiency bonus reduced.
A creature whose proficiency bonus drops to 0 can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.

action.name: Flay (3/Day; 5th-Order Power)
entries: The voiceless talker shoots forth a 15-foot cone of pure psionic energy. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
entries: The voiceless talker projects a psionic image over their body, transforming their appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature they have seen. When they manifest this power, they can also change the appearance of any equipment they carry for the duration.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect the voiceless talker's appearance and make a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

reaction.name: Brain Drain
entries: When a creature grappled by the voiceless talker makes a saving throw against one of the voiceless talker's powers, the voiceless talker momentarily weakens the creature and the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Phasing Rifle (1/Turn)
entries: When the artillerist hits a target with their Psionic Rifle attack, the artillerist can attempt to teleport the target (no action required). The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be teleported to an unoccupied space the artillerist can see within 60 feet of the artillerist.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The artillerist makes two Psionic Rifle attacks, or they manifest a power and make one Phasing Tentacles attack.

action.name: Psionic Rifle
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit:21 (3d10 + 5) force damage.

action.name: Phasing Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:21 (3d10 + 5) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the artillerist can choose one of the following effects: the target is grappled (escape DC 17) or teleported up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space the artillerist can see.

action.name: *Memory Thief (5th-Order Power)
entries: The artillerist psionically plunders the mind of a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage, and until they finish a long rest or die, their proficiency bonus is lowered by 1 and the artillerist gains a cumulative +2 bonus to damage rolls. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and doesn't have their proficiency bonus reduced.
A creature whose proficiency bonus drops to 0 can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.

action.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
entries: The artillerist projects a psionic image over their body, transforming their appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature they have seen. When they manifest this power, they can also change the appearance of any equipment they carry for the duration.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect the artillerist's appearance and make a DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonus.name: *Vanish for One (3/Day; 3rd-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: The artillerist cloaks themself from the sight of a creature the artillerist can see within 60 feet of them. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or the artillerist becomes invisible to the creature for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). This effect ends early if the artillerist attacks the creature, deals damage to them, or creates an effect that forces them to make a saving throw.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the graywarper takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the graywarper takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Psionic Nexus
entries: When a non-minion voiceless talker within 30 feet of the graywarper uses telepathy or manifests a psionic power, they can do so as if they were in the graywarper's space.

action.name: Phase Chant (Group Attack)
entries: Mleee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit:4 psychic damage. If the target is a creature and if three or more graywarpers joined the attack, the target must make a Charisma saving throw. The DC for this saving throw is 11 plus the number of graywarpers who joined the attack. On a failed save, the target becomes phased until the end of their next turn. While phased, the creature is translucent and immaterial, and they deal half damage with weapon attacks and unarmed strikes.

trait.name: Baby Burst
entries: When the spider dies, a swarm of spiders bursts forth from their remains and acts on the same initiative count as the spider did.

trait.name: Rider Launcher
entries: An allied rider who jumps off the spider has a long jump of 30 feet and a high jump of 15 feet, with or without a running start. If an allied rider jumps off the spider, the first melee weapon attack the ally makes on the same turn has advantage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

trait.name: Wide Back
entries: Two Small or Tiny creatures can share a space while riding the spider, allowing up to eighteen Small or seventy-two Tiny creatures to ride the spider at once.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Bladed Leg
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Web Spray
entries: The spider sprays webbing from their abdomen in a 15-foot cube. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the webbing. A creature can use their action to make a DC 14 Strength or Dexterity check, freeing themself or another creature they can reach on a success.

action.name: Trample (Recharge 6)
entries: The spider can move up to their speed and move through the spaces of other creatures as if they were difficult terrain. The spider can make one Bladed Leg attack against each creature whose space they move into during the move. A creature hit by this attack can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the willow remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal willow tree.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the willow takes fire damage, they catch fire and take 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute. The effect ends early if the willow takes cold damage or a creature uses an action to extinguish the flames.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The willow makes two Frenzied Branch attacks.

action.name: Frenzied Branch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit:12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the willow is on fire, this attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Tugging Roots
entries: Roots erupt from a point on the ground the willow can see within 60 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and moved up to 30 feet toward the willow, taking 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet moved.

action.name: Willow's Tears
entries: The willow showers salty droplets on their bower. Each creature within 15 feet of the willow must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the willow (save ends at end of turn). While charmed in this way, a creature can't willingly move more than 15 feet away from the willow. If a creature charmed in this way takes damage, the effect ends for them.

reaction.name: Tree Transformation
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the willow deals slashing damage to the willow, the willow attempts to turn the creature into a tree. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or their feet begin to transform into tree roots and they are restrained. A creature restrained in this way must repeat the saving throw at the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, they are transformed into a wooden tree and are petrified. A creature petrified in this way resembles a normal tree of the same size as that creature, except the creature's face appears carved into the trunk. If the willow dies, the petrification ends and the creature reverts to their true form. A lesser restoration spell also ends this effect.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the wobalas's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the wobalas must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The wobalas can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the wobalas reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the wobalas consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the wobalas's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a wish spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wobalas makes three Despair Bolt attacks.

action.name: Despair Bolt
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one creature. Hit:16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The wobalas can burn 1 soul to make the target frightened of them for 1 minute. If the target is immune to being frightened, the wobalas regains the burned soul.

action.name: Banishing Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit:22 (4d10) psychic damage, and the target is teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the wobalas can see.

bonus.name: Flee, Mortal (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The wobalas chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move their speed away from the wobalas by the most direct route possible, with no regard for their own safety. Creatures who can't be frightened succeed on this saving throw automatically.

trait.name: Death Wail
entries: When the yumgrub dies, they let out a distressing screech. Each creature within 15 feet who can hear the yumgrub takes 1 psychic damage. Yumgrubs and creatures who have eaten a yumgrub within the last minute are immune to this damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the yumgrub takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the yumgrub takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The yumgrub can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Yum
entries: A Small or larger creature can use an action to consume a living yumgrub within 5 feet of them. The yumgrub dies, and for 1 minute, the consuming creature's speed is doubled and they gain a +4 bonus to their Strength score and a +2 bonus to AC. When the effect ends, the creature gains two levels of exhaustion.

action.name: Bite (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. -1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire ancient lightning eel takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The eel can breathe air and water. They can survive out of water for up to 24 hours.

trait.name: Foudroyant Majesty (3/Day)
entries: When the eel fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead. When they do, they can't take the Multiattack action on their next turn.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The eel has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the grappled condition on themself.

trait.name: Stormsurge
entries: Other lightning eels within 30 feet of the ancient eel deal an extra 24 (3d12 + 6) lightning damage with their weapon attacks and Electric Pulse.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eel makes one Bite attack and uses Electric Pulse.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:18 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 30 (4d12 + 6) lightning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). While grappled, the target is restrained and the eel can't make a Bite attack against another target.

action.name: Electric Pulse
entries: The eel channels energy toward a creature within 60 feet of them. The creature must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, made with disadvantage if the target is touching the eel. On a failed save, a creature takes 54 (8d12 + 6) lightning damage and is dazed until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

bonus.name: Coiling Storm
entries: The eel coils around a creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 19).

reaction.name: Heart of the Storm
entries: When another lightning eel that the ancient eel can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the ancient eel releases a crackling filament of lightning in their direction. The target is restored to life with 10 hit points. Each lighting eel can be restored to life only once with this reaction.

legendary.name: Call to the Storm
entries: Every other lightning eel within 30 feet of the ancient eel can use their Electric Pulse action as a reaction.

legendary.name: Electric Rush
entries: The eel surges with lightning, moves up to their speed, then makes a Bite attack. On a hit, the Bite attack deals an extra 18 (4d8) lightning damage. A creature who hits the eel with a melee attack during this movement takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

legendary.name: Fulminous Wave
entries: The eel releases a crackling wave of electricity and uses Electric Pulse against each enemy within 30 feet of them.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire clawfish takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The clawfish can hold their breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:9 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, and if the target is a Small or larger creature, the clawfish becomes attached to the target (remove DC 13).

action.name: Electrocute (Recharge 6)
entries: Each creature touching the clawfish takes 23 (4d10 + 3) lightning damage. If the clawfish is immersed in water, each other creature within 10 feet of the clawfish who is touching the same body of water must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

name: Dire Deathhawk
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire deathhawk takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Corpse Sense
entries: Within a range of 5 miles, the deathhawk can sense the presence of Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days; the deathhawk knows the general direction these are in but not their exact locations. In addition, the deathhawk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to find Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The deathhawk doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deathhawk makes one Beak attack and one Wounding Talons attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:17 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Wounding Talons
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:17 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they begin bleeding (2d10).

bonus.name: Bloodcurdling Shriek (Recharge 6)
entries: The deathhawk shrieks, and each enemy within 300 feet of the deathhawk who can hear them must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures who are immune to the frightened condition automatically succeed on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is horrified for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While horrified, each time the creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, they are immune to the Bloodcurdling Shriek of all deathhawks for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire lightning eel takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The eel can breathe air and water. They can survive out of water for up to 8 hours.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The eel has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the grappled condition on themself.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:11 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Electric Pulse
entries: The eel channels energy toward a creature within 20 feet of them. The target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, made with disadvantage if the target is touching the eel. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (6d12 + 2) lightning damage and is dazed until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire scyza takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The scyza deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: War Harness
entries: While wearing a war harness, the scyza can carry up to thirty-six Medium or smaller creatures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scyza makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:18 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage, and the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Tail Whip
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit:21 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is on top of the scyza, the target falls off and lands prone.

action.name: Head Crest
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:31 (5d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature who can hear, they are dazed until the end of their next turn by the crest's deep ringing.

action.name: Claw Twister (Recharge 6)
entries: The scyza claws at the ground in a flurry. Each creature of the scyza's choice within 5 feet of them must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (5d12 + 6) slashing damage, is knocked prone, and is blinded by a cloud of dust until the start of the scyza's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone or blinded.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire skitterling takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The skitterling doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:5 (1d4 + 3), and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn. Creatures who are immune to poison damage or the poisoned condition succeed on this saving throw automatically.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire stoneback isopod takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The isopod can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The isopod has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:20 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Seize
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit:13 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the isopod can't make a Seize attack against another target.

reaction.name: Curl
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the isopod hits them with an attack, the isopod defensively rolls up inside their rocky carapace. The isopod gains a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack, and the attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 23 (3d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet into an unoccupied space of the isopod's choice.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the swarm of dire skitterlings takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: In Your Face
entries: While the swarm occupies an enemy's space, that creature has disadvantage on attack rolls made against any target other than the swarm and takes 18 (3d10 + 3) slashing damage if they attack a creature other than the swarm.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Diminutive creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit:33 (6d10 + 3) slashing damage, or 23 (4d10 + 3) slashing damage if the swarm has half of their hit points or fewer. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn. Creatures who are immune to poison damage or the poisoned condition succeed on this saving throw automatically.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire war spider takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Baby Burst
entries: When the spider dies, a swarm of spiders bursts forth from their remains and acts on the same initiative count as the spider did.

trait.name: Rider Launcher
entries: An allied rider who jumps off the spider has a long jump of 30 feet and a high jump of 15 feet, with or without a running start. If an allied rider jumps off the spider, the first melee weapon attack the ally makes on the same turn has advantage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

trait.name: Wide Back
entries: Two Small or Tiny creatures can share a space while riding the spider, allowing up to eighteen Small or seventy-two Tiny creatures to ride the spider at once.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:17 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 25 (4d10 + 5) poison damage.

action.name: Bladed Leg
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit:17 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Web Spray
entries: The spider sprays webbing from their abdomen in a 15-foot cube. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the webbing. A creature can use their action to make a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity check, freeing themself or another creature they can reach on a success.

action.name: Trample (Recharge 6)
entries: The spider can move up to their speed and move through the spaces of other creatures as if they were difficult terrain. The spider can make one Bladed Leg attack against each creature whose space they move into during the move. A creature hit by this attack can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire yumgrub takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Death Wail
entries: When the yumgrub dies, they let out a distressing screech. Each creature within 15 feet who can hear the yumgrub takes 1 psychic damage. Yumgrubs and creatures who have eaten a yumgrub within the last minute are immune to this damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the yumgrub takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the yumgrub takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The yumgrub can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Yum
entries: A Small or larger creature can use an action to consume a living yumgrub within 5 feet of them. The yumgrub dies, and for 1 minute, the consuming creature's speed is doubled and they gain a +4 bonus to their Strength score and a +2 bonus to AC. When the effect ends, the creature gains two levels of exhaustion.

action.name: Bite (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:2 (1d4).

name: Sightless Astral Dreadnought
resist: damage from attacks made without advantage

trait.name: Astral Brace
entries: The dreadnought cannot be banished or teleported out of the Astral Plane.
A creature that hits the dreadnought with a melee weapon attack is pushed 15 feet away from it, unless it is grappling or attached to the dreadnought.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: Attacks made against the dreadnought by a creature attached to it have advantage, and the dreadnought has disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures attached to it.

trait.name: Sightless Socket
entries: The dreadnought is blinded and can't be cured by any means.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dreadnought fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Timeless Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 61 (8d12 + 9) piercing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dreadnought can force the target to succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be drawn into the dreadnought's donjon.
On a success, the target can prop the dreadnought's mouth open for a moment, allowing up to one creature within the donjon to use its reaction to escape.

action.name: Cordcutter Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (5d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 22).
On a critical hit, a target affected by the Astral Projection spell must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or die.

legendary.name: Claw Crush
entries: One creature or object grappled by the dreadnought must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 38 (7d10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Distortion Pulse
entries: A bubble of distorted space ripples out from the dreadnought in a 20 foot radius.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away.

legendary.name: Inverting Escape
entries: The dreadnought disgorges each creature in its donjon, then can make a DC 22 Constitution check, swallowing itself and disappearing down the length of its body and into its donjon on a success.
After 1 hour, the dreadnought reappears in a random unoccupied space in the Astral Plane.

mythic.name: Endless Gaze

trait.name: Aura Sight
entries: The mageripper treats each creature within 60 feet that has unexpended spell slots or magical items as though it can see them clearly.

action.name: Spellripper Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage and the mageripper becomes attached to the target (remove DC 14).
If the mageripper has any temporary hit points, this attack deals an additional 5 (1d10) force damage.

bonus.name: Devour Magic
entries: One creature the mageripper is attached to must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or lose its lowest level unexpended spell slot.
The mageripper gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the total of spell levels lost in this way.

The charmed creature takes 3 (1d6) nonlethal psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns for each 5 feet away from the nereid that it is.

On a failed save, a creature is charmed by the nereid and can't speak or take actions for as long as she continues singing.
This effect ends for each affected creature if any affected creature begins suffocating.

entries: When the dire prowcrusher hippopotamus takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Dense Bones
entries: The hippopotamus can move without hinderance across the bottom of a waterway.
While swimming, the hippopotamus sinks 20 feet at the end of each of its turns.

trait.name: Protective Blubber
entries: The hippopotamus reduces any bludgeoning or slashing damage it takes by 3.

trait.name: Territorial Rage
entries: If the hippopotamus begins its turn within 10 feet of one or more hostile creatures, it has advantage on attacks that target those creatures and disadvantage on other attacks until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hippopotamus makes two attacks with its Bellowing Bite, one of which it can replace with its River-Splash Trample.

action.name: Bellowing Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (5d12 + 7) piercing damage.
A Gargantuan or smaller watercraft hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or overturn.

action.name: River-Splash Trample
entries: The hippopotamus moves up to 20 feet in a straight line, and can move through the space of any Huge or larger creature.

Each creature whose space the hippopotamus moves through in this way must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 31 (4d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be pushed ahead of the hippopotamus, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A creature at least partially submerged in water has disadvantage on this saving throw.

bonus.name: Buoyant Leap
entries: If the hippopotamus is at the bottom of a waterway, it can leap up to 15 feet.

bonus.name: Tuskmaw Gape
entries: The hippopotamus' mouth yawns wide, giving one creature within 10 feet disadvantage on the first melee attack it makes against the hippopotamus before the beginning of the hippopotamus' next turn.

reaction.name: Tuskmaw Reprisal
entries: When a creature affected by the hippopotamus' Tuskmaw Gape misses it with a melee attack, the hippopotamus can make a Bellowing Bite attack against it.

name: Rustchoked Iron Golem
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Flame-Softened
entries: If the golem is dealt any fire damage, it loses its damage resistances until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Screeching Halt
entries: If the golem misses with an attack, it immediately ends its turn, then each creature within 30 feet that can hear it and is concentrating must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

trait.name: Golemcraft Ward (1/Day)
entries: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead.
The golem adds +3 to its saving throws against spells and magical effects for each use of this ability is has remaining.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two melee attacks.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
If this attack exceeds the target's AC by 5 or more, the target is pushed 5 feet away and knocked prone.

action.name: Rust-Pitted Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage, plus an additional 5 (1d10) slashing damage if the target is prone.

reaction.name: Furnace-Fume Remnants
entries: When the golem takes any acid or fire damage, it can deal 4 (1d8) poison damage to each creature within 10 feet of it.

name: Forgeborn Iron Golem

trait.name: Armor Breach
entries: While the golem has fewer than 106 hit points, it continuously leaks poison gas.
Its Crucible Fume recharges only on a roll of 6, and any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the golem takes 13 (3d8) poison damage.

trait.name: Golemcraft Ward (2/Day)
entries: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage, plus an additional 11 (2d10) slashing damage if the target is prone.

action.name: Crucible Fume (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The golem vents forth acrid fumes in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 45 (10d8) poison damage and begin choking until the end of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aalpamac can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Distance Distortion Aura
entries: The presence of an aalpamac distorts the vision of creatures within 60 feet of it. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to correctly judge the distance between itself and its surroundings until the start of its next turn. An affected creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and it can't move more than half its speed on its turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the aalpamac's Distance Distortion Aura for the next 24 hours. Creatures with blindsight, tremorsense, or truesight are unaffected by this trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aalpamac makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

trait.name: Armored Berserker
entries: The pain caused by the iron plates bolted to the abaasy's body keep it on the edge of madness. Whenever the abaasy starts its turn with 60 hp or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the abaasy goes berserk. While berserk, the abaasy has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

On each of its turns while berserk, the abaasy attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the abaasy attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the abaasy goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hp.

trait.name: Dual Shields
entries: The abaasy carries two shields, which together give it a +3 bonus to its AC (included in its AC).

trait.name: Poor Depth Perception
entries: The abaasy has disadvantage on attack rolls against a target more than 30 feet away from it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abaasy makes three melee attacks, only one of which can be a Shield Shove attack. If the abaasy uses two hands to make a Spear attack, it can't make an Iron Axe attack that turn.

action.name: Iron Axe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Shield Shove
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (4d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone or pushed up to 15 feet away from the abaasy (the abaasy's choice).

action.name: Spear
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, or 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Eyebeam (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The abaasy fires a beam of oscillating energy from its eye in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Abhaddanayla, Lord of Rakshasas
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Abhaddanayla fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Abhaddanayla can't be affected or detected by spells of 8th level or lower unless he wishes to be. He has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Puppet Master
entries: When Abhaddanayla casts the charm person spell, he can target up to seven creatures. When he casts the dominate person spell, the spell's duration is concentration, up to 8 hours. When he casts the mass suggestion spell, the spell's duration is 30 days.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Abhaddanayla makes six Claw attacks or three Serpent Bow attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting. If Abhaddanayla hits one creature with two Serpent Bow attacks, a swarm of snakes appears in the target's space, acting as an ally of Abhaddanayla and obeying his telepathic commands. The swarm remains for 1 minute, until Abhaddanayla dies, or until he dismisses it as a bonus action. He can have no more than four swarms active at a time.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the target is cursed if it is a creature. The magical curse takes effect whenever the target takes a short or long rest, filling the target's thoughts with horrible images and dreams. The cursed target gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

action.name: Serpent Bow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

action.name: Burning Monkey Cloud (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Abhaddanayla conjures a cloud of quasi-real burning, screaming monkeys in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 60 feet of him. Each creature in the area must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 38 (11d6) fire damage and 38 (11d6) psychic damage and becomes frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Duplicitous Disguise
entries: Abhaddanayla covers himself and anything he is wearing or carrying with a illusion that makes him look like a Small or Medium Humanoid. The illusion ends if he takes a bonus action to end it or if he dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 21 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that Abhaddanayla is disguised.

reaction.name: Sacrificial Monkey (3/Day)
entries: When Abhaddanayla is hit by a melee attack, a withered monkey composed of shadow appears and throws itself into the path of the attack, halving the damage Abhaddanayla takes before vanishing.

entries: Abhaddanayla makes one Claw or Serpent Bow attack.

entries: Abhaddanayla uses Spellcasting.

entries: Abhaddanayla becomes invisible at the same time that an illusory double of himself appears where he is standing. After the double appears, Abhaddanayla can move up to his speed. Both effects last until the start of his next turn, but the invisibility ends early if Abhaddanayla attacks or casts a spell.

trait.name: Darkness Aura
entries: An adult or older cave dragon can generate an aura of darkness that fills its space and the surrounding 20 feet. This darkness prevents normal vision and darkvision from functioning. Blindsight and truesight function normally. Activating or deactivating the aura is a bonus action.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: An adult cave dragon glides through stone, dirt, or any sort of earth except metal as easily as a fish glides through water. Its burrowing produces no ripple or other sign of its presence and leaves no tunnel or hole unless the dragon chooses to do so; in that case, it creates a passageway 15 feet wide by 10 feet high. The spell move earth cast on an area containing an earth-gliding cave dragon flings the dragon back 30 feet and stuns the creature for one round unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw.
