entries: A dome of magic covers the nautilord, just large enough to contain its shell. The nautilord can control the ambient pressure, temperature, water levels, and breathable air levels (for air-breathing passengers) inside, allowing creatures and objects within it to exist comfortably in spite of conditions outside the nautilord. Creatures and objects within the shell have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the nautilord. Creatures inside the shell can exit whenever they want, but nothing can pass into the shell's dome unless the nautilord allows it. The area inside the dome is a magnificent palace carved into the nautilord's shell, complete with open 'air' balconies used as entrances or exits, and numerous covered chambers that can comfortably hold up to 50 passengers. The palace is 60 feet long, 30 feet wide, and 80 feet tall. When the nautilord dies, any creatures inside the dome are expelled into unoccupied spaces near the closest exit.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The nautilord can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature inside the magical dome that surrounds it shell. Similarly, it can hear and understand any creature inside the dome, regardless of the language it speaks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nautilord makes two Beak attacks and one Tentacles attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the nautilord can automatically hit the target with its Tentacles, and the nautilord can't make Tentacles attacks against other targets.

action.name: Jet Propulsion (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nautilord releases a magical burst of pressure that propels it backwards in a line that is 90 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature within 15 feet of the space the nautilord left and each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) force damage and is pushed up to 20 feet away from the nautilord and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, but isn't pushed or knocked prone.

reaction.name: Withdraw
entries: When a creature the nautilord can see targets it with an attack, the nautilord can pull its body into its shell, gaining a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Evasion
entries: If the nullicorn is subjected to a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, the nullicorn instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: At the end of the nullicorn's turn, any spell or magical effect with a duration that is affecting the nullicorn, such as hold monster or mage armor, immediately ends.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The nullicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Nullifying Blight
entries: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 hours after infection, which include fatigue, light-headedness, and blurry vision. When an infected creature casts a spell or activates a magic item, an itchy rash appears and spreads as more magic is used. Until this disease is cured, when the infected creature starts its turn wielding or wearing a magic item and each time it casts a spell or activates a magic item, it loses 5 (2d4) hp.

At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the hp the creature loses each time it uses magic increases by 2 (1d4). A creature that succeeds on three saving throws recovers from the disease.

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The nullicorn senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nullicorn makes two Hooves attacks and one Void Horn attack.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Void Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract the nullifying blight disease (see the Nullifying Blight trait).

action.name: Spread Blight (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nullicorn's Void horn flashes and emits a brief ripple of darkness. Each creature within 20 feet of the nullicorn must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and contracts the nullifying blight disease (see the Nullifying Blight trait). On a success, a creature takes half the da half the damage and doesn't contract the disease.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the oaken sentinel remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary oak tree.

trait.name: Grasping Branches
entries: The oaken sentinel can have up to six Grasping Branches at a time. Each Grasping Branch can be attacked (AC 16; 25 hp; vulnerability to lightning damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a Grasping Branch deals no damage to the oaken sentinel, which can extend a replacement branch on its next turn. A Grasping Branch can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 16 Strength check against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oaken sentinel makes three Grasping Branch or Rock attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Fling.

action.name: Grasping Branch
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 50 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and the sentinel can't use the same Grasping Branch on another target.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Medium or smaller creature grappled by the oaken sentinel is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

name: Origami Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The origami golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: False Appearance (Unfolded Form Only)
entries: While the golem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary paper screen, tapestry, or similar flat paper or fabric artwork.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, except Fold.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Standing Leap (Frog Form Only)
entries: The golem's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The origami golem makes three Lacerating Strike or Wing Buffet attacks.

action.name: Lacerating Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Wing Buffet (Dragon or Swan Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Hazardous Hop (Frog Form Only)
entries: If the golem jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature within 10 of the golem when it lands must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

action.name: Shredded Breath (Dragon Form Only) (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem exhales a spray of paper fragments in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 31 (9d6) slashing damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded.

action.name: Trumpeting Blast (Swan Form Only) (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The golem emits a trumpeting blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 31 (7d8) thunder damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't deafened.

bonus.name: Fold
entries: The golem can fold and reshape its papery body to resemble a Large dragon, a Large swan, or a Medium frog. It can use this bonus action again to unfold into a Large, flat piece of decorative fabric or paper. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. It reverts to its unfolded form if it dies.

name: Ortifex
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Blood Bearer
entries: A creature that subsists on blood, such as a vampire, can use its action while within 5 feet of the ortifex to drain blood from it. The creature can drain up to the ortifex's current temporary hp, regaining hp equal to that amount. The ortifex then loses temporary hp equal to that amount.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The ortifex can pinpoint the location of creatures that aren't constructs or undead within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Hypnotic Heartbeat
entries: A creature that can hear the ortifex's heartbeat and starts its turn within 60 feet of the ortifex must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of its next turn. While charmed, it is incapacitated and must move toward the ortifex by the most direct route on its turn, trying to get within 5 feet of the ortifex. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

Unless surprised, a creature can plug its ears to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it is deafened until it unplugs its ears. If the creature unplugs its ears while still within range of the ortifex's heartbeat, it must immediately make the saving throw.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Blood Siphon (Recharge 6)
entries: The ortifex drains blood from nearby creatures. Each creature within 20 feet of the ortifex must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The ortifex gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic damage dealt. If it gains temporary hp from this action while it still has temporary hp from a previous use of this action, the temporary hp add together. The ortifex's temporary hp can't exceed half its hp maximum. A creature that doesn't have blood is immune to Blood Siphon.

trait.name: Shelve
entries: A paper drake can fold itself into a small, almost flat form, perfect for hiding on bookshelves. The drake can still be recognized as something other than a book by someone who handles it (doesn't just glance at it on the shelf) and makes a successful DC 11 Intelligence (Nature or Investigation) check. The drake can hop or fly (clumsily, by flapping its pages) 5 feet per turn in this form.

trait.name: Refold (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A paper drake can fold its body into different sizes and shapes. The drake can adjust its size by one step in either direction, but can't be smaller than Tiny or larger than Medium size. Changes in size or shape don't affect the paper drake's stats.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one bite attack, one claw attack, and one tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (5d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 round.

trait.name: Slow Burn
entries: When the peat mammoth takes fire damage, it catches fire. If the peat mammoth starts its turn on fire, it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The mammoth's saturated body douses the fire at the end of the peat mammoth's turn. Creatures engulfed by the mammoth don't take fire damage from this effect.

If the peat mammoth dies while it is on fire, it explodes in a burst of fire and flaming peat. Each creature within 15 feet of the peat mammoth must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature is engulfed by the mammoth when it dies in this way, the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage.
entries: The peat mammoth has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The peat mammoth makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the peat mammoth is on fire, the target also takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The peat mammoth moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the mammoth enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the mammoth. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the mammoth enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the mammoth's turns. When the mammoth moves, engulfed creatures move with it.

An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 17 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the mammoth. The mammoth can engulf up to two Large or smaller creatures at a time.

name: Pelagic Deva
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The pelagic deva can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The pelagic deva's weapon attacks are magical. When the deva hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immortal Nature
entries: The pelagic deva doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Living Coral Armor
entries: The pelagic deva's armor is made of living coral. If the deva's armor is damaged, such as from a black pudding's Pseudopod attack, the armor fully repairs itself within 1 minute, provided it wasn't destroyed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pelagic deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pelagic deva makes three Trident attacks.

action.name: Trident
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage. If the pelagic deva makes a ranged attack with its trident, the trident returns to its hands at the start of its next turn.

action.name: Transforming Touch (5/Day)
entries: The pelagic deva can magically polymorph a willing creature into a giant octopus, hunter shark, or plesiosaurus. The transformation lasts 8 hours, until the target uses a bonus action to transform back into its true form, or until the target dies. Any equipment the target is wearing or carrying is absorbed into its new form.

In the new form, the target retains its alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores as well as its ability to speak. Its other statistics are replaced by those of its new form, and it gains any capabilities that the new form has but it lacks.

bonus.name: Anoxic Aura (1/Day)
entries: The pelagic deva removes oxygen from the nearby water for 1 minute. Each creature that requires oxygen to live (including air-breathing creatures under the effects of the water breathing spell) and that starts its turn within 20 feet of the pelagic deva must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or begin suffocating. The deva never suffers the effects of this aura and can choose any number of creatures in the area to ignore its effects.

name: Permafrost Elemental
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The permafrost elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the permafrost elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The permafrost elemental doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Frigid Footprints
entries: The ground within 10 feet of the permafrost elemental freezes over and is difficult terrain.

trait.name: Plague Bearer
entries: If the permafrost elemental takes more than 15 fire damage on a single turn, each creature within 10 feet of the elemental must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or becomes infected with the primordial plague disease. Alternatively, the creature becomes infected with sewer plague or cackle fever (the elemental's choice) instead.

Primordial plague takes 1 minute to manifest in an infected creature. After 1 minute, the creature is poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the creature must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hp maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

action.name: Plague-Ridden Pound (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The permafrost elemental brings both of its fists down, striking the ground and sending shards of ice from its body flying at nearby creatures. Each creature on the ground within 20 feet of the elemental must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) cold damage, is knocked prone, and becomes infected with primordial plague (see the Plague Bearer trait). On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone or infected.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the pine doom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pine tree.

trait.name: Sticky Pine Tar
entries: A creature that touches the pine doom is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained. In addition, when a creature hits the pine doom with a bludgeoning or piercing weapon while within 5 feet of it, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or the weapon becomes stuck to the tree. A stuck weapon can't be used. A creature can take its action to remove one stuck weapon from the pine doom by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check. Splashing the pine doom with a gallon of alcohol frees all creatures and objects stuck to it and suppresses this trait for 1 minute.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The pine doom deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pine doom makes three slam attacks. Alternatively, it can use Sap-filled Pinecone twice.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sap-filled Pinecone
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by sap. A creature can be free if it or another creature takes an action to make a DC 16 Strength check and succeeds.

action.name: Flurry of Pinecones (Recharge 6)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the pine doom must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 15 (6d4) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Primordial Matriarch
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Elemental Attacks
entries: The primordial matriarch's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d6 damage of the type determined by Roiling Elements.

trait.name: Elemental Aura
entries: At the start of each of the primordial matriarch's turns, each creature within 5 feet of her takes 10 (3d6) damage of the type determined by Roiling Elements. A creature that touches the primordial matriarch or hits her with a melee attack while within 10 feet of her takes 10 (3d6) damage of the type determined by Roiling Elements. A nonmagical weapon that hits the matriarch is destroyed after dealing damage.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The primordial matriarch doesn't require air, food, drink or sleep.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the primordial matriarch fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The primordial matriarch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Roiling Elements
entries: At the start of each of her turns, the primordial matriarch chooses one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The matriarch has immunity to that damage type until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The primordial matriarch deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental matriarch uses Storm Blast. She then makes two Elemental Lash attacks.

action.name: Elemental Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) damage of the type determined by Roiling Elements.

action.name: Storm Blast
entries: The primordial matriarch emits elemental energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) damage of the type determined by Roiling Elements and suffers one of the following effects, depending on the damage type. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer an additional effect, unless specified below.

items.name: Acid Blast
items.entry: On a failed save, the creature is covered in acid. At the start of each of its turns, it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage until it or another creature takes an action to scrape or wash off the acid.

items.name: Cold Blast.
items.entry: On a failed save, the creature is restrained by ice until the end of its next turn, or until it or another creature takes an action to break it free. On a successful save, the creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Fire Blast.
items.entry: On a failed save, the creature catches fire. Until it or another creature takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Lightning Blast.
items.entry: On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Thunder Blast.
items.entry: On a failed save, the creature is deafened for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, a deafened creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the deafness on itself on a success. On a successful save, the creature is deafened until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Create Elementals
entries: The primordial matriarch magically creates up to 3d6 mephits, 2 air elementals, earth elementals, fire elementals, or water elementals, 2 ice elementals, or 1 rockslide elemental. The Elementals arrive at the start of her next turn, acting as allies of the matriarch and obeying her spoken commands. The Elementals remain for 1 hour, until the matriarch dies, or until the matriarch dismisses them as a bonus action. The primordial matriarch can have any number of Elementals under her control at one time, provided the combined total CR of the Elementals is no higher than 10.

reaction.name: Elemental Adaptation
entries: When the matriarch would take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, she can change the element selected with Roiling Elements to that type of damage, gaining immunity to that damage type, including the triggering damage.

legendary.name: Elemental Change
entries: The primordial matriarch changes the damage immunity granted by Roiling Elements.

legendary.name: Fly
entries: The primordial matriarch flies up to half her flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Create Elemental (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The primordial matriarch uses Create Elementals.

legendary.name: Return to Mother (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The primordial matriarch absorbs an Elemental within 10 feet of her, gaining a temporary hp equal to 10 times the CR of the Elemental absorbed.

name: Primordial Surge
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The primordial surge doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Life From Death
entries: When the surge dies, it explodes in a burst of raw creation. The area in a 50-foot radius centered on the primordial surge is blanketed in lush flora native to the region, providing enough food to feed a dozen Large or smaller creatures for 6 (1d12) days. Creatures in the area that have been dead no longer than 1 day are returned to life with 4 (1d8) hp.

trait.name: Primordial Form
entries: The primordial surge can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the primordial surge or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the primordial surge's choice). In addition, the primordial surge can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 7 (2d6) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the surge's choice). A creature that starts its turn in the primordial surge's space must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be blinded and deafened until it starts its turn outside the surge's space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The primordial surge makes three Elemental Strike attacks.

action.name: Elemental Strike
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (the primordial surge's choice).

action.name: Primordial Storm (Recharge 6)
entries: A rain of elemental energies falls around the primordial surge, producing one of the following effects:

items.name: Restorative Rain.
items.entry: Each creature within 30 feet of the surge that isn't a Construct or Undead regains 27 (5d10) hp. The area becomes difficult terrain as nonmagical plants in the area become thick and overgrown.

items.name: Ruinous Rain.
items.entry: Each creature within 30 feet of the surge must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (5d10) acid damage and 27 (5d10) fire damage and is coated in burning acid. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't coated in acid. A creature coated in acid takes 5 (1d10) acid damage and 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it or another creature takes an action to scrape or wash off the acid.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Beam (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The prismatic dragon emits a beam of white light in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The prismatic dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):

name: Pumpkin King
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Pumpkin King's innate spellcasting ability score is Charisma (save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.

trait.name: Archfey Resistance
entries: The Pumpkin King succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Pumpkin King makes two vine attacks.

action.name: Vine
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Harvest Dance (1/Day)
entries: A 15-foot-radius swirling vortex of gourds and vegetables extends out from the Pumpkin King, moves with them, and spreads around corners. The vortex lasts for 1 minute. Until the vortex ends, the area is difficult terrain for creatures other than the Pumpkin King, and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn in the area, it must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Pumpkin King moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Vine Attack
entries: The Pumpkin King makes one vine attack.

legendary.name: Fire-Fallow (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Magical fire ignites from within the Pumpkin King's pumpkin head, flickering out from their eyes and twisted mouth. Each creature within 10 feet of the Pumpkin King that can see them must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn. The fire remains until the start of the Pumpkin King's next turn. While this fire lasts, a creature that touches or hits the Pumpkin King with a melee weapon while within 5 feet of the Pumpkin King takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Pumpkin King casts a spell from their list of innate spells, consuming a use of the spell as normal.

name: Pyrite Pile
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands Dwarvish and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the pyrite pile remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal pile of gold nuggets.

trait.name: Gold Fever
entries: When a Humanoid or xorn that can see the pyrite pile starts its turn within 60 feet of the pyrite pile, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn. A charmed creature must take the Dash action and move toward the pyrite pile by the safest available route on its next turn, trying to get within 5 feet of the Elemental.

trait.name: Metal Sense
entries: The pyrite pile can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of Small or larger deposits of such metals within 1 mile.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pyrite pile makes two Slam attacks. If the pyrite pile hits one Medium or smaller creature with both attacks, the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The pyrite pile can have only one creature grappled at a time.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Nugget
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Eat Gold
entries: The pyrite pile absorbs 52 (8d12) gp worth of nonmagical items and coins made of precious metals, ignoring copper, worn or carried by one creature grappled by it, and the elemental regains hp equal to half that amount. Absorbed metal is destroyed.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the pyrrhic podthrower remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a clump of crabgrass.

trait.name: Flaming Seedpod Regrowth
entries: The pyrrhic podthrower has four Flaming Seedpods. Used Flaming Seedpods may regrow each turn. If the pyrrhic podthrower starts its turn with less than four Flaming Seedpods, roll a d6. On a roll of 5 or 6, it regrows 1d4 Flaming Seedpods, to a maximum of 4.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The pyrrhic podthrower regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the podthrower takes necrotic damage or if it is grappled and removed from the ground, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The podthrower dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pyrrhic podthrower makes three Grass Blade attacks, or it uses Flaming Seedpod twice.

action.name: Grass Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Flaming Seedpod
entries: The podthrower lobs a flaming seedpod at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. The seedpod explodes on impact and is destroyed. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 12 (5d4) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Unstable Bulb
entries: When the pyrrhic podthrower is grappled and removed from the ground while above 0 hp, the unstable root bulb bursts. Each creature within 10 feet of the podthrower must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 12 (5d4) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Ladgerda, the Queen of Mammoths
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Elephantine Passivism
entries: No elephant, mammoth, or other elephantine creature can willingly attack Ladgerda. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Ladgerda fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Archfey Resistance
entries: Ladgerda succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know her name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Ladgerda's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If she dies, Ladgerda's soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In 1d6 days, it inhabits the body of another elephantine creature on the Material Plane, which becomes Ladgerda with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every elephantine creature on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Speak with Elephantines
entries: Ladgerda can communicate with any elephant, mammoth, or other elephantine creature as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If Ladgerda moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Ladgerda can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ladgerda makes three Battleaxe attacks or two Gore attacks, or she makes one Gore attack and one Stomp attack. She can replace one attack with one Trunk attack or Trunk Slam.

action.name: Battleaxe (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage, or 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Gore (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 34 (6d8 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 34 (5d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Trunk (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 19) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Ladgerda can't use her Trunk attack on another target.

action.name: Trunk Slam
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by Ladgerda is slammed into the ground or flung away. A creature slammed to the ground must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This doesn't end the grappled condition on the target.

A creature flung away is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown creature strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Tusk Sweep (Elephantine or True Form Only) (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ladgerda channels raw magic as she sweeps her tusks in a wide arc. Each creature in a 15-foot cube must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from Ladgerda. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed away.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Ladgerda transforms into a Gargantuan oliphaunt, a Huge mammoth, a Medium female human with thick brown hair tied back in a braid, or back into her true Huge loxodon form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her.

reaction.name: Catch Weapon (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: When Ladgerda is hit by a melee weapon attack, she can reduce the damage by 1d10 + 17. If this reduces the damage to 0, Ladgerda can catch the weapon with her trunk if she is not using it to grapple a creature.

If Ladgerda catches a weapon in this way, she must make a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the attacker's Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (the target chooses the ability to use). Ladgerda has disadvantage on the check if the wielder is holding the item with two or more hands.
If she wins, she disarms the creature and can throw the weapon up to 60 feet in a random direction as part of the same reaction.

legendary.name: Regenerative Hide
entries: Ladgerda regains 15 hp. She can't use this legendary action again until the end of her next turn.

legendary.name: Trunk
entries: Ladgerda makes one Trunk attack.

legendary.name: Shoving Stampede (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Ladgerda charges, becoming an unstoppable stampede in a line up to 80 feet long and 15 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure a creature takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone. Ladgerda's movement along this line doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Queen's Trumpet (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Ladgerda raises her trunk and emits a loud trumpeting that is audible out to 300 feet. She chooses up to three creatures that can hear the trumpeting. If a target is friendly, it has advantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. If a target is hostile, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Chelamma, the Queen of Scorpions
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Chelamma's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Arachnid Passivism
entries: No scorpion or spider can willingly attack Chelamma. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Chelamma fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Archfey Resistance
entries: Chelamma succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know her name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Chelamma's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If she dies, Chelamma's soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In 1d6 days, it inhabits the body of another scorpion on the Material Plane, which then becomes Chelamma (with all of the hp and abilities thereof). Only killing every scorpion on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: Chelamma can use her action to polymorph into a Huge giant scorpion, a Medium human woman of unearthly beauty, or back into her true Medium, scorpion-tailed humanoid form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form - with the exception that only her scorpion and true forms retain her climbing and burrowing speeds. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

trait.name: Speak with Arachnids
entries: Chelamma can communicate with scorpions and spiders as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Chelamma can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In human form, Chelamma makes two scimitar attacks. In scorpion form, she makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her sting. In her true form, she makes three attacks: one with her sting and two with her scimitar.

action.name: Claw (Scorpion Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). While in scorpion form, Chelamma has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

action.name: Sting (Scorpion or True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Acidic Bile (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Chelamma spews acid from her mouth in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) acid damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: At Will Spell
entries: Chelamma casts one of her at will spells.

legendary.name: Burrow (Scorpion or True Form Only)
entries: Chelamma moves up to her burrowing speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Scimitar (Costs 2 Actions; Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: Chelamma makes one scimitar attack.

trait.name: Bladed Shell
entries: A creature that touches the crab or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the crab moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Shell Bash attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the crab can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crab makes one Claw attack and one Shell Bash attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Shell Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The reef drake deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The drake can burrow through coral and solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) slashing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Concussive Snap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The reef drake snaps its jaws, emitting concussive force in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) thunder damage, is pushed up to 15 feet away from the drake, and stops holding its breath, if was doing so. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage, isn't pushed, and doesn't lose its held breath. Constructs and objects and structures have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonus.name: Reef Stealth
entries: If the reef drake is within 10 feet of a coral reef, it can take the Hide action.

bonus.name: Siege Follow-Through
entries: If a reef drake destroys an object or structure, it can make a bite attack against a creature it can see within 5 feet of that object or structure.

name: Warforged Sentinel
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The sentinel is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sentinel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Reflective Aggresion
entries: The sentinel has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't hit it within the last minute. In addition, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against a creature if the creature dealt damage to it in the previous round.

trait.name: Spell-Deflecting Mirror
entries: Any time the sentinel is targeted by a ranged spell attack roll, roll a d6. On a 5, the sentinel is unaffected. On a 6, the sentinel is unaffected and the spell is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the sentinel, turning the caster into the target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged sentinel makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Warp Reflection
entries: The warforged sentinel points its shield at a creature within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the sentinel's shield, the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't frightened. An evil-aligned target has disadvantage on this saving throw. At the start of each of the frightened creature's turns, it takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Reflective Retribution
entries: The sentinel adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the sentinel must see the attacker. If the attacker misses, the attacker takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The riptide drake can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The riptide drake can't use its blindsight while deafened or out of the water.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The riptide drake has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The riptide drake makes three Sonic Pulse attacks or one Bite attack and two Slam attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sonic Pulse
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) thunder damage. The riptide drake can use this action only while underwater.

action.name: Buffeting Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The riptide drake exhales a powerful stream of water in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 38 (7d10) bludgeoning damage and becomes disoriented for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't disoriented. When a disoriented creature moves, it moves in a random direction. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Manipulate Currents
entries: While underwater, the riptide drake can change the flow of water within 60 feet of it. It can choose one of the following effects, which lasts until the start of its next turn.

items: A 20-foot cube of rushing water forms on a point the drake can see in the water. The cube's space is difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn swimming in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed out of the cube directly away from the riptide drake.

The current shoots in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line from the drake in a direction it chooses. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the drake in a direction following the line.
The drake takes the Dash action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Feinting Frolick
entries: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Merciless Mockery
entries: The satyr mocks the failure of a creature within 10 feet of it that has failed an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw since the end of the satyr's last turn. The target must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) psychic damage on a failed save. This damage can't reduce a target below 1 hit point.

action.name: Impulsive Rush
entries: The satyr takes the Dodge action and moves up to half its speed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Feinting Frolick
entries: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The satyr makes two attacks and can use its Thrashing Leap or Impulsive Rush.

action.name: Spirited Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
The first time each turn that this attack misses, the satyr must make an additional attack roll, choosing a different target in its reach.

action.name: Thrashing Leap
entries: The satyr leaps up to 15 feet, then each creature within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Impulsive Rush
entries: The satyr takes the Dodge action and moves up to half its speed.

reaction.name: Pluck Free
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the satyr rolls a 1 on an attack roll, it can steal the creature's weapon. The satyr is considered proficient with a weapon they steal using this feature.

reaction.name: Wild Whirl
entries: When a creature enters the satyr's reach for the first time on a turn, the satyr can make a melee attack against it at disadvantage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Feinting Frolick
entries: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The satyr makes three attacks and can use its Impulsive Rush or Share Libations.

action.name: Wild Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.
On a miss, the target can use its reaction to make an opportunity attack against the satyr.

action.name: Impulsive Rush
entries: The satyr takes the Dodge action and moves up to half its speed.

action.name: Share Libations (1/Day)
entries: Each charmed or willing creature within 5 feet of the satyr gains 10 temporary hit points that last for 1 minute. A swarm affected by this ability gains twice as many temporary hit points.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is charmed by the satyr, poisoned, and has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

bonus.name: Ecstatic Dance (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Each creature the satyr hit with an attack this turn must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes charmed by the satyr until the end of the satyr's next turn, or until it takes any damage.
While charmed in this way, a creature must use its action to Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.

bonus.name: Incite Abandon
entries: Each creature charmed by the satyr must use its reaction to make a melee attack against a random creature within its reach.

trait.name: Packed Swarm
entries: The throng can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the throng can move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature.
When the throng moves, each Medium or smaller creature in its space moves with it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The throng has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Riotous Rampage
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the throng's space. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage if the throng has fewer than half its hit points.

action.name: Hurl Firebrands
entries: One creature within 30 feet of the throng must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) fire damage and begins burning (1d10), or half as much damage on a success.
A Medium or smaller target has advantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Revel's Allure
entries: When a creature attempts to exit the throng's space, the throng can force it to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target can't willingly leave the throng's space this turn.

trait.name: Enthralling Performance
entries: If the satyr performs for at least 1 minute, it chooses up to four humanoids within 60 feet of it who watched or listened to the entire performance. Each target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed. While charmed in this way, the target idolizes the satyr and will take part in the satyr's revels. The charmed condition ends for the creature after 1 hour, if it takes any damage, if the satyr attacks the target, or if the target witnesses the satyr attacking or damaging any of the target's allies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sleepless Reveler
entries: Magic can't put the satyr to sleep.

trait.name: Feinting Frolick
entries: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The satyr makes two ram attacks or two shortbow attacks.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Impulsive Rush
entries: The satyr takes the Dodge action and moves up to half its speed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sleepless Reveler
entries: Magic can't put the satyr to sleep.

trait.name: Feinting Frolick
entries: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The satyr makes three ram attacks or three shortbow attacks.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Hail of Arrows (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The satyr fires an arrow that magically transforms into a flurry of missiles in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Impulsive Rush
entries: The satyr takes the Dodge action and moves up to half its speed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Feinting Frolick
entries: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Name Thief
entries: The satyr may make a single attack or move up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity at the beginning of the turn of any creature whose name it possesses.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The satyr makes three attacks, one of which may be with its ram.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Impulsive Rush
entries: The satyr takes the Dodge action and moves up to half its speed.

trait.name: Archfey Resistance
entries: Hyrsam succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Feinting Frolick
entries: Whenever Hyrsam is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, he gains advantage on the first attack he makes before the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Strains of Creation
entries: While Hyrsam isn't deafened, he can end one condition or spell affecting him at the start of each of his turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hyrsam makes two attacks, each of which he can replace with his Note of Discord, Benumb, or Call to Revel.

action.name: Fennelstem Fiddlestick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) force damage plus one of the following effects:

items: The target must move up to half its speed in a direction of Hyrsam's choice.
The target takes an additional 20 psychic damage. then can choose to gain an equal number of temporary hit points.

action.name: Note of Discord (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Hyrsam can see within 120 feet of him must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.
If Hyrsam is concentrating on a spell, he can end his concentration as part of casting this spell to impose disadvantage on the target's saving throw.

action.name: Benumb (6th Level Spell)
entries: Hyrsam touches a willing creature within 5 feet of him, banishing its cares. For the next hour, the target ignores the effects of being frightened, poisoned, or paralyzed, and has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

action.name: Call to Revel (7th Level Spell)
entries: While a wild whoop, Hyrsam calls down a cascade of ambrosia, granting each willing creature within 60 feet of him 20 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it has advantage on attack rolls.
When a creature loses the last of these temporary hit points, it must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes poisoned until it finishes a long rest.

action.name: Life From the Vine (8th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Fruiting vines sprout up in a 30-foot radius within 300 feet of Hyrsam, making the area difficult terrain for 1 minute.
Creatures in the area can use their action or bonus action to pluck fruit and restore 10 (3d6) hit points to themselves or a creature within 5 feet of them.
A creature targeted with this ability that died in the last minute is restored to life with 1 hit point.

action.name: Unname (9th Level Spell)
entries: Hyrsam attempts to draw forth the true name from a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 69 (6d12 + 30) psychic damage and its true name is obliterated, each record and memory of it is forever destroyed. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it ceases to exist and cannot be restored to life by any means.
For 1 year, or until it is given a new true name, a nameless creature has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

bonus.name: Song of Mischief (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of Hyrsam rolls a d10 whenever they would roll a d20.

bonus.name: Song of Mirth (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of Hyrsam that has any temporary hit points can use its bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action.

bonus.name: Song of Mayhem (7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of Hyrsam that has any temporary hit points is charmed by Hyrsam and treats all other creatures as hostile.

legendary.name: Impulsive Rush
entries: Hyrsam takes the Dodge action and moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Prancing Strike
entries: Hyrsam moves up to half his speed, then makes a melee attack. If this attack was made at advantage, the target is knocked prone on a hit.

legendary.name: Incite Abandon
entries: Each creature charmed by Hyrsam must use its reaction to make a melee attack against a random creature within its reach.

name: Rockslide Elemental
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the rockslide elemental moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the elemental used Nimble Separation before making this Slam attack, the target has disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The rockslide elemental doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The rockslide elemental has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rockslide elemental makes three Slam attacks, or it makes two Skipping Stone attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Skipping Stone
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the stone bounces to another creature within 10 feet of the target. That creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Nimble Separation
entries: The rockslide elemental can briefly separate its components parts and take the Dash action. opportunity attacks against it have disadvantage until the start of its next turn.

name: Royal Chimera
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the royal chimera fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regal Bearing
entries: The chimera's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes one Bite attack, one Claws attack, and one Eldritch Horns attack, or it makes two Arcane Blast attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Eldritch Horns
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) force damage.

action.name: Serpent Strike
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Arcane Blast
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) force damage.

action.name: Searing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dragon head exhales a 30-foot cone of fire that burns and blinds. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) fire damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The chimera's goat head casts one of the following spells, requiring only verbal components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

legendary.name: Prideful Prowl
entries: The chimera moves up to its walking speed, or flies up to half its flying speed, without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Serpent Strike
entries: The chimera makes one Serpent Strike attack.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The chimera uses Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Roar of the King (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lion head lets out a bellow that spurs on its allies. Each friendly creature, including the chimera, within 30 feet of the chimera that can hear the roar gains 11 (2d10) temporary hp and can't be frightened for 1 minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one bite attack and one tail swipe attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save or contract Rust Drake Tetanus.

action.name: Tail Swipe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Vomits Scrap (Recharge 5-6)
entries: A rust drake can vomit forth a 15-foot cone of rusted metal. Targets in the affected area take 55 (10d10) slashing damage, or half damage with a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. In addition, affected creatures must also make a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw or contract Rust Drake Tetanus.

action.name: Rust Drake Lockjaw
entries: This disease manifests symptoms in 1d4 days, when the affected creature experiences painful muscle spasms, particularly in the jaw. After each long rest, the creature must repeat the saving throw. If it fails, the victim takes 1d3 Dexterity damage and is paralyzed for 24 hours; if the saving throw succeeds, the creature takes no damage and feels well enough to act normally for the day. This continues until the creature dies from Dexterity loss, recovers naturally by making successful saving throws after two consecutive long rests, or is cured with lesser restoration or comparable magic. After the disease ends, the victim recovers 1d3 lost Dexterity with each long rest; greater restoration or comparable magic can restore it all at once.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The sacred hippopotamus knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Divine Jaws
entries: The sacred hippopotamus's weapon attacks are magical. When the hippopotamus hits with a Gore attack, the Gore deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage or radiant damage (included in the attack), the hippopotamus's choice.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The sacred hippopotamus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sacred hippopotamus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sacred Guardian
entries: The sacred hippopotamus can pinpoint the location of an agent or worshiper of an opposing deity or a creature with ill intent toward the hippopotamus's sacred site within 120 feet of itself. In addition, the hippopotamus can sense when such a creature moves within 100 feet of the site and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of the site.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage or radiant damage (the hippopotamus's choice).

action.name: Divine Cacophony (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The sacred hippopotamus opens its jaws and releases a cacophony of otherworldly screams, songs, and roars from the Upper or Lower Planes in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage or radiant damage (the sacred hippopotamus's choice) and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't stunned.

action.name: Healing Rumble (2/Day)
entries: The sacred hippopotamus touches another creature with its snout as it hums a tone that reverberates through its jaw. The target magically regains 10 (3d6) hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

bonus.name: Protector's Step
entries: The sacred hippopotamus magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space within its sacred site or within 30 feet of the exterior of its sacred site. Swirls of golden light or tendrils of inky shadow (the hippopotamus's choice) appear at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

name: Salt Golem
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Blinding Salt Spray
entries: Any time the golem is hit in combat, thousands of tiny salt crystals erupt from its body. All creatures within 5 feet of the golem must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded for 1d3 rounds.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

name: Samurai Crab
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The samurai crab can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The samurai crab makes three melee attacks. If the crab is grappling two creatures, it can't make Crustaceous Sword attacks.

action.name: Crustaceous Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15), and the crab can't use this claw to attack another target. The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

bonus.name: Fighting Stance
entries: The samurai crab adopts a fighting stance, choosing from the options below. The stance lasts until the crab ends it (no action required) or uses this bonus action again.

items.name: Banded Claw.
items.entry: The samurai crab adopts a wide, grappler's stance. While the samurai crab is in this stance, each creature that starts its turn grappled by the crab takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Hard Shell.
items.entry: The samurai crab adopts a defensive stance, increasing its AC by 2.

items.name: Soft Shell.
items.entry: The samurai crab adopts an offensive stance, gaining advantage on the first Crustaceous Sword attack it makes each turn.

trait.name: Sand Camouflage
entries: The sand dragon has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

trait.name: Sandy Nature
entries: The sand dragon is infused with elemental power, and it requires only half the amount of air, food, and drink that a typical dragon if its size needs.

trait.name: Stinging Sand
entries: The first time the sand dragon hits a target with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The sand dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:

items.name: Sand Blast.
items.entry: The dragon exhales superheated sand in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) piercing damage and 11 (2d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Blinding Sand.
items.entry: The dragon breathes fine sand in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can take an action to clear its eyes of sand, ending the effect for it.

trait.name: Desert Camouflage
entries: The drake has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

trait.name: Sand Glide
entries: The drake can burrow through nonmagical sand and worked earth. While doing so, the drake doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or its speed is halved for 1 minute. If the target's speed is already halved and it fails the saving throw, it is paralyzed for 1 minute instead. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Heatwave Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The drake exhales superheated air in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it suffers one level of exhaustion.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The sasquatch has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The sasquatch has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the sasquatch takes 25 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hp, it is reduced to 1 hp instead.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the sasquatch can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sasquatch makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its fists.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Fist
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Vanishing Tantrum (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The sasquatch roars and stomps, kicking up debris and leaving deep footprints in the ground. Each creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The sasquatch can then move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and take the Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
