trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire aalpamac takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aalpamac can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Distance Distortion Aura
entries: The presence of an aalpamac distorts the vision of creatures within 60 feet of it. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to correctly judge the distance between itself and its surroundings until the start of its next turn. An affected creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and it can't move more than half its speed on its turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the aalpamac's Distance Distortion Aura for the next 24 hours. Creatures with blindsight, tremorsense, or truesight are unaffected by this trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aalpamac makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire alke takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Back Spikes
entries: Any Small or larger creature riding the alke against its will must make DC 16 Dexterity saving throw at the start of its turn, taking 35 (6d10 + 5) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The alke has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the alke moves at least 30 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claws attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the alke can make one Beak attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alke makes one Beak attack and two Claws attacks.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Piercing Roll (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The alke tucks in its head and throws itself spikes first into nearby foes. The alke moves up to 25 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (6d10 + 5) bludgeoning and 35 (6d10 + 5) piercing damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

reaction.name: Repelling Spikes
entries: The alke adds 3 to its AC against one melee or ranged weapon attack that would hit it. To do so, the alke must see the attacker and not be prone.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire alpha fish takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Defensive Frenzy
entries: When it has half its hit points or fewer, the alpha fish can make one headbutt attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Frightening Display
entries: When the alpha fish uses its Fin Flare, it looks one size category larger that it actually is to any creature that can see it until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Too Aggressive
entries: The alpha fish attacks anything it thinks is threatening, even inanimate objects or illusions. It automatically fails ability checks and saving throws to detect or see through illusions.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The fish can breathe only under water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alpha fish uses its Fin Flare. It then makes two headbutt attacks.

action.name: Headbutt
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fin Flare
entries: The alpha fish flares its fins in an attempt to frighten its opponents. Each creature within 30 feet that can see the fish must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the alpha fish's Fin Flare for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire balloon spider takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Erratic Discharge
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the balloon spider must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 15 (3d8 + 3) lightning damage and can move or take an action on its turn, but not both. On a success, the creature gains the benefits of the haste spell until the end of its turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, it is immune to the spider's Erratic Discharge for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 19 (4d8 + 3) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or it can move or take an action on its turn, but not both.

action.name: Charged Web (Recharge 4-6)
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, range 40/80 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 13) by strands of charged webbing and begins to hover off the ground. Until this grapple ends, the target takes 1 lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. In addition, the grappled target can make a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to manipulate the strands of webbing and fly 10 feet in any direction.

action.name: Draw In
entries: The balloon spider magically pulls all creatures grappled by its webbing up to 10 feet toward it. If this movement pulls the creature within 5 feet of the balloon spider, the spider can make one bite attack against the creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire biting gnat swarm takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The biting gnat swarm can pinpoint, by scent, the location of warm-blooded creatures within 20 feet of it.

trait.name: Distracting Buzz
entries: A creature that is not deafened and starts its turn in a space occupied by a swarm of biting gnats must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become distracted by the droning of the gnats' wings. A distracted creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks that use Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the swarm's Distracting Buzz for the next 10 minutes.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The biting gnat swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny beast. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 19 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, or 15 (3d8 + 3) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hp or fewer. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become blinded for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Alternatively, the target can take an action to clear its eyes of the insects, ending the effect.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire bonespitter takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Bony Body
entries: A creature that starts its turn or enters the space within 5 feet of the bonespitter must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 44 (5d14 + 9) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonespitter makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its bone spike.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the bonespitter. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the bonespitter, and it takes 44 (7d10 + 9) acid damage at the start of each of the bonespitter's turns. An undead creature made of mostly bones, such as a skeleton, is immune to this acid damage.

If the bonespitter takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the bonespitter must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the bonespitter. If the bonespitter dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Bone Spike
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +14 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is knocked prone, pinned to the ground by the spike, and restrained. As an action, the restrained creature or a creature within 5 feet of it can make a DC 22 Strength check, removing the spike and ending the condition on a success. The spike can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 15; vulnerability to bludgeoning damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage).

action.name: Shard Spray (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The bonespitter exhales a 60-foot cone of bone shards. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 69 (12d10 + 9) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If a Large or smaller creature fails this saving throw, it is also knocked prone, pinned to the ground by a shard, and restrained. As an action, the restrained creature or a creature within 5 feet of it can make a DC 22 Strength check, removing the shard and ending the condition on a success. The shard can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 15; vulnerability to bludgeoning damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage).

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire blood barnacle takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Barnacle Shivers
entries: Characterized by the inescapable cold-and subsequent shivering-that slowly pervades the victim's body, barnacle shivers is a disease that infects creatures attacked by blood barnacles. Until the disease is cured, the infected creature can't regain hp except by magical means, and its hp maximum decreases by 17 (3d10 + 2) for every 24 hours that elapse. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hp maximum to 0. A Humanoid or Beast slain by this disease rises 24 hours later as a zombie. The zombie isn't under the blood barnacle's control, but it views the blood barnacle as an ally.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The blood barnacle can pinpoint, by scent, the location of creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead and that don't have all of their hp within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the blood barnacle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal barnacle.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the blood barnacle attaches to the target. While attached, the blood barnacle doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the blood barnacle's turns, the target loses 10 (2d8 + 2) hp due to blood loss.

The blood barnacle can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the blood barnacle by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength check. When the blood barnacle is removed, the target takes 14 (3d8 + 2) piercing damage.

If a creature ends its turn with a blood barnacle attached to it, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract the barnacle shivers disease (see the Barnacle Shivers trait).

reaction.name: Host Defense
entries: When a creature damages an attached blood barnacle with anything other than fire, the creature hosting the barnacle must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to protect the barnacle. The barnacle takes half the damage dealt to it, and the host takes the other half.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire caldera kite takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Firesight
entries: The caldera kite can see through areas obscured by fire, smoke, and fog without penalty.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The caldera kite doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Sulfuric Haze
entries: A glittering haze emanates from the caldera kite within 10 feet of it. The haze moves with the caldera kite, lightly obscuring the area. If dispersed by a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour), the haze reappears at the start of the caldera kite's next turn. When a creature enters the haze's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 25 (4d10 + 5) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. If a creature's saving throw is successful, it is immune to the Sulphuric Haze of all caldera kites for 1 minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The caldera kite makes two Wings attacks or one Wings attack and one Proboscis attack.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the caldera kite doesn't have another creature grappled. Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, the caldera kite can automatically hit the target with its Proboscis, and the caldera kite can't make Proboscis attacks against other targets.

action.name: Wings
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage and 25 (4d10 + 5) poison damage.

action.name: Dust Cloud (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The caldera kite thrashes its body and releases stored toxic gases. Each creature within 20 feet of the caldera kite must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10 + 5) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw can't speak and is suffocating until it is no longer within 20 feet of the caldera kite.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire capybear takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The capybear can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The capybear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The capybear has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the capybear's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the capybear moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the capybear can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The capybear has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swamps or muddy terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Protect the Community
entries: When another capybear within 5 feet of this capybear is hit by an attack, this capybear can leap in the way, becoming the new target of the attack.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire caretaker weevil takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Calming Presence
entries: A creature that enters a space within 5 feet of the caretaker weevil or that starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma saving throw or be indifferent to all creatures that it is hostile toward while it remains within 60 feet of the weevil. This indifference ends if the creature is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its allies being harmed.

trait.name: Diligent Preservation
entries: A creature that isn't a Construct or Undead and that starts its turn with 0 hp within 60 feet of the caretaker weevil becomes stable. In addition, any corpse within 60 feet of the weevil is protected from decay and can't become Undead while it remains within 60 feet of the weevil and for 24 hours after it leaves the area.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Glue Glob
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d10 + 1) acid damage. The target must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained for 1 minute. On a success, its speed is halved for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Regenerative Spittle (3/Day)
entries: The caretaker weevil launches spittle at one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target regains 13 (3d8 + 1) hp. For 1 minute, the target regains 1 hp at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire carrier mosquito takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the carrier mosquito moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an impaling proboscis attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 25 (3d14 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Disruptive Droning
entries: While a carrier mosquito is in flight, it produces a constant, loud droning, forcing those nearby to shout in order to be heard. A spellcaster within 30 feet of the mosquito must succeed on a DC 15 spellcasting ability check to cast a spell with a verbal component. In addition, a creature that is concentrating on a spell and that starts its turn within 30 feet of the mosquito must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration on the spell.

action.name: Impaling Proboscis
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 22 (3d12 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, the mosquito can automatically hit the target with its impaling proboscis, and the mosquito can't make impaling proboscis attacks against other targets.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The beetle makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d14 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Spit (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The carrion beetle spits a line of acid that is 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in that line takes 61 (7d16 + 5) acid damage, or half damage with a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire carrion beetle takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire cave goat takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The cave goat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Sturdy Climber
entries: The cave goat has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb rocky surfaces.

action.name: Ram
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire clacker beetle takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Compact
entries: A clacker beetle can occupy the same space as one other clacker beetle.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (3d10 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Clack
entries: The beetle clacks its mandibles to create a small but dangerous booming noise in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8 + 2) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When multiple beetles clack in the same turn and create overlapping cones, each creature in overlapping cones must make one saving throw with disadvantage against the total damage from all overlapping cones rather than one saving throw for each cone.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire conniption bug takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Death Trap
entries: When the conniption bug dies, its mandibles remain locked in place, continuing to grapple beyond its death. Until the grapple ends, the creature takes 20 (3d12 + 2) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns as if the bug was still alive. Any creature can take an action to remove the mandibles with a successful DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Wisdom (Medicine) check.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The conniption bug can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The conniption bug has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the bug's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The conniption bug's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Vicious Wound
entries: The conniption bug's melee attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

action.name: Barbed Mandibles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the conniption bug doesn't have another creature grappled. Until this grapple ends, the target takes 20 (3d12 + 2) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the conniption bug can't make Barbed Mandible attacks against other targets.

action.name: Barbed Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire death butterfly swarm takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Potent Poison
entries: The death butterfly swarm's poison affects corporeal undead who are otherwise immune to poison.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit point.

trait.name: Weight of Wings
entries: A creature in a space occupied by the death butterfly swarm has its speed reduced by half, and must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded. Both effects end when the creature doesn't share a space with the swarm at the end of the creature's turn. If a creature succeeds on the saving throw, it is immune to the swarm's blindness (but not the speed reduction) for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes a Bite attack against every target in its spaces.

action.name: Bites
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., every target in the swarm's space. Hit: 29 (7d8 + 1) piercing damage, or 17 (4d8 + 1) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target also takes 26 (5d10 + 1) poison damage and becomes poisoned for 1d4 rounds; a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw reduces poison damage by half and prevents the poisoned condition.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire pangolin takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Edged Scales
entries: A creature that touches the pangolin or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 23 (3d12 + 5) slashing damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The pangolin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pangolin makes two Claws attacks and one Tail Slap attack.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tuck In
entries: The pangolin curls its entire body, forming an armored ball. While an armored ball, it moves by rolling, has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, is immune to the prone condition, and it can't make Claw or Tail Slap attacks or climb. The pangolin can uncurl its body as a bonus action.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire lionfish takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the lionfish moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Headbutt attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 28 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

trait.name: Coral Camouflage
entries: The lionfish has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in underwater terrain that includes plant life or coral reefs.

trait.name: Envenomed Spines
entries: A creature that touches the lionfish or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 24 (4d10 + 4) poison damage.

trait.name: Poison Affinity
entries: The lionfish has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The lionfish can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lionfish makes one Bite attack and one Headbutt attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d12 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Headbutt
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 24 (4d10 + 4) poison damage.

action.name: Forceful Spit (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The lionfish launches a stream of pressurized water from its mouth in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 44 (8d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 20 feet away from the lionfish and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the lionfish and isn't knocked prone.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire duffel crab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Extradimensional Bag
entries: The duffel crab uses an extra-dimensional space, such as a bag of holding, as its "shell." The bag can hold creatures in addition to the crab, based on the size of the extradimensional space. Breathing creatures inside the bag can survive up to a number of minutes equal to 10 divided by the number of creatures (minimum 1 minute), after which time they begin to suffocate. If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is destroyed. While this would normally cause the contents to be lost in the Astral Plane, the crab's half-in, half-out existence kept the bag constantly open, even when it fully withdrew, altering the bag, which simply spills out its contents into the area when the bag is destroyed or the crab dies. The bag becomes a standard bag of holding or similar magic item with extradimensional space 24 hours after the crab dies.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless and withdrawn into its extradimensional bag, the duffel crab is indistinguishable from its extradimensional bag with an ajar lid or opening.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duffel crab makes two Claw attacks, or it makes one Claw attack and uses Collect.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crab can't attack another target with that claw. The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Collect
entries: The crab places one target it is grappling into its extradimensional space, provided there is room, and the grapple ends. The target is blinded and restrained, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the extradimensional space. A trapped creature can take its action to climb out of the bag by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check (the creature's choice). If the crab dies, a trapped creature is no longer restrained by the crab and can escape from the bag using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire frost mole takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The frost mole has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Snow Burrower
entries: The frost mole can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud.

trait.name: Snow Camouflage
entries: The frost mole has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

trait.name: Snow Pit
entries: If the frost mole moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature, it can dig a 5-foot-diameter, 20-foot-deep pit beneath the creature. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the pit and land prone, taking falling damage as normal. If the target is Large or larger, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained. If the target is prone or restrained, the mole can make one claw attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Tuck In
entries: The giant armadillo tucks its entire body into its shell, forming an armored ball. While in this form, it moves by rolling around, it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and it can't take the Attack action or burrow. The giant armadillo can return to its true form as a bonus action.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire giant armadillo takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire giant flea takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The giant flea can pinpoint, by scent, the location of creatures that have blood within 60 feet of it.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The giant flea has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The giant flea's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the flea attaches to the target. While attached, the flea doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the flea's turns, the target loses 8 (2d6 + 2) hp due to blood loss. The flea can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. It does so after draining 12 hp of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the flea by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength check.

bonus.name: Leaping Escape
entries: The giant flea leaps up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire giant mantis shrimp takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Fluorescing Challenge
entries: The giant mantis shrimp has advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks while agitated, as its natural fluorescence flashes in a disorienting array.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant mantis shrimp makes two Sonic Claw attacks.

action.name: Sonic Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the giant mantis shrimp doesn't have another creature grappled. Whether or not the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 26 (3d14 + 5) thunder damage and be deafened and stunned until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Water Jet
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the shrimp must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn. The shrimp then swims up to half its swimming speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire giant pufferfish takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Spiny Body
entries: A creature that touches the giant pufferfish or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 16 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage. While the pufferfish is puffed up, this damage increases to 20 (4d8 + 4).

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The giant pufferfish can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage, or 19 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage while puffed up.

action.name: Spine
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage while puffed up. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 20 (4d8 + 4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it takes 16 (3d8 + 4) poison damage at the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Burst of Speed (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The giant pufferfish takes the Dash action.

bonus.name: Puff Up (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the giant pufferfish increases in size by filling its stomach with air or water. While puffed up, the pufferfish is Medium, doubles its damage dice on Bite and Spine attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the pufferfish lacks the room to become Medium, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire giant snow beetle takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Snowball Concealment
entries: The giant snow beetle has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide if it is within 10 feet of a Large or larger snowball. It can attempt to hide even if another creature can see it clearly.

trait.name: Snowball Roll
entries: The giant snow beetle can spend 1 minute to roll up a ball of snow equal to its size.

action.name: Pincer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rotten Snowball Shove (Recharge 6)
entries: The giant snow beetle tosses one of its carrion-filled snowballs at a point it can see within 20 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 24 (4d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and becomes poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poisoned condition on itself on a success.

action.name: Snowball Shove
entries: The giant snow beetle tosses one of its rolled snowballs at a point it can see within 20 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 24 (4d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a target takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire gigantura takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Telescoping Eyes
entries: The gigantura has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and magical darkness doesn't impede the gigantura's darkvision. In addition, it has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws against being blinded.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The gigantura can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gigantura uses Horrific Gaze. It then makes one Bite attack and two Tail Slap attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (4d14 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the gigantura. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the gigantura, and it takes 47 (8d10 + 7) acid damage at the start of each of the gigantura's turns. The gigantura can have up to two Huge, four Large, six Medium, or eight Small creatures swallowed at one time.

If the gigantura takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the gigantura must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the gigantura. If the gigantura dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Horrific Gaze
entries: The gigantura's telescoping eyes swirl disconcertingly in the direction of one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the gigantura, the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. A target that successfully saves is immune to this gigantura's Horrific Gaze for the next 24 hours.

name: Dire Glacier Behemoth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire glacier behemoth takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Ground Disruptor
entries: When the glacier behemoth moves, it can choose to make the area it moves through difficult terrain. When it uses Inexorable Charge, it automatically makes the ground difficult terrain.

trait.name: Unstoppable
entries: Difficult terrain composed of ice, rocks, sand, or natural vegetation, living or dead, doesn't cost the glacier behemoth extra movement. Its speed can't be reduced by any effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The glacier behemoth makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 43 (5d14 + 8) piercing damage.

action.name: Inexorable Charge
entries: If the glacier behemoth moves at least 10 feet, it can then use this action to continue moving in a 40-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in this line must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 68 (12d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone. The glacier behemoth's movement along this line doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire karkadann takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Impaling Charge
entries: If the karkadann moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Horn attack on the same turn, the karkadann impales the target on its horn, grappling the target if it is a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 19). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, takes 43 (6d12 + 7) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the karkadann can't make horn attacks against other targets.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The karkadann has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The karkadann makes two Hooves attacks or one Horn attack and one Hooves attack.

action.name: Hooves
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Horn
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 7) piercing damage.

action.name: Toss
entries: One Large or smaller creature impaled by the karkadann is thrown up to 30 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 22 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The karkadann touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 32 (5d10 + 7) hp and is cured of all diseases and poisons afflicting it.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire keelbreaker crab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The crab can breathe air and water

trait.name: Living Figureheads
entries: Three magical figureheads adorn the crab's back. While at least one figurehead remains intact, the crab has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and can use its Wail.

Each figurehead is an object with AC 15, 20 hp, resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If all the figureheads are reduced to 0 hp, the keelbreaker crab can't use its Wail action. Damaging a figurehead does not harm the crab.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The crab deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crab can use its Wail. It then makes two pincer attacks

action.name: Pincer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Wail
entries: As long as at least one if its living figureheads remains intact, the keelbreaker crab can cause the figurehead to wail. Roll a d6 and consult the following table to determine the wail.

rows.name: Frightening Wail
entries: Each creature within 60 feet who can hear the crab must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the keelbreaker crab's Frightening Wail for the next 24 hours.

rows.name: Maddening Wail
entries: Each creature within 60 feet who can hear the crab must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

rows.name: Stunning Wail
entries: Each creature within 60 feet who can hear the crab must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't stunned.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire razorback crab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Bladed Shell
entries: A creature that touches the crab or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 19 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the crab moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Shell Bash attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the crab can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crab makes one Claw attack and one Shell Bash attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Shell Bash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 19 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Dire Samurai Crab
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire samurai crab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The samurai crab can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The samurai crab makes three melee attacks. If the crab is grappling two creatures, it can't make Crustaceous Sword attacks.

action.name: Crustaceous Sword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16), and the crab can't use this claw to attack another target. The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

bonus.name: Fighting Stance
entries: The samurai crab adopts a fighting stance, choosing from the options below. The stance lasts until the crab ends it (no action required) or uses this bonus action again.

items.name: Banded Claw.
items.entry: The samurai crab adopts a wide, grappler's stance. While the samurai crab is in this stance, each creature that starts its turn grappled by the crab takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Hard Shell.
items.entry: The samurai crab adopts a defensive stance, increasing its AC by 2.

items.name: Soft Shell.
items.entry: The samurai crab adopts an offensive stance, gaining advantage on the first Crustaceous Sword attack it makes each turn.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire sporous crab takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The sporous crab can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Filthy
entries: The sporous crab makes its home in grime and muck and is covered in filth. A creature that touches the sporous crab or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. If a creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it also contracts sewer plague. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the crab's Filthy trait for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sporous crab makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spore (Recharge 6)
entries: The sporous crab sprays spores in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 23 (4d10 + 3) poison damage and becomes infected with the crab's spores. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't infected with spores. After 1 hour, small bubbles and bumps appear across the skin of the infected creature. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the infected creature's body fights off the spores and no longer has to make the saving throw. If a creature fails the saving throw every day for 7 days, young sporous crabs hatch from the creature's skin, and the creature takes 27 (4d12 + 3) slashing damage. The spores can also be removed with a lesser restoration spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the swarm of dire clacker beetles takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Constant Clacking
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space takes 22 (3d14 + 1) thunder damage.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 31 (6d10 + 1) piercing damage, or 21 (4d10 + 1) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the swarm of dire compsognathus takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Grasslands Camouflage
entries: The compsognatus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in tall grass.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 32 (6d10 + 2) piercing damage, or 22 (4d10 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the swarm of dire fleas takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The giant flea can pinpoint, by scent, the location of creatures that have blood within 60 feet of it.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Ravenous
entries: When a creature that doesn't have all of its hp starts its turn in the swarm's space, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or lose 18 (4d8 + 2) hp from blood loss.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The swarm's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny flea. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 32 (6d10 + 2) piercing damage, or 22 (4d10 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire swarm of penguins takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Medium penguin. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

trait.name: Tobogganing Tide
entries: The swarm can move at double its walking speed over ice and snow.

action.name: Beaks
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 43 (8d10 + 3) piercing damage, or 28 (5d10 + 3) if the swarm has half its hp or fewer.

action.name: Toboggan Charge (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The swarm moves up to 20 feet in a straight line over ice or snow and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 (5d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 28 (5d10 + 3) piercing damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

trait.name: Dire Rage
entries: When the dire tidehunter takes the Attack action, it can make an additional attack with a natural weapon.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The tidehunter can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Net Maker
entries: With 1 minute of work, the tidehunter can create a net out of seaweed, rope, or similar material. The tidehunter typically carries 2 net.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage.
entries: The tidehunter has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tidehunter makes three attacks, only one of which can be with its net. It can use Reel in place of two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). The tidehunter has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Net
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: A Large or smaller creature hit by the net is restrained until it is freed. The net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 16 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 17 (1d4 + 5) to the net (AC 13) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net.

action.name: Reel
entries: The tidehunter pulls one creature restrained by its net up to 20 feet straight toward it. If the target is within 10 feet of the tidehunter at the end of this pull, the tidehunter can make one claw attack against it as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Entangle Weapon
entries: When the tidehunter is targeted by a melee weapon attack, the attacker must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or miss the attack as the tidehunter uses its net to interfere with the weapon. The tidehunter must have an empty net to use this reaction.

name: Atropus, the World Born Dead
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Atropus' innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Anathematic Secrecy
entries: Atropus can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

trait.name: Divine Scourge (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, each creature within 100 miles of Atropus that is a celestial or a user of divine magic must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. A target takes 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target also suffers one level of exhaustion.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Atropus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Life Eater
entries: When a creature within 120 feet of Atropus is reduced to 0 hit points, it dies, and the creature can't be revived by any means. The creature is then raised as an angel of decay under Atropus' control. Constructs and undead are not affected by this feature.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless it wishes to be affected, Atropus is immune to spells of 4th level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Atropus' weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Negative Energy Aura
entries: Any non-undead creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Atropus takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. Furthermore, non-undead creatures can't regain hit points and do not benefit from resistance to necrotic damage while within 30 feet of Atropus. A non-undead creature that were to magically regain hit points must instead make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes necrotic damage equal to the hit points it would have regained.

trait.name: Overlord of Death
entries: While within 120 feet of Atropus, any undead ally of Atropus makes saving throws with advantage, and that ally regains 2d6 hit points whenever it starts its turn there. Additionally, Atropus and each undead within 120 feet of it are immune to effects that turn undead.

trait.name: Unyielding Essence
entries: Atropus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, as well as those that would read its thoughts, determine if it is lying, or magically influence its thoughts or behavior.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Atropus makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit:25 (3d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and Atropus gains temporary hit points equal to half that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

legendary.name: Charge
entries: Atropus moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Life Drain
entries: Atropus targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Atropus regains a number of hit points equal to half the amount of damage dealt.

legendary.name: Slam
entries: Atropus makes a slam attack.

legendary.name: Waves of Exhaustion (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Atropus emits waves of negative energy in a 90-foot cone. Each non-undead creature in that area must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 35 (10d6) necrotic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage, and suffers no increase in exhaustion level.

name: Kyuss, the Worm that Walks
immune: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Kyuss's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Kyuss is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). Kyuss knows the following spells:

trait.name: Anathematic Secrecy
entries: Kyuss can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

trait.name: Create Spawn
entries: A Medium or smaller creature that is slain by Kyuss is raised as a {@creature spawn of Kyuss|vgm} under his control after 1d4 rounds. Constructs are not affected by this feature. Additionally, when Kyuss casts a spell that raises undead, he can choose for any number of the undead to be spawn of Kyuss.

trait.name: Divine Scourge (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, each creature within 100 miles of Kyuss that is a celestial or a user of divine magic (a cleric, paladin, druid, ranger, or some other class the DM deems appropriate) must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. A target takes 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target also suffers one level of exhaustion.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Kyuss fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Kyuss has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Kyuss's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Quicken Spell (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As a bonus action, Kyuss can cast a spell using a spell slot of 6th level or lower. Kyuss cannot cast two spells of 1st level or higher on the same turn.

trait.name: Return to Worms
entries: When Kyuss is reduced to 0 hit points, he breaks apart into 16 swarms of insects in the same space. Unless the swarms are destroyed, Kyuss reforms from them 24 hours later.

trait.name: Unyielding Essence
entries: Kyuss is immune to any spell or effect that would alter his form, as well as those that would read his thoughts, determine if he is lying, or magically influence his thoughts or behavior.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kyuss can use his Frightful Presence. He then makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit:26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Kyuss's choice that is within 120 feet of Kyuss and aware of him must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Kyuss's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Plague of Worms (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of Kyuss's choice within 20 feet of him must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and is blinded and restrained by masses of swarming worms. An affected creature takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of Kyuss's turns. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Worm Smite (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Kyuss makes a slam attack against a creature within 15 feet of him. If the attack hits, it deals 32 (5d12) extra necrotic damage in addition to its normal damage. This extra damage increases to 45 (7d12) if the target is a celestial or a user of divine magic (a cleric, paladin, druid, ranger, or some other class the DM deems appropriate). If this attack hits a target affected by Kyuss's Plague of Worms, the target must also succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Kyuss moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Kyuss casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Bless Spawn (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Kyuss targets one spawn of Kyuss within 60 feet of him. The target magically transforms into a {@creature blessed spawn of Kyuss|EdE}. The target's hit points are raised to meet its new hit point maximum, even if it had taken damage before its transformation.

legendary.name: Summon Spawn (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: A {@creature spawn of Kyuss|vgm} emerges from a point on the ground within 30 feet of Kyuss. The spawn acts on its own initiative count and follow Kyuss's orders to the best of its ability.

name: Blessed Spawn of Kyuss
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The spawn's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The spawn of Kyuss regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If the spawn takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the spawn's next turn. The spawn of Kyuss is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Worms
entries: If the spawn of Kyuss is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, all the worms infesting it wither away, and it loses its Burrowing Worm and Plague of Worms actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn of Kyuss makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it must must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Burrowing Worm
entries: A worm launches from the spawn of Kyuss at one humanoid that the spawn can see within 10 feet of it. The worm latches onto the target's skin unless the target succeeds on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. The worm is a Tiny undead with AC 6, 1 hit point, a 2 (-4) in every ability score, and a speed of 1 foot. While on the target's skin, the worm can be killed by normal means or scraped off using an action (the spawn can use this action to launch a scraped-off worm at a humanoid it can see within 10 feet of the worm). Otherwise, the worm burrows under the target's skin at the end of the target's next turn, dealing 1 piercing damage to it. At the end of each of its turns thereafter, the target takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage per worm infesting it (maximum of 10d6). A worm-infested target dies if it drops to 0 hit points, then rises 10 minutes later as a spawn of Kyuss. If a worm-infested creature is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, all the worms infesting it wither away.

action.name: Plague of Worms (Recharge 6)
entries: Each creature of the spawn's choice within 10 feet of the spawn of Kyuss must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and is restrained by masses of swarming worms. An affected creature takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the spawn of Kyuss's turns. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility

entries: A dense mass of shimmering, translucent force slams down up a creature the evoker can see within 100 feet, forcing it to make a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice).
On a failure, the target takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 16).  On a success, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

action.name: Wreath of Blades (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Razor-sharp blades of hardened magic whirl through the air in a 10 foot radius centered on the evoker.

A creature that starts its turn in the area, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (4d10) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Force Barrage
entries: The evoker makes two attacks with its Force Barrage.

legendary.name: Woven Path
entries: The evoker moves up to half its speed, creating a path of force beneath it as it goes that lasts until the end of its next turn.
The evoker can treat surfaces such as air or water as solid ground with this movement.

trait.name: Spellshaper
entries: When the evoker casts a spell that affects an area, it can choose for any number of affected creatures to have advantage on saving throws they make against it, and to take no damage from the spell on a success.

trait.name: Coutershock (3/Day)
entries: When the evoker would be affected by a spell, it can make an Arcana check against the spellcaster's spell save DC.
On a success, the evoker is unaffected by the spell and the spellcaster takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage for each point the evoker succeeded by.

trait.name: Contigent Renewal (1/Day, Mythic Trait)
entries: When the evoker is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 127 hit points and regrows any missing body parts.
For the next minute, the evoker regains 15 hit points at the beginning of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Blast Touch (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Fire blooms from the evoker's palm, exploding in a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 5 feet.

The evoker and each other creature in the area is pushed 10 feet away, then must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is knocked prone, additionally.

action.name: Amplifire Outburst (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ranged Spell Attack. +10 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire plus 18 (4d8) lightning damage.
If this attack was made with advantage, each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Render to the Flame (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Flames rise to engulf up to six creatures within a 20 foot radius centered on a point the evoker can see within 60 feet, forcing each to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, a creature begins burning (2d10). While burning in this way, attacks against the creature have advantage.

action.name: Scatterspell Bombardment (Recharge 5-6, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The evoker launches a cascade of shimmering orbs in a 60 foot cone that detonate as they hit the ground, forcing each creature in the area to make three DC 18 Dexterity saving throws.
For each failed saving throw, a creature takes 10 (3d6) damage of one type of the evoker's choice; acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

reaction.name: Condense Burst (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: When two or more creatures the evoker can see within 60 feet make a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the evoker can cause the effect to affect only one of them and deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

legendary.name: Protective Measures
entries: The evoker gains 5 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the evoker has resistance to damage from its own spells.

legendary.name: Blast Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The evoker moves up to half its speed and uses its Blast Touch.

legendary.name: Glyph Mine (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: A bright glyph flares on the ground in an unoccupied 5 foot radius space the evoker can see within 60 feet.

The first time a creature enters that space in the next minute, the glyph explodes in a 10 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

mythic.name: Charge Spell
entries: Magical power condenses in the air around the evoker, cumulatively adding one additional damage die to each damage roll the evoker makes on its following turn.

trait.name: Eternity Burns

This attack ignores all cover from any nonmagical, nonliving material, disintegrating through it without resistance and leaving a 2 inch wide hole in its wake.

action.name: Lava Geyser (5th Level Spell)
entries: A torrent of lava spews up from the earth in a 60 foot high, 15 foot radius column, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 33 (6d10) fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
For the next minute, a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area or steps onto it for the first time on a turn must make the same saving throw.

action.name: Annihilation Shrine (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: The evoker raises a Large, monolithic shard of black crystal (AC 20; 100 HP) from the earth centered on a point it can see, amplifying nearby magic.
For the next hour, evocation spells cast within 30 feet of the shard have their range multiplied by 10 and their radius doubled.

action.name: The Sky Consumed (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A point of fire appears in the sky above the evoker, growing second by second as it hurtles toward earth. Each creature and object within 500 feet of the evoker immediately begins burning (1d10).

At the beginning of the evoker's next turn, the fire strikes it. The evoker and each creature within 500 feet of it must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 98 (28d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Condense Burst (6th Level Spell)

legendary.name: Burning Leap

legendary.name: Furnace Shield
entries: The evoker calls forth a 10 foot square, 6 inch thick opaque curtain of fire that lasts until the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space it can see.
Nonmagical ammunition that passes through this curtain disintegrates. A creature that passes through it for the first time on a turn takes 14 (4d6) fire damage.

legendary.name: Forgefires of Creation (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The evoker uses its Starfire Lance or Lava Geyser.

mythic.name: Apotheosis of Flame (Costs 2 Actions, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: White-hot flames engulf the evoker for the next minute, causing the following effects:

items: The evoker gains a 60 foot flying speed and can hover.
When the evoker would take any fire damage, it takes no damage and instead gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

The first time each turn that the evoker takes any damage, flames explode outward from it, forcing the evoker and each creature within 20 feet to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

entries: The guard makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with its Bulwark Bolster, if available.

action.name: Silencer's Grasp (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target is grappled (escape DC 15).
A creature grappled in this way that casts a spell must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the spell fail, ending the grapple on a success.

action.name: Hammerhand Blow (4th Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 16 (3d10) force damage.
A target affected by one or more spells that increase its AC takes an additional 5 (1d10) force damage and has one such spell end.

action.name: Scour Conduit (4th Level Spell)
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (8d6) nonlethal radiant damage.
Each other creature that controls a magical effect affecting the target such as a contract, curse, spirit possession, or spell takes the same amount of damage, then can choose to end the effect.

action.name: Bulwark Bolster (Recharge 5-6, 5th Level Spell)
entries: Up to four friendly creatures the guard can see each gain 5 temporary hit points.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Confinement Ring (1/Day, 6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A 10 foot radius circle of luminous runes shimmers into existence at a point the guard can see within 60 feet (AC 15, 40 HP, immunity to poison and psychic).

The circle provides total cover and blocks exit by nonmagical means, but freely allows creatures to enter. While the circle has all of its hit points, it additionally blocks teleportation and ethereal travel.

bonus.name: Sound Alarm
entries: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it.
Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

trait.name: Watchful Eye
entries: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

trait.name: Pillar of Order
entries: Hostile creatures within 15 feet of the guard have disadvantage on attacks that target creatures other than it.

trait.name: Lawkeeper's Fervor (2/Day)
entries: When the guard or another creature within 30 feet fails a saving throw, the guard can choose for it to succeed.
The first time each turn that the guard sees a friendly creature reduced to 0 hit points, it regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guard makes two attacks with its Spiritbreaker Greatgavel, one of which it can replace with a use of its Suppression Field.

action.name: Spiritbreaker Greatgavel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus one of the following effects:

items: The target takes 11 (2d10) force damage.
The target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Suppression Field (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A field of irresistible force blooms in a 15 foot radius centered on a point the guard can see within 100 feet, dragging creatures to the ground.
Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 18).

The cursed creature takes 22 (4d10) radiant damage whenever it starts its turn where the guard can see it. This damage can't reduce a creature below 1 hit point.

bonus.name: Constraining Command
entries: The guard points at a creature it can see and demands it be stopped.
Up to two creatures within 5 feet of the target can each use their reaction to attempt to grapple or shove it.

bonus.name: Enforced Appearance (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The guard targets an unoccupied space within 5 feet that a creature teleported out of in the last hour, wrenching the lingering magic.
The creature must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be teleported back into that space, or become immune to this effect for one hour on a success.

reaction.name: Irresistible Force

legendary.name: Mana Tithe (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the guard can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be forced to expend one spell level worth of spell slots for each point it failed by.
A creature that can't is instead dazed until the end of its next turn on a failure.

legendary.name: Manifest Law (4th Level Spell)
entries: The guard attempts to bind the magic of a creature it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw.

On a failure, the guard can choose a spell level, learning each spell of that level that the creature can cast, then can choose one spell revealed in this way; the target cannot cast that spell for the next minute.

legendary.name: Spiritshatter Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The guard moves up to half its speed and can make an attack with its Spiritbreaker Greatgavel.
A frightened creature hit with this attack becomes turned for as long as it remains frightened.

trait.name: Watchful Eye

trait.name: Swarm
