name: Froghemoth Elder

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the froghemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Shock Susceptibility
entries: If the froghemoth takes lightning damage, it suffers two effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The froghemoth makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks, and it can use Tongue.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:23 (3d10 + 7) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns.

The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to three creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands prone in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth. If the froghemoth dies, any swallowed creatures are no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit:20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

action.name: Tongue
entries: The froghemoth targets one Large or smaller creature that it can see within 25 feet of it. The target must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth.

reactionHeader: The froghemoth can take up to three reactions per round but only one per turn.

reaction.name: Alien Gaze
entries: When a creature the froghemoth can see damages the froghemoth, the froghemoth swivels its eyestalk toward the creature and pierces the creature's mind with its otherworldly gaze. That creature must make a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Leap
entries: Immediately after a creature the froghemoth can see ends its turn, the froghemoth jumps up to half its speed. Each creature within 5 feet of the froghemoth when it lands must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The leprechaun casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

trait.name: Industrious
entries: The leprechaun is proficient with all artisan's tools and adds double its proficiency bonus to ability checks made with them.

trait.name: Reluctant Refusal
entries: When a creature offers the leprechaun the chance to partake in merriment or revelry such as a song, a dance, or a good meal, the leprechaun must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 24 hours. While charmed in this way, the leprechaun partakes of the offering, treats the creature as a trusted friend, and seeks to defend it from harm. The charmed condition ends if the creature or any of its allies damage the leprechaun, force the leprechaun to make a saving throw, or steal from the leprechaun.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leprechaun makes two Cobbler's Hammer attacks and can use Spellcasting.

action.name: Cobbler's Hammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) force damage. If the target is a creature, its speed is halved until the start of the leprechaun's next turn.

action.name: Gift of Luck (1/Day)
entries: The leprechaun touches a creature and magically gifts the target a measure of luck. The creature gains the leprechaun's Astonishing Luck reaction. The creature can use the reaction three times, after which this gift goes away. The leprechaun can revoke this gift from a creature at any time (no action required). A creature can benefit from only one leprechaun's Gift of Luck at a time.

bonus.name: Cunning Trick
entries: The leprechaun takes the Disengage or Hide action or makes a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

reaction.name: Astonishing Luck
entries: When the leprechaun fails an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, it can roll a new d20 and choose which roll to use, potentially turning the failure into a success.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is grappling a creature, the memory web takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the web takes the other half.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: If the memory web is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the memory web move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the memory web is animate.

trait.name: Memory Flood
entries: When the memory web is reduced to 0 hit points, it discharges any memories it consumed over the past 24 hours in a telepathic deluge. Hazy, dreamlike visions of these discharged memories lodge in the minds of creatures up to 120 feet from the memory web.

action.name: Ensnare
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit:The target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The memory web can grapple only one creature at a time.

bonus.name: Drain Memories
entries: The memory web targets one creature grappled by it. The target must make a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the save automatically. On a failed save, the target takes 5 (2d4) psychic damage and becomes memory drained until it finishes a long rest or the memory web is destroyed.

While memory drained, the target must roll a d4 each time it makes an ability check or attack roll, subtracting the d4 roll from it. Each time the target is memory drained beyond the first, the die size increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on until the die becomes a d20, at which point the target is knocked unconscious for 1 hour. If a memory drained creature is the target of the Greater Restoration or Heal spell, the memory drained effect ends on it. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

spellcasting.name: Communal Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pech works with three or more pechs to cast spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (save DC 12). If at least three other pechs are within 30 feet of it, the pech can cast Wall of Stone. If at least seven other pechs are within 30 feet of it, it can cast Greater Restoration . Each other pech involved in casting the spell can't have the incapacitated condition and must have at least one use of Communal Spellcasting remaining, which it must immediately expend to participate (no action required).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pech has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

On a failure, the target is dragged up to 20 feet. If it ends this movement in dim light or darkness, the target is restrained in place (escape DC 12) until illuminated by bright light.

action.name: Repulse Light (3rd Level Spell)
entries: A torrent of shadows stream forth from the Shadovar in a 30 foot cone, pushing each light source in the area up to 30 feet away, or extinguishing it if it can't be pushed.
A creature carrying an affected light source can make a DC 12 Strength saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

action.name: Sculpt Shadows (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Shadovar creates 3 (1d4 + 1) Shade Stalkers in unoccupied spaces of darkness it can see within 30 feet.
The shades act on the Shadovar's turn and under its control, and disappear after 1 minute or if it uses this ability again.

trait.name: Nether Magic

action.name: Glimpse of True Nothing (3rd Level Spell)

A creature killed by this damage turns to shadow and melts away, disintegrating entirely.

action.name: Shadow Hollow (1/Day, 5th Level Spell, Concentration)

action.name: Shadowself Alliance (1/Day, 5th Level Spell, Concentration)

trait.name: Nether Magic

A creature cursed in this way recovers no resources other than hit points upon completing a short or long Rest.

action.name: Banish Hope (5th Level Spell, Concentration)

entries: The Shadovar conjures a semi-real Darkweaver that acts on its turn and under its control in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.
While concentrating on this spell, the Shadovar takes 5 psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns and can't voluntarily end its concentration.

action.name: Umbral Oubliette (Recharge 5-6, 8th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the Shadovar can see within 60 feet sinks into its shadow, falling into the great nothing that lies beneath and before everything.
The creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, and can use its action to attempt to claw its way out (escape DC 16), ending the effect on a success.
When it does, a creature within 5 feet of the space it departed can use its reaction to give the creature advantage on its check.

reaction.name: Embrace Loss (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the Shadovar would make a saving throw, it can choose to fail.
If it does, it gains 15 temporary hit points that last until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Shadow Slip
entries: The Shadovar teleports up to 30 feet to a location it can see that is not in bright light.

legendary.name: Stain the Soul (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the Shadovar can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of each source of bright light it can see until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Reave Spirit (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Shadovar makes an attack with its Reave Spirit.

trait.name: Vengeful Resonance
entries: The advespa has advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against a creature that killed a friendly advespa in the last minute.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Ironbite Mandibles (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.

action.name: Venomsong Chorus (Group Action)
entries: The advespa sings out a telepathic whine, agitating the venom injected into nearby creatures.
Each creature within 30 feet that is affected by an advespa's venom takes 2 psychic damage.
If three or more advespas contributed to this action, each affected creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or fall prone.

trait.name: Vengeful Resonance
entries: The advespa has advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against a creature that killed a friendly advespa in the last minute.

trait.name: Icy Torpor
entries: If the advespa takes any cold damage, it is dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The advespa makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Advespa Whipsting.

action.name: Speartalon Lunge
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
A dazed or incapacitated creature hit with this attack is grappled (escape DC 15).

action.name: Advespa Whipsting
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing plus 11 (2d10) fire damage and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dazed, poisoned, and burning (1d10) for the next minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature that this effect ends for is afflicted with Stinghollow Stupefaction.

action.name: Amberbile Slather
entries: The advespa spits a thick, foamy bile onto a creature grappled by it, which rapidly hardens into a brittle golden crust, restraining the creature (escape DC 12).
A creature restrained in this way is unaffected by gravity and is levitated 15 feet into the air whenever a creature within 30 feet of it casts a spell of 1st level or above.
This restraint ends if the target takes any bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Vengeful Resonance

trait.name: Icy Torpor
entries: If the advespa takes any cold damage, she is dazed until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Advespa Hatchery
entries: When the advespa dies, at the beginning of her next turn 10 Advespa Handmaidens emerge from her corpse.
For each 20 damage dealt to her corpse, 5 fewer handmaidens emerge.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The advespa makes three attacks, one of which can be with her Advespa Whipsting.

action.name: Speartalon Lunge
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.
A dazed or incapacitated creature hit with this attack is grappled (escape DC 17).

bonus.name: Implant Larva (Recharge 4-6)
entries: The advespa deposits a wriggling advespa larva in the wound of a dazed or incapacitated creature she hit with her Advespa Whipsting this turn (AC 12, 1 HP, remove DC 14).
Until the larva is removed, the target suffers the following effects:

items: The target stabilizes automatically while at 0 hit points.
Whenever the target fails a Constitution saving throw, it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Ironwing Flit
entries: The advespa flies up to 20 feet, then can use her reaction to regain one expended Legendary Action.

legendary.name: Amberbile Drain
entries: Each creature within 300 feet that is restrained by an advespa's Amberbile Slather must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, a creature loses an unexpended spell slot, then levitates 15 feet into the air, or is dazed until the end of the advespa's next turn if it cannot.

legendary.name: Surrogate Broodcall (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One intact corpse of an Advespa Malagyne or of a creature implanted with advespa larvae within 60 feet bursts open, and from it crawl 2 (1d4) Advespa Handmaidens.

trait.name: Minion

trait.name: Fleshy Morass
entries: When the lemure is hit with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damag, swathes of its ruined flesh cling to the attacker.
Until the beginning of the attacker's next turn, its speed is reduced by half and attacks made by it have disadvantage.

action.name: Cringing Cling (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage
If three or more lemures contributed to this attack, the target is grappled (escape DC 11) by one of them.

action.name: Quiverburn
entries: The lemure twitches and sobs as its flesh glows with heat, dealing 2 fire damage to one creature grappled by it.

entries: When the nupperibo is killed by any non-radiant damage, the darkness filling it spills forth in a 5 foot radius, filling the area with magical darkness for the next minute.
This magical darkness dissipates if illuminated by bright light produced by a spell of 1st level or above, or if cleared by a strong wind.

action.name: Blind Lurch (Group Attack)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage.
If three or more nupperibos contributed to this attack, the target is grappled (escape DC 13). A creature grappled in this way is choking and escapes if one of those nupperibos moves or dies.

name: Spinagon Drudge
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Explosion-Prone
entries: If the spinagon would be dealt any fire damage, its quills explode. Each creature within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage, the spinagon falls prone, and it can't use its Volatile Quills until it completes a long rest.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spinagon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with the Dodge action.

action.name: Soulprod Fork
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
On a hit or miss, the target has disadvantage on opportunity attacks it makes against the devil this turn.

action.name: Volatile Spines
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack. +4 to hit, range 20/80 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage and the quill is embedded in the target's flesh (remove DC 12).
If the target takes any fire damage, each quill embedded in it explodes, dealing an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage to the target per spine.

reaction.name: Frantic Scatter
entries: When a devil is killed by a creature the spinagon can see, the spinagon can move up to half its speed directly away from that creature without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Spinagon Shriekleader
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spinagon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with the Dodge action or a use of its Skulker's Flame.

action.name: Soulprod Fork
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Skulker's Flame (1st Level Spell)
entries: Pale, dim flames slither from the spinagon toward a creature it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (1d10) fire damage and begin burning (1d10).
A creature illuminated by bright light has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Grating Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The spinagon lets out a painfully distracting shriek, forcing each non-spinagon within 30 feet that can hear it to make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failure, a creature loses its reaction and up to one creature within 5 feet of it can make an opportunity attack against it.

action.name: Debt-Brethren Call (1/Day)
entries: The spinagon summons 3 (1d4 + 1) Spinagon Drudges to unoccupied spaces it can see within 60 feet. After 1 minute, the summoned spinagons are banished to whence they came, their debt repaid.

reaction.name: Frantic Scatter
entries: When a devil is killed by a creature the spinagon can see, the spinagon can move up to half its speed directly away from that creature without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries: The lemure makes two attacks with its Desperate Lunge, one of which it can replace with a use of its Bash Head.

action.name: Desperate Lunge
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is grappled, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

action.name: Bash Head
entries: The lemure slams its face against a prone or grappled creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw.
The lemure takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage, and on a failed saving throw the target takes the same amount.

reaction.name: Boil Back
entries: When the lemure is reduced to 0 hit points by damage not from a divine source or silvered weapon, it can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw.
On a success, the lemure grows a new body from its shed gore, regaining all of its hit points.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature.

This attack has advantage if the swarm is within 30 feet of a devil of CR 5 or greater.

action.name: Quiverburn Cluster
entries: The throng twitches and wails in pain, clumping around each other creature in its space as its members burn from within.
Each other creature in the throng's space takes 7 (2d6) fire damage, or half as much if the mob has fewer than half its hit points.

trait.name: Darkness Overflowing
entries: When the woundpack takes 10 or more non-radiant damage from a single source, its space is shrouded in magical darkness for the next minute.
This magical darkness dissipates if illuminated by bright light produced by a spell of 1st level or above, or if cleared by a strong wind.

action.name: Hellflesh Crash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (6d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has fewer than half its hit points.
On a miss, this attack instead hits the woundpack.

action.name: Lurching Jostle
entries: Each creature in the woundpack's space must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and be grappled until the end of the woundpack's turn.

action.name: Whispered Names
entries: The woundpack takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage, then each creature in its space that cannot see through magical darkness must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failure, a secret name of the Invincible Tyrant passes through the creature's mind, dealing 18 (4d8) psychic damage to it.
A creature that fails by 5 or more can choose to remember the name. If it does, the creature takes twice as much psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Nupperibo Ancient
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Seeping Darkness
entries: At the end of each of the nupperibo's turns, magical darkness emanates from it in a 10 foot radius, filling the area for the next minute.
This magical darkness dissipates if illuminated by bright light produced by a spell of 1st level or above, or if cleared by a strong wind.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the nupperibo fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Burgeoning Rupture (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the nupperibo is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 104 hit points and ruptures, hatching forth as a mature Baatorian.
In this form, the nupperibo regains 30 hit points at the beginning of each of its turns if it is in magical darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nupperibo makes three attacks with its Hellflesh Tendril.

action.name: Hellflesh Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.
A creature hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is grappled until the beginning of the nupperibo's next turn (escape DC 16).

action.name: Voice of Baator (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The nupperibo speaks an horrid word in the true voice of the hells, forcing each other creature within 30 feet that can hear it to succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 9 (2d8) psychic damage and be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Flee to the Shadow
entries: The nupperibo moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement in an area of magical darkness, it can then take the Hide action.

legendary.name: Hellflesh Slither
entries: The nupperibo moves up to half its speed and makes two attacks with its Hellflesh Tendril.

mythic.name: Devour Fiend
entries: The nupperibo's form stretches and splits, attempting to consume a creature grappled by it.
The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (5d8) acid damage, or half as much on a success.
If the nupperibo kills a fiend in this way, the fiend's spirit is wholly destroyed and the nupperibo gains 20 temporary hit points.

mythic.name: Rapture of Slime
entries: Acrid sludge congeals around each creature in an area of magical darkness created by the nupperibo, dealing 9 (2d8) acid damage to it.

trait.name: Chain Servant
entries: The chain can use the attack bonus of a friendly kyton within 30 feet of it, instead of its own.

trait.name: Hate-Fueled
entries: If the chain is targeted with a magical effect that could charm or calm it, or with a spell-nullifying effect such as Dispel Magic, it shatters and dies.

action.name: Rattling Lash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Barbed Coils

name: Kyton Clinker
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unnerving Mask
entries: Beneath its chains and wounds, the kyton always appears to be a deceased individual known to the observer.
Creatures who have had a friend or family member die in the last year subtract 1d4 from attacks they make against the devil.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kyton makes two attacks with its Hellforged Chains, one of which it can replace with its Bonds of Torment, if available.

action.name: Hellforged Chains
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the devil can grapple the target (escape DC 13).

action.name: Bonds of Torment (Recharge 4-6)
entries: One creature the kyton can see within 30 feet that is grappled or restrained by chains has those chains extrude spines of iron into it.
The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) piercing plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Bloody Dance
entries: When the kyton is hit with an opportunity attack, it can make a Hellforged Chains attack.

entries: If the gorebrute begins its turn affected by a condition that ends on a successful saving throw, it takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and can make a saving throw to end the effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kyton makes two attacks with its Gorechain Flail, one of which it can replace with a use of its Punishing Slam.

action.name: Gorechain Flail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

action.name: Punishing Slam
entries: The kyton swings a creature or object grappled with its Gorechain Flail into a target within 15 feet.
The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.
The grappled creature or object takes an equal amount of damage.

action.name: Flay Living (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The kyton's chains sprout flensing blades that eagerly carve away at the skin of a creature grappled by it, forcing it to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw.

On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and escapes the grapple.

legendary.name: Leaping Lash

legendary.name: Gorechain Puppetry (Costs 2 Actions)

action.name: Deathready Charge
entries: The barbazu moves up to its speed directly toward the nearest hostile creature it can see.

If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the target, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn, or become immune to this effect for the next minute on a success.

name: Falxugon Wormtongue
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Crossroads Traveler
entries: While standing at the center of a crossroads, the falxugon can spend its full movement to teleport to any other crossroads with which it is familiar.

trait.name: Refuge of the Damned
entries: While it is not incapacitated, the falxugon has immunity to all non-force damage. This trait is suspended for 1 minute if the falxugon takes any hostile action.

action.name: Agonizing Barb
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes an additional 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While poisoned in this way, a creature is considered paralyzed.

action.name: Immolating Touch
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) fire damage and the target begins burning (1d10).

action.name: Indulgent Visions (Concentration)
entries:
The falxugon touches a creature and plunges it into a vision in which its deepest desires are fulfilled, forcing it to make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is dominated by the falxugon for the next minute.

At the end of each of the creature's turns and whenever it takes damage, it can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Perfected Guise (Concentration)
entries: The falxugon shapeshifts into a humanoid form until it makes an attack, or back into its true fiendish form. While shapeshifted into a humanoid form in this way, the falxugon's true nature, alignment, and thoughts can't be detected through magic.

action.name: Infernal Throng (1/Day)
entries: The falxugon summons a Lemure Throng that acts on its initiative to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of it.

reaction.name: Assess Debt
entries: When a creature deals damage to the falxugon, it can cause that creature to be cursed until it deals damage to an ally. While cursed in this way, a creature takes 11 (2d10) nonlethal psychic damage at the end of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Devilish Dance
entries: When the falxugon is missed with an attack, it can cause each creature within 5 feet of it to take 5 (1d10) fire damage, and then move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Immolating Touch
entries: The falxugon moves up to half its speed and uses its Immolating Touch.

legendary.name: Leisurely Stretch
entries: The falxugon regains the use of its reaction, and the next attack made against it before the start of its next turn is made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Wailing of the Wretched
entries: The falxugon causes a chorus of horrid screams to echo through the mind of creatures of its choice within 15 feet of it. A target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become dazed until the end of its next turn.

entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Assassin's Passage
entries: Whenever the dogai becomes invisible, it can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that is in dim light or darkness.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 necrotic damage.
If three or more dogai contributed to this attack, the target additionaly gains a level of exhaustion.

bonus.name: Vanish
entries: If the dogai is in dim light or darkness, it turns invisible until the end of its turn or until it makes an attack.

name: Dogai Godhand
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Hardly There

action.name: Soul Grip
entries: Melee Spell Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) necrotic damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
entries: When Dispater would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
If he does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Dispater immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dispater makes two attacks with his Rod of the Banded Citadel, one of which he can replace with a use of his Rust-Wrought Ruin or Burning Tower Art.

action.name: Rod of the Banded Citadel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) force damage.
A creature hit with this attack for the second time on a turn must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
A prone target hit with this attack, or one that fails this saving throw by 5 or more, takes an additional 11 (2d10) force damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Rust-Wrought Ruin (6th Level Spell)
entries: Dispater disintegrates one nonmagical metal object he can see within 60 feet into a flurry of razor flakes, destroying it.
Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) slashing damage and begin bleeding (2d6).

action.name: Burning Tower Art (7th Level Spell)
entries: Dispater calls down a 100 foot tall column of red-hot iron in a 10 foot radius he can see within 300 feet.

Each creature in the area is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space, then must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) bludgeoning plus 14 (4d6) fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Black Iron Bloom (Recharge 5-6, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Veins of iron begin to spread from Dispater in a 30 foot radius, corrupting all they touch.

A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have a limb of its choice turn to iron, becoming unusable and counting as a nonmagical metal object for the spell's duration.
If each of its limbs are already iron, the creature is instead petrified until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Untouchable Defense
entries: When a creature Dispater can see ends its turn within 30 feet of him, he can teleport up to 15 feet directly away from it.

reaction.name: Prepared Contingency (1/Day)
entries: When a creature within 500 feet takes any hostile action against Dispater, he can negate its effects, revealing a way in which he perfectly prepared in advance for that outcome.

legendary.name: Obdurate Advance
entries: One column created with Dispater's Burning Tower Art moves up to 30 feet in a straight line.
Each creature it ends this movement within 5 feet of must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire damage and be pushed 10 feet away from it.

legendary.name: Weight of Evil
entries: One prone creature Dispater can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage.
A creature treats this save DC as 5 lower if it is Neutral-aligned, or as 10 lower if it is Good-aligned.

legendary.name: Raise Rod (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Dispater raises his Rod of the Banded Citadel and gravity increases in a 15 foot radius around him, making the area difficult terrain until the beginning of his next turn.
When a creature enters this area, Dispater can end this effect, then use his reaction to move up to his speed directly toward it and make two melee weapon attacks against it.

name: Mammon, King of Greed
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources

trait.name: Lord of the Third
entries: Whenever a creature reduces a devil under Mammon's control to 0 hit points with a spell, GP equal to that devil's maximum hit points teleport out of that creature's possession and into Mammon's vaults.
Additionally, Mammon can be attuned to any number of magic items at once.D

trait.name: Gospel of Mammon
entries: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of Mammon heals or grants advantage to one of its allies, it takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Whenever a creature in the area deals damage to one of its allies, it gains an equal amount of temporary hit points.

trait.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
entries: When Mammon would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
If he does, one friendly devil within 30 feet loses 25 hit points. If a devil is killed in this way, Mammon immediately regains a use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mammon makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Dispossess or Blackglass Skewer.

action.name: Covetous Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) force damage, plus an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage for each 1,000 GP worth of currency the target owns, to a maximum of 35 (10d6) additional fire damage.

action.name: Dispossess (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Mammon can see within 60 feet of him must make a DC 23 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target becomes unattuned to one magic item of its choice that it is attuned to. If a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it becomes unattuned to every magic item it is attuned to.
Each item that is affected by this spell teleports into Mammon's space.

action.name: Blackglass Skewer (6th Level Spell)
entries: Mammon thrusts a barbed spear of obsidian towards a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 69 (6d12 + 30) piercing damage and is dragged up to 120 feet towards Mammon, taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Blood Covenant (8th Level Spell)
entries: Mammon touches a creature within 10 feet of him, cursing it with a psychic link to him. While cursed in this way, whenever the target deals damage to Mammon, it takes an equal amount of psychic damage and can attempt a DC 23 Charisma saving throw, ending the curse on a success.

action.name: Bathe in Gold (Recharge 5-6, 9th Level Spell)
entries: Molten gold swirls to engulf a creature Mammon can see within 60 feet of him, dealing 55 (10d10) fire damage and forcing the target to make a DC 23 Strength saving throw, becoming restrained (escape DC 23) on a failed save.
While restrained in this way, a creature is additionally blinded, burning (5d10), and choking. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this effect is petrified into a solid gold statue.

reaction.name: Succumb to Plenty
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Mammon regains any amount of hit points, he can cause the target to become charmed by him until the end of its next turn, but regain double the amount of hit points.

reaction.name: Slithering Cringe
entries: When Mammon takes 20 or more damage from a single source, he can move up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Cruel Custom
entries: Mammon moves up to half his speed and makes a melee attack. If this attack hits an ally, he regains a use of his Infernal Mastery.

legendary.name: Wages of Sin
entries: Mammon or one devil under his control within 5 feet of him takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage, then immediately becomes attuned to a magic item that Mammon is carrying.

legendary.name: Miser's Due (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Mammon summons a Narzugon Oathchained that acts on his initiative to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of him.

entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target additionally begins bleeding (1d6) or has its bleeding value increase by 1d6 if it was already bleeding.

action.name: Seaforged Waveblade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
A creature hit with this attack for the second time on a turn begins bleeding (1d6).

action.name: Breaker Charge
entries: The sahuagin moves up to half its speed, then can force one creature within 5 feet of it to make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the sahuagin, taking half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Drowner's Call (1/Day)
entries: The sahuagin forces each creature it can see within 30 feet of it that is holding its breath to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature stops holding its breath.

reaction.name: Ravenous Surge
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the sahuagin begins bleeding or is reduced below half of its maximum hit points, it can move up to half its speed towards the creature.

reaction.name: Blood in the Water
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the sahuagin begins bleeding, it can make a Sawfang Bite attack against it.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The sahuagin has advantage on attack rolls against a bleeding target or one that is below half of its maximum hit points.
Additionally, the sahuagin can pinpoint the location of such a creature within 120 feet of it.

trait.name: Divine Hunger (3/Day)
entries: When the sahuagin would fail a saving throw while there is a bleeding creature within 15 feet of it, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Vessel of the Maw's Will (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If the sahuagin would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 136 hit points, and it shapeshifts into a Huge two-headed wereshark for 1 hour. Additionally, the sahuagin can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sahuagin makes two attacks. If its Mythic Trait is not active, only one of these attacks can be with its All-Devouring Maw.

action.name: All-Devouring Maw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target additionally begins bleeding (2d6) or has its bleeding value increase by 2d6 if it was already bleeding.

action.name: Verdigris Great-Trident
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack. +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the sahuagin.

action.name: Bloodletter Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The sahuagin exhales a stream of corrupted water in a line that is 60 feet long and 10 feet wide. If the sahuagin's Mythic Trait is active, it instead exhales two such lines. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage and begins bleeding (2d6), taking half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Ravenous Surge
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the sahuagin begins bleeding or is reduced below half of its maximum hit points, it can move up to half its speed towards the creature.

legendary.name: Hungering Tide
entries: The sahuagin forces each creature within 60 feet of it that is bleeding or is at half its hit points or fewer to make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a a failed save, a target is dragged up to 30 feet towards the sahuagin.

legendary.name: Tail Slam
entries: The sahuagin makes an attack with its Tail Slam.

legendary.name: Circle Prey (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sahuagin moves up to half its speed, then forces on creature within 30 feet of it to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened of the sahuagin until the end of its next turn.

mythic.name: Impact Ram
entries: The sahuagin moves up to half its speed, then forces on creature within 5 feet of it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is dazed until the end of the sahuagin's next turn and the sahuagin can immediately make a melee attack against it. A target that was already dazed is instead stunned until the end of the sahuagin's next turn.
